review_text: The airport is different from how I last saw it Its been renovated and finally reached an international standard Theres a lovely restaurant on the th floor called Oea I had a wonderful meal there Theres also a quaint but useful duty free section A first class lounge can also be found close to the Duty Free section Air conditioning and spacious areas throughout makes this airport impressive and comfortable

Living in Geelong this airport is great mins from my parents place and traffic is rarely a problem Check in is quick quicker with no bags check in online the night before stroll through security and a short walk onto the plane Only criticism is that the airport is small gates and only bar cafe and newsagents Hopefully with the new International terminal theyre cleared to build theyll upgrade the domestic terminal too
Lisbon to Salvador Bahia Flight plastic free The first one I have travelled with And they had Ipads to comfortable watch what we preferred The distance between the chairs was large

Apart from the usual lateness which one comes to expect from some regional airlines this was an excellent flight The aircraft was practically brand new and the cabin crew were professional Between booking and the actual flights it had changed its name from Afrijet to FlyGabon

I took KE from HKG to ICN in July As I have already known that it was a top airline I had high expectations on it The ground service was very good The seat was quite wide and the cabin crew were very polite The food was average but not many movies to watch Although it was delayed for two hours I think the whole experience is worth the price

I came from Bangkok to Doha and transited for hrs and then to my homeland Cairo I was frustrated to stay that long transit time but once i stayed there I enjoyed it so much The internet coverage and speed is awesome Perfect atmosphere perfect cleaning perfect toilets Unforgettable experience Thanks to each and everyone who participated at this huge well maintained entity

Nice clean provincial airport handy for Asturias Cantabria and Galicia The checkin hall is spacious and on the occasions Ive used it it has always been hasslefree The cafe is large and reasonably priced and the toilets clean There are a half dozen care hire booths in the airport I always use the bus to get into and out of Oviedo It is cheap euros single and runs regularly from the stop outside the arrivals hall Regular buses also run to Gijon and Aviles There are plentiful taxis if you want a more expensive drive in The only mild criticism I have of the airport is the time it takes to get through customs on arrival Other than that a pleasant airport which nearly makes flying pleasurable

Liked the airport of Edmonton Very efficient security and no big walking distances A nice bright design that make you feel comfortable Besides there are a lot of shopping and dining options here This Airport can be a role model how regional midsize airports should be

The signs at Fuzhou airport are quite helpful since available in both English and Chinese The border security counter has a rating system where you can rate them based on your experience If you dont speak Chinese it may be slightly difficult to get around Queue was quite long and it took quite long to find your baggage However it was an OK experience The staff was very friendly and friendlier than I had expected

Landed H from CPT and out in mins as no baggage Long walk as aircraft parked far Very nice and clean airport Really like the wide choice of outdoor restaurants in the garden Pup and go vehicles move fast Police and security officials visible

Most of the airport was hot Only felt moderately cool at the quiet area which wasnt quiet at all It was right next to noisy escalators and on top of an area where staff I assume they were staff would congregate and loudly converse The rest of the time I thought staff were loudly and the airport was nice enough Lots of restaurants and little shops although most closed at night I arrived and was in transit for hours Outlets everywhere and potable water available

Outstanding Customer Service from Air China Jakarta Airport Ground Staff On October nd I arrived from Sydney to Jakarta Qantas planning to board within hours on Air China CA to Beijing then to Madrid and Sao Paulo Due to Qantas airplane problems the Qantas flight arrived hours late leaving me with only hours to board Air China Unfortunately Qantas refused to give any assistance to facilitate the very short time for check in Talking to the Indonesia immigration agent he called Air China ground staff who sent an agent with a mission to help meI did not have a Visa on Arrival no boarding card and a checked luggage at Qantas The agent did everything to make me board the Air China flight talked many times to the immigration officers called Air China office to send a letter to the immigration and ran times to the Air China counter to try to solve all bureaucratic issues The agent and other Air China agents issued all documentation needed and ran with me and my luggage through Jakarta terminal be able to catch the flight Boarding the Air China flight CA in such a short time was a small miracle that was possible because of the competence and excellent service of Jakartas Air China ground staff

I took the flight K from Mandalay to Heho to get to Inle Lake as it is the quickest way to get there This was my first time flying with Air KBZ and it was a pleasant flight Checkin and boarding was very efficient The flight left Mandalay about minutes before the scheduled time and arrived about minutes earlier The cabin was very clean and seats were comfortable Cabin crew were friendly I will not hesitate to fly again with Air KBZ

Bangalore to Hyderabad My first time with Air Costa they been operating as a regional airline India for years A great experience the legroom was really good seats comfortable and the aircraft very new Its low cost so besides a glass of water it costs But given the flight time of little over an hour thats no problem The range of food and beverages looked good though The flight was mins late the only downside

Departure was fairly easy and quick and there was an English guide for completing the customs form You can only spend local money in the cafe or burger place but duty free only accepts dollars and euros Escalator up to departures and not big inside but okay and clean Arrival is very slow so be patient There is no queuing at passport control so I just took a seat on the side and waited until only a few people left and was much easier At customs you need to complete two forms and I couldnt see an English guide whereas there was one in departures so ask a local or fill it in best as you can and customs officers will help with rest There is a separate queue for tourists and they speak a little English make sure you keep the second copy as you will need it when you come to leave the country Taxi ride into centre around Som ie but youll need to haggle a lot Overall its a fairly small airport and arrival does take a long time but it seems they are trying to improve things all the time

The experience is a unique one and I also have a trouble on how to rate this airline We start off from Singapores Changi Airport and the check in was quite smooth note that their carryon is only kg we get our boarding pass finish security and customs we finally managed to board the plane the cabin crew was very sweet and nice we are not delayed however the landing was super bad

Small airport very friendly staff not too many food choices but the best for long layovers if you need a place for sleep plenty of big chairscouches comfortable and with outlets for charging electronics

Very small airport but there still are jet bridges which was surprising Everyone I met was so friendly and welcoming The bags were out very quickly Just remember to arrange the transport before arrival

The airport is very new and modern I have flown through this airport multiple times but this is the first time at the new terminal It is a lot larger than the original terminal There was finally free WiFi and it was pretty fast considering the internet in China It was mainly based off of Shanghai Pudong the airport I was actually flying to and had the identical announcement system that PVG terminal had Although there were a few foreigners including me it felt very open and very welcoming

LimaCusco and three other internal flights within Peru All flights on time and quality of aircraft pilots as in landing and take offs was exceptional Aircraft were almost new As all were clean including the toilets which cannot always be taken for granted on an aircraft that is subjected to multiple take offs and landings during the day FAs very professional A very good experience
Sorong to Jayapura Flight left almost on time Aircraft clean and comfortable with friendly crew and many empty seats at the back Inflight meal only a cup of water and a little breadroll

Dhaka to Singapore Good food good seating and comparatively better ground services at Dhaka Staff on board are just okay though My travel ticket price was high though Worst inflight entertainment service

Travelling in and out of Launceston Airport proved a pleasant experience Since the terminal is still fairly new everything seemed to be in very good working order Facilities were very good having large coffee shops and well stocked souvenirgift shop selling real Tasmanian and Launceston branded items Check in and customs were hassle free No time lost waiting for luggage or taxis

On December st I had booked a flight for my dad and his brothers to Cape Town I joined them we were helped by Thabile Mchunu at Counter and she was absolutely amazing My elders had never taken a flight before and he kindness and friendliness was amazing and helpful to calm the nerves

My son was travelling on Kids Solo as an unaccompanied Minor with a h stop over in Paris The departure from Dublin was delayed by hour The agents Mustafa and Laura at the check in counter went out of their way to arrange a new flight with KLM arriving half an hour earlier than the original flight They were extremely helpful and understanding We were very impressed with their professional approach and excellent customer service

My recent flight from Washington DC DCA to Philadelphia PHL with American Eagle operated by PSA Airlines was smooth and efficient We experienced a minor maintenance delay but on a minute flight it hardly made a difference The crew was pleasant and professional ensuring a comfortable experience The aircraft a CRJ is the largest in PSAs fleet offering a bit more space compared to their other planes Given the short duration of the flight theres really nothing to complain about it was a quick easy and wellhandled trip Great job PSA

I will like to thank entire staff of Air Asia We were on family vacation with my year old child and got amazing cooperation Without any hassle we could book seats and the entire journey was enjoyable Will like to be thankful to the pilots as the landing on all the flights was smooth I paid my gratitude to the staff personally too

I enjoyed the flight Check in was easy and the flight departed on time The staff were friendly and efficient The seat was comfortable too Only tea coffee and water is available free of charge which is no big deal given its such a short flight

Its always very relaxing to fly from to Nuremberg Its a really small airport but everything works so easy and uncomplicated You can get there easily by train a subway station is directly in front of the entrance or by car you can park just min walk away checkin is very fast and boarding too There is no shopping and not that many food options but when you just want to get relaxed and easy from A to B its perfect And the staff are nice too even the security staff is always goodhumored More airlines should use this airport

A very pleasant flight There was an issue with the bag drop but I had some friendly assistance The plane left on time and the flight attendants were helpful and friendly The new plane was clean and comfortable A small snack was served which was fine on such a short flight I also appreciated the free beer

In the last years Lusaka International Airport has been going through a re development programme which has seen an upgrade in its infrastructure The old style check in counters have been replaced and updated The airport has received new ground handling equipment escalators and lifts Having been invited on a press tour of the facility i got to see first hand what is happening The airport is very clean cleaner than some more developed airports I have seen in my travels

First time flying with Virgin Atlantic and very impressed Full flight but smooth boarding good legroom and good IFE Crew friendly and professional Flight slightly delayed due to ATC so arrived half hour late Only downside was the meal served a pasta dish that was a bit bland Would fly Virgin again

I was browsing airfares for a late November trip and I stumbled across a business class fare on JAL for much less than it usually sells for Approx USD for TorontoChicagoTokyoBangkok return YYZ ORD was on AA Considering I usually pay about for economy with my extra golf bag this seemed like a no brainer and I pulled the trigger on that fare the very next day That decision was the correct one Ive just returned from the trip which is an annual one and Ive never crossed half the globe and had it feel so easy A fully lie flat bed all the way except TorontoChicago and a completely private one at that The food was great the service was great the lounges were great check in priority and fast track immigration in TokyoBangkok It was as easy as travel can be Ive flown JAL in economy before and even then I thought it was a superior experience than our local option Air Canada which continues to disappoint every time I recall even in economy the seats were wider fewer total seats across instead of and the meals were better Well business exceeded expectations even after YouTube reviews had set them sky high I have no reservations about wholeheartedly recommending them If I were to nitpick and I was fully expecting it as everyone seems to mention it is that the cabin is kept too warm So I packed shorted and a tshirt for sleeping in It was manageable

Beijing Nanyuan to Hohhot China United is the only airline that uses Beijing Nanyuan a former military airport in the South of Beijing The airport is easy to get to and flights in and out of Nanyuan do not seem to be subject to delays as serious as those at Beijing Capital Theres also very little taxiing Checkin was quick easy but the checkin area is noisy and dilapidated Toilets at the airport werent great The flight was on a newish and the plane was clean Service was friendly and the bacon wrap for breakfast was actually very nice Takeoff and arrival were both on schedule Id use China United again just to avoid the delays at Beijing Capital

Was on flight with Vietnam Airlines from Hanoi to OsakaKansai on its business class Nothing to complain as ground staff cabin crew were professional and offered the best that they could Seat was comfortable I chose the Japanese breakfast and found that it was somehow delicious Inflight entertainment surprisingly was excellent with new movies and music album No WiFI onboard even in business class which may be something the airline should consider to improve

My husband and myself were at Alicante airport returning from a short break I am disabled following a subarachnoid haemorrhage years ago I really needed to feedback on my support from Carmen who reported she has worked many years in the assistance area she was so kind and helpful and made my journey much more settled I cannot thank her enough Regards Kath Robinson

Lanzarote to Lisbon via Gran Canaria with Binter Canarias Great airline First flight with an ATR later a CRJ to Lisbon Checkin easy and smooth Connection LPA easy Both flights great staff Nice smile Service on the first flight water and a cookie second flight a chooice of a snackbox sweet tapas mix We had the tapas served with canarian red wine water and later a coffee Second glass of wine served Great FA nice plane as seated and uneventfull flight Would fly them anytime

SVOSVXHEL Arrived mid morning from Moscow on domestic flight There seem to be a good number of piers to allow access to the terminal building Airport in the middle of being fully upgraded with building work everywhere estimated to be finished some time in Arrival was via various corridors that would not normally see passengers but the luggage was on the belt when we got there and then out into Arrivals Airport not that busy so things seemed to run OK Early morning Checkin for departure required basic suitcase scanning before Checkin which seemed a little slow Security Scanning perfunctory no need to get laptops out and shoes off with minimal queuing Facilities in Departure Lounge limited but sufficient Free WiFi available which was OK Boarding directly via pier smooth

Smooth arrival domestic in the new airport It is the only airport that I have arrived at that there is actually free onwards buses to most of the tourist resorts north of the airport about every five minutes I did not know about this free service but if passengers have lots of luggage they need to be mindful that it could be a long haul from the bus stop in their resort to their actual hotel I took a taxi from one of the three or four tax agencies outside arrivals they were actually half the price of taxihailing apps There were some nice airy restaurants in the arrival area and presumably these are available to departing passengers Five stars from me

Denpasar to Moscow Hard product ok as the aircraft has been flying for Emirates before with angled seats providing acceptable comfort Huge screen but only showing airshow IFE works on your personal device through a dedicated app Selection of movies rather limited Streaming with some issues during the flight Catering on level of premium economy Some choices but very basic food Wine available one white and one red basic quality No snacks between the two meals on a hour flight nuts only Crew trying to do their best very friendly Overall no consistent business class product huge room for improvement Value for money below average

On the plane the staff hardly gave us any water and the water tasted like the plastic cup it was in I am not surprised if anyone got dehydrated The legroom was good and the seat was okay Overall it was okay I wouldnt recommend it

A little and modest airport in the capital of Saxony Apparently the politicians and the government members of the state of Saxony gave it the right to exist to be able to travel by plane directly to and from Dresden and avoiding using the bigger and better airport in Leipzig one hundert of miles away I wonder if this airport is profitable at all Any how it is very clean and clear and it is the best way to get to Dresden from outside east part of Germany Airport staff seems to be much more bored then engaged
We loved Lynx It was Super affordable planes were on time and no delays We dont eat on planes anyway so who cares Will definitely be flying again

Check in smoothless immigration great lounge perfect When you arrive at the gate here comes the security check All Xray staff do NOT take care of your stuff You fold your jacket you find it in a wreck when you pick it up Put your expensive bag in a tray they take it out and put it directly on the conveyor belt Really this is not acceptable for Singapore I have a stars not for all airport staff but security staff They need to care more

I have used Monastir Airport now for years and whilst the queues at immigration can be slow at times I think the other facilities and friendly staff more than make up for this Transport links are excellent if you are an independent traveller

I have never expected that a smallscale airport can be able to provide outstanding and extensive services to travellers The airport was very clean and tidy and everything in the terminal was well organised Incredibly large number of facilities including an observation public bath A wide choice of restaurants was available and the prices were reasonable The sky deck was very large and great for phototaking Airport signs were very clear and staff were always eager to help travellers Convenient access to the city centre The airport gave us a great impression upon our first visit to Nagoya

This is a wonderful airport Staff providing good services to pick up luggage when arriving It has a good transportation centre with taxis bus routes to downtown and shuttle buses to other cities near Wenzhou Many shops in the airport selling products with affordable prices Wifi is fast This airport is expanding to have another much larger terminal by

The airport is well laid out the gates are simply marked and the staff are extremely helpful There is an information desk to the left of the entrance which will direct you where you need to go Considering this was my first flight and after having a head injury they allowed my parents to go through security with me to guide me through the process Security was slower than I have come to realize is usual and very confusing however once on the other side there were many shopping options and also a great deal of eating options There was suitable seating and the boards with times of departures were readily available The bathrooms were a little messy however

Incheon Airport generally has a nice and clean layout making navigation straightforward However my experience today at Security Lane was quite disappointing Out of the three passport scanner machines only one was operational causing severe delays I joined the queue at PM and only cleared security at PM taking over hour and minutes to get through For an airport of this reputation such inefficiency was unexpected Thankfully I had arrived early for my PM flight or I might have missed it While the rest of the airport experience is great the management should urgently address such issues

Astana to Almaty Staff was polite and the plane seemed new I hope it will continue to work like this After long stagnation in Kazakhstan aviation industry this was like fresh air even not considering the price of the flight Only inconvenience was lack of credit card payment support only cash support

This airport has excellent free wifi but lacks any decent shops or restaurants I stayed in the airport for hrs whilst waiting for a connecting flight The checkin agent wouldnt check my bag through so I was stuck at the airport The best area for wifi is on the nd floor There are powerpoints behind the bench seats for charging your laptop Airside there are small shops and a cafebar at the very end of the departure lounge where the wifi doesnt work As a capital city airport it is lacking in many of the things one would expect Without the wifi it would be very hard to pass the time waiting for connecting flights

Airport is small but functional Clean toilets and security is taken seriously We could not check in online but went through COVID verification and were questioned if we were staying in another EU country for more than days The airport police also gave warnings to people who did not wear their masks Repeat offenders were told they will be asked to leave the airport This is impressive first time seeing mask regulations treated seriously in EU For some strange reason though we were kept on the bus for quite a while prior embarking the plane

Attractive food comfortable seating In particular the flight attendants are professional and dedicated to helping passengers Head flight attendant Ms Hang and Ms Chi are very enthusiastic and very considerate in assisting passengers The flight crew is friendly and professional xut n hp dn ch ngi tin nghi c bit t tip vin chuyn nghip v rt tn tnh n cn h tr gip hnh khch trong sut chuyn bay tip vin trng c Hng c Chi nhit tnh lm v rt n cn h tr cc hnh khch t bay thn thin v chuyn nghip

I am pleased to commend Mdm Novia for her exceptional professionalism during our recent flight cancellation on November After our Citilink flight from Pontianak to Jakarta was canceled Novia managed all the necessary arrangements for our next flight with outstanding efficiency and kindness Her assistance made a challenging situation much easier and we are very grateful for her dedication and hospitality She truly goes above and beyond in her service

I came from Bangkok to Doha and transited for hrs and then to my homeland Cairo I was frustrated to stay that long transit time but once i stayed there I enjoyed it so much The internet coverage and speed is awesome Perfect atmosphere perfect cleaning perfect toilets Unforgettable experience Thanks to each and everyone who participated at this huge well maintained entity

Thessaloniki to Athens Very nice and comfortable journey Flight was almost full Used the website to checkin and a mobile phone boarding pass was sent making it really easy Crew was friendly and helpful Candy small snack and drink offered in this domestic Greek flight Luggage was included in the price and although I did not have any it made the cabin have much more space for peoples handluggage Timely and orderly departure and arrival Very good experience I recommend them on this route

I tried to avoid Santa Barbara at all costs for trip between Caracas and Miami roundtrip They had been notorious for very long and cruel delays Had no more choice and to be fair was pleasantly surprised that my experience was quite good Flew in an old but nicely refurbished B that I think has helped them regain some kind of decent scheduling For both roundtrip segments the flight was very much on time and they now offer economy plus as an option with lots of leg room Meals were ok and the staff very cordial I have to say it is much improved and would fly them again However it may still be a gamble in terms of on time departures

Flew out of Dundee Airport for the first time even though it is our home town when we are back for the summer holidays Friendly checkin staff and understanding security staff Yes it is a small airport and lacks the faciilities of say Edinburgh and Glasgow But after the Glasgow incident it was refreshing to drive to an airport and not suffer the issues encountered at other BAA airports The takeoff to London City provides a fantastic view of the Tay Will use it more often
London to Algiers There was a slight delay but the service onboard was excellent Clean very nice food and friendly personnel Very pleased with the whole experience Would fly Air Algerie again

For a small town scale Manado airport is pretty good Has several places for check in Several lounges equipped with internet access and good food The lounge area is quite spacious and has good service from Avsec This airport is set as the transit airport for Raja Ampat another greatest diving spot in indonesia located in Papua and also has an international direct flight like Singapore etc

We found Munich Airport to be an excellent airport very well laid out with two level gate system that seems to work very efficiently Very easy to follow signage good seating Check in and baggage drop off was well managed by friendly staff at Singapore Airlines service desks Gates and boarding in designated assigned groups seemed to work quite well Well presented airport

Flew from Prague to Rome Ciampino return with both flights spot on time noting that both legs were fully booked without any empty seats onboard No checked in baggage so headed straight to the gate The Ryanair mobile App is helpful apart from the nagging up selling but its understandable Its great boarding passes can be saved viewed in Google Wallet Boarding was managed well in PRG and CIA even with the full of passengers with Prague being strict on carry on luggage sizes as some fellow travellers were being a bit cheeky The cabin crew on my return flight were especially superb and professional with a smile Both legs were on a Boeing s I suspect there are no Max stationed in Prague One had an updated interior with slim seats and notably much more comfortable esp Legroom than the other although both were in top condition including cleanliness This product is ideal hassle free for quick flights around Europe

This is a small international airport The personnel are polite helpful and efficient Nearly everyone speaks understandable English and some speak other languages as well Whenever possible I use this airport as my point of entry to Mexico The few options for food and drink are very good and the prices are reasonable

Paris to San Francisco Read the reviews after purchasing my ticket and was quite worried Ive flown to Europe multiple times on multiple airlines and this flight was just the same as all the other airlines Economy seats are the same size as UnitedDelta Our flight was several hundred dollars cheaper per person than any other alternative Yes boarding is a bit chaotic and unorganized but that was not that big of a deal to me Yes there are no screens on the seats however they offer free WiFi with access to their entertainment on your own device that includes movies tv shows games and music They do not have charging in seat so bring your own portable charger if necessary Food was delicious and they had good options for purchase throughout the flight Flight attendants were very friendly and provided great service We sat in the back of the plane with seats together and that was great because the aisles were a bit roomier back there

The booking was easy via Zipair website reasonable price and good flight time The trip was pleasant in general the plane is clean new upgraded the staff were very friendly and polite and flight was on time But need to be more clear about the low price comes from not providing anything in return Like things are granted on other long flights hours for example a screen to watch movies games tv show this is unavailable on zipair there is WiFi to use on your own devices its not that strong anyway Other things are unavailable blankets no free non alcohol drinks even water I dont need to say food or snacks Thats all needed to be mentioned clearly on their website to be prepared ahead There are a few items available for purchase honestly the food could not be worse they bring it in small carton box water bottle thats it no tray no bread butter no dessert Otherwiseall good just needed to add these information and details make a plan to enjoy the trip

Ive been to Wroclaw Airport times Its fast convenient beautiful airport doesnt matter if it is arrival or departure The variety of shops and restaurants is adequate and the prices are normal airport prices A very clean terminal that is one of the prettiest terminals Ive been to Toilets are very clean Only problem is absence of air conditioning in buses between terminal and airplane its very disappointing and uncomfortable in summer

I have taken flights on V Air and found it a surprisingly pleasant experience The aircraft seemed new the FAs were very efficient and the meals prebooked at a discount tasty On the latest TPECNX flight I measured the seat pitch at If this is accurate then it puts many of the long distance flights on legacy carriers to shame The first flight in May was held up an hour at TPE due to runway maintenance The other two this month both departed within minutes of the advertised schedule Its about time there were low cost carriers between BKK and TPE I will happily take V Air for future trips

The Tehran lounge was really good free highspeed WiFi plenty of comfortable seating and endless snacks and food options which is really impressive considering that Mehrabad is a small yearold airport mainly used for domestic flights despite being international The A aircraft was really old but well maintained seats were very comfortable and featured a whopping m of legroom The interior was definitely upgraded from the original aircraft as things like touchscreens were nonexistent at the time the aircraft was built Bathroom was also clean and spacious A small amenity kit was provided along with some masks and a hand sanitizing gel A non alcoholic predeparture drink was served along with warm nuts The cabin crew were super warm and friendly a warm breakfast was served which was magnificent The service and amenities were unbelievable for such a short flight Though no WiFi was available on board and the IFE needed some serious improvement Also some snacks and refreshments were served before landing but I was too full to eat or drink so I just went for some water We departed on time but arrived minutes early and like all flights with Iranian pilots the landing was butter smooth It costed for a round trip in business class Overall really good flight and I would definitely fly Mahan Air again

This is a brand new terminal that opened just about nine months ago It is very well designed spacious light filled and comfortable with a limited yet sufficient number of traveler facilities Immigration both coming in and departing was quick and easy My only gripe is with the terminal and gate announcement system Every announcement in the airport even at the gate was totally garbled and not understandable There is something horribly wrong with the announcement system which really needs some immediate attention

Albury is a pleasant airport The staff are kind and knowledgeable There are gates departure and arrival The lines are short but it is still good to get in early The seats in the boarding lounges are somewhat comfortable When it comes to security its okay The airlines that you need to go through security for are Qantas and Virgin Australia but not Regional Express The terminal is clean especially the toilets The caf is overpriced but the food is ok The only shopping in the terminal is the caf Unlike most airports it is almost impossible to get lost in ABX The only drawback is that to get to and from the terminal to or from the plane you have to walk across the tarmac Out of all the airports I have been to ABX has been the best

Very little queueing times in both the domestic and international terminals Jacksons International has just undergone some big renovation work and is looking excellent with great shopping and cafs Jacksons Domestic still needs a bit of work especially in the departures hall but I understand plan are afoot A pleasant airport to transit

Cabin was clean Personal screen was big enough and a lot of entertainment programs were available Seat was very comfortable My personal area was spacious Tullys Coffee was offered with tasty chocolate Flight attendants provided quick and responsive service Everything was excellent

We flew from Sydney to Zhengzhou and vice versa on Tianjin Airlines recently overall it was a great trip ground staff were very friendly they even reserved a couple extra seats for us so that my two young kids could have a decent sleep on the way home cabin staff were also very friendly they were very helpful throughout the flight Legs rooms great food service was decent as well The only minor issue is their entertainment system was very old there were just a handful movies to select from also their D map system was not functioning for both sectors which meant you couldnt tell where you were currently other than that it was really a great flying experience
This airport has beautiful views of the tarmac and a nice and comfortable lounge with easy check in and very friendly staff The food is amazing with an amazing variety of restaurants

Brussels to Antalya Positively surprised okay we have been on a more recent airplane but it was certainly ok The children were well taken care of and the staff were very friendly Of course there is always one grumpy one which was also the case during our flights Closing off the curtain right in front of you while you want to bring your children to the toilet without any apologies not very polite The words just a second madam would already have been perfect Besides this we had nice flights

Nice clean and quiet little airport with good cafeteria Also the departure area has free Internet if you need to check your email before boarding I thought that was a nice touch We flew out of Plymouth on an Air Southwest flight and their staff are wonderful The only downside for us was an overzealous security officer That aside Plymouth has a lovely little airport and a super airline in Air Southwest will certainly fly with them again

Yangon is a relatively small airport Its setup is strange in that you are required to pass through security just to access the checkin counters Once in it appears you cant get back out so if youre there early you have to wait in an area with no services and no WiFi until your counter is open Air is circulated by fans only so it gets pretty warm They take security very seriously Luggage is scanned three times as are people We flew out of T which has gates so lines were pretty much nonexistent Immigration took about seconds We used the Priority Pass Lounge which was pretty sad and very cold so we ventured out about half an hour before boarding Shopping was sparse as was food and beverage Toilet facilities were basic but generally clean Gate services were good I recommend it because its the only game in town

Returning from my honeymoon to Mexico we flew via Qantas business on the way there and now our return trip is with Fiji Airways We have just finished the first leg and Im writing this while enjoying the Nadi business class lounge The flight was amazing I had my reservations because Im aware Fiji airways doesnt provide pyjamas and their menu and offerings are a little more restrictive than that of Qantas but I felt compelled to write a review because of just how great Fiji Airways were The cabin crew were the most attentive I have ever experienced and they memorize everyones names Even when youre not in your seat walking to get a snack or to go to the bathroom they were calling me by name asking me how my flight is and if I want a snack Comparatively on my Qantas business class flight the cabin crew dont speak to you unless they have to The seats were comfortable and felt nice and private When I went to make my bed crew ran to me to do it for me The pillow is nice and full they give you a mattress cover for your seat and a nice full doona as well as a blanket They served Mumm on board as the champagne which is a personal fav so that gets extra marks The food was not as good as Qantas But it was not bad I enjoyed the pumpkin and ginger soup a lot Was probably the highlight of the meal As my main I opted for the Fijian bbq chicken The potato rostis were a little mealie the chicken was flavorful although a little tough The passionfruit mousse was alright but nothing to ring home about The fruit plate had a nice selection of grapes blackberries raspberries pineapple rockmelon and honeydew I also opted for the standard brekky which consisted of an omelette tomato a chicken sausage Im not a breakfast person but it was ok Another comparison to Qantas no barista style coffee on board So I had to settle for an American style coffee which Im not a big fan of The entertainment system is really functional but needs a bigger selection of new movies Wasnt a whole lot on there that I was too keen to watch but I made do Overall the flight was really comfortable and I would definitely fly and recommend Fiji Airways The attentiveness and kindness of the crew really made the flight

Arriving at Blantyres Chileka airport is a colonial experience Arriving from Johannesburg the airplane is taxied in front of the arrival hall School classes have already been run out to see the big bird landing The building has a wooden veranda and there is a special area were people are expected to cheer after the president has landed The first time I arrived at Chileka the luggage was simply dropped on the tarmac The passengers had to fight to get their possessions Of course quite some passengers did not find any luggage at all as it had stayed behind in Joburg Immigration is quite impressive with a lot of stamps in passports and on listings To get out you have to go through a door then you turn sharply turn left and right Again left until you bump into the departing passengers and their luggage Since half a year we have a new arrival hall at our airport

Flydubai provides a pleasant and comfortable travel experience from Dubai to Kerala I am feet tall so I had plenty of leg room The food was tasty and sufficient and the service was good The positive experience is made better by effective boarding

Other reviews are clearly outdated so dont put much stock in them My arrival was around midnight and was fine incoming passengers were separated into Brazil nationals and all others and as a nonBrazilian I was quickly processed I found it odd that passengers exiting the terminal were forced to go through the dutyfree shop but this may have been a result of the late hour The departure was fine also scheduled for am It was confusing to check bags because only some of the checkin counters are visible when entering the terminal others are in a second row behind the first My carrier opened their counter hours before the flight and security opened about hours beforehand so I had a few hours before checking in There werent an abundance of seats but few people were inconvenienced I didnt see any lockers to store baggage Even at this late hour pm several shops were open like a news stand a snack bar a chocolate shop and a cosmetics shop Beyond security there was only one small news stand with a few snacks and water but it was also open There was abundant seating here All in all this airport is just fine

The airport itself is small and easily accessible The downside is the airport security staff The staff who greeted us first were pleasant and friendly but the ones conducting inspections and overseeing direct searches of people and luggage are gruff at best and grumpy at worst I think they need some training on how to be polite and respectful to passengers This isnt the first time that we experienced this kind of behaviour on the security line The washrooms are limited and in need of cleaning and an upgrade They could also use at least one area for passengers with pets so the animals can relieve themselves as seen in many other airports

Although it was busy Australia Day Public Holiday check in was quite easy The plane left on time and staff were efficient and friendly Only water coffee and tea is available for free but for a short flight I dont mind Overall a great flight and a pleasant way to end my Australia Day Break

Sunshine Coast Airport MCY services mainly flights to Sydney SYD and Melbourne MEL with some services to Adelaide ADL and seasonal international services to Auckland AKL New Zealand A new low cost airline will soon be operating from the airport which will make flights north to several cities in Queensland and other flights to Melbourne and regional New South Wales and regional Victoria The airport terminal is located in Marcoola about mins north of Maroochydore Private Airport transfer services Taxis Ubers and public buses service the airport however the public bus system does not run a timetable that would service all arrivals or departures Paid short term and long term parking is available with some of the long term parking having sails to provide limited protection from the elements There is also an offsite private parking business within the airport precinct that offers secure indoor and outdoor paid parking The terminal has Checkin counter areas for airlines at the northern end and a covered breezeway then leads to security screening and the departure area at the southern end of the terminal The luggage carousels for arriving passengers luggage are also located at the southern end of the terminal along with rental car counters toilets Luggage sometimes can take a while to arrive on the carousels as it appears the incoming aircraft is unloaded and the bags for the departing flight are then loaded before the arriving flight luggage is finally brought into the terminal and loaded onto the baggage carousel The departure area has food outlets that sell food and drinks at the usual airport prices as well as a few shops including a surf shop and a news agency books newspapers etc The northern end of the departure lounge also operates as the international departure and arrival area when the seasonal Auckland flights are operating at other times it forms part of the domestic departure area Gates serve both as Arrival and departure gates and their are currently no aerobridges so you will walk down stairs onto the tarmac and into the terminal Facilities are available for disabled passengers who cannot utilise the stairs The airport at times can be very busy especially if flights are delayed otherwise their is plenty of seating As most flights are coming from Sydney and Melbourne weather or other delays can have a knock on effect causing delays to outbound flights The real advantage of using this airport is avoiding around a hr min trip to Brisbane Airport on a good day when there are no traffic delays or accidents on the M to Brisbane Airport The airport is expanding and the terminal facilities will improve as part of the expansion project Overall a very good airport experience

Orlando to Jackson I am a frequent traveler and have flown my entire life My mother is a Delta flight attendant of years and when I was young she would take me on her flights I had flown over times before the age of Given this background I am very particular when it comes to my air travel Going into flying with Via I had my reservations as I normally stick to the main carriers but their service and in flight experience greatly exceeded both me and my fiancs expectations Would gladly fly with Via Air again and look forward to the next chance I get to fly with them

Was looking forward to flying with Solomon Airlines who were operating this flight on behalf of Air Vanuatu Check in was quick efficient and polite Boarding passes issued and invitation to the Air New Zealand Lounge where we sipped champagne and ate nibbles while we waited for our flight Boarding was quick and we sat in our allocated seats A C in Business Class Immediately offered champagneJuice or water before takeoff Naturally we had Champagne on this midday flight Cabin was clean airy and bright and the cabin crew were an absolute delight Friendly smiles everywhere and typical south pacific hospitality Lunch served was fresh very inviting and very tasty naturally followed by more champagne Flight time hours went by very quickly Even though the aircraft did not have WiFi no IFE and no charging ports that really didnt bother us as we were forewarned by researching in advance and we came prepared Its when youre not prepared travelling with kids and their electronic bits and pieces that they are forever glued to is where this could be an issue Be prepared Highly recommend Solomon Airlines and would be very happy to fly with them again

Arrival on and departure on Efficient and friendly airport staff even the immigration officers were welcoming It was supposed to be a domestic airport so the international terminal was nearly empty when we arrived Spotlessly clean no matter the departure or arrival hall toilets luggage claim Floor guide was very clear As impressive when we departed from the airport Before departure visited their domestic terminal Amazed with their friendly and helpless ground staff and the facilities despite the small size of the airport Three domestic terminals with good Japanese and western restaurants Observation deck was amazing that I could actually see planes takeoff and land very closely unlike Hong Kong International Airport where they charged The domestic terminals were busier but still spotlessly clean and efficient and it is close to the main city and subway station A fantastic tiny airport

Staff all very helpful in particular a lady from the special assistance team She went above and beyond what a lovely lady who clearly is very devoted to her job role We would choose to fly from Eindhoven airport again as our experience was so smooth and professionally handled Thank you such a small thing to say I hope this gets back to the whole team

Manila to Kalibo I am a frequent flier of AirAsia I am always happy with the service that I am getting Staff are really friendly This is a short trip to fulfil a holiday and fantastic service The best part is being able to sit within the exit row without paying for this

I recently had the pleasure of flying with Pegasus and I must take a moment to commend Adnan the head cabin staff for his outstanding service Adnan is truly one of the best cabin staff I have encountered in a very long time From the moment we boarded his attentiveness and warm demeanor made a world of difference especially for my elderly parents and me Adnan was consistently polite and greeted us with a genuine smile which created a welcoming atmosphere on the flight His willingness to assist no matter how big or small the request was evident and greatly appreciated A particularly challenging situation arose during our flight when an incident of domestic violence occurred between a couple I was so impressed with how he handled the situation He remained calm and professional prioritizing the safety and comfort of all passengers His quick thinking and ability to diffuse the situation by separating the individuals without causing further disturbance to the rest of us showcased his exceptional skills in crisis management He is undoubtedly an asset to Pegasus Airlines His dedication to his role and the wellbeing of passengers is commendable

Victoria Falls boasts a nice new terminal building that is uncluttered and pleasant I arrived for a flight to Addis Ababa and was immediately impressed with the pleasant surroundings of the terminal and its air conditioned comfort Check in procedures were swiftly handled and passengers then move on to clear security and immigration which are straight forward save for the fact that one has to deal with the nuisance of removing his shoes at security Following security one takes an elevator up to the departure level where there a number of shops very expensive shops and food outlets All of these were clean and presentable Restroom facilities were wellmaintained and clean Boarding was accomplished via an air bridge directly into the plane Surprisingly Victoria Falls International Airport is very straight forward and easy to negotiate Staff are friendly and helpful I feel that anyone traveling through Victoria Falls airport will have no difficulties or issues

This was a third flight with this airline during a three week period of a SE Asia tour but Im reviewing this because of the element of positive surprise for a relatively short flight The flight was delayed but apologies were given around because of its double city service this scheduled flight was also used for a Hanoi service A smooth boarding process was also met by using more spacious premium economy seats with snack and hot drink service compared to just water as before Cabin staff were friendly and efficient

Neat little airport The staff seem friendly and helpful If I remember there are like restaurants which is really good for a small regional airport The restaurants are decently priced If you pass through CAK definitely try the Buckhead Grill The terminal is fairly clean and a has a very expensive and modern feeling for a regional airport though the terminal kind of looks like a mall I think the worst part of the airport is the small parking During peak hours parking can get very limited The staff really knows how to get you from AB fast They handle rushes and long lines very well I recommend this airport instead of flying to places like Cleveland because it is a little less frantic and dirty

The Puerto Princesa International Airport had just opened its new terminal The terminal was clean and brand new The airport terminal had no jet bridge or ramp stairs so we had to deplane via an old fashioned staircase at the mercy of the weather thankfully at that time it was already dark The airport lacks formal transportation to the city center although the city streets is just a mere minutes walk away Definitely one of the best provincial airports in the Philippines if you consider dirt runways the norm

Loved it Takes no more than minutes from entering to get to the gate When you depart minutes It was like heaven compared to Toronto where there are long lines lots of computers and where it takes so long to get to the gate and where you dread the lineups getting off the plane for the same reason It is convenient it is quick clean and has a Tim Hortons

Luang Prabang to Vientiane CheckIn was fast well organized and the staff friendly The departure arrival was on time and the aircraft made a very well maintained impression During the flight despite the short flight time of only minutes there were small bites and drinks The seat absorbency was slightly larger than other airlines Overall a good surprising experience

Amazing service on this airline and consistently great as we flew a few times with them On time check in precision boarding and very friendly through out the whole trip even when it gets bumpy We will fly with Asiana Airlines again as this was the best service compared to Qantas Emirates Air France and SAS that we also used Thank you so much for looking after us on board

Clark Airport is well secured and accommodating for passengers and there are plenty of seats provided in the predeparture terminal There are also small food stalls for the passengers who can fill their tummy while waiting their flight to depart

This review is limited to Terminal A I havent flown through Terminal A in years but it still remains a very modern airport terminal It is spacious with plenty of seating and dining options especially at Gates A There is a rather long underground walkway from these gates to the main terminal A The walkway is beneath the tarmac and runways We dined at Legal Seafoods before departure to DFW Excellent food The terminal was very busy given the snowstorm and delayed flights Bathrooms were okay but could have been cleaner WiFi was very fast and easy to connect too Kudos to Logan airport snow clearing crews and the crews deicing planes Our flight to DFW was delayed but we managed to take off Throughout the storm planes kept taking off and landing

When cabin crew ask for your feedback and thoughts on how they could improve you know they are genuinely committed to improving service To be honest I could not fault them on our hour mins flight The plane was fairly new very clean and the welcome aboard and service throughout exceptional I had to compliment the crew on the food The steak was perfect and tasted as if it had been cooked onboard It bettered my steak experience from steak cooked on board in first class I really look forward to flying Aircalin again and experiencing that level of customer service and care Highly recommended

Had a missing baggage when landing at Victoria Falls Airlinks staff was very helpful in tracing and rerouting this baggage to Nairobi where I was when they traced the baggage Awesome customer experience

Experienced CMN last month arrival from Paris Orly with RAM and continuing to Muscat with Oman Air Had to retreive my luggage pass immigration and recheckin again All was very smooth and from the time the plane landed I was outside less than min later very impressive Agents were all polite and efficient The secret is like everywhere else Be patient respectful and polite and everything will be fine Will not hesitate to use this Airport again

Because of the items in the news about delays and queues we were quite worried about going to Bilbao airport We did have to wait a few minutes at passport control but not too long The airport is a new building very light and modern we didnt have to use any steps at all which was brilliant On our return journey we purchased food and drinks in the cafe they were nicely prepared and the area was very clean and tidy All in all a very good experience and the area can be proud of the facilities
Very good array of shops ahead of security Very modern very clean Far nicer than the other airports that Ive encountered in Brazil

A comfortable flight seated in a pair of two seats on the left of the aircraft The ground service and on board service were friendly and efficient and we were pleasantly surprised to get a tasty snack and an alcoholic or nonalcoholic drink on this short leg plus an Easter chocolate The flight operated about mins late There was no attempt to enforce the airlines policy on takeon baggage Luckily we were on early and could find space for our takeon bags over our seats but other people were struggling due to the suitcasesize bags allowed on board

The airport was great with chill music clean spaces and nice atmosphere overall We were departing in the early morning flying to Kyiv but still almost everyone stayed professional and kind despite the early hour The only thing that disappointed us was two workers at the passport control gate We were talking to them in English gave our passports but they did not even say hi Just went with the take off your mask as a form of greeting when they saw our document and realized we are from Ukraine First of all even if it was easier for them to talk to us in Russian it would have been nice not to hear such rude words and intonations Secondly and most important not every citizen of Ukraine knows or wishes to speak in Russian Which we clearly demonstrated by talking to the workers in English first Their responses and the looks they were giving us were not professional Again everything else was perfect and we enjoyed this little time we had at the airport

Rimini Airport is highly recommended as a way to access the Adriatic Riviera This smaller than average airport is located on the edge of Rimini MiraMare and is well connected to Rimini and the train stations by coach and a local tram service is not far away either The negative aspect is that the lack of clear signs inside the airport for ground transport could be very misleading for newly arrived passengers and lead the newly arrived into the hands of very expensive taxi drivers Rimini Airport has some nice shops and is well set out I highly recommend this airport

Tokyo Haneda to Sapporo return with Skymark Airlines First leg on Boeing NG New cabin comfy seat and generous legroom for a lowcost airline Even though I didnt purchase any the drinks and snakcs are sold at a cheap price Departure and arrival on time Return leg delayed for mins due to congestion at destination airport Return aircraft was an older Boeing Very warm cabin temperature But overall worth the ticket price Definetely better than AirAsia and JetStar
Everything was very good We used the lounge in the airport The services were great

Hugh brand new terminals both International and Domestic Check in was the usual full baggage screening but the lines were not long Once at check in again everything was easy as we were a group of our tour guide checked all the bags as we just sat and waited all very efficient Airport vast and very clean once in departure lounge on upper level there were shops for snacks and good coffee or tea Announcements made over loud speaker system but very difficult to understand

Visited Uganda on and departed on Both arrival and departure experiences were smooth Arrival hall is rather large There is mandatory health screening before one can proceed to visapassport control Obtaining a visa is relatively easy Present valid passport and make payment Baggage claim appeared to be a rather large area with perhaps carousels At departure level the lighting seems rather deem There is the mandatory screening of bags before you can enter and check in for the flight The staff is very friendly The facilities are clean and the departure hall appears small given the amenities gift shops dining and duty free The Karibuni Lounge is excellent It puts to shame US airline lounges in the USA with its food offerings and amenities Bathrooms are cleaned frequently by an attendant Overall no issues with EBB airport Immigration control staff are very friendly The only drawback to this airport is that passengers have to be dropped off in the parking area and then make their way around the roadway to the departure level
Everything about the flight experience went well I was worried reading the other reviews but in the end it was a very positive experience The terminal in El Nido is also very good

Funchal to Porto Santo This minutes flight is a true experience Aero Vip carries out the public service obligation connection between Funchal and the smaller Porto Santo airport located on the island with the same name The outbound flight was on a vintage Jetstream turboprop airliner with the return flight being on a slightly older Jetstream In both cases the safety briefing was carried out by the first officer himself as the plane does not have any FA on board The outbound flight left right on time and touched down in PXO just minutes later The plane on the way back arrived late and we left PXO with some minutes of delay again reaching our destination in slight over minutes The planes interiors are quite worn out but overall the planes gave me the impression of being in a good mechanical shape If you take this flight to reach the beaches in Porto Santo as was my case the whole flight is a really fun and unique retroexperience for aviation enthusiasts which unfortunately comes with a hefty price tag EUR return It needs to be said however that the rates are much cheaper for residents who need this flight as a means to ensure territorial continuity

Easy access by car Small but spacious building A couple of cafes landside and large cafe airside Plenty of seating and clean toilets Smooth processing at the xray check point and plenty of screens with info as well as clear PA system Excellent wifi A pleasant experience

Departed from Bangalore to London on BA from the new T in Bangalore Terminal is clean fresh and very green There is a green wall and several waterfalls Not what I had been expecting in India Both security and immigration very efficient and egates used to enter the airport Admittedly it was am when I entered the airport and therefore very quiet Not all the concessions airside are open yet but many are Choice of several places to eat and a decent duty free area Most pleasantly surprised

On time departure and arrival for all flights Flights were relatively smooth Aircraft clean with friendly flight crew providing the usual no frills service IFE worked flawlessly with a good selection of movies DALHOU CUNBNA and BNADAL were on B aircraft This type of aircraft has no power ports to charge personal devices Further there are no trays in the armrest in row HOUCUN was BMAX This is a gorgeous aircraft with large overhead bins and mood lighting

Jakarta to Singapore onboard their Airbus Aneo Checkin was absolutely fast and they did not overcharge me for being a tad overweight having prepaid for my bag The ground staff honored my window seat request without issues Boarding started early and the flight attendants were already friendly right from the start as if they were already having a very nice sleep and ready to go While I admire the freshness cleanliness and condition of the cabin their decision to fit boring oldgeneration Collins Pinnacle seats is something I always despise these seats were thick which gave me less legroom compared to other slimline seats It was however userfriendly and quite comfortable if you get past the legroom Boarding started way before departure time but that had no effect on ontime departure as we left minutes late well it was just so definitely not a complainworthy issue I was given a bottle of water on this flight due to me having purchased the bundle If I remember correctly this was not mentioned in their list of benefits upon booking so I took it as a very nice gesture I could tell that the cabin crews were very seasoned and had done their job for years they were friendly courteous and awesome throughout the flight Landing was done early and upon arrival my bags were already waiting for me tidily arranged by the Singapore ground staff Citilink called themselves Supergreen and they earned a Supergreen light from me no wonder they are a star airline Based on this flight alone I was more than satisfied

Just flew on a oneway flight from Zurich to Sarajevo and was extremely pleased The flight was carried out by their ATR aircraft which looked pretty new and was clean too We both departed and arrived early which I found great however What Id noticed is that the only type of entertainment they offered on board were the magazines in the seat pockets which were rather boring but this was after all a small aircraft so I wouldnt have expected anything else The plane was surprisingly full there were only about three unoccupied seats on board The inflight meal consisted of a very tasty sandwich and a wide selection of drinks Very kind cabin crew and they spoke really good English which was great I definitely recommend flying BH Airlines

It is a mediumsize International airport located in the city easy to arrive Served with all the big airlines companies in Brazil and also Surinam Airways TAP Portugal and flights to Miami and Fort Lauderdale by LATAM and AZUL The terminal is clean and offers lots of options for shopping and food The departure lounge could be bigger Sometimes it is filled of people and the seats are not enough The staff are good and prepared

The airport terminal was built from scratch beside the old building currently closed It has a huge skylight from end to end making good use of natural light that reaches all floors through an atrium Many sculptures are integrated in the project which gives it an interesting touch Facilities are good enough The local delicacies stores are surely to be visited Totally sets itself apart from most Brazilian airports whose problems usually begin at finding a parking spot and extend through all possible aspects up to the boarding ramps

Other reviews are clearly outdated so dont put much stock in them My arrival was around midnight and was fine incoming passengers were separated into Brazil nationals and all others and as a nonBrazilian I was quickly processed I found it odd that passengers exiting the terminal were forced to go through the dutyfree shop but this may have been a result of the late hour The departure was fine also scheduled for am It was confusing to check bags because only some of the checkin counters are visible when entering the terminal others are in a second row behind the first My carrier opened their counter hours before the flight and security opened about hours beforehand so I had a few hours before checking in There werent an abundance of seats but few people were inconvenienced I didnt see any lockers to store baggage Even at this late hour pm several shops were open like a news stand a snack bar a chocolate shop and a cosmetics shop Beyond security there was only one small news stand with a few snacks and water but it was also open There was abundant seating here All in all this airport is just fine
Kiev to Odessa but they serve sandwiches and the whole range of beverages B clean Plenty of legroom Flight was ontime Its worth the money

Singapore to Davao Pretty decent flight with a very well organized crew Happy to serve and with a smile from crew members The style of the seats is a bit old fashioned color of the seats There is no entertainment on the plane but you can connect to the WiFi and get the movies on your device but only if you have the SilkAir app Silk air should let us know in advance before you get a h flight

Handy and efficient airport and friendly service However complete disregard of Government standards in respect of refunds Coronavirus Car park booked and paid for in advance on non flex basis Refund refused despite HM Government Competition and Markets Authority direction Beware sharp practice

Chisinau Airport is going thru a massive renovation and expansion However it is a clean bright and vibrant airport with new dining areas upgraded infrastructure and trained staff There are regular mini busses linking airport with city an official taxi service and a lot of unofficial taxis random private individuals offering taxi service There used to be A bus express line but I am not sure if it still in service In the common area there are some restaurants and other airport services The passport control and security is working fast and efficient There is a big duty free shop with usual goods tobacco alcohol cosmetics etc On the first floor stairs from the duty free shop there is a nice cafeteria Fly Away with good food and decent prices There is also a nice playground for kids The waiting area is renovated looks green and great Very comfortable chairs plugs and USB pots for charging your devices and hours limited free wiki Its a small cosy airport in a continuous development and expansion

Such a comfortable and convenient airport to use The relaxed feeling that I experienced was something you dont normally feel in airports Everything and everyone seemed to be at a relaxed pace and the friendliness of the immigration staff was very pleasant The baggage arrived promptly and even the customs staff seemed very friendly as I passed by At the exit to the car park I was asked by a couple of international visitors if I could assist them as they lost their car park ticket I went with them to the car park and visitor reception desk and the two ladies there were very understanding and helpful There were hand sanitising dispensers and hand towels available throughout the concourse and what is different about Shannon airport is that the sanitising foam dispensers were well stocked compared to other airports that all seem to have the dispensers but they are all empty

Every time on arrival from either holiday work meetings interstate or visiting relatives in Melbourne I feel all the renovations look great but please put the car park ticket machines near the carousel arrival hall out of the weather When some people pay at the gate they hold up the traffic I travel with Virgin regularly and cant wait for the renovations to be finished

TokyoOsakaTokyo Starflyer has the best costperformance ratio of the market very comfortable leather seat in A Easy to get emergency exit at check in when requested but still at least inch legroom Drink service PTV footrest for hour flight and professional attendants At a unbeatable rate when booking a bit in advance even less than the Shinkansen The only drawbacks are the lack of frequency for Osaka comparing to JL or NH still OK with flights per day

As I was travelling in Emirates Business class from Tehran I was able to use the VIP terminal just around the corner of the main terminal It was very clean stylish and modern for Iranian standards Emirates passengers got to use the whole second floor which provided a good buffet nice leather seats clean prayer room and very clean toilets The customer service and security checks were also quite decent despite being busy during the day

I arrived on a national flight from Guadalajara The gates of the Tijuana Airport are quite modern with jetways at each gate There are restaurants and shops along the concourse It was necessary to have my passport checked by an immigration officer who saw it was a US passport and waved me through without looking at it The customs inspection was minimal The baggage claim area is OK When I checked in for my departing flight I found passengers were required to go through screening and customs inspection to enter the checkin area It is possible to exit and go outside while awaiting boarding time after you check in The street entrance to the airport is under construction and it is necessary to walk past the boardedoff areas to enter the terminal There is a bus station at the airport right by the terminal for shuttle buses to CA Overall this airport is not bad and will be very good once construction is completed

Its been decades since I last traveled through Nashville The transformation of this airport is amazing The international arrivals facility has Global Entry but no Mobile Passport Control Give yourself plenty of time at least hours to make connecting flights The lines care very long and the distances from the gates to Immigration and Customs are very long The terminal was very crowded however with wheelchair assist we were able to breeze through Immigration The only drawback is that one has to exit the secured area and go through TSA security all over again with very long lines Once youre through the security one is met with wide open very clean and brightly lit concourses with dining and shopping aplenty Restrooms were very clean The free airport WiFi was easy to connect to and very fast

On June airport started renovation of taxiways as well as the installation of a new apron The inside of the airport is very clean it is easy to orientate the construction of a new terminal will begin The runway lighting is bad but will also be updated soon I very much hope that everything will be fine and that it will be easier and safer to travel
Good airport nice shops and the seating is comfortable great restaurants very respectful staff and flights always on time
Excellent also it is not as large as other mainly international airports it is the largest airport in Shandong province There are many attractive airlines and aircrafts in this airport

Please please get some training for your check in crew miserable is a mild word I have travelled to Guernsey twice this year and both times the check in crew seem to be doing all pax a favour Many years ago in BMI times in Guernsey this would not have been tolerated All over Guernsey one gets superb service until you get to the airport and check into or ask a question on the Flybe desk Having worked in tourism for many yearsincluding Guernsey I feel you are doing Fly be a great disservice The flight was excellent and on time Hope next time I will see a change

A typical small Australian airport which operated well Some distance out of the city it is served by a bus and taxis fare Check in was easy there being more than enough desks for the traffic Security was efficient with a bookshop and cafe airside All gates are walk to the plane which are never far away Compared to many this is a nice airport

Love John Wayne Airport it is close and convenient to the I and everything in southern California It is a lot easier to get in and out of than LAX and so much more modern Flew from here to Portland recently and going through security and checking in the bags was a breeze

This review is for Terminal Terminal is dramatically different RGN has undergone vast changes during the last years There remain remnants of the underdeveloped facility that once was but the outside world has arrived in Yangon and at least as far as the airport is concerned it is a good thing CustomsImmigration at both arrival and departure is reasonably fast On the absolute worst day you might wait minutes but an average wait will be minutes or less Lines at check in counters move quickly which is terrific Departure lounges are a lot nicer than they once were Now they sport clean comfortable spaces dependable WiFi and food that works in a pinch Restaurants in the airport are not great but if you want a decent cup of coffee some KFC a Burger King something or other youll be ok Souvenir and duty free shops still have a long way to do Alcohol and cigarettes are fairly priced There are perennially empty luxury clothing brands without customers There are a couple of small boutiques selling attractive textiles carvings local bath products delicious local coffees etc Services are generally more than adequate in the predeparture areas There is a bag wrapping counter for flimsy luggage convenience stores plenty of seating free WiFi etc Taxis downtown should be priced out before you leave Money Change desks offer the exact same rate as all the other places in the country so theres no reason to hold on to your foreign currency The airport is still a work in progress but leaving and arriving in this amazing city is a lot less unpleasant than a few years back

UIOCCS There were no problems to speak of nor was the experience extraordinarily positive First off I should say that I had problems in booking via the Santa Barbara website and so had to visit their agency in Quito I had my bags fairly thoroughly checked by migration people in Quito but thats understandable given the flow of drugs in the region The flight itself was fine Boeing no obvious neglect crew were friendly enough food was decent We did leave about mins late At the Caracas end our bags were slow in arriving It seems that there are problems but you may get lucky and avoid them as I did

Was surprised how good it was Very nice and smiling crew bed quite comfortable good choice of drinks Did not really like the gluten free option as I got the same meal twice Ground service was a disaster

Went on holiday in May flights where changed by TUI so we ended up flying with Titan Airways I must say they were fabulous beautiful planes and the staff were friendly and great with my little girl who is years Would love to fly with them again

This used to be the old airport for all departures from KL but after this trip I realised this airport isnt old at all In fairness the upgrades have given Subang a good uplifting and made the airport hasslefree for passengers Theres a good restaurant upstairs serving hot food We didnt have any difficulty getting to the gate and we got there with time to spare Signage was good airport checkin and security not too difficult to clear For local and regional departures Subang would be the airport I will consider from now on

BirminghamShuttlesworth Airport is absolutely exceptional across the board Modern well laid out and astonishingly clean Good facilities throughout Parking easy and close to the terminal The modernization of all the facilities done smoothly I live miles away close to another commercial airport but gladly drive the three hour round trip to fly from BHM as I will in April

Its a small airport at an island abt km from Rijeka Checking in and out goes quite fast at our experience Some staff members in the shop are kind of grumpy Nevertheless we are very happy with this airport how they have arranged a hotel in Opatija for our group when our flight was cancelled all of a sudden in the evening Our flight company Transavia told some people to find and book by themselves a hotel but the airport arranged bus transport and a luxurious hotel so our compliments

Great experience at arrival Very friendly staff welcoming all the way Quick check of Thailand Pass with no waiting time as smooth through immigration The bags already on belt when we came to arrival hall

Flight from Karachi to Islamabad plane flight was pleasant and no turbulence during the whole flight enough leg space to stretch your legs as being a domestic flight there wasnt any entertainment available but the food was excellent Even though the airline is cheaper than other airlines in terms of service and satisfaction it has an edge over its competitors
