KigaliParis th Dec on one of their A aircrafts Checked in online smooth but is unnecessary and does neither add value nor gain time I chose an entire seatrow for free due to my Gold Status with Rwandairs Dream Miles Program Marburg declarations forms have to be filled prior to enter the airport Checkin slow minutes per pax but they managed to checkin luggage onwards with other airline Dream lounge in Kigali is a pleasure with panorama windows over town Catering options varied a bit sparse the best hot snacks appear not to reach the lounge easily only on firm request I suspect that they are consumed by lounge staff have seen indications hereof Wines are subpar No sparkling wine offered Flight on time full on time Seafood meal preordered and given Generous catering They gave me on early request an entire row onboard for better sleep Blankets earset and pillows given Very affordable ticket USD tr purchased months before departure Extremely good value for money Miles given

The booking was easy via Zipair website reasonable price and good flight time The trip was pleasant in general the plane is clean new upgraded the staff were very friendly and polite and flight was on time But need to be more clear about the low price comes from not providing anything in return Like things are granted on other long flights hours for example a screen to watch movies games tv show this is unavailable on zipair there is WiFi to use on your own devices its not that strong anyway Other things are unavailable blankets no free non alcohol drinks even water I dont need to say food or snacks Thats all needed to be mentioned clearly on their website to be prepared ahead There are a few items available for purchase honestly the food could not be worse they bring it in small carton box water bottle thats it no tray no bread butter no dessert Otherwiseall good just needed to add these information and details make a plan to enjoy the trip

I used this airport several times past few years This time I was traveling to Greenville SC I found the Airport was improving in terms of services and facilities This airport is not too large one but it has all basic facilities Moreover it is located in the central of Washington DC

This is my second trip using this Airport This is a far superior experience when compared to the main international airport KLIA especially at the immigration Department The staff are friendly and helpful It took us less than minutes to clear immigration and custom The airport is clean and free wifi is provided I would highly recommend this airport if you are travelling within Malaysia or South East Asia

A small airport with a modern purposebuilt terminal with direct raillink from the city With only one flight to serve on a Sunday afternoon service all round should have been and was excellent Plenty of seating although that in the bar was a bit utilitarian

Arrived into Grand Cayman from Miami on Saturday night Immigration took minutes and bags were already off the belt when we came into baggage hall Only recommendation is a larger canopy by car pick up point as needed during heavy downpour we got very wet On departure took minutes from arrival to check in and clear customs check Limited seats at gates but more seats to right hand side as you enter departure lounge A bit warm but not too bad More space needed by desks at each gate as gets crowded Food and shopping limited but sufficient Few restaurants and duty free but food items very expensive Boarding is via walk to plane which is great if weather is good Passengers were crowding the gate before Boarding Zones were called All in all a good airport experience at a small airport

Bagan to Heho Very short flight again another ATR aircraft as a nervous passenger I was not looking forward to the flight but it was great Seating was no seat numbers given as only a few passengers on this flight No Inflight snack but coffee or cold drinks were supplied All in all a good flight and would travel again

TallinnAmsterdam is a short flight but crew were nice helpful and were able to understand at least languages they helped my Dutch Grandmother who speaks no English Amenities not normally provided but because flight was near empty they gave out snacks plus complementary tea and coffee They also allowed us to sit in vacant seats which was nice In general a nice trip and much more than was expected for basically a regional airline

ZHRGVAVCE and back Checkin at Zurich and Venice airport very quick and efficient Good connection times at Geneva airport much better than other carriers Flights departed on time and arrived early Flight Attendants very friendly both ways Flew over the Alps which was nice but small amount of food served on the flights Overall did the job Looking forward to my next trip with Darwin in July

When I arrived at this airport from incheon the immigration lines were long It took me more than an hour to get out of the airport I headed to Incheon a few days later Security and immigration was actually fine although I found the facilities a little old There were plenty of places to shop and relax but I wished that there were more food choices Overall this is a small but functional airport

You might use Moscow Vnukovo when flying to cities within the CIS on regional airlines or catching a charter flight to Turkey Egypt etc The airport is located southwest of the city it takes about minutes and Roubles tofrom Yugo Zapadnaya metro station by minibus in normal traffic taxi drivers ask the usual extortionate rates as in Sheremetyevo The building is very small and displays a bizarre mixture of typical drab Soviet facilities and shiny renovated areas that you could almost call Scandinavian Arriving at about am on a redeye flight I was greeted by a pack of stray dogs roaming the street outside the terminal but then I was able to wait for the first bus into town while having an excellent cappuccino in the new cafe inside the arrival area with plenty of seats and cheerful service from the very friendly staff Immigration is the same as everywhere else in Russia even though this was the only place where I was asked to produce a copy of my invitation and health insurance On an afternoon visit the departure sector which is located on the same level as the arrivals was almost deserted Services on offer are scarce one exchange office with ridiculously short opening times one Atm one cafe a couple of windows selling airline tickets and providing general information in Russian exclusively Everywhere around the airport there are obvious signs of big renovation works going on Im really curious to see what comes out of it in the future All in all one of the most relaxed ways tofrom Moscow and Russia

The gate agents are great but they might have the most inefficient TSA security checkpoint Ive ever witnessed It took them around minutes to scan bags and only one was flagged out of the They seem to be the only airport where the analogic machines have actually made the security checkpoint slower which is wild considering the technology of those things Everywhere else seems to have competent people to run them

I could not believe this was the first time I had arrived and departed from Tokyo Haneda Airport When I first arrived immigration was straightforward and I was very impressed When I was leaving checkin was also pretty straightforward and the whole Terminal was massive with great lounges shops and food Plus I got to do plenty of plane spotting from lounges

This was the first time we had used Coventry Airport to travel to Barcelona Having been used to departing from the larger airports oh how we laughed The porter cabin style check in and the cattle shed style arrivals made us laugh and laugh The coffee shop was like having a cup of tea in your front room What fun to be escorted to the plane by the same person who checked us in we wouldnt have been suprised if they had flown the plane too The only hitch was when we arrived back there was already a flight in we were held on the plane while they found someone to escort us to the so called terminal We giggled at the thought of someone shouting Stan Can you leave the loo cleaning and get the next lot off the Barcelona flight We will be using Coventry again if only for a good laugh

A small airport maybe or passengers a day I am guessing Fifteen flights a day AA to CLT and DFW DL to ATL And UA to DEN and IAH The plusses Fast From drop off to gate in maybe minutes max Friendly staff especially at TSA Small town helpfulness had a cell phone left on a plane returned to the check in desk before I got there to ask for lost and found Nice new departure hall and baggage claim Very airy with lots of light Low cost parking for friends picking me up The minuses The airfares They border on extortionate Many times cheaper to fly from MIA to Europe than to Shreveport And UA AA and DL always seem to have the exact same air fare The local chamber of commerce should work on that Concourses are dated Industrial carpeting remember that Looks like they have not been refreshed since the s Odd quirky amateur art and movie posters and house plants maybe a positive No discount carriers like Spirit Jet Blue Frontier or SWA No mainline jets just smallish regional planes

Convenient location only mins from the Mosque Excellent modern facilities Nice simple elegant layout with steelwork reflecting date palm trees Convenient location of cafetarias toilets and prayer rooms Friendly staff and security personnel Clean and tidy Ample seating facilities

Auckland to Shanghai via Chengdu The food was very good from a Chinese perspective The service was impressive The crew members were nice and passionate Also for transit in Chengdu the passenger is able to claim yuan voucher free hour baggage storage free transit commendation in Chengdu Based on this price you cannot ask more Thank you Sichuan Airlines for the wonderful memory

Belfast to Bourgas We were checked in at Belfast international we walked through check out and still had approximately another minute wait on the steps downstairs before the shuttle busses came to get us not very safe or the best place to be waiting a long time with young children The flight over was fine but for some reason even though I booked certain seats over and back they did not show up when collecting our tickets they were very helpful and allocated us the same seats in Belfast but coming back from Bulgaria the seats we requested were given to someone else Staff on the flights to and from Bourgas were lovely But getting back into Belfast after getting through the security checks we went to get our bags and we were waiting at the baggage claim area almost an hour before bags started coming out everyone actually clapped when they started arriving very slowly one at at time for the first mins again not very convenient with tired young children starting to get impatient I honestly dont think well fly with BH Air again or recommend them

I recently flew American Eagle from DCA to PHL on Republic Airways and I must say it was a delightful experience Despite a minor delay due to operational circumstances the E main economy extra setup offered ample legroom and a level of comfort that made the short minute flight exceptionally pleasant The crews professionalism truly stood out they even made a point to walk around and offer a water service a thoughtful gesture you wouldnt expect on such a brief journey Overall Republic Airways continues to deliver a professional efficient and safe product under the American Eagle brand Truly theres nothing to complain about

Was expecting the worst after the number of negative reviews but was very pleasantly surprised at how quick efficient and friendly the service was Traveling in September probably has a substantial bearing on numbers but we were through checkin and passport control in minutes which is much better than most airports weve used in the recent past Water is available to top up bottles for free or just from a machine as you exit security far from the exorbitant prices encountered at other airports The service selection and seating area at cafe Soho are excellent assuming our flight is on time Ryanair its a five star experience

Townsville is a delightful little airport They even use air bridges which was a surprise It is a little crowded as the area for departures arrivals is quite narrow but really very minor issue You exit down an escalator to retrieve your luggage which was pretty fast There is a cafe there and behind are very clean washrooms A positive experience no fuss whatsoever Departing this charming airport the security staff were the friendliest I have come across Lots of glass and places to sit in the departure area and all with a minimum of fuss Well done Townsville Airport I loved it Plus there was almost no traffic outside at all

Used this airport on numerous occasions over the last years Over the last year both domestic and international terminals underwent some renovation and rearrangement of facilities in my opinion for the better Of all facilitiesservices expectable from a midsize regional airport ARH lacks free WIFI coverage and cafes serving hot meals Overall it is a decently wellkept airport which may though benefit from further renovations and improvements

Getting through this airport was such a breeze our home airport is Pearson which is insanely busy We were able to apply for TSA cares for our autistic family Tameeka helped us from start to finish of security and was so warm and thoughtful in helping us navigate their first time through Highly recommend using this service if you have a family member with disabilities We applied for the same program at Orlando and no one helped us the staff were rude and the lady guarding the family and disabled line tried to turn us away Thoroughly disappointed especially compared to Buffalo We will definitely be flying out of Buffalo in the future

The airport is a charming little place up on the Sunshine Coast There are only about flights a day going to Sydney and Melbourne It has recently been upgraded and expanded the gate area is much bigger and has food outlets and toilets It opens up on to the runway and provides nice views Its an easy airport to handle as it isnt too big to get lost in but isnt so small so as to feel cramped The butterfly sanctuary between checkin and security which must be walked through as it is on the pathway is a lovely touch and provides a unique atmosphere The ground staff are very friendly If heading up to the Sunshine Coast it is often cheaper and quicker to fly direct rather than to Brisbane and by far it is an easier airport to use

Very comfortable flight This was my first time to fly with FA Fuji Dream Airlines and I was impressed Checkin was efficient departure was punctual and the cabin was very comfortable and stylish Best of all customer service was so friendly both the checkin staff at Matsumoto Airport and the cabin crew It was a short flight of only one hour but very pleasant

Overall a very good flight However they asked me to complete an Onboard customer survey after Lunch was served the st service Gulf Air however FAILED to deliver the nd service which was Afternoon Tea As I realized the flight was running out of time I proactively asked the attendant what happened to Afternoon Tea was She replied There was a catering mix up and only Asian Food was put onboard for nd service She then asked if I would still like Afternoon Tea which I replied YES to So off she went and bought me Afternoon Tea She quietly explained that there was not enough Western Food for all of the Business Class people Apart from this the Service was Excellent and Smiling happy Female service staff all around Free WiFi worked fine for the majority of the journey as you would expect Would still book and pay for Gulf Air anytime in the future

I would like to say a huge thank to Yasmin who went to great lengths to find us a new flight the same day but from Bristol airport flight missed just Start of holiday delayed by hours only her professional and helpful support was greatly appreciated Thank you again

Phnom Penh to Siem Reap The check in was fast and the staff friendly The departure arrival were punctual and the aircraft made an average good maintained impression The seat distance was sufficiently good Despite the short flight there was a small bite and water Overall a good experience

I flew with my husband from Sharm El Sheikh to Cairo to see the pyramids and Egyptian Museum with a return flight to Sharm three days later The flight took off on time the cabin crew were friendly and the seats were comfortable Unfortunately my husband was taken ill in Cairo and I decided we needed to return to the UK I cancelled our return flight on the morning we were due to fly back to Sharm The money was in my bank two days later I would fly Air Cairo again

A small airport serving the capital Its a bit of a chaotic place long queues staff arent the friendliest and generally messy The terminal itself is clean tho and seating is comfortable As its the only major airport in the country this it what they can offer Taxi trip to the center is lek

Agree with all the positive comments only in transit at Pittsburgh International recently and found it to be a very pleasnt experience due in large part to the variety of shops and restaurants An uncrowded spacious layout adds to the comfort level Also agree with a previous comment regarding the downside of this airport being the near monopoly of US Airways a greater presence by competing carriers would be a real plus

There are a lot of negative reviews for this airlines but for a budget airline what do these reviewers expect Premium airline service They have obviously never flown on EasyJet or Ryanair to make a comparison Flew to Turkey from Manchester and was quite impressed by their checkin service and legroom on the plane Recommend to anyone

Flight slightly delayed but arrived slightly ahead of time by minutes Crew well presented and very professional Meal type and beverage selection an overkill for such a short flight Will fly Eswatini Air again

Check in at San Andres had to be done at the airport since I had a bag to drop off the line was very long so I waited about minutes Since there are no drinks or snacks available for sale on the plane I bought some stuff at the airport to bring along on the plane Flight back to Bogota was quite smooth quiet and easy I flew back on the same plane that had brought me to San Andres Nothing to complain about Cheap option to San Andres and very efficient

Copenhagen to Keflavk in Saga Class on a MAX Saga Class is Icelandairs take on Business Class comfortable though not quite a true premium offering The seats are spacious with generous pitch though they do not recline into a flatbed That said for a short threehour flight this is hardly a drawback Service was quintessentially Icelandair friendly efficient and professionally businesslike Among options connecting Iceland to Europe and the Nordics Icelandair remains the most comfortable premium choice Complimentary WiFi was a welcome perk for Saga Class passengers though connectivity proved inconsistent

PBHCCU CCUPBH Y class Check in staff at Paro very helpful friendly smiling Cabin crew similarly accommodating and friendly Clean cabin decent space for Y class Light refreshments and sandwiches veg or nonveg served on this short minute segment Every flight has been spot on time or slightly early Good announcements from cockpit to point out Himalayan peaks when near Paro Competitive prices A good alternative inout of Bhutan from Drukair

The international arrivals and departure section at Harare Zimbabwe airport is a revelation On arrival all the staff including Immigration and Customs were friendly and welcoming and this contributed to an excellent first impression and a speedy processing Possibly helped by having obtained visas before flying On departure check in was efficient and again the friendly staff were most helpful There is a full range of facilities airside and clean toilets At present there are not too many international flights but the experience was excellent

Arriving at this airport is a little strange as it seems to be full of men wearing leather jackets However departure is quite nice its never very busy but everyone who works there is friendly and the cafe does a good selection of food

Morning flight Kiev Odessa a new clean Embraer It was a very pleasant flight with free candies and beverages served by smiling crew Departed on time and arrived early Check in in Kiev quick and easy The atmosphere and attitude quite relaxed and pleasant

The trip took us from Bangkok to Paro and back to BKK and other than having to use the apron bus at Suvarnabhumi and the lack of IFE the entire process was faultless The flights both departed and landed ahead of schedule checked bags didnt go missing meals were comprehensive and appetising cabin crew were courteous and professional With Business Class fares being a premium over Economy fares I wondered why more people didnt take up that option As several others have pointed out the views upon the journey in and out of Paro were breathtaking making it a great way to welcome any visitors into their enchanting and enthralling kingdom

One of the easiest domestic airports to figure out Just a couple of restaurants but each one has great selection of food Theyve been getting better flights and it is transitioning to more of a transit type airport Staff is scarce but ticket counters are fast to checkin and the security line is real quick minutes at the most I now start my journey to any destination from here

ABQ is a nice concept but one that needs some improvements For starters If you have TSA PreCheck here youre golden Security is an efficient and friendly process If you dont have PreCheck then the service at least for a small airport can be quite noncommunicative abrasive and slow The puebloinspired architecture and interior design of the airport render it one of the most beautiful small airports in the USA and the postsecurity viewing area of the runway and mountains is the sort of thing that more airports in this country need However its not always easy to enjoy the design and the views when the tile and carpet flooring and seating throughout the airport are dirty and for a lack of better words dilapidated and outdated Speaking of seating there really isnt enough of it in my opinion The signage directing you to amenities services and locations throughout the airport is helpful but also outdated The dining and shopping options are fine for a small airport so no real complaints Some people complain about the rental car facility being separate from the terminal and requiring a shuttle bus but honestly the bus runs frequently and the ride is pretty short Everything is easily accessible from I and downtown Albuquerque With a little modernization and polishing ABQ has the potential be as good as new again

Boarding on TLV was done on time but delayed to get permission to depart A was in a good condition and clean Stewardesses were professional and friendly Inflight service was beverages coffee water sandwich and granola bar On the return flight there was a minutes later departure schedule change they informed us with email days in advance
Brilliant Airport new clean clear spacious Shame so few airlines do fly into MVD

Not Verified The new airport is much better than the old but the issue with taxis remains The military controls the airport and hence which taxis are used No meters and extortionate fares Better off walking minutes south on road outside arrivals right angle to airport terminal and pickup a bluebird or AA cab from there Clean and metered Pity the Government does not stop in and do something about this as it is a horrible welcome to what is otherwise a friendly and interesting city and region

We flew Jeju Air which is Korean Low cost airline for the first time The first flight was from Bangkok to Seoul and the second flight was from Busan to Bangkok The checkin at Bangkok is quite good and smooth but checkin at Busan is not smooth as the ground staff was not friendly and seemed to be inconsiderate Both flight was ok and the seat was not bad for low cost airline not so cramped and leg room is good though we flew over hours Cabin crew were friendly eventhough they served us only a cup of water which is understandable Both flight was not delay and the flight from Busan arrived ahead of schedule Overall it was a good flight both way
Seattle to Dallas Great flight and spacious cabin Had a connection from Vancouver Staff went above and beyond First class meal was very delicious and the crew was extremely nice

Arriving and departing from this regional airport is far less stressful than dealing with the airports in Cancun or Mexico City There are fewer passengers of course plus the airport is well organized and clean Checkin was fast and easy and security was well organized courteous and fast There are several places to enjoy a snack or meal before takeoff The waiting area is spacious and uncrowded and offers great views of planes landing and taking off Wifi was free and worked well

TimisoaraMunich The flight was h min and operated on a SAAB which was in pretty good shape I believe these are former Crossair props Was offered a decent breakfast on this flight although a little bit disappointed that the cheese omlette was cold Otherwise good selection of drinks and friendly crew Overall a good deal for the price Would fly them again

On the understanding that Srinagar being the capital of Indian administered Kashmir is at the centre of one of longest running conflicts in the world then one should expect a particularly unique experience regarding airport security Srinagar airport in this respect does not disappoint On arrival on Jet Airways from Delhi one is immediately struck by the fact that this is a military airfield masquerading as a civilian airport MiG fighters and helicopter gunships abound at the far end of the airfield and all buildings are camoflauge painted The odd civilian Boening looks incongruous For arriving foreigners you are accosted by a security official fairly politely it must be said to fill in a long registration document He then accompanies you out of the arrival and baggage collection hall on a dirt track to the carpark to ensure you are being met by whoever you had claimed you were on the form Only then can you be on your way If you are not being met I am not sure what your fate would be Departure though is an object lesson in airport security The first hurdle is a kilometer or so before the airport terminal where you are stopped at a roadblock and put your luggage through an xray machine Entering the airport and only passengers are allowed not guests or friends you again put bags through another xray sceeening Then you are allowed to go to check in after which you must as a foreigner fill out another lengthy departure registration form for the police No hand luggage whatsoever is allowed on Delhi bound flights so all you can carry is what you can fit in your pockets therefore travel with a multipocket vest or similar to maximise carry on potential Hand carried clear plastic water bottles do suprisingly seem OK though to carry on The waiting area after check in is basic but OK as long as you dont mind being stared at suspiciously by numerous armed army and poice men Then there is another long queue for a more detailed security check which involves turning out all pockets and being individually scanned Finally you are through to the actual departure area but this is not the end After being released to go out on foot to your waiting Boeing you again go through another security check all pockets and a patdown before eventually you board the plane Great views of the Himalayas to the north on the flight out but since cameras are not allowed on board the memories stay in your mind and not on film

Really nice clean small airport in terms of actual experience On arrival my Aer Lingus flight landed slightly ahead of schedule and I was airside within minutes from leaving aircraft door Immigration was a breeze and quick and the person checking passportsIDs was friendly and welcoming On departure security was fast and efficient and staff were relaxed and friendly The departure area is small but has couple of food options given the size and there was decent dutyfree area although I think greater part of this could be allocated to local products especially food given some of the really great quality stuff I had during my stay in Cork Toilets very clean and maintained and gate areas had plenty of seating The thing I loved though is they sell bottles of water for which you can just quickly tap and take from a stand no pricegouging and they have a refill station centrally located if you need refill it before you take off or if you brought your own bottle much better than Heathrow T when I left The only thing that lets this airport down and why I have marked it down is poor information on its website before travelling doesnt look like its been updated since covid and poor transfers from the airport to the city on arrival Taxis are expensive to the city at given the distance Bus to the city is regular service bus not a dedicated airport shuttle is only every half an hour in either direction and you need Leap card or euros no cards accepted This is inconvenient as international visitors wont necessarily immediately have the either of the former to hand I was lucky that a kind stranger on the bus paid for me using their own Leap card as the bus was waiting when I arrived if I had to go to get cash I would have missed it and had to wait half an hour for the next one Once on the bus it isnt clear when you arrive in the city as it is neither announced nor displayed on the electronic board just random street names and the bus runs with the lights off inside so you travel in the dark and it is all rather disorientating The stop in the city is also a random bus stop not the bus station which also makes it unclear where to get it from when you need to return to the airport from the city Im really perplexed why a city that has a lot of tourism has made it so difficultinconvenient for visitors in this respect and its a shame as the experience at the airport itself was excellent

Very modern terminal which improved a lot since last year and is far more superior that some airports in Europe Air bridges free WiFi and excellent staff customer service I certainly recommend Lviv airport and definitely would fly there again

Pokhara to Kathmandu I received very good service by Yeti Airlines at Pokhara and Kathmandu airport on st Dec Due to fog my flight was delayed I had a connecting flight to Delhi from Kathmandu to Delhi at The Staff at Pokhara Airport were very helpful to my request to advance my booking to an earlier flight and ensured my luggage was loaded in the cabin itself so that I could get it first when I landed at Kathmandu At Kathmandu the staff unloaded my luggage and took me in the small van to the terminal so I could leave the airport quickly I would rate this as excellent service On my next trek in Nepal I would fly this airline again

Absolute and stunning perfection in everything Crew are the best wonderful and polite people who are there to make your journey a great part of your day Please treat your crew nicely they are literally one of the best and I fly a lot times a month

The arrivals area is pretty shabby but from disembarking the plane to getting on the bus to St Helier took less than minutes We departed from Jersey late afternoon on a Saturday when it was very quiet and so it was a very pleasant experience The staff at security and in the shops were all helpful and charming For the size of the airport the selection of shops and food were decent although there did seem to be a lack of seating after security however there was plenty at the gate

The girl who initially was nice to us at the information desk then proceeded to question us at the departure lounge She looked disappointed when we produced our negative results and examined them very closely Travelling right now is stressful enough without somebody who is having a bad day create more stress

A first class airport with a good range of facilities There does not seem to be the usual hectic atmosphere of most airports bringing back the pleasure into flying Decent food at non ripoff prices particularly recommend the caferestaurant on the mezzanine floor

Nimes is one of the most pleasant airports Ive experienced Its quite small is a favourable alternative to Montpellier for those of us whose eventual destination is in the Herault area not least because of its close proximity to the motorway and current absence of major roadworks It is a place to relax and stroll about while waiting to meet incoming friends and carparking is a doddle The flight to and from Liverpool with Ryanair is direct

I flew Motor Sich this past July from Kyiv to Odesa and it was a great experience It was on one of their AN s and to my surprise the seats were the most comfortable economy seats I have flown not to mention the most room Also when checking in my bag was a few kilos overweight and they let me check it with no extra charge Would definitely fly Motor Sich again

Small airport in Orange County NY that is a welcome alternative to Newark other airports if you can get a flight Fare was hundreds less flying to PHL connecting to IND rather than nonstop from EWR but lots of time spent sitting in airports It is clean staff are pleasant but not much to do Wish there were more nonstops out of this airport to major cities but I hear it is great if you are going to Florida

STNMAHSTN what a fantastic airport clean quiet and easy to find your way round I know this airport is much quieter than some but why cant they all be like this Even had outside smoking areas in the departure lounge and it wasnt all retail retail retail like most UK airports

Being fed up with the chaos at many ports of entry into the USA from Europe as a non USAcitizen I thought to try out a new way to enter the USA with less wait hassle stress and frustration I flew the nonstop AA flight from LHR into RDU Even though I was in business class and was among the first to disembark I believe all passengers entered the USA border control in minutes or less It took me minutes from plane door to curbside Also the airport is modern and clean really nice staff With just one or two daily incoming flights from Europe I dont think there is a better way to travel into the USA from Europe I connected the next morning on a very early am departure Staff told me there was a morning rush so I was a bit nervous about TSA opening only at am Arrived at am and soon after that TSA started processing passengers Again lovely kind people all around What an exceptional airport

Contrary to all of the recent negative press about airports and their staff our experience flying and coming back in was seamless Given the pressure that all airport staff are under they are doing an amazing job and are doing it with a smile We travelled down to Newcastle from Scotland and stayed in the Premier Inn the night before I would have no hesitation in using this airport again Well done to all of the staff

We were flying to Kuala Lumpur from Madinah airport through group reservation on Feb The checkin counter staff separated all of us When we wanted to exchange seats with fellow group members the crew were not really helpful All the havoc could easily have been avoided had the checkin counter staff been more accommodating when seating passengers according to their family groupings Do not assign seats according to your mood or whims and fancies for that day It is very unprofessional Next is the passenger security scan Ladies and men security scans were separated At the scan even folding chair cum walking stick was confiscated How do you suppose the passenger is going to walk to the gate when the walking stick is taken away My yearold mother wears a lumbar support waistband She was told to remove it and go through the scan again How to remove without privacy at that scan area Security lady can easily be more sensitive and take her to a more private place

I was down with flu and surprised when I checked in and cleared passport that the airport did not have any pharmacies or clinics inside the airport This is the first time in a long history of travel that an airport doesnt have these facilities Very disappointed

I travelled from London Heathrow to Rotterdam on February and returned the following day On the outward journey I was through immigrationpassport control in less than a minute Arrivals area contains an information desk which provided useful information on onward connections and provided me with change for the bus travel recommendations and a complementary city map Bus number leaves from virtually outside arrivals and takes approx minutes to reach Rotterdam Central It costs euros at the time of writing and the driver has limited change On the return journey there was no queue for checkin and virtually no queue for security This is a small airport but there are decent airside facilities including a duty free shop cafe newsagent and an upstairs bar which has an outdoor seating area and viewing platform If you are travelling with BA there are no lounge facilities but you are allowed three complementary items from the airport cafe for which you will need to complete an information card Clear information throughout the terminal and announcements in English and in Dutch Free Internet in departures which was fast and required no password Overall this was a stress free experience and I was impressed with Rotterdam Airport

Good small airport The staff is not friendly at all First nobody smile in that airport and when i pass the gate they dont greeting at the search point and passport point One guy he just pointing me by hand what to do and chewing gum in your face

Piarco to Grenada A nofrills airline though efficient Staff at check in at arrivaldeparture were polite very helpful and efficient I experienced difficulty in accessing and using the online check in service though this proved to be no obstacle at the check in desk The aircraft while obviously wellused and aging somewhat allowed reasonable legroom Im and was comfortable enough to doze through the flight

Tashkent Airport can be difficult to navigate Regulations are strictly enforced especially at departure Upon arrival I noticed that the people do not observe lines and not speaking Uzbek or Russian can be a disadvantage Make sure that you fill out and keep all official forms you receive There is one for each hotel you stay in and there are matching customs forms for arrival and departure you need to list valuables and cash and produce both forms when leaving the country Departure gate is a floor below the departure area There is now an escalator and carts are available for taking bags from the entrance gate to the escalator but only passengers may enter the departure gate Good luck if you have more than one or two bags There are no porters or at least not when I was there I had forgotten about the customs forms after I had to repeatedly insist to the airline representative that I was allowed to check in more than one bag and the customs official said I could not take my money out of the country without submitting both forms You will have to remove your shoes and socks and put on blue plastic booties before going through security The airport personnel were courteous and even friendly but it was clear that no exceptions would be made
The airport staff was helpful polite and respectful There was a metro which helped me move around quickly Schedule boards everywhere Nice restaurants and coffee shops Not crowded at all

My sister and I flew from LGW to Banjul I have nothing but praise for the cabin crew We flew out on th Nov at The crew were amazing we have flown many times and although some passengers were difficult they never wavered from the job in hand and seemed to be happy genuinely I wish I took the crews names as they were on the go the whole hrs

A comfortable flight seated in a pair of two seats on the left of the aircraft The ground service and on board service were friendly and efficient and we were pleasantly surprised to get a tasty snack and an alcoholic or nonalcoholic drink on this short leg plus an Easter chocolate The flight operated about mins late There was no attempt to enforce the airlines policy on takeon baggage Luckily we were on early and could find space for our takeon bags over our seats but other people were struggling due to the suitcasesize bags allowed on board

Return journey Clean modern aircraft comfortable seat tasty food and drying and great cabin crew On the way back ground staff checked our bags through to EDI on BA even though we did not have the journey on a single ticket Impressive and enjoyable journey and I would happily use them again

The arrivals area is pretty shabby but from disembarking the plane to getting on the bus to St Helier took less than minutes We departed from Jersey late afternoon on a Saturday when it was very quiet and so it was a very pleasant experience The staff at security and in the shops were all helpful and charming For the size of the airport the selection of shops and food were decent although there did seem to be a lack of seating after security however there was plenty at the gate
I travelled from Istanbul to Bangkok via Delhi service was good as compared to low the fare and staff behavior is also very good but for extra luggage they charge extra money

With family in Brittany Im a regular user of Rennes St Jacques and have seen its traffic grow significantly in volume over the past decade What a shame that the airport itself has not been able to keep up The only passenger facilities are a small caf gift shop and once you get beyond security theres a popup snack stall closed on Sundays and a vending machine No shops eating establishments or even the token Duty Free Generally I pass through the airport quickly so this isnt really a concern but if you are unfortunate enough to be delayed its not fun My main issue is with the speed of checkin which can only be described as glacial When there are two or more imminently departing flights at the same time the queues barely seem to move at the risk of passengers almost missing their plane I speak from experience here Staff are pleasant and bilingual but absolutely inefficient at processing large volumes of passengers I want to like Saint Jacques its clean friendly and has a good bus service to the city centre but it hasnt really done enough to move with the times and comfortably accommodate its passengers If it had a choice of amenities expanded checkin with more staff and a better departure lounge it would be pretty much the perfect regional airport

Brussels to Lanzarote Nice little airline Both outbound and return flights on time Food premium menu delicious Swift and attentive service of the staff Clean aircraft on both ways We booked emergency exit seats which offered extra legroom which is a bonus on h flights Would recommend this airline for sure such a shame that this brand will probably disappear
Yangon to Lashio in November ATR plane Allocated seating and good snack served with excellent customer service Would fly with them again any time

A very good experience arriving and departing The airport is modern clean and efficient No delays or problems arriving Queuing at immigration did not take too long and bags had already arrived after that Departure is also very good No immigration formalities for departure so you get into the departure lounge quite quickly I used the business lounge which was very comfortable with good wireless internet and a reasonable food selection

Very nice airport closely situated to New York City and very convenient for all travelling tofrom Long Island Decent selection of shops easy to navigate and not crowded at all when I flew threw both times Local hub for Southwest airlines

SZBRDNSZB Return trip from Subang Skypark secondary airport in KL to Redang Island ATR looked in good condition could not have been very old minute flight a bottle of water and a refresher towel offered service punctual and friendly both flights on time A small airline but felt very safe flying with them

Great airport but it is huge and can take up to minutes to get from gate to gate if in transit Good variety of shops and restaurants lots of toilets which are always clean Its a shame theres no areas to relax apart from at gates Singapore Doha KL etc all have sofa areas and big TVs to watch which is great when you have a long lay over I always thought there were smoking rooms here but werent Not an issue if you have a lay over of more than hrs as you can go through immigration and leave the airport I did however find cigarette butts behind floor standing AC units on two occasions at unmanned gates where passengers and probably staff hide and have a quick smoke I even smelt cigarette smoke at one point so people obviously are smoking in the terminals Some staff seemed quite unhelpful and standoffish though when I asked about a few things but mainly young ones who were more interested in what was on their mobile phones

I would like to share a positive experience I had with airport staff on December I came back from a weeklong trip to find that my car battery had completely died We called AAA but it was a long wait time due to the holiday weekend A very nice gentleman in an airport pickup stopped by to check on us and offered to jump start the car He was respectful and courteous and saved us quite a bit of wait time We will forever be grateful for his kindness and professionalism

Always great and good value for money No issues with delayed flights and a smooth journey overall Friendly staff and onboard service even on super short flights eg Bangkok to Trat At Trat airport they also have complimentary snacks and drinks

It was a good easy flight on a nice modern clean plane The meal was satisfactory a couple of hot dishes as well as salad dessert and bread served along with wine or beer The IFE was decent a good screen and reasonable selection of movies and TV series The service was friendly but nothing outstanding My only gripe is the lack of communication from the cockpit for some reason they didnt switch off the seatbelt sign for nearly hours Whilst it was a bit bumpy it wasnt excessive so I wish they had communicated why this was the case Otherwise it led me to believe that we were constantly expecting something worse

A small airport for the tiny capital of Montenegro so that means big queues for border control no online check in hardy any shops or food and beverages Staff were friendly and correct Best to prebook a taxi in order to get to town which will be around euro
Great regional airport Min check in time for Lufthansa flights is mins Good connections via MUC to international destinations Reasonable amenities at the airport

Milwaukee is a great airport to spend a couple of hours in Decent food selection a great interminal aviation museum and the most incredible airport used bookstore Ive experienced Wish I had brought another carryon bag as I could have filled the thing with all the great books at reasonable prices I wanted to buy

Flew Star Peru from Lima to Cusco Pleasantly surprised after reading dire reviews here Departure was more or less on time in small rather old plane It was mostly empty too Seats not incredibly comfortable but very short flight anyway Price not a bargain but not terribly expensive no point booking in advance BTW as fares do not seem to really vary that much Flight was fine and service was rather good and polite onboard with snacks drink and luggage all included in fare No issues at all

Domestic h flight from Ulaanbaatar to Dalandzadgad in South Mongolia on Hunnu Air in July Checkin and security clearance at the old ULN Chengis Khan Airport reasonably swift Departure and arrival on time Very pleasantly appointed ATR in good state of repair Friendly flight attendants Coffee water snacks All announcements in Mongolian and Russian I guess Cabin crew also speaks no English

GRX is a small regional airport Boarding and disembarking aircraft is usually very quick due to the limited aircraft movements Passenger facilities are limited waiting areas are small no lounges minimal eating outlets and taxis are hard to come by which is surprising for an airport However some of the nicest security screening staff that I have ever come across always smiling and patient with passengers UK and US staff can really learn something here

My recent trip from Jakarta to Denpasar with Pelita Air was an absolute pleasure Both departure and arrival adhered to the schedule The seat pitch in their aircraft offers ample legroom Every seat has a USB port and an AC power outlet A tasty light snack and water were provided which was perfect for the short flight duration Departure from Jakartas Terminal was offers a bright airy ambiance and a good selection of shops and restaurants for preflight browsing Smooth Transfers Even for a far gate a bus was available to take passengers to the aircraft The cabin crew were professional and courteous Pelita Air provided WiFi access to their Inflight Entertainment IFE system that allowed me to stream movies shows or music on my device making the flight even more enjoyable A Minor Room for Improvement While the ground staff were generally helpful there were a few instances where they seemed a bit inattentive Perhaps some additional training could improve their overall efficiency

Excellent airport Well organized Airlines and security staff are friendly and professional Good customer service The airport building is very clean and modern Good parking indoor and outdoor next to the terminal Easy to go around In conclusion a place were its pleasant to go

Small airport only serves a couple of airlines Landing process was pretty fast seem the airport does not have air bridges Bags delivered pretty fast Check in at airport was fine many dining options Security check was fast Not sure about transportation options because we were picked up and dropped off by our hotel It is a very sufficient regional airport

I flew roundtrip to visit family for Christmas week On the outbound leg all the flight attendants were decked out in their fanciest tackiest holiday finery We even had the Grinch try to run down the jetway at LaGuardia Plentiful snacks and the WiFi worked well enough for the inflight entertainment bring your own device for that I was also able to use the WiFi to track my luggage through the Southwest website The best part is unlike other airlines one can check up to two bags for free very important when youre bringing NYC goodies to Brooklyn expats Flights took off on time and arrived on time the outbound to SMF arrived early in fact so early we had to wait for a gate Ten out of ten would recommend

I flew into and out of Moscow Sheremetyevo Airport in December for the first time and was quite impressed with arrivals and maybe a little less so with the departure process Arriving and clearing customs and security and getting bags was all pretty straight forward and easy enough and efficient Signage for me was great and easily navigated to the bag carousels and also found an ATM before exiting to take out some cash Plenty of food options once exiting and then I easily followed signs to the Aeroexpress train from the airport to Moscow Belorussky about a min walk through terminalI bought my train ticket online prior and scanned the barcode and all worked fineSo transport to and from the airport is easy on the way back I took a Yango ride and it pulled up easily right in front of terminal On the way departing security is pretty tight but to be expected you go through two screening stations and again check in pretty seamless except for the fact your Departure Terminal indicated on the board may not be the one you finally need to go to as I found out Ended up having a fairly decent walk from one terminal to another Once that finished then we headed to the aerobus as is common in Europe to be driven to the plane waited for about mins with open bus doors for late passengers in Moscow winterthen the drive started and instead of a couple of minutes it turned into about minutes driving from one aide of the runway around the end and over to the opposite apron to the plane But for me all an adventure but just be prepared for a bit of a walk and maybe an extended bus ride Overall a nice clean airport that was very functional and not overly crowded when I went through and easily accessible and a good range of eateries and amenities

Norman Manley KIN is an airport of two halves Arrivals is a bit shambolic We arrived on a and people had to be ferried in a variety of minibuses and coaches to the arrivals hall Following that queuing for immigration took over an hour even with most of the desks open The arrivals area is shabby but will be updated shortly The baggage collection is also a novelty with cases pilled up and scattered across the arrivals hall near customs Departures is totally different A modern light and attractive area with well marked check in desks and orderly waiting Beyond the fairly efficient security checks is a relaxing lounge with many retail outlets of both Jamaican and international food and goods

On October th we flew from Vienna to Karpathos which turned out to be the last passenger flight with this Airline to this destination due to the sad development The crew worked flawless as ever and was extremely friendly despite the fact that they are not quite sure about their professional future Not a single mention came up about that but you could see and sense their feelings We are exceedingly angry about the fact that many thousand passengers loose their money and some thousand well working employess lose their job Many many thanks and good luck for the crew and all the other employees of ABNiki

As a frequent flyer on the Kuwait Airways I would recommend it on there large aircrafts such as Ber Aneo or A and specially on business class even though it is expensive but you will get a good quality service My rating would be on there business first and royal class And I have also uploaded a photo of Ber business seat

Over the years have had the pleasure of travelling through this airport surely the best planned facility of its size anywhere in the world Maybe all wouldbe new airport planners should pay Norfolk a visit to see what a well designed airport should look like and thats not even mentioning the surrounding beautiful botanical gardens a very pleasant change from the usual grimy industrial areas adjoining most airports

Flight was delayed for hr which was communicated via sms prior to departure Aircraft was a brand new A very clean and spotless Seats are comfortable however the leg room is a bit tight and I am an average cm tall Crew were very friendly and smiling and helpful and served a meal consisting of a sandwich biscuits water and coffee which is unusual in European airlines specially on domestic flights and I liked that they still have inflight magazines for people like me who like to read old style Overall a very nice experience
The pleasant experience of arriving and departure in Shannon Airport was above all else Efficiency professionalism courteous Dublin needs to take a look and see how its done Well done Shannon

Absolutely love this airport Easy in and easy out Not jammed with people like the zoo at MCO Orlando Adequate places to get something quick to eat and comfortable seats to wait Only min from our place in Oviedo I just wish more domestic carriers other than just Allgiant flew into SFB Maybe international travelers dont care for it because its not a large airport but its great for us and I do recommend it

Very nice and comfortable Estonian Air flight from Copenhagen to Vilnius via Tallinn crew friendly and smiling Even if Tallinn airport is very small connection time was too tight Smaller aircraft to Vilnius but comfortable For reasons unknown there were no sales on this h min flight A good experience for the price and safety was taken seriously

Flew with AIRDO a low cost airlines owned by ANA from Tokyo Haneda to Hakodate Flight was on time and full of passengers who were en route to observe the cherry blossoms in Hakodate Cabin crew was really professional friendly and attentive Legroom was good seat was comfy cabin was clean Soft drinks water apple juice tea orange juice coffee was served to all passengers even it was a low cost airlines Both of take off and landing were smooth
Perfect flight Good breakfast Feel safe Flight attendants were very professional They take care of you All was perfect

I thought it was great In the past Ive been very critical of Manchester Airport but credit where its due my recent experience was very good As always we parked in Jetparks and got the shuttle bus I hadnt been through Terminal for about years as all of my recent flights have been from the dump that is Terminal What a refreshing improvement the expanded Terminal is The checkin area is bright and clean passport control was a doddle and it took just minutes to get through security albeit this was at in the morning I had a wander round bought some duty free and sat and relaxed for a while until my flight was ready It was a bit of a trek to the departure gate for my flight to Frankfurt but no real problem Boarding was via the airbridge so thank goodness no messing about with buses to far flung areas of the tarmac And our flight took off exactly on time My return flight was a week later Again an airbridge was available and the arrivals gate was fairly close to Immigration One of the travellators was being repaired but in a couple of minutes I was through passport control and amazingly my bag was in the first batch then straight through customs and out through Arrivals where the JetParks bus was waiting All told minutes from the plane to my car So Manchester Airport can be a smooth and stress free experience

This is an extremely clean and well maintained airport They do updates regularly as needed Its very easy to get to and from Parking is pretty cheap compared to a bunch of other airports Ive been to but not super cheap Theyre already planning out the new rail connection to downtown that will be running by Currently there is a bus service as well as Uber and taxis if you dont have someone picking you up Lyft on its way to the city Its very easy to get around and if you come in from an international destination the customs is very quick What I do find bothersome is the lack of airport lounge in the US departures area The only lounges in the airport are Air Canada and Porter both on the domesticinternational departures area The food selection in the airport is pretty slim but you wont go hungry its just really limited in the US departures to one soso restaurant and a tim hortons Shopping is even more slim in all departures areas But does anyone really go shopping in an airport This airport is miles or kilometers ahead of those in a lot of US airports Ive been to despite all the drawbacks
Excellent service very cheerful and professional cabin crew Delicious catering punctual Honestly EgyptAir deserves a much better rating Keep up the excellent work

We were travelling back to Johannesburg after a vacation in the Maldives when my husband suddenly lost consciousness after about minutes in the air The cabin crew were outstanding They found a Doctor on the flight brought the oxygen helped administer the oxygen calmed the family down and were caring and kind for hours When we landed in the Seychelles an ambulance was on the runway and the excellent Sara Chang Pen Guest Service Agent for Air Seychelles took over She accompanied us to the hospital and negotiated our admission and treatment there staying with us for several hours until he was well enough to be discharged She also booked us into a hotel organized our passports to be stamped sent our luggage to the hotel and ensured we were booked on the earliest flight home days later I do not believe that we could have had better service on any other airline and we are truly grateful for their excellent service

We were very pleasantly surprised with our experience in Premium We normally fly Premium Economy on British Airways and this was a far better experience the plane was lovely and new and the crew were much friendlier The premium experience on board is good nice to have additional space and a private section of the cabin and the crew were generous with drinks The food was fine and we were pleased to be served two hot meals on the way out Our checked bags came off very promptly at both ends the Premium labels did seem to make a difference The only slight negative was that our flight left Gatwick late afternoon and the Premium check in line took longer than the normal one as they seemed to give priority to those checking in for next mornings flights Strange but didnt spoil the overall experience

Went through KLIA terminal one domestic section for morning departure and afternoon arrival Despite the age the airport maintains its cleanliness The toilets were kept clean and spotless by the cleaner all the times The custom check for domestic flight a bit crowded due to higher number of flights However the whole process at the custom check was very efficient Lots of cafes and shops available to fill up the time while waiting for flights The wifi works very well for me The baggage claim section still under maintenance I think Its been awhile and the airport management need to check on this Overall very satisfied with the airport facilities and management for domestic section airside I think this airport need a bigger new terminal soon as the present terminal already seems and feels crowded

Ccuta to Palonegro SATENA is a Colombian regional carrier that offers good connectivity to remote regions of the country and also serves big cities Pleasant experience with courteous staff punctual departure and arrival wellorganised boarding and luggage delivery The airline has been around for over years but is normally overlooked It is an excellent choice for domestic travel within Colombia

While waiting for passport control I felt very hot and dizzy I asked a make member of staff if I could have some water He got me through security got me water and made sure I was ok Very helpful and I wish I knew his name to thank him

The airport is very small with just about million passengers a year The few checkin desks are enough service is fast no queues travel agencys most big car rental companys have a desk and restaurants and visitors terrace with a nice view are available

I have been flying with Volotea for years and have never had any problems I believe that the company is one of the best in existence This is due to all the staff and the company organization Sono anni che volo con Volotea non ho avuto mai problemi Ritengo che la compagnia sia una delle migliori tra quelle in essere Questo merito vs al personale tutto e allorganizzazione aziendale

LHR T BA Gold Wing worked well Pleasant check in and very fast security screening Concorde room service attentive C gate boarding OK but nothing special for First Passengers Latest BA version of first with only suites with privacy doors Comfortable seat with plenty of stowage Good screen and good choice of IFE Amenity kit good quality and bedding pillows cushions and blankets all good Excellent menu and food very well presented Cabin crew could not have been more attentive and helpful without being obtrusive On time departure and early arrival Bags delivered relatively swiftly and priority tagged bags were first off All in all one of the best BA First flights Ive had in many years Whilst not touching the Middle Eastern carriers BA First on this showing is easily the best way to cross the Atlantic

Very nice cabin comfortable seats and good entertainment systems The food tasted very good and there was enough food for the flight length The flight attendants were all very friendly except steward Plane TVJA Date July

The new terminal at Antigua airport has only been open for a few months and it is quite magnificent Its up there with the best European airports although not anywhere near as large The dutyfree shops are amazing particularly their rum selections which include Clement Rhum Agricole from Martinique and some genuine sugar cane syrup to mix it with The souvenir shop also looked very good although I didnt have enough time to look round it in great detail

Thank you for your kind service My elderly parents flew out and the patience and attention to their comfort was impressive and appreciative They contacted me upon their arrival and both were very calm and satisfied They have been worried about flying days coming into it All that went away at the airport in Bellingham They were greeted upon their arrival at their destination with the necessary extra services Thank you so much

It was my first time to fly with Asiana Airline Service is world class check in counter staff are super friendly Flight crew are very friendly excellent service always there on call you press button and the air hostess is there Always smiling Food was beyond and above the first class standard I flew Sydney to New York via Incheon Seoul all flights had the same standard Desk crew in JFK New York was just as friendly I give Asiana Airline for punctuality on time arrival and departure I give them for flight crew I give them for food quality

Old airport but reconstruction going on Very efficient immigration on the way in with separate lane for business class Fast delivery of luggage as well took me less than minutes to be out of the airport Departure wise a little bit slower but acceptable friendly immigration and security people very basic business lounge Departure procedure efficient despite lack of discipline of Chinese passengers always trying to jump queues
Wonderful airport with great hospitality only wish some other airline other than Ryanair flew into there from the UK

The Narita Express train from Tokyo is an excellent means of getting to the airport and comes straight in to the terminal Narita airport was rather quiet when we travelled though it so maybe we were lucky as there were no queues at all in security nor immigration Plenty of shops for last minute gifts The terminal is light and airy and everything well signposted More than happy with our experience

My son who is epileptic had a seizure during the security check in We had already requested Special Assistance at the desk and the airport team were incredibly helpful and took us to a quiet room to wait until our flight was called They checked on us every minutes and arranged a wheelchair and preferential boarding once the Gate opened They also ensured that the crew were aware of our situation and forwarded the request for assistance to Gatwick

Fly or times a year Mexico City to Ciudad Victoria Planes are small Fokker Turboprops Always very friendly staff and have been on time Seats are rather small an excellent lounge with drinks and snacks at a number of airports Service onboard with snacks and drinks are adequate

Where do I start this was simply the best flight Ive ever had I was on the AM from LHR to JFK Boarded on time pushed backed and took off on time The premium seat on Virgins A NEO was more than enough Met with amazing crew with brilliant hospitality The food was business class standard on this special flight The return flight the food was still good not as good as they outbound flight though Entertainment is one of the best there is and unlimited alcohol and snacks at all times Overall this is the best and only airline you should cross the pond in Very pleased

Milan to New York return via Dusseldorf I had a very positive experience with AirBerlin on all four of our flights The prices were phenomenal all four of us flew economy roundtrip for less although they did charge me quite a bit for seat reservations with small kids you cant really make a good case for oh honey sorry you get to sit to that stranger Everything ran on time The seats are as about tight as most US airlines though not as bad as Uniteds back rows But we fit fine video was working with lots of options for watching food was okishand the attendants were quite helpful and very nice Really I have no complaints And yes I did check in luggage on the way back because who doesnt overshop in Italy and I got them back in NYC We were all nervous about this due to all the bad review of lost luggage In fact it is why I am writing the review as I promised myself I would write a good review if we arrived home intact with a good experience I fly Business for work I was expecting worse but was very pleased as were my husband two kids

We flew out of YQB UA on Tuesday October at pm I became very disabled after a bad fall in old Quebec Clty on Monday October After going to the Blessed Sacrement emergency and having much pain due to pelvic fractures After much pain we had to delay flight plans back home from Oct I contacted UA for disability help I was assured we would be taken care of at the car rental area and throughout the airport terminal also YQB website assured they are very proud of their disability service Fortunately after Avis personnel refused to help an airport employee saw us struggling to manage our luggage walker and wheelchair and offered to help get us to Avis Sadly I had to beg for help because the response was Our airport is too small Finally at Avis a young man behind the desk said I will help you And then took us to the UA Ticket Counter He refused an offer of a tip Then after getting baggage etc taken care of again we asked for help to go through TSA and boarding area At first the response was again Our airport is too small Fortunately a young woman said she would help And she did with kindness and refused a tip She dropped us off at boarding area after letting us get some food at a vendor and stopped so we could use the restroom She said she would be back to help us get our boarding pass and onto the plane SHE DID We are giving an excellent rating because of the people that did take the initiative to help us despite others refusing

Luangpraban to Vientiane This airline was above expectations The checkin opened on time The staff where very helpful and gave me a seat with extra leg room The flight left on time and arrived early Will use again for sure

I usually travel to Tenerife South and North airports several times a month The most important thing for me is the fastest way thru security and food services On both airports usually time waited for security screening is less than min average time min staff polite and very helpful The food and services offered in Tenerife South is much better than the older airport in the north of the island I have used both airports VIP lounge They are nice have lots of food and drink and usually are ok Sometimes during peak season can be a bit crowded or even full
Singapore to Tioman Island We found the check in staff very welcoming friendly and helpful The flight in the dash was what real flying is all about Again the crew were very friendly

Heho to Yangon The aircraft was pretty new and very clean We have been greeted with a smile and the personnel was kind and professional We have been served some basic breakfast that for such a short flight was appreciated Flight on time and overall very comfortable and enjoyable experience

Kolkata to Bangkok I have nothing but good things to say about Bhutan Airlines Theyre a great ambassador for their country even though I never set foot in Bhutan I flew from Kolkata to Bangkok on an Airbus in Economy bulkhead Surprisingly I had the row to myself The plane was clean and colorful decked out in Bhutanese red and gold in the interior and the crew were in traditional Bhutanese outfits as well Seats were comfortable we were on time and the flight was only about half full There was a meal on this short hop featuring Bhutanese cuisine and it was truly outstandingone of the best economy class meals Ive had in years Even the inflight magazine was superb highlighting not just places to see and things to do in Bhutan as well as spotlighting some of the more unusual aspects of their culture such as women taking multiple husbands Bottom line it was not just a great transport experience on time hassle free but an educational experience about their home country as well I cant wait to take them all the way to Bhutan
You are all so sweet and smiling I travel frequently and for the first time in my life I saw so many smiles and excellent service Well done Keep it up

I had to fly from Alicante with a fractured leg The staff and facilities were absolutely amazing Please can you teach Edinburgh Airport how to facilitate and treat disabled passengers Thank you so much Alicante
Departed on october to Paris Orly abd back on October Airport very clean opened early in the morning Check In and Security Checks are easy early in the morning

An excellent small but well equipped airport Clearly built to service the Santa charter trade I went through offseason when it was quiet The security staff are probably the most pleasant anywhere saying thank you and smiling and for that alone it deserves a recommendation

After much fanfare and glowing reviews surrounding this relatively new transpacific airline operating out of Taipei I decided that I had to give it a try to see if it lived up to its hype The booking experience was straightforward and smooth when online check in opened I managed to select a seat at no extra cost and successfully managed to download the mobile boarding pass into my digital wallet So we were off to a good start The Aneo is a great choice for regional and short to midhaul flights its configuration in economy making the cabin intimate and cosy with fewer passengers stuck in window seats Another good start was when boarding proceeded smoothly and we took off on time Legroom was comfortable without being too generous with Google putting it at cm the longhaul industry average but nothing spectacular The cabin appeared to be spanking clean and in tiptop condition with its comforting shade of brown appeasing to the eyes Both USBA and USBC charging ports were offered and the seat even included a pillow for this short hop cross the Taiwan Strait Unfortunately dining options seemed to have fallen short with the food rather bland and not as appetising A small packet of juice was offered but no choices were given and neither was plain drinking water Another pet peeve is that in this day and age somehow Starlux does not have their IFE system connected to their PA system hence the IFE system was not allowed to be used during takeoff and landing Its the first time Ive experienced something like this on an aircraft that has an IFE system which by the way was pretty comprehensive The crew were all very professional and courteous and consistently checked on passengers during the short flight As a bonus we landed minutes ahead of schedule thanks to the speedy boarding and takeoff process All in all still a very attractive option in this competitive market though it falls short in an few areas and certainly has room for improvement

Flew SkyWork Airlines from Berlin to Bern You can eckeck in hrs before flight Both flights were on time Cabin was clean and legroom standard Service was friendly and they offer coffee and pie for lunch Airport was small but there was a bustrain connection to the town I would recommend them

When you get off the plane at Quito Mariscal Airport you are greeted with a stunning view of the mountains The staff are all very friendly and the airport itself is quite modern While there arent tonnes of bars and restaurants like the airports at home in Britain it doesnt matter Because the facilities are satisfactory and the staff behave the way staff should I arrived in Quito after transit in Panama which was a total dump with extremely rude staff so to arrive in my final destination where I now live and to be greeted to my new country in such a friendly manner by immigration and customs was lovely

Excellent service I flew on a hr m flight and the crew were excellent from boarding to disembarking The crew offered a complimentary snack onboard the seats are comfortable and the flight was smooth There were no delays or inconveniences during the flight The seats recline and although they are a bit old they are still leather and big so its very comfortable The crew helped me find my seat and they had a great attitude when I ordered a glass of water twice I will fly with them again recommended

My family flew to Daegu from Gimpo From checkin to boarding service rendered by all staff were efficient and excellent Cabin was clean and seats were usual economy class comfy On our return flight from Daegu to Gimpo we were late due to traffic and could not checkin thru self serve kiosk We had barely mins prior to flight departure Approached counter staff for assistance First thing the staff did was radioed the Captain while processing the checking in and printing of boarding passes An agent came over to escort and assisted us throughout the procedure to ensure we boarded the plane without further delay All these were completed within mins and flight departed on time Our biggest compliment is towards the Captain for both flights Journey was smooth and landing was perfect which you dont even feel the plane has landed Flew with many major top airlines in the world but never had this landing experience ever before Cabin Crew rating great and comparable to top airlines Keep it up and will definitely choose and fly Air Busan on all my destinations where served by Air Busan

Denpasar to Moscow Hard product ok as the aircraft has been flying for Emirates before with angled seats providing acceptable comfort Huge screen but only showing airshow IFE works on your personal device through a dedicated app Selection of movies rather limited Streaming with some issues during the flight Catering on level of premium economy Some choices but very basic food Wine available one white and one red basic quality No snacks between the two meals on a hour flight nuts only Crew trying to do their best very friendly Overall no consistent business class product huge room for improvement Value for money below average

Hong Kong Airport has not lost its lustre beauty elegance cleanliness And its employees are highly professional respectful and friendly Every time I travel through it I discover something new and this time I discovered the following A breathtaking and Epic view from the Sky Deck In late Hong Kong International Airport opened its new Sky Bridge a metrelong bridge built metres above the ground This is the worlds longest bridge over an active runway allowing even an Airbus A to pass underneath This bridge allows passengers and aviation lovers to enjoy breathtaking panoramic views of the airports aircraft movement and watch aircraft take off land and pass beneath them an experience unparalleled at any other airport If you are travelling through Hong Kong Airport you must visit this bridge
