Nouakchott to Dakar The new Nouakchott airport is about min from the city and opened only years ago Pretty efficient airport not crowded and only gates The lounge was surprisingly good English spoken fast WiFi and a decent selection of food and beverages Mauritania is a dry country The plane was less then a year old but very poor maintained The whole seating arrangement was mixed up Seat itself was old and relatively clean No welcome drink amenities or InFlight magazine Hot meal was served on a min flight Only coffee was served no other options The toilet had no soap nor towels Many passengers eat their meal with bare hands Crew was friendly but didnt speak English Not flag carrier worthy airline but for African standards pretty cheap and the hard product is pretty new Service in business class to Easyjet economy

I recently had the opportunity to experience the new terminal at Kempegowda International Airport in Bangalore and I must say it is a remarkable addition to the citys infrastructure Design and Ambiance The terminal boasts a stunning architectural design that blends modern aesthetics with traditional Indian elements The spacious layout is filled with natural light thanks to large glass facades The use of local materials in the design adds a unique touch making the environment both inviting and reflective of Karnatakas heritage Facilities One of the standout features of the new terminal is its stateoftheart facilities From efficient checkin counters to wellorganized security checks the entire process felt streamlined and userfriendly The wide range of shopping and dining options is impressive offering everything from local delicacies to international brands I particularly enjoyed the curated selection of souvenirs that showcase local artisans Technology The incorporation of technology is commendable Free WiFi charging stations and selfcheckin kiosks make the travel experience more convenient The digital displays for flight information are clear and easy to navigate which is essential in such a busy hub Sustainability What truly sets this airport apart is its commitment to sustainability The use of rainwater harvesting systems and solar energy reflects a forwardthinking approach to airport management which is vital in todays context of climate change Accessibility The airport is wellconnected with ample transportation options including taxis buses and ridesharing services The ease of access from the city makes it a practical choice for travelers Overall Impression In summary the new terminal at Kempegowda International Airport is a remarkable blend of modernity functionality and cultural resonance It elevates the travel experience and sets a high standard for airports in India Whether youre a frequent flyer or just passing through this airport is a pleasant surprise that showcases the best of Bangalore

We flew with Turkmenistan Airlines for flights one from Milan to Ashgabat hrs with a Boeing and another flight hrs from Ashgabat to Kuala Lampur with a Boeing Both flights were much better than expected after reading the reviews Both aircrafts looked modern and clean with very comfortable seats For the very affordable prices the airline offers the service is very good We got meals on both flights and unlimited coffee water or any other drinks The staff was really nice and you can even ask for a blanket if needed The only negative point is that you cant checkin online which leads to long queues at the desk but expect from that everything was fine We would definitely fly again with this airline they deserve more good reviews

What a great airport From the city centre bus stop to departure gate in just minutes friendly check in and security staff and of course amazing views of the surrounding mountains As a previous poster said along with Tallinn this must be one of the nicest and quickest European airports to use

An hour delay no apologies nor explanations Quite some occasional turbulences again no word from the cockpit What compensated the whole flight was the incredible good seat pitch and the round of drinks and a cookie definitely much better than what some selfproclaimed fullservice airlines deliver

I read lots of bad reviews about this company and was quite nervous to fly with them To my surprise and relief both flights went really well The checkin was quick and problem free everything very efficient Staff very helpful and friendly Both flights left on time Would highly recommend it as a budget airline

Beijing to Pyongyang Comparing an intraEuropean flight of hours and this flight practically no differences clean aircraft nice stewardesses punctual simple food good and attentive service a normal standard

The staff are very friendly The queue times for checkin and security are almost always very short or non existent making for a very smooth fast and pleasant experience all the way to boarding For such a small airport there are also a good amount of amenities ample seating and it is always clean

Hamad International Airport is nice brand new airport Very spacious and clean Good wifi line and plenty of free desktop for internet Seats are everywhere and they are comfortable Charging points are available throughout this airport Many choices for food and shopping However I find that the price is rather high

Manston is a wonderful airport to fly out of I walked next to my bags as I left the aircraft and collected them withing two minutes The airports size means within another minute I was at the main entrance Departure is wonderful check in was quick despite there only being six desks Within the blink of an eye you are in the departure area Dont expect vast shopping areas or money eating distractions here though

Flew SZGZUR Wasnt expecting anything from an hour long flight in a small twinprop plane but this was an excellent flight Smooth takeoffs and landing Easy checkin and great assistance at the airport Flight left on time with no delays Crew is very courteous and they speak very good English When you think it cant get any better they served food Complimentary food is a rare thing on short domestic flights especially on twinprop planes Overall excellent airline and would recommend them

Frankfurt to Berlin our first flight was cancelled but they arranged me other flight Next day I use Air Berlin also this time their service was on time and good service and cabin crew they are very friendly and helpful I was very happy their service

This airport has excellent free wifi but lacks any decent shops or restaurants I stayed in the airport for hrs whilst waiting for a connecting flight The checkin agent wouldnt check my bag through so I was stuck at the airport The best area for wifi is on the nd floor There are powerpoints behind the bench seats for charging your laptop Airside there are small shops and a cafebar at the very end of the departure lounge where the wifi doesnt work As a capital city airport it is lacking in many of the things one would expect Without the wifi it would be very hard to pass the time waiting for connecting flights

This is really a different airline The plane was impeccable clean looked young Cabin staff is really amazing taking care and checking during the hole flight Food was exquisite The Samsonite amenity kit was amazing sleek and modern A real pleasure to travel on this airline

The negative reviews of this airport have been highly exaggerated Bangladesh is a third world country so no its not quite up to the standards one would expect from a big international airport but its really completely fine I did not have any trouble getting through immigration or customs and didnt have to pay any bribes nor was I ever approached by someone who attempted to bribe me The Bangladeshi people are the best part of Bangladesh and thats true of the airport as well at least from the perspective of an English speaker Many of the staff speak English and were all polite friendly and welcoming The airport was reasonably clean and there were a few bugs though its not infested by any means Theres plenty of space It can get a little hot though as it is poorly airconditioned but its not any worse than any other airport in other poor countries Once you are out of the official airport you do need to be careful because there are some scammers mostly unaffiliated with the airport running around who will try to get you to put your bags on their carts and then charge you exorbitant fees to get your bags back As usual when travelling to a place with a lot of poverty dont engage with these people and you will be fine

A short and very pleasant morning flight Efficient boarding airport is small nice seats Professional staff which served water and a sweet Very soft landing All in all a nice experience meeting again the high expectations for AegeanOlympic Air

GSO is a very convenient and nice airport Parking is super convenient right next to the terminal which makes it nice when picking up people It is a nice and clean airport that I try and fly out of whenever I can I only wish that I could get more direct flights out of there

Love Ryanair efficiency Does what is says on the packet nothing pretentious Crew were great and even managed to go down with aisle with the trolley on a minute flight My th flight with them just wish they flew to Frankfurt theyd get all my euro business

My boyfriend and I booked the basic fare from Hamburg to Rome Fiumicino I didnt expect much because Germanwings is a low cost airline but it was great The staff were friendly when boarding was completed the pilot welcomed us all on board and although we had just booked the basic fare the stewardess gave us drinks for free Departed and arrived on time The first time I was in Rome I waited nearly minutes for my bag but this time they were really fast Would recommend flying with Germanwings

The airport has basic facilities and I think it works when it has little traffic The staff are nice and friendly There are very limited options if you want to eat something at the airport After the security there are only two cafes without good meal options The seating at the gates is limited Most of the gates are located upstairs with limited space Considering the fact that passengers arrive and depart from the same gates they sometimes get very crowded

Lovely little airport Check in was very quick as was passport control and security Good selection of shops after security Airport was very clean including the toilets A couple of dining options available and a drinking water dispenser provided to top up your bottles Mineral water can also be purchased for US Plenty of seating available by the gates On departure there are no gates just a short walk to the plane All in all a great little airport

Both arrival and departure from MGA was problem free No crowds The only short queue was immigration on arrival If not included in the air fare there is an entry charge of US and a departure charge of US The facility is modern and clean Shopping here is not cheap but the quality and variety of merchandise is excellent Eating is much more expensive than outside the airport but prices compare favourably with European equivalents The waiting areas have ample seating and are cool Unlike many other airports there is a lack of electronic information boards But it has the charm of some of the once small manageable airports we once had in Europe

Airport is easy to reach by metro train and taxi Check in area and departure area have been perfectly clean In the check in area only few shops and restaurant available departure area have more choice but I did not use them as I used the lounge Check in went fast and efficient same for security check Staff was professional

I have flown Porter on other occasions and have many good experiences I was supposed to travel with them in April but due to an accident I would not be able to with upcoming doctor and Physio appointments The customer service representative Erin was phenomenal She listened and asked questions as to address my issue with regards to my upcoming flight I am now able to have time to heal myself and take my flight at a later date Thank you Erin and Porter

Extremely friendly wheelchair assist personnel I am disabled and was being moved from gate to gate and since I had some layover time I decided that I would like to get a snack at one of the fast food shops The wheelchair assistant not only took me there but he helped me get my order as well The people everywhere were friendly Cleanliness wasnt top grade but adequate

The signs at Fuzhou airport are quite helpful since available in both English and Chinese The border security counter has a rating system where you can rate them based on your experience If you dont speak Chinese it may be slightly difficult to get around Queue was quite long and it took quite long to find your baggage However it was an OK experience The staff was very friendly and friendlier than I had expected

Astana is a small international airport that is well connected to Europe via Frankfurt London Paris and Amsterdam through Kazakhstans Air Astana The airport has only one terminal for Domestic and International flights A new terminal is being constructed next to the existing facility which is planned to be opening in spring The arrivals and baggage reclaim is small Immigration quite smooth and officers were friendly but remember to fill in your immigration card with a blue or black pen not with a red one as it is not accepted I had almost no queues Taxi pickup at the terminal is not wellorganised and taxi recruiters can be annoying The central hall for departures is quite spacious and there is sufficient seating around the checkin area Checkin areas are small and somewhat oldfashioned but work fine Friendly ground staff Short queuing time at checkin passport control and security Emigration passport control is fine There are few FB and retail facilities at the international departure gates There is plenty of seating at the end of the concourse close to the small cafe in the back Transferring between international flights is quick and easy Passengers do not have to pass immigration only security screening It took me only minutes from arrival gate to departure gate FB and retail facilities are limited especially in the departure are after immigration Food choice is limited Very good wifi while waiting for checkin or for your flight Password can be obtained via SMS Terminal and toilets are clean Remote arrivals and departures via bus in winter when temperatures can go below Celsius can be cold and slippery but also a very interesting experience When the new terminal will be opened in I assume less aircraft will be handled via busses

Lots of good food and shops Amazing love piano playing and fun Wicked Weed food court However the reason Im writing is because this place is filthy I dont want to touch a surface I know theyre under construction but that doesnt account for counters and corners and floors that obviously havent been scrubbed in a long time Gross Embarrassing The survey asks if I would recommend this airport and my reply is mixed First off airport choice is pretty arbitrary as it just depends on where youre going and also some aspects are great The cleanliness however is terrible

Domestic arrival was good canteen facilities are reasonably priced Toilet was clean in arrival hall International departure money exchange facilities available The security check was not particularly friendly boarding was smooth via gate with Virgin Australia using an air bridge

Arrived mid night from Mumbai in a domestic flight aircraft attached to aero bridge in min we were at baggage area baggage arrived in next min Washroom were clean paid porters available plenty of baggage trolly No public transport during night only option is either prepaid or booking directly with taxi drivers We took prepaid going to Utorda around km paid approx inr during night a percent surcharge is applicable during day time should be around inr Just after you exit the terminal would be surrounded by taxi drivers prepaid cab counter is inside the building at arrival hall

Waco Regional is not a bad airport overall They only have one flight which is to Dallas but I have heard rumors that United Express is resuming flights to Houston The reason I have given it stars is because their flights are always delayed or late My advice to travelers flying into Waco is to have patience The baggage claim takes a while The car rental facility is not bad for a small town Overall I think the airport shows good quality
The security staff at Townsville Airport are the most friendliest efficient and personable I never dread having to go through screening at this airport pity Brisbane AP doesnt operate as efficiently

Not good for transit passengers Staff are polite and helpful but nowhere to relaxsleep in a darker and quiet area No ATMsshopsfood outlets just a cafe upstairs Toilets clean Electric socket near where I was sitting didnt work I obtained wifi with the help of someone as there seems to be no airport wifi This lounge is just a square room brightly lit with toiletschairs and a few coffee tables Please improve our flying experience

Small but good airport I visited it two weeks ago and I found it to be clean Its true that there not many people principally fligths of SAS and Norwegian but I liked it especially the after control zone where two barrestaurants The checkin zone is clean and well organized with an active information point Positive general impression from this airport

Think it only has a dozen flights or so a day exclusively under the Air NZ banner now Freedom Air is being reamalgamated into Air NZ It has been well modernised and seems very spacious It has the advantages of a small airport with short distances plane to terminal to baggage collection and to car park We were in the car and off within mins of getting off the lane On departure there is a great upstairs light and airy waitingeating arrivals area with plenty of space and excellent views There are adequate drinks food and shop The only downside was that the hire car companies closed quite early so as we were arriving at pm we had to persuade friends to come and collect us

Pulkovo new terminal is reasonably good and modern Easy to navigate both on arrival and departure Visa checks are very complex in Russia and Pulkovo stands up to the job with lots of passport check desks queue cleared in less than mins both ways Departures hall has restaurants cafes shops signage is good However the airport still has long way to go There are very few air bridges majority of planes sit on the tarmac and require shuttle bus to the terminal Connections to the city centre belong to previous decade you have to take bus that takes you to the metro then ride the metro for several stops Ending up having to take a taxi which has some risks in Russia if you arent familiar

Flew Lublin to Heraklion Very comfortale trip without delays friendly helpful and professional crew good amtosphere on board everything fast and without problems I felt safe during the journey and I think that I will choose Small Planet for my next year holiday

Short one hour flights with Safarilink to Diani from Nairobi Wilson return A very pleasant way to reach the coast from Nairobi and much quicker overall than the JKIA Nairobi Airport to Mombasa route Drink and biscuit served Both airports were small indeed Diani is described as an airstrip

Koh Samui Airport is a lovely little airport and probably the most attractive airport I have ever travelled through Check in seemed to be very efficient and no long queues There is a large number of shops and restaurants available outside after you have checked in Toilets were ok and reasonably clean but quite a lot of insects buzzing around As many airport in Thailand they mix passengers on domestic flights through different parts of the airport and therefore passengers with international departures clear immigration and board the flight through a different gate to the domestic passengers on the same flight Seems a bit odd but they have a system and it works

I was on an Aer Lingus flight operated by Cityjet My flight was late due to weather in London and my original flight got cancelled but I got put onto a flight minutes later The flight itself was OK The seats on this little Avro are very cramped Cityjet uses a configuration instead of the standard This makes the seats very thin and leaves you with not much room The inflight catering was provided by Aer Lingus and featured a buy on board service As this was a morning flight I opted for a Hot chocolate and some shortbread and for this was decently priced But the highlight of this flight was well and truly the Avro RJ which I wanted to fly on before they all get retired and I am very pleased I did It is a unique experience and I would recommend for any aviation fans to try this flight as it is relatively cheap and the Avro is an absolute joy

The cabin was too warm which made this short flight rather uncomfortable also it was a rather turbulent one They served a good sandwich with complimentary drinks which in my opinion is a very nice gesture Legroom was premium as were the seats

Passenger assistance is the best we have experienced very polite helpful and well organised thank you very much airport clean good to see it as drinking water fountain also impressed free bottles of water on arrival on inbound flight
Great airport Excellent shopping facilities Very clear directions Very helpful staff A cut above the rest of the small airports I have visited

Excellent security Left my laptops by mistake at security and went to my plane I noticed once in the plane While I couldnt deboard the staff and pilot called security and they were found and brought to lost and found A friend picked them up days later

My first experience with Malm Aviation flying from StockholmBromma to Malm Cheap fares friendly cabin crew comfortable aircraft free meal and coffee on that domestic flight Do you recognize SAS Youre right it isnt SAS It is Malm Aviation

I had to cancel my travel plans from Dar Es Salaam to Arusha due to a medical emergency Coastal Aviation was very supportive understanding and efficient in processing my situation Much appreciated Great company

Just had to leave this review on th May returned from Rhodes and my flight was delayed two hours Just after midnight left baggage reclaim to go to my car I had a flat battery and was unable to get into my car It was exceptionally cold and all I was wearing was shorts and a tee shirt I returned to the terminal where I met the staff at the parking desk At this time the terminal was empty and they were locking up The staff came out and helped me gain entry to my car but I had a two hour wait for the Green Flag breakdown The staff waited with me almost an hour and had to go home leaving me alone in the car park freezing cold but not before he returned to his office made me a hot cup of tea and brought it to me in my car A beautiful act of kindness and one I will never forget

I could not believe how quiet the airport is now Ryanair have decreased their flights checked in with baggage in less then minutes and through security to departures in no time Once airside there is not much to do but there is several duty free shops a caferestaurant and a SubwayMcDonalds outlet as well as two outdoor smoking terraces All in all a nice clean little airport with helpful and friendly staff
I am not sure when you went to the airport in maracaibo but things have change a lot Prices are not as bad and there is lots of choices to eat and drink very reasonable

I should report good news On a recent flight to AMS my preprinted boarding pass could not be read by the scanner at security and I was dealt with as were other passengers in a similar situation very brusquely and rudely by a couldntcareless itseverybodyelsesfaultbutmine attendant On my return I wrote a letter of complaint to the airport manager received an immediate acknowledgement and within a few days a detailed and thoughtful apology not just a standard halfhearted general foboff Excellent PR which I applaud

I was impressed and there is room for improvement Both sectors departed and arrived on time Suprisingly Calm and efficient boarding the Aircraft which was pristine two very hard working and happy Crews With a rather Comfortable seat On Both Sectors the Aircraft appeared full I tried to be a smart snagging a decent seat at online check in Many carriers allow you to select an alternate seat should you be allocated a poor one Omar Air do not and I had H and F in the aft cabin right at the rear of the Aircraft The Forward Cabin is far more appealing and it served me right Seriously consider paying for a seat there That said if wasnt onerous Should they address two things they are up there even nicer than the usual elite Middle Eastern Carriers A spectacular dawn arrival into Muscat was an unexpected treat and what a delightful Airport Please address Economy Catering Plastic cutlery Tray looks cheap and nasty and it was sparse Two choices including the apparently notorious Chicken with Rice which is exceptionally unappealing Same meal on both sectors IFE Such a shame as the Screen is of exceptional quality Content falls well short of the competition here Despite the Mealplan and Tedious IFE Id still recommend

WestJet from Calgary to London Heathrow was excellent The flight attendant introduced herself by name and provided a warm welcome Remembered customers names as well A very decent sparkling wine and hot towels were served before take off Menu choices were good and dinner was quite tasty Breakfast options were far better than on other carriers There was a good choice of wines poured generously IFE system was pretty standard Seats comfortable Overall the quality of the premium economy product on WestJet is far superior to Air Canadas and better than British Airways
Relatively simple layout Staff very friendly and informative Buses into the city centre bus station depart right in front of the terminal but are not as frequent as could be

Super modern airport bright shiny and very clean Security control was reasonably quick on departure and arrival and I found the staff professional although they dont smile a lot Bonus points for having showers after security I took one and it was marvellous I wasnt sold on Abu Dhabi itself but the airport is certainly one of the best Ive experienced in recent times

The airport is fine and clean food was good and getting through the security was fine However the so call dutyfree store is another matter everything was way over priced For example the Local Rum Appleton years old was over USD That is very expensive to pay that kind of money in Jamaica for local rum on a dutyfree when you can buy the same in Ontario Canada one of the higher liquor tax jurisdictions for under USD All of the products on the dutyfree were way overpriced You can get the same rums in the USA at the supermarkets for less from the dutyfree store of Montego bay airport I purchase a Cuban Havana Club year old in Havana on December for USD

Cochin International Airport is a beautiful environment friendly and comfortable airport From the infrastructure to the furniture the process the staff everything about this airport exudes comfort and positive vibes The airport is powered by solar panels wooden interiors and well functioning toilet fittings and fixtures make this airport an environment friendly one

How refreshing for an airport free wifi free minutes parking for passenger pickup abundant electrical outlets under seats a splendid Aviation Historical Museum friendly TSA security welcome home free cookies free shuttle to your car long term parking per day which is closer than the short term in most airports even if it costs a little more to fly out of Fort Wayne it is worth it

Despite the difficult situation in Egypt this airport has got no worse since I was last here two years ago neither has it got any better It was clean and it had adequate facilities for the reduced number of passengers now using the airport Duty Free prices are ridiculously high and therefore not as well used as they could be There is free wifi but I could not get a reliable signal Baggage delivery on arrival was astonishingly fast a quality for other airports to copy The longest queues were those going through security at the front door of the airport other security queues were quite short

A fine small airport great personal service clean well decorated easy parking simple and efficient signage has a luxury feel befitting the Palm Beach Clientele Food selection adequate and reasonable Parking is a breeze Always many security personnel and queue times very short A pleasure to travel to or from

I am a frequent traveller and I like Hyderabad airport It offers a good shopping experience Has many brands and user friendly I keep traveling to middle East through this airport as well as various through Mumbai and Delhi as well I would like to say people are helpful and good easy to understand and very clean airport I can rate it as one of the best airports in India

A late night flight pm delayed by almost minutes is not the most pleasant beginning to the journey especially given the horrible Encalm Lounge in Delhi dirty crowded rubbish food However the onboard experience was amazing the A has lieflat seats with large IFE screens which is a treat since I could sleep comfortably for over an hour in a less than hour flight The cabin crew were prompt helpful and very attentive Upto food choices and a pretty good spread The IFE screens were great and the entertainment catalog is good enough for a short domestic flight but would be a bit boring for a hour or above flight However baggage claim experience was not the best despite the baggage being priority tagged it arrived after of the copassengers in the flight had received their bags and when you are running over an hour late it was a bit frustrating

It is absolutely unfair to give only one star to this airline the Tupolev plane is in good condition and perfectly clean the crew are efficient pleasant and helpful and last but not least it is always on time you can find many airlines much worse than that for instance Air China on the same route The route flown is the no route of Air Koryo linking DPRK to Beijing and this entitles you to some patriotic videos on the overhead screen The buns served are not too bad and drinks are acceptable for such a small trip All in all a good experience

Used this airport on numerous occasions over the last years Over the last year both domestic and international terminals underwent some renovation and rearrangement of facilities in my opinion for the better Of all facilitiesservices expectable from a midsize regional airport ARH lacks free WIFI coverage and cafes serving hot meals Overall it is a decently wellkept airport which may though benefit from further renovations and improvements

Unhelpful Disorganized Was on a layover from Amsterdam to Toronto Canada I arrived through KLM airlines but my luggage didnt When I asked about my luggage the luggage staff said they transferred it to my next flight which they dont do and my itinerary said baggage not checked through When I left luggage collection and went to the check in area I asked a staff member if they could confirm it was sent through and they said with certainty that they would not have transferred my luggage and to go check again I went back to check again but security would not let me back into the luggage area I told them the story and without even looking at my flight itinerary said it was transferred to my next flight I had no contact with this security officer before nor did they know anything about my situation prior Now to be clear its almost certain that KLM lost my luggage and its not the luggage handlers problem But for them to just lie about it to get rid of me is unacceptable They could have said it appears it didnt arrive and thats fine I cant blame them for that But I just essentially went back and forth between people in the airport not knowing who was telling the truth or who knows what theyre talking about I dont expect Mexico City airport to be the best airport in the world but to be an international airport that essentially has no centralized information center and to have employees who just lie to get rid of you is really unacceptable Im sure they dont get paid the most and I get that
Another great flight Very consistent service consistent quality of food and comfortable aircraft The service on the flight was just spot on I would recommend them based on how consistent they are

I found Philadelphia International Airport very confusing to navigate Fortunately we had requested wheelchair assistance for my mum who has limited mobility The guy Cordell who helped us was friendly approachable and kind which made our experience so much more pleasant

Departure in afternoon fast check in very clean airport and large waiting area after customs check Bar before customs checks and automatic distributors after Boarding directly by satellite Arrival in the morning disembarking by feet aircraft very close to the terminal Quick luggage delivery Some taxis not very numerous outside the terminal Airport very pleasant

Travelled with my brother and mother The travel operator booked the flights I never heard or know this airline before The route flown was domestic from Tehran Mehrabad to Shiraz We were dropped at the wrong terminal Apparently Kish Air operates from Terminal We were dropped to Terminal Ground staff at airport were polite As we brought a wheelchair the ground staff required the wheelchair to be shrinkwrapped Airport wheelchair requested without much fuss Flight was a little delayed minutes Airport ground staff were fantastic during the boarding process My mother used a disabled friendly vehicle Aircraft was an old MD Chicken pickle sandwich and peanuts served during flight with orange juice box Cabin crew very friendly The toilet was foul The water did not work in the tap or closet Upon arrival in Shiraz once again excellent airport ground serviceKish Air flight crew and captain also friendly and welcoming

Awful from front desk to boarding airport is like a sauna staff are rude and dont want to be here but then there is only a handful of staff No information for English lucky I speak Italian it makes you appreciate Gatwick and Heathrow

Dusseldorf to London City Very nice flight including free Snacks and drinks Legroom was okay and staff was friendly but seemed a little stressed due to a huge amount of hand luggage in this flight Inflight magazines were old

This January was my fifth trip to PortauPrince and my first since I flew in on a DC just after the quake While the airport is essentially the same the service coming and going is very much improved Customs and security well organized Staff courteous Best of all the road and parking lot outside are way better controlled I was impressed at how much has been done without new buildings Cleaner more efficient and quite friendly Big compliment on the effort and results I returned to Canada via Fort Lauderdale which was a bad transit experience

The airport itself is good but the design looks simply ok The airport is big it has old and new parts the new part looks better It has many checkin desks fast security check and very nice that they have priority security check and priority passport control Some nice business lounges and good duty free

A rather small airport serving Firenze I used the airport in the winter season so imagine it during the busy summer season Theres bus boarding only and max small gates It has a abundance of dutyfree shops and food beverages counters Prices are reasonable Staff is friendly and efficiently working

A quick visit to Rome from Prague on Ryanair The airport location close to the city is great with a painless connection via Airport Link Bus Train The entire trip easily purchased on the Trenitalia app for only to Termini The airport terminal itself is large enough to accommodate flights at the same time could be stretched to capacity with more traffic Boarding and disembarking on foot with some shops available Staff was curtuous so our departure was on time The proximity to Rome is a strong selling point when comparing to FCO

Flew in from Baltimore on Southwest What a great little airport Easy to navigate spotless facilities fast wifi and good options for coffee and snacks A great alternative to Boston for access to Cape Cod

Nimes is one of the most pleasant airports Ive experienced Its quite small is a favourable alternative to Montpellier for those of us whose eventual destination is in the Herault area not least because of its close proximity to the motorway and current absence of major roadworks It is a place to relax and stroll about while waiting to meet incoming friends and carparking is a doddle The flight to and from Liverpool with Ryanair is direct

I upgraded from Economy to Economy Sleeper on this hour flight This gives you a row of three standard economy seats to yourself in a separate and quieter segment of the cabin between economy and business You also get a mattress pillow and duvet the idea being that you can sleep across the three seats This does not really work because If you try to lie flat your feet stick out into the aisle If you prop yourself up sitting with your back to the window the inner arm rest sticks into your back The mattress which is meant to be attached via straps to the seats slides off easily when you move If there is turbulence and you have to fasten your seat belt it is not possible to do this while lying horizontally across the seats Standard economy seats lack the depth needed lie down comfortably across them You cannot watch a programme on the entertainment system in a horizontal position I tried for a while to find a comfortable position but gave up in the end and just sat in my reclined seat Its a nice idea and was worth a try but it does not deliver It was quite a costly upgrade too and the airline would be better served converting that midsection into proper premium economy with more comfortable and spacious seats Of the rows on each side of the cabin only two were occupied which perhaps reflects the point I am making about value for money The service throughout was excellent and my review and ratings refer specifically to the Economy Sleeper offer

A very friendly team of airport workers overall Southern hospitality goes a long way Would like to see more dining options and shops that are not all identical in product choices Overall a very good experience Would definitely fly to Memphis again without hesitation

The experience is a unique one and I also have a trouble on how to rate this airline We start off from Singapores Changi Airport and the check in was quite smooth note that their carryon is only kg we get our boarding pass finish security and customs we finally managed to board the plane the cabin crew was very sweet and nice we are not delayed however the landing was super bad

Kuala Lumpur to Kuching return on Feb Overall vey satisfied with the experience An exceptional service by the friendly cabin crew The airline offers an exceptional value for money The economy class cabin very clean and features new seats and wifi entertainment using own device The food is good for a domestic flight In both sectors boarding by groups and strictly follow The ground staff is good but can be better For one and half hour flight am not complaining

Rhodes to Birmingham We would just like to say a big thank you to all the crew on our aircraft from Rhodes to Birmingham that brought us back on the th September due to Thomas cook not trading anymore The staff was so friendly and professional Thank you once again

The Buffalo Niagara Airport was quite an experience It was easily accessible and was fantastic with the hotels right across the road The staff were okay We were flying early in the morning so they might have been tired but they seemed alright The airport was larger than I expected The parking was easy and cheap Overall it was a nice experience

Budapest to Shanghai New Years Day Flew on a newer B They had opened not less than checkin counters in Budapest of which are for Sky Priority only thus very comfortable BPs issued immediately including the following flight with China Eastern SVGHKG counts as international flight As being Flying Blue Silver I was accessed to Sky Priority counters and was checked in in a few Minutes prioritised in all queues and boarding and eventually at gate upgraded from Economy to Economy Plus as flight was full in lower classes and in business I was lucky not to have my original selected seat as all seat were taken in economy Trip went smooth captain made kind announcements FAs were also kind and firm though listening Lots of food they ran out of wine and beers within an hour after departure Very embarrassing but quite typical for Chinese airlines apart from Cathay Pacific Bought own supplies of champagne from airport FA off course accepted it as they know they are running short especially on a New Years Day I brought my own glasses and let them chill down my champagnes Good food two full hot meal rounds with options Catered from Budapest thus Western oriented unlike when departing from Shanghai I had at least hot meals on board many were meals in excess as passengers were stuffed after New Year and could have had more if I could manage At breakfast service still dinner meals were left Clean toilets throughout Blankets and earplugs provided Individual IFE was extremely good and technically the best I have seen in the skies Content limited to some Western movies but that suffices as their choice goes beyond the most popular Hollywood stuff Simultaneously plenum monitors display the current flight data and maps Arrived Minutes early in the huge completely overdimensioned Shanghai airport I rate them high as for Qatar Airways though the product pros and cons are quite different The trick is not to have Westernised expectations and to appreciate all what they do for you if you are firm with wishes and appreciative Best with Shanghai Airlines was the new aircraft its punctuality good service surprising foods I tried and finished all sorts of dishes they offered all were fairly tasty and an unbeatable price

Hobart Airport is much more user friendly now though the terminals have not been connected so Jetstar passengers are still relegated to the old botched international venture built for the old Ansett The new catering in domestic is good but It is shameful that there is no WiFi intenet access anywhere It would cost a few hundred dollars at the most for the Tasmanian Government to give free WiFi access at Hobart Airport and so reinforce the image it is trying to give as a progressive State It is doubtful that a private company will ever do it and Tasmania would top all the other states in lateral thinking if it did it for free

Small but very clean airport disembarking to exiting airport mins minimal duty free shops on arrival but more extensive on departure area Very security conscious on entry and exit All in all a walk in the park no hassle

The seats were excellent with a feel of much more room than the official seat pitch I am ft in We could sleep for a couple of hours daytime flight with the blinds down as they should be no point booking a window seat in my view I focus on seat quality much more than smiley faces and food the food was middling and the second meal before landing was distinctly subpar

Why do we always want to fly the big airlines VLM has the efficiency of a budget airline the service of a high value airline and the punctuality of a German airline They have friendly staff and after landing you are out of the airport in minutes Moreover book well in advance and you have a very attractive fare

First and only visit to a Nang on a transit back in Oct No complaints overall easy navigation not crowded amenities were up to expectations considering it to be only rd largest airport in Vnam Immigration was surprisingly nice asked me for a CS survey which I was delighted to do Staff was also friendly put me on priority queue to my connecting flight international to domestic Fast and efficient everything was done quickly Would love to fly there again as soon as I get the chance

NurSultan to Almaty return I bought the tickets on the companys website Initially I planned to travel with just a hand baggage but the day before the flight I managed to add a baggage on the website for tg The flights were excellent Flight attendants sold buy onboard drinks and snacks Arrival was just on time The ticket price turned out to be cheaper even than the Talgo train

Perfect experience After having read the reviews on Fastjet I was very nervous despite friends reinsurance that the airline had improved dramatically in recent years Well everything was perfect The ticket was very reasonably priced Checkin online and baggage drop off were easy The flight left on time and arrived minutes early The air hostess was charming The snacks though not fancy were good and our chairs were comfortable The baggage was on the carousel by the time we arrived Very happy customers

Guayaquil airport is one of the best around The building is modern very functional and easy The staff who work there always are profesional and the most important thing is that you always has a feeling of been safe

A good airport Lots of places to eat including burger and many seats with places to charge you devices I sat there for hrs just streaming Netflix on the wifi May I say the wifi Is great Highly recommend

I hadnt flown from LGA in years and was very impressed with the new Terminal B home to American Airlines and others Beautifully designed spacious and easy to navigate with abundant dining and shopping opportunities Checkin areas are spacious and efficient Great rest rooms The new terminal is unrecognizable and a huge improvement

The new Hanoi international terminal opened at the end of December excellent and well planned a big improvement on the old terminal It only took me a few minutes to check in and pass the security very efficient happy helpful staff all the way

The airport is huge with clear signage direction and information It is well connected to the public transportation such as bus taxi Grab and the airport rail link leading to Phaya Thai Immigration is fast and convenient All nationalities are now using the auto gate for immigration at Departure Shopping and dining experience is quite nice with great choices of duty free items More greens might be needed to make the airport more ecofriendly I would suggest

YYZAMSYYZ Legroom was okay got the exit row on the way back Food decent for a charter Seat width normal unlike Air Transat they dont squeeze an extra row of seats in I didnt feel the need to upgrade to Economy plus The personal entertainment device portable hard drive with monitor was great Worth the euro on the day flight back

Because I arrived by train I spent a long time at the airport before taking the plane I appreciated being able to wait while working on the platform on the first floor Its quiet holds along the wall On the other hand the layout is more than basic and it would deserve to landscape this place and make it more comfortable and with more outlets associated with the tables It is not at all pretty to see Everything is well signposted to access the boarding gates toilets checkin counters Real improvement to be made after security for catering and accessible power outlets Indeed the choice of food is more than summary at the only restaurant in place Only breadbased food and very rare more than mediocre salads Plots with sockets on the boarding floor are extremely rare and many people jostle to get there The beverage dispensing machines can be used with a credit card but do not dispense card tickets which does not allow for an expense report Very detrimental to business travelers like me Johannesburg to St Denis Service like it was years ago professional attentive amenity kit handed out on a hour flight and the quality and quantity of the catering Ive not seen for years Thoroughly recommended

Great little airport Everything in one location baggage belts next to car hire desks and you walk out into the car park and collect your car Will be my preferred choice now rather than coming in via LAX or SAN and facing a hour drive

This was my first time using EVA and I was a little disappointed The lounge in the airport was ok but nothing special As for the flight on first impression it appeared the plane had not been refit for years The colour scheme was drab no frills functional tired However the flight was ok The food was plentiful and good the service excellent the lie flat bed was quite comfortable and the entertainment ok The staff even called you by name throughout the flight which was a nice touch The toilet was also particularly spacious and clean One small moans After the food service the flight crew disappeared and didnt really reappear for hours If you wanted something you had to go to the galley and ask They provided it Overall I would have no hesitation using them again if the price was right

I arrived at PSP from SFO I have used the airport from time to time in the past It is quite capable of coping with its traffic but has experienced one major improvement whereby hired cars can now be collected on site This is very welcome especially when the heat is high
I loved the flight and service the crew was very helpful and friendly Found the seats comfy and because of the low fares we booked make this trip to Iceland Thank you WOW airWe will miss you

Lovely small airport with one of the best views of any Ive ever visited About km from the town but generally one plane at a time so queues transport etc not really an issue Great coffee bar go upstairs for views to die for coffee is also good Planes can go early and beware of the winds when leaving Sympathetically installed to harmonise with landscape as much as an airport can Still need to pay in cash a departure tax about GB Pounds Also dont carry fresh food in hand luggage even if on an internal flight it will be confiscated on arrival due to some strange Argentinean regulations

Flew Air Niugini because of the B very nice cabin in a xx configuration Took seat A bulkhead seat very comfortable with heaps of leg room Staff were amazing and very attentive food was OK entertainment was enough for this flight of approx hrs

So refreshing to be able to use Duerne instead of Brussels Less than minutes from plane to car this week and that included collecting a bag On return I checked in about minutes before the flight hardly any queue

Departure in afternoon fast check in very clean airport and large waiting area after customs check Bar before customs checks and automatic distributors after Boarding directly by satellite Arrival in the morning disembarking by feet aircraft very close to the terminal Quick luggage delivery Some taxis not very numerous outside the terminal Airport very pleasant

My husband suffers with neuropathy and towards the end of our holiday his feet were very painful which made walking difficult I did not arrange assistance at the airport and was concerned he was unable to do all the walking at the airport and worse still the amount of walking at Heathrow I enquired at the help desk and explained my predicament The staff were amazing and not only arranged assistance at Gibraltar but also contacted Heathrow on our behalf I cannot thank them enough for making our Journey an amazing experience at both airports which would have been a nightmare their kindness was was very much appreciated and I cannot thank them enough

Flew Stockholm to Tehran with Iran Air I had good flight with the new fleet of this airline minute delay but the cabin was new and clean with good seat distance and very tasty food Iranian film and music and route information was provided I recommend flying with Iran Air on international routes because of the nice cabin and good meals for the value of money

Beautiful views on takeoff free longterm parking nice friendly efficient staff and so convenient if you live between Edinburgh and Aberdeen But does it really have to be so prohibitively costly for the nonbusiness and small business traveler The dreary trek to Edinburgh by train and bus or even car adds hours but saves hundreds of pounds Whens Easyjet coming to Leuchars Air France needs some competition

A postmodern airport with many good restaurants and very spacious and comfortable environment Inside the departure area you have an amazing view of the aircrafts The seats are very ergonomic and delightful All the airports areas are very clean and hygienic On the other hand there are not many signals explaining the directions for each of the airports areas and facilities

Nice looking airport with lots of great vendors but TSA security check is a nightmare TSA PreCheck only available on the A terminal side Airlines dont make you aware of that or let you know there is a quick path from A terminal to B TSA checks were very slow so go to your gate early

Small clean airport Close to the city centre If one arrives for a later flight in the evening arrive with a full stomach as nothing is open after It is an efficient small airport with quick security The TV is still on at full volume in the departure area

Just wanted to shout out the excellent customer service and help I received recently at Denpasar Bali airport I stupidly left two bags on the carousal when I went through customs Airport security were very friendly as the guided me through a secure area to go back behind the luggage area to retrieve the bags and customs did not hassle me for going through twice Cant imagine doing this so easily in a North American airport Bali people are great

PortoOslo th Aug on a B Ticket purchased on DYs homepage CheckIn online not possible on computer but need mobile app No extra costs having BPs printed out in the airport Large handluggage were accepted regulations appear strict but are not enforced in any aggressive way Airport crowded and incredibly hot in sunny afternoons Boarding in groups is a nuisance as the groups get amalgamated into a large cramped pool before final boarding Those passengers called last upon for boarding de facto became the first to board Onboard spacious well bolstered seats better than for most other airlines yes Direct flight almost took hours I got a prepaid hot meal served which was nice and tasty Full flight A significant boarding delay of hour created congestion at gate and caused late arrival of more than one hour No IFE but WiFi worked

Milan to New York return via Dusseldorf I had a very positive experience with AirBerlin on all four of our flights The prices were phenomenal all four of us flew economy roundtrip for less although they did charge me quite a bit for seat reservations with small kids you cant really make a good case for oh honey sorry you get to sit to that stranger Everything ran on time The seats are as about tight as most US airlines though not as bad as Uniteds back rows But we fit fine video was working with lots of options for watching food was okishand the attendants were quite helpful and very nice Really I have no complaints And yes I did check in luggage on the way back because who doesnt overshop in Italy and I got them back in NYC We were all nervous about this due to all the bad review of lost luggage In fact it is why I am writing the review as I promised myself I would write a good review if we arrived home intact with a good experience I fly Business for work I was expecting worse but was very pleased as were my husband two kids

Dragonair is part of Cathay Pacific From Hong Kong to Guangzhou is less than miles but they provide an excellent service When on board cabin crew deliver a bottle of water and a cookie The cabin crew are very nice

Corpus Christi is fine small airport In remarkably good shape and well kept Very simple and easy to navigate TSA security was a breeze no lines and all staff were actually very firendly Not much offering presecurity but couple of shops and restaurants post security Easy to get to just west of downtown

Loved flying into Milwaukee We flew in from DC with AirTran to attend our daughters naval bootcamp graduation and what an excellent airport It was a short minute drive to North Chicago We even loved the enterprise rental car pickupdropoff I highly recommend this airport

Excellent location Good services I appreciate the airport but maybe it is necessary to improve the checkin services during the night time Sometimes the terminal electronic system does not work and personnel seem to have problems with the check in
Airport is quite small and toilets are not so clean Not much to do while waiting for your flight but for a short wait the experience is not that bad

I arrived at night so it was difficult to be as observant as during the day but baggage came off the conveyor belt within minutes and I obtained a modern car with a very pleasant driver for the transfer to my city hotel the transfer costing P which was reasonable Overall an airport that delivered for me on this trip

Used Estonian times in the last months AMSTLL vice versa Pleasantly surprised CRJ with a lot of legroom Charming staff Disliked the practice of sending economy passengers to a kiosk in TLL to get a boarding pass where you pay euros Once had a delay of minutes which the captain explained announcements over the speakers were very distorted and hard to understand Boarding at TLL was a mess The plane was a bit late arriving disembarking passengers refuelling no bridge from the gate people kept waiting Catering was okay but you pay through the nose of course No visa cards just cash

I was surprised when I arrived at Berlin Tempelhof how small the airport was However the facilities are there although in a small scale and the airport is relatively clean and friendly Not a bad airport just a bit out of date

Excellent flight great room and staff were excellent Little English is spoken I had originally booked Hainan but they cancelled initial booking and booked me to Capital Very limited entertainment and glad I had a book

Excellent small regional airport spotlessly clean with very friendly staff slight oddity that the baggage reclaim belts are in the arrivals hall but I was out within th mins of the plane touching down and you cant get much better than that

Air New Zealand representative named Leanne was very helpful when I needed help to check in my ft surfboard she was helpful when I needed help to print out my boarding pass exceptional patience and excellent customer skills

Vistara stands out as a premium fullservice carrier offering a superior travel experience that consistently impresses From checkin to landing the attention to detail and customer focus is evident making it one of the best choices for both domestic and international travel in India The cabin crew is exceptionally professional courteous and attentive ensuring passengers feel comfortable throughout the journey The seating arrangement especially in Premium Economy and Business Class provides ample legroom and ergonomic comfort ideal for long flights The inflight entertainment options are diverse catering to various preferences and the complimentary meals are thoughtfully curated offering both quality and variety Punctuality is another area where Vistara excels with flights often departing and arriving on time Additionally the checkin process is seamless and the airline staff are welltrained to handle queries efficiently The partnership with Singapore Airlines also adds a layer of credibility and enhances the overall experience That said Vistaras ticket prices can be slightly higher than budget carriers but the services provided justify the cost For those who value comfort reliability and excellent service Vistara is worth every penny Its an airline that truly redefines air travel in India with its commitment to quality and customer satisfaction

I had the best custermer experience at Midway airport I had just gone through the TSA checkpoint when I realized I had left my work binder at the seating area on the way in I was panicking and I asked a manager in TSA who took his time to walk me back though security and hunted down where I last saw it There was a gentleman who told us that he saw another member of security take it to baggage claim He went above and beyond to find the person who took it there and luckily it was descovered Him and another member were able to get it back to me and I was in much relief He was then able to help me get back though security so I could make my flight on time I have never had such great customer service at any other airport

FDHTHF Friendly staff clean aircraft with comfortable leather seats Orders for drinks and snacks taken and served individualy Prices on their inflight menu are OK Landing in Berlins Tempelhof airport is a fantastic experience Too bad the airport is due to be closed soon Even with bags to claim aircraft to subway station took less than Minutes Beat that

Excellent service Nothing to complain Theyve served an excellent food during the h long flight and was delicious All the flight attendants were polite and worried about the cleanliness and support all the passengers aboard There arent delays and the luggage have arrived perfectly fine A Grade

Second time we have flown Rex and it is now our go to airline Staff service and on time performance were exemplary It is in everyones interest to support Rex in the interests of competition But the efforts of their staff make for a truly great experience miles ahead of any other airline in the country

Although Westchester County Airport is awfully small compared to JFK or Bradley it is amazing It has car rentals an actual baggage carousel five airlines going in and out of there local planes accepted too and even have gates This is so much better than some small airports Ive been to

Everything was great and professional from the moment we arrived There were two other flights at immigration one from Europe the other from Buenos Aires and immigration lines was moving fast When we got there the officer was very friendly and welcoming she even wished us to enjoy her country that was very nice Airport is very modern has all the amenities to pass by time really fast free WIFI is available plus charge stations

Stockholm Bromma is a small airport Its very clean and the service was efficient Great proximity to the city centre Landing baggage collection and exit was super easy Taxi driver able to wait right by the carousel so there is no confusion about meeting places

Overall Shanghai Hongqiao is a good airport if you are flying domestically There is not much you can do inside the terminal There are not many restaurants and shops there On the up side you dont need to arrive too early for departure because wait times are typically not terrible Arrival can a bit painful since you may have to walk pretty long distances to get to the exit Shanghai Hongqiao Railway Station is adjacent to the airport and they are connected indoors thus if you need to make a transfer between a flight and high speed train it will be easy

Very convenient to reach from anywhere I would call it a no frills airport If this airport is to compete as an International airport it has to invest money in renovation and updating of the building In general I am thankful for the close proximity of this airport

Just flew from Vienna to Podgorica and on to Belgrade with Montenegro Airlines The first flight was operated by a Fokker and the second leg was operated by a new Embraer jet I was very pleased with their overall product Their flight attendants were active throughout the flight and spoke decent English the services on board were pretty good the seats were relatively comfortable both flights were ontime and the price was cheap Tranzit at Podgorica Airport went very easy due to the small size of the airport Overall great flight Id fly them again

Such a comfortable and convenient airport to use The relaxed feeling that I experienced was something you dont normally feel in airports Everything and everyone seemed to be at a relaxed pace and the friendliness of the immigration staff was very pleasant The baggage arrived promptly and even the customs staff seemed very friendly as I passed by At the exit to the car park I was asked by a couple of international visitors if I could assist them as they lost their car park ticket I went with them to the car park and visitor reception desk and the two ladies there were very understanding and helpful There were hand sanitising dispensers and hand towels available throughout the concourse and what is different about Shannon airport is that the sanitising foam dispensers were well stocked compared to other airports that all seem to have the dispensers but they are all empty

Osaka to Busan Great value budget airline Web site and onboard magazine promise free water but none was offered Checkin at KIX was about minutes checkin at PUS was zero with no other customers in sight Offered decent seats even though we hadnt prebooked them Outward flight was delayed due to air traffic control restrictions at KIX but landed on time due to timetable padding Return flight left early but landed slightly late after circling around western Japan for ages Boarding on both flights smooth Bus to terminal at PUS but sky bridge on return flight Perfectly adequate and reasonably efficient for a budget airline and a onehour flight Would use again

Honeymooning in various resorts in Borneo so visited Kota Kinabalu several times during our trip Check in area busy and crowded and Air Asia check in process a bit confusing but staff very kindly helped us out Rest of airport very well laid out and signage very helpful with ample seating at boarding gates

Such a small airport but somehow it was still amazing The staff were incredibly nice its not very busy I do think it does need a few more shops there was a fair variety of places to eat Ive never really had an issue with delay we have been delayed a few times but not for very long The flight attendants were kind and the landing was smooth Overall I personally think that it was a magnificent airport and it is very underrated

Tehran to Paris CDG with Iran Air Their new and well maintained aircraft are being being used on this route so I had a pleasant experience with them Food was amazing cabin crew were very professional and the flight was extremely smooth

Finally the new Medan Airport opened after a few years delay and it was just weeks old when I touched down at Kuala Namu The terminal building itself is stunning a combination of Suvarnabhumi and KLIA with lots of daylight The gate holdrooms are huge with comfy chairs and you can see the tarmac clearly Airside and landside shops and restaurants are not entirely opened but lots of interesting shops and restaurants will open soon Check in area is also airy huge shiny and modern This is the first airport in Indonesia with a direct rail link to the city and the train station even though its not entirely finished also stunningly designed Arrival areas still has a lot of things to be completed as the airport is just soft opened Hopefully when its officially opened in September all the facilities are ready

I have been to some of the worlds best star SIN ICN HKG HND airports but Sapporos New Chitose tops them all Why So much to do and enjoy Airport History Museum Royce Chocolate World factory openair Observation Deck Movie Theatre Onsen Sky Museum interactive airline stuff for kids and adults Hello Kitty Theatre Hotel amazing number and variety of food court options Aside from these frills New Chitose excels in what really matters to travelers Despite huge crowds SapporoTokyo is one of the worlds busiest routes terminal is spacious and easy to navigate Efficient checkin countersone dedicated to just school groups Spotless restrooms plenty of seats in departure areas Easy to use frequent every minutes JR train connections minutes to Sapporo Station Polite hardworking security teams Short waits on the runway for takeoffs

Rio de Janiero to Curitiba via Sao Paulo Really good experience really smooth inflight entertainment and free food and drink the cabin crew were really friendly This really beats European customer service the leg room is still the same but just the service outweighs it for me

Surprisingly good experience Cabin staff were unbelievably attentive and helpful Food and beverages were excellent for airline food Boarding and deboarding were well organized Only downside was business configuration was and flat bed was not as comfortable as on other airlines

Taipei TSA to Makung and then Makung to Kaohsiung Taipei to Makung served by A Checkin was very smooth and there was no queue Agent was extremely friendly and helpful A lot of boarding calls far too many in the departure halls Plane was spotless and comfortable with generous leg room They served drinks for this very short flight minutes and a choice of newspapers Service was very efficient with a smile much better than most of the international long haul flights nowadays Crew were very well groomed Makung to Kaohsiung on an ART Checkin agent again very efficient and friendly Very old plane and has started to show its age However still good leg room and very high standard of service A drink and newspaper were served Crew again provided first class service to all passengers
TPEKHH one way Plane full but staff friendly on time and no complaints A bargain considering the onehour flight was only about USD

Nice airport corresponding to the Chinese standard no frills but essentials are there If you fly international no need to arrive early as the checkin counter is opened just one hour before flight time If you arrive early it is difficult to find a seat Not very friendly immigration people but nice lounge with good wifi connection and unlimited Internet access Plenty of outlets to satisfy the western appetite Starbucks KFC etc

Congratulations everyone on the wonderful new airport at Bonriki The building is such an improvement on the previous facility and now provides travellers to and from Kiribati with a modern beautifully designed space to start and finish their Kiribati adventure I understand their are more features such as a cafe and lounge still in progress but in the meantime could airport management please think of a way to provide water to passengers in the departure lounge as we just experienced nearly hours in hot conditions without water Many thanks cant wait to return and see the next stages of the development

UMEBMA economy This little Swedish airline brings back what flying used to be in the good old days The flight was an hour short hop between Umea a small city up north and Bromma a tiny central airport of Stockholm in an Avro RJ Plane was clean and flight attendants nice free newspapers Aftonbladet and some inflight magazine followed by a coffee service a free meal sandwich fresh orange juice and chocolate cake Before landing we were given hot towels and sweets

I have travelled through Derry airport numerous times in the last two years with a young child and usually on my own I cannot express enough how helpful staff have been on every single occasion They always offer to help me with bags usually fast track me through security scan my boarding card and passport so that I dont have to stand in long queues especially if my child is sleeping and have even bumped me up to priority boarding again ensuring I am not standing in queues struggling with bags or a toddler Their customer service is second to none and they always make the journey pleasurable

Bremen Airport Terminal E is a big shed with Ryanair inside No doubt noisy in a hail storm its open and breezy Staff efficient Plenty of natural light skylights in the roof The light rail service line service from the station is great too Beware it does not take credit cards or bank notes over Euros functional

This airport is head and shoulders above any other airport I have been to and Ive been through a few Every person I interacted with form check in to security to service staff were all over the top friendly with great senses of humor The security line is the fastest I have ever seen I have never waited in a line here even during the holidays maybe minutes max The gates are clean and modern tons of outlets and different seating arrangements lots of space for only having gates Loads of parking for an airport of this size I was able to park my car like meters from departures and left it there for a week I know how infuriating flying can be especially when things go wrong but it goes a long way when people are so friendly This is my favorite airport and I go out of my way to fly out of here please give these people the recognition they deserve

Flew KigaliNairobiDar and return midMarch Aircrafts were all on ageing B except the st leg was on the smaller Embraer A flight cancellation was clearly announced days in advance allowing for alternative and even better options compared to original schedule All flights on time FAs catering and seating were all good Could select my preferred exit seat free with amble legroom through KQs homepage Transfers in Nairobi were smooth Twothree pieces of luggage were received well both ways Paid access to lounge in Nairobi discounted to USD due to Silver status with Kenya airways Miles earned and given generous luggage allowance together with the inexpensive ticket make this detour over Nairobi worth the trouble as compared to direct flight alternatives All flights on time

An excellent small but well equipped airport Clearly built to service the Santa charter trade I went through offseason when it was quiet The security staff are probably the most pleasant anywhere saying thank you and smiling and for that alone it deserves a recommendation

A short flight with this airline on behalf of Swiss Plane was all clean and modern and had USB outlets Staff was friendly and professional Food and beverages were buy on board unfortunately but a bottle of water and a chocolate were complementary All in all a rather uneventful flight but good and professional as it should be

I believe myself to be semiwell traveled and have experienced many airport scenarios in my lifetime middle aged and will have to give kudos to Dallas Love Field TSA agents for their remarkable work getting me from the baggage claim area for general boarding all the way to my gate with time to spare in as little time as I can possibly fathom I actually witnessed a family who did not make their flight one prior to mine but same gate and persisted by raising their voices that the gate agent should have known they were there but because TSA took so much time they were late The truth later came out that they were ONLY in line for one hour on a holiday weekend That is exceptional but poor timing on their part Everyone in the aviation world knows that on a holiday weekend there is a hour minimum time preparation period to make your flight So a free plug for DLF consider this Saying all of this not only was TSA awesome in their timeliness but the gate agents kept their cool and handled the situation with excellence

Bremen is a small and convenient airport and my experience proved enjoyable Arriving with Air France I disembarked in the main terminal Very short walk to the baggage claim I picked my suitcase within ten minutes Tram line frequently connects the airport with the city centre every min during peak hours min otherwise travel time min A oneway ticket costs however beware that the machines accept neither credit cards nor bank notes greater than Easy departure with no queue at baggage dropin I breezed through security Bremen uses the fullbody scanner which makes the screening process much faster Security staff efficient and friendly Bright departure lounge but there might not be enough seating facilities if all gates are used at the same time Only issue Not enough toilets facilities either landside well hidden at the very end of the building or airside one toilet block only

Sharjah via Mukhalla to Socotra and back onboard nearly full Yemeni Bombardier CRJ plane Check in at Sharjah was a bit chaotic due to much luggage boarding the plane was guided by the station manager personally in Sharjah as there wasnt any seat allocation They have an inflight magazine During the hour flight to RIY a snack was served Crew very nice on the return flight leaving SCT the captain even explained everything what was visible from the windows The plane was in a good shape at least what was visible clean and tidy

At last a quiet clean and efficient airport Terminal F without the tiresome duty free The hourly Borispil Express train will drop you off near Terminal D and you need to catch a halfhourly shuttle bus to Terminal F mainly for LCC flights as its something like a m walk otherwise The number of flights is fairly small and seemingly mainly Ryanair Plenty of room to wait just a couple of refreshment options Straightforward passport control and security no queues Plenty of seats in the departure lounge easy access to gates good view of airport operations No duty free Hooray A couple of refreshment stands No air bridges but then LCCs dont use them anyway A very relaxing experience particularly in contrast to departing from a UK airport

Paro International Airport is located meter above sea level so flights can only fly in the morning I took a Druk Air flight from Bangkok and the other time I took a flight from Kathmandu I prefer flying from Kathmandu because I could see Himalayan Mountains if the weather permits Paro Airport has very basic amenities because they have two carriers flying in and out It replicated Bhutanese traditional architecture and it looked very beautiful as I was walking into the airport

Previous comments on GPT are no longer true Often GPT is cheaper that New Orleans or any other nearby airport The presence of AirTran keeps fares very reasonable and service is pretty good in all directions The new terminal to be completed this year will be beautiful

Gatwick to Prevesa We have flown now this route three times with Small Planet Airline since most recently out on and back and consider that this airline just gets better and better On the latest occasion both flights left on time and arrived early The aircraft was spotlessly clean and comfortable with smart leather seats and bright multicoloured headrest covers The friendly cabin crew were professional and safety aware whilst the commentaries from the flight deck both before take off during the flight and before landing was informative and very well executed For a no frills budget airline the catering was both plentiful and reasonably priced eg full English breakfast with coffee if you wanted it for Great to see that this airline has revived the old tradition of offering boiled sweets to all passengers with courtesy prior to the aircraft starting its descent Based on our experience I would have no hesitation in commending Small Planet Airlines
