I have flown Austrian twice from LAX to Vienna and it is maybe my favorite international airline at this point And I have flown quite a few international carriers out of LAX to points around the world Both trips were in economy but I chose exit rows due to being When not flying premium economy or business this will be the only way I fly The service on Austrian was impeccable the flight attendants kind and very attentive The seats were comfortable and the food was perhaps the best I have had when flying economy I cant say enough about it I do wish Austrian flew to LAX on more than just a seasonal route because I prefer nonstop flights and while I know I can transit through ORD an IAD year round nonstop flights are always the better deal What do you say Austrian LAX to Vienna year round

The seat was spacious but the recline function was lost on my seat Crew were friendly They offered one meal plus one snack for just hours The onboard announcement was inaccurate that they claimed to be landing soon hours before the actual landing Surprisingly personal onboard entertainment was offered

Since there is no other airport that you can go through to get to this place I have to recommend it Staff were friendly and nice There were no long lines at departure I was taking AA flight in the afternoon and there were some people waiting for BA flight At arrival I went through immigrations and customs with no hassle Lady at immigration even said Welcome to St Kitts I never hear those pleasantries in the US I heard they are building a new terminal So I hope they could have more services at the new terminal

DUD is a small but efficient airport with everything you need Landed from Wellington bags out very quickly The airport is quite far from city centre mins cost nearly dollars by Taxi and dollars by super shuttle Departure is well organised checkin sufficient airline lounge is located upstairs security check right before you board
Small but good airport the usual Japanese quality clean efficient good staff Places to shop and eat and have lots of charging spots Its so convenient to reach from the city center

I have flown Austrian twice from LAX to Vienna and it is maybe my favorite international airline at this point And I have flown quite a few international carriers out of LAX to points around the world Both trips were in economy but I chose exit rows due to being When not flying premium economy or business this will be the only way I fly The service on Austrian was impeccable the flight attendants kind and very attentive The seats were comfortable and the food was perhaps the best I have had when flying economy I cant say enough about it I do wish Austrian flew to LAX on more than just a seasonal route because I prefer nonstop flights and while I know I can transit through ORD an IAD year round nonstop flights are always the better deal What do you say Austrian LAX to Vienna year round

Flew to Dublin yesterday th October after catching train from Preston where I had been working for a few days to Squires Gate which is about a minute walk ADF was a bit of a disappointment but checkin and security a breeze Staff friendly and efficient Depatures lounge was a bit oldfashioned not necessarily a bad thing quite nostalgic really but was very clean and the cafe was good Aer Lingus as always a joy to travel with

With the media coverage of airport delays we arrived early for our flight Any anxiety quickly disappeared our trip through security was quick and painless The staff were polite efficient and happy Duty free prices were reasonable and toilets and surrounding areas were very clean A good experience

We flew from Liberia to San Jose This was an incredibly easy flight We left exactly in time and arrived a few minutes early in San Jose The San Jose Domestic terminal is a very easy and quick experience Absolutely no problems whatsoever I would highly recommend

Pensacola isnt a fancy airport but its fine functional and beautiful Even the exterior architecture greets travelers in a way that reminds them of the waves and big skies of Florida This is also a better alternative in my opinion to flying out of other Gulf Coast airports such as Mobile Tallahassee and GulfportBiloxi Pickup and dropoff are a breeze Checkin is hasslefree Security is a breeze and even more so with TSA PreCheck Dining and shopping options arent ample but do get the job done nicely remember PNS is a small airport Boarding the flight is easy Pensacola is just a very modern efficient airport one that reminds me a lot of other smaller airports like Louisville however no small airports in this country set the world standard like Wellington and Christchurch both in New Zealand do

This is a good airport The cleaning can be improved but I do like the layout its not a very very long walk but it is long if you ask me I go here for my vacation flights instead of having to drive hours to the nearest true international airport Overall Columbus has a good airport Would definitely fly here again

Brindisi Salento is a pleasant fairly new airport spacious enough for the level of fights The lurid yellowgreen fluorescent plastic seats are a bit much and I wouldnt want to encounter them with a hangover Transit from city centre by bus A costs cents buy tickets in airport or in town from the bar on the way from the railway station to the bus stop in Via C Colombo and runs half hourly The snack bar prices are silly Coffee more than in town bottled beer more draught beer only more but wasnt available If your flight is from gate which the Ryanair flight to STN was be aware that it is straight in front of passport control meaning that a lot of people cant get through passport control until boarding begins

Flew them on the Frankfurt Sarajevo trip on board their B I found the airline staff professional and friendly which cant be said about the customs at SJJ airport most of whom looked downright angry and like they hate their job The BH airlines crew were great and boarding was quick and breeze The flight arrived a few minutes early and I found the cabin fairly modern and clean

A very big shout out to Jude and Liz at the checkin service desk as well as Tup the client manager on the flight I happened to leave a bag containing a priceless religious item at the checkin desk as we were running late for the flight And in my haste I left the bag at the desk I totally forgot about it and would have been extremely devastated and upset if I realised I left it behind Once we boarded the plane and settled in a very kind Tup and other staff member came up to us and returned the bag to us I can only guess that Liz and Jude realised I was a religious Jew and made the effort to return the bag to us on the plane before it took off My wife and I were so touched by this extremely kind gesture We spoke to Tup during the flight and expressed our gratitude but I wanted to leave this note of thanks to Jude and Liz too We always try and fly Rex your staff are friendly and happy so different to the other airlines we have flown on domestically And this incident just reinforces the good vibes we get when flying Rex

This newish airport is compact clean spacious bright and well designed I arrived from Dallas Plane docked at a jet bridge Quick and short walk to fast and friendly immigration followed by customs less than minutes plane door to curb Well managed safe taxi service with no lines On the return a similar smooth experience The airside offers a nice choice of shops restaurant and lounges Certainly the small scale makes this airport a joy to use for limited international travel Nice friendly staff everywhere

In a month traveling around South America I flew Latam Chile times on the following routes RT SCLPMC OW PUQSCL RT SCLIPC and OW SCLMVD I may be extremely lucky but all these flights were on time safe very comfortable and served decent food and drink options On the flights on which I checked luggage it arrived within minutes on the carousel On my last flight to Montevideo a crewmember approached me and my wife by pronouncing our names in order to serve snacks and drinks to us I am very happy that my first experiences with LATAM went so well and based on these experiences I can recommend this company without reservations Thank you very much One thing they definitely should improve is to provide free wifi to all customers I know that is still not a practice worldwide but it really should be

What a lovely little airport the whole experience seemed organised with little to no queuing areas as passengers seemed to just self manage to the different areas of the airport From check in to departure the airport was very clean with little wrong on this front I found myself very impressed with the smiling security team as I went through pre security and main search area as well Arrivals was good as well with clean arrivals area straight from the plane I was really impressed with this airport when comparing to some of the UK airports it has a much higher standard Wifi runs on a free voucher system which worked a treat very easy with no need to sign up Shopping is not great as there is just a duty free shop and FB is limited and expensive Overall a very good airport

I fly in and out of here regularly and am very impressed For a small airport TSA is efficient and does not do a lot of unnecessary screening just to have something to do as at other small airports The gate crews work very hard to get you out ontime and luggage retrieval is easy Rental car offices are next to baggage claim and other than Budget are extremely helpful There is a coffee shop upstairs as well as a barrestaurant everyone is friendly here and pricing is reasonable Two minutes from I The place seems pleasantly ignorant of airport hassles that have descended upon much of the industry

Kolkata to Colombo Average aircraft no IFE available Legroom is less but seat width is satisfactory Crew was quite active throughout the hour flight Announcements were clear and audible Restrooms were clean but only the rear restroom was allowed for the economy class passengers Boarding was smooth Food served was scanty but then it was a flight at am so no one was really hungry

Small but efficient and clean airport There was not much rush and check in to gate was minutes in the evening I fly from this airport once a year and never have any issueso far Customs and immigration takes less time than any other airports in India experienced

What a lovely little airport Check in staff very helpful top security must say and very good information desk Pity about the facilitiess and layout of the airport despite the levy charge Fast punctual service and with a smile

Siem Reap to Da Nang I purchased a flight without baggage I purchased baggage separately for AU with great difficulty via the Cambodia Angkor Air website I received the receipt on Messenger The receipt could not be located at Siem Reap airport I was forced to then pay US to get my luggage on board I have emailed the airline with the receipt and transcript but there has been no response On board I had never seen a refreshment trolley pushed along the aisle with such speed allowing nobody the opportunity to obtain a drink

The airport is really modern and beautiful Its very tidy and clean and has a lot of signs and announcements and a lot of staff that help out with your luggage the staff are really kind and the airport is really clean
Flight was on time food provided is very good and warm They did provide us window seat while boarding Its good idea to try Nepal Airlines for onward journey if you are traveling fromto Nepal

When I landed in Anchorage late at night the first thing I noticed was how busy the terminal was I was really hungry after a long hour flight from LAX so the first thing I did was grab something to eat from Cinnabon one of many restaurants at this airport Baggage claim experience was smooth Taxi was readily available outside for transportation to hotel While returning back I had a very smooth checkin and security experience If you enjoy watching beautiful scenery and planes Anchorage will not disappoint As you walk around the terminal you will notice many photo opportunities both inside and outside the terminal

As my wife and I arrived yesterday morning we called in to Chocolate shop in Departure Lounge I accidentally mislaid my wallet When I arrived in Cairns city I looked for my wallet Panic set in My wife called security at Cairns Airport Some minutes later Anita rang back with good news The wallet was found She passed the wallet on to Security Trident in Departure Lounge ready to collect We drove back My wife called in to Departure Lounge with a boarding pass and found a very helpful Trident male security officer who despite being really busy with customers found the time to hand the wallet to her with a very nice attitude I am writing this review as I wanted to express my sincere thanks to Anita who was on a mission to help us Big thank you to your staff

The airport itself is good but the design looks simply ok The airport is big it has old and new parts the new part looks better It has many checkin desks fast security check and very nice that they have priority security check and priority passport control Some nice business lounges and good duty free

Nice little airport Size is adequate for the small number of flights a day Departures and arrivals are separate buildings so it is quick to checkin and collect baggage Departure hall is basically a pergola with a shop and a bar but its fine On arrival you get free trolleys which is a bonus
Good airport no delays it was fairly quiet when I travelled Security and passport checks all done efficiently Staff were polite and helpful

Nice flights all on time with friendly staff for a good price Non of the services offered could be purchased in advance seats and meals as all credit cards were rejected Also shocked to see use of a kettle On the floor behind row in the galley

I fly through San Javier about times a year and generally it works fine My only complaint is the boarding process Because there are no seperate gate lounges people queue in the departure hall All pretty chaotic especially if one has paid for priority boarding as it means fighting through crowds to get to the front and in the process putting up with mindless comments from people who dont seem to understand the concept of priority boarding The ground staff do nothing to help

Domestic passenger Arrived at and departed on from Terminal No issues disembarking Having staff there to ensure passengers with baggage to reclaim dont inadvertently leave without collecting it is helpful On return it took a while to clear security With a number of airports across the UK now using the new scanners meaning liquids can stay in hand luggage its a pity Terminal had not restarted this Good range of shops and restaurants in departures with clear signage and ample seating Flight pushed back on time but there was a wait of about minutes as it sat in a queue for takeoff clearance From previous experience excellent for international travel as most major cities across the world reachable with a direct flight but Gatwick remains my first choice for regional travel

I tried to arrange a group trip with SyrianAir from London to Aleppo via Damascus and back Initially all was fine until they cancelled the first leg of the journey to Damascus a week prior to us leaving The next flight was days later but there was no immediate plane to Aleppo once we had arrived at Damascus which meant we would have to take a bus up instead a journey we werent too keen on While friendly the staff are fairly useless and I sat for MANY hours trying to sort things out We changed the flights to stay the same number of days but decided to go to Aleppo at the tail end of the trip under our own steam and the fly Allepo to London again via Damascus on the same ticket Unfortunately the staff didnt really get the group concept and kept issuing tickets for the wrong dates for different members of the group It took too many visits to their offices in Baker Street to finally get everyone on the same flights at the same time The flight to Syria was fine late and we managed to get up to Aleppo ourselves but the day before we were to fly out again we went into the Syrian air offices to confirm everything was ok IT WAS NOT They had cancelled the flight to Damascus without informing any of us and we had to arrange a midnight bus from Aleppo to Damascus Airport to make the correct flight back to London Luckily this one hadnt been cancelled But it was late My advice Dont Fly SyrianAir and if you do check on your flights constantly

After reading some of the less stellar reviews online and being unable to reach any English speaking staff on the phone who could verify the incabin luggage dimensions I was naturally apprehensive about the flight from Tel Aviv to Nice on Monday September To my pleasant surprise the entire flight experience was excellent The plane was clearly in great shape a relatively new aircraft with leather seating and spotless interior The departure and arrival were pretty much on schedule The fact the departure from Ben Gurion airport was using a shuttle bus and not a jetway reminds me to warn any future passengers during any unlikely but possible inclement weather to dress accordingly or bring an umbrella for the extended exposure to the elements while trying to board an outdoors staircase Other than that I thought the whole experience was most pleasant and I would have no qualms about flying Israir again
Milan Bergamo to Tirana Lot of comfort reclining seat big leg space cheap food prices on board cabin crew very professional Flight on time

Seoul to Okinawa I was very impressed my Jin Air employee that was working at gate Seoul ICN February I first told him that I needed a seat assignment and he recognized me first off by my name I was really impressed by his professionalism and mannerism

This airport is highly recommended Many of the reviews below are pre which is when the facility completed a full upgrade of terminal and gates I would discard any pre reviews as irrelevant to the current condition Long Beach Airport is a welldesigned and pleasant experience compared with LAX and to a degree John Wayne Its a smaller but more efficient facility with competitively priced parking within an easy walk of your gate The TSA Security Checkpoint is relatively fast compared with other airports The facility boasts two outdoor seating areas for two of its restaurants a comparative luxury in this age of airport design being little more than shopping malls with airline gates The central area between the two terminals is an outdoor seating area allowing for a retreat from the madness at the gates One of the unique aspects of LGB is the lack of jetways Walking out onto the tarmac to board a plane is a fun and different experience which adds significantly to the charm of this facility Long Beach doesnt have the cold and sterile feel of most modern airports and that is a welcome aspect of flying here There are a number of restauranteating choices available though the shopping is a relatively weak area In general Long Beach is easily my favorite American airport and is qualitatively far better than the vast majority of facilities I use

I was impressed by the cleanliness and orderliness of this airport Even the porters and staff act professionally Big space check in counters not cramped You dont have the feeling that youll be harassed nor cheated Considering this airport on my future flights

Vistara is overall good The seats were comfortable the food was kind of okayish staff service on point inflight entertainment was okay This my first time flying with Vistara and i am sure that i will be flying again with this airline The ground service could have been more better than this the bus took a little bit of time

A small but efficient airport with a good tax free selection As mentioned before the transfer time to Oslo is long about hours more to downtown Oslo compared to Oslos main airport Gardermoen as this is not really an airport meant to serve Oslo However it costs about the same to get to Torp as it does to get to Gardermoen due to the outrageously expensive but very efficient Airport Express Train going to the latter airport When choosing between coach and train to Torp note that the train takes slightly longer and is about NOK more expensive but more comfy and a beautiful journey at times

Like Bermuda itself this airport is a thoroughly civilized experience not very busy so not crowded with a rather predictable traffic pattern of arrivals and departures Facilities are very adequate and the dutyfree shop has a reasonable variety albeit a bit expensive On entry customs officials are polite and welcoming When checking in for our departing flight the official who had to pat me down for a followup security check the machine beeped when I went through apologized for having to do so and thanked me for accommodating the security process All in all a refreshingly unique experience one that is alas vanishing amid the alltoocommon post overzealous and ironically ineffective security measures elsewhere Bravo to Bermuda and its airport

Really excellent airport I flew to and from Palma De Mallorca airport for a weeks holiday There was absolutely no queues But it was am so it was expected But even when I arrived at about pm the queues were short and went very fast Definitely a great experience No delays or inconvenience except for most of the shops being closed on departure but as stated earlier it was in the morning Highly recommend

My Husband and I traveled on American Airlines Flight AA to New York from Florida We were extremely pleased traveling home on this plane This was mainly due to Flight Attendant DeJon DeJon made sure we were comfortable asked us what drinks we wanted and served us snacks and a very nice lunch Mostly he was so congenial and I could see he was working so hard taking care of the passengers My Husband and I are seniors and I can honestly say that we very much appreciated DeJon It made our flight enjoyable and we were glad we flew with American Airlines

I was very impressed by the level of care and support I received at the airport Having a severe reaction to an insect bite and no Antihistamine tablets with me The local team and Airport police went out of their way to help I wish I had noted their names they looked everywhere and obtained tablets for me while making sure I was comfortable and relaxed Thank you very much as the level of care and support at a busy airport was very welcome and impressive

We arrived well in time for our flight and stood in line for terminal entrance During our time in Pakistan we have been guided to the front of lines quite a few times so were not surprised that this happened here as well by members of airport staff We gave a small tip when inside but soon they asked for big amounts of western money we gave which is quite a lot for Pakistani standards they wanted We ripped away our luggage and walked away They dripped off Once inside long lines for passport control lounges closed but a decent departure hall with enough seating

Al Ula is one of the top tourist destinations in Saudi Arabia and this new airport serves that area Currently they have only a few flights per day to other Saudi cities and to Dubai so terminal is quite small it has only departure gates few shops and cafes car rental and a tourist desk Very stylish building actually and everything is done fast since there are not many passengers around with exception of renting a car There is no commuter traffic and very few taxis so renting a car is quite mandatory It took an hour to get my car because of the queue and bureaucracy Nevertheless experience was good and this region is very beautiful with lots of history

Juliaca is the smallest commercial airport I have experienced Because of the size it is easy to find your way around There is not very much in the airport so bring something to amuse yourself The good news is due to the size it is a very clean including the bathrooms There was a VIP Lounge that I peeked into It consisted of a few chairs and a cooler with soft drinks and beer

Flew Lublin to Heraklion Very comfortale trip without delays friendly helpful and professional crew good amtosphere on board everything fast and without problems I felt safe during the journey and I think that I will choose Small Planet for my next year holiday

Manchester Tripoli Late leaving Manchester due out at and eventually left at around pm Smallish plane two seats either side of the aisle but hardly anyone on board so plenty of room Plane was new and the experience was fine cabin crew were helpful and friendly and food was good No video screens or music so take your own or a book Will be using this route again

LX from Vienna to Zurich operated by Helvetic Airways The flight was completely full but boarding was expertly handled by the crew and went very smoothly The EE is a small aircraft and space in the overhead bins is limited The crew assisted passengers with finding a place for their carryon luggage and in the end all luggage could be stored somewhere Also the crew were very friendly and courteous As this was a very short flight a small snack was served which was excellent All in all a very comfortable short flight on a small aircraft with an excellent crew

Really nice facility The Olympic games in that city I am sure modernized the facility Nice waiting area at departure area to wait with friends before immigration Immigration was fast but was surprised by the friendliness and the I hope you had a nice stay in our area of the one person at immigration check with excellent english skills Nice Food selection and shops acceptable Over all a good experience

Munich to Bologna and Pisa to Munich both on an Embraer economy Both flights handled efficiently southbound on time northbound delayed by about mins on departure due to to late arrival of incoming flight there had been thick fog at MUC early that morning which had sent things adrift for much of the morning However support given to those with tight connections Modest inflight service snacks and drinks wine came in proper glasses Air Dolomiti worked okay for us

Osaka to Busan Great value budget airline Web site and onboard magazine promise free water but none was offered Checkin at KIX was about minutes checkin at PUS was zero with no other customers in sight Offered decent seats even though we hadnt prebooked them Outward flight was delayed due to air traffic control restrictions at KIX but landed on time due to timetable padding Return flight left early but landed slightly late after circling around western Japan for ages Boarding on both flights smooth Bus to terminal at PUS but sky bridge on return flight Perfectly adequate and reasonably efficient for a budget airline and a onehour flight Would use again

The ground staff in Puerto Princesa Airport and air crew of flight Z were so kind and understanding I have traveled via AirAsia Philippines times and I havent encountered any problems with them I always find their crew friendly The online booking is easier to navigate and payment process is smooth compared to the trouble I experienced with the other local airline
A reliable airline with excellent service from checkin to boarding to in flight service Gracious staff Prompt at times early Amazing and use airbridge in Bangkok

I flew from Marseille to Ajaccio Overall I was satisfied The outbound leg was carried out with an ageing but very well kept ATR and the return with a recent A Both flights were on time and the crew was polite and smiling Given the short duration of the flights both around minutes the inflight service consisted solely of drinks but thats fine The basic fare always includes a checked in luggage and the price was correct I spent euros return to fly on midJuly booking just weeks prior to departure The only minus was the long waiting time to collect the luggage at AJA minutes despite having just aircrafts to unload but I dont blame it on Air Corsica

I flew Ariana Afghan Airlines from Kabul to Delhi Timing was good but very crowded while boarding The flight was enjoyable but no entertainment Good and enough food provided Very friendly and helpful staff on the flight The ticket was very reasonable price

A true surprise and real gem of an airport Superbly clean and tidy nice array of shops to suit all prices and barcafes also serve good food Staff pleasant seating comfortable and good signposting Only downside was that internet charges too high and not always available

Avalon is a small airport outside of Melbourne As it is small it is quite quick to get through immigration on exit and security The best option is to get a bus from Southern Cross station and this helps as it meets the plane so you can get to Avalon with plenty of time The new international departure area is big but with a few shops and a bit pricey Not too bad with more international it may improve a bit

This airport is small so whilst access is good facilities are very limited Airside there are only vending machine so if you want anything to eat or drink best use the bar Landside Do not carry tins eg Duck Confit Pate etc that are greater than g in hand luggage they will be confiscated at security

Hong Kong to Kahsioung A quite nice flight It was my first time flying an Embraer jet I know it is small but the seat is comfortable and wide A delicious hot meal was served in a mins flight The crew is friendly and fluent in English The only bad thing is that the flight was delayed for hours

We flew with Turkmenistan Airlines for flights one from Milan to Ashgabat hrs with a Boeing and another flight hrs from Ashgabat to Kuala Lampur with a Boeing Both flights were much better than expected after reading the reviews Both aircrafts looked modern and clean with very comfortable seats For the very affordable prices the airline offers the service is very good We got meals on both flights and unlimited coffee water or any other drinks The staff was really nice and you can even ask for a blanket if needed The only negative point is that you cant checkin online which leads to long queues at the desk but expect from that everything was fine We would definitely fly again with this airline they deserve more good reviews
The best airline I have flown is Royal Brunei the best of all with excellent customer care and a flight crew with excellent and excellent machine cleaners Thank you Brunei Airlines

Ohrid St Paul international airport was in terms of size like a trip with the time machine The aircraft is parking literally in front of the Arrivals door where passengers are directed to the Passports control There were only desks working out of which for an airport with flights daily can be considered a good performance Nevertheless despite the size the airport is well organized and clean showing the travelers how flying was at the past times when holding an airline ticket was considered a luxury As an improvement for the administration I think that a shuttle bus from airport to the city roughly km Distance would be to consider synchronized with the flying schedule

I really like this modern airport It is efficient and clean Staff are polite and sost can speak at least a reasonable English and in case of any difficulty they would call a colleague The general public cannot access the main terminal for security reasons A separate building called Meet and greet hosts the first baggage and traveler security inspection facilities A large free parking for private cars and taxis is available From here a bus every minutes brings the passengers and only them to and from the main terminal a few hundred meters away In the same way those waiting for passengers on arrival wait for them at a waiting space at the Meet and greet building Only registered VIP vehicles usually diplomats and high ranking officials can access the main terminal The terminal itself is modern clean and spacious and includes all the expected services The duty free shop is not big but the choice of articles is good for a small airport When arriving I experienced a dozen arrivals in the past years both during the day and the night I never had to wait more than minutes for my baggage While information is always available and efficient inside the airport the same cannot be said for the website Here updates on flight status are unpredictable sometimes wrong sometimes late sometimes correct and on time

I want to thank to all the staff at this airport for helping me find my luggage which was lost because of Zrich airport The medicine of my mom were in that suitcase and all your team helped me a lot to locate and find it as soon as possible Very warm hearted people and extreme professionals They didnt skip any official procedure so that they kept the security conditions but did their best to help me Unfortunately I do not remember their names but I hope this message will find them and make them feel appreciated Thank you wish you all the best and God bless you

A poor low cost experience with full service airline Lufthansa for which I paid a high fare Got a cup of water and a chocolate gr Kindly enough they let me have a second chocolate because I nicely asked In their Tourist Class not that their intraEuropean Business Class is anything great much better Lufthansa Co are nothing better than any other low cost airline when flying in Europe The only difference is that most of the European low cost airlines are consistent you get what you pay for and there are no surprises Not with Lufthansa pay higher fares add luggage seats etc and get the full noservice experience

We arrived late at night nearly midnight so were exhausted We went through passport control reasonably quickly and the baggage reclaim was also very smooth Very modern airport and due to less passenger traffic very efficient Taxi to railway station was done in under minutes Very clean toilets included which is often a rarity Overall I would have to say I prefer Zhulyany over Borispol which I have been flying through for years due to its better connections to the city Though in London it is not very convenient as Wizz Air fly from Luton

HKGBKK It was quite a pleasant trip from Hong Kong although delayed an hour They served nice food for breakfast and juice or water or fizzy drink It was an old but clean aircraft The pilots were nice and apologised for delay BKKHKG Delayed hrs mins it was an old Japanese again and the food they served for dinner was chicken with rice orange pudding butter cake and peanuts and a drink Recommend this airline

One of the better airports in Africa I made use of the pay lounge at USD where they served snacks and drinks I had a medical situation was referred to the medical station and received good medical attention

Spent a few hours at Saskatoon Airport for a layover Comfortable seating and general overall layout Decent selection of food and drink for a smaller airport I enjoyed the interactive flight map Friendly and helpful staff Loved the amount of window space Nice airport

Pokhara to Kathmandu I received very good service by Yeti Airlines at Pokhara and Kathmandu airport on st Dec Due to fog my flight was delayed I had a connecting flight to Delhi from Kathmandu to Delhi at The Staff at Pokhara Airport were very helpful to my request to advance my booking to an earlier flight and ensured my luggage was loaded in the cabin itself so that I could get it first when I landed at Kathmandu At Kathmandu the staff unloaded my luggage and took me in the small van to the terminal so I could leave the airport quickly I would rate this as excellent service On my next trek in Nepal I would fly this airline again
Windhoek airport is small but clean and really well organized The only restaurant at the check in area is situated at the Arrival area food is fresh and delicious Facilities are quite good
Francistown Johannesburg September Good short flight efficiently run with good crew On time and no problems

Travelled twice fromto Joburg Very small airport used mainly and maybe only to reach Okawango Delta A couple of flight per day to South Africa and Gaborone twice a week to Namibia However it is usually quite busy because all small airplanes leaves from here to all airstrips in Okawango Security control also for internal flights with these small planes One gate you walk to the airplane There are no facilities inside only one toilet and no food and shops one checkin desk that open hours before flight but the queue is reasonable It is a safe airport quite clean but not the place where youd like to spend more time than necessary Nice shop and honest food just in front of the airport

CNFGRUMAO So I had a very early flight bound to Manaus paying extra for hotel was not worth it so I decided to sleep here The airport has being refurbished so there is a brand new section the information is clear and the lines are always small and after you get your boarding pass you can go through security and you will be very safe Cleaning staff are friendly and will even tell you the best spots to sleep They have chairs without armrests and cushioned seats The food is horribly expensive and everything closes at pm There is this good acai shop outside the check in area coxinhas and acai shakes are great there

The flight attendants are top notch service is gracious and consistent Little things like coming by often to take trash asking your preferences clearly and sincere friendliness that I think is sadly lacking in some airlines these days I dont know how they manage to do it but the eggs are truly good Also this is the only airline in which I was served a dish I tried to recreate once I got home a corn salad with red onions and feta Delicious They do not serve typical Korean food but all I ask of airline food in economy is that the food not be disgusting Air Premias dishes can actually be described as good The legroom in economy is by far the biggest selling point of this airline Even though their entertainment options are severely limited I am completely happy with economy on Air Premia

Guayaquil to Baltra I wish to say a few positive words to review my trip to Galapagos with this nice airline which proved to be punctual reliable and with great customer service I had to anticipate my return flight from Baltra to Guayaquil so I decided to call the customer service on their international line I was a bit scared as reding the previous reviews I was expecting the worse Actually the customer assistant on the phone not only spoke perfect English but also managed to help me with the change easily and at no additional cost In few minutes the new ticket was delivered to my email together with all the information regarding the entrance requirements to Galapagos The whole checkinboarding process was easy and quite fast both ways and departure and arrival time perfectly punctual The plane was probably a bit outofdate but the crew and the pilots did their best to make the flight as pleasant as possible Drinks and a snack were served during both flights and we got lots of announcements from the cockpit Smooth takeoff and landing completed the journeys so overall a nice experience and nothing to complain I have to say that I travelled much better than with other airline companies

One of the nicest and cleanest airports Ive experienced Thoughtful touches are everywhere from the piano in the food court to bags for wet umbrellas to a cart of peanuts and pretzels from Delta identical to what they give out in flight at the baggage claim Bathrooms are spotless And clocks throughout the airport

I have flown here only on private aircraft The commercial airlines have yet to discover this often overlooked resource The parking and terminal buildings are great Reminds me of how Chicago Midway used to be before the most recent spate of reconstruction like a hometown feel Very clean facilities and the commercial pax I have spoken to all seem to enjoy it Mostly the lack of a commute to Chicago I think
Great airport Easy to park easy to get to terminal and fast security Beats almost every other larger airport I have been to Not much to do but you wont be there long anyway

This is a very nice airport Pretty clean and very manageable My only reason for posting a review is there was no functioning water fountain neither for drinking or filling water bottles in the concourse Didnt work when we arrived still didnt when we left six days later Drumming up money for the concession stand Had to buy water for the trip out Bad look for an otherwise pleasant place

The airport of Santa Claus its only km away from the arctic circle and Santa Claus Village which is a major tourist destination and during winter holiday season there are a lot of charter flights coming here Terminal is not big with departure gates in total so I can imagine that space is tight during holidays Now it was smooth since there were no other flights departing There are few shops and cafes after security to get some last minute souvenirs and snacks The city of Rovaniemi is not far either so its easy to get there by taxi or by bus

Flew from Lisbon to Las Palmas on th December Wasnt exactly sure what to expect from such a small airline The CRJ plane was fine albeit somewhat dated Service on board was very efficient with a nice spread of snacks for a hm flight I would definitely fly with them again A good airline

Finally the new Medan Airport opened after a few years delay and it was just weeks old when I touched down at Kuala Namu The terminal building itself is stunning a combination of Suvarnabhumi and KLIA with lots of daylight The gate holdrooms are huge with comfy chairs and you can see the tarmac clearly Airside and landside shops and restaurants are not entirely opened but lots of interesting shops and restaurants will open soon Check in area is also airy huge shiny and modern This is the first airport in Indonesia with a direct rail link to the city and the train station even though its not entirely finished also stunningly designed Arrival areas still has a lot of things to be completed as the airport is just soft opened Hopefully when its officially opened in September all the facilities are ready

Super nice and wonderful airport It has so many destinations and the time slots for the destinations are awesome The airport and airline staff are super friendly and helpful This is a great gateway to arrive and depart in and out of Taiwan The queue for security is never too crowded Best airport in the world

Arrived mid night from Mumbai in a domestic flight aircraft attached to aero bridge in min we were at baggage area baggage arrived in next min Washroom were clean paid porters available plenty of baggage trolly No public transport during night only option is either prepaid or booking directly with taxi drivers We took prepaid going to Utorda around km paid approx inr during night a percent surcharge is applicable during day time should be around inr Just after you exit the terminal would be surrounded by taxi drivers prepaid cab counter is inside the building at arrival hall

Departure experience was relatively smooth an early morning flight on Ryanair so airport was very quiet Security was well managed clear markings on the floor to encourage social distancing However there was no coffee shop open so nowhere to buy a drink or a bite to eat Arriving back was very quick there were a number of staff members on hand to organise passengers no queue at passport control and bags were out within minutes however this was to be expected due to a very quiet flight and an empty airport Overall whilst the airport appeared clean we did not see any staff members cleaning while we were there with no hand sanitising stations available to passengers

Due to cancellation of BA flights tofrom Amman I ended up taking RJ Had a good experience in both directions Plane was clean the seats comfortable and there was a decent IFE selection for the hour flight Crew were fine polite but not particularly friendly or warm They didnt go out of their way to assist but were responsive I was impressed that before meal service they came around with drinks and nuts you dont get that on many airlines anymore The meal selection was decent with a choice of hot dishes accompanied by a starter roll and dessert and a selection of alcohol All flights were on time I wouldnt hesitate to take them again

Raro continues to provide the friendly and lowkey facilities I so enjoyed years ago visited and as commented on here in however theres a whole new terminal building that with a whole four shops and a cafe at departure is positively massive compared to what went before Its been nicely done and they have continued the live music for welcoming and departing with custom songs depending on where your place is going eg Pub with No Beer for the flight to Sydney The cafe does a good coffee and theres enough seats to cope with a planefull The staff here actually care about their customers and thats what makes it such a pleasant experience compared to almost any other faceless oversized airport with security gone mad as there is almost everywhere else Thoroughly recommended

This airport is very small for the number of passengers and airlines it is serving Everywhere seemed to be crowded and felt cramped I thought they needed more space for better facilities and customer service Transferring from the train coming from London to the terminal and between terminals was very easy and well signage The prayer room is available and wellmaintained and the toilets are clean Not a pleasant experience for shopping and dining as there are too many people in a cramped space

Khartoum to El Fashir the capital of North Darfur in the Sudan the hr minute flight departed and arrived on time Polite crew who patiently showed people to their seats Two bread rolls one with cheese the other with chicken a cake water soft drink followed by tea and coffee was provided This is more than BA can provide on their domestic or European routes so if Badr airlines can provide it in Sudan on a domestic flight to Darfur why cant BA Overall a great flight and experience

My first experience on Uniteds ER was spectacular The ground crew was good and helped me board the flight according to standard procedures The seating was pretty good even though it was Economy Class I was sitting in Economy Plus the same seating as Economy Class but with more legroom The cabin crew were all friendly people even though we had moderate turbulence that made everyone anxious However my only issue is that the food did not meet todays standard for Economy Class The entree portion was too small and they didnt notify the mobile app for a lastminute change I thought I would have a chicken entree because I had reviewed it via Uniteds mobile app But instead when I was onboard I had beef which confused me Therefore I recommend that United improve its Economy Class meal service to provide nicer better portioned and more options for all customers

Transfer from international to domestic flight and back last week My flight from London arrived into Terminal D and transferred to Terminal B for the domestic departure Efficient experience overall clear signage but some long walking distances from arrival to the shuttle train Terminal B has a nice interesting design and plenty of seats with chargers Nice selection of lounges for cardholders Overall recommended

I flew on the new jet service this weekend past and I was really pleased no delighted with the experience The checkin teams and boarding teams at both SYD and MEL treated me like a valued customer and couldnt be nicer The crew were welcoming and continued that valued experience through to disembarking and the ramp team handled my bag and delivered it without worry to me The inflight magazines page about inflight exercises was really difficult to read And I didnt know it was a cashbar only I wanted to buy a drink but I only had my credit card Also Manage booking has been down for a while now Otherwise a fresh choice for Australians that places the customers airport experience at the core of the experience

This is such a convenient airport Reminds me of a small midwest airport where you park close by check in and at the gate so quickly While not a lot of fancy amenities like the larger international airports this airport is such a breeze
Despite the poor reviews I kind of had to use Safi on the Dubai to Kabul route I was pleasantly surprised that we got reasonably new As with normal leg room and the planes were dead on time

It looks like a white elephant but what an elegant one Corpus Christi appears to handle only connecting flights to Dallas and Houston thats the international bit with just three airlines operating there It is light bright airy and wonderfully free of the normal hustle and bustle of a modern airport Checking in took three minutes passport control and security about the same they have new full body scanner Each airline has its own gate complete with airbridge to connect even to small planes

The service was good everything that I ordered came in a minute or less and all my needs were attended to Free snacks of hot fudge and tea Fast and there were no delays not late for take off or landing Really recommend thanks for a great flight I am really happy

We flew with Turkmenistan Airlines for flights one from Milan to Ashgabat hrs with a Boeing and another flight hrs from Ashgabat to Kuala Lampur with a Boeing Both flights were much better than expected after reading the reviews Both aircrafts looked modern and clean with very comfortable seats For the very affordable prices the airline offers the service is very good We got meals on both flights and unlimited coffee water or any other drinks The staff was really nice and you can even ask for a blanket if needed The only negative point is that you cant checkin online which leads to long queues at the desk but expect from that everything was fine We would definitely fly again with this airline they deserve more good reviews

Having no low cost carriers until relatively recently between Bangkok and Taipei this was one of the few major Asian routes which meant a plane change in a third country to find a decent fare for budget travelers Now it is served by two V Air and Tigerair Taiwan On the basis of this flight both are excellent and put similar carriers in the shade The Tigerair Taiwan afternoon flight to Bangkoks Don Mueang airport was boarded efficiently using a bus gate and taxiing commenced minutes early FAs were smartly dressed and super efficient smiling as they carried out their duties My preordered meal was piping hot unlike on some fullservice carriers who serve from a trolley All in all a seamless and flawless flight

Travelled from here to Canada via Amsterdam apart from hideously expensive cafe its always a pleasure to travel from here Check in and security excellent and baggage pick up very quick its small size makes it virtually stress free

Being first time flyers with Rex we were delighted with the personal service at airports and in the air Assisted with booking in luggage and seating details Being tall enough leg room to be comfortable We would choose to fly rex whenever possible

Clark Airport is now our favorite way into or out of the Philippines We flew in on Asiana and weeks later departed on Emirates Both arrival and departure were smooth experiences Immigration luggage claim and customs were fast and efficient and we were meeting our family in just a few minutes Departing the security and checkin were fast and efficient and the staff were professional efficient and pleasant Queues were short and the gates were all just an escalator ride and a few steps away The gate area was spacious clean and comfortable Rest rooms were clean and in good condition Food offerings were quite adequate for a small airport and reasonably priced no lie WiFi worked fine Not a lot of shops but hey were flying not malling The only concern is that it was difficult to get an adequate cell phone signal at the gate area Some other passengers were having this problem as well though I did manage to make my call after a couple of tries The VIP lounge takes walkins for p pretty reasonable But the main advantage of this airport is location you dont have to fight Manila traffic like you do going to or from NAIA If your destination is anywhere north of downtown Manila this can easily save you the better part of a day Its not big or glamorous but who cares Its clean comfortable and very convenient Id definitely recommend this airport for any traveller and especially for families

ABQ is a nice concept but one that needs some improvements For starters If you have TSA PreCheck here youre golden Security is an efficient and friendly process If you dont have PreCheck then the service at least for a small airport can be quite noncommunicative abrasive and slow The puebloinspired architecture and interior design of the airport render it one of the most beautiful small airports in the USA and the postsecurity viewing area of the runway and mountains is the sort of thing that more airports in this country need However its not always easy to enjoy the design and the views when the tile and carpet flooring and seating throughout the airport are dirty and for a lack of better words dilapidated and outdated Speaking of seating there really isnt enough of it in my opinion The signage directing you to amenities services and locations throughout the airport is helpful but also outdated The dining and shopping options are fine for a small airport so no real complaints Some people complain about the rental car facility being separate from the terminal and requiring a shuttle bus but honestly the bus runs frequently and the ride is pretty short Everything is easily accessible from I and downtown Albuquerque With a little modernization and polishing ABQ has the potential be as good as new again

The airport of Santa Claus its only km away from the arctic circle and Santa Claus Village which is a major tourist destination and during winter holiday season there are a lot of charter flights coming here Terminal is not big with departure gates in total so I can imagine that space is tight during holidays Now it was smooth since there were no other flights departing There are few shops and cafes after security to get some last minute souvenirs and snacks The city of Rovaniemi is not far either so its easy to get there by taxi or by bus

Seat Comfort was excellent Legroom was excellent The hard product is very good The soft product is abysmal and food is unacceptable Communication is poor The staff is truly detached from their customers Not just the flight attendants but the gate agents and counter personnel It seems like they dont want to be at their job jobs So detached that when we landed in Madrid the purser welcomed us to Paris France I almost always fly British Airways This time a segment was on American Never again

I was very impressed with the experience at Riga Airport So fast through security and no problems with my Japanese hair sticks which look like weapons on xrays Pleasant staff too which makes a real change Wish I could say the same for UK airports Good range of shops and helpful staff but some of the cafes are very expensive just for coffee and cake Slightly let down by toilets and desolate area C after passport control but generally very impressed compared to some nightmare experiences in the UK

Its a pleasure to travel with Cyprus airways They are so kind and really try to help The staff in Dubai is super friendly and playful with my daughter Im a nervous flyer and I always feel at ease when travelling with Cyprus airways

I flew from YYZ to AMD via Doha old airport Overall experience is not so bad except transporting to plane by coach Embarking from and boarding to plane is by coach but overall management of coaches are good Security check is quite fast and not so much hold up Security personal are not checking for liquid in your hand baggage and line moves really nicely This is for transfer and not sure about passenger boarding from Doha Airport terminal is quite clean and roomy Good part is there is a nice play area for young kids and reasonably good quality free WiFi Washroom are no so clean mainly due to culture of people using them and mostly wet In rush hours it is crawded and also sometime close one in middle due to close off that area US bond flights Not so much food option but overall food is not so costly compare to European airports Ground staff are not that helpful but Qatar Airways staff are excellent I missed new terminal by only days

I prefer using this airport over almost any other in Texas major cities but in true American airport form there are advantages and drawbacks to using San Antonio SAT Here are the pros Access from either I or US is pretty easy considering that interchange is one of the busiest in the city Access to the very busy touristic downtown is relatively easy as the airport isnt far away by rideshare Parking is easy access from the parking garages to the terminal is easy signage leading to and within the airport is pretty easy to follow Delta checkin was quick and friendly Gate agents were professional and helpful Staff in the stores generally seemed friendly The terminal is mostly clean the presecurity checkin area is very spacious and modern Using CLEAR and PreCheck I breezed through security However here are the drawbacks Security TSA had an officious dour attitude that Id expect much more in Houston Miami LAX or NYC not San Antonio Dont know what that was about The restrooms were filthy Seating throughout the terminal was not at all ample for the crowds of people waiting to fly out the airport desperately needs expansion and that includes more seating and general modernization postsecurity Upon return baggage claim was remarkably slow for a small airport albeit a small airport serving a large metropolitan area So pound for pound SAT is an overall good option and Id still rather use them than anything in Houston or Austin but there is still room for improvement

Pleasant smaller airport Parking is easy as is dealing with rental cars if necessary Ive used both Tucson and Phoenix Airports Phoenix had a direct flight and was less expensive for traveling between Boston and Tucson From now on Ill be using Tucson Airport due to the ease of access and human scale

A very pleasant airport Modern spacious very quiet the building has good acoustics to dampen internal and external noise Tasty food free drinking water you need to bring your own bottle Also interesting in the general area of the terminal you can spend time in the Flyport an interesting educational area about aerospace Efficient service smiling and helpful staff All in all highly recommended

Boarding on TLV was done on time but delayed to get permission to depart A was in a good condition and clean Stewardesses were professional and friendly Inflight service was beverages coffee water sandwich and granola bar On the return flight there was a minutes later departure schedule change they informed us with email days in advance

Compared to so many airports a delightful experience I was first off my arriving flight and so did not have to queue for a visa Only one person was doling them out so I guess that stragglers had quite a wait On departure plenty of shops for such a small airport with plenty of seating both indoors and out no problems in either direction with passport or customs

A small but efficient airport with a good tax free selection As mentioned before the transfer time to Oslo is long about hours more to downtown Oslo compared to Oslos main airport Gardermoen as this is not really an airport meant to serve Oslo However it costs about the same to get to Torp as it does to get to Gardermoen due to the outrageously expensive but very efficient Airport Express Train going to the latter airport When choosing between coach and train to Torp note that the train takes slightly longer and is about NOK more expensive but more comfy and a beautiful journey at times

This is a small yet spacious airport with two terminal piers jutting out in a Y shape There were ample seating space plug points to charge your phones and also an enclosed section with desks and chairs to do any work on your computer Large glass windows afforded views of the runways and let sunlight stream in Bathrooms clean TSA security was thorough Check in counters are opened a couple of hours before a flight and I found the staff friendly Car rental booths are in the baggage conveyor belt section and long term parking is just outside the terminal as are the parking lots for rental cars minimal walking required Very easy and fast entry and exit intoout of terminal Driving directions to airport were clearly marked Only a couple of shopsstores for food and drinks A selection of Wisconsin beer was available in the restaurant but not my favorite Leinenkugel Overall a very pleasant airport

After guessing at which line to wait for checking my luggage Im still waiting in a line that doesnt move for longer than an hour The reason the conveyor belt that moves the luggage is broken When I left Washington the same problem happened just that the IAD airport organized porters with carts and we didnt wait at all The disorganization level at this airport is outstanding

Good flight Turbulence was handled well Landing a bit quick and rough Food service was on the ball neither delicious or gross somewhere Im the middle Stewardesses were polite Bathroom clean Unfortunately no entertainment system or phone charging outlet At the check in at Singapore I could not check in until hours before the flight and there was no online checkin available due to the agency booking

Toulon to Paris Orly Aircraft on time and clean Good service in flight pleasant staff on departure inflight and on arrival We had to leave bags at plane entry gate and we fetched them at plane exit gate in Paris The aircraft is useful for small flights but is a little small for passengers Flight entertainment would have been appreciated domestic flights in another countries have in flight entertainment even for hr flights

We were running late due to high traffic in Ayodhya owing to Kumbh Mela Akasa helped us by providing buffer minutes at boarding This helped us in arriving to the flight in time They have ensured that our boarding is faster so that overall flight time wont get delayed As soon as we are seated flight took off within mins This did not result in any delay

Good airport with facilities to cater for the number of flights Slight delays on arrival due to fruit and vegetable quarantine but no problem read the notices and listen to the announcements makes it easy It does the job
A quick hop from Bangkok to Chiang Rai here No frills did the job perfectly left slightly early and arrived well on time Seats comfortable for an hours flight I still love the liveries of the airline

This is the first time in over a year I used this airport and I have to say that I am not disappointed Its facilities are fair very clean pleasant to stroll through and spacious The staff is pleasant and professional

Always love to travel tofrom Kaohsiung airport very convenient to city center and Kaohsiung train station via metro small airport but got everything you need cafe restaurant duty free ground staffimmigrationsecurity always friendly and efficient Both China Airlines and EVA Air lounges are nice with plenty of food and drinks

The airport is very very small when arriving However it is clean and staff are kind When leaving the check out is done outside and some companies are not as efficient as others but the airport is at no fault When leaving there are two relatively small waiting room with limited selection of snacks and duty free Based to buy souvenirs and keepsakes before the airport The people are what make this airport pleasant they are friendly and work very hard

As a resident of Chattanooga I have used this airport on several occasions With just gates it seems to be a bit undersized for a city of However speaking from an architectural perspective it has more character than most airports I have flown through and is very clean besides There is virtually no chance of getting lost owing to the small size and simple layout The security checkpoint is neither intimidating nor cumbersome but the agents are thorough and will search your bags if needed CHA recently added a daily direct flight to DallasFort Worth and will soon follow up with direct service to Houston and Orlando Other cities with direct service to and from CHA include Atlanta Chicago Charlotte Washington DC Cincinnati and Memphis CHA really is a connected airport and getting moreso all the time apparently

The airport staff are friendly and the waiting time is short very convenient because there are many transport choices to choose The seats are comfortable and there are the sky bridge let me see the airplanes

Im a frequent traveller and this was our first time using Air Astana from London to Delhi I read some great reviews nevertheless I was quite apprehensive to say the least Well how wrong was I Air Astana in my humble opinion is indeed providing amazing in flight service and great user experience We flew Airbus LR that appeared to be fairly new extremely clean and looked after Our economy cabin was looked after well we had nice amenity kit the food served was nice and tasty and with proper cutlery Equally choice of beverages was excellent too The crew is well trained and do their best to keep passengers happy On the improvement side we spent about hours in Almaty and found the airport to be quite small and quite basic which I think is a bit of let down and so I think thats the area they need to actively work on if they really want to get more customers flying with them I certainly will fly with them again and recommend it
Quick lines through security and it is a better option than flying out of Logan with the longer lines Airport restaurantsbars are limited but OK for all the longer that you will be there

A modern and moderate sized airport for the capital of Finland Staff was friendly and helpful queuing times were very short due to modern handluggage scanners The terminal itself isnt very big but has an easy to follow layout There are a lot of dutyfree stores and foodcourts of course theyre all overpriced as one might expect Connection to town is offered by trainconnection All in all a good experience

Very small old fashioned terminal nothing wrong with that as check in was a breeze All luggage checked and weighed together then put onto a trolley No computers everything written out including boarding cards Once checked in usual hand luggage screening and off into the small departure lounge Rows of plastic seat along with a few little shops selling the usual goodies from Myanmar and snacks A very good caf with great coffees and teas Usual badge so the staff know which flight you are on All very relaxed and you can watch the flights taking off and landing Toilets worth a miss

Hiroshimas airport is somewhat small but is intelligently laid out and easy to navigate Perhaps because of its relative newness it appears to be quite pristine inside with a good range of services for travellers The biggest drawback is the distance from Hiroshima city well over a half hour outside of the city As another reviewer noted the IBEX flight requires walking out onto the tarmac which could be a hassle in inclement weather

Due to the relatively low number of flights planes dont have to wait circling around in the air or on the tarmac The airport itself is perfectly connected to the inner city and the central station trains from there take you to Munich Wrzburg and Regensburg in about hour to Frankfurt and Stuttgart in hours by a minutes metro ride Passport and security checks as well as baggage handling are a breeze Staff is very friendly and helpful

Aalborg Lufthavn AAL is a smallish airport near the city of Aalborg There is not usually a lot of people leaving or arriving at any one time so there is hardly ever any time wasted standing in line for checkin or security checks brilliant A very friendly and inviting atmosphere overall

I chose this airport for my summer holidays back in as a familiar airline started operating a scheduled summer route and provided very appealing promo prices It seems that is airport is mostly used by charter and low cost airlines providing allinclusive offers to leisure destinations However you can still find some scheduled international routes operated by bigger European airlines throughout the year such as Air France of course but the prices usually go through the roof meaning you can buy a train ticket to Paris and fly from there at half the price The current trend is that bigger European airlines will use this airport just for a couple of months per year mostly for the summer season That being said the airport is very small but on the other hand there is also not much traffic so it is as big as it should be I suppose It is very easily accessible from anywhere within France or northern Europe This is because Lille is a train hub in northern Europe you can use the Lille Europe train station in Lille to reach multiple European capitals There is a bus shuttle from Lille Europe train station to Lille Lesquin airport for euros allerretour or euros single journey not very cheap but not expensive either The airport is also very nice from the outside and the inside and you have perfect view for landings and takeoffs while waiting in the gate for your flight The airport has a very informative website a facebook page and a twitter page There could be more adequate toilet facilities in the gate I was waiting the was a single facility with just one or two toilets inside I do not remember correctly On the plus side the facility was spacious and appropriate for people with mobility issues eg wheelchair

Granada Airport is located about km west of Granada Single runway small terminal Regular buses run into the city If you arrive late no worries as it is only a short taxi ride In recent years the number of flights have increased Mainly to Madrid and Barcelona but with also Liverpool Stansted Melilla The usual facilities for a small airport so dont expect too much

This was the nicest transatlantic flight Ive taken and Ive been traveling to and from Paris a lot It was a very large and comfortable plane The flight attendant who took care of us was delightful The seats were very comfortable and went almost completely flat for an actual sleep The food was even decent We flew back on Air Canada which was fine but I was sad it was not the same as the way out I will try to fly with Corsair on my next trip in October Thank you

Tbilisi to Baku Everything went smoothly here Boarding was quick and on time We were pushed back on time which also meant the flight left on time It was only a short hop of mins I will see how they are again when I fly hours plus on my next flight Overall No issues Airline very smooth and would recommend
Very nice airport Small short ways with quick checkin short TSA waits short Gate walks and free wifi for minutes

Friendly flight attendant who take care of the passengers efficiently Excellent flight but the cabin of the Dash needs a very serious refresh and more confortable seats The flight time was respected On the gate the employees of Air Canada Jazz offer a good service

AirAsia keeps getting better its hard to believe they are a budget airline The ground crew was efficient and accommodating the cabin crew was attentive and friendly and the seats were clean and comfy We chose the Thai vegetarian Penang Curry that was yummy Big tip for this flight Tokyo to Bangkok book a window seat on the right side of the aircraft if you want to get an incredible aerial view of Mount Fuji

Flight TF Gothenburg Stockholm Bromma Attentive professional FAs comfortable seats papers for free good in flight magazine on time clean plane smooth boarding and disembarkation clear safety announcements good sound system Best of all a small meal for free with coffeeteasoda and a chocolate candy

Dane County Regional is a cute little airport lying on the outskirts of Madison and it has had some of the best services I have ever experienced at any airport The airport is incredibly clean and attractive on the inside and the outside This includes nice modern architecture on the outside and mosaic flooring and stained glass handling lights It may not have as many stores as other airports but there is a store for nearly all travel needs such as a Cafe a restaurant a travel store and a Wisconsin Gear store I also noted that there were multiple stores under construction There are hardly any delays and MSN connects to nearly all large nearby airports which provides excellent connection availability The best part was the incredibly fast Wifi and charger ports in the waiting area

Flew into Alderney from Southampton A lovely little airport Very relaxed friendly staff and a good shop and cafe very good considering the airport is tiny Taxis waiting right outside the main entrance and it only takes about minutes if that to get from the aircraft to the terminal entrance Very good all round

LX from Vienna to Zurich operated by Helvetic Airways The flight was completely full but boarding was expertly handled by the crew and went very smoothly The EE is a small aircraft and space in the overhead bins is limited The crew assisted passengers with finding a place for their carryon luggage and in the end all luggage could be stored somewhere Also the crew were very friendly and courteous As this was a very short flight a small snack was served which was excellent All in all a very comfortable short flight on a small aircraft with an excellent crew

Staff are very rude They checked me thoroughly and ask to open my bag and not to touch anything i was just standing there and they are also checking the other passengers coming after mins i ask the security if i can go and get my bag she said oh yes you can i forgot She made me wait for nothing They have an overpriced for their food inside the airport I will share this experience to my colleagues and other friends

I had lose my hand carry luggage during the security check due to my own negligence I only realized it after boarded to my flight Singapore airline SQ on th Feb I highly appreciated Incheon airport ground staff and Singapore airline staff professional service quick response and putting customer satisfaction at high priority as they managed to quickly locate the luggage ensure me the luggage will be sent back the by the next available flight and I could proceed returning Singapore as per plan Two staff members Im not sure if hes Incheon airport staff or Singapore airline staff I would like to mention in particular who had responded very fast and given me great support at the boarding gate Mr Kang and Mr Lee Both their effort was sincerely appreciated

My favourite airport Fast efficient and very pleasant Easy to get to easy to navigate checkin and security is always fast and friendly and the lounge above Security is great Extremely roomy and classy great for work or relaxation even offers open smokers cabins that dont feel like a cage and a chess game for those with plenty of time Almost everywhere in the airport can you overlook the runway and the whole place is just modern roomy and open The airport size is an advantage without doubt the distances between parking checkin security lounge gate and flight are minimal so getting in and out is always a pleasure Much better than Copenhagen in almost all aspects

The crew were attentive and friendly and constantly checking we are ok I would especially like to thank flight attendant Osher who noticed I was upset and on the verge of crying and took me aside for a chat tissue and tea This made me feel I am already at home even before landing
Pleasant short flight Plane was clean and on time Boarding was efficient Staff cheerful Very convenient to reach other Caribbean islands Will fly with them again

Old airport but reconstruction going on Very efficient immigration on the way in with separate lane for business class Fast delivery of luggage as well took me less than minutes to be out of the airport Departure wise a little bit slower but acceptable friendly immigration and security people very basic business lounge Departure procedure efficient despite lack of discipline of Chinese passengers always trying to jump queues

One of the nicest most modern airports in the country Decent array of shops and restaurants Not a large selection between security checkpoints and departure gates but that is typical and here it is still far better than at Fortaleza a city of similar size Airport is close to town especially beach areas so transportation is usually easy How many agents are actually working at the checkin counters can vary widely but I assume that is the responsibility of the airlines

The international terminal is small and because of that there are no endless walks which is great The visa on arrival staff were very quick and it only took a few minutes to be processed then it was the same going through immigration Our bags were waiting for us in the baggage hall after immigration then it was over to the taxi desk and straight into cab and on to our hotel On departing once again immigration was very quick then we had a short wait in the departure lounge which was very nice with a few shops and a good cafe

Very pleasant flight from Athens to Thessaloniki with Ellinair Easy process of booking and echeck in the boarding pass is sent to the mobile so no app or printer is needed Athens Airport was a breeze the fee included checked baggage so I chose to check in my hand luggage also for free the company did it with a smile Departure and arrival on time flight about full Good legspace service included very small snack and drinks Immaculate and smiling crew Quick retrieval of baggage in Thessaloniki Excellent experience

I visited Oman first time in and used this airport It was then very a small and unorganized airport Now the airport has become huge with many other facilities There is a museum with Omani architectures There are many handicrafts shops with very high prices of commodities There are KFC and McDonalds that offer food at an affordable price There are Muslim prayer room and toilets as well

Flew STNBIO BIOSTN modern stylish terminal architecture some way outside Bilbao but perhaps the nearest bit of flat land to be found amongst all those hills No problems on arrival speedy passport check and luggage quickly up on the belt Same when leaving fact luggage drop and security control Airport is clean staff friendly and helpful Minor gripes no free wifi no post office to buy stamps souvenir shop did not have any postcards food and drink airside expensive lifts seem to have a mind of their own not enough seats on the groundside Bilbao well worth a visit even for a day but certainly a weekend

What a fantastic little airport after leaving Paris CDG behind and all its filth it was such a welcome sight to arrive in a clean modern organized airport What a shame that more airlines dont fly into Pau The staff in the airport were also extremely helpful and polite Much nicer airport than Toulouse which is not far away
