Think it only has a dozen flights or so a day exclusively under the Air NZ banner now Freedom Air is being reamalgamated into Air NZ It has been well modernised and seems very spacious It has the advantages of a small airport with short distances plane to terminal to baggage collection and to car park We were in the car and off within mins of getting off the lane On departure there is a great upstairs light and airy waitingeating arrivals area with plenty of space and excellent views There are adequate drinks food and shop The only downside was that the hire car companies closed quite early so as we were arriving at pm we had to persuade friends to come and collect us

SCAT has a very poor reputation but I had no problems with them Check in was performed by a handling agent in Almaty and as usual with any airline there it was perfunctory but efficient I had selected my seats previously online with no issues The flight started to board a little late alongside an Air Astana flight departing minutes later to Astana resulting in many passengers going to the wrong gate and being turned back there This is more an airport issue than an airline one though The flight pushed back around minutes behind schedule The aircraft although rather old felt comfortable and the crew were very efficient They managed to serve candies before take off a boxed meal and a drink followed by tea and coffee and more candies before landing all for a hour minute flight Baggage was included in the ticket price and the onboard service was friendly The price was less than many European low cost carriers would charge for their most basic service Their low safety ranking nearly put me off but according to their website they are working on getting accreditation so this reassured me and I am glad I flew with them

My husband and myself were at Alicante airport returning from a short break I am disabled following a subarachnoid haemorrhage years ago I really needed to feedback on my support from Carmen who reported she has worked many years in the assistance area she was so kind and helpful and made my journey much more settled I cannot thank her enough Regards Kath Robinson

I was really impressed with V Air flying from Bangkok to Taipei Easy to use website for booking Smiling staff at check in Very efficient even weighed and tagged cabin baggage Flight lifted off at exact departure time Plane seemed new We didnt preorder food but were able to buy some Cabin crew did a delightful safety demonstration smiling graciously and the passengers applauded Everything spotless efficient thoughtful

The whole experience was very professional Flight was completely comfortable clean and the air crew were friendly and helpful The flight was on time and the in flight service was just excellent for such a short flight
Simply fantastic what an experience A very time and cost efficient way to travel in Scotland heres hoping they add more routes soon

Superb airport Small Friendly service No queuing went through security in under minutes Fast free wifi with constant connection and no connectivity issues Burger and chips SEK cl beer SEK Decent viewing facility but minimal air traffic to view

I flew from Kerry to go to Alicante ALC and back Parking is not far from the terminal When you go in the door the toilets cafe and checkin area are very close Internet was fast and easy to connect to Toilets were clean enough The caf has good food and there are two vending machines before you go into departures It is a short walk to departures and security is not that long There is two boarding gates with a small gift shop Boarding went through very quick and the flight arrived minutes early We arrived back after ten days and we were early again which was great There is only one baggage belt and it can get very crowded Very satisfied with the airport and the experience

Almost everything I saw in New Zealand is well organized Auckland Airport is the exception We waited minutes to get through international departures due to long lines for boarding pass scanning passport co tell and security there were only lanes open for the latter plus one for premium passengers Really not up to spec if Auckland wants to be an international hub

I was on an Aer Lingus flight operated by Cityjet My flight was late due to weather in London and my original flight got cancelled but I got put onto a flight minutes later The flight itself was OK The seats on this little Avro are very cramped Cityjet uses a configuration instead of the standard This makes the seats very thin and leaves you with not much room The inflight catering was provided by Aer Lingus and featured a buy on board service As this was a morning flight I opted for a Hot chocolate and some shortbread and for this was decently priced But the highlight of this flight was well and truly the Avro RJ which I wanted to fly on before they all get retired and I am very pleased I did It is a unique experience and I would recommend for any aviation fans to try this flight as it is relatively cheap and the Avro is an absolute joy

I appreciate that this company is opening routes from Brest to cities like Strasbourg and Nice for example which is very useful both for my work and for visiting my family The fares offered are very attractive and the service is of a very good level I recommend this company Japprecie que cette compagnie ouvre des lignes au dpart de Brest vers des villes comme Strasbourg et Nice par exemple ce qui est tres utile aussi bien pour mon travail que pour rendre visite a ma famille Les tarifs proposs sont tres intressants et le service est de tres bon niveau Je recommande cette compagnie

The flight was a very good price the plane was in great shape and the cabin crew were excellent The food could have been better and they ran out of wine quite early but overall a good experience and Id definitely fly with them again If you have a layover book a lounge at Shenzhen airport the food was good and the shower included in the price made a massive difference to a long journey

Flew via Halifax on way from Heathrow to Toronto As its a pretty small airport theres not that much to do apart from look at the lobsters in the lobster shop we couldnt believe it when so many people were boarding planes carrying lobster boxes There are a few eateries both land and airside which are not wildly overpriced just average food on offer Tim Hortons provided a decent sandwich Overall we quite enjoyed the hours we spent there though If you go up the lift in the main concourse area theres a small viewing platform room which is a calm and relaxing place to be We watched the few planes that came in and out for minutes before going through security Everywhere there are plenty of staff to offer help all dressed in lovely tartan uniforms and without exception totally friendly There is also free wifi so we took full advantage of that We did ask one member of staff if we had time to go and see Halifax She replied in a friendly but blunt way Youd have to take a bus to get there and theres not really much to see anyway Its small but clean efficient and did the job for the few hours stopover

This airport is very nice clean and efficient The staff at the airport are also very kind and welcoming I remember I was a little late to my flight and only had around half an hour to the flight from the checkin area They really got me in and out very fast and I had around minutes to spare Very thankful for that

Extended and refurbished runway is so much improved New Terminal building constructed for Euro Cup is really nice and well designed With lots of space very clean and spacious When I arrived on the flight from Warsaw we were coached to the international arrivals where all or of us cleared passport control in under minutes Baggage was on a belt also in about min after we disembarked It was a pleasure to use such a lovely little airport and o much improved

Checkin was very slow with just three counters open for the full flight Boarding was unorganized and chaotic with just two gate agents being overwhelmed controlling the crowd There were no boarding groups and at the end they gave up and it was free for all As a result the flight took off minutes late Seats on the A were comfortable with a responsible seat pitch Service was good with ok food

The rum and pretty well everything in the duty free stores costs double what it costs in a grocery store in Managua Rum is about US in a grocery and in the duty free in the airport A pound of Case de Cafe coffee is about vs about in the grocery store However the duty free shops are the only place to buy legitimate Nicaraguan cigars as total production in the country is for export They are very good and very high quality but to be honest at times in the USA they cost less Random luggage searches on departure are almost always for locals rarely tourists The airport is really quite advanced for Central America currently departures are a bit of a hassle with the construction of that area arrivals are a breeze and rarely does it take more than minutes with immigration and customs both especially for tourists vs visitingreturning Nicaraguans Taxis to the city are clean and controlled if a bit slow vs a regular taxista and cost US with the drivers in the red shirts However if you walk to the street about feet the fare is around If you can negotiate in Spanish that is

Check in and security very fast and efficient but then you hit the overpriced shops and the limited and expensive catering options They should let the cafe outside arrivals take over a spot inside they offer decent food at good prices The place is clean the staff are pleasant and helpful but it doesnt make up for the over priced shops and the limited choice of food

Flew Waterford to Birmingham on th January Nice little airport staff very friendly Small cafe before departure excellent coffee and light snacks Security and boarding very well handled An enjoyable experience

Zurich to London City Very pleased with service received flight attendant went out of his way to recognise we were flying business as technically non exists on this short hop flight Given Easter gifts as well as free flowing champagne and cognac Plane was very clean quiet and modern

Surprisingly smooth flight on board Czech Airlines checkin was smooth and flight departed on time from Paris and as I had Plus fare they did not bother me about my cabin bag and backpack during boarding On board offer was OK and prices were low the beer which I ordered was cold which is perfect They also offered a water after the paid service so for the price I paid I was more than happy Flight arrived minutes early only downside of the trip was the long wait for the bags in Prague

I just booked through this airport in October on my way to Australia It was such a dream no queues friendly efficient staff Luggage scanned without having to remove Ipad small bottles etc It must be one of the better airports in the EU

My recent return flight from Melbourne to the Gold Coast with REX Airlines was excellent Everything from booking to disembarking on the return flight was easy The staff were friendly and professional Given that CV issues are currently dominating travel within Australia I felt REX Airlines handled everything beautifully

Sunshine Coast Airport MCY services mainly flights to Sydney SYD and Melbourne MEL with some services to Adelaide ADL and seasonal international services to Auckland AKL New Zealand A new low cost airline will soon be operating from the airport which will make flights north to several cities in Queensland and other flights to Melbourne and regional New South Wales and regional Victoria The airport terminal is located in Marcoola about mins north of Maroochydore Private Airport transfer services Taxis Ubers and public buses service the airport however the public bus system does not run a timetable that would service all arrivals or departures Paid short term and long term parking is available with some of the long term parking having sails to provide limited protection from the elements There is also an offsite private parking business within the airport precinct that offers secure indoor and outdoor paid parking The terminal has Checkin counter areas for airlines at the northern end and a covered breezeway then leads to security screening and the departure area at the southern end of the terminal The luggage carousels for arriving passengers luggage are also located at the southern end of the terminal along with rental car counters toilets Luggage sometimes can take a while to arrive on the carousels as it appears the incoming aircraft is unloaded and the bags for the departing flight are then loaded before the arriving flight luggage is finally brought into the terminal and loaded onto the baggage carousel The departure area has food outlets that sell food and drinks at the usual airport prices as well as a few shops including a surf shop and a news agency books newspapers etc The northern end of the departure lounge also operates as the international departure and arrival area when the seasonal Auckland flights are operating at other times it forms part of the domestic departure area Gates serve both as Arrival and departure gates and their are currently no aerobridges so you will walk down stairs onto the tarmac and into the terminal Facilities are available for disabled passengers who cannot utilise the stairs The airport at times can be very busy especially if flights are delayed otherwise their is plenty of seating As most flights are coming from Sydney and Melbourne weather or other delays can have a knock on effect causing delays to outbound flights The real advantage of using this airport is avoiding around a hr min trip to Brisbane Airport on a good day when there are no traffic delays or accidents on the M to Brisbane Airport The airport is expanding and the terminal facilities will improve as part of the expansion project Overall a very good airport experience

Kalmar is a small regional airport Only gates but we have to walk out to the planes the same way Only a few airlines serve this airport The staff are friendly and efficient and the mood is quite cosy There is actually no stress and the place seem to be very relaxed There is a small bar and a small tax free shop which is open only when there are some international departures mainly some charter to Mediterranean destinations Main airlines using this airport are SAS and BRA for domestic flights mainly to Stockholm SAS to Arlanda and BRA to Bromma BMA The airport is clean even the toilets are of a high standard Even though this airport lacks a lot of things it is one of my favourites
Our team fly weekly and we reckon Rex are the most reliable airline in Aus Boarding is easy flights are on time crew are great WiFi on all flights would seal the deal Yet to be disappointed

Rio De Janeiro is a good aiirport but was very crowded during the Olympics The new terminal is awesome but GOL VIP lounge is poor the Plaza Premium Lounge is better The duty free is good but overpriced Customs and immigration officers are quite sympathetic and the airport is clean

We had a very good experience flying with Island Air The day we took our return flight they were celebrating their th anniversary We were greeted with lei greeting before boarding the flight On the flight we were given some local cookies local coffee and POG juice The flight attendants were nice I was not expecting good customer service as I read some bad reviews but it was a pleasant experience overall

Brasilia airport is clean and always improving the facilities The architecture is uptodate The airport is well located and you can reach it by bus but no train or subway It has an good commercial area close to the gates The airport facilities are in good condition and are well maintained

I am so impressed with Air North The last time I flew with a different airline I remember waiting ages for drink service that only came around once and paying something ridiculous for a small snack But Air North blew that experience out of the water Complimentary food and drinks are one thing but this was only a hour flight and they kept us busy the whole time serving drinks a lovely sandwich a cookie and then more drinks I was positively full at the end of the flight And when I complimented the cookies oatmeal chocolate chip served warm the very lovely stewardess Keely got me and my sister my travelling companion a few for the road She gave us good tips for visiting the Yukon too The airline was clean flight was smooth and service was fantastic I wish Air North flew everywhere they would be my first choice every time

Was departing New Orleans two days after jazzfest Had no problems with queueing anywhere Had some time to kill before my flight and sat outside in a cool spot close to where buses depart Spent some time chatting to n airport employee Absolutely delightful polite young man

Things have improved vastly since the new terminal opened and the new baggage claim is very good far faster than Edinburgh or Glasgow Return journeys can be a bit of a pain but the new departure lounge is reasonably good Airport staff weve found to be generally polite and helpful Our tips for a happier return trip Buy any food or drink in your resort Dont be in a rush to go through security to the departure lounge its much nicer outside or in the checkin hall If you smoke there is a smoking room in the departure lounge Think about investing in a portable balance for weighing your baggage as if you are overweight it could cost you

Gatwick to Puerto Vallarta We travelled in premium economy both directions and its worth the upgrade but only just Firstly the premium check in was fast the included lounge access was great The only part of the upgrade that doesnt work is the bags off first this didnt happen in both directions The food quality was acceptable drinks were free flowing The crew seemed to be experienced and happy which made for an enjoyable flight both ways

A relatively large regional airport for a small town However Darwin is the state capital of Northern Territory We checked in for the flight went through security and then waited for the flight to depart There were no hassles or problems Everything went smoothly

Have used this airport twice in the last year and found it very smooth From plane arriving at terminal only ten minutes to clear border control collect bags and exit airport Bus to Gothenburg outside terminal to meet each flight and in to city in about minutes quicker than from the main Gothenburg airport Adequate facilities in airport and an outside area airside for smokers to sit in the sun with a drink

Going to Washington Dulles Airport is easy when departing and arriving regardless of connectionsgood staff lounges and great AeroTrains and Mobile Lounges to connect different terminals They have good food in various terminals and airline lounges

Living in Geelong this airport is great mins from my parents place and traffic is rarely a problem Check in is quick quicker with no bags check in online the night before stroll through security and a short walk onto the plane Only criticism is that the airport is small gates and only bar cafe and newsagents Hopefully with the new International terminal theyre cleared to build theyll upgrade the domestic terminal too

It is a very clean airport and very easy to move around Departures and arrivals are well defined and separate It is very safe and there are good shopping areas in the departures My experience at this airport is flights all without problems at the airport and the last flight was in January Nice views from airport we can see Desertas Islands and the sea sunrise and sunset

Do Book the First Class lounge as soon as you arrive ready for your return I didnt and sat jealously sweltering and being zapped by mozzies as I waited for my inevitably late flight Otherwise if there is only one flight due there seems to be enough room and seats probably get too crowded if more than one flight waiting to depart Arrival and getting through customs is a fuss and very slow although the security people are friendly I got my passport stamped as well as the visa when I asked nice free souvenir Toilets were a bit smelly and not totally functioning but did have toilet paper Gents Stuff is sold in both duty free shop and kiosks around the departure lounge Note as expected the duty free shop is much cheaper You can only pay in CUCs or at an exorbitant markup by credit card Good views of the apron from the lounge and the only downside is if you are a fervent antismoker This is cuba they sell cigars you can work it out Tip a few people had stuff confiscated from their hand luggage tobacco and spirits I think it was all stuff that the proper export tax hadnt been paid on Keep a few CUCs to slip the staff at the airport and they also really apreciated a drink or two As everywhere the porters are quite bullish Dont get upset at being asked for a tip just for loading the suitcase into the coach Look how much you earn and then realise how much is worth to them
The flight was good but it lacked in terms of inflight entertainment and food plus the wifi service which was without any surprise very bad Still it was a decent flight overall

Sukhothai Airport about as nice an airport as youll ever find anywhere It is tiny really well maintained and most enjoyable to use I think it hosts two small plane flights a day by Bangkok Airways which also owns the airport maybe a few more flights There is one gate A small complimentary buffet with coffee tea banana sticky rice cookies and such is at one end The waiting area is a traditional wood roof no walls with wood benches to sit and huge AC machines to help cool You get to the aircraft on an open air trolley riding past lily ponds with statues and manicured hedges There a few local items for sale and some Bangkok Airline bling Everyone was pleasant and helpful The Sukhothai airport zoo is next door featuring some giraffes and zebra It was not open both when we arrived and left but we could see the animals through a fence Across the way is what seems to be a dinosaur museum with many lifesize dinosaur statues outside

Corruption and extortion are alive and well at this airport Both myself and four colleagues in the following days were asked for our passports and then dollars to return them from officials at this airport It has been a while since this last happened to me in any country at any airport but this place stands out Who would want to visit this place for business or vacation Never again

Excellent small airport which is newly built few flights in the afternoon when it is at its busiest It is located way out of town hence you need to have pre booked transport to reach the town as no public transport is available The building is air conditioned which is a relief from searing heat The washrooms needed a bit of TLC The shopping was expensive as is the case at any international airport Food options are plenty Aircraft turn around time is quick Overall a good airport WiFi is free for one hour

Im impressed with all the improvements made at Dammam Airport Its easily my favorite airport to fly inout of in Saudi Arabia because of its compact size array of services retail and food and beverage outlets Its website and WiFi connectivity are also quite good and easy to use

Very early flight out of HK bussed from the terminal near gate downstairs so easy A bit of messing around at check in echeck in you need to show visas etc Plane spotless and staff attentive Bathrooms clean Return we prebooked one bag between us for the hold which we would recommend its about USD to do so whereas on the spot its more like US plane is immaculate and the staff responsive and quick Prebooked meals are served quickly and hot and cold drinks available Walked off to a far gate but train takes you to immigration Great for short flights and I feel they are better earlier in the day as more likely to be on time Seat is fine for a hour flight I would say Drinks arent extortionate nice cold prosecco for HK the app website is a bit tricky I joined it but had to do it all on the laptop first then open the app and register Sort of CX connected but not really Its a bit counterintuitive

This review is for T Arrival is smooth and quick as there are only few passengers and many open immigration counters There are counters for Chinese passport holders foreign passport holders APEC and crew as with other airports The signs and direction from arrival gate to the immigration baggage customs and exit are all clear A few steps from the immigration is the baggage carousel and then another few steps is the customs counters and then the exit There are taxi bays outside the terminal building and a bust waiting area I am not sure if the airport is connected by a train to the city proper as I did not use nor check it On departure checkin counters a less crowded as it ws an early flight There is a security check upon entering T and then another one after checkin and then a final and more detailed one after immigration There was no long queue and so I made it quick and fast to the boarding area Just at the back of the immigration is Gate which is my boarding gate and opposite it is Starbucks There are only few stores and restaurants Seats are not a problem as there are many empty ones The toilets are clean and well maintained Directions and signs are clear and understandable Visa and Mastecard are accepted The terminal is old but spacious The thermostat just needs to be adjusted as it is warm and it makes me feel uncomfortable The wifi si not working as well Overall I enjoyed this airport as an airplane enthusiast as it gives me a good view for plane spotting while waiting to board
Bar and restaurant staff appeared to be totally fed up and disinterested in their job Could do a lot better Rest of the airport was fine and very clean

No complaints about this airline on our flight from Siem Reap to Phnom Pehn in July No queue at checkin comfortable seats with plenty of leg room The A is old but very comfortable and clean Cabin crew and checkin staff very friendly and professional The flight departed early and was in the air for about minutes and they still managed to serve refreshments during the flight Excellent value as well with the tickets for both of us about the same as travelling by bus Would recommend Bassaka very highly and I hope they grow and prosper in the future

Each time I have flown in and out it has been easy The lines moves quickly and everyone is friendly and helpful Upon arrival after passing through immigration you proceed to the baggage carousel and hope that your luggage has made it to your destination with you but dont try to walk away with your suitcase that easily someone will be standing by to check your baggage tag and your passport

Kaimana to Manokwari Plane left and arrived minutes late really on time in this part of the world The check in staff were very flexible about cabin luggage size On board seats were reasonably comfortable and crew pleasant

Had a great flight from PHL to DCA on American Eagle operated by Republic Airlines A brief winter maintenance delay ensured a safe departure and while we experienced mild turbulence leaving Philadelphia and again upon arrival in Washington the pilots handled it smoothly Due to the conditions inflight service was not possible but safety remained the priority The Main Cabin Extra seats made for a much more comfortable experience and with a flight time of under minutes we arrived quickly and safely Republic continues to deliver a reliable and professional service for the American Airlines group

Singapore airport is magnificent and extremely wellmaintained with its facilities gardens waterfalls etc but arriving in the country has been made very difficult for Nordics There is no one at the immigration department upon arrival you first have to fill out a variety of information in English on a small computer which can take up to an hour If the machine accepts everything be happy There was no one to assist you in the queue of dozens of people at the machines And if you are accepted you go to another automatic machine where you present your passport and other necessary documents Your bag has been spinning for a long time waiting for you to pick it up from the belt When leaving the country everything seemed to be OK but then the departure security check began which was anything but friendly The border control officers who were clearly enjoying it gave orders and ripped off the jackets of older people who did not obey at the same second A militarystyle manly arrogant woman took my passport and boarding pass away because they noticed my diabetes pills everything was drugs to them Then I was ordered aside and subjected to various tactile tests with a digital device They couldnt didnt care to read prescriptions Overall it had the feel of being in the military chain of command

Friendly flight attendant who take care of the passengers efficiently Excellent flight but the cabin of the Dash needs a very serious refresh and more confortable seats The flight time was respected On the gate the employees of Air Canada Jazz offer a good service

Great airport Very easy to find everything spotlessly clean and nice decor The TSA employees were very efficient and friendly I was flagged at TSA precheck for my bag to be hand searched because of a binder in my bag The agent looked through the binder and repacked my items I was still through the security fast They have helpful announcements periodically TSA called people over the loudspeaker when someone had forgotten an item at security One announcement was for a granola bar left behind One of the best airports I have been to in a while

I have always found flying tofrom Sligo Airport a pleasure On a sunny day as one flies over Sligo Bay and comes into land is spectacular The airport is tiny with two flights per day to Dublin and two flights per day from Dublin It is served by Aer Arann The airport has has complimentary newspapers at the check in desk adn there is a little bar where a range of refreshments are served The staff are friendly and the service is first class There are no luggage carousels in the airport so all luggage is left in the Baggage Reclaim by hand One can be in the car after collecting their luggage in under a minute It could do with better signposting though and the roads to get to it are not the best but all in all a superb airport

Arrived in Paro airport at pm There WERE flights that had arrived Immigration was quick and the staff were very polite We got our bags and we left the airport in less than minutes For our departure check in took minutes and immigration another The departure lounge is small but adequate Lots of craft shops and a few places to eat Very casual airport and the staff are very friendly The cafe food was however awful but the coffee was nice Wifi available but kept disconnecting All in all a charming little airport for this stunning country

The airport was great with chill music clean spaces and nice atmosphere overall We were departing in the early morning flying to Kyiv but still almost everyone stayed professional and kind despite the early hour The only thing that disappointed us was two workers at the passport control gate We were talking to them in English gave our passports but they did not even say hi Just went with the take off your mask as a form of greeting when they saw our document and realized we are from Ukraine First of all even if it was easier for them to talk to us in Russian it would have been nice not to hear such rude words and intonations Secondly and most important not every citizen of Ukraine knows or wishes to speak in Russian Which we clearly demonstrated by talking to the workers in English first Their responses and the looks they were giving us were not professional Again everything else was perfect and we enjoyed this little time we had at the airport

Air Cambodia formerlyCambodia Angkor Air I felt quite sad for this airline because although the cabin crew were amazingly calm relaxed and friendly it seems that despite using smaller aircraft ATR s I understand they are really giving it their all to provide a decent level of service for such a short flight even though a cup of water was all that was provided I very much doubt if Ill ever fly with them again but I wish them all the very best
I can understand why Incheon airport is one of the best in the world The airport is very clean and peaceful There were various seating options and different shops I definitely recommend it

Small airport well organized and easy to get around The staff are not even remotely nice and not very fast at handling all the procedures The terminal is nice clean but lacking heavily on options to eat specially after going through security Not enough places to sit and waiting areas are small

As most of people here state the airport is brand new and clean but they schedule most of flights at the same time in other words the arrival hall becomes a nightmare We had to wait airborne for some minutes before we were allowed to land due lack of ramp space The airport is well connected with buses to town On departure everything was pretty much smooth but they let you wait outside waiting on the heat During peak summer season I would avoid Corfu if I were you

Yogyakarta to Jakarta onboard IP Checkin was absolutely breezy and easy and having purchased some extra baggage allowance they didnt overcharge me for being a bit overweight it only cost me around for a kg extra allowance Departure was pretty much on time and the flight attendants were friendly right from the start This time I got their first Airbus A on the fleet featuring Recaro BL seats which had just gotten its cushion changed The new cushion looked and felt comfortable and my seat was userfriendly and full of features combined with the slimline nature of the seats which left me with inches legroom instead of inches The cabin despite being old looked wellmaintained adequately airconditioned and spacious Takeoff was only a few minutes late and once airborne the IFE kicked in Pelita has just recently changed their IFE system from Starlight to Pasflix which for me looked like they just cloned the Starlight interface that was built via Tripper to their own app That being said due to the WiFi speed some of the contents failed to load properly but for me it just didnt matter on a short minute flight The meal was significantly better than my previous flight with no more sticky jam distorting my tastebuds Landing was early and my bag arrived without too much of a wait The ground experience at both CGK and YIA was superb Sometimes with flights like this I forget that they are a new rejuvenated airline because their new rejuvenated energy made me love them As its name suggests theyre truly a shining light in the Indonesian aviation industry apart from the slow IFE they gave me no reason to hate them

BK TSNXIY Not as bad as I thought very cheap no IFE pretty bad meal but still a meal nonetheless Aircraft was an older but was perfectly clean Service was efficient but brash Chinese regulations mean that you cant use your mobile phone any time during the flight even in flight mode and they do enforce this
The aircraft was on time from Manchester and on the return journey from Lourdes Bartres the aircraft left early The staff were a bit distant the food good overall OK

I cant remember when the last time I was here but nevertheless it was a pleasant surprise to use the airport again Many places to have food and the atmosphere was pleasant Just one thing that I disliked was the toilet in the common area It was really smelly and should be dealt with immediately

PEKVKOTLVVKOPEK flew with a premium economy seat Online checkin was a bit painful due to age old software but the airline staff at the counter were excellent to resolve the issue and made a smooth checkin for us and offered an emergency exit seat I knew before hand about the poor inflight entertainment so I carried an iPad with several movies and music in it Cabin crew were on par with other airlines and spoke very little English which wasnt an issue at all No wine or alcohol being served in the cabin but the generous flow of fruit juices candies and chocolates made my travel bit comfortable I would definitely fly them again

Very efficient and pleasant airport Check in was quick and used the executive lounge I have used many but this was excellent One of the very best Food and drinks of good choice and a high standard Served to you rather than self service Comfortable and lovely friendly staff who couldnt do enough for you

Camilo Daza Airport serves Colombias largest border city Ccuta Access to the airport is quite easy as is moving inside it Checkin process is fast and hasslefree Staff is quite professional and courteous Free wifi with excellent speed The airport is being remodelled and although small in size will be more beautiful and pleasant to use There are just a few shopping choices which is a drawback and the food court is also small and limited in variety Once improvements are over it will certainly be a more efficient and agreeable airport

I frequently travel through this airport and would note a couple of problems in an otherwise nice facility First Ive arrived on another airline and been unable to get help in the transit lounge from Air Ivoire even though they are my next flight You have to get somebody to take you to the front desk through a little back hallway and tip them Second if you go through the passport desk they have plain clothed policemen without badges who demand your passport in the luggage area without identifying themselves The restaurant in the departure area is much nicer than the one outside the ticket area where you check in

First of all the editors of this website should note that Go Mokulele doesnt exist anymore the Cessna operations of that company are now run by a totally different company DBA Mokulele Airlines This may explain why I am puzzled by all the negative comments I flew KonaMaui MauiMolokai and MolokaiHonolulu this summer and all three flights were perfect flight experiences and I had more than pounds of luggage with me Indeed you are weighed at checkin like in preWWI days remember that Cessnas are very small propeller planes with serious weight limitations not large jets but this is done discreetly I flew on what seemed to be brand new aircraft The seating arrangements also are clearly designed for center of gravity optimisation Good side is that you always get a window and aisle seat seating and since you dont fly very high the views of Hawaii from above are magnificent And for airline geeks such as myself you see and hear whats going on in the cockpit which is interesting

Paris to Reunion Air Austral is a fairly good airline The seat layout of the Airbus A was xx The leg room was not too bad Inflight entertainment was good and worked well Cabin service was average but generally fine The flight was on time

I was extremely impressed with Providence TF Green Airport It is high up on the list of my favorite small airport and heres a lowdown on it The Terminal It is all very straightforward with everything well signposted and not complicated at all Security is efficient and the multiple times weve gone through there wasnt much line at all After Security there is a decent selection of Shops and Dining The shops include the standard souvenir and news shops plus a few interesting clothes and accessory shops Foodwise there is a small but good variety of places to eat ranging from a Dunkin Donuts to an Oyster Bar The seating in the terminal is comfortable and regularly equipped with charging outlets The WiFi is nothing special free for minutes but at least its there Connections Norwegian Air advertises the airport as BostonProvidence While Providence isnt too far from Boston it is still a good hour driving The RIPTA bus service passes reasonably frequently and is a good way to get to downtown Providence I recommend that or the Peter Pan Coach over the MBTA train as that passes infrequently and only works on weekdays To get to Boston using Public transportation I would recommend taking the Coach as the train not only rarely passes but it takes forever as it stops at every station along the route And there it is A nice little airport clean and with good amenities The main problem is the lack of connections especially late at night which might make an uber the only option I really recommend it though even as a lowcost alternative to Boston

Milan to Male Nice airline Very good in all services Economy class is a very good class Beverages are very good too with a lot of product On my flight services were snack lunch and a afternoon snack with a slice of pizza If you need something else you can ask to steward that will help you in every moment Staff is very kind and happy Good airline
Beautiful airport in Orange County with incredible ease to all major interstates Airport sits off the and is perfectly situated for Los Angeles visitors Large airport with a small town feel
Nice small friendly airport Good transport links to the city by bus which meets flights and plenty of taxis A few shops and cafes and very clean facilities

Very short min flight to Zanzibar and back again from Dar es Salaam with Coastal Aviation Both flights were on time and our luggage arrived too Tiny aircraft and fully booked so quite a squeeze but comfortable enough for such a short flight Was very pleasantly surprised with the punctuality and reliability Would definitely recommend flying Coastal

A friendly airport if you just want to watch the planes from the viewing area but not passenger friendly poor layout Up a lot of stairs for passport checks when you arrive Had to go through security the past twice on departure the both times they claimed I had passed through a public area after the first check Security patdowns are embarrassingly intimate

I flew in January with Edelweiss from Zurich to Cape Town with my friend Everything was excellent from the very beginning The crew was very nice and helpful answered all my questions accurately and professionally On the way from Cape Town we transferred to another flight in Zurich to Budapest The crew informed us about the ground gate the time of departure and all the necessary information needed for the transfer The food was fine the whole flight went quickly and I was very satisfied I will definitely choose this company for future flights The aircraft was clean tidy and everything met my expectations The toilets were also in great condition and clean The crew at the airport was very nice and helpful

Check in at Port Vila was somewhat chaotic in the Domestic Terminal however certain check in desks for certain flights ensured you checked in for your flight ontime Very strict closing times for check in be warned to check in on time Boarding announcements were not very clear and any announcements were very hard to hear due to echo in the terminal Boarding was efficient greeted by the Smiling crew and that was it really Pre takeoff checks and we didnt see the crew again until the prelanding checks were done There is NO refreshments offered so take your own We did on this flight and so glad that we did Beautiful views to be had heading north to Santo however things turned to custard on coming into Santo It was midafternoon when the thunderstorms tend to pop up and we could not land at Santo due to the weather We then endured another minutes back to Port Vila where more chaos ensued I must say it was the Australians and Americans who were demanding on arrival wanting compensation and accommodation their pleas went unanswered as weather issues are not the responsibility of the airline folks Found our own hotel for the night turned up back at the Airport the next afternoon for our replacement flight and off we flew back to Santo and landed on a beautiful afternoon Cabin crew again were full of smiles on boarding and deplaning but really they did nothing else Aircraft was clean toilet was clean and announcements on the aircraft were much clearer than on some airlines we have travelled In fairness to Air Vanuatu they got us there and back and then there again safely they accommodated us onto an extra special flight due to the disruption you could not ask for anything else

Glacier Park International Airport FCA in Montana USA is the best small regional airport I have visited After a very long journey from Sydney we were cleared very fast What impressed us was the security guard who stands on arrival exit door greeted us with a big smile and sad welcome to Montana On our return flights we were checked in very fast cleared very fast with smiles by TSA what a difference after LAXTSA The terminal and toliets are very clean

My brother and I and Flew for the first time everyone was very helpful they even put us in the sky lounge which consists of a buffet and drinks They did no extra charge and they helped out through the whole time without necessarily babying us Thank you for the experience
The airport is new modern and colorful Everywhere is clean There are nice looking green areas with flowers and trees outside The employees were polite and smiling

I flew TokyoSapporoTokyo I was pleasantly surprised at the efficiency and professionalism of the staff The crew spoke English We departed and arrived ontime The great price combined with the excellent service ensures I will fly Skymark again

We misplaced our passport which was very stressful However Ashley and Phil at the Canberra airport made sure that we still made it onto other flights back to New Zealand Their service was outstanding they were both so helpful nothing was a hassle which helped to alleviate a very stressful situation for us We cant thank them enough

The international terminal is small and because of that there are no endless walks which is great The visa on arrival staff were very quick and it only took a few minutes to be processed then it was the same going through immigration Our bags were waiting for us in the baggage hall after immigration then it was over to the taxi desk and straight into cab and on to our hotel On departing once again immigration was very quick then we had a short wait in the departure lounge which was very nice with a few shops and a good cafe

Lilongwe airport Malawi takes you back to some of the delights of s travel no announcements so you have to listen carefully when the staff shout which plane is boarding Fortunately its a small and quiet international airport so you cant go too far wrong unless youre asleep Theres enough shops to keep you entertained for minutes theres a cafe and you can watch the planes from the outdoor balcony and theres not much else But what it needed to do it did so efficiently and pleasantly nice to be aware from the security paranoia of LHR or other big western airports Note the duty free doesnt come in sealed duty free bags so you do run the risk of losing it all if you transit to somewhere else as we did A shame as the prices were really ok and I dont know anywhere else outside the country that you can get Malawi gin

I have used Polonia six times in the last four year both international and domestic arrival and departure No problems with taxis overcharging just as for any airport do your research Be affirmative informed and polite

I recently flew UL with family from MELCMBMEL return Given the many negative reviews seen here I was expecting a very poor product But to be honest I was pleasantly surprised Of course there is certainly room for improvement the seats could be more comfortable upholstery needs to be changed arms loose or broken needs an overall clean At times the quality of annoucements were not the best Boarding in CMB was a bit disorganised considering the flights were very full on both sectors But the IFE system for me and everyone around me was working in both sectors many reviewers here are complaining about it not working A decent selection of movies TV and music Good head sets Food was average airline food cant complain Cabin service was very professional helpful efficient and attentive Bagage was delivered to belt on time Checkin at both ends was OK Will definitely consider again I got what I paid for For those complaining please pay more and choose another airline

I had not heard of Air KBZ before I made the booking for my Myanmar trip However all of the three domestic flights Mandalay to Thandwe Thandwe to Sittwe and Sittwe to Yangon went very well ontime arrivals food and beverages free of charge although the flights were short friendly staff modern and clean aircraft I would fly Air KBZ again in case I return to Myanmar

I have to say this is the best airport I have ever used so straight forward and friendly helpful staff all the way Plenty of shops to have a stroll around and fantastic food Only an hour away from home with great parking I am sure this is my airport of choice from now on Absolutely love it great start to our holiday Thank you Doncaster Sheffield airport

London Gatwick to Podgorica The Fokker seats were comfortable in formation but they were small and legroom was limited Crew members were helpful and attentive We were served a couple of drinks and a fairly basic sandwich but it was fine It was cheaper for me to book a ticket to Belgrade via Podgorica than it was just to Podgorica I told the checkin staff I wanted to get off at Podgorica and that was fine

KigaliJoburg June in an old narrowbody B I was upgraded from an inexpensive economy ticket to business class by using miles in their Dream Miles Frequent Flyer Program Checkin and lounge access in Kigali smooth as usual Luggage was kindly checked in to final destination legs ahead on different tickets and airlines Thats a courtesy winner which hardly any European airlines can cope with Checkin issued my onward Boarding Passes on the spot which made my life easy by staying in transits throughout the journey enjoying entitlements and lounges instead of struggling with immigration and landside eg in South Africa Lounge in Kigali is good though still with room for minor improvements Boarding easy by walking m on tarmac directly to the aircraft The business seats were in rows in x configuration I had D to avoid direct exposure to the rising morning sun In economy seats are narrower and in x configuration Morning flight departed on time and arrived slightly early Onboard seating perfect special meal accommodated other hot meals offered were also good No drinks and no food menu provided Unclear what they actually had onboard for catering Drinks and wine selection sparse and modest However we were offered predeparture champagne Piper Heidshick FAs were generous pampering us well and of world class in kindness and attentiveness They might benefit from further airline exposures IFE is useless no headsets given Given FFP miles instantly according to my original booking Luggage well handled Cannot demand much more for regional flights in business class

Manado airport is one of the best in Indonesia It has a small delay rate and has a very good view from the waiting room The airport terminal faces east of Manado and oversees the beautiful nature and mountain ranges with the planes takingoff and landing
The airport is cool clean well ventilation and beautiful The navigation sign is clear help the customer easily navigate inside the airport The staff are considerate and thoughtful

Not a large airport my wife and I found this one more like ones we are used to in New Zealand No airbridges but airstairs do the job well especially at smaller airports Arrival was good a lot of taxi touts which is not unusual in Malaysia we used a coupon taxi for transport to our hotel Did not visit the shops or toilets here had a long wait in departure lounge for our flight Met our needs staff helpful

First and foremost the charging stations here in T are nothing more than horse posts Zero USB terminals I tried worked Ninety percent of the plugs did not work plus they are shoved on a wall so only people can use the ones that do work MAJOR inconvenience I suggest charging tables with stations and access to both sides in multiple locations throughout Second different restaurants Not sure how many variations of a club sandwich one can experience but that seems to be the theme here Its sad when McDonalds is your best choice Other reviewers are correct who decided how many seats were required in the gate area Its more like a commuter airline in a mountain town with gates Add more Lastly Iberia needs to add personell At least at the Customer Service desk since most of their inbound flight misconnect Two employees to take care of customers an hour is cruel On a positive note it is a very clean airport Cleaning staff gets stars

Excellent new terminal spacious and with lots of checkin counters Flew China Southern to Nanjing and the checkin was swift as was security All passengers get patted down regardless of whether you beep or not which was a bit of a nuisance Beyond security good amenities and restaurants We had an early morning departure and the terminal was very busy but it is definitely large enough to handle the number of people One downside is we got a bus to the plane which took minutes

Amsterdam to Paramaribo Surinam Airways has good service unfortunately the A had some maintenance so they leased an A from Wamos Air but they have the service from Surinam Airways The food was amazing with hot meals The crew was very friendly but the airplane from Wamos Air wasnt so good no IFE for a our flight you can download the app for movies no power outlets just a standard seat with table Overall the service was good but the aircraft not

Probably the best island airport in the Indian Ocean Well designed structure the only challenge is the long queue in the immigration hall The authorities need to arrange extra officers during peak timings

Good small airport The staff is not friendly at all First nobody smile in that airport and when i pass the gate they dont greeting at the search point and passport point One guy he just pointing me by hand what to do and chewing gum in your face

I recently flew with Swiss Air on the Bucharest to Zurich route in an Airbus A Despite the overall comfort of the aircraft and the friendliness of the cabin crew the cabin temperature was much too low and could not be adjusted despite our requests The crew was kind and suggested we wear warmer clothes assuring us that the situation would improve over time Unfortunately the temperature remained consistently low throughout the flight making the journey less comfortable than we would have liked Nevertheless the aircraft was modern and clean and the staff provided prompt and friendly service If it werent for the temperature issue I would have had a very pleasant experience If the temperature cannot be adjusted immediately the company could provide passengers with additional blankets to offer them thermal comfort Overall my flight experience with Swiss Air was good but the temperature issue left a negative impression

Quito to Galapagos with LAN Airlines Excellent service throughout Had never encountered this airline before but would recommend highly Lovely staff with excellent English and nice snacks Both Quito and Galapagos airports are nice indeed with easy check in and plenty of space Aircraft seats are leather and comfortable

The airport is brand new It opened in replacing the old and dilapidated airport in the city centre The pre departure lounge is spacious and clean with some pocket gardens Full of daylight even in rainy season and the windows give a great vista of the mountains The restaurant serves nice food although I wish the airport authorities would install free WiFi The checkin counter is getting stuffy and quite small but the queue is still tolerable Comfort rooms are still in good shape yet needs proper maintenance to keep it looking brand new The arrival area during high traffic days gets a bit congested Parking security is not a problem although the toll is quite steep for countryside standards Accessibility is also not a problem as shuttles and cheaper mode of transportation

I am very grateful to Royal Brunei Airlines for helping me facilitate my lastminute return to Brunei My husband and I were supposed to return to Brunei on November th but because my sister passed away on the morning of November th we had to return to Brunei immediately At first there were no available slots for a return flight but one of the RB KUL crew Mohad did everything he could to help me get back to Brunel I am very thankful and deeply appreciate his assistance If it werent for his support I wouldnt have had the chance to be there in time for my sisters burial Good job RBA and keep up the great work

Malaga to Birmingham Originally a Monarch Airlines flight this was operated by Omni Air International chartered in by the CAA The aircraft was excellent and spotless and the comfort was amazing However the reason for my review is the excellent staff They were kind polite helpful considerate and lovely people it was only a short flight from Malaga to Birmingham but we all said that we wished it was a longer flight they gave us drinks and the most lovely toasted sandwiches which were fantastic Please pass on the thanks of the passengers and myself

Departure is very tedious Our flight got delayed not due to the airports fault but it took hours for them to get our luggage back Most of the luggage returned were wet and damaged Arrival however is very quick and easy

I recently slipped a disc and needed assistance at Gibraltar airport I cant say just how heartwarming it was to be met by the lovely Sam and guided through what can be a pretty stressful experience with genuine humanity and not a few laughs along the way Shes a real gem as were all other staff involved from check in to departure Another client asked what happened as we were raised into the transport and an attendant whod had a similar injury gave some really good supplementary advice as we disappeared I do a fair amount of travelling and that was a rare experience Thank you all

Boarding by bus transport Flight on time cabin crew friendly They served water during the short flight Got an emergency exist seat based on my frequent flyer status No entertainment available Landing ahead of schedule Nothing special but effective flight

This airport is small so whilst access is good facilities are very limited Airside there are only vending machine so if you want anything to eat or drink best use the bar Landside Do not carry tins eg Duck Confit Pate etc that are greater than g in hand luggage they will be confiscated at security

Beijing to Xiamen I used Capital Airlines flight from Beijing to Xiamen and I felt that the flight attendants were in excellent service Although the meals is a sandwich the taste is quite good that my son ate three I ordered coffee my wife drank tea which is very traditional Chinese The plane arrived minutes late but it arrived on time which pleased me It is worth mentioning that in front of my pocket there is an tablet computer there are many videos and movies it is very convenient The only problem is that carbin crew sells souvenirs during the flight but its understandable that airlines want to make more money On the ground Hainan Airlines owns the T terminal in Beijing and the Capital Airlines is a subsidiary of Hainan airlines so it is also at t Boarding pass checked baggage boarding is very convenient the terminal is also very clean

VilniusTallinn OV Sept We were very surprised when the checkin lady at Vilnius airport charged us the equivalent of around Euro pp for the checkin The use of the existing checkin machines at Vilnius airport would cause this fee as well she explained to us The only way to get a free checkin would have been the use of a smartphone We did not unfortunately have this possibility Up to now I have never encountered costs for the use of a checkin machine at any airport Apart from this Flight was on time Aircraft clean Quiet and comfortable flight Seats average Only few travellers on this flight Drinks and food for sale Free checkin baggage Very fast baggage delivery in Tallinn airport

A satisfactory experience overall the first leg slightly better than the second one Clean modern aircraft leg space ok food better than average and service more than acceptable For the fare I paid I can have no real complaints Would fly with this company again if the opportunity arose
I agree with the previous reviewers comments This is a great little airport An added bonus is that there is now a direct train link to Jerez centre as well as Cadiz and the surrounding cities

This company is horrific We had a cancelation of our flight back home and this airline refused to refund our money Fly Maya Island Air They are exceptional less expensive and very flexible The planes are also shady You will not regret flying Maya Island Air Have a wonderful and safe flight

The airport is much improved since I was last here in Arrivals not much to say there was just my flight in so the baggage queue was pretty tame Departure check in was a breeze even though there were three flights due to depart that morning There is free wifi and plenty of seating The new terminal building is spacious and modern with a nice outside seating area overlooking the runway and apron Security was also a breeze with only a very small queue and security staff seemed pleasant enough No air bridge though so if its raining you have a couple of minutes walk before you get to your aircraft Overall a nice little airport

Paris Orly to PointePitre Overall good experience decent food friendly service on the inbound flight Outbound all of the crew disappeared at night difficult to get something to drink Some security concerns upon landing in Paris Crew didnt check the cabin at alltwo teens sleeping in lie flat position until touchdown No one to wake them up no one to remind them to put their seat in an upright position never saw that before Seats are ok but angled lie flat

I flew with a friend to Iceland from Toronto for a day trip We were attracted to wow air because of the cheap price and direct flight to Keflavk international airport near Reykjavk It is important to note for travellers that you do have to pay for a carry on bag and pay for a checked bag so my friend and I packed our checked luggage together and split the cost however make sure to pay attention to the weight The website advertises that it needs to be kg and as long as we were under kg the attendant was fine with our bag On the flight itself there is a decent amount of space for a backpack under the seat in front and for the price youre paying its great I was blown away by the customer service on the flight there I am a very nauseous flyer typically I get motion sickness on any moving vessel I took a different type of gravol than normal and needless to say ended up vomiting times on the hour flight After the nd time I vomited they offered to move me up to premium class but I declined After the rd time they offered again to move me where I had more space to be comfortable and where there would be less intense turbulence They were so attentive and kept checking up on me to make sure I was okay They offered me cups of ice continuously and ginger ale and made su

Bangkok to Yangon retjurn in midMay This is my first experience with this airline and it did not disappoint The checkin at the airport for both flights were uneventful efficiently handled and most notably having little or no queues which is always a welcomed sight when there are snaking queues at neighbouring counters for other airlines The boarding for the outgoing flight started a little after the scheduled time The planes do not have any seatback entertainment units but for the outgoing flight there was onboard wifi which allow you free access to a selection of movies and TV shows on the MAI app which can be preloaded onto phones Ipads etc The selection was limited For a min flight it is impressive that the cabin crew is able to come round with wet tissues followed by a meal and drinks service The cabin crew were polite and cheerful The captain made announcements regularly which were spoken in clear English

I travel from Limoges to and from Paris The terminal is a little bit small but it is very clean There is a not a very long queue time and the staff were very proactive At this airport there is one bar and one restaurant but there are no lounges or dutyfree The boarding area is very small and there is not much seating This is a little but very efficient airport

Stockholm Bromma to Malm Sturup Very friendly cabin crew and good service This is the only airline in Sweden that serve free meals during domestic flights The plane were clean and the seats were of standard model I will fly with Malm Aviation whenever I go to Stockholm again Best domestic airline so far

Initially booked in Economy Class but when I was about to board agent took my boarding pass and voila got upgraded to Business One thing that stands out with Philippine Airlines is the hospitality and warmth of their crew both on ground and on board Food may not be at par with other big Asian carriers but for what they lack makes it up with their service One thing to consider as well is the ticket price being the most affordable Ill keep using PR as it is the most convenient affordable and with genuine service PRs exclusive Mabuhay Lounge at MNL T is one the best thing that happened with PR so far Keep it up

I think Dublin airport does a very good job of dealing with large number of passengers efficiently and with courtesy I travel through there at least once a month and rarely come across any issues I think when they get more of the enhanced security scanners it will be even better

Since Zhulyany Airport had opened the new Terminal I have flown times from there Everything was nice clean and efficient and friendly service I really can recommend this airport to be used for a visit in Kiev

Very clean and well taken care of This airport is served by so many great airlines with diverse destinations I do think that GRR needs more international routes At GRR the airport is not too big so it makes efficient travel Also they have a good selection of shops and stores The airport facility looks really modern and cool for being over years old The only cons is that sometimes it can get a bit crowded and the staff doesnt manage high groups of passengers well Would give an if I could
I think it is a great airport compared to most Chinese airports Today Hangzhou Airport is quite different from what it used to be Its very large and modern and has good service

This review is about the new Siem Reap International Airport that began operations on October It was my first time at this airport and was taking the long hour trip by the post office bus Besides a big nice golden Buddha statue there is nothing decorative cultural paintings etc at this new airport Despite having an invitation to a lounge the lounge was not in operation yet There is only one coffee facility where people must queue up Only one Chinese restaurant was open but who to eat dim sum for breakfast The staff overall seemed distant and immigration staff only became friendly after I began speaking in Khmer I know that this is a new airport but maybe the airport authority can pick up some ideas from this review t was also very hot inside

The Plaza Business Lounge at Brisbane Airport was comfortable enough with a range of food and drinks but no tonic for a GT There were very few toilets in the lounge though On board the A the seat was comfortable and the service was friendly and responsive My vegetarian meals were good but breakfast was served far too early interrupting sleep The plane for the connecting service to Sapporo was an unreconstructed A with oldstyle business class seating but comfortable enough for a hour flight The service and vegetarian food out of Taipei were both excellent Overall China Airlines is a good way to travel between Australia and Japan at a reasonable price

Good shopping for such a small airport Clean and clear Cheap car parking compared with Schiphol When arriving plane parked in front of terminal and was outside the building with my checked bag in minutes

I recently flew from PHL to DCA on American Eagle operated by Republic Airways and had a fantastic experience The flight crew was attentive and professional ensuring everything ran smoothly from boarding to landing The aircraft was clean and comfortable and the service was prompt despite the short flight duration The pilot provided clear updates and the entire trip was seamless A great example of efficient and excellent regional service

Flew GA Jakarta to Amsterdam GarudaIndonesia arranged a car to pick me up at my home and drop me off at Terminal At the Drop off area Rudy from GarudaFirst Class Team was on hand to assist me with Check in and security process Traveling with Garuda in Business or First Class there is a special lane in the immigration which can be used and this is quite fast even when the airport is busy I was then taken to the FirstClass lounge where full A La Cart dining is available however I just went with the fruit platter as I wanted to wait for the onboard meals The service team in the lounge are most helpful When I it came time to board the aircraft I was assisted by Rudy from the First Class Team who helped me through the boarding gate and on to the aircraft At the aircraft door I was meet by the cabin crew Vivi Jayanti Inggo and Chef Sansan who give me a very warm welcome and guided me to my seat The overall ambience of the FirstClass section is excellent and the crew keep the toilets exceptionally clean The food and drink menus were extensive and meals can be served on demand and I enjoyed both meals severed The onboard wiffi had excellent connectivity Garuda Indonesia First Class service is outstanding as they also include access to the VIP Lounge in Amsterdam Schiphol airport and all formalities for my transfer flight are taken care of including immigration

Its mainly a domestic airport Internal sign and direction system is clear and well arranged Immigration check procedure is efficient The Japanese officers are well organized Public transportation from Komatsu airport to city downtown only relies shuttle bus The schedule is not frequent The time interval is often more than one hour

Hollywood Burbank Airport is a perfectly splendid airport and a notsoperfectlyspendid airport simultaneously What do I mean Well first Long Beach is my favorite airport in the Los Angeles area with Burbank a respectable second I find them to be more pleasant than especially LAX and even Orange County The feeling of flying into and out of Burbank is one of aviation yesteryear of sorts think sort of like the show Wings Driving onto the airport and following the signage to the terminal and car rental return is simple and straightforward Dropoff and pickup areas in the front of the terminal are simply and clearly delineated though sometimes difficult to access given the constant flow of traffic in that area which is still nowhere remotely as bad as LAX but remember Burbanks terminal is old Walking into the airport you clearly have a feeling of sera Art Deco architecture something really Americana and unique even as American airports go Checkin for either American or Southwest is a breeze no sarcasm no lip service all business but still pleasant Seating and flooring pre and postsecurity is a little aged and worn in some areas and could really stand to be improved but theyre also no worse than much of LAX Shopping and dining options are very limited even by small airport standards surprising considering that we are still in the greater Los Angeles area after all The staff at the car rental facilities are generally helpful and professional though actually friendliness is hitandmiss Ive never met anybody rude there though TSA personnel seem to be the most truly hitandmiss either sugarcoatedly friendly and jovial or aloof and grumpy almost to the point of being rude To TSAs credit here though they are amazingly efficient even by small airport standards whether you have TSA PreCheck or not There has been a proposal by the airport authority to effectively construct a new terminal in the place of the existing terminal which would be a shame to have materialize with the charming existing terminal could just be renovated and modernized while keeping its rich history in tact In all Burbank is a good airport with some notable warts but positive experiences to be had hard to rave about but still easy to like
Family trip from Montral to Edmonton Boeing Canadian North is a nice airline Food great No inflight Entertainment Beverages and Cabin Service nice It was a calm nonturbulent flight

I flew on TWay from Seoul Incheon to Singapore I was a bit surprised to find a usb charging port on my seat for a low cost carrier and free of charge some more The tray table included a personal electronic device holder which allowed me to use as a stand for my phone Seat was very comfortable on A in a seating configuration with leather padding for a low cost carrier Flight landed early in Singapore didnt feel so much turbulence also not very strong turbulence so quite a smooth flight

Just wish to say that the check in and wheelchair assistance at Malpensa was really excellent and one of the best that I have experienced as a recent wheelchair traveller Staff were very helpful and efficient The only issue that I would raise is the state of the toilets

CHA has the misfortune of being too close to Atlanta Over half of Chattanooga flyers drive to Atlanta or Nashville or Birmingham to fly However CHA offers competitive fares and I would guess most flights now are regional jet The airport itself is beautiful with a large copper dome as the facilitys trademark in honor of the citys railroad heritage CHA is a modern stateoftheart airport and is where I choose to fly out of even though I live in the northern Atlanta burbs

A wonderful flight from Tehran to Paris with new A that was very modern Good entertainment system but only a small number of film and music choices but a very good flight map The aircraft was very clean Two meals were served first a very good breakfast and a snack later

I was twice in Tianjin Airport First time it was domestic flight the second time it was an international one I was positively surprised about the airport and its open and bright architecture No signs are missing very straightforward as well as very good shopping and food opportunities I flew the second time with Air China and I would have appreciated it if the airline provided permanent open checkin desks but they didnt So if you are too early as I was that time you have to wait until the desks are open to drop your Bagage All in all a quite good experience

Barbados to Bequia SVG Air Grenadine Alliance will take you to Bequia and other beautiful small Caribbean islands I flew them from Barbados to Bequia return in January Ignore any timetables or prices you find via internet search these are not current Email the airline directly they will respond promptly and courteously You will be billed in Eastern Caribbean dollars XCD These are roughly XCD per one USD Expect your flight to cost roughly the same as or even slightly more than your flight to Barbados from the US It may be more costeffective for a large group to charter a flight Ground staff are laidback but helpful and courteous flight crew are professional Checkin is straightforward and they will let you check one bag without fee plus bring a personal item on plane I was able to fit a mediumsized duffel under the seat Your flight may stop briefly at other islands such as Canouan and Union Island to pick up and discharge passengers It is a beautiful ride My flights were on DHC Twin Otters a workhorse of global aviation and not claustrophobic for a small plane Great views including through windshield which you can see as cockpit door remains open

Flying from Fayetteville to CLT on July The young man at AA was unfriendly like I never seen before Your ID put your bag take your bag were his only words No greeting no thank you no have a good flight I recently moved to Fayetteville for a job from New York Flying often Never flew from Fayetteville used Raleigh for that There was no soap in the restroom at am already Security was okay did not use thank you or please in their lexicon I will fly from Raleigh next time
Clean airplane departed on time Crew were professional and friendly Good announcement from the pilot Offered a cookie and a bottle of water No in flight magazine

This is a nice and modern airport at the moment they are expanding the airport so there is a lot of building going on but in the departure area you will not notice this very much The Airport has got free Wifi and a small restaurant with shop on the land side Airside you will find a small shop with prepacked sandwiches and hot dogs and other small stuff a small duty free shop is also around but not very cheap There is no Lounge to be found at the moment but after the expansion is completed there will be one available around May Checkin procedures are fast and the waiting area after checkin is fine with a view on the tarmac All in all a nice modern but small airport with expensive restaurants and shop

We flew from Dubrovnik to Athens and then Athens to Zagreb on Croatia Airlines They were on time within minutes for both flights You drop your bag on the tarmac and they load it into the belly of the plane And then you pick it up directly from the tarmac after the flight so there is very little chance for lost luggage which I like They allow a smaller carryone bag as well They did not weigh our bag or try to charge us for anything extra We were allowed to pick our seats for no charge The seats are standard and comparable to Southwest airlines for leg room and space We were served water and drinks on both flights For the price we paid it was a great deal Some people might be nervous about flying a propeller plane but it was a very smooth flight in both directions with almost zero turbulence and a very smooth landing If you had to fault them for one thing it would be nice to have some in flight entertainment Other than that it was a perfect flight Definitely recommend

Great employees service schedules but I have stopped flying with Horizon because they are now using Turbo Prop planes Q Its slower has more noise and vibration and most of all they cannot fly at altitudes where the ride is smooth This is compared to the full size jets that Southwest flies on the same routes as Horizon I used to have the credit card had Frequent flyer status and earned oodles of miles Those days are gone
