We booked different domestic flights tofrom and in Sulawesi with Lion Air as there were no real alternatives What I was afraid for having read reviews here already happened days before departure of our first flight as I got a message our initially booked first flight was cancelled and we were rebooked on a later flight From the flights booked were cancelled and we got rebooked Luckily I managed to arrange my pickup at the Makassar and Ternate airports where we already arranged travel Our flights from Makassar to Palopo and back were the only ones that remained as booked Palopo flights on an ATR twinturboprop had Wings Air owned by Lion Air flight numbers All other flights were on s Service on board of the flights was nonexistent but at least the flights were smooth and left on time as per the new schedule Also baggage reclaim went smooth but this of course shouldnt be an issue as all airports were quite small The positive note is staff at the airports were nice and friendly and always did their best to assign us seats with more legroom which was much appreciated

Landed at the newer of the two terminals Baggage collection was fast and was able to buy a phone card easily on the lower Arrivals level but telephones were only on the upper Departures level Security was tight with baggage tags checked by airport staff No illegal taxi touts hounding you and bus into the city was quick and easy On departing the airline waiting areas were large and comfortable The food in some places was cheap very cheap Same as supermarket price for bottle of Pepsi Had a gate change but was handled quickly and easily Efforts were made to keep me informed despite being the only foreigner on my flight New monorail will soon open from airport to city Airport taxi prices are not too expensive but be prepared for a wild and crazy ride

UMEBMA economy This little Swedish airline brings back what flying used to be in the good old days The flight was an hour short hop between Umea a small city up north and Bromma a tiny central airport of Stockholm in an Avro RJ Plane was clean and flight attendants nice free newspapers Aftonbladet and some inflight magazine followed by a coffee service a free meal sandwich fresh orange juice and chocolate cake Before landing we were given hot towels and sweets

The staff at this airport have to be the friendliest and most helpful airport staff I have ever met My fiend and I arrived at the airport leaving for Vietnam with an hour and a half until our flight thinking all of our documents were in order Turns out we had both entered incorrect information on our travel visas by mistake and this mistakes would not be overlooked by Vietnam country officials rendering the visas void and us unable to travel We were traveling on New Years Day so the visa office at the airport was closed The staff were extremely helpful with our situation They assigned us a personal check in clerk who stayed with us through the whole ordeal and was calm and reassuring the entire time He contacted an emergency visa officer who drove from his home to the airport and issued us emergency visas on the spot albeit for a large fee but this was expected Since it was a holiday they did not have any visa issuers on site They allowed us to check in even though we did not have the correct visas in place knowing that the visa officer was on the way Once we had our visas we had about min until the plane left The checkin clerk ran us all the way through the airport moved us to the head of the security line got us right up to the front of any queue we encountered and got us on that plane He was running like his life depended on it It was amazing to watch and experience We got on the plane with min to spare We are eternally grateful to that checkin clerk the visa officer and all the staff we briefly encountered The onus was definitely on us for messing up our visas but they helped us all the way regardless Most wonderful people Ive ever met at an airport would recommend

Absolutely love this airport Easy in and easy out Not jammed with people like the zoo at MCO Orlando Adequate places to get something quick to eat and comfortable seats to wait Only min from our place in Oviedo I just wish more domestic carriers other than just Allgiant flew into SFB Maybe international travelers dont care for it because its not a large airport but its great for us and I do recommend it

We took Flight from Kathmandu to Bangkok by Nepal airlines for our Holiday trip Flight was on time meal provided during flight is delicious and have veg and non veg options Staff of airline were well behaved and professional I will use service of Nepal in future as well Highly recommended
Relatively simple layout Staff very friendly and informative Buses into the city centre bus station depart right in front of the terminal but are not as frequent as could be
Its easy to get around very friendly people and easy to get bags and leave Always a good experience and they have free wifi so never a problem with communication

GSO is a very convenient and nice airport Parking is super convenient right next to the terminal which makes it nice when picking up people It is a nice and clean airport that I try and fly out of whenever I can I only wish that I could get more direct flights out of there

I could not believe how quiet the airport is now Ryanair have decreased their flights checked in with baggage in less then minutes and through security to departures in no time Once airside there is not much to do but there is several duty free shops a caferestaurant and a SubwayMcDonalds outlet as well as two outdoor smoking terraces All in all a nice clean little airport with helpful and friendly staff

Late evening arrival into CFU on the th May arriving minutes early from EMA Deplaned quickly and minimal delay at passport control only due to people disembarking at the same time there were also several friendly assistants to help manage the queue and answer any questions Baggage was starting to appear on the carousel as we entered the collection area so again no great delay and straight out to waiting transport On our return journey early evening departure th May small queue for checkin and baggage drop Plenty of friendly JET staff to assist and pre tag cabin baggage so maybe a minute delay but the queue was inside the building and checkin desks open Security again was very quick with only about people in front of us whilst I wouldnt say the security staff were unfriendly they were perhaps best described as efficient Then into the departure lounge with more than enough seating for all the waiting passengers from various flights with a variety of shops and food and drink establishments available Again passport control to gates was fast and friendly with no great delay and even at the gates there was food and drink available which looked very appetising Flight boarded quickly and departed about minutes behind schedule It has to be said that since the completion of the refurbishment of this airport the experience is vastly improved The toiletswashrooms are no longer an area to be feared and requiring a bio hazard suit to use The whole airport is clean and bright with sufficent staff on hand There is also a greater choice of food and drinks available So a really pleasant and relaxing experience flying into and out of Corfu compared with previous occasions

We had to return early from a holiday in Dubai and it was considerably cheaper to fly from Sharjah than from Dubai Sharjah is a relatively small airport but has a reasonable duty free area a food court with a number of very reasonably priced outlets and very friendly staff It was very clean and staff were constantly and vigilantly cleaning the public areas Unfortunately the check in desk for Pegasus was very slow and boarding was slow as well Nevertheless a stress free experience Would definitely use Sharjah again
The airport staff was helpful polite and respectful There was a metro which helped me move around quickly Schedule boards everywhere Nice restaurants and coffee shops Not crowded at all

Flight from Rome to Turin the plane was old but very clean the hostesses were all very friendly Its better than other low cost airlines because they let you bring both a trolley and a small handbag in the cabin while on other low cost such as Ryanair that isnt allowed

I have read many negative reviews about this airline so I was not disappointed There was absolutely no service no water was offered no entertainment seats were standard but could not be reclined Checkin was efficient as well as boarding and the most positive point was that the plane left and arrived on time Given the price it was a reasonable option
Comfortable enough flight which was fairly on time We were surprised that there was no catering on this flight of about hours Only took hand baggage

Best staff ever Great little airline We did flights in all every one on time Staff super friendly and helpful We connected in Belize and got through immigration much faster than expected They put us on an earlier flight and even called our hotel to pick us up early Excellent service Planes are small propeller type so no real in flight service or drinks etc also note no toilets on board Flight from Cancun took an hour and a half so worth keeping in mind They use the private FBO terminal in Cancun airport so make sure your taxi knows that when going to the airport All in all super friendly everything was on time these are small planes but all were smooth even through dark clouds Very well organised ground staff a pleasant change from flying through big terminals on big airlines

Apart from the fact that the crew at Incheon were a little rude everything was perfect For a low cost airline the seats were very comfy and the legroom was amazing I would definitely recommend this airline

Duesseldorf Timisoara return This airline has been a pleasant surprise The Saab was comfortable seats very good and legspace excellent Food on board was among the best Ive seen The return from Timisoara was operated by an Air Nostrum CRJ Checkin counter at Timisoara opened only minutes before scheduled departure but checkin smooth Cabin crew was Carpatair staff and they deserve a compliment On both flights they were friendly helpful and competent
Amazing from beginning to end Amazing service food and cabin The variety and the quality of the food is mind blowing The service was spot on and attentive The seat was comfortable and private

Forgot my mask and expected to be greeted with a negativecold attitude but it was quite the opposite The attendant was quick to help me get my bag tags helping me use the kiosk most efficiently and a cloth mask Each attendant I came across from the ticket counterTSA securitygate were very friendly Thank you for starting my travel so well

I have used it many times New Esenboga Airport is excellent Comfortable clean helpful staff Duty free is small but can find everything During the evening times its very busy for domestic arrivals nearly flights land in minutes International arrivals are also fair enough Great airport
Loved this airport was friendly decor like someone said is s hawaiian Very comfy armchairs only thing missing was a bar Car hire easy to find and Hilo just down the road

Berlin Tegel is a very unique airport both is positive and negative ways After arriving at Berlin Tegel and disembarking the aircraft we had to queue up on the jetbridge as the customs checkpoint was right after the jetbridge A very interesting concept Right after that was a small baggage carousel then out of the departures area This meant that there was basically no departures area We had to wait quite some time for our baggage When we returned to to the airport our checkin process was pretty smooth and the lounge was easily accessible There was a huge observation deck which spanned the roof of a terminal offering beautiful views of the runway and tarmac a good place to spend the time However you have to go through a small security check and buy a ticket before entering Every two gates had its own departure area with seats and its own security checkpoint This meant snaking queues into the public area each time a flight was boarding and it was hard to walk around with baggage because there was little space Inside the tiny departures area there was insufficient seating and insufficient space for the boarding queue Everyone was squeezed at the gate and there was absolutely no order or anything No queues set up
Tried Premium Economy class and I was surprised about the seat quality and onboard meals This class also included amenity kit which I appreciate Cabin crew nicely handle my yo child

I read some scary reviews here which made me leave for the airport more than hours before my flight But after a very good journey on the excellent Aeroexpress train I have nothing to report DME is no Changi for sure but it is a completely average airport No big queues and from checkin to lounge it took me minutes max The bulk of it spent with a slow passport officer who did not speak English and was confused by my dual nationality and me living on a third country But the rest of the security measures XRAY of all luggages on entry second check of boarding pass and passport are on pair with other specially Asian airports Granted this is a Sunday afternoon so things could get busier during the week But this is it just an adequate airport Not one of the modern Shopping Centers you find these days but just a regular place to wait for your next flight Maybe the view from the lounge is different but I learned long ago to not leave home without my Priority Pass Contrary to some of the reviews here the airport does offer wifi and it does accept any international number Maybe this is one of the benefits of traveling after the WC

Departed from Bangalore to London on BA from the new T in Bangalore Terminal is clean fresh and very green There is a green wall and several waterfalls Not what I had been expecting in India Both security and immigration very efficient and egates used to enter the airport Admittedly it was am when I entered the airport and therefore very quiet Not all the concessions airside are open yet but many are Choice of several places to eat and a decent duty free area Most pleasantly surprised

Naha airport has undergone some renovation and expansion it keeps improving each time I go there Being a small airport arrival is easy and luggage waiting time is not too long customs are also friendly and easy to pass through There is a major improvement in checkin areas for international flights and some domestic Used to be in a cramped little area now its a lot more spacious There is also a big improvement in food offering before immigration Once passed international immigration you will be left with very little choice I believe they are still undergoing some major facelifts for the departure gate areas maybe more stores will be added soon Overall this is a charming little regional airport which is easy to move around

A small airport with all the benefits of that short distances quick security not too crowded Its also quite quick to get into the city Limited flights compared to Belfast International or Dublin but when I have the option Id choose this over the others The business lounge is also very well maintained and spacious plus good food and drink options

It is one of the best airports in the world An absolute architectural beauty The facilities at the airport are top class There are variety of shops at the duty free The security and cleanliness of the airport is mindblowing

Went to OVD on a day trip from BCN in mid June to visit family in nearby Castrillon I seen the airport evolve for the last thirty years into a very nice compact and efficient operation Everything is laid out in a logical sequence You arrive into a small checkin area as there are still less than a half dozen or so carriers that use it go through a quick and orderly screening area and up to the gates There are various shops to include a regional Asturias gift shop stores transportation outlets and the such Public areas are clean and not crowded by any means There is the typical cafe with lots of room and reasonable pricing We found taxis right outside the terminal along with two bays for ALSA busses running to both Oviedo and Gijon Be advised that the trip to the provincial cities of Oviedo Gijon and Aviles all take about a half hour or so to get to All in all a very nice userfriendly airport

Dhaka to Coxs Baza Booked a discounted ticket more than a month ago Didnt expect too much Just on time departure arrival Thats what I got Boarding luggage handling was smooth Cabin crew wasnt exactly cordial but professional enough It was a min ride but the captain was able to make it bumpy despite clear weather Cheese sandwich cake was good enough for a shorts haul flight like this but as expected no IFE Aircraft was manufactured in so common for local Bangladeshi carriers But the seats were good pitch even for a Dutch national who flew alongside me was well over Hope for a similar experience with Regent next time

Porto to Paris Orly on ZI A on March First time on this airline and Im a little bit unimpressed with checkin at Porto Airport No effort to direct passengers to correct boarding desks hence I ended up in the webcheck inbagdrop queue with passengers who had not even checked in online Thankfully queue was processed within minutes and got to the gate with plenty of time to spare My seat was next to the emergency exit so I had plenty of legroom Seat itself was comfy and perfect for a nap Crew extremely professional and always had a smile on their faces Flight took off on time and landed smoothly in ParisOrly minutes ahead of scheduled arrival time Once on the ground we were told by the cabin crew that the captain of this Aigle Azur flight had piloted his last flight so we promptly congratulated him as we departed the aircraft All in all Aigle Azur was worth the money that I paid Not sure if Ill have another chance to travel on them again but if they have routes that I want to fly Ill keep them in mind

Much better than it used to be they seem to have clamped down on the baggage handlers and general hangers on trying to extract dollars from you on the way in On the way out no real problems aside from a few panhandllers trying to take a last opportunity to rip you off Dont miss the duty free shop it looks awful from the outside but is really well stocked and cheap

Positive departure experience at Seville airport on Oct for a domestic flight After reading previous reviews I was wary of flying out of this airport but our experience was perfectly good Before the security checkpoint we found a pleasant caf for lunch Going through security was quick and easy Restrooms were clean and a cleaning person was busy at work keeping them so A push button rating system for the condition of the restroom was outside the door so perhaps Aena has received the message from prior reviews and is trying to do better No complaints at all about this airport

First time in Jordan we had to change the airplane at Amman airport The experience at the security check was not a good one The staff was rude to the customers and not very professional although we were friendly and everything was ok with our hand luggage We spent a few hours in the BusinessLounge and enjoyed the food and the comfortable atmosphere

Minsk Airport was recently renovated and even though the layout may be outdated it looks brand new The airport is easy to get around and there are plenty of signs and directions for the passengers I did not experience any queues at all neither at checkin nor with the security and passport control it was all very quick and professional The terminal is extremely clean just like the city is which is almost surreal at times given that it is the place where thousands of people pass through every single day Food and shopping options seem standard for the airport of this size there is a dutyfree shop a souvenir shop fast food restaurant and a few cafeterias The only problem is that I havent seen any money exchange offices Airport staff are very professional and efficient When it comes to wifi there is a minute free connection however one can buy a very cheap wifi service for several days which also works in the city The main downside of the airport is the fact that it is so far away from the city and that there are no low cost options

VKOAER Overall pleasantly surprised by the product Online checkin via Aeroflots website was quick and efficient Vnukovo airport is clean spacious and comfortable with lots of Rossiyas checkin counters and assistance desks The aircraft was new and clean although legroom was a bit tight seats themselves were very comfortable Cabin crew were quick efficient and friendly Free food included a nice sandwich tea coffee juices and Coke You could also purchase a nice craft beer with snacks Overall a very pleasant experience for a middle discountsector airline

Checkin security check an immigration at Xiamen Airport swift although not very friendly Contract lounge large with decent FB choices Boarding for both flights well organized Both flights with good FB offerings and service and on time IFE very good The big letdown was again the lack of frequent flyer points for members of other One lWorld airlines besides Asia Miles There was not even a fare bookable in economy which attracts frequent flyer points I fly frequently within the OneWord alliance and no other carrier has this practice I will therefore stick to the other members of Oneworld in the future

Travelled late July Arriving from Edinburgh late afternoon found the airport quiet Standing at the back of a long line for passport control I thought we could in for a long wait But they virtually waved the entire plane load through in around minutes By which time the luggage had already arrived So we were out of the airport within minutes Ive never known anything like it On the way back there were several flights delayed due to a storm However everything still worked well for our flight and we departed on time Not a big airport but I was happy with my time there

Lovely airport and great shops for an airport of this size Paying a the counter for taxis removes the touts that descend on you in other places Food options are limited but then who would want to spend too long checking in too early and getting hungry when on such a lovely island

Dhaka to Singapore Good food good seating and comparatively better ground services at Dhaka Staff on board are just okay though My travel ticket price was high though Worst inflight entertainment service

I took GOL twice for domestic flights during a recent trip to Brazil I chose the extra legroom seats which were available for a reasonable surcharge and offered plenty of legroom Overall the flights were comfortable and on time All passengers were offered a small snack and a drink I would choose GOL again
Wonderful crew on this very short flight The aircraft comfort better than the ATR which is the main BW commuter No service on this minute hop but all in all great value and on time

Recently flew throughout Myanmar on the following routes YangonMandalayHehoMandalayNyaung U BaganHehoThandweYangon on their Fokker and ATR aircraft Checkin interesting as there are no computers and everything is weighed manually Ground crew cordial but not overly friendly Flight crews were friendly and always helpful Catering is good for the short flights with croissants and drinks being offered on even the shortest of flights unthinkable in Europe Aircrafts were always spotless and comfortable

This airport is passable if youre the passenger Have been through many times Problem is if you are waiting for someone to arrive No seats anywhere Pricy food choices super high taxi prices It is clean though

Modern and easy to use No queues to speak of Firefly the main user are efficient and a cheaper alternative to flying Malaysian out of KLIA However beware transfer times from downtown KL especially during morning and evening peak times even more so on MondaysFridays Although nearer to the city centre than KLIA it can and did in my case take longer to get to Subang mins than it would have taken to get to KLIA

Small but very clean airport disembarking to exiting airport mins minimal duty free shops on arrival but more extensive on departure area Very security conscious on entry and exit All in all a walk in the park no hassle

Considering that Mykonos is a small hilly island this little airport does well It is small so transit through from disembarkation to exit is really quick and not far to walk Arrived on connecting flight from Athens on Aegean at am Bags were out in around minutes Return flight back to Athens a week later Afternoon flight so busier as flights departing together Check in was busy big queues but efficient check in staff Small coffee sandwich counter and gift shop airside and small duty free shop toilet facilities and snack bar with hot drinks once passed passport control and security Its not the Business Lounge at Changi but it does the job for the short time people are there Good job

We chose Eastar Jet because of its reasonable price for the round trip from Seoul Gimpo to Jeju First we made booking for pax name of one of us is lack one word so we submitted to correct Immediately I received a call from Seoul to let me know how to change and remind me via email On the day of flight theres a storm in Jeju so we hardly to landed We were afraid that we have to flight back to Seoul luckily we landed safe after few trial times On the return way days later at the airport we were informed that the flight was cancelled due to the storm But Eastar Jet told us that they would find another airline for us then we had tickets of Jin Air then boarding without any problem We were satisfied of services and staff of Eastar Jet from booking until last minute Thanks Eastar Jet for making our trip more memorable and happy

Flew Stockholm to Tehran with Iran Air I had good flight with the new fleet of this airline minute delay but the cabin was new and clean with good seat distance and very tasty food Iranian film and music and route information was provided I recommend flying with Iran Air on international routes because of the nice cabin and good meals for the value of money

I booked return flights from Sydney to Rome via Guangzhou where the airline provides an easy and comfortable option of a free hotel depending on the gap between your next flight The stopover option is incredibly well handled with transport provided to and from your hotel I thoroughly recommend this as Guangzhou has a great easy to use metro system and its very easy to get around The A fleet used are in excellent condition with pleasant staff although meals can be a let down one on my return journey was actually inedible However the real test of a good airline is when things dont go to plan My return flight from Rome was cancelled due to a technical issue after we had boarded the flight We spent hours on board with regular updates provided before the Captain made the decision not to fly Prior to disembarking which involved reentering Italy and collecting our bags lunch was served on board a nice touch Once back in the terminal we were given further meal vouchers and asked to return an hour later On return we were bussed to the nearby Sheraton where all accommodation and meals were covered for hours while the plane was repaired and put back in service These changes left only hours to change to my rescheduled flight from Guangzhou to Sydney however to my delight China Southern provided a hotel option close to the airport allowing for a refreshing stop and rest before the final long leg back to Sydney So sure I arrived on Sunday morning instead of Friday night as planned but the way I was looked after was very good I would certainly recommend China Southern and will fly with them again

MSP Airport does a great job with stores and restaurant options and recently completed some moderate improvements in aesthetics to terminal They currently offer a total of electric parking spots which are spread out across sites It appears the planning team completely overlooked this aspect of the customer experience

Los Angeles to Cusco via Lima We were pleasantly surprised when Lan Airlines delivered our luggage hour from the airport the day after we landed American Airlines in the US didnt tell us sbout collecting our luggage in Lima before flying to Cusco must go through Customs so it never arrived in Cusco Lan Airlines Personnel were very helpful to fill the forms out and to deliver was unexpected Thanks for helping make our trip great

The terminal offers an array of restaurants and shops which gives passengers a well rounded experience The security was smooth and quick with just only a few passengers waiting in line The airport has a very white theme which makes the interior very bright Staff at the airport are generally helpful and able to speak basic to intermediate level of English I had troubles connecting to the WiFi network I asked the airport staffs to help me out because they couldnt figure out the reason of not being able to connect the WiFi All in all Bahrain Airport is one of the nicest airports to travel in addition to Doha and Muscat Airports

Louisville Airport is a great airport very clean and improvements being made all of the time Arrived from Chicago off of the aircraft and by the luggage claim within minutes Local staff are all very helpful and polite as well as being professional For some passengers there were some issues with delayed or lost luggage but the American Eagle ground staff were very professional and sorted out their problems quickly

Ive used within China different airlines Air China Spring Airlines Shenzen Airlines and Kunpeng Airlines Clearly the best one was Kunpeng Airlines Although the flight had a delay of hours bad weather at the airport from which the airplane came information at the airport was good boarding really fast after the airplane arrived Nevertheless it was clean inside and the crew was very friendly As it was a short flight only minutes I expected less or no service onboard Was surprised that they offer a drink and a small meal The airplane itself seems to be a new one

I was pleasantly surprised by Safi on a hop from Dubai to Kabul Yes the aircraft was old and the legroom poor But the flight was on time the staff friendly and the food free excellent A shame there is no chance of a glass of wine A big advantage of Safi is that it operates from the very civilised Dubai Terminal making it ideal for connecting to most of the major carriers except Emirates FlyDubai offers a slightly more comfortable service on the same route but operates from Terminal which is little more than a shed and a very long and tedious bus ride to other terminals

My daughter and myself were at airport this morning waiting for my sister in law coming from London Her flight was delayed we were concerned that maybe she missed her flight We met a lovely young man Philip He was so helpful friendly kind Philip is fantastic with customers Inquiring about flights out of airport Philip was very helpful

Was feeling travel sick after arriving Abu Dhabi airport and while waiting for my next flight Starbucks staff were very helpful and called the medic for me and were very helpful Helped me recover within hour Lovely staff

SAPBZEFRS I had two flights with this regional airline this past month Ssmall grand caravan planes but both clean and spotless flights on time crew friendly Due to the size of the aircraft theres no FA on board Price paid fair I do recommend if youre flying to Belize

Dragonair is part of Cathay Pacific From Hong Kong to Guangzhou is less than miles but they provide an excellent service When on board cabin crew deliver a bottle of water and a cookie The cabin crew are very nice

The island is lovely the residents are lovely The only down side is the poorly trained passport officials pretending to read passports and carry out security checks I have no idea where these people are found they need training or firing

I flew out of Athens on July th with American Airlines and I had requested wheelchair assistance The gentleman who assisted me at the airport Aggelos was absolutely amazing He took great care of me and was extremely respectful and helpful in anyway possible He actual went out of his way and even performed beyond his job responsibilities and provided excellent customer service In my years of travelling I have never experienced such superb customer service He is a very valuable employee who needs to be recognized for his outstanding customer service skills He went above and beyond for a customer I will never forget my positive experience with this Greek fellow
Love Quebecs airport Small but offers all of the facilities in a big airport Not too much people

An airport geared towards business travellers its in excellent condition and has very appealing decor feels like a hotel lounge There is also free WiFi which is welcome There are very few queues are the majority of travellers are going onwards to Heathrow and New York which made for a pleasant change with Transavia than flying through Eindhoven Very clean and security methodical However the food prices are extremely high even by airport standards But otherwise this is an excellent airport the most impressive Ive used

I had to fly from Alicante with a fractured leg The staff and facilities were absolutely amazing Please can you teach Edinburgh Airport how to facilitate and treat disabled passengers Thank you so much Alicante

The airport has a capacity of million passengers a year It has two terminals passenger terminal and cargo It is a nice small airport There is a bar in the waiting lounge and also a restaurant a place where you can buy newspapers At the terminal it also a new Restaourant lot of airline companies has their offices in the airport building including British Airways Adria Austrian Airlines etc You can not sleep in the airport is closed after the last scheduled flight at pm Pristina center is very close as there is a Motel Aviano located km from the airport There is no buss service from airport to the city but the majority of travellers use taxi to get to the town The price is usually euro

Flown HanedaChitose and FukuokaHaneda in the new A Very good seats almost like business class seats Service on board was excellent Drinks and snacks for a small fee about euro for a coffee Will fly with them again when in Japan

My wife and I flew return trips on Druk Air from Kathmandu to Thimpu for a section of our honeymoon There are very limited options to get in and out of Bhutan so I was a bit concerned about the ability to choose exactly what airline and flights we were going to take However it all went really smoothly We were warned beforehand that the flights are often several hours late ours was close to on time We were told that wed see the Himalayas as we flew past including Mt Everest which we did The crew were courteous and helpful and the food surprisingly good for such a small airline The plane was old but appeared to be well looked after There is no inflight entertainment system so bring a booktablet to keep yourself entertained or read the airline magazine which will mainly feature articles about how much the Bhutanese love their King they are crazy over their monarchy If we are ever lucky enough to go back to Bhutan Id be very happy to fly Druk Air again
Tu Moscow St Petersburg Creature comforts not up to modern aircraft standards but superb real experience Food quite good and service good Do it before the Tus become a thing of the past

Return flights to Hobart Generally pleasant flights in both directions The process for checkin and bag drop was smooth Boarding via the rear stairs was orderly if a bit slow The crew were friendly and courteous Baggage collection was quite prompt The seats legroom was a bit tight but OK for a short flight Disembarkation at Melbourne was slowed down by a crew member having their photo taken with friends who were passengers on the flight

My husband and I traveled to Yellowknife for a day The main reason was that we wanted to visit Buffalo Airways Canadian North were fantastic Both services on time and on the way back to Edmonton we were lucky enough to travel on a Combi which was fantastic The crew on the way home made us feel so welcome They were efficient and very pleasant Great breakfast on the way up and a good dinner on the way back If only they were a bit closer to our home in Australia We would be more than happy to travel with Canadian North any time A great experience

Boarding an A was a unique experience and you will enjoy a pleasant flight thanks to the spaciousness and comfort The cabin crew were admirable and friendly the food was good and delicious Highly recommended

Very clean aircraft The cabin crew were very attentive and nice Seat pitch was good aircraft cleanliness was OK but could use improvement The inflight meals were sufficient for a one hour flight I was served a chicken sandwich The presentation of the food was good and it also tasted nice as well Overall I would recommend this airline to anyone who is trying to visit Myanmar for a cheap price

HELMUC on tired MD Took the Internet upgrade opportunity for to Premium Economy Worth it on ground service Quick checkin Fast Track at Security as Economy Pax had a long queue for both The SAS Lounge in Helsinki very basic Cabin crew friendly nice breakfast However no English newspapers available and no comments at all to the flight from the cockpit The price for the upgrade is ok as I had rows for me alone in contrary to the Economy cabin which was full Otherwise you are flying Low Cost with a high economy fare

Montgomery Regional Airport Dannelly Field has been completely modernized and is one of the most attractive small airports in the US Checkin in close to the curb and security is efficient Food and drink groundside and airside is basic Deplaning is easy and baggage claim is close to the street Parking is reasonably convenient unless you are travelling mid week It can be a longish walk to the terminal

SINRDN Return A new ATR with two flight attendants For a hr flight a packed towel plus a bottle of water was given out Although the attendants werent very enthusiastic the crew members in the flight deck kept us up to date with information

JAL economy class is outstanding The seats are the widest in the business if a bit hard and the food was healthy and tasty Flight attendants were polite and attentive My only complaint is that the offerings on the inflight entertainment service were subpar it was hard to find a movie that rose above mediocre

SZBRDNSZB Return trip from Subang Skypark secondary airport in KL to Redang Island ATR looked in good condition could not have been very old minute flight a bottle of water and a refresher towel offered service punctual and friendly both flights on time A small airline but felt very safe flying with them

I never thought I would find myself reviewing a TSA department but I felt compelled to after my recent positive experience My family and I were unexpectedly transiting through Newark on June We had several mishaps happen beyond our control after an extended travel day hours The TSA department at Newark airport in particular a man named Fontaine helped greatly alleviate our stress and help expedite us through the security line and airport correcting the mistakes of our airline workers I cannot begin to tell you how appreciative I am for their help empathy and services

I flew from Marseille to Ajaccio Overall I was satisfied The outbound leg was carried out with an ageing but very well kept ATR and the return with a recent A Both flights were on time and the crew was polite and smiling Given the short duration of the flights both around minutes the inflight service consisted solely of drinks but thats fine The basic fare always includes a checked in luggage and the price was correct I spent euros return to fly on midJuly booking just weeks prior to departure The only minus was the long waiting time to collect the luggage at AJA minutes despite having just aircrafts to unload but I dont blame it on Air Corsica

Expensive transfers to airport The airport itself has decent facilities plenty of toilets seats and wifi is adequate Security wait times have improved from disaster of Be prepared to wait in long lines on arrival at immigration There are no egates and seems short staffed especially at night Overall the airport is OK but has areas of improvement

I love Air North and use them whenever its convenient between Kelowna and Vancouver Very reasonable fares which includes two checked bags and advance seat selection for Always on time friendly staff and I love the vintage s Its like what flying was like decades ago much nicer and more relaxed

We had a great flight with French Bee from Paris back to NYC We booked late for our first ever Europe trip so we didnt want to buy expensive tickets We took a risk going with French Bee since its cheap about one way We were nervous seeing all the bad reviews especially with cancellations Turned out to be an awesome experience on time good foods no turbulence

Barcelona BLA to Caracas CCS in Venezuela on a classic Boeing aircraft I experienced Conviasa to be quite nice to fly with Anyhow they do not offer much more than the average European nofrills carriers A costfree nonalcoholic drink was served on that short domestic flight the aircraft was clean and fine despite its age we departed BLA about minutes ahead schedule not every airline in Venezuela manages that Since the ticket costed me less than EUR I can call it a quite satisfying experience

A nicely laidout airy and spacious airport with excellent facilities and courteous staff a proper Estonian showpiece With TLL only km from the city centre taxi fares are very reasonable Security was efficient and from a UK perspective refreshingly unofficious

The airport is new and clean however it is already overstretched For departures there are only a couple of snack bars and small shops in the departure area and for an international departure theres only one cafe Although your plane may be parked at a jetbridge you may not board from the jetbridge but rather have to go outside and use stairs Alternatively you may board at gate but then walk in the arrival corridor to the jetbridge at gate Check in and security were easy and fast At arrivals the tourist information office was closed There is no area for rental car return you will have to go in to the building to tell them you have returned Signage on the roads to the airport is not very good and it is tricky to reach the airport from any direction other than downtown There is construction at the airport entrance and perhaps that will address this issue The airport makes a good arrival spot for the Eje Cafetero Arriving with Easy Fly our bags arrived almost instantly

Often use these airport as it is my local Very small and very nice Celebrating its th year of commercial services this year Restaurant is conveniently placed close to checkins and staff are young and very helpful Everything is very smooth and thanks to its small nature very quick to get from checkin through security and to the gate No long lines However if a normal Ryanair on a flight is boarding for London usually the waiting area becomes extremely busy with no seats left forcing people to sit on ground and on windowsills Toilets are also not exactly very clean but still at standard Overall excellent airport

I arrived early for checkin at GIG Staff arrived just under hours before departure but then spent the better part of half an hour getting ready Once opened checkin was a breeze No line at security or immigration as this is the first international flight departing Rio Priority checkin for business class so I boarded as one of the first people Clean cabin but recliner seats with rather limited recline The really bad part was that the neck rest was at shoulder height so the seat was rather uncomfortable The flight attendant spoke Spanish and offered a drink Later breakfast was served omelette and croissant Omelette was good and included half a slice of ham Croissant had no resemblance to any croissant I have had before Portions generally too small Arrival in Peru without any waiting time at Immigration or Customs Bags were amongst the first to hit the carrousel Checkin was easy as I had to go to a special line to pay the change fee No queue at neither immigration or security Access to Sumaq lounge which is so so Once again priority boarding and a clean plane The seats were older in this aircraft and very hard old school recliner seats Much better male attendant who spoke excellent English Drinks just after boarding and dinner Choices were fish or lasagne I opted for the fish which was a nice tilapia with rice Again very small portion Despite a pm departure time I got little sleep due to the poor seat Reached Rio on time and no lines anywhere as this is the first international flight to land in Rio Bags were among the last to hit to carrousel which once again shows that regardless of airline the priority tags are largely decorative Overall an ok experience To be honest I would probably not book TACA if alternatives were available

Recently travelled with a broken ankle The staff were very helpful getting me on and off the plane The special waiting area was a nice touch because I was scared of getting knocked by other passengers

Hobart Airport is much more user friendly now though the terminals have not been connected so Jetstar passengers are still relegated to the old botched international venture built for the old Ansett The new catering in domestic is good but It is shameful that there is no WiFi intenet access anywhere It would cost a few hundred dollars at the most for the Tasmanian Government to give free WiFi access at Hobart Airport and so reinforce the image it is trying to give as a progressive State It is doubtful that a private company will ever do it and Tasmania would top all the other states in lateral thinking if it did it for free

It was my first time at this small and beautiful airport Very wellmaintained and nicely decorated airport The downtown and hotel areas are not too far Staffs were friendly Outside of the airport is also environment friendly and green

I recently flew from PHL to DCA on American Eagle operated by Republic Airways and had a fantastic experience The flight crew was attentive and professional ensuring everything ran smoothly from boarding to landing The aircraft was clean and comfortable and the service was prompt despite the short flight duration The pilot provided clear updates and the entire trip was seamless A great example of efficient and excellent regional service

Odessa to Kiev return Plane a rather old Boeing but for such short trips under hour is not a problem I was surprised to see that they offered sandwiches on both flights together with tea coffee and juices

I have flown several legs with Qantaslink over the past months The Q has a more comfortable seat than the new seats in Qantas Boeing and soon to be Airbus s apart from their newest aircraft VHA which has seats so hard that a wooden bench would be more comfortable Ground Service Im pretty disappointed that you cant select your seats until hour before you leave for us less desired Red FF or no FF customers and all the seats up the front are blocked off for Qantas preferred customers Baggage drop and collection has been efficient on all flights where I have checked my luggage On board cabin crew do their jobs and the pilots are friendly Most delayed departures have ended in on time or early arrivals Food they may as not bother I dont consider tiny cent sized corn chips with some sauces a meal or even a snack I think Qantas and Qantaslink need to do alot better here One bonus is that unlike Rex you can purchase a lounge pass with your flight to allow you to relax have some food or drinks and get away from the crowds before our flights out of capital cities Lounge passes unless youre a Qantas Club member or Gold FF and higher cost Boarding disembarking When they dont use those ramps which are great for people with mobility issues disembarking is pretty efficient but when the ramps are used it can take up to minutes for them to put the ramp onto the aircraft The buses that take passengers to and from remore stands are a safety hazard if you have mobility or balance issues then sit in a seat as the drivers seem to be very heavy on the brakes

Small but efficient little island airport Quite possibly the cleanest terminal building Ive ever been in a small team of cleaners were walking around constantly dusting vacuuming polishing and looking for any litter the whole time we were there No fuss no overly loud announcements friendly staff obvious sign posting and a nice selection of shops which had very reasonable prices and unobtrusive sales assistants who didnt attempt to force anyone into buying things I really like this airport a lot the only thing Id mention is that try to remember its a tropical island so be careful where you leave your bags While waiting outside for the shuttle bus to take us to our rental car centre I saw a huge spider the size of the palm of my hand scurry into someones luggage Probably not the best start to that persons vacation but thankfully we managed to arrive and depart without any extra passengers with us

A supposedly international city airport and in the huge transit area the managers dont even manage to install a few water fountains for cool refreshing water for tired and thirsty travellers especially those with children What an appalling omission It is a shame really as in most other respects the airport is very pleasant

DohaCasablancaGambia on th Jan QR could not issue Boarding Passes though having issued ticket Eventually I got BPs printed out quickly while boarding in Doha Embarked after being bussed around in Doha airport Aircraft was a newer Dreamliner B filled to last seat Was in the middle of a midsection in the back surrounded by passengers all over However the seats are spacious and can recline cm I felt comfortable and slept quite well Food was served on large trays and main course was very delicious spicy seafood with plenty of support like heavy salad desert cheese and chocolate I could choose my favourite meal despite being on of the last being served Got an extra portion on request On this hour night flight the two meal rounds were valued and sufficed Drinks plenty including Moroccan wines and beers Staff are Moroccan males are professional hardworking focused and pragmatic They may appear being blunt but on firm requests they act well They relocate seats up to last Minute and beyond to accommodate passengers wishes allowing couples and families to sit together Amenity kit hearsets pillows blankets provided to all IFA promised a lot with big screens and options However it was not working properly for approx half of the cabin it froze again and again or ran into endless loops In Casablanca RAM kept their announced promises of providing a smooth STPC hotel meals and transport for longhours transit passenger Passed immigration without hurdles I was put up in the fine star Zenith hotel and got two meals within a hours stay Back to airport accessed the RAMs Zenith Lounge which is spacious fine sufficient catering and tarmac views in two floors Upper floor has a manned bar while the lower have barista and meal catering Lively and exotic a surprisingly good lounge including local wines of fair quality Last leg Casablanca to Banjul on a B was also a pleasure Wide spaced seats I was given my preselected exit seat without charges Good hot meal provided with three options FAs were professional all males Catered well for appreciated their seafood and wines Recall this is only a hours flight with an impressive fully serviced catering with drinkrounds Generous airline providing at least x kg luggage allowance for everyone Luggages arrived quickly and in good condition at final destination Only minor spots IFE unreliability and busgating in DOH and CMN These are easily outweighed by other perks the airline provides Ticket not expensive First time with RAM pleasantly surprised cant really fault them fully recommended

I have been through Abidjan a few times and whilst I was impressed on my first visit progressive improvements since then mean that it is definitely the best airport I have been to in Africa There is now decent and free wifi in the departures area a comfortable new cafe and the information boards are clear

Modest airport staffed by cheerful smiling people typical Malawian experience Took about mins to get through immigration and another mins to reclaim bags Most peoples bags are opened at customs for a cursory examination On the way out check in was a bit Heath Robinson systems were down and bagsboarding passes manually processed Only downside was the check in agent tagged my bag through to LHR using a handwritten tag and told me unconvincingly it would be fine Just as well that I took the precaution of checking at Johannesburg as the bag came out on the belt and I had to check it in again Overall a satisfactory experience
TSA worker screaming at everyone She removed purse shoes and jacket from the bin where I was told to place them She threw each item on the belt individually Never stopped hollering

Warsaw to Tallinn Our flight was in codeshare with LOT Polish Airlines Between our arrival and departure there were minutes gate opens mins before departure the ground crew worked very well so we could catch our Nordica flight to Tallinn with ease The seats are comfortable the legroom is more than okay Bigger meals and drinks are available on purchase but they serve complementary drinks coffee tea water and snacks chocolate bar The cabin crew was kind and the cabin was clean

Travelled last month from Subang to Penang Flight was great Flight attendants were friendly and welcoming No in flight entertainment but there were magazines Only serve Peanuts fresh baked bread a mineral water and a wet towel for each passenger Baggage allowance was also ok as the limit was Kg Price was also cheap as I only paid RM for a one way flight One my return flight to Subang there were only passengers and the flight still continued even thought not even of the plane was full I would recommend the Airline to people who want to travel in Malaysia

A nice airport and frankly I am surprised at the bad reviews I arrived there at approx hrs Entry and checkin were very easy Security was straight forward and immigration was very easy Once on the airside a restaurant was open as were the dutyfree shops The only downside were the grumpy staff of the shops who obviously had not woken up yet Announcements were clear and boarding was orderly and we took off on time

I expected the worst but to my surprise its one of the smoothest flight I have ever hard Everything was good other than the seats that needs a mattress to make them comfortable for sleeping The staff were good I will fly it anytime I prioritise feeling safe

My husband suffers with neuropathy and towards the end of our holiday his feet were very painful which made walking difficult I did not arrange assistance at the airport and was concerned he was unable to do all the walking at the airport and worse still the amount of walking at Heathrow I enquired at the help desk and explained my predicament The staff were amazing and not only arranged assistance at Gibraltar but also contacted Heathrow on our behalf I cannot thank them enough for making our Journey an amazing experience at both airports which would have been a nightmare their kindness was was very much appreciated and I cannot thank them enough

Efficient frequent bus service from St Helier is a good way to get to the airport but once there it goes downhill The first security check boarding pass is quick and easy but wouldnt necessarily say friendly The next bags etc despite belts in operation and at least staff members that I could see the queue to pass through the scanner took minutes even though I was number in queue Some of the staff must be either very new or unable to cope with what I would say not unusual circumstances such as wheelchairs passengers arriving Even after that wait selected for random screening dont mind too much though as best to be safe but the biggest bug bear the public one and only bar had sullen staff looking like theyd rather be somewhere else wouldnt we all then for strange reason their bosses have decided to stop selling their best selling drink Carling Lager and replaced it with San Miguel at approx p more per pint probably suggesting this was a more in drink If a nice tasting lager it may be but I certainly wont be racing to that bar again somewhere enjoyed a pre departure drink many a time These airport bar bosses may think theyre making more money by selling the more expensive drink but I know many who will do exactly the same as me and bypass that bar once theyve realised this ridiculous change

I was surprised with the cleanliness and efficiency of the airport in Guayaquil Really modern and easy to navigate I liked the zen garden at the domestic arrivals which really was a nice touch Toilets were clean Passport control very organised and staff are polite also duty free staff were very helpful Nice WiFi and view of the runway watching planes goes by Happy using it

Richmond is a medium size airport that has recently been extensively renovated My experience flying in and out was very pleasant RIC is a human sized airport so it is easy to get around Baggage recovery was fast and painless with our checked bags appearing only about five minutes after we had arrived at the carousel The rental car desks are conveniently sited and the rental car garage is a two minute walk from the terminal Our total time from landing to driving off in a rental car was less than thirty minutes The airport is well connected to the adjacent Interstate highway so the airport is easy to get into and out of On departure checkin and security was quick and painless There is a restaurant in the secure area offering a view of the ramp a pleasant thing for the travelling aircraft buff Overall I was very impressed with Richmond airport and would use it again anytime

Hua Hin airport offers a direct connection to the resort city of Hua Hin and the surrounding towns of Prachuap and Cha Am and saves the visitor the relative hassle of a and half hour bus ride from BKK airport and a similar time from DMK Don Meuang Bangkoks other airport Especially if you are coming from Malaysia The only airline currently operating a service into Hua Hin is Air Asia God bless them from Kuala Lumpur to Hua Hin The route has been a success and rumour has it that other routes will open up from Hua Hin ideally Chiang Mai to begin with OK to the airport review Its a relatively simple regional airport With checkin counters a small snack counter and adequate seating in the checkin area You go upstairs by escalator to passport control security and then the departure lounge again with adequate seating and a bathroom There is plenty of car parking by the airport and about metres out of the main gate is a Family Mart like a which sells snacks To get in to Hua Hin you can catch a taxi or walk out the gate and catch a Green songtao baht to town then another baht if going on in the direction of Market Village and Khao Takiab One of the pleasures of using the Air Asia service is that as the plane pulls away from the terminal building the ground staff wave you goodbye Thai gesture of respect its a nice touch Anyway many thanks to Hua Hin airport and Air Asia for making this route a reality

I use this little airport for flights between northern England and SE Asia via AMS on KLM I find it a very convenient feeder airport to the AMS hub and the small size of the terminal ensures that arrivals are swift and painless Im on the road within mins of hitting the tarmac in most cases Staff are generally friendly and helpful By contrast nearby NCL which used to be very quick and efficient is much more hassle with some of the most miserable ground staff in Europe

Milan to Male Nice airline Very good in all services Economy class is a very good class Beverages are very good too with a lot of product On my flight services were snack lunch and a afternoon snack with a slice of pizza If you need something else you can ask to steward that will help you in every moment Staff is very kind and happy Good airline

Hong Kong to Beijing with Cathay Dragon My seat was at the middle of the aircraft One meal was served and the total flight time was about hours The meal service was good The crew were friendly and nice Nevertheless the inflight entertainment system was not quite updated and the legroom of the economy class seat was not quite enough The area of the restrooms could also be improved In total it was enjoyable flight
Excellent except that the parking is free and hence clogged We landed taxied to within years of the terminal walked straight through the door to baggage arrivals and within minutes were in the car
Great Airport used it for a Ryanair flight to Stansted Small highly efficient great bar restaurant and shops A breeze to get through am going to use again Wish they were all like this

BDL is my hometown airport I found plenty of kiosks for checkin at US Airways and went through security quickly On the airside at US Airways gates very limited options in terms of stores and restaurants and the good shopsrestaurants are at the other side of the terminal Upon return finding luggage is easy and the pickup for valet lots is fast the amenities are limited but the airport is streamlined and easy to use I prefer BDL plus connection to a direct flight from BOS or JFK anytime

I fly into and out of Albany a few times a year on business For my money its one of the most efficient airports in terms of securityTSA in the country They get you in out and on your way with very little hassle the way it should be The airport itself isnt huge and doesnt have some of the amenities of a larger hub but as a traveller Im looking for efficiency and thats what Albany Airport provides

Singapore to Davao Pretty decent flight with a very well organized crew Happy to serve and with a smile from crew members The style of the seats is a bit old fashioned color of the seats There is no entertainment on the plane but you can connect to the WiFi and get the movies on your device but only if you have the SilkAir app Silk air should let us know in advance before you get a h flight

Im a native Sudanese born and raised in Sudan who travels a lot around the World Whenever I visit my beloved Sudan I always feel sad twice The first time is when I arrive at KRT Arrival Terminal This terminal was opened in It was as it is now small with two halls handling maximum of two airplanes at any time But it was nice clean artfully designed and the staff members seemed to be happy working there Unfortunately since then nothing has changed improved or fixed as in some cases and its been getting worse and worse every time I see it The second time I feel sad is when I leave Sudan Not only because Im leaving home but because of the waiting battle at KRT Departure Terminal where bureaucracy is at its highest level This terminal was born more than sixty years ago and never raised Its still small and always seemed very crowded even with one airplane passengers You always have to have extra money with you for the unannounced new fees or stamps Sudan has just signed a peace accord ending more than years of civil war in the South The oil money has started fueling the economy and a new state of art airport is being planned in the east side of the River Nile in Omdurman Hopefully this new airport will be opened soon Theres more than ten millions Sudanese who leave outside Sudan And always willing to visit their family no matter what sometimes twice a year The great generous and passionate people of Sudan deserve much more than what they have now

The Algiers airport terminal was not so good because they dont have many shops or restaurants the toilet was not clean and design of the building was not good But the new Algiers airport terminal was so big with a modern design and the second name of this terminal is the door of Africa that means it connects Africa with the world terminal has so many shops or restaurants and it was comfortable in the vip lounge

Addis Ababa to Sanaa Flight leaves Addis early morning but requested to be at airport two hours before departure making this hmin flight an allnighter Boarding called way too early leaving pax waiting almost an hour at gate before doors opened Old A Economy seats xx config had exit row so okay for space In spite of hand luggage limits several pax carrying huge bundles cramming the overhead bins Bit of commotion as some pax were not allocated desired seats took a while to sort Meal served but didnt eat as trying to catch some sleep Lights left on throughout flight Seats standard economy not too clean though and interior showed serious signs of wear

Excellent flight great room and staff were excellent Little English is spoken I had originally booked Hainan but they cancelled initial booking and booked me to Capital Very limited entertainment and glad I had a book

Spent a few hours at Saskatoon Airport for a layover Comfortable seating and general overall layout Decent selection of food and drink for a smaller airport I enjoyed the interactive flight map Friendly and helpful staff Loved the amount of window space Nice airport

When we arrived at Luxor airport got off the coach all I can say was what appeared like a pack of wolves were waiting to help with bags Now Im a ft stone bloke so am well capable but even despite this I ended up almost having to wrestle my bag away from a very eager helper who all the time was whispering under his breath drink please interspersed with something It appeared as if there was a supervisor or someone that they didnt want to hear their requests if so they were spectacularly unsuccessful in stamping out this sort of overaggressive help Having managed to wrestle free of the initial wave of helpers get inside the building once again there was another helper to lift bags onto the xray belt This time however as he didnt have any English phrases apparently the helper was saying something in Egyptian again whispering while showing me an Egyptian Pound note folded in the palm of his hand as a prompt Having now managed to get through these levels of assistance there was of course another helper at the other end of the xray machine who was equally helpful in taking the bag off the belt similarly looking for money Next up was the checkin desk itself yes you have guessed it there was yet another helper at the head of the queue to again lift the bag onto the checkin conveyor There is a sign on display at the desk stating that all baggage assistance was free of charge but this was clearly not having any effect on the various helpers that have to be negotiatedovercome Finally naturally there is the customary help in the toilets where even though I am at yrs of age well capable of washing drying my hands I was presented with some toilet paper with the by now customary demand for money All in all never again

Its development in the last years is rather impressive More than one million passengers now use this airport each year for a regional airport this is rather much I think I like she short distances the easy and quick checkin services the nice environment and the very close parking facilities I you arrive at this airport you have to wait never longer than min for the luggage delivery

Paris to San Francisco Read the reviews after purchasing my ticket and was quite worried Ive flown to Europe multiple times on multiple airlines and this flight was just the same as all the other airlines Economy seats are the same size as UnitedDelta Our flight was several hundred dollars cheaper per person than any other alternative Yes boarding is a bit chaotic and unorganized but that was not that big of a deal to me Yes there are no screens on the seats however they offer free WiFi with access to their entertainment on your own device that includes movies tv shows games and music They do not have charging in seat so bring your own portable charger if necessary Food was delicious and they had good options for purchase throughout the flight Flight attendants were very friendly and provided great service We sat in the back of the plane with seats together and that was great because the aisles were a bit roomier back there

Zagreb Airport is a small but clean airport The airport staff were generally friendly helpful and efficient Moderate queuing time Seating area was a bit crowded during busy hours and lacking charging sockets around seats Fast and free WiFi

UIOCCS There were no problems to speak of nor was the experience extraordinarily positive First off I should say that I had problems in booking via the Santa Barbara website and so had to visit their agency in Quito I had my bags fairly thoroughly checked by migration people in Quito but thats understandable given the flow of drugs in the region The flight itself was fine Boeing no obvious neglect crew were friendly enough food was decent We did leave about mins late At the Caracas end our bags were slow in arriving It seems that there are problems but you may get lucky and avoid them as I did

A small but pleasant airport On arrival customs officer friendly and smiling Luggage delivered quickly and duty free shops in the arrival lounge On departure staff pleasant including the security check Just be aware that the domestic terminal is very small and offer very few seating possibilities before check in
London to Algiers There was a slight delay but the service onboard was excellent Clean very nice food and friendly personnel Very pleased with the whole experience Would fly Air Algerie again

The lady at the airport charged me to bring my small backpack on the plane She said its considered a carry on luggage yet it fit perfectly underneath the seat with lots of extra room Its ridiculous Ill never fly with them again

London Johannesburg via Tripoli return I took the precaution of travelling hand luggage only and making sure not to use the bathrooms during the stop over at Tripoli and was pleasantly surprised The service matched any Ive travelled with over the years and at half the price Considering they offer the option of twice as much luggage in the hold as any other airline Ive travelled with I might even travel with lots of luggage next time

Victoria Airport on arrival the terminal was easy to find clean and well laid out Friendly and helpful staff who went out of their way to guide you checkin was a breeze and no surprises with our luggage Even the customs staff shared some humour with us On the other side of security it was just as impressive with clean well laid out waiting areas and washrooms Water fountains available that you could fill up your water bottle from and not have to pay the rip off price for bottled water like at other airports We will definitely use this airport again in the future

Another pretty solid trip with Jet A full package holiday was booked through them and they did not disappoint The flight times were good as they offered a decent early flight to get there and a leisurely enough time to return Checkinbag drop at Belfast was quick and easy with friendly staff and the boarding process was fast and well managed leaving the experience hassle free Onboard the plane was clear well kept and pleasant decent leg room for taller passengers as well The inflight shopping options seemed OK although this wasnt something that I would usually avail of however food and drink options were good enough Not bad in terms of range and price to match granted more than you would want to pay on the High Street but OK for a flight The staff really made the experience good with the crew friendly and very efficient getting food and drinks out quickly and picking up the rubbish after in good time Jet has been like this the last few times weve travelled with them so hoping this keeps up

The airport has a nice design but it is not well maintained and you always feel its aging fast The waiting time to reach immigration might take more than an hour in summer while bags might take on average minutes in nonpeak times Duty free is good and the RJ lounge is very good with plenty of options Toilet and hygiene facilities dont have consistent standard

If you like large airports with lots of shops restaurants and people then Sanford is not the sort of airport you would appreciate However if you prefer a small regional type airport that you can pass through quickly both in and out without stress then I strongly recommend Sanford We now look at TUI flight options first simply because they use this airport The staff are friendly including immigration and security and yet its only about miles north of Orlando and roughly a minute drive to the Disney resorts We havent been here since but I can confirm from the time we started queuing for immigration to collecting baggage was only minutes Compare this to Orlando International where you would probably be held in a holding area due to congestion

I had read many bad review with Swoop so I booked with an open mind primarily because of the low cost of flying with a family of We had a month old with us and had her gear in tow car seat and stroller we were told it would be easier to gate check the baby equipment Right from our first interaction with the staff they were very accommodating with our situation and the stewardesses were phenomenal in explaining the safety protocol with a baby Our outgoing flight was smooth and no issues our return flight was delayed mins because of weather but we were given ample notice Once we were cleared to board we were delighted to see the same staff who recognized us and came over to say HI Its a shame that Swoop will be no longer I would fly with them again

Istanbul to Tripoli This airlines is decent and I was served particularly well The food and beverages were great and the in flight entertainment contained a lot of movies to watch Also the WIFI was pretty fast and effective

Tiny But stunning location Barra Aiport sits on the edge of a wide beach on the Scottish Island of Barra Twice a day once in winter flights from Glasgow and Benbencula land on one of the three runways But these are no ordinary tarmac runways These are marked out on the sand of the beach and only when the tide is out The flights are the only British Airways flights where the timetable is marked subject to tide The terminal a proper little toytown terminal complete with tiny terminal control tower big burly firemen and one checkin desk No compromise though on safety checks and procedures Be sure to be here in good time to watch the incoming Twin Otter fly in and land on the beach The tiny cafe sells lovely home made organic snacks and the whole experiences is a joy if you have only been used to the hustle and bustle and chaos of some large well known international terminals If a glorious sunny day checkin good and early and take time to stroll three hundred yards up over the dunes to see the other stunning beach close to this amazing little airport
Perfect and uneventful flight left in time boarding in BKK was done professionally and efficient Staff were polite and helpful Enough space in overhead lockers

The airport is very big so you better arrive early if you have international flight Immigration queuing might take more than an hour and duty free is very far away from lounges and gates so you might have to choose between duty free or visiting the lounge Staff are generally friendly even under pressure

What is happening with some Italian Airports As Florence and Pisa Bologna is completely and horrendously overcrowded One cannot walk around at the gate area which is immediately after a socalled DutyFree With people queuing to get on a plane or for a sandwich or coffee there is no space to get anywhere without pushing your way through The worse there is absolutely no air to breath with all these people standing around Probably much is because of some low cost airlines which let you queue well before effectively boarding planes but whatever it is Bologna should think about some solution as it is an ordeal A pity because personnel is generically very friendly and there are lovely food options in the terminal
The plane was in a good condition even for an old plane Both flights were on time On the minute flight there was no service Staff of the airline were professional and quick at check in No echeck in

Bydgoszcz airport is very small but there are many people traveling through it daily There are no shops only one cafe and newsagents both in the duty free area Security checks are usually fast and check ins go smoothly This city would benefit from a much bigger airport and hopefully it will soon have one

Corpus Christi is fine small airport In remarkably good shape and well kept Very simple and easy to navigate TSA security was a breeze no lines and all staff were actually very firendly Not much offering presecurity but couple of shops and restaurants post security Easy to get to just west of downtown

This airport is well organized and easy to navigate its become one of my favorite airports in the world On this trip JFKSFOTPE I flew into and also left from Terminal One recently renovated attractive and spacious It also contains quite a few spaces for relaxation plus many restaurants and shops On arrival my bag arrived before I did On departure I checked in at the Interational Terminal which is connected to Terminal One Going through security at International was fast and easy The only negative was that several of the restaurants in Terminal One were closed in the evening

Lovely airport With a three hour wait at this airport it was a lovely airport to spend some time before going through the gates Great food options and variety There was lots of seating with tables and we could have food from anywhere Great to keep the whole family happy I am not a big fan of designer stores so the fact that we spent time before security was ideal

The security staff were incredibly slow and seemed to be more interested in personal chats than getting customers through the security process as quickly as possible Why not be more proactive you will get less tension with customers shorter queues and a better job satisfaction You dont need to be unfriendly and impersonal

Three trips between CCS and BLA I found Conviasa to be clean modern friendly and welcoming My Spanish is functional but quite basic and when I struggled there was usually multilingual staff even on the short hop from Caracas to Barcelona and back Luggage allowance on this flight is a generous kg and a free drink is provided despite the flight time being only minutes Seats comfortable with more room than I was expecting All in all Conviasa offer a superior albeit slightly more expensive service on this short route than do their competitors Avior
