Be Aware Arrival at the airport was okay the immigration line was long but it moved pretty quickly The airport was clean and looks pretty new Our main problem with this airport is the departure security check point where you have to apparently place all liquids below the authorised limit in ziplock bags Nowhere in the airport is there a sign saying that all liquids must be in clear plastic bags The check in agent said nothing nothing from the airline and did I say no signs We got to security and were told to throw away our items or pay US per ziplock bag If that didnt feel like an organised racket then I dont know what else qualifies This type of action is dishonest in every respect but at that point we had no choice Weve travelled through London Luton and they have the same plastic bag policy but not only are signs of it everywhere they provide the bags This felt like a shady scheme and we quite honestly will try to avoid this airport in future PS Duty free alcohol was cheaper in out home country as well

My wife was having trouble getting her handbag through security After much rummaging by the security officer he pulled out a penknife My wife was mortified The knife had belonged to her brother a farmer who had died some years previously She became visibly upset and the officer got quite concerned He said not to worry if we would go to the shop get an envelope and stamps he would post the knife back to her Got home from the holiday to find the knife duly arrived What a kind and considerate man thank you very much
I had special assistance booked here The check in staff were incredibly kind and helpful and the assistance staff were fantastic Could not fault my experience

CHA is a compact but efficient airport serving a metropolitan market of about residents In the past it has suffered from proximity to major airports in Nashville and Atlanta but today airlines service Chattanooga with a rather rapidly growing number of destinations The airport is very clean with free WiFi throughout and parking and security is superior Low fare airlines have joined the legacy carriers so there is quite a nice selection of flights and fares Sure saves time and headaches of leaving from larger airports

Gatwick to Joburg troubles just beginning to brew in Libya The start seemed off putting when I noticed an extra three hours on the flight time from Tripoli to Joburg which the booking office could not explain also when I was not on the reservations list at checkin However the latter was sorted without hassle Service on flight to Tripoli was fine plane new and clean food good However we landed in a sandstorm which was worrying Fortunately we were herded along to the departures lounge as all signs in Arabic Onward flight delayed by a couple of hours due to sandstorm Toilets at the airport were inadequate in number but reasonably clean We were then taken on what felt like a mystery tour on an airport bus down a dirt road turned out to be to the other end of the runway where our plane sat all on its own amidst military aircraft The three hour extra time was now clear as it was a much smaller plane than expected a few passengers had seats allocated on row numbers which were not on the smaller plane however there was enough room and extra for everyone boarding Once again food and service fine There was a refuelling stop at Kinshasa During my week in S Africa the revolution in Libya took off I expected to lose my money and have to rebook myself back on an alternative carrier However when I contacted Afriqiyah in Joburg they said I was rebooked on Egyptair travelling back same night as my original booking They sent me email confirmation and my trip home went smoothly The Afriqiyah staff were helpful and efficient in spite of what was obviously a stressful time for them On the basis of value for money Afriqiyah is excellent but be prepared for a journey with a difference

Ground staff friendly and professional Limited facilities at Albrook Airport but functional Couldnt do online check in but was smooth at the airport Older plane but was on time and smooth flight No real on board service so take your own snack or drink after airport security Flight was only mins so not a problem Plane does have a toilet Its not like flying a major international airline but its a short flight and was a good experience They even gave us umbrellas to walk to the plane as it had started to rain which was a nice touch Id seen other negative reviews so was pleasantly surprised how professional and polite their staff were Id use them again Its difficult to rate the actual on board service because there really isnt any no entertainment or food drinks but its such a short flight its not that relevant So I base my score on the overall experience Good service and on time flights with friendly staff but in flight service not really offered

Dulles Airport is located in Virginia and bit far from Washington DC Very large and wellmaintained airport very clean Few sitting places Immigration process takes long time Boarding bridge works as bus to the airport terminal Taxi and bus services are there

Superb This is by far the best business class product within Europe The meal was one of the best Ive eaten Cabin crew delightful Wine servings enormous and just nothing to correct in the product It is a shame that no other European airline comes close to this standard

Manchester to Tenerife On the morning of our flight TUI informed us that due to scheduling issues they have enlisted Privilege style as a charter airline The seat was comfortable only issues were my tray table was loose the window was in a position that caused pain on my neck to look out of it The interior felt somewhat tired Apart from this the flight was comfortable and landed safely
Large and fairly spacious airport unless theres a couple of wide bodies departing The terminal is new and smart without being stunning Good range of shops
The folks at Delta and Sky West were great They took great care of daughter and her room mate on their way home for spring break They made a special trip to get our bags at the Elko Airport

A very friendly team of staff overall at Memphis Airport Southern hospitality goes a long way Would like to see more dining options and shops that are not all identical in product choices Overall a very good experience Would definitely fly to Memphis again without hesitation

Greatly improved airport with better immigration facilities on arrival fast track lane for business passengers on departure entrance into departure hall entrance to immigration much faster retrieval of luggage and more smiling people The departure zone after security has been revamped and is now more frendly too

A small airport right in the east of the city center with a convenient metro connection readily available The terminal itself is small but well organized and has enough small shops for food and beverages Security queuing times late in the evening were nonexistent border control only inbound was equally fast Best airport if youve to be in London itself

Never have I been to an airport with staff so keen to help and so lovely After a baggage mishap at Shanghai Airport I arrived at Fukoaka knowing that my bag was not on the flight that I was on Upon arrival immigration was a breeze even with a British passport and I went straight to the arrivals desk where four people immediately helped me They were so kind and helpful and sorted out my problem immediately They reassured me that everything would be ok and even gave me a yen note to pay for the delivery of my luggage to where I was staying somewhere around hours away from Fukoaka The whole airport experience was wonderful in comparison to the rude service I received at Shanghai Pu Dong Airport Thank you to everyone who helped out a traveler who had lost his baggage

Flew this route again last weekend Menzies the handling agent at EDI very helpful bag drop and boarding a breeze Where SunExpress excel is with their cabin crew who were helpful friendly and professional Also very well groomed Bugra and Ismet were excellent and an asset to the company I wouldnt hesitate to travel with them again and recommend

This is a nice little airport as previously stated and one minor comment which persons using it for the first time should appreciate is that there is no ATM or machine for buying tickets for the connecting buses into Stockholm although the information desk is helpful and do accept most credit cards They will try to assist in anyway possible So be prepared

We flew the wonderful StarFlyer aircraft from Kansai to Tokyo Haneda The checkin staff was extremely friendly and quick and their security line had nobody in it The boarding was speedy we timed it and we got on and took off within minutes We were dissatisfied by the fact that we could not redeem United miles as the airline is partly owned by ANA overall the flight was above and beyond

Couple of short flights with HOP An Embraer to Paris then a Bombadier down to Perpignan Both aircraft cabins were nice staff were friendly and helpful and the snacksdrinks on board were satisfying Flights were on time As a platinum cardholder my connection between CDG and ORY was without charge saving Euro which is a really practical and helpful perk of Flying Blue membership thanks Air France for that I fly a lot with HOP and they always do a good job well done again

I enjoyed my flight aboard Air Zimbabwe from Harare to Johannesburg the crew were very friendly and the service was excellent We arrived ahead of schedule checkin was fast and smooth and the seats were comfortable

The short one hour flight from FUK to ICN was operated by an old A with angled flat seats As the flight was short lunch service began shortly after takeoff off a panini sandwich When I finished the meal it was time to land The second leg of the journey from ICN to SIN was operated by a newer year old A The seat on the A was more modern and fully flat There were choices for dinner a Western selection of steak and a Korean selection of beef ssambap I chose the latter The taste was delicious and the meal service ended with coffee or tea I went with ginseng tea The cabin attendants were friendly and polite in their service The cabin manager introduced herself to each business class passenger prior to takeoff The drawbacks of the hard product was that there was no storage compartment only a small recess to put your cellphone I felt that the rack containing the inflight shopping catalogue could have been put to better use by installing a small storage compartment Entertainment was limited compared to SQ and BR No preflight drink was offered unlike on other airlines In summary Asiana is an above average airline but not the best service is excellent but tHe hard product could be improved

We booked a day trip to Luxor from Sharm and flew Air Memphis Aircraft was an old MD which was tired looking inside and out but clean Friendly cabin crew juice and a snack were served Dont let appearances put you off
TFNGMZ return on ATR Very good minute flights Served cup of water and chocolate bar Great views of a snow capped Mt Teide on left going and right returning
Wonderful Right size efficient super clean reliable in all weather conditions and wonderful ergonomics

I was very excited to land here as this airport is famous around the globe for its risk landings The infrastrucure per se is very basic you deplane on the tarmac and then walk to the arrivals staff were ok I found people in the Madeira island to be very friendly Do not come without pre booked stuff as I noticed they inflate the prices for tourists who decided to book on the spot The airport is clean and security is fast long lines though Snacks on the land side much cheaper than air side

Its development in the last years is rather impressive More than one million passengers now use this airport each year for a regional airport this is rather much I think I like she short distances the easy and quick checkin services the nice environment and the very close parking facilities I you arrive at this airport you have to wait never longer than min for the luggage delivery

Thumbs up for Belfast City Airport Excellent revamp New improved security area Bigger Duty Free Shop not sharing any space with other retail Much more passenger seating Good new bar with charging points and a family table service area The views of the apron have not been compromised This makeover is long overdue now gives Belfast International a run for its money and much more user friendly than London City my final destination today

Excellent flight more leg room than other airlines cabin stewardess who was excellent and tended to all passenger requirements served all passengers with complimentary food with drink which is unknown nowadays Good old fashioned service and customers do count Flight from Waterford VG th June

Nice airport corresponding to the Chinese standard no frills but essentials are there If you fly international no need to arrive early as the checkin counter is opened just one hour before flight time If you arrive early it is difficult to find a seat Not very friendly immigration people but nice lounge with good wifi connection and unlimited Internet access Plenty of outlets to satisfy the western appetite Starbucks KFC etc

Ive seen many negative reviews about Sri Lankan airlines However my trip was so good Even though it was a hour flight they provided drinks and a snack which doesnt happen in North America The service was professional too I hope they will grow

I have taken flights on V Air and found it a surprisingly pleasant experience The aircraft seemed new the FAs were very efficient and the meals prebooked at a discount tasty On the latest TPECNX flight I measured the seat pitch at If this is accurate then it puts many of the long distance flights on legacy carriers to shame The first flight in May was held up an hour at TPE due to runway maintenance The other two this month both departed within minutes of the advertised schedule Its about time there were low cost carriers between BKK and TPE I will happily take V Air for future trips

My experience at the new Siem Reap Airport surpassed all expectations The staffs friendliness and proactive assistance elevated my journey Navigating immigration was not only expeditious but also conducted with an admirable level of efficiency The airports outstanding features combined with the exceptional service created an atmosphere of ease and comfort

Es una aeropuerto pequeo pero moderno tiene todo lo accesible que se necesita para un viajero es rpido en lo que es migracin las malestas llegan rpido al recogedor todo limpio hay WiFi gratis conectores por muchas partes muy amable el personal buena seguridad lo Malo son los precios de las tiendas todo esos precios desorbitados pero en lo que respecta al aeropuerto muy bueno anunci de vuelos pantallas todo modern It is a small but modern airport it has everything that is needed for a traveler it is fast in what is migration the baggage arrives quickly to the pickup everything is clean there is free WiFi connectors for many parts very friendly and good security personnel Bad things are the prices of the stores with those exorbitant prices but in regards to the airport very good announcements with modern screens for flights

In November Phnom Penh air travelers started using a spacious new terminal equipped with percent more checkin counters than now twice as many immigration counters and three times as many Xray machines for carryon bags In Cambodias largest airport expansion mil in a generation the new airport terminal will seem like an upscale shopping mall There is a large food court twice as much floor space for duty free and a host of new food and beverage vendors never seen that far west on Russian Boulevard Last week the VIP and Premium lounges opened and are as good as any in a terminal this size It all looks very clean and organized though I have yet to see the new terminal when there are great numbers of people arriving or departing

Privilege Style operate an old Singapore Airlines and I took their flight between Miami and London Gatwick as Norwegian were unable to run their new Boeing Dreamliner I see a lot of people complaining about Privilege Style however I had an amazing experience in their business class cabin I actually chose to fly with Privilege Style so I could experience the old Singapore Airlines business class cabin and I wasnt disappointed The business class cabin was in a configuration and was completely booked out however the seat I had was very spacious and I had so much room to myself The cabin crew in the business cabin looked after us like a true business class experience which I was not expecting We had a welcome drink and there were plenty of staff for the small number of people in the cabin I pressed the call button at one point and a cabin crew member came over straight away The food was very good too nothing special but it was better than I expected It was also served quickly too which was great theres nothing worse than waiting hours for your meal We had blankets and a pillow provided too really making this feel like a business class flight and I liked how the cabin crew stopped economy passengers from using our toilets As we flew over the Atlantic the cabin lights dimmed and most people got sleep Ive flown business class several times before and for the price I paid this is one where I got the most value Note that the entertainment system is a bit rubbish but I knew that and took my laptop preloaded with some films and my own noise cancelling headphones Im posting this because I did research before this flight online and couldnt find any positive reviews about the business class experience and for that reason I was worried about what it was going to be like I hope this review helps people who might be thinking about booking with Privilege Style
A fantastic new airport that is miles ahead of the old Durban International Bright spacious and with a feeling of quality

I fainted in the flight and where some crew may have panicked in some cases this crew handled the situation very well Provided me with all the necessary assistance and first aid and was very kind and humble till the end

Travelled last month from Subang to Penang Flight was great Flight attendants were friendly and welcoming No in flight entertainment but there were magazines Only serve Peanuts fresh baked bread a mineral water and a wet towel for each passenger Baggage allowance was also ok as the limit was Kg Price was also cheap as I only paid RM for a one way flight One my return flight to Subang there were only passengers and the flight still continued even thought not even of the plane was full I would recommend the Airline to people who want to travel in Malaysia

As per a previous review on checkin was advised that bags could only be sent as far as Haikou At that point I would have to enter China collect baggage then checkin for BKK flight And thats despite both flights being on a single ticket Upon arrival then had issues at passport control They wanted evidence of my nd flight The print out I had on me simply said SYD BKK And had no wifi access Eventually was allowed in The flights themselves were great Relatively modern planes with attentive flight attendants in business on the A and on the Western food options on the way over Very much Chinese on the way back For the price I paid it was a great option but hrs to BKK instead of hours might turn others off

Plovdiv is a small domestic airport It doesnt have any lounges Checkin is okay Not many staff so the lines are long There are very few flights some days even no flights The little bar next to check in is good However the airport is nice

Been coming to GCM for years Yes tourism has increased based on reports by almost over last years which is fantastic for this beautiful Island But the airport although complete remodelled is poor at best Aesthetically pleasing it is too small and very uncomfortable Why go half way for something inadequate from the start Fortunately the entire staff are awesome and eased the pain Suggest a change in schedule of when flights arrive may assist even by minutes Two recent issues I dealt with The runway pothole was a total screw up From accounts in paper it appeared that new asphalt from night before was destroyed by a jet blast Asphalt needs to cure Second and personally involved is that our plane needed to wait one hour after everyone was boarded for maintenance to return a log book This made our connection for our next flight impossible with all the inconveniences associated How can you allow this calamity to occur is still not sitting well with me If you expect tourism to continue to visit your beautiful Island you need to improve

I was down with flu and surprised when I checked in and cleared passport that the airport did not have any pharmacies or clinics inside the airport This is the first time in a long history of travel that an airport doesnt have these facilities Very disappointed

I was impressed by the cleanliness and orderliness of this airport Even the porters and staff act professionally Big space check in counters not cramped You dont have the feeling that youll be harassed nor cheated Considering this airport on my future flights

This is a good smaller airport to fly in and out of The terminal is new and it shows Also staff are friendly and helpful This terminal is also well located as it is actually on the outskirts of the city not outside of the city In addition it is served by local transit However there is one accessibility issue While the lanes for commercial providers are covered and wide there is only a lane uncovered pickup area on the arrivals level for private vehicles This results in congestion during heavier arrival times

Terminal International Departure Efficient passport control and security check within the terminal an incredible amount of dining and bar options for every budget Wonderful new terminal maybe with not many toilet facilities as only negative point

Malm to Stockholm I rebooked on Malm Aviation due to SAS strike in Sweden What a sharp contrast to SAS Checkin was painless using the selfservice machines Flight was operated by an Avro RJ with comfortable seats and sufficient legroom Cabin crew was efficient and smiling But the nicest touch was the free snack on board tasty roast beef sandwich orange juice coffeetea I was rather impressed by the cabin service on this hourflight The only negative point is the free seating policy as usual it resulted in a freeforall at boarding Malm Aviation is a very nice niche airline and I would strongly recommend it

MontpellierMditerrane Airport is a tiny but nice airport Facilities are clean some computer charging desks are available reasonable amount of seats can be found at the gates Shopping and eating options are according to the size of the airport The airside area also features a lovely terrasse taking advantage of the sun drawbacks however The terrasse does not offer a direct view on the movement area and its the spot where all smokers endup Bagages delivery on arrival was a bit long especially for such a small airport Traffic right outside the terminal can be abot messy as the pickup dropoff zone seems to be on the street so cars are jammed Wifi connection procedure should be simplified and streamlined
Regional airport not that busy Efficient checkin Services pretty basic but everything works Newer TG Business Lounge very nice
Great Airport used it for a Ryanair flight to Stansted Small highly efficient great bar restaurant and shops A breeze to get through am going to use again Wish they were all like this
It was the smoothest landing ever and an enjoyable flight overall The crew was very polite and the departure and the arrival were on time in a minute

Yangon to Mandalay Lounge photo and In flight meal photo are added We can access Lounge at Yangon International Airport for all Business Class traveler variety of Breakfast Lounge is located at the rd floor of Yangon International Airport Terminal for domestic In flight meal is great but simple because it is just a hour short flight

The international terminal of Haikou Airport is a very spacious terminal I have ever seen The terminal is small and dedicated The staff of VIP room help me to carry the language when I arrived and welcome me before I check in and keep me company all the way to the lounge There is a beautiful tropical garden in the terminal The staff in the airport is professional and dedicated I want to thank them for treating me so well

Leonardo da Vinci Fiumicino Airport is a huge welldesigned welldecorated airport with clean and huge facilities I waited there for hours as the checkin security check and immigration were completed early However I spent good time as the airport facilities made easy travelers to navigate and browse for shopping and restaurants Airport staffs were good They speak English well Only bad thing is that travelers have to walk long to get into the boarding bridges

What a lovely place The tiniest airport an aerodrome actually I have been to People are lovely they take care of you There is a bar free wifi if it doesnt work in some areas ask for the airlines it is kept clean The only thing is getting there taxi only as far as I know

Even though it is small this is one of my favourite airports Its a minute walk from the plane to the terminal baggage is normally on the belt as soon as you arrive in and the best part is the cafe not only is it cheap but they have excellent hot bacon rolls and the fresh cakes are excellent too If only public transport links were better though I have been told the National Express service to London will soon call at Kent International

RGN to Mandalay Airfare considerably less than other airline Flight was on a new airbus Checkin while chaotic went well Lots of airport staff Everything was done manually with paper and counters Cabin crew well dressed and pleasant Flight was comfortable and on time

The Buffalo Niagara Airport was quite an experience It was easily accessible and was fantastic with the hotels right across the road The staff were okay We were flying early in the morning so they might have been tired but they seemed alright The airport was larger than I expected The parking was easy and cheap Overall it was a nice experience

A quick efficient security check just inside the door then youre in a big lobby and go to a checkin counter which you must do at any rate for a flight out of Russia even if you printed a boarding pass online so dont bother There are plenty of shops and places to eat both before and after formal passport control and formal security each of which involved less than minutes queuing Quintessentially Russian the passport officer never smiled but he was efficient and in no way discourteous Restrooms are clean and wellmaintained I awaited boarding in a nice lounge but almost all the newspapers to read are in Russian which I cant read Ample seating area at gate My flight to Paris had boarding via a jetway

On one of my recent flights I had the pleasure of experiencing the exceptional service of a remarkable cabin crew Their service made me truly appreciate what it means to go above and beyond in offering warmth and professionalism This cabin crew was not just doing their jobthey were truly caring for every passenger making everyone feel like they were being treated with the utmost attention and respect From the moment we boarded the crew greeted each passenger with sincere smiles Whether they were guiding us to our seats or answering questions they were always patient and considerate making everyone feel at ease Despite the long flight they maintained a cheerful and relaxed attitude making the time pass much faster than expected Throughout the flight the crews service was even more impressive During meal service they paid close attention to each passengers needs and even proactively asked if anyone required additional assistance What truly stood out was the crews high level of professionalism As we prepared for landing they didnt rush to tidy up or prepare for descent Instead they walked around the cabin gently reminding passengers to check for any forgotten personal items ensuring nothing was left behind This cabin crew with their genuine smiles attentive service and professionalism made this flight truly exceptional Im grateful for this outstanding crew who made my journey both pleasant and reassuring

We had quite a lot of time to kill in this airport and it didnt disappoint There was a restaurant right in the middle of the terminal that was delicious and decently priced Unfortunately the wifi was not working no matter how many times we tried but they had this nice area called the library we sat in that was pleasant and helped the time pass

I had my period during the departure and didnt have sanitary paper with me My departure was from Terminal and after entering it there was no place where I could get it It is important that such things as sanitarny paper or diaper for babies are available to buy on an airport It should be available in the toilet or in one of the shops I had to ask several women which were also waiting for a plane whether they have sanitary paper It was uncomfortable I found sanitary paper cause one of the women had it but I could be less fortunate

The flight took off and landed on time boarding was efficient and the crew were friendly I have no complaints I ignored an offered opportunity to upgrade to business class but did take up the chance to block off the next seat for which was great So often I have watched Luxair planes at London City and wondered how the flights would be Turns out I was impressed

This is a small airport but the new passenger terminal is great Fast service helpful people and clean This is a good alternative of Brussels airport We like it and for sure if possible we will try again

A small but efficiently operating airport Arrival was smooth and fast even when there was an additional covid document check There are enough small shops and food and beverages available Transportation is best done by train which will cost only euro

My flight with Air Do was a great example of Japanese customer service Being an All Nippon codeshare flight I was connecting from another ANA flight that unfortunately ran late and my connection was already only minutes the tightest theoretical connection that ANA allows My flight to Fukuoka arrived at a remote stand and they already had a van with a concierge best I can describe it waiting with a sign for me They whisked me away and drove me right to the gate with just minutes to spare My bags also made the transfer as well with them having their own luggage cart drive them right to the plane As for the flight itself the plane itself wasnt in the best shape being an exANA that was at years old and definitely showing its age I was able to get the bulkhead seat and had the entire row to myself Im a tall guy and leg room was no issue Recline was great considering theyre a budget airline and they had the usual drink service with a choice of green tea coffee and apple juice Their inflight shop has some cool items too I got myself a little plushie of the airlines polar bear mascot One downside of this flight was that we arrived at a remote stand at the farthest end of Sapporo airport having to take a min bus ride to get to the terminal Other than that a good flight but excellent customer service

It was years ago I used this airport and wow so much has changed The check in on nd level had moved to a much more spacious rd level It made the experience totally different in a positive way No longer does it feel cramped Staff are friendly and signage are very clear The only thing that still need improving is the variety of shops available air side and food options It is still pretty basic at this stage With more and more airlines flying to OKA they can be more ambitious and open up more shops and restaurants to cater for us

A wonderful little airport So impressed While it was busy at the peak of the holiday season everything moved quickly and efficiently The shops airside while small have a great selection of Spanish specialties like olive oil I hope the new airport that opens next year keeps up the same high standards

Great airport for small aircraft Twin OtterCessna used primarily for safari transfers Courteous and friendly staffsecurity as well as satisfactory washrooms and a nice snack bar Wilson airport is a welcome change from the chaos of Jomo Kenyatta Note due to its small size there is no souvenir or duty free shopping

Chicago OHare to Savannah and return October Have used Savannah HHI International for many years when flying to Hilton Head Island SC A really very pleasant little airport serving mostly Delta and United Express internal flights Friendly check in staff quick luggage retrieval and absolutely the best Car Rental desks just yards along the same floor from Luggage Retrieval with the cars park right outside the Terminal This is a relatively small International Airport but there is a pleasant courtyard with a couple of shops and eating choices with lots of tables and chairs and a great information desk Once through security there is a surprising range of nice eating choices BUT of course they may not necessarily be open for a late night departure Have used many USA Airports over the years but this and RenoSparks in Nevada is the gem would unhesitatingly recommend

We flew with Turkmenistan Airlines for flights one from Milan to Ashgabat hrs with a Boeing and another flight hrs from Ashgabat to Kuala Lampur with a Boeing Both flights were much better than expected after reading the reviews Both aircrafts looked modern and clean with very comfortable seats For the very affordable prices the airline offers the service is very good We got meals on both flights and unlimited coffee water or any other drinks The staff was really nice and you can even ask for a blanket if needed The only negative point is that you cant checkin online which leads to long queues at the desk but expect from that everything was fine We would definitely fly again with this airline they deserve more good reviews

Internal flights in Colombia BOGSMR CTGBOG were real value for money The planes were clean the service was good and the free Juan Valdez snack peanuts and some little cookie were delicious Excellent value for short flights

Cape Town to Johannesburg The SLOW lounge in the Cape Town domestic terminal is a maelstrom of activity around lunchtime but at least theres an impressive spread of food Boarding was the now usual queuing on the ramp and airbridge but passengers were sensibly allowed on at both ends of the plane Service was efficient although lacking BAs homegrown friendliness The Comair fourcourse meal was adequate but not up to the best that Club Europe offers A late departure was compensated for along the way and our bags were moreorless first off the carousel Overall a decent flight

TAR Aerolineas is a new regional Mexican carrier which operates several routes in Mexico Flew a domestic route roundtrip and found the service to be topnotch Aircraft brand new and clean punctual departures and arrivals attentive ground and cabin personnel excellent value for money Would choose them again when my travel plans take me to Mexico
The folks at Delta and Sky West were great They took great care of daughter and her room mate on their way home for spring break They made a special trip to get our bags at the Elko Airport

Sal is a great small airport which is easy to use lots of signs and decent food options Good taxi services and shuttle buses to hotels Clean and airy and bright Would recommend Aeroplanes park very close and many airlines fly to Sal which is useful Friendly staff

Brisbane to Toowoomba and I was amazed at the service provided by this small regional airline Skytrans Airlines Even though the flight in a small propjet was only minutes duration we were given bottles of water and packets of potato crisps Returning the next day service was equally as good Would recommend this airline

Egilsstadir to Reykjavk Check in was a breeze Waiting area very clean Boarding was very easy just showing ticket and photo ID It was a minute flight They served tea or coffee with a chocolate I really enjoyed the flight as I did not want to travel by road again I will fly them again

What a great little airport Friendly staff in all areas and in my opinion unique system to me anyway of scanning the hold luggage whilst youre with it before its loaded onto the aircraft Domestic departure lounge is small but plenty of seating available

Visited Tirana on and departed on Both the arrival and departure experiences were smooth There was a slight delay at passport control on arrival as the scanner was not working at the booth where we presented our passports This is a neat and bright medium sized airport There is a lot of seating at the departure gates There is a nice Business Lounge that we accessed through our Priority Pass card The staff are friendly and professional Check in was effortless There is no online check in for TIA so one has to check in at the counter WiFi is available however it appeared to be spotty We did not have to wait very long for our luggage to arrive in baggage claim There are no jet bridges at TIA All passengers are bussed to and from the terminal to the aircraft

Pakse to Bangkok Great legspace even for longer people Im cm tall Friendly staff and snacks were served with drinks Ride was smooth plane clean and we were almost on time Would recommend and will fly again with Lao Airlines

Outstanding views when arriving in on a fair weather day Pass through Airport in little time due to size of airport Friendly staff and facilities need to step up with any increase in flightpassenger numbers Sligo City is only miles form the airport or Euro taxi Journey Area beside airport is popular for running golf surfing and sea sports with international surf competitions held regularly

The Airport was quiet and everything went really smooth The staff were professional and did not give me a hard time while checking in and during customsimmigration Toilets and lounge were clean and comfortable to use The wifi was also very reliable

Nice small low cost but very aged airport needs full reconstruction asap Everything looks like the s but not nice way The floor was dirty so they need to improve cleaning as well Restaurant was closed so there was nowhere to even get a coffee Staff were kind and helpful Will fly there again as FR and W operate nice cheap flights otherwise no chance will be back

My first experience with this regional airline on a short hop from PointaPietre to Melville Hall Very pleasant and relaxed flight nice staff and decent leg and hand luggage space Will be happy to fly with them at any time again

Amazing experience I want to thank you all of the flight attendants for being so friendly and helpful I am afraid of airplanes and they helped me calm down and relax Special thanks to Maria for being there whenever I need her The best flight attendant Her customer service was super She was there to help and make me feel comfortable

BOGMZLBOG I took them from Bogota to Manizales when I was visiting Colombia in December The crew was fantastic airport staff was polite The planes were new comfortable and service was great Tickets were very reasonable but book them early through the website to take advantage of the promotional fares which could equal US round trip depending on where you are going and how early you book

This is a small yet spacious airport with two terminal piers jutting out in a Y shape There were ample seating space plug points to charge your phones and also an enclosed section with desks and chairs to do any work on your computer Large glass windows afforded views of the runways and let sunlight stream in Bathrooms clean TSA security was thorough Check in counters are opened a couple of hours before a flight and I found the staff friendly Car rental booths are in the baggage conveyor belt section and long term parking is just outside the terminal as are the parking lots for rental cars minimal walking required Very easy and fast entry and exit intoout of terminal Driving directions to airport were clearly marked Only a couple of shopsstores for food and drinks A selection of Wisconsin beer was available in the restaurant but not my favorite Leinenkugel Overall a very pleasant airport

Wonderful airline Both going to and coming back from Whitehorse I really enjoyed flying with them Flights were on time No trouble with checked baggage Staff were super friendly They even provided a complimentary sandwich and warm cookie on a flight that was just over two hours I have a high opinion of this airline and would gladly fly with them again Thank you Air North

Exceptional Service from Ground Crews I recently had an experience that despite starting off on the wrong foot turned into a testament to the incredible dedication of the airlines ground crew Unfortunately we mismanaged our time and ended up missing our flight It was a stressful situation for our family of four and we were worried about what would happen next However the ground crew went above and beyond to assist us They were understanding and reassuring immediately helping us to rebook our tickets What truly impressed us was their effort to ensure that we could sit together on our new flight The staff worked diligently and communicated openly throughout the process making a stressful situation much more manageable Thanks to the remarkable support from the team we were able to travel together without further issues I cant express enough gratitude for their exceptional service It truly made a difference in our travel experience Highly recommend this airline for their commitment to customer care

The security staff at Aberdeen airport are not up to standard Many of them are aggressive and argumentative and their main aim is not to be friendly or courteous I have been fortunate enough to travel to many countries and I say without hesitation that the security staff at Aberdeen airport are either the most poorly trained that I have encountered or that they are paying no attention to the training they receive The management team needs to review the training of the security staff at Aberdeen airport urgently

Bremen is a small and convenient airport and my experience proved enjoyable Arriving with Air France I disembarked in the main terminal Very short walk to the baggage claim I picked my suitcase within ten minutes Tram line frequently connects the airport with the city centre every min during peak hours min otherwise travel time min A oneway ticket costs however beware that the machines accept neither credit cards nor bank notes greater than Easy departure with no queue at baggage dropin I breezed through security Bremen uses the fullbody scanner which makes the screening process much faster Security staff efficient and friendly Bright departure lounge but there might not be enough seating facilities if all gates are used at the same time Only issue Not enough toilets facilities either landside well hidden at the very end of the building or airside one toilet block only

I have used Monastir Airport now for years and whilst the queues at immigration can be slow at times I think the other facilities and friendly staff more than make up for this Transport links are excellent if you are an independent traveller
Jayapura to Tanahmerah Flight left and arrived on time Aircraft was clean and cool crew friendly and even a simple inflight meal of a box of tea and a cake was provided
A very nice small airport with all that is needed except a coffee shop if I remember correctly Access is easy and clear the terminal clean and there is free parking

Its a small airport with the most basic of facilities but there were no delays in either direction I hope that means they have sorted out immigraton though it may be that my BA flight from London City arrived at a quiet time My only gripe is about one woman on security who was quite unfriendly when she told me I had to return to checkin because she didnt like the look of a vase I had in my carryon bag Otherwise the staff seemed quite friendly

A totally stressfree experience as sampled on a return charter flight from the Tampa Bay area Just eight departure gates but ample seating and a friendly barcafe No TSA hassle either A good gateway to Biloxi the Mississippi Gulf Coast and even Mobile AL Close to I
Havana Cayo Coco return A one hour flight with an old ATR turboprop Seats surprisingly comfortable and we were offered a free drink plus candy onboard Nothing special but we arrived on time

Minsk to Gatwick The airport in Minsk looks like it has been renovated recently and it was modern and efficient Boarding was slightly delayed but we got to Gatwick on time The aeroplane was fairly comfortable and you get a bit more room in an Embraer which has a x seating configuration The food and beverages were quite good and the aeroplane had some cool branding featuring a tankbased computer game that was developed in Belarus Cabin crew were a little gruff and could have been warmer and more welcoming but overall its a decent product and good value for money

Ms Terri V who was the boarding agent for my flight provided phenomenal customer service when it was needed most When I realized that my lay over time from my connecting flight to my final destination was tight she was able to move me up four rows with no extra charge She was friendly patient and wanted to do what was right for the customer given my situation when many others may have not cared as much She is someone other boarding and TSA agents should emulate not just here in San Antonio but around other airports as well

I travelled all around the world I saw many regional airports WroclawBreslau was excellent Everything went quickly Staff were really helpful no queues Brilliant seats before departure No problem with luggage One minus no good access to the city transport You must take a taxi to drive to the center

Bangkok Airways is a lovely boutique airline They are well run pleasant and efficient They go the extra mile Id fly again with them in a heartbeat Its a hr flight from Sukhothai to Bangkok Due to massive flooding the road to the airport was closed However the airfield was dry and the flight stayed on time How did we get there They sent a WD pickup truck to meet us on the other side of the Yom River at a temple where our driver could get us The drive through the flood waters was tricky but we made it as did a nearly full cabin of other passengers We were not charged for this service if there was a charge the place where we stayed may have picked it up The flight is about an hour Still they served a meal and a good one at that

On December st I had booked a flight for my dad and his brothers to Cape Town I joined them we were helped by Thabile Mchunu at Counter and she was absolutely amazing My elders had never taken a flight before and he kindness and friendliness was amazing and helpful to calm the nerves

A small but tidy airport adequate for short transits The securityxray procedures for transit can be time consuming if more than one flight arrives at once Expect an hour of queueing to get through the security If you have a short connection staff will call you out of the normal queue just in time for your flight For longer transits there is nothing to do in the airport and little food The only coffee shop airside was closed in December A transit visa is available on arrival for AU and costs BN Money exchange is near the immigration area and easy Meter taxis are supposed to be available but on my pm arrival none were available unmetered all charge BN for even the shortest trip On my return the next morning the hotel booked me a car for Overall a transit stop in a budget hotel adds AU to your trip Unfortunately the new schedule with Royal Brunei since Oct now require long stopovers and overnight transit in Brunei when connecting to SEA destinations and this now makes other more expensive airlines a more attractive option Dry flights and inconsistent alcohol rules may also influence travellers Immigration staff are slow poorly organized and lazy Visa stamps tend to take up a full passport page where they could use only a third like other countries This trip was minutes waiting at immigration Business Class lounge is quiet and comfortable for short stops Has shower facilities but nowhere to sleep Food is hit and miss depending on time of day and number of guests No alcohol in the lounge An airport to be tolerated rather than enjoyed SingaporeKuala LumperBangkok are all far better options

I flew in January with Edelweiss from Zurich to Cape Town with my friend Everything was excellent from the very beginning The crew was very nice and helpful answered all my questions accurately and professionally On the way from Cape Town we transferred to another flight in Zurich to Budapest The crew informed us about the ground gate the time of departure and all the necessary information needed for the transfer The food was fine the whole flight went quickly and I was very satisfied I will definitely choose this company for future flights The aircraft was clean tidy and everything met my expectations The toilets were also in great condition and clean The crew at the airport was very nice and helpful

CDGTIPOUA out ABJTIPCDG return Excellent flight to TIP clean new A with good food and friendly staff Flight to OUA similarly well presented Unfortunately the flight from ABJTIP was operated by Nouvelair on Afriqiyahs behalf other passengers also noticed the difference with grumpy staff and terrible food Happy to return to CDG with Afriqiyah again and more good service

Rimini Airport is highly recommended as a way to access the Adriatic Riviera This smaller than average airport is located on the edge of Rimini MiraMare and is well connected to Rimini and the train stations by coach and a local tram service is not far away either The negative aspect is that the lack of clear signs inside the airport for ground transport could be very misleading for newly arrived passengers and lead the newly arrived into the hands of very expensive taxi drivers Rimini Airport has some nice shops and is well set out I highly recommend this airport

After standing at passport control for over hour It was our turn Seconds earlier a couple appeared in another queue next to ours My partner who speaks the language perfectly pointed out that there was a queue Also someone else in the queue pointed it out as well The passport officer told us to go back over the red line And told this couple to come forward Not military not late for the same flight as us Cant believe that someone should get preferential treatment at passport control

Being a frequent traveler to Ancona Airport I have expectations that are met every time Since this airport is so tiny checkin and security are a breeze The single terminal is fairly clean and peaceful The Italian shops have what you expect The only problem I have with this airport is that you cant get coffee in the terminal This isnt much of a problem though because you can simply get it outside There isnt anything wrong with this airport but its not extraordinary It is very relaxed and is a good airport

Northwest Arkansas Regional Airport may be the best smallmedium airport in the United States In spite of being a regional airport in a small state XNA has direct flights to New York DC San Francisco and LAX This unparalleled service is ideal for business travelers and those making connections to international flights Most of the planes that fly out of XNA are regional jets CRJ or Embraer but they fly to most of the countrys major hubs The ground services are also above and beyond what is typical of an airport this size with a large brewpub and highquality furnishings I am definitely impressed and would fly from XNA again

Much better now that they inaugurated the new pier More shops restaurants although some are overpriced and seats available Good staff and cleanlinessThe restrooms are very good and clean One problem is the distances between checkin and boarding

This airport has a extremely large number of visitors Ground transport and flow to and from are fine Concessions facilities and restaurants are far and few between sit down bar restaurant for many gates waiting lines everywhere all facilities both male and female have long lines Very far behind the times would rather fly to any other airport in they area

Mahan Air from Kuala Lumpur to Tehran Check in was fast and friendly The signage to find the premier lounge in Kuala Lumpur airport was almost nonexistent and took me a while to locate the lounge which offered minimum amenities Boarding was efficient and the A was packed for this flight The aircraft interior was new and clean with smiling crew The flat bed was great and plenty of food was offered for this hour flight Perhaps the refreshment pizza and a burrito at the end of the flight was a bit too much Only negative thing I can think of was not much entertainment and it was limited to public LCDs Considering the business class fare was almost cheaper than other airlines which operated indirect service it was a good buy I was especially impressed by the very attentive flight attendants Overall a good flight

The airport itself is nice as others have commented I travel through here about once a month and the new terminal is very comfortable and pleasant However the local security is capricious at best They seem to give security agents very little guidance but a huge amount of leeway I have had toothpaste confiscated no pastes they said a bar of soap no soaps they said and the list goes on and on I am all for reasonable and tight security but it seems like every trip I have a random item confiscated And it is not just me I see it happen to others all the time too
Its not crowded Its very new and clean airport Sign and directions are easy to follow Before my departure time I really enjoy spending time Ankara airport Esenboga

The airport is clean very functional and not too big to the point it becomes customer unfriendly As expected most products available to buy are well overpriced Passport control and security was a breeze

A very easy and pleasant airport to use On arrival I was able to exit the terminal in less than five minutes In the arrival concourse is a staffed information booth a shop closed when I arrived at night and rental car booths Taxis waited outside I called a Uber Departure was likewise very easy I printed out my boarding passes from a machine The shop gifts snacks and reading materials was open University of Notre Dame paraphernalia was noticeable TSA security check was unhurried and polite After security there are a couple of good places to eat and drink The bathrooms were clean The concourse was airy with high ceiling and glass panes that allowed you to watch tarmac and runway activity The airport is about a minute drive from downtown South Bend

My experiences with customs and immigration have always been exceptionally pleasurable Over the past year I arrived in Cayman a dozen times to meet with immigration lawyers on the basis that I will move here The officers greet me warmly and I am processed efficiently I usually try to fly in in midweek when it is less crowded However yesterday I arrived on Saturday This was an interesting experience because the airport was almost full to capacity causing long lines and delays I suggest any traveller to avoid arriving or departing on a Saturday or Sunday because there can be many flights arriving and departing The airport is safe clean and convenient Everyone is friendly and easygoing I love it here I suggest everyone come visit at least once in their lifetime This is paradise an expensive paradise though

I flew from Glasgow to Halifax in August with Europe Airpost I was attracted by the great ticket price and a direct flight to Halifax Nova Scotia The ticket was almost half the price of the major international airlines An extra leg room seat cost Euro each outward and Euro return each fantastic value The flight was very pleasant a clean aircraft complimentary newspapers headsets and meals The crew was pleasant but unobtrusive Flights in both directions departed and arrived on time It is the first transatlantic flight I have made in a small aircraft like this Boeing it resulted in smaller than normal queues to embark and disembark and also to reclaim baggage Not much else can be said except great flight great price I wish air travel was always like this

The crew were attentive and friendly and constantly checking we are ok I would especially like to thank flight attendant Osher who noticed I was upset and on the verge of crying and took me aside for a chat tissue and tea This made me feel I am already at home even before landing

Bari Airport looks new but they have not yet found a way to avoid a minute wait for security checks Leaving tourists in a minute queue for security is not a good way to attract tourists If the queue is minutes on th April what will it be in July and August Puglia is a great region to visit and Bari is an excellent gateway Pity the local autorities cant run an airport

Definitely deserves Nice staff and beautiful sight I loved how they just fit I didnt like that there are two gates and you have to wait a while for the second one too Usually there is only one The bathrooms were clean and had great terminal seating

My recent minute flight from DCA to PHL operated by PSA Airlines for American Eagle was a pleasant experience Despite a minor delay while waiting for the crew to arrive from another flight the service was good We were offered a predeparture beverage and even received beverage service during the short flight a nice touch for such a brief journey The CRJ proved to be more comfortable than the CRJ making the quick trip enjoyable For such a short flight theres truly nothing to complain about

I like that Recaro seats were used The seat was very soft and legroom was actually the most I have gotten thus far even for such a tiny plane like the A neo It was very well kept and modern and the cabin was spotlessly clean There was even a meal on the short flight of hours Excellent experience However there was no screens for IFE but there was a cool magazine that kept me entertained so yeah However there unfortunately was a karen or kevin or whatever you call it on our flight The crew were very professional

I had a fantastic experience at Ben Gurion airport From the moment I arrived everything was smooth and efficient The checkin process was quick security lines were wellorganized and the staff was friendly and professional The terminal was clean spacious and wellmaintained with plenty of seating areas to relax before my flight I was especially impressed with the variety of shops and dining optionsthere was something for everyone Free WiFi was fast and reliable making it easy to get work done while waiting Boarding was handled efficiently and overall the experience was stressfree and friendly I highly recommend this airport for its excellent service and organization Looking forward to flying through here again

Used Kilimanjaro as our entry point for Tanzanias northern safari circuit KLM was the only flight arrival at the time the airport though small had the fresh feel of yester years relaxed airports walking to arrival area ushered by ground staff No soulless airbridges and automatic sliding doors leading to empty spaces The whole ambience was relaxed Immigration was quick and efficient they had a green and red channel when tried to walk through green channel were asked politely to go through red were asked a few cursory questions and waved through total time from disembarkation from the airplane to the waiting car less than minutes The charm of this airport is that it is not like the other mega airports small and fresh

This airport was very wellrun when me and my family were here We were going to Punta Cana for a family vacation through jetBlue We were able to get through security smoothly and the customs and shuttles were fast The food court provided a wide variety of foods for me and my family to choose from and everything was very modern The bathrooms were clean enough for usage The only con about this airport was the lack of the jet bridge It didnt help that it was raining upon our leaving Punta Cana We experienced torrential downpour and had to quickly get onboard and we were drenched by the time we were on the plane But there were also many good things about this airport and I would not mind visiting it again

I have been flying with Volotea for years and have never had any problems I believe that the company is one of the best in existence This is due to all the staff and the company organization Sono anni che volo con Volotea non ho avuto mai problemi Ritengo che la compagnia sia una delle migliori tra quelle in essere Questo merito vs al personale tutto e allorganizzazione aziendale

Recently opened airport because the former airport in Matshapa is now being used as something else The new location is quite inconvenient because it takes more than an hour from Mbabane city centre and I would strongly recommend that you use the road from Johannesburg to Mbabane because it takes only four hours from SA Cost wise it is also efficient to use the road

From the first step of the airplane at Koh Samui Airport I felt that I was in a tropical paradise It was not a standard airport bus but a train of small wagons painted in bright colours Airport is a complex of many small buildings in Thai style connected by open galleries A lot of open space just covered with roof from rain Many trees and flowers Even an aquarium in WC There are minibuses for transfer to Samui hotels and of course you can take an individual taxi with fixed price

Saint Petersburg to Samara The airline is very good The cabin is clean and comfortable and with this always promised food and friendly staff As for the baggage allowance things are even better the baggage allowance is kilograms

A moderate sized airport with fast security processing times decent dutyfree shopping and enough seats with a power socket Signaling isnt the clearest however as the airport was build in steps Half of the gates are bus boarding only It has a convenient metro connection to the city center Wifi was quite good and staff friendly and helpful

I was pleasantly surprised by my flight with Sri Lankan airlines from Delhi to Sydney via Colombo All the flights were within minutes of on time and the staff I dealt with were very helpful and courteous The lounges in Delhi and Columbo were very good with a range of food and comfortable seating The lounge staff in Colombo were particularly friendly Boarding was done in an orderly fashion with business class and elites boarding first On arrival at Colombo a remote stand was used and business class was taken in a separate bus from economy passengers There is no additional security at Colombo so you walk into the terminal and transfers can be very quick The seat on the A was a recliner seat which was surprisingly confortable with a pillow and blanket and I fell asleep for an hour or so of the hour flight The staff on this flight were exceptional quickly dealing with refilling glasses and removing completed food courses The food was excellent and the servings were quite large The A seats are fairly standard business class with a small cubby hole for your feet They are not that new but they are confortable enough There is no mattress topper or pyjamas provided but the pillow is quite comfortable and the blanket is very warm Usual amenities are provided toothpaste and brush eye mask socks moisturisers and lip balm In flight entertainment has a large range of TV and movies to watch Obviously many South Asian content but also lots of Western content The hard product does need an update but it still works quite well Staff vary flight to flight but from this flight I would highly recommend them I have also travelled from Melbourne to Delhi with Sri Lankan and the service was just as good on that occassion

The seat was spacious but the recline function was lost on my seat Crew were friendly They offered one meal plus one snack for just hours The onboard announcement was inaccurate that they claimed to be landing soon hours before the actual landing Surprisingly personal onboard entertainment was offered

My son and I flew them in June from Copenhagen to Podgorica It was an older F aircraft but quite comfortable In fact we commented on how far the seats reclined The flight attendants were nice and the cockpit crew did a nice job getting us there safely We departed on time and arrived on time No complaints

Richmond is a medium size airport that has recently been extensively renovated My experience flying in and out was very pleasant RIC is a human sized airport so it is easy to get around Baggage recovery was fast and painless with our checked bags appearing only about five minutes after we had arrived at the carousel The rental car desks are conveniently sited and the rental car garage is a two minute walk from the terminal Our total time from landing to driving off in a rental car was less than thirty minutes The airport is well connected to the adjacent Interstate highway so the airport is easy to get into and out of On departure checkin and security was quick and painless There is a restaurant in the secure area offering a view of the ramp a pleasant thing for the travelling aircraft buff Overall I was very impressed with Richmond airport and would use it again anytime

Tontouta Airport is a building dating back to the s offering basic facilities However it is undergoing an amazing expansion and facelift which looks promising modern with pleasant architecture and more userfriendly The new airport should be completed by On arrival pax climb down steps and cross the airparking zone to enter the airport There are fivesix immigration booths open per flight however the quarantine service is small and slow Tontouta airport is a no smoking area The departure hall is of reasonable size for the current traffic and the ground staff is friendly The caf is expensive and basic but it could be worse The whole airport is a free WIFI zone On departure after checking in the luggage pax often wait long minutes in a line to perform the immigration and security controls The police and security staff are usually friendly enough though cruelly lacking the ability to communicate in English The boarding lounge where the gates are located is well air conditioned though boring The main features being a largish dutyfree shop and a caf on the st floor The business class lounge is comfortable and obviously more interesting There is a postoffice and a bank in both arrival and boarding lounges for money exchange however the only ATM distributor is in the main hall across from the souvenir shop

Flew NIKI from Valencia to Vienna Quick boarding and ontime departure Cabin was clean and the flight was smooth and relaxed Cabin crew provided drinks and a very good cheese sandwich Later they provided us another round of water and coffee Seats a little bit narrower than other airlines Paid for a return ticket for flying with a very good airline

This is a very small airport but it is clean convenient and easy to get around Passing through security was a breeze no big queues to wait at The waiting room was easy to find and it was nice clean and comfortable There isnt many places to eat or shop but I really dont care for that Airport staff was ok they arent the friendliest out there but they werent rude either It is a shame there is no public transport access to the airport except for a mini bus that links to the major hotels but not to the city

Travelled twice fromto Joburg Very small airport used mainly and maybe only to reach Okawango Delta A couple of flight per day to South Africa and Gaborone twice a week to Namibia However it is usually quite busy because all small airplanes leaves from here to all airstrips in Okawango Security control also for internal flights with these small planes One gate you walk to the airplane There are no facilities inside only one toilet and no food and shops one checkin desk that open hours before flight but the queue is reasonable It is a safe airport quite clean but not the place where youd like to spend more time than necessary Nice shop and honest food just in front of the airport

The flight was great However it could still improve Bring your own tablets as the IFE systems were kind of laggy and the choices were very limited The seats were quite hard and on my nd flight the seat recline was broken so I had to manually force it back to the original position The food was wonderful and so were the staff

Flight SN on the st of October Efficient boarding welcoming crew and comfortable seats The flight left with a slight delay of but arrived earlier in Stockholm The highlight was the crew Charming well groomed cheerful and carried out an excellent cabin bag management during boarding The seemed to be enjoying their jobs and their enthusiasm was contagious It was a pleasure to fly them

Getting in yesterday was ok except for having to walk great distances when my partner and I have hip issues Being offered a ride on an electric cart that did not happen Then today we sat in the check in area for more the an hour waiting for someone to push our wheelchairs to our gate We were taken to the head of the line only to have to wait But everyone was very nice
Very convenient airport as it is not very large Signs are clear getting to and from the airport is easy too Shops are available post office included The terminal is clean

Manston is an excellent small airport The staff immigration customs and police are friendly but still professional Checkin was handled well Security was a little laborious but was thorough and in no way objectionable There is a small shop and a barcafeteria which considering the short amount of time needed to check in is all that is required A great option for those traveling to or from the south east corner of England I hope the route to Amsterdam is successful as it is so much more pleasant than flying from one of the big London airports Heathrow in particular I have heard that a rail link will be coming

I traveled to Bengkulu Indonesia to visit friends for the first time in November Flew on Lion Air Upon arriving at the airport we deplane using stairs and walked on the tarmac to the arrival building It was late afternoon with the sun just about to set The airport building is very quaint Nice outdoor gardens greet you and on the day I arrived a nice afternoon breeze Slowly make the way to the inside of the terminal where one luggage belt half inside the terminal and a portion outside the terminal awaits The luggage eventually arrives and it gives you time to see the pictures of some of the sights to see in Bengkulu Once luggage in hand you go outside where there are various options for transport to where ever you are going I was met by friends that took me to the hotel Two weeks later I left Bengkulu and experienced the departure area You go through the usual security immediately upon entering the terminal say your good byes outside the door then walk to the check in desk where you obtain your boarding pass and check your luggage English is not widely spoken at the airport if at all but I had no issues whatsoever You then go to the gate area nice seats air conditioned tvs bathrooms and probably restaurants though I left on the first flight out and I not see anything to buy food or drinks Eventually they called the flight once again no English and we boarded the same way nice walk outside to the waiting aircraft All in all a really nice experience in this airport

First impression of Minsk airport was given by its exterior grand Brutalist Sovietera architecture Very impressive Inside the terminal doesnt feel grand and impressive I was in transit only so I only saw the arrival gates transfer area and the airside departure areas The arrivals area is a bit of a maze and signage not that clear So be sharp when looking for the transit area after arrivals The transfer area was old fashioned with worn fakeleather couches that seem to taken from a landfill Queuing time at the transfer area was OK around minutes After boarding card check passengers process through security which was a bit of a joke as passengers are not checked at all after passing the walkthrough metal detector The departures area with its shops is a bit of a maze and the gate waiting areas are very small There is not a lot of choice in shops what I saw was mostly liquor or food and beverage outlets Seating in the gate waiting areas is limited but on the upper level of the departures area there is sufficient space to take a rest on one of the seats At the upper level there are also seats on which you can recline but these seats are quite hard and not very comfortable to take a good nap There are also sleeping cabins here Wifi works great login via SMS Terminal and toilets are clean especially at the upper level where not a lot of people go The terminal it not really fit for PRM passengers as there are a lot of stairs but not escalators and just a few lifts They did install stairlifts at the gates a rather silly solution in my opinion but is works This airport is fine when you have a short transfer In case of a long transfer it can be boring and FB options are very limited

The addition of the new Southwest wing has been a good improvement for all those who enjoy flying on this airline Flying out of this airport has been very convenient because of its location for many Long islanders especially those living in Suffolk and eastern Nassau counties The one drawback to the Southwest facility expansion is the distance from their new gates to the baggage claims area

Excellent airport Arrived at am on the BA London flight First time visit to India so I stopped off at the biometric finger print machine queued for minutes and completed he task in mins Went to border control There is a separate queue for business class travellers and they checked my boarding pass I could have done the finger prints here The agent wanted to see my eVisa print out Kind of defeats the object of have an eVisa But processed and passport stamped and quickly through By the time I arrived at the baggage claim my luggage had already arrived I then exited to meet my pre booked driver Took about mins from getting off the plane to getting into the car Departure had to get a ticket check before entering the terminal I have checked in online but mobile boarding pass not available Had to show the eTicket on my phone to get into the terminal I also had a print out of the itinerary Check in business class for BA flight to London only agent so about mins spent Dedicated business security lane was reasonably efficient Went to the Encalm business lounge to find a queue but this was the Priority pass queue the agent called business and first class travellers to the front I was then redirected to another lounge Enclam Prive I dont know what the differences are but I needed an airline invite to get in Nice big lounge with a huge choice of food some cooked to order Efficient boarding in groups and policed very well Overall a great airport experience

Madrid airport really easy to manage Security really fast for premium passangers a breeze Then on to the lounge good selection of food and beverages Lots of space Boarding ok by buses not the best Once on board warm welcome by crew by my name welcome drinks and really comfy seats All amenities blanket and pillow are ok compared to other carriers but the best for me is the food and wine selection Good service Manage a good sleep before served nd meal before arrival IFE really good headsets could improve not the best Arrival T at JFK short on taxi after landing so great job

I dont know what all the fuss was about Bad reviews about security dirty airport unfriendly staff no seating I experienced none of that In view of the negative reviews we arrived hours before take off and were through security in five minutes Very cheerful efficient and friendly staff Bought some items at duty free and the lady there was extremely pleasant and helpful Plenty of seating Good food and drink offers and both the airport and toilets were very clean Boarding process straightforward and stressless On return our plane landed about minutes behind schedule This unfortunately coincided with other flights landing at the same time so passport control was very busy but it only took about minutes to get through The staff there were smiling at I understand why passengers complain but its also useful to get positive reviews sometimes I hope my next experience of Leeds Bradford will be as good as this one

Not a shining example of modern airport technology but it works Arrival was quite easy since by the time our visas had been processed the queues had gone Departure very easy with short queues The only downside would be the fact that smoking seems to be allowed everywhere and ashtrays are not in use Hence the cafe is rather uncomfortable Everyone was very friendly and helpful

We are longtime members of another airlines frequent flyer program and lounge but ion this occasion chose Rex at the th hour as it was the only airline that hadnt hiked its fares dramatically for the last couple of days before departure We were very pleasantly surprised for want of a better term Despite costing us less than half what the competitors were offering the service was exemplary On needing a booking matter checked and dealt with by customer service I was very happy to find myself speaking to someone local who understood the exact situation and fixed it quickly and easily The airliner itself was modern clean and well presented staff were friendly and relaxed We also won a bid to get bumped up to business class which was a first Cant fault Rex we will fly them again in the near future

CPHHurghadaCPH Flew this airline as part of a charter flightholiday in the Red Sea Both flights I enjoyed immensely Credit for this goes to the cabin crew and their ability to generate such a happy atmosphere in cabin The food quality served was by far the best I have put my teeth into for economy class in more than years of flying around the world On top of this the plane was literally an all new A I had paid a little extra for a few extra centimetres of leg space thumbs up arrival on time at both ends
Needed a wheel chair because of an injury people were so helpful and caring A special thank you to Damian who pushed my wheel chair So grateful Thank you

Nice and clean airport As an avgeek I love watching planes and there are so many big windows next to restaurants to watch planes Security wasnt long The checkin staff were really nice On arrival Immigration was really quick and baggage claim was surprisingly quick Very quick and free wifi
