My recent flight with Binter Canarias from Fuerteventura to Las Palmas was a delightful surprise The flight itself was a breeze clocking in at just minutes and departed right on schedule Binter Canarias impressed me most with their commitment to passenger comfort despite the short flight duration The aircraft a brand new ATR felt incredibly spacious with ample legroom The cabin crew were topnotch professional friendly and accommodating They even provided a complimentary snack of water candy and a chocolate bar a small gesture that went a long way Considering the price I paid for the ticket the overall experience felt miles ahead of what Ive come to expect from many established European legacy carriers Binter Canarias exceeded my expectations in every way If youre looking for a comfortable and hasslefree way to island hop in the Canaries I wouldnt hesitate to recommend them

Porto to Paris Orly on ZI A on March First time on this airline and Im a little bit unimpressed with checkin at Porto Airport No effort to direct passengers to correct boarding desks hence I ended up in the webcheck inbagdrop queue with passengers who had not even checked in online Thankfully queue was processed within minutes and got to the gate with plenty of time to spare My seat was next to the emergency exit so I had plenty of legroom Seat itself was comfy and perfect for a nap Crew extremely professional and always had a smile on their faces Flight took off on time and landed smoothly in ParisOrly minutes ahead of scheduled arrival time Once on the ground we were told by the cabin crew that the captain of this Aigle Azur flight had piloted his last flight so we promptly congratulated him as we departed the aircraft All in all Aigle Azur was worth the money that I paid Not sure if Ill have another chance to travel on them again but if they have routes that I want to fly Ill keep them in mind

First time with Swiss and first time ever in Business Class Could not fault in any way from the moment we got on board until we disembarked Actually felt like a valued customer and the crew could not do enough for us The food was top notch better than some restaurants we have been in The lie flat beds are comfortable but was unable to get much if any sleep due to turbulence and excitement at seeing my son at the other end The IFE was very good with loads to choose from I watched all episodes of Almas not Normal Brilliant comedy on duch a long flight The BC section was tastefilly done with light wood and soft colours giving the sectuon a nice intimate feel I would not hesitate in flying Swiss BC again an all round great experience

This is a good airline with more legroom than most for economy and I have taken it a few times already this year but I am considering switching to United from now on The inflight entertainment is sparse And even the little that they have is almost useless to nonKoreans because they do not have subtitles Somewhat related to above United now has Starlink giving me not only entertainment options from my laptop but the ability for me to be online I like the extra legroom of Air Premia but fast and free unlimited internet service is very compelling

This airport continues to improve as it gets more and more traffic Air Seychelles are the ground handling company and they have built an excellent lounge for premium passengers It really is very very nice The shopping improves with every visit and the space available keeps increasing in size for passengers to stroll That with the friendly and helpful staff makes it a winner

Pros The flight attendants were kind and helped us with the wifi for minutes Very helpful mindful and demure The food was great I was not expecting that Legroom was wonderful Me being m there was easily lots of legroom Theseat was hard IFE sucked and dirty floors

Tanahmerah to Korowai Batu This route is a governmentsubsidized one operated with tiny aircraft carrying only about a dozen passengers No advance booking possible but Dimonim staff were helpful in getting us on a flight the same day Departure time was uncertain but we eventually got on the plane Once aboard it was a great flight offering sweeping views of the rivers and rain forests below Cheap too

Singapore airport is magnificent and extremely wellmaintained with its facilities gardens waterfalls etc but arriving in the country has been made very difficult for Nordics There is no one at the immigration department upon arrival you first have to fill out a variety of information in English on a small computer which can take up to an hour If the machine accepts everything be happy There was no one to assist you in the queue of dozens of people at the machines And if you are accepted you go to another automatic machine where you present your passport and other necessary documents Your bag has been spinning for a long time waiting for you to pick it up from the belt When leaving the country everything seemed to be OK but then the departure security check began which was anything but friendly The border control officers who were clearly enjoying it gave orders and ripped off the jackets of older people who did not obey at the same second A militarystyle manly arrogant woman took my passport and boarding pass away because they noticed my diabetes pills everything was drugs to them Then I was ordered aside and subjected to various tactile tests with a digital device They couldnt didnt care to read prescriptions Overall it had the feel of being in the military chain of command

Only good thing about Bangalore airport terminal is it is beautiful and clean No other facilities available like other airports It does not have much food stalls and shopping area near GATES Moreover toilet are very far from gate location Less seating areas

Small airport by international standards Immigration and customs smiling and welcoming Departure easy with only one aircraft departure tax has to be paid and quite rigorous security procedure but done with typical Cook Islands good nature Walk from terminal to aircraft across tarmac necessary Could be a wet one in a tropical downpour

It was really nice experience this was my first journey with Vistara I am feet height and still I was able to sit comfortably They provided food also after long time get food in Indian domestic flight was a good feel Every days we used to get in jet and kingfisher airlines It was a nice experience now waiting for my connecting flight to Dubai

I took domestic flights with Iraqi Airways from Basra to Baghdad and then a return to Sulaymaniyah One was on a smaller Bombardier and the others on a B The Basra flight was delayed a couple of hours because of fog No problems with that it happens I missed my next flight on a different ticket to Erbil The later flights were all full so they changed my ticket to Sulaymaniyah at no cost All aircrafts were good particularly the B which was not very old at all The B had good leg room was clean in flight entertainment and a reasonable snack was served The smaller Bombadier whilst a little older was perfectly OK Overall a good experience

Over the years have had the pleasure of travelling through this airport surely the best planned facility of its size anywhere in the world Maybe all wouldbe new airport planners should pay Norfolk a visit to see what a well designed airport should look like and thats not even mentioning the surrounding beautiful botanical gardens a very pleasant change from the usual grimy industrial areas adjoining most airports

TLVTLS Flights were on time the plane was clean inside and the seats were comfortable but there was not enough legroom The crew were very friendly and professional We got tasty sandwiches and drinks Take off and landing were excellent We will recommend

Tel Aviv to Minsk Amazing flight no delays we boarded quickly clean aircraft really comfy seats and the food was great choice between sausages and beef and we got a waffle cherries bread with the the meal Staff was really nice no complaints

All flights were on time and comfortable Cabin crew were friendly and welcoming On board snacks to buy were good value Seat pitch good average Last year we few with this company from Madrid to Malta and return Both flights very good

Compared to so many airports a delightful experience I was first off my arriving flight and so did not have to queue for a visa Only one person was doling them out so I guess that stragglers had quite a wait On departure plenty of shops for such a small airport with plenty of seating both indoors and out no problems in either direction with passport or customs

Always love to travel tofrom Kaohsiung airport very convenient to city center and Kaohsiung train station via metro small airport but got everything you need cafe restaurant duty free ground staffimmigrationsecurity always friendly and efficient Both China Airlines and EVA Air lounges are nice with plenty of food and drinks

Launceston Airport has seen a large redevelopment program completed over the period At the northern end of the terminal are checkin counters for Qantaslink Jetstar Virgin Blue and Tiger Airways which has created more room than before Southern end of the terminal has two baggage carousels added with car rental counters opposite for Avis Budget Europcar Hertz Thrifty Red Spot New upgraded retail outlets are provided in the central section of the terminal which are Newslink Long Bar and Hudsons Coffee This central area has been expanded with a greater amount of room making it easier when more than one flight is in at the same time New security area directs passengers downstairs to new roomy departure lounges which are now at the lower level Windows at the central section and the departure lounges give visitors and passengers great views of the mountains east of the airport This redevelopment has made Launceston Airport a lot more user friendly than previously

The best airline I have tried till now The best pilots they are very competent The service is good Delicious food Im proud to be Lebanese and to have such a company The tickets are expensive but its worth it

The airport is clean very functional and not too big to the point it becomes customer unfriendly As expected most products available to buy are well overpriced Passport control and security was a breeze

Completely pleasant airport Small very clean shopcaferestaurantprices much lower than in Borispol Easily accessible from center by taxi or trolleybus just plan enough time in traffic peaks of Kyiv and Close to very recommendable planemuseum in pedestrian distancemaybe mins to walk Customs working attentively but very polite Immigration takes usually more time mins in average than emigration but much more quickly than in Borispol The same about security Free wifi works properly and fast Have no post office in terminal but one across parking lot located left direction of entrance behind the power plant of the airport

Contrary to what I had expected to find at a small domestic airport the terminal was beautifully clean well laid out with the benefit of some shops friendly staff who helped us through the security and check in process Ladies toilets both Indian and Western style were acceptably clean AC was okay if you were standing under it I would have no hesitation in travelling through this airport again on future visits to India Well done to those who maintain the Airport keep up the good work

Older Dash but comfortable and good leg room but very noisy Departed on time friendly sole flight attendant juice and water on offer and great views of the Atolls they were organised friendly and have pride in their brand and country cant ask for more than that A bit pricey but no competition I guess

A modern stylish and clean airport with good facilities but rather small The checkin area in terminal was rather crowded as were the departure gate areas Immigration was rather slow and unnecessarily complicated Customs were simple There wasnt enough seating in the gate area and the restaurant was busy There were plenty of Duty Free shops and in fact too many All in all a very nice airport

Everything that has been written here is still true including the mystery unannounced departure fee US one time Sudanese pounds another made more interesting because Sudan is transitioning between dinars and pounds Flights do leave in the middle of the night because the middle of the day is unbearably warm and they do leave late so patience and flexible travel schedule is a must Bureaucracy is still in full effect with multiple Xrays and searches Courtesy is in rare supply And yes Sudanese do not queue for anything You just shove and elbow and get to the front of the crowd any way you can Even for no reason the mob getting in the front door resembled a rugby scrum but once inside there were no big crowds and thus no reason to push and shove rather than just wait in line its just the way theyve always done it I had the chance to leave via the new International Terminal that opened this month and was pleasantly surprised Air conditioned spacious ceilings numerous clean restrooms watersnacks for sale plenty of seats in the departure lounge actual flatscreen TVs showing when flights are scheduled to take off It is dare I say closer to what other international airports are like than it has ever been That being said if you have reason to travel to Sudan than you probably already know to expect the unexpected

We found Banjul airport very efficient and friendly As we were on foot from the main road we were expecting a long walk to the terminal but we shouldnt have worried as within m of the airport entrance we were asked if we would like a lift in a chauffeur driven car taking the security supervisor to work We gratefully accepted and on reaching the terminal he insisted on helping us check in quickly as we had no hold baggage Boarding cards in hand we rapidly went through security and mins later were sitting in the pleasant open air departure area and ordering a couple of beers and a sandwich Service indeed and for the most part delivered with a smile

Use the airport regularly and its great parking facilities are next to the terminal so no need to go on a five mile cross country slog with children in tow nor wait for a packed shuttle boss and try and cram all luggage and children on board As stated before the airport is small and basic understatement but then again I dont use airports to sit in or spend all my holiday money in shops before i even depart the UK something which I think happens at many of the larger airports A very short walk from the terminal the interim passenger facility as it is more technically known to the plane and then you are away on your flight Coming back is so easy as well the arrivals area is a seperate building from departures If two planes arrive at the same time then I am under the impression that one has to wait for a short period of time foir the arrivals area to clear However after disembarking getting through passport control and getting to the baggage claim belt we were waiting for about two minutes and then hey presto the bags started coming through Again a very short walk to the car park ever present taxis and an hourly bus service tofrom the railway station and city centre are also available and we were offhome within minutes of landingat a bigger airport just down the A I have been waiting for minutes just for the baggage carousel to start revolving All in all it is basic but it does exactly what it says on the tin its a building well two buildings for passengers getting to or arriving from a city by air and it does this with minimum of fuss and least amount of time In some ways it is a good alternative for any inbound passengers wishing to avoid the congested London Airports the bus to the railway station and frequent trains to the centre of London could have you in the capital very easily Heres hoping for the new terminal an increase in services and more airlines I know I shall be a regular user of Coventry Airport and so shall my friends family and colleagues for many years to come

A typical Ryanair airport Small and miles from anywhere although perhaps suitable for the Alps and skiing access or unless you have relatives nearby However it meant that from the plane to the car hire desk was about metres and we were on our way less than minutes after landing If you need a train the station is literally metres from the terminal door Its not an architectural gem the seating is limited and hard but it has a cafe and a shop and its efficient and has what you need The staff were friendly and allowed us to board first on our return to the UK as my wife had a broken hand in plaster As long as the plane is on time it does the job well
Flew Tokyo Narita Sapporo Tokyo Narita Flight from Narita was on time while from Sapporo to Narita was delayed for hour Overall flight was ok Ground staff very professional

My adult daughter had just returned from her connection in Las Vegas to Baltimore Airport in route to her final home destination in Maryland My daughter had difficulty locating her car and had gotten on the wrong airport bus Now normally this is frustrating for anyone but my daughter is autistic so trying to problem solve while in a heightened emotional state is a big struggle for her Morgan is higher functioning and prides herself on how independent she is but after a night of flying across country and running to connection flights she was feeling defeated and concerned about finding her vehicle as the sun was going down A bus driver named Chris on bus was her guardian angel He went out of his way to get her to the correct bus before it got dark when the main office confirmed they were too swamped to assist He even had to deal with an angry traveler yelling at him for taking the extra time of getting Morgan to the correct bus connection although Morgan said he was very efficient and quickly navigated her to the correct destination Thank you Chris your kindness is noticed and the world is a better place because of people like you

Its a smaller airport compared to Mumbai not a problem actually Some toilets on the arrival hall are not good This airport has more shopping options now and its enough actually There are spa and lounge facilities available here The lounges are okay I have never experienced any delay to date Overall an above expectation feel It gets my job done

From and to Singapore on Silk Air This is a functional airport which in the Philippines is high praise Security checks are numerous and slow as everywhere in the Philippines but because of the small number of international passengers moves quite quickly The same can be said for checkin baggage claim and immigration Toilet facilities are sufficient and clean On the downside for those who need shops there is only one very small cafe before immigration and a kiosk selling very basic items in the gate area All in all a good facility in the Philippines

Brussels to Antalya Positively surprised okay we have been on a more recent airplane but it was certainly ok The children were well taken care of and the staff were very friendly Of course there is always one grumpy one which was also the case during our flights Closing off the curtain right in front of you while you want to bring your children to the toilet without any apologies not very polite The words just a second madam would already have been perfect Besides this we had nice flights

Yangon to Nyaung My wife and me flew three routes with Air KBZ over our holiday in Myanmar and we got outstanding service every time The cabin crew all have excellent presentation and are very courteous and attentive We had a cold snack tea and coffee all of which were very tasty on all flights Its unusual to be given cream cakes at am but they were very nice All aircraft used were very clean and in good condition and all flights departed and arrived exactly on time Air KBZ is way better than we expected

The toilets are the cleanest I have seen Im years The customs was quick and efficient I travel every year to Curaao and was a pleasure to see that they are much better than Schiphol Las Americas American airports European airports

A very small airport no airways you walk on the tarmac to the terminal if like most people you need to buy a visa there is a line manned by only people and no organization at all then the customs man grunts at you or makes you open everything but then you are out and in one of the most beautiful places on earth

This review is for Terminal Terminal is dramatically different RGN has undergone vast changes during the last years There remain remnants of the underdeveloped facility that once was but the outside world has arrived in Yangon and at least as far as the airport is concerned it is a good thing CustomsImmigration at both arrival and departure is reasonably fast On the absolute worst day you might wait minutes but an average wait will be minutes or less Lines at check in counters move quickly which is terrific Departure lounges are a lot nicer than they once were Now they sport clean comfortable spaces dependable WiFi and food that works in a pinch Restaurants in the airport are not great but if you want a decent cup of coffee some KFC a Burger King something or other youll be ok Souvenir and duty free shops still have a long way to do Alcohol and cigarettes are fairly priced There are perennially empty luxury clothing brands without customers There are a couple of small boutiques selling attractive textiles carvings local bath products delicious local coffees etc Services are generally more than adequate in the predeparture areas There is a bag wrapping counter for flimsy luggage convenience stores plenty of seating free WiFi etc Taxis downtown should be priced out before you leave Money Change desks offer the exact same rate as all the other places in the country so theres no reason to hold on to your foreign currency The airport is still a work in progress but leaving and arriving in this amazing city is a lot less unpleasant than a few years back

Return flights from Glasgow to Verona Check in was quick as was passing through security Facilities were alright bearing in mind our flight was at am Boarding was efficient Return again was stress free other than the automated passport gate refusing to let me through Baggage was already on the carousel when through security All in all a pretty good experience

Flying from AEP to IGU in Prem Economy I was nervous about what to expect on Aerolineas I have to say that I was really pleasantly surprised once we got on the plane Check in at Business was a breeze Security and Boarding was polite chaos They had two flights going to two locations boarding at the same gate at the same time However the premium economy was great simple but worth the extra The seats were comfortable and clean think that armchair type of seats you use to get in business class Service on this flight was friendly on others it was nonexistant They provided a sandwich and soft drinks The best thing though is on every Aerolineas flight my bags were on the carousel as I arrived there They have some amazing expedited system to get premium bags off which is great

A newly started airport in North Bihar catering large population of North Bihar and even some area of NepalThe airport is actually an operative airport of Indian Airforce and runway is simultaneously used for civilian service The Terminal being used is a temporary one and a new terminal will come soon is years This airport should be seenused for service and facilities but for logistically importance for reaching some of the most undeveloped area in India with ease Terminal is one of the smallest in India but managed nicely no parking available have to park outside the campus on the road from main gate the terminal is just min walk so not an issue trolleys are there washroom are clean there is one tea and snacks shop just near main gate in the campus and use that if you need anything after that wont find anything inside Hope they construct a new terminal soon Though cabs are available outside but no option of prepaid or authorized cab inside better to book cab in advance
New facilities in the national arrivalsdepartures concourse very nice modern terminal new roads from Quito recently finished so the trip to city is quicker and easier overall great airport

Im a Connecticut resident and use Bradley a halfdozen times a year Terminal A is perfectly serviceable nothing fancy but it does the trick Luckily most carriers use it Terminal B which I understand will be closed at the end of cannot be demolished fast enough It is an eyesore with next to no services I guess its only advantage is for people who wonder what air travel used to be like in the s and s They can see firsthand in Terminal B I wish BDL had service to longer haul hubs like DEN and SLC but I guess there isnt enough demand Nonetheless Im perfectly happy using the airport Its smaller size means fewer delays quicker deplaning and some breathing room

A very big shout out to Jude and Liz at the checkin service desk as well as Tup the client manager on the flight I happened to leave a bag containing a priceless religious item at the checkin desk as we were running late for the flight And in my haste I left the bag at the desk I totally forgot about it and would have been extremely devastated and upset if I realised I left it behind Once we boarded the plane and settled in a very kind Tup and other staff member came up to us and returned the bag to us I can only guess that Liz and Jude realised I was a religious Jew and made the effort to return the bag to us on the plane before it took off My wife and I were so touched by this extremely kind gesture We spoke to Tup during the flight and expressed our gratitude but I wanted to leave this note of thanks to Jude and Liz too We always try and fly Rex your staff are friendly and happy so different to the other airlines we have flown on domestically And this incident just reinforces the good vibes we get when flying Rex

Was departing New Orleans two days after jazzfest Had no problems with queueing anywhere Had some time to kill before my flight and sat outside in a cool spot close to where buses depart Spent some time chatting to n airport employee Absolutely delightful polite young man

The best airline I have tried till now The best pilots they are very competent The service is good Delicious food Im proud to be Lebanese and to have such a company The tickets are expensive but its worth it

We booked our return flight as a direct flight which was canceled and then simply staying in Paris We started more than hours later missed our connecting train were poorly provided with drinks unfortunately not a great experience Our direct flight to Colombo from Frankfurt was great very nice staff super on time

I was pleasantly surprised I didnt run into any issues the other reviews described Yes I did need to go through immigration again but there were absolutely no lines at pm on a Thursday Every counter or checkpoint I went through whisked me through quickly and efficiently I had plenty of time to sit down for dinner before my flight and check out some of the shops The airport is clean and modern Some of the seating areas at gates are not that comfortable average but some looked better
My budget airline fare turned out to be a complete surprise with full service and a fairly new A plane The service friendliness and cleanliness are no less than those of Singapore Airlines

Great little airport used mainly by Porter airlines Check in was efficient and you go down to an airport lounge open to everyone They serve free tea coffee and soft drinks along with cookies and nuts The wifi is free and fast Boarding is effortless and the scenery on take off is stunning The only downside was that when the lounge is busy it gets a little grubby with dishes lying everywhere Otherwise it comes highly recommended
Excellent flight left on time and arrived on time Amritsar to Kullu Small aircraft which was about full Great price no complaints from me and would happily fly with them again

Manchester to Tripoli Airbus A Plane was a little old and tired looking Only passengers on board and I was the only one in Business Class Seats were OK food was fine The flight took off on time and arrived in Tripoli on time Based on costs and timings this was very good value compared to British Airways

Brilliant both times we flew them Brilliant food crew especially the Thai based very comfortable seats got a decent amount of sleep Kept snacks in the galleys Stocked bathrooms with toothbrushes eye masks etc Good wifi connectivity decent ife Brilliant airline and will definitely fly again

We had great experiences with Coastal on separate flights within Tanzania Our planes generally had passengers on board plus pilot and copilot For peace of mind we were permitted to check that our bags were in the cargo hold of the plane before boarding I was nervous about flying on such a small aircraft but all flights were smoother than expected and relatively short in duration We experienced excellent customer service via emails when arranging for our XL bags due to equipment for photography and diving and the staff member was able to answer our questions about transfer from the Dar Es Salaam domestic to international terminal Note Its a minute drive and there is a Coastal shuttle that runs between them Only a couple of minor flaws The air conditioning did not appear to be working on one of the planes while we were on the ground so it was very hot One of our flights inexplicably was delayed about minutes but fortunately it did not affect our itinerary in the least Overall I was very happy we chose Coastal Aviation for our interTanzanian flights and would not hesitate to fly with them again

Burbank is a very small regional airport serving the San Fernando Valley and northern Los Angeles suburbs with only gates and no jetways but its a very good alternative to the chaos that is LAX There are flights on Southwest dominant carrier United US Airways JetBlue American and Alaska to all major western USA airports plus DallasFt Worth and New York JFK The terminal is very small and can get overcrowded during peak times and foodbeverageconcession options are very Spartan but its easy to navigate has excellent free wifi and the security screening process is streamlined and wellrun You can also walk from the terminal to the longterm parking lot which you cant do at LAX

Was feeling travel sick after arriving Abu Dhabi airport and while waiting for my next flight Starbucks staff were very helpful and called the medic for me and were very helpful Helped me recover within hour Lovely staff

The staff at this airport have to be the friendliest and most helpful airport staff I have ever met My fiend and I arrived at the airport leaving for Vietnam with an hour and a half until our flight thinking all of our documents were in order Turns out we had both entered incorrect information on our travel visas by mistake and this mistakes would not be overlooked by Vietnam country officials rendering the visas void and us unable to travel We were traveling on New Years Day so the visa office at the airport was closed The staff were extremely helpful with our situation They assigned us a personal check in clerk who stayed with us through the whole ordeal and was calm and reassuring the entire time He contacted an emergency visa officer who drove from his home to the airport and issued us emergency visas on the spot albeit for a large fee but this was expected Since it was a holiday they did not have any visa issuers on site They allowed us to check in even though we did not have the correct visas in place knowing that the visa officer was on the way Once we had our visas we had about min until the plane left The checkin clerk ran us all the way through the airport moved us to the head of the security line got us right up to the front of any queue we encountered and got us on that plane He was running like his life depended on it It was amazing to watch and experience We got on the plane with min to spare We are eternally grateful to that checkin clerk the visa officer and all the staff we briefly encountered The onus was definitely on us for messing up our visas but they helped us all the way regardless Most wonderful people Ive ever met at an airport would recommend

My first time flying MEA and I found it to be an excellent airline The planes were new clean and comfortable The business class seats are not lieflat which is fine given they only do shorthaul routes but they have a good recline function TV monitors and tables are in the armrests regardless of your seat Service was warm friendly and professional the staff were engaging cheerful and consistently present in the cabin Predeparture drinks were served though alcohol was only offered on the ground in Beirut Once in the air another round of drinks was offered and then drinks were served with the meals I opted for the Champagne which was decent I thought the food was very good for a hour flight you had a choice of starters mains and dessert each served individually IFE was good an uptodate selection of movies and series My departure from LHR was delayed by over hours but they kept us updated With the exception of this I thought it was a great airline and given its shorthaul network the service and quality of food was excellent

Seattle to Edmonton returning Bombardier Q plane small but with comfortable seating even for a sixfooter as I am Great cabin crew and nice free drinks An inflight snack might have been nice but overall a pleasant experience

A newly started airport in North Bihar catering large population of North Bihar and even some area of NepalThe airport is actually an operative airport of Indian Airforce and runway is simultaneously used for civilian service The Terminal being used is a temporary one and a new terminal will come soon is years This airport should be seenused for service and facilities but for logistically importance for reaching some of the most undeveloped area in India with ease Terminal is one of the smallest in India but managed nicely no parking available have to park outside the campus on the road from main gate the terminal is just min walk so not an issue trolleys are there washroom are clean there is one tea and snacks shop just near main gate in the campus and use that if you need anything after that wont find anything inside Hope they construct a new terminal soon Though cabs are available outside but no option of prepaid or authorized cab inside better to book cab in advance

The best airport in the Philippines Brand new free wifi seamless arrival and departure and plenty of excellent food choices The connection between international and domestic is by foot and very short Connecting flights is so easy

Bradleys new A terminal is fantastic Finally we can show pride in our states airport and hopefully swing travelers to Hartford rather then Boston or New York As said before the old B terminal thats serves American and Indepence is really worn down Signs of TWA and Pan Am still are posted throughout the terminal which is more or less one giant hallway Security is quick and all the checkins are well light and clean New parking garage makes getting to terminal A even easier Just need to do up B and we can be a worldclass airport

First time to travel with airBaltic I flew AMSRIX then RIXVNO and finally TLLAMS as part of my Baltic trip I was impressed with the aircrafts and their cleanliness of interior All flights left on time and there was smooth boarding Seats are comfortable and I loved the fact they still have the inflight magazine No inflight individual entertainment screens Food was for purchase which was on for those short flights The only negative thing was on the TLLAMS sector bathrooms were not clean Its not the airline fault but they should have checked it And when we arrived in AMS disembarkation took forever as we were waiting for the buses thats the airport staff fault But overall was a lovely experience

Although I had a long layover here and as a single female passenger I was a tad concerned after having read other reviews However the airport is absolutely fine interesting architecture in the landside area a few cafes small shops selling local goods and lots of banks People were very friendly and there was a sense of calm compared to most airports I have been to especially in my home country Scotland and the UK Customs and security were a doddle and once airside there are the usual airport shops plus a few local and individual shops with interesting goods on sale The gate area was modern bright and airy again it was very ordered and peaceful

Tokyo Haneda to Sapporo return with Skymark Airlines First leg on Boeing NG New cabin comfy seat and generous legroom for a lowcost airline Even though I didnt purchase any the drinks and snakcs are sold at a cheap price Departure and arrival on time Return leg delayed for mins due to congestion at destination airport Return aircraft was an older Boeing Very warm cabin temperature But overall worth the ticket price Definetely better than AirAsia and JetStar

As most of people here state the airport is brand new and clean but they schedule most of flights at the same time in other words the arrival hall becomes a nightmare We had to wait airborne for some minutes before we were allowed to land due lack of ramp space The airport is well connected with buses to town On departure everything was pretty much smooth but they let you wait outside waiting on the heat During peak summer season I would avoid Corfu if I were you

Tular to Antananarivo Quick Checkin on time plane a bit old refreshments and a snack served friendly flight attendants The fare was somehow high but this is Madagascar You shouldnt come here if you are pampered by lowcost carriers

At Guadalajara airport the main hallway is completely renovated but its still very crowded during morning hours as this is the busiest time and lines can be long Staff are helpful and friendly There are or VIP lounges I have used the Aeromexico Salon Premier which is brand new and the BanamexCiti Salon Beyond which is the best for me Many restaurants many stores and duty free

Surprisingly nice flight for a Chinese airline The business class named first class is of the usual type in China ie rows of seats with old seats and small reclining angle The crew was very attentive wine Chinese was decent and so was the food nothing special but ok Reading material is of course restricted to the China Daily and there is no individual entertainment but on a hours flight especially on a night flight this is not essential Flights both ways were on time I would recommend this flight as it is the only airline to fly directly between Bangkok and several places in the Shandong province schedule is terrible but it is still better than transferring

Small airport with basic but sufficient facilities Upon arrival airport staff welcomed passengers and provided a small bag of local snacks which was a nice touch Outbound processing was fine with courteous and friendly staff in security Checkin queue took a bit longer than normal for a regional ATR flight Room for improvement on this but ground staff very friendly and helpful

The flight was a very good price the plane was in great shape and the cabin crew were excellent The food could have been better and they ran out of wine quite early but overall a good experience and Id definitely fly with them again If you have a layover book a lounge at Shenzhen airport the food was good and the shower included in the price made a massive difference to a long journey

What a fabulous little airline We flew Tropic Air from the teeny airport at Tower Hill Belize which is a metal hut with a single airstrip in the middle of a sugar cane field Our flight to San Pedro on Ambergris Caye was only minutes The airports Tropic Air staff consisted of one friendly gentleman who didnt ask us for ID because our hotel manager who drove us to the airport vouched for us We met both Tropic Air pilots who were also quite friendly Our plane was a little seat single prop beauty that looked very new inside and out Hubby and I secured the last seat bench style and very comfy with plenty of leg room There was no cabin staff no beverages or snacks not even a commode But it was a wonderful flight with wonderful customer service at the airport We wouldnt hesitate to fly Tropic Air again

Staff were very helpful Both of the officers help me get my phone which I lost in the airport They managed to contact me to retrieve back my phone although I am already departed to my destination Thank you so much

I arrived in Lilongwe for a work training we were facilitating and spent one night in Lilongwe and proceeded to Blantyre the following Monday afternoon When I arrived at Crossroads hotel where would stay until the coming Saturday morning I realized I did not have my passport wallet with forex and most importantly my passport and an older one I immediately alerted the hotel and the driver said he would check By the time I got to my room there was a message from Victor the Airport Manager who tried calling on watsap so I immediately responded He assured me they had everything and the next morning I went to collect it Sure enough every last note was still there I waited for a security officer to confirm that nothing was missing and signed off The honesty kindness and sheer humanity displayed was so moving I am deeply grateful to Angel for her assistance and the Airport Manager You guys are really incredible
Iloilo Airport is one of the best and nicest airports that Ive seen Shopping store and a number of restaurants and coffee shops are also available Really amazing
Flew in and out of here on flights to and from Sao Paulo A striking modern terminal with reasonable facilities Very pleasant

Zaporizhia airport Ukraine is probably the most original and exotic airport I flew to and from The airport serves a million people city and is unbelievabely small It did not see any main restructuration and reconstruction since the middle of soviet era and this airport is a real step back in times but it will change by I have nothing bad to say about this airport because it is impossible to compare with european standards The terminal consist in a small building where everything is included into a very small space It deserves a visit Landing in Zaporizhia is landing in the s You walk to the terminal from the aircraft then you pick up your lugguage straight on the tractor no conveyor For checkin you also bring you baggage straight to the tractor because there is no conveyor as well Then there is a very small cafe and a unique passport control and you arrive in a waiting room that youve never seen before To go to the plane you walk down outside stairs and walk to your aircraft again A very interesting experience

After reading some of the less stellar reviews online and being unable to reach any English speaking staff on the phone who could verify the incabin luggage dimensions I was naturally apprehensive about the flight from Tel Aviv to Nice on Monday September To my pleasant surprise the entire flight experience was excellent The plane was clearly in great shape a relatively new aircraft with leather seating and spotless interior The departure and arrival were pretty much on schedule The fact the departure from Ben Gurion airport was using a shuttle bus and not a jetway reminds me to warn any future passengers during any unlikely but possible inclement weather to dress accordingly or bring an umbrella for the extended exposure to the elements while trying to board an outdoors staircase Other than that I thought the whole experience was most pleasant and I would have no qualms about flying Israir again

Genoa to Paris This was an Air France flight operated by local carrier CityJet Everything was done through the Air France website and I was able to upgrade to business class for around The business class seat was probably one of the smallest seat I ever flown however the service was fantastic and for a flight that lasted under two hours there is really nothing to complain about The airplane had four engines thing that I found quite interesting since it was very small aircraft I was served a full breakfast that was very nice and the presentation was five star I would fly this airline again without hesitation

Such a small airport but somehow it was still amazing The staff were incredibly nice its not very busy I do think it does need a few more shops there was a fair variety of places to eat Ive never really had an issue with delay we have been delayed a few times but not for very long The flight attendants were kind and the landing was smooth Overall I personally think that it was a magnificent airport and it is very underrated

I had pretty low expectations for this airline but fortunately things turned out well and PIA delivered for me The flight was on time and bags arrived in a timely manner While the meal served was not exactly delicious it was nice to know they at least served some food on this hour flight The seats were standard and flight attendants polite and respectful Would consider using again

This is a small airport Single terminal concept Security was quick and since my flight was to Sao Paulo it is internal and there is no passport check All the gates are in a single long corridor Distances to walk are short The shops and cafes directly face the gates so you can drink a coffee and see when your gate is boarding The free WIFI was excellent Good stress free experience airport
Very comfortable and the staff were really nice our flight was not delayed it was wonderful flying with HiSky as it was my first time flying with them and had a wonderful experience

Bahrains new airport has given me a satisfying experience as I found the place really simple big enough and neat I must say that it seemed also like a planespotters paradise since they have these huge glass windows that gives an almost unobstructed view by gate area and also a rooftop experience from The Terrace In my point of view the only downside is the limited Internet and when you have not enough money to spend for food Im also glad that the playroom at the bottom of their huge central LED screen is free for everyone to enjoy and wheelchair accessible as well which is absolutely a big plus Also the airport didnt seem too crowded and I hope it stays that way

Koh Samui is usually an excellent airport the tropical ambience laid back staff garden setting and impressive views of the planes make this a quirky experience The recent floods and mass cancellations have regrettably brought this airport to its knees however Under normal conditions I thoroughly recommend this establishment
Very nice and clean no problems at all It is very small but it was still a very good and modern airport One of the cleanest airports I have been to

I have flown from Charlotte NC to Pittsburgh many times in the past yrs Today I lost my wallet I was very fortunate to be called informing me someone had turned in my wallet They kindly sent an employee up to gate B to return it to me just minutes before my flight took off That is excellent customer service and I will be forever grateful for their kindness I will never forget this Thanks for such a wonderful and caring staff You guys rock

Check in at San Andres had to be done at the airport since I had a bag to drop off the line was very long so I waited about minutes Since there are no drinks or snacks available for sale on the plane I bought some stuff at the airport to bring along on the plane Flight back to Bogota was quite smooth quiet and easy I flew back on the same plane that had brought me to San Andres Nothing to complain about Cheap option to San Andres and very efficient

Traveled to Manaus many times found the airport good with easy access to car park Staff nice security not too long a queue shops etc are standard airport stuff Would recommend early arrival and double check all documentation you need to travel Stop to look at the turtles outside the terminal in their own pond

Very pleasant flight from OKA to ISG Relaxed but very professional and friendly staff At least one member spoke English Maybe the least full flight I have ever experienced in a B I was quite surprised that they use such a big plane for this route but it seems they only use this model on this airline I had to buy a luggage allowance since my checked bag exceeded kg but the fee was quite decent yen Same as for the drinks service I remember coffee is only a yen nothing to be angry at
No boarding bridges But views are very nice Not much wait for luggage The ground service is good

Being fed up with the chaos at many ports of entry into the USA from Europe as a non USAcitizen I thought to try out a new way to enter the USA with less wait hassle stress and frustration I flew the nonstop AA flight from LHR into RDU Even though I was in business class and was among the first to disembark I believe all passengers entered the USA border control in minutes or less It took me minutes from plane door to curbside Also the airport is modern and clean really nice staff With just one or two daily incoming flights from Europe I dont think there is a better way to travel into the USA from Europe I connected the next morning on a very early am departure Staff told me there was a morning rush so I was a bit nervous about TSA opening only at am Arrived at am and soon after that TSA started processing passengers Again lovely kind people all around What an exceptional airport

An unexpectedly pleasant experience The booking process was a bit odd but after using several different credit cards one finally worked on the airline website for a ticket about euros less than any other airline Check in and boarding was smooth Two suitcases allowed at kg each Or one at a maximum of kg There was entertainment with several English language recent films Ample food provided The layover was fine No one was saying anything about not taking photos and it wasnt any more different than transferring in China Seemed the duty free shops take card now too

Excellent airport Well organized Airlines and security staff are friendly and professional Good customer service The airport building is very clean and modern Good parking indoor and outdoor next to the terminal Easy to go around In conclusion a place were its pleasant to go
Plane clean and on time Ran out of water after row economy Its a short flight so bring back water in seat pockets of you cant cope No coffee tea or drinks for anyone

Long lines await you when you arrive and need to visa to enter the country There are only two counters one for visas and the other for travellers who do not need visas The arrival hall is small but the waiting drivers etc are gathered respectfully outside the terminal building The airport is not far from the town
A great small and friendly airport with views to die for All flights seem to come and go on time with no issues Good choice of shops and eateries plenty of seating great views and friendly staff

Dane County Regional is a cute little airport lying on the outskirts of Madison and it has had some of the best services I have ever experienced at any airport The airport is incredibly clean and attractive on the inside and the outside This includes nice modern architecture on the outside and mosaic flooring and stained glass handling lights It may not have as many stores as other airports but there is a store for nearly all travel needs such as a Cafe a restaurant a travel store and a Wisconsin Gear store I also noted that there were multiple stores under construction There are hardly any delays and MSN connects to nearly all large nearby airports which provides excellent connection availability The best part was the incredibly fast Wifi and charger ports in the waiting area

Each time I have flown in and out it has been easy The lines moves quickly and everyone is friendly and helpful Upon arrival after passing through immigration you proceed to the baggage carousel and hope that your luggage has made it to your destination with you but dont try to walk away with your suitcase that easily someone will be standing by to check your baggage tag and your passport

Small super convenient airport Its small but efficient Has one food counter with the really good food Better than most airports Have to walk out on tarmac to plane Arrival and exiting are quick and easy Wait about minutes to minutes for bag and out the front door in steps Outside attendant are great The give directions and keep pick up lines organized enough Gets a for Convenience

I enjoyed lengthy stop overs here on a recent flight to BKK in Biz class with Gulf Air The airport is amazing clean and transit was smooth The lounge was fantastic and food and drinks were excellent Staff throughout the airport were amenable and friendly Overall it is a much less stress free and agreeable experience in comparison to transit through Doha or Dubai

Easy to get around It was the perfect size for someone on foot The staff seemed like a small town community Everyone seemed to be in effective communication with each other Traveler satisfaction was clearly a priority for the staff at Akron Canton airport I felt a good positive energy there I liked the choices of food and beer that were available throughout the gates I liked how well my emotional support dog was greeted and welcomed into the airport and on all three flights I took home I will fly to and from this airport in the future

I did a round trip with Tunisair in May TunisLondon Gatwick overall impressed by the trip having read the bad reviews before on time good service smooth ride and economy class had well spaced seats as well I cant think of anything bad to say about my experience Hoping Tunisair is getting serious and keeps up providing as good of a service as I had Also very good prices the cheapest next flight was double as I had to pay with Tunisair

I have no complaints whatsoever about the new airport in Wichita Lobby is wide and bright with helpful staff at the information desk There is a wonderful exhibition on the aviation history of Wichita on the second floor Go to the airport early so that you can read all the displays Not a wide assortment of food choices but good enough Car rental area is well organized and staff is welltrained A most pleasant experience there The signage for getting to the city center and on the highways could be better but I think that is the responsibility of the city not the airport A very pleasant airport to use

Never had any problems flying in and out of John WayneOrange County Airport Its clean security is quick and efficient and has that laid back atmosphere that is OC Its very convenient even when it comes to flying internationally you can get almost anywhere in the world with no more than one stopover At times Ill fly out of LAX if Im not in the mood for that stopover but OC always offers a pleasant alternative for convenience and efficiency Because of its curfew a lot of planes depart first thing in the morning so getting there early is advised But overall a great airport

Small regional airport With just two terminals it is pretty painless to navigate Lines at the security checkpoint move fast I was told that a contractor operates the checkpoints In my experience staff was friendly and two or more lanes were open Some restrooms in the secure area were closed off due to renovations in progress Concessions were limited but there is a McDonalds a Subway a news store and a coffee outfit Because its a regional airport many code share flights are operated by smaller airlines flying commuter aircraft If youre not a fan of turboprop aircraft avoid Piedmont Air operating as US Air Express on DHC planes

Its always very relaxing to fly from to Nuremberg Its a really small airport but everything works so easy and uncomplicated You can get there easily by train a subway station is directly in front of the entrance or by car you can park just min walk away checkin is very fast and boarding too There is no shopping and not that many food options but when you just want to get relaxed and easy from A to B its perfect And the staff are nice too even the security staff is always goodhumored More airlines should use this airport

Chiang Mai to Khon Kaen with Kan Air A small but very efficient airline ATR very clean ground staff did a great job and the biggest surprise options between fish and chicken meal with rice for a minute flight with rounds of drinks I choose this airline as the fastest way to go from Korat airport closed to Chiang Mai via Khon Kaen to avoid a hour bus ride As for the price this was half than a bus ticket to Chiang Mai Excellent

Decided to fly direct from Brisbane to Dunedin rather than via Christchurch then driving I had previously flown into Dunedin over years ago and the differences were huge from then until now It is a small airport for a small city so it is compact but effectively laid out International flights arrive at an annex that is connected to the main terminal building by a corridor There are no Smartgates at immigration but it only receives a single international flight at a time it was also good that all three counters were manned for quick processing To get to the rental car office you have to leave the terminal turn left and reenter the annex building which was quite a cold walk on a late night flight For the return trip it was a very busy morning with several domestic flights departing near the same time as my international flight thus international passengers were held in the main terminal area until those domestic flights were processed before being allowed through for screening However there is only a couple of vending machines at the international gates with a small duty free so it is better to not rush through

I have used the comfortable Cr Colombo Airport in Genoa at least times in the last years Small comfortable no crowd no queue security check is not the standard paranoia of the EU just lazy smiles Friendly staff excellent shop excellent coffee shop fantastic quality of espresso good grappa and beer reasonably priced And not to forget it is comfortable to rent a car and drive anywhere in the Ligurian Coast easy car return the Airport is before Genova on the road One of my favorite airports

I used Wakkanai Airport to fly out to Tokyo Haneda It is located about minutes away from Wakanai city There are only four flights per day by All Nippon Airlines two in and two out to Haneda and a city in Hokkaido The three storey building is clean modern and spacious Checkin is on the ground floor second floor is the arrival and departure gates and third floor is the viewing gallery Gift shop and a small restaurant are on the second floor just next to the securitydeparture The airport is on an open field with no other buildings nearby Wakkanai Park which the Japan Cup sled dog racing is held here annually in the winter is opposite the airport Like most Japanese regional airports Wakkanai airport is very much under utilized The ground staff are polite and efficient

From Zanzibar to Arusha ATR arrived on time from Dar el Salam Friendly staff and they offer snack and juices and alcoholic drinks On arrival our suitcases arrived in a short time Overall good experience

Great airport small and friendly Not too bothered about duty free shops its an airport for quick in and out like most should be flights seem to be moving to Alicante but lets support this little airport and its staff Car hire very easy

I was pleasantly surprised by the quality of Air KBZ flying from Yangon to Mandalay I bought the ticket just two days before the flight and the fare was very reasonable Checkin was fast and efficient and a Air KBZ employee approached me in the line and escorted me to the checkin desk and helped me checkin The domestic terminal is small and a bit chaotic but this is not Air KBZs fault and should be remedied when the new domestic terminal is finished There are no screens announcing that boarding has commenced so you have to pay attention to the airline employees who walk up and down the waiting area with handheld signs with your airline and flight number on it Boarding was via a bus to the aircraft The plane was clean in good condition and the seats were comfortable The flight crew was helpful and friendly We were served a light breakfast on this minute flight The flight took off and landed on time I would certainly fly Air KBZ again

Frankfurt to Sao Paulo with TAM Airlines Service was attentive friendly and acceptable for economy class Food is as good or less good as with other airlines Seat is standard and what you get for economy The IFE is rather slow and not as quickly responding as for example in the of LAN Overall a good and pricewise interesting way to travel to South America Luggage was damaged upon return at FRA but ground staff not interested in being friendly or understanding

Flew last week from Munich to Tyunmen TJM Siberia B with Europeanstyle business cabin middle seat free Smooth checkin my coat was taken by a smiling attendant but no help to put my kg luggage in the locker No entertainment during the hours journey redeye but more than decent meal with appetisers and good Chilean wine I hope that my return flight in two days will be at least as peaceful although the linguistic capacities of the crew should be improved

Portlands airport feels slightly dated not run down by any means but still pleasant and functional enough A lot of construction taking place at this time in the checkin area I guess in an effort to modernize the airport and expand passenger capacity The terminals themselves again are a little dated but still nice enough and functional TSA PreCheck operates smoothly here even where there are a lot of PreCheckers in line Personnel whether theyre working at checkin for TSA in a restaurant or at the boarding gate are usually super bubbly but still professional helpful and polite PDX is neither stellar nor bad its aboveaverage but with a lot of potential And its better than SeaTac

Zurich to Geneva return with Darwin Airline Booking and checkin was smooth online checkin was not available Boarding was quick maybe due to light load factors on both segments Both flights were on time arrival even early Very nice cabin crew comfortable seats with huge seat pitch s style on the Saab I can recommend them at least for flights from and to Geneva I am aware that Darwin Airline has some punctuality issues But that never happened to me Great value for money

London Gatwick to Podgorica The Fokker seats were comfortable in formation but they were small and legroom was limited Crew members were helpful and attentive We were served a couple of drinks and a fairly basic sandwich but it was fine It was cheaper for me to book a ticket to Belgrade via Podgorica than it was just to Podgorica I told the checkin staff I wanted to get off at Podgorica and that was fine

A surprisingly large and spacey airport given the size of Porto Boarding times security and seating were all great cuz of the practical layout Even during peak season theres plenty seats available Prices at the foodcourt were lower than youre used to in Europe Theres a convenient metro connection to the city center So all in all a hassle free airport

Eilat to Tel Aviv The plane arrived minutes late but that was ok The boarding was quick and nice The cabin crew was good nice and helpful minutes on the flight and we got some snacks I love Israirs snacks Of course you could get some water with it The landing was pretty shaky

The airport infrastructure is generally good and quite modern offering a clean and wellmaintained environment However one major drawback is the long walking distance between terminals and gates which can be tiring especially for elderly passengers or those with heavy luggage While the airport staff are polite and friendly they do not always demonstrate efficiency or resourcefulness when handling issues which can be frustrating for travellers in need of quick assistance Additionally one of the biggest concerns is the frequent long queues at immigration which can cause unnecessary delays particularly during peak hours This aspect of airport operations could be significantly improved by increasing the number of immigration officers implementing more automated systems or streamlining the process to enhance efficiency Overall while the airport offers a modern and comfortable environment there is still room for improvement in terms of staff efficiency and passenger flow management
The airport is new modern and colorful Everywhere is clean There are nice looking green areas with flowers and trees outside The employees were polite and smiling

Quebec City airport is very clean and comfy Free and fast wifi with no submission or forms to fill or emails to wait for to validate the access The whole terminal is bright and welcoming The seats inside the departure terminal are new and very comfortable The checkin area is very well organised and neat The toilets are very clean On my arrival everything was easy and in the end the only little improvement this airport could make is for the luggage delivery time Apart from this very small detail this airport is just perfect

London City to Paris Orly I arrived just over one hour prior to my flight and proceeded to checkin Whilst the queues were not long it did take at least minutes due to the multitude of bags of some passengers Boarding was orderly and we left on time The E has a lot of legroom compared to other BA cabins though the cabin has started to look a bit dated with older seats and torn magazines The onboard service was appreciated though it was not exceptional The service was somewhat lethargic but they were attentive After about minutes we began our descent into Orly Overall it was a great flight and if you live somewhat closely to LCY I would recommend CityFlyer over the regular BA service exLHR

The brand new terminal is now open and is spectacular Any deficiencies from previous reviews are now remedied More gates with jetways more shops and restaurants Check in was seamless as was immigration facilities Clean and modern and when the new train system is functioning it will be easy to get into the city

My first time flying MEA and I found it to be an excellent airline The planes were new clean and comfortable The business class seats are not lieflat which is fine given they only do shorthaul routes but they have a good recline function TV monitors and tables are in the armrests regardless of your seat Service was warm friendly and professional the staff were engaging cheerful and consistently present in the cabin Predeparture drinks were served though alcohol was only offered on the ground in Beirut Once in the air another round of drinks was offered and then drinks were served with the meals I opted for the Champagne which was decent I thought the food was very good for a hour flight you had a choice of starters mains and dessert each served individually IFE was good an uptodate selection of movies and series My departure from LHR was delayed by over hours but they kept us updated With the exception of this I thought it was a great airline and given its shorthaul network the service and quality of food was excellent

I had forgotten what the airport was like but it was great very small and compact no air bridges to aircraft just a quick walk across the airfield Immigration was very easy and efficient as international flights seem to land one at a time The luggage was swiftly off the aircraft and minutes you are in your taxi off to your Hotel Check in again was very quick we arrived very early and were first in the queue your taxi drops you off curbside and you walk about paces and the checkin is in front of you Immigration was very quick minutes and you are airside very limited space and a sad sight of a Burger King Fortunately we went upstairs to the BusinessFirst Lounge shared by most airlines it was empty when we arrived but filled very quickly good tea and coffee a bit limited offerings but ample really Called when the flight was boarding chaos downstairs but they were calling priority boarding and eventually all went as planned

Ive been using this Airport over the last decade and what is happening in the country did not help a lot with the growth of the overall experience of this Terminal I can admit that compared to the other airports I visited Tunis Carthage kept a Vintage look in its facilities the Departure hall is well decorated with a breathtaking ceiling decoration and paneling the local handicraft shops and the roaming merchants in the airports give a local taste and overview of the country lifestyle The Departures hall offers a multitude of facilities including pharmacies coffeeshops Foreign exchange Post Tourism information desk Banks where passengers should do all their shopping before accessing to the Dutyfree area Once Stamped your exit a central coffee shop is conveniently positioned in the center of the hexagon shaped hall distributing all departure gates offers coffee or snacks before departure but note that beyond the police border and all over the dutyfree zone payments cannot be done in local currency and card payments are not always available due to the immaturity of card payments in Tunisia Duty free zone offers plenty of last minute gift possibilities ranging from local handicrafts souvenirs sweets and clothing to branded perfume chocolates and spirits Cleanliness remains one of the major defects in this Airport make sure you have a pack of tissue or sanitizing wipes when you use the restrooms I wish a pleasant stay in Tunisia for all visitors that would like to discover more about the magic of North Africa

Flying from Cape Town to Dublin to attend a conference and later return to Chicago from there I was looking forward to my first chance to check out Hamad Doha Airport Qatar Airways was fine except we arrived late in Doha We had to take a crowded bus to the terminal and it took over a half hour There were traffic jams on the tarmac I then had to run a long way through jammed concourses and just made my connection to Dublin On the way I saw crowds of people a bunch of luxury stores and chain eateries and some trees and plantings in one area Color me unimpressed

When I landed in Anchorage late at night the first thing I noticed was how busy the terminal was I was really hungry after a long hour flight from LAX so the first thing I did was grab something to eat from Cinnabon one of many restaurants at this airport Baggage claim experience was smooth Taxi was readily available outside for transportation to hotel While returning back I had a very smooth checkin and security experience If you enjoy watching beautiful scenery and planes Anchorage will not disappoint As you walk around the terminal you will notice many photo opportunities both inside and outside the terminal

I have flown in and out of this airport on several occasions although I dont live in Kentucky I mean it is a small airport serving a small city so dont go expecting any big city amenities other than just a couple of sitdown restaurants a Dunkin Donuts and a small store But it is surprisingly spacious extremely clean and very modern Signage is clear staff and security are friendly the terminals are small and manageable and there is even complex and beautiful artwork on the floor in security honoring the regions thoroughbred horse racing heritage Lastly where else can you park in the parking garage that is only around feet from the terminal The ease simplicity and friendliness of this airport makes it one of my favorite airports in the world and Ive been all over North America and Europe

It was my first time flying with PLAY and I have no complaints whatsoever I booked a roundtrip flight from Hamilton CA to Berlin Germany for US PLAY Flex with seat choice in the front of the plane and one kilo piece of checked luggage included What more can you ask for at this price The crews were friendly the seats have plenty of leg room the plane was clean There are no screens free movies etc and you have to pay for drinks ie Euros for a cup of coffee thats less than at the airport I was happy to pay for my coffee and to read a book instead of watching a movie because I saved about compared to a flight on a US airline out of Buffalo NY where I live To all those writing bad reviews regarding carryon luggage Ive seen people carrying large duffle bags onto the plane or a rather large suitcase a backpack AND a stuffed shopping bag type of bag and the crews were very helpful finding room for those bags in the cabin What are these people complaining about My personal opinion Pay a little more when making your reservation check your luggage and quit complaining I dont understand the I have to take my entire household into the cabin mentality at all And remember if there are issues at the airport with carryon luggage or a long wait for your checked luggage its not on the airline its on the airport employees And that is the only complaint I have the check in people at BER are very unfriendly But those are Swissport employees not PLAY employees Thank you PLAY for a very nice experience

Hong Kong to Hanoi Regional flight Hong Kong toHanoi January on an A aircraft Ticket included free services and luggage Hot meal given was OK Flight full on time Nice clean aircraft Seats were good but space to front seat was horrible and extremely tiny small de facto painful to knees CheckIn in Hong Kong was quick and easy though my handluggage was double the limit Checked in luggage arrived smoothly checked by customs in Hong Kong who had left a note inside the bag Airbridge provided at both ends

I must say that in my experience the staff at the security check are doing a great job I was flying back to Moscow from Yerevan on Tuesday th October The staff were very welcoming polite and helpful Moreover while passing the security check I realized that I lost my cross the thread on which it hung was torn and after passing the security check I informed the security staff about it They were very helpful and helped me find my lost cross

I have been flying from Mangalore International Airport domestically for a very long time Ill be honest the checkin baggage claim or the security is just literally the same like any other airport with less people The airport is calm and clean Restrooms are provided The only drawback is there is no source of recreation and entertainment here We have a couple of eateries but very very very limited WiFi is provided But when we speak about shopping Dont depend on Mangalore Airport it has nothing Trust me nothing The last time I visited there was a food stall at the ground floor and an umbrellaraincoat shop and a metal item store at the first floor That is it No clothes no alcohol no McDonalds etc But all in all its a good airport I mean its catering for the needs of Mangalorians Arrival also went very smooth

Overall a lovely flight with BA cityflyer as usual I will review both the outbound and return EDIPMI Check in wasnt particularly friendly at EDI no consideration for priority as a business class customer Fast track security was good BA lounge at EDI had a poor selection of food in the morning but plenty choice of drinks and staff were lovely EDI PMI flight on E aircraft configuration for business and economy In business the drinks were flowing constantly and a wrap was offered to eat In economy a sandwich and free bar was also offered Crew were friendly PMI EDI Check in at PMI was chaos and took an hour for priority Fast track security was quick Lounge was drab and we only stayed for a coffee There was food and drink available Flight was good I was in row and only Arabic chicken dish left it didnt appeal and I asked for an economy sandwich they only had vegan option available sweet potato and cranberry It was ok Crew were lovely and drinks were flowing constantly to those that wanted it Again economy was given free bar and a sandwich It was nice to travel club Europe as a treat but to be honest on a hr flight low cost airlines are more than fine

Airport was much better than expected In the general area are a few food options incl coffee shop icecream bar and a few fast food choices They even have a small duty free We were in the TAAG lounge called the Pearl lounge Clean comfortable with basic drinks food Staff are very friendly Did not see showers Internet is available but weak Other than internet this lounge is better than many US lounges I have visited I was expecting something much worse

Travelling in and out of Launceston Airport proved a pleasant experience Since the terminal is still fairly new everything seemed to be in very good working order Facilities were very good having large coffee shops and well stocked souvenirgift shop selling real Tasmanian and Launceston branded items Check in and customs were hassle free No time lost waiting for luggage or taxis

The flights are frequently delayed but its a small price to pay for clean aircraft ample seat pitch kind crew and the lowest fares My flight from Melbourne to Kuala Lumpur was on an A with plenty of legroom and good meals Online checkin yields a good seat for me and their use of KLIA T makes for an easy and relaxing journey

Atyrau to Uralsk I had a few meetings to attend in Uralsk and Aksai and was not looking forward to the hour or more arduous taxi journey from Atyrau to Uralsk in C heat I was recommend to use Qazaq Air as they now have a direct flight from Atyrau to Uralsk I booked a return flight online selected a seat paid via card and my eticket was immediately emailed On arrival to the airport checkin is simple and efficient The flight was serviced by a Bombardier Dash Next Gen aircraft which was very clean and the aircrew well dressed and welcoming The flight h m was very good with a surprisingly powerful takeoff and flight landing mins earlier than scheduled I certainly was impressed with the overall service and the value for money I will be using Qazaq air again for direct flights around west Kazakhstan

I agree entirely with Fernando Immigration staff also very helpful as well as friendly and efficient Only problem now is the collapsed bridge on the road to Caracas A diversion has been made but is only two lanes and is operated on a tidal system Can add an hour or two to the journey

Due to the relatively low number of flights planes dont have to wait circling around in the air or on the tarmac The airport itself is perfectly connected to the inner city and the central station trains from there take you to Munich Wrzburg and Regensburg in about hour to Frankfurt and Stuttgart in hours by a minutes metro ride Passport and security checks as well as baggage handling are a breeze Staff is very friendly and helpful
