The main issue I had as a transit passenger at Douala International Airport was that you cannot go strait to international departures after arriving on an international flight I had electronically checked in for my connection flight already I arrived from Malabo on Ethiopian and traveled onward to Johannesburg on South African Airways I had to enter through customs and got issued with a transit visa free and then had to exit through customs again to international departures Once in the departure terminal there is a business lounge that you can also enter for US if you travel economy It looks like they are busy upgrading the place so all considering it is ok

Sharjah via Mukhalla to Socotra and back onboard nearly full Yemeni Bombardier CRJ plane Check in at Sharjah was a bit chaotic due to much luggage boarding the plane was guided by the station manager personally in Sharjah as there wasnt any seat allocation They have an inflight magazine During the hour flight to RIY a snack was served Crew very nice on the return flight leaving SCT the captain even explained everything what was visible from the windows The plane was in a good shape at least what was visible clean and tidy

PSP is a great little airport The s style terminal is fairly well designed but with the advent of security screening areas its a bit harder to negotiate Rental cars are right outside the door from the baggage carousels The weather is seldom a problem so flights stay pretty close to their schedules Parking is reasonably priced and convenient to the terminal

Newcastle is a small airport which always delights Its not the most modern or breathtaking however its well organised and functions well Checkin zone is excellent and plenty of space clean despite dated toilets and some generic shopseateries The renovated security area is very modern with hightech equipment meaning the check is very thorough despite being completed in under minutes without priority This of course makes the airport feel very safe however security staff arent the most friendly Ive got to admit which surprised me The departure lounge is spacious and has plenty of room with no awkward no return sections Shops are overpriced which youd expect for an airport but theres plenty of choice Theres also a newly renovated lounge which we didnt visit on this occasion but looked fabulous Despite this the area leading to the gates is quite dated and needs upgrading to make the whole experience seamless Arrivals are also great very fast and friendly border agents It took approximately minutes for us from leaving the plane to outside the airport which is simply excellent Despite the excellent terminal one thing that really disappoints me with Newcastle is the parking arrangements Extremely expensive and the shuttle system to the longterm car park is a nightmare never mind the technical issues and problems with closed car parks Id try to arrange alternative transport to the airport if possible as the dropoff zone is good

Each time I come back to Milan Malpensa from other airports I long for the quick and modern security checks installed here I left on the evening of a small holiday period and there were thousands of travellers Despite this the security checks at Terminal handled the crowd without problems we waited about min for the whole process Being able to carry liquids to leave computers in the bags mean really accelerating the flow and guaranteeing a quick check After that the airport is nice there are seats to wait before boarding a lot of shops and restaurants possibly some more gates should be added

Cebu Mactan international is a nice airport that was recently redesigned but people need to be aware that it was hit rather hard at the end of last year by typhoon Odette and as a result things are not yet up to again Airport is still comfortable and clean however but at this time with a slightly limited number of shops and dining areas available on the departures side of the airport It is also a strange rule that my girlfriend was not allowed into the terminal to say goodbye to me COVID rules taken too much to an extreme perhaps One major issue I had was checking in staff The entire process took me over an hour because in the Philippines they have a tendency to train new staff on the job it appears with no supervision from an experienced member of staff This can make things very frustrating for the passenger It took me perhaps minutes to explain to this lady that yes I had a connecting flight with Scoot to Perth and yes it WAS on a separate ticket I think she was confused by this or felt that you could not book a flight this way The upshot of all of this was that she forgot to put a label on my cases to forward them from Singapore to Perth so essentially nothing arrived in Perth Fortunately I reported this to Scoot and received my cases two days later The Philippines is a wonderful destination and the people are generally very warm and friendly but please give your new staff supervised training

Kazan to Baku Its not really a low cost airline because the cost is not low and quality is even lower than a usual lowcost But I had no choice Hand luggage is not included it is made clear on their website But the problem is that you cant pay for the hand luggage on their website you have to pay at checkin counter And they force you to pay in different currency using their crazy exchange rate so you will overpay for it a lot The reason as they explained it it is because they need to check your bag size and weight to see if it will fit Cant they allow to pay for it online and deal with overweight bags at the airport for extra cost My bag was within the limits but I had to pay more Surprisingly seats were pretty comfortable and spacious enough for tall people They even gave a free sandwich But teacoffee was not free Anyway I cant recommend to fly with Buta

Conakry is in no way a modern airport even quite old But its management is stunning I have been through this airport a great number of times over the years and am always impressed by its efficiency especially arrivals In minutes you get through immigration and then at the luggage carousel something Ive never seen in the possibly airports I know luggage trolleys are already positioned in front of the carousel so very convenient Unfortunately to leave the airport is somewhat difficult especially for elder people as you have to push you trolley on a pretty steep ramp before exiting the airport Also departure area needs to be modernized

A brand new airport opened for Dakar in called Blaise Diagne Its infinitely better than the old one mentioned in other reviews on this page which is no longer in use The new airport is clean and modern with helpful staff Once inside I felt like I was already in Europe I had no problems with security or checked baggage

I flew United from San Francisco to Melbourne and returned from Sydney in Polaris Overall it was a positive experience The Polaris lounge at SFO is superb and a great start The product on United is among the best The seat is comfortable and the entertainment options plentiful Both crews were pleasant and accommodating The main downfall was the food The menus were uninspired and the presentation was subpar for a business class service The taste was ok but compared to the competition they fell well below the mark For instance the breakfast had a bowl of cut up fruit that was less interesting that what I make at home We were fed but with little originality or style If they could improve this offering they would truly rate with some of the best Too bad

My wife and I had the most magnificent experience on Sunday th July when we took a scenic flight with Loch Lomond Seaplanes from Cameron House on Loch Lomond The pilot and staff were exemplary the take off and landing as smooth as operating on tarmac and the inflight commentary first class The day was perfect as we flew over Gare Loch Loch Long Holy Loch Loch Striven Kyles Of Bute Tighnabruaich Loch Fyne along the Crinan Canal and finally turned over the Gulf of Corryvreckan where we saw the infamous whirlpool I cannot praise the whole operation highly enough
Quick lines through security and it is a better option than flying out of Logan with the longer lines Airport restaurantsbars are limited but OK for all the longer that you will be there

Singapore to Thandwe via Yangon with Myanmar National Airlines This was a very pleasant experience All flights ahead of time great service and food super friendly flight attendants Both the domestic and international terminals in Yangon are modern and well organized Overall highly recommended

As I was travelling in Emirates Business class from Tehran I was able to use the VIP terminal just around the corner of the main terminal It was very clean stylish and modern for Iranian standards Emirates passengers got to use the whole second floor which provided a good buffet nice leather seats clean prayer room and very clean toilets The customer service and security checks were also quite decent despite being busy during the day

The airport was renovated in before the Olympic games it looks like Miami International Airport nothing special good duty free some good lounges all in all good airport with some problems with queues and not so friendly staff

A very pleasant experience both arriving and leaving this airport the terminal is well designed with some good places to eat and purchase last minute items too There is a business lounge which is a great oasis to relax and catch up on business for a fee which offers drinks and food Baggage collection was fast and was on the reclaim by the time we had walked from the arrival gate to the reclaim The customer service and information is very good and professional as is TSA who all appear to go the extra mile to assist passengers departing

In my eyes it is the best lowcost airline in China It has strict regulations on hand luggage and reminds that there is no free baggage allowance when booking tickets One can buy meals online in advance and on the plane The meals are delicious The seat spacing is acceptable and the attitude of the flight attendants is good There is no entertainment system on the plane and the bathroom is relatively clean The crew happily filled in the flight log The most important thing is that air tickets are very cheap

Convenient location only mins from the Mosque Excellent modern facilities Nice simple elegant layout with steelwork reflecting date palm trees Convenient location of cafetarias toilets and prayer rooms Friendly staff and security personnel Clean and tidy Ample seating facilities

Excellent modern airport that is complete There was a complete redesign and now it consists of concourses West and Central with the East Concourse still to be built The facility is modern and airy and nicely designed for post with lots of shops and restaurants post security Presecurity it is very tight particularly because people waiting for arriving passengers congregate at the two TSA checkpoints see CHOKE points For the passenger flying into or out of OKC is a breeze

The Seat I sat in seat A next to the window this seat was spacious and much better than other airlines Ive flown in this region There was ample legroom the width was reasonable and the window on the Embraer was large as normal The configuration of the cabin is interesting and is incredible due to lacking a middle seat The Service The staff were perfectly friendly kind and polite with us and offered us gingerbread men and water during the flight The gingerbread was better than I expected and the water was normal The Ground Service The flight was perfectly on time and we landed on schedule The boarding was normal and was completely seamless which was surprising at Gatwick Overall the flight was seamless and comfortable I booked this flight using miles so I cant comment on the price but I would definitely recommend Helvetic Airlines if you are flying to Switzerland over lowcost airlines like EasyJet in the same region

Toronto City Center while dwarfed in size by nearby Toronto Pearson Airport provides an exceptional experience for travelers Most notable is the terminal cafeteria stocked with free coffee soft drinks and light snacks In an era where nothing seems to be given out for free in air travel it is refreshing to see this at City Center The terminal is designed differently than those at most other airports As opposed to separate waiting areas for each gate there is one central waiting area which serves every gate the airport has gates At first glance the sight is a bit jarring but travelers will feel at ease as they settle in to the comfortable seats with their free snacks City Center is also recommended because of its location Views from within the airport and during approaches are beautiful as the airport is situated over water Lake Ontario Meanwhile the airport is very close to downtown Toronto making transport to and from the airport quick and cheap

Unscheduled visit to this fantastic little airport Staff member on the front desk helped me with my bags right through to departures I have broken my wrist cant thank her enough for great customer service Then through to feel spoiled in the aspires lounge by the host with the most Brilliant service I shall definately return to this super place again

As much as people complain I found entering Pearson to be a breeze The whole process of disembarking walking and clearing immigration went quickly and I was through within minutes most of that walking and enjoying a coffee while I waited for my bus The staff were courteous and pleasant On my departure once again seamless with efficient customs officials Terminal has improved the seating and I was impressed As always the beer is overpriced but tell me an airport where it isnt The PA announcements were very clear a bonus compared to a good number of airports I have been through Maybe it was just the day but the complimentary WiFi kept kicking out after minutes or so Overall no complaints

ODSIEV on a new ATR having small screens for the safe announcements and you can see some comics during the hour minutes flight Flight was full but service was ok they offered refreshment Staff were very friendly and we were on time Overall very nice experience

Barra is an amazing airport its tiny shed like and has few facilities The most people there at one time will only be approx as the flights are operated by little twin otters What makes Barra great is the runway its the beach The approach and landing experience are a must Also once youve got off and collect your bag from a shelter in the car park youve got a maximum of metres to walk to your car taxi or bus they meet every flight and are a good way to get around the islands

I flew with Boliviana de Aviacin from Cochabamba to Madrid with my wife and two children We flew on a B for the first shorthaul flight from Cochabamba to Santa Cruz and then on a A from Santa Cruz to Madrid Very friendly service on board Personal screens on each seat for the long flight They could make some progress on the food tthey serve though This being said we had two full meals dinner and breakfast unlike other airlines who only offer one free meal for the same hour flight Santa CruzMadrid We arrived to Madrid on time All in all a very pleasant experience with BoA

I must say I was quite surprised with this relatively new airport It is well designed and all checkin security and boarding processes were very efficient The free wifi connection is probably one of the best services Ive experienced so far The choice of dining and shopping are also very good The airport itself is quite far from the city but there is a train service to the city

A small pleasant and friendly airport All the staff are really nice and now even the younger staff at security are very friendly which wasnt typical before the pandemic The procedures are very fast However during peak times there is absolutely not enough space around the caf and dutyfree shops in the Schengen section even after the recent terminal upgrade I really miss the newspaper stand in this area I would especially like to praise the staff at Little Slovenia in the NonSchengen section Its truly a small oasis of kindness and wellbeing

BDL is my hometown airport I found plenty of kiosks for checkin at US Airways and went through security quickly On the airside at US Airways gates very limited options in terms of stores and restaurants and the good shopsrestaurants are at the other side of the terminal Upon return finding luggage is easy and the pickup for valet lots is fast the amenities are limited but the airport is streamlined and easy to use I prefer BDL plus connection to a direct flight from BOS or JFK anytime
We took flight from Kathmandu to Delhi The aircraft was Airbus Flight was quite good and on time Food that was given during flight was good and well presented cabin crew was so friendly and humble

Passed through Toronto City Centre Airport on a recent trip from Chicago to Quebec It is a small airport so very easy to navigate We were through Canadian immigration very promptly and back through security for our onward flight without fuss The departure lounge was very comfortable with plenty of seats available All the immigration and airport staff that we encountered were friendly and helpful Overall a great introduction to Canada and one of the best airports that I have been too

On arrival into APW in the evening heat arrived into immigration waiting for minutes as there were no immigration officers to process our docs as if they were on lunch This was a bit of a shock Apart from that dilemma baggage was swift on the conveyer belt pretty fast Custom officers very polite efficient Faleolo airport is very open spacious In a hot humid climate tiles are laid through the entire airport There are no main entrance doors to the terminal as it is one open place but very modern indeed Departure lounge quite nice with the Tropical Pacific feel to it a big beautiful bar dominates the one huge departure lounge This would be the only place together with the PH J Class lounge is airconditioned
A great small and friendly airport with views to die for All flights seem to come and go on time with no issues Good choice of shops and eateries plenty of seating great views and friendly staff

Massena to Boston I flew once on the charter service on Boutique Air and multiple times on the commercial side of things I am amazed on how professional and fun everyone is We know about Boutique Air from living in upstate NY and so me and my friends of mine chartered Boutique Air to New York City for my bachelorette party and then I often take them to Boston I am hoping for more routes out of Massena since right now they only do Baltimore and Boston Either way its nice having a reliable company in my area that I can count on to get me where I need to be

The new terminal building is probably the best small airport terminal in Europe Small efficient very friendly and checkin procedure is made in minutes Beside Munich by Lufthansa Amsterdam by KLM Intersky to Vienna and Berlin Brussels is now connected with Berne by EAE Overall a great airport

I recently traveled through Johannesburg International Airport and was thoroughly impressed by the exceptional service and overall experience The airport staff were incredibly helpful and friendly making the whole journey smooth and stressfree The facilities were clean wellmaintained and easy to navigate enhancing the overall travel experience From efficient checkin processes to a wide range of dining and shopping options Johannesburg International Airport truly excels in providing a topnotch travel experience I highly recommend this airport for its great service and overall pleasant atmosphere
Quite amazing that Bangkok Airways manages to serve a warm meal with drinks and coffee on a minutes full flight free of charge Even though the food wasnt very special but still edible it impressed me
Clean easy to navigate reasonably priced for an international airport weak wifi signal Security staff not very polite The airport was easy to access

TCI is a beautiful welcoming island with fabulous accommodations great beaches wonderful restaurants plenty to do etc However the government obviously has a policy of treating visitors terribly upon arrival and departure This was my wifes and my third visit and it has only gotten worse Evidently their desire is to cut down on the large number of tourists visiting by making arrival and departure tortuous you have succeeded Upon finally boarding our plane back to the US my wife turned to me and said We need to consider other options for our next trip I cant afford the mental cost of coming and going here I readily agreed and our plan for a fourth visit to TCI was quickly moved to the dustbin I strongly recommend that anyone considering a trip to TCI consider other destinations until this airport is improved

Johannesburg to Gaborone with Air Botswana Fast check in at airport On time boarding and departure Full flight operated by an ATR Good Crew A good snack of crackers and local beef jerky served Landed on time Fast immigration and was out of airport in minutes Return flight on same day Again fast check in Fast Security control and immigration On time departure on a newer ATR Rather empty flight with everyone having an empty seat next to them Good snack and wide array of drinks served by a crew happy to do more than their best On time arrival in JNB Small airline but they know what they are doing Recommended on visits to Botswana

Johannesburg to Gaborone with Air Botswana Fast check in at airport On time boarding and departure Full flight operated by an ATR Good Crew A good snack of crackers and local beef jerky served Landed on time Fast immigration and was out of airport in minutes Return flight on same day Again fast check in Fast Security control and immigration On time departure on a newer ATR Rather empty flight with everyone having an empty seat next to them Good snack and wide array of drinks served by a crew happy to do more than their best On time arrival in JNB Small airline but they know what they are doing Recommended on visits to Botswana

Hong Kong to Xian Being the second time travelling with Cathay Dragon my impression towards this airline is greatly improved In my flight to Xian except for my IFE that failed to show the flight map everything just went right and nothing special happens the cabin crew also provided good service to us However as things went wrong in the return flight back from Xian to Hong Kong the excellence of the Cathay staff is well demonstrated As the Hong Kong Airport Authority restricted flights from landing in Hong Kong that day after we entered the cabin with the door closed we were still not sure whether we can fly The cabin crew reacted professionally to answer many enquiries from passengers meals were served on ground and we could just wait for further notifications from the pilot Finally the flight was delayed to the next day we were then forced to leave the cabin and went back to the airport the only thing that made me discontented is that there was no any compensation from the airline though the airport restriction issue is not the problem of the airline In the delayed flight next day we saw the same crew and they also showed how professional they are After knowing that it is the birthday of one of our friends they even provided snacks and gifts to us Their quality of service was just awesome and left us very deep impression It is really an unforgettable experience travelling with Cathay Dragon and it is definitely a yes if I have a chance to travel with them once more

San Francisco to Indianapolis I was on my last leg of journey home from New Zealand I flew out with American an then Fiji Air New Zealand Jetstar in New Zealand and they were all great The staff on Virgin America need to fly with these airlines and learn how to smile be friendly and not look grouchy A smile goes a long way

SJO is a very modern airport immigration is friendly but asks to see all your papers come prepared if you do not hold your tickets carpeted floor free wifi Internet expensive gift shops and food carts taxi fare is high usd for a minutes drive before checking in you must pay departure tax it now costs usd you can pay with credit card overall good experience I will be back in the summer
Wonderful crew on this very short flight The aircraft comfort better than the ATR which is the main BW commuter No service on this minute hop but all in all great value and on time

A generally good experience at Durban airport Arrival is quite simple and they seem to keep the touts out of the waiting area The checkin is well organized and immigration outbound proceeded quickly There are a number of shops and restaurants The food and the shopping are forgettable but not expensive Decent amount of seating at the gates Wifi works fine

What a lovely little airport the whole experience seemed organised with little to no queuing areas as passengers seemed to just self manage to the different areas of the airport From check in to departure the airport was very clean with little wrong on this front I found myself very impressed with the smiling security team as I went through pre security and main search area as well Arrivals was good as well with clean arrivals area straight from the plane I was really impressed with this airport when comparing to some of the UK airports it has a much higher standard Wifi runs on a free voucher system which worked a treat very easy with no need to sign up Shopping is not great as there is just a duty free shop and FB is limited and expensive Overall a very good airport

This is a fantastic airport Short walking distances nice staff good easytonavigate easytouse layout a stressfree atmosphere nice cafs I used Billund as a transit passenger on my way from Copenhagen to Berlin and my only minor remark is that the TRANSIT signs just pointed to a locked door I had to walk back exit and go through security again Never mind there was no queue and I doubt the locked door is standard procedure since the security folks got a little bit puzzled when they saw my Copenhagenissued boarding pass Dont hesitate to use this airport

No real problem with the airport As with most chinese airports its rather recent with pretty efficient baggage claim Its also relatively close to the city ab km which means there are cheap and crowded regular buses and taxi will cost you maybe yuan But what I really love is the waiting area outside

Very slow running late on our arrival and departure nearly missed connecting flight back home because of slow progress at Male airport Lovely Maldives you are amazing but please step up your services and speed at the airport

Ccuta to Palonegro SATENA is a Colombian regional carrier that offers good connectivity to remote regions of the country and also serves big cities Pleasant experience with courteous staff punctual departure and arrival wellorganised boarding and luggage delivery The airline has been around for over years but is normally overlooked It is an excellent choice for domestic travel within Colombia

VIP Boarding is a scam VIP Seats are a scam Too many flight cancellations without warning Every question I ask the response is I dont know Uncomfortable seats Always super late and they lie about being on time I will stick to USbased airlines from now on This is the last time I fly VivaAir

Modest airport staffed by cheerful smiling people typical Malawian experience Took about mins to get through immigration and another mins to reclaim bags Most peoples bags are opened at customs for a cursory examination On the way out check in was a bit Heath Robinson systems were down and bagsboarding passes manually processed Only downside was the check in agent tagged my bag through to LHR using a handwritten tag and told me unconvincingly it would be fine Just as well that I took the precaution of checking at Johannesburg as the bag came out on the belt and I had to check it in again Overall a satisfactory experience

Excellent flight good service with hearty meal starter main course dessert tea and coffee Duty service on board A generous pitch for economy class seats Note the delay at departure due to the closure of Orly airport and the flights diverted to Paris CDG

I thought this airport was lovely Outside are the cobbled roads and tram link into center In the main airport terminal the facilities are excellent They have a truly amazing viewing deck with information about the space programme and aircraft using the airport Security was quick efficient and friendly and boarding immediate to the aircraft I feel Bremen airport gives passengers the proper respect they deserve even when travelling a budget airline

Second busiest airport in Finland after Helsinki now really quiet thanks to covid Terminal is reasonably big and has jet bridges so you dont need to go outside while boarding unless its a small turboprop like we had which cannot use jet bridges There are couple of shops a bar and a cafe and just like most other airports in Finland there are rocking chairs where to relax and even a piano anyone can play Checkin security and baggage claim went smoothly and fast since there were only a few passengers Airport is well connected to the city by buses and taxi

Traveling through Murtala International airport in Lagos Nigeria is an experience Staff are generally friendly and smiled a lot My documents were repeatedly checked I counted ten checkpoints altogether At five of them I was asked if I would hand over some money They weirdest situation was that the customs officer asked how much money I carry and then after hearing the honest as he was a customs officer answer asked me if I would give him some of it The airport is quite run down and processes are not streamlined Boarding was rather chaotic with passengers placed on different coloured seats after the boarding passes were scanned

ADDAMM via Sanaa Overnight in Sanaa where Yemenia provide hotel and breakfast Pleasant flight attendants and acceptable food A good flight and a lot cheaper than competitors I had to change this flight and put it forward by one week which was no problem and didnt cost anything to change

SCAT has a very poor reputation but I had no problems with them Check in was performed by a handling agent in Almaty and as usual with any airline there it was perfunctory but efficient I had selected my seats previously online with no issues The flight started to board a little late alongside an Air Astana flight departing minutes later to Astana resulting in many passengers going to the wrong gate and being turned back there This is more an airport issue than an airline one though The flight pushed back around minutes behind schedule The aircraft although rather old felt comfortable and the crew were very efficient They managed to serve candies before take off a boxed meal and a drink followed by tea and coffee and more candies before landing all for a hour minute flight Baggage was included in the ticket price and the onboard service was friendly The price was less than many European low cost carriers would charge for their most basic service Their low safety ranking nearly put me off but according to their website they are working on getting accreditation so this reassured me and I am glad I flew with them

We have used this airport in the past there is noticeable improvement in the facilities and services The check in are is spacious with adequate seating and few shops The check in process was smooth and the security swift and friendly After security there is a large waiting area with free newspapers and view of the apron the separture lounge is upstairs and they have aerobridges A good regional airport if you want to go to see the Big Cat Tigers

I use the airport of Brindisi quite often and among the years several improvements have been made to the terminal area It is now clean with several shops and bars Toilets are available in the departure and arrival areas The security check may be a little bit complicated because the area is a bit small Once passed the gate area offers enough space and a bar to wait your boarding time The only issue which needs to be resolved soon is related to the car parkings There are now several flights and in fact Brindisi airport carried Mln pax in It is mandatory to build up a multi story car park close to the terminal Overall judgement of the airport is widely positive

Really small airport but everything went fine Fast check in and fast security check Theres only one coffee shop kuna for a cappuccino and kuna for water is a decent price People speak English and are friendly The WiFi works fine but you have to get the password from the personnel I asked a girl from the duty free shop Taking points away only because the WiFi password is not available somewhere and you have to ask and there are no nice seating areas

Not good for transit passengers Staff are polite and helpful but nowhere to relaxsleep in a darker and quiet area No ATMsshopsfood outlets just a cafe upstairs Toilets clean Electric socket near where I was sitting didnt work I obtained wifi with the help of someone as there seems to be no airport wifi This lounge is just a square room brightly lit with toiletschairs and a few coffee tables Please improve our flying experience

On the whole SSA is everything youd expect a mediumsized airport to be Its spacious well signposted and safe Checkin is usually fast except for charter flights to Europe security is fast and friendly domestic arrival also fast and efficient The one major problem at SSA are the long queues at customs in the afternoon when several international flights arrive pretty much at the same time If you dont carry a Brazilian passport expect to stand in line for over an hour There are just enough shops and food amenities SSA is still thankfully first and foremost an airport not a shopping mall If you are taking a bus from the city centre to the airport or vice versa be aware that traffic in Salvador is horrendous and the journey at peak times will take at least two hours

Please note this review is for Terminal This terminal was opened years so its relatively new Terminal looks classy with the palm trees outside it Had a good experience at Guarulhos Security line was quick and efficient Passport control was also light in traffic and staff were polite as is often the case in Brazil Not too many shops but the terminal is manageable and not huge so walking distance is good What lets Guarulhos T down a bit is the signposting needs to be better The Free WIFI was great

Booking Mostly smooth except could not select seats and when selected the selection would not be saved Checkin Got reminder and was easy to conduct online checkin except no boarding pass as the document verification is not online Boarding Chaotic as boarding was not by zones but first come first serve So lot of traffic jams in the isles and many people sitting in seats they were not assigned to Broken seats with stained covers and strange smells Handrests chipped seatbacks cracked Enough legroom Inflight entertainment Many screens and controls not working broken Wireless entertainment worked smoothly but no clear directions on how to access it Inflight meals Very basic many drink choices eg gin and tonic not available Deplaning Long wait before people could get off not sure if it was the ground staff or the plane Baggage checkin and collection Smooth Got ontime notifications about baggage being loaded on different planes along the route Collection was also easy

Ive been in CCS many times and the improvements made to the airport are incredible Very friendly and helpful staff Still it is not a modern airport but manageable considering the amount of passengers The only bad thing is that they are not paying attention to the security and when you are in the arrivals hall a bunch of people come and ask you if you want a taxi or maybe you want to buy the local currency I undestand this due to the political situation the country is facing but as I always say it could and must be better

Due to a mechanical fault the plane that landed was too small for all of the passengers So the ground staff at Nevsehir had to work really hard to deal with about people who could not fit The staff in this small office tried so hard to identify the most urgent passengers who had connecting flights then they prioritised everyone The staff were faced with passengers who all thought they were the most important person in the airport We did not have a connecting flight and were lower priority So the team arranged for about of us to be bussed to nearby Kayseri airport our flight was going to be hours later than expected So the ground staff refunded the cost of our flight not once but twice We were able to collect the money from a counter at the airport immediately then we were upgraded to Business class which meant we were able to sit in quiet and cool comfort while we waited Then on the flight we were very impressed with the food and service and priority baggage service I know the fault was not due to the ground staff but they really tried hard and were very successful at getting people through to their connecting flights and what they offered us really helped ease the pain of our delay I am really impressed with the people in that small office I wish I da their names to thank them personally I highly recommend flying with Turkish Airways after this experience
Short but pleasant flight on time Friendly crew cheap tickets clean plane and for a such a short flight a good snack was offered Boarding and deboarding fast

This is one of the nicest airports I have visited The staff are all helpful and cheerful The security system is quick and efficient and the seating areas are comfortable and spacious The woman playing piano in the area prior to security really sets the tone The whole expereince was professional polite and efficient

I fly from Amsterdam to Norwich and back regularly The airport is always a breeze Check in never has a queue security never has a queue You can arrive minutes before a flight and its never a trouble Staff are nice and friendly There isnt a massive selection of things to do airside but you wouldnt expect there to be The development fee is bizarre but certainly not unique to Norwich Go to a small airport get a small airport experience Norwich appears well run and is always a pleasure to fly through If you want a big airport experience go to a big airport Ill happily take shorter waiting times and friendlier service and stick with Norwich
CPHFAE return new aircraft on time friendly and smiling FA snack alcoholic nonalcoholic beverage served

Nice friendly airport Quick check in usually efficient security screening everybody keeps moving Gates are easy to findnavigate Short on food options nice bar after security near Gate Good coffeebagel bar near Gate The new airport is about finished Will be nice to see the improvements Eisenhower is the new airport name excellent choice

Its a LCC and as such they do a great job Check in was smooth Without major hassles The flight departed on time only to be held up by the tower for half an hour due to traffic The seat was comfortable They did something strange for a LCC They fed all of us a free meal It wasnt the best meal But it was a hot chicken Meal And also due to some social media content They gave everyone on board a free gift of a tshirt Im sure that was a once off But all in all great flight experience Note no wifi and no screens But thats minor now days Because we all have Content

I was a little worried after booking Island Air due to some of the reviews I have read about latecancelled flights Our flight was on time I did notice that on days when the weather was very poor that flights were showing some delays but I guess this would be in common with most airlines flying around the islands The quick minute hop was pleasurable and stress free Island Air operates from the commuter terminal at HNL In reality it is just them and another small airline that shares the facility No lines at check in no lines through security Once airside free wifi available throughout as well as free newspapers and even coffee Onboard had great views and even some commentary en route by one of the flight attendants pointing out points of interest Was a nice touch Served either a bottle of water or a cuplet of juice Bags US each to check in appeared on reclaim belt within a minute of arriving in the baggage hall All staff in the airport and onboard were really friendly

Arrived from Bangkok on Thai flight and still bussed to the terminal in June Queues for visa on arrival handled relatively quickly and luggage handling dealt with promptly and efficiently Friendly staff with a relaxed atmosphere

I have been in this airport many times over the last three years and it is by far the best airport I have experienced in Latin America It is clean and new and easy to get through with no long queues only a little when waiting in immigration after transatlantic flights Everything is very open and there is many different things to buy in taxfree

Islamabad to Manchester Very prompt check in for Shaheen Air No hassle Boarding very professional and well organised Friendly cabin staff Clean very aircraft Good quality food served lunch Asian style and evening dinner European style and plenty of cold drinks coffee tea Little treats like chocolates also served during flight Food served on time and promptly This flight had free Wifi which worked well Generally very happy with Shaheen Air I would definitely recommend and I would fly again with them

Nuremberg is an amazingly convenient and fast airport You get there easily by public transportation from the metro station to check in its not even one minute walking and you can be at your gate within minutes of arriving Baggage delivery is quick mostly your baggage is already at the conveyor belt when you get there
The plane was modern and the cabin very clean and appealing The crew was very friendly and professional Fast check in and at Belgrade Airport the suitcases arrived very fast

Round trip from Guatemala to Roatan via San Pedro Sula and Tegucigalpa respectively June For all hour flying segments service was exemplary lunch box on every flight with delicious sandwiches On the way back departing Roatan plane was intensively checked for an oil leakage threatening our connection at Tegucigalpa with passengers getting nervous about the situation but TACA agent in the waiting room was reassuring Even offered a free phone call to Guatemala The plane got fix and we landed just in time in Tegucigalpa with TACA personnel waiting for us at the door of the plane with umbrellas over the tarmac to get to the other plane When we landed in Guatemala all luggage arrived too Great service from all the involved staff at all the airports and flights

Since the new modern terminal was inaugurated traveling to Pristina has become more convenient and a more pleasant experience than before All needed facilities are here in a minimum amount of space But it feels very fresh and airy though The new terminal really is great and pretty much everything has improved since the old terminal isnt used anymore

Vientiane to Bangkok UPlane was clean food was excellent tuna sandwiches plus water and a second drink of either Pepsi Coffee Tea Miranda Orange or more water The crew made this flight excellent for a start there are cabin crew in total which made a difference to the service time delivery Every member of the crew smiled were courteous served ladies first to emulate their countries values and did a great service One small minor point was that my seat back pocket was broken slightly in A Will definitely use again

At last a quiet clean and efficient airport Terminal F without the tiresome duty free The hourly Borispil Express train will drop you off near Terminal D and you need to catch a halfhourly shuttle bus to Terminal F mainly for LCC flights as its something like a m walk otherwise The number of flights is fairly small and seemingly mainly Ryanair Plenty of room to wait just a couple of refreshment options Straightforward passport control and security no queues Plenty of seats in the departure lounge easy access to gates good view of airport operations No duty free Hooray A couple of refreshment stands No air bridges but then LCCs dont use them anyway A very relaxing experience particularly in contrast to departing from a UK airport
Flight attendants hospitality service careful consideration I hope the WiFi on airplanes will be better in the future Cabin clean and tidy It was an unforgettable journey

A couple of points firstly there is now a new terminal so most of the tips above do not now apply Agree about the prices for coffee etc they are outrageous They now handle more international flights for example to Bangkok so I would like to think they are better equipped for international flights now I have Never been stopped by the immigration people I find them very friendly Last point the taxis There is no doubt they are expensive They are on the clock but from the airport the clocks run fast From my old apartment it was km to the airport and on one occasion km back Better to pay rmb for the bus directly outside the airport then get a taxi from the Aviation hotel in the city Hope this helps

KULCTUKUL The Shuanglin terminal is equipped with all the usual amenities The toilets are clean the terminal is clean The terminal also has signs in EnglishChinese Going through customs and immigration is a breeze You can reach the city centre easily by bus or taxi however signs to the bus outside was not to clearly shown

This June we booked on La Compangnie Newark to Paris return Our flight over was cancelled hours before departure We had firm bookings on a flight Paris to London La Compagnie offered us a later flight instead of Paris to Nice Of course we could not make our Paris to London connection We dropped that and waited until the next morning flying directly to London from Nice We incurred an extra nights stay in Nice taxi rides a lost ticket from Paris to London lost return flight when you dont show for the first flight you lose the return and a lost night in our London hotel adding up to over a thousand dollars in extra costs At the end of our stay in England and Paris we were told that our flight from Paris to Newark was also cancelled If we arrived at am at Orly we would be put on the morning flight instead of the more comfortable afternoon departure Flights for people both cancelled and we are repeat customers The check in people at La Compangie said the company would meet us they did not would reimburse us if we showed receipts they did not After multiple attempts to contact anyone by phone and waiting for weeks they more or less told us too bad we owe you nothing Unless you are willing to see your flight changed with very little notice and you have a great deal of flexibility or insurance at the other end do not fly this amateur operation

The international terminal of Haikou Airport is a very spacious terminal I have ever seen The terminal is small and dedicated The staff of VIP room help me to carry the language when I arrived and welcome me before I check in and keep me company all the way to the lounge There is a beautiful tropical garden in the terminal The staff in the airport is professional and dedicated I want to thank them for treating me so well

This is a small but friendly airport The checkin area is not air conditioned and is hot Checkin was efficient immigration and security were efficient with hardly any queues In departures there were two food and drink outlets a dutyfree shop and several other shops Boarding was efficient

The airport is wellorganized secure and clean with nearly all services available The crew at Air Mauritius is extremely professional and they go above and above to execute their jobs in a courteous and professional manner Nishi the travel consultantpassenger service is amazing in terms of customer service and taking care of passengers with a smile and enthusiasm

International Arrival at Tashkent is fine Bus from plane to terminal Very quick and smooth passport control no landing card needed no forms to fill in Baggage Reclaim was slow for some reason Money Exchange in Baggage Reclaim Hall along with local mobile SIM Cards Baggage Xray and then walk in fenced off compound to where taxis and buses await the usual scrum of offers of taxi etc Domestic Departures in separate building which is older Xray and show ticketETicket to get in then Checkin desks Security scanning of hand luggage basic water is allowed to go through Departure Hall has gates for bus loading of planes There is a small cafe serving drinkssnacks and seats International Departures is in a separate building scanned to get in and lots of Checkin Desks Only Money Exchange that was reluctant to exchange Uzbek Soms but did so very important as there is nowhere to do so after passport control Checkin show as no online checkin everyone has to checkin to get a Boarding Pass Passport Control quite quick and Security OK International Departures has a mix of shops selling local items and usual big brand alcholcigarettes price in USD or EUR prices OK A few cafes that were priced in local currency Euros or US Dollars Many departure screens and quite a lot of seating Only a couple of air bridges so most planes land on remote stands served by buses

Found arrival experience excellent Check in on departure was good and quick Security was good and quick However toilets before security were not good no lock or even handle on gents toilet door Cafe was ok but no toilet After security there where vending machines but if you had no euros you couldnt get anything aircon lacking

We took a short flight from Vientiane to Luang Prabang and service at every touchpoint from checkin to arrival was delivered with smiles professionalism and efficiency A clean aircraft with ample leg room was another example of their star service If my experience was the standard that Lao Airlines delivers then this airline will surely go places Highly recommended

Lovely experience through check in and security at around am this morning th July The chap at Tui desk was friendly professional and helpful All four members of staff at security were great Helpful friendly and professional Lovely atmosphere At the caf a lovely women served me Smile on her face Finally going through to boarding gate yet again a friendly cheerful and helpful lady checked me in am by this stage Its a small airport The shop and caf are small Im not here to shop or sit drinking Im here to have an ideally stress free start to my holiday The staff make this place Thank you

I flew from Blantyre airport a number of years ago and was struck by just how quaint the whole set up was It is a very basic airport not far off the common tin shack analogy that comes with most African airports There is very little to do and there is just a bar to distract you The best thing about Blantyre airport is the Duty Free shop A selection so limited it is almost refreshing Malawi Gin Whisky JW Cane spirit macadamia nuts coffee and nick nacks I bought to W light bulbs that had been turned into paraffin lamps Wonderful

Bydgoszcz airport is very small but there are many people traveling through it daily There are no shops only one cafe and newsagents both in the duty free area Security checks are usually fast and check ins go smoothly This city would benefit from a much bigger airport and hopefully it will soon have one

Visited Tirana on and departed on Both the arrival and departure experiences were smooth There was a slight delay at passport control on arrival as the scanner was not working at the booth where we presented our passports This is a neat and bright medium sized airport There is a lot of seating at the departure gates There is a nice Business Lounge that we accessed through our Priority Pass card The staff are friendly and professional Check in was effortless There is no online check in for TIA so one has to check in at the counter WiFi is available however it appeared to be spotty We did not have to wait very long for our luggage to arrive in baggage claim There are no jet bridges at TIA All passengers are bussed to and from the terminal to the aircraft

A small airport where you can go from the luggage checkin to the gate within minutes There were enough places to sit down and the WiFi is good If you want to eat something before the security there is a restaurant with enough food pricequality top After the security you can also drink or eat something Boarding goes quickly

Flew out of Dundee Airport for the first time even though it is our home town when we are back for the summer holidays Friendly checkin staff and understanding security staff Yes it is a small airport and lacks the faciilities of say Edinburgh and Glasgow But after the Glasgow incident it was refreshing to drive to an airport and not suffer the issues encountered at other BAA airports The takeoff to London City provides a fantastic view of the Tay Will use it more often

A wonderful flight from Tehran to Paris with new A that was very modern Good entertainment system but only a small number of film and music choices but a very good flight map The aircraft was very clean Two meals were served first a very good breakfast and a snack later

HELCPHHEL HELCPH on Avro RJ ontime both ways Clean aircraft crew and service are nothing special but seats comfortable and spacious in the x configuration CPHHEL on B food for purchase in both directions drinks free In general this is competitive to SAS on the same sector but definitely a lowcost feel without a particularly lowcost price

We flew Qantas on a flight operated by Finnair on their behalf from Sydney to Bangkok It was a great experience from start to finish staff smiley and helpful Finnair my special GF food great good entertainment offer and we left on time from Sydney and touched down a few minutes early in Bangkok It was the distinct mixture of experiences on this flight which have made me post A collaboration of Scandinavian Australasian and Asian continents More like this please Just great My husband would have liked just a bit more legroom in economy for a long flight

Baghdad airport is OK It works without too much hassle It is a reasonably modern building There are linked terminals which you can easily walk between both airside and landside There is a restaurant landside and small cafes both sides Capacity is limited airside though Usual facilities landside mobile phone companies ATMs exchange etc If you have a long transit it is better to stay landside and visit the restaurant There are moderate queues for security and immigration can be a bit slow If you are not on Iraqi Airways there may not be any business lounge available certainly not for Turkish anyway

I had just gotten to Khartoum from Dubai and I really had to use the washroom I went to the mens washroom and man oh man It smelled like people went there and forgot to flush I didnt use the washroom I ran back to my father because there was faeces on the floor of the toilet as well Outside I saw a janitor sitting in his chair comfortably and as I do not know how to speak Arabic I just decided to hold it instead of telling someone to clean up Other than this the airport was alright but not even close to ideal A month later my mother came via the same flight and airport and she had to wait hours at the luggage belt for her luggage to arrive

Baghdad airport is OK It works without too much hassle It is a reasonably modern building There are linked terminals which you can easily walk between both airside and landside There is a restaurant landside and small cafes both sides Capacity is limited airside though Usual facilities landside mobile phone companies ATMs exchange etc If you have a long transit it is better to stay landside and visit the restaurant There are moderate queues for security and immigration can be a bit slow If you are not on Iraqi Airways there may not be any business lounge available certainly not for Turkish anyway

Vancouver to Whitehorse Air North is a wonderful friendly airline serving the Yukon Their combination of an older fleet and genuine hospitality makes it the ideal way to get to Canadas beautiful Yukon There is no IFE on board any of their aircraft which can be a downside for longer trips but the food is all free and comes is greater quantity then the meal options you pay for on mainline carriers Air Norths flights are finished with a warm cookie service which is always enjoyable Overall a great airline and great customer service
It is easily accessible from the city center by metro within minutes It is clean and modern Employees are friendly and helpful Signposts are clear Goods are bountiful

Luang Prabang International is a small and pleasant airport with a decent selection of amenities and relatively good service Upon arrival in Luang Prabang immigration officials will direct you to the relevant desks for passport checks if you dont need a visa you will be directed straight to the passport control desks The airport has a money changer located right outside the arrivalsdepartures area where the US dollar rate is relatively similar to the rates quoted in town There is a desk to order a taxi for kip per person or if you prefer a cheaper ride you can try to hail a tuktuk from outside the terminal Checkin was very quick on my flight departing Luang Prabang and I cleared the immigration check within minutes as my SilkAir flight had few passengers Inside the airport there are some shops selling local crafts and duty free outlets though they werent very interesting Anyone whos flying Bangkok Airways will be pleased to not that they have a waiting lounge in this airport There was plenty of seating in the gate areas and boarding of my flight was very efficient All in all this is a good airport to use if you ever have a chance to use it and if your flight isnt full

Used this airport several times over the past decade at various times of the day and on long and short haul flights A small pleasant airport where it is usually possible to find a quiet corner Staff are helpful and usually smile Dining is American fast food variety and expensive Pay the departure tax in advance at your hotel Avoid the postsecurity shopping as the prices are high

Small airport but airport location wonderful Dont have boarding bridge Ground staff are very fast No need to wait for a long time to check in bags I got my bag on arrivals right after reaching the belt very fast Staff are friendly No shops inside airport taxi counters before arrival gate

This ugly block is straight out of Stalins era although a new terminal is going up alongside The old one is tatty Two gates A B A few little shops a bar and no smoking inside VIPs are called earlier than other travellers and in my case to a different gate Keep your eyes peeled I tried my Skyteam Platinum card on the VIP gate and it worked The VIP lounge plumbs new depths Seedy styling and furniture with a peeling linoleum floor and no smoking there either And you have to pay for everything even a coffee but the range of food and drink is quite reasonable Still we did get our own minibus to the aircraft and we got on first To be fair the folks around the place are friendly enough

My son and I flew them in June from Copenhagen to Podgorica It was an older F aircraft but quite comfortable In fact we commented on how far the seats reclined The flight attendants were nice and the cockpit crew did a nice job getting us there safely We departed on time and arrived on time No complaints

Hiroshimas airport is somewhat small but is intelligently laid out and easy to navigate Perhaps because of its relative newness it appears to be quite pristine inside with a good range of services for travellers The biggest drawback is the distance from Hiroshima city well over a half hour outside of the city As another reviewer noted the IBEX flight requires walking out onto the tarmac which could be a hassle in inclement weather

Due to cancellation of BA flights tofrom Amman I ended up taking RJ Had a good experience in both directions Plane was clean the seats comfortable and there was a decent IFE selection for the hour flight Crew were fine polite but not particularly friendly or warm They didnt go out of their way to assist but were responsive I was impressed that before meal service they came around with drinks and nuts you dont get that on many airlines anymore The meal selection was decent with a choice of hot dishes accompanied by a starter roll and dessert and a selection of alcohol All flights were on time I wouldnt hesitate to take them again

Very nice very small domestic regional airport I arrived from IAH Houston on a tiny little Saab and I collected my luggage and was outside in about minutes I also departed there for IAH with eventual connection to LHR and was surprised by the very welcoming attitude of the Continental staff The security staff seemed less happy to be working but I was through in under minutes Its a nice little airport with a nice little cafe and a few static displays to look at Its also used by USAF so its common whilst waiting for your flight to see an FA land or depart

KIVBUDKIV early February The plane was a SAAB both ways It is a bit old and noisy especially during takeoff but once at cruising altitude turned out to be a nice ride Check in efficient and departurearrival on time The service on this hour flight consists of a light breakfast in the morning and a hot meal for afternoon and evening flights All in all a pleasant experience Checkin quick and the same could be said about baggage delivery at both ends Would fly this airline again which is the only direct option to Budapest

Arriving passengers are bussed to the terminal where visa stamps are paid for or collected These are not visas in the traditional sense but a tourist tax of Immigration simply involves having your passport stamped there seemed to be no checks and this was done speedily Baggage delivery was very quick on a fast moving belt and you are soon outside of the terminal building Departing passengers have to endure a number of queues to get into the terminal but once through checkin is reasonably quick Luggage weight checks are very thorough and they seem disappointed if your luggage is within limits and recheck it a few times in the hope it gets heavier Departure forms are completed after checkin airside there are the usual range of caes some offering free WiFi which is really great and things you never knew you wanted Buses take you to your plane This would be a good airport by European standards and is an example to others in Egypt of how it can be done The one thing that annoyed me was that in the Gents Toilets supposedly free you were hassled even whilst occupied for a tip by the attendant he did not get one

Hong Kong to Kolkata An excellent flight where I was doted on by two very amiable and helpful cabin crew members It helped that I was one of just two passengers in the business class section which had seats in two rows of x A menu card was provided and my selection was tasty and filling A good complement of drinks and spirits was on offer However they have not changed their dessert a small cup of Haagen Daz ice cream in at least years It is always served solid frozen I passed on it and had some port wine instead The flight departed on time from a satellite terminal which was reached by a short bus ride from the main terminal Arrival was on schedule Indian government landing cards required of foreigners were provided on board The seats are traditional business class recliners and were reasonably comfortable Boarding was smooth intermixed with main cabin travelers through a jet way Ipads with a small selection of films and shows were provided soon after take off It was difficult to slot them into the metal clasps on the back of the seat in front of you you needed to hold on to the ipad to watch your program Magazines and newspapers on offer Lots of storage space overhead Leg space could be a tad extra once you recline fully your toes juts on the bottom of the front seat Announcements were made in clear English and for a very thoughtful touch also in Bengali the language of the destination city Cathay Dragon had a duty free catalog and three of my four selections were available for purchase This is one aspect of travel I very much enjoy as it lets me pick up last minute gifts

I was with my mother at the entrance of the airport There was a young man named William He asked us if we needed help and I couldnt believe he helped us to get a wheelchair immediately That was awesome customer service compared to my experience in LA airport

A relatively large regional airport for a small town However Darwin is the state capital of Northern Territory We checked in for the flight went through security and then waited for the flight to depart There were no hassles or problems Everything went smoothly

Not Verified I loved this airport I have travelled to NY many times before always into JFK Now that I have discovered the wonderful Norwegian Airlines I arrived and departed NY via Stewart International It is a relatively small airport but efficient and confident There is no masses of hurrying crowds which are the tension you get at large international airports The airport is surrounded by greenery when you leave the terminal there is a brief walk across to pick up rental car taxis or the shuttle bus so relaxing For the journey home everything was relaxed fast and efficient As I mentioned it is a small airport the bar caf shop and duty free is in a small area Some people might want more but I found it more than enough All hands are on deck in the airport to get everyone on their way home Great little airport and great flights and price by Norwegian Airlines

I have faced very rude behavior from cabin crew from Kuwait to Cochin flight on at hrs Since I was traveling with my yearold son the air hostess insisted I keep the child on the seat but the child was crying so I requested the attachments to keep the baby on my lap she was quite unhappy and brought that belt and just threw it at my seat The rest of the flight journey was nice and comfortable

Easy to access by train Plenty of shops and eateries even convenience store Lots of toy machines Clean and enjoyable to wait for our departure Signs are clear You can enjoy lunch while watching the airplanes take off Weve got our last minute omiyage shopping like handkerchiefs japan only cute snacks and satisfying lunch

STNGSE Arrived on Ryanair Single runway so only one plane can landtakeoff at a time Very compact with everything close by A very short stroll from the aircraft to the terminal where Passport Kiosks quickly processed everyone The Baggage Claim is one conveyor and there are limited toilet facilities before getting to Arrivals Hall Arrivals is midway between the Checkin Desks and the Security Scanning Outside the airport there is a taxi rank usually stocked with cars for each flight and the bus to the centre of Gothenburg Picnic tables are still outside on the grass where you can relax Security is OK and then a smallish Departure Lounge which is very busy if flights are going at similar times The Duty Free has various things but no alcohol There is a cafe selling hot and cold drinks sandwiches and similar and a small bar selling drinks There are Departure Doors of which Gate has Passport Control for nonSchengen flights NB Whilst Security is quick if there are two flights at the same time the process slows especially as most passengers travel with volumes of hand luggage that need liquids etc removed It is a good little airport and friendly in size

Came to Dushanbe airport at around am for my very early flight to Istanbul The new terminal is small but functional and easy to go through Not plenty to do but the airside cafe is quite nice with good selection and the free wifi was actually quite fast Duty free shop has the typical selection you see everywhere and some local products Plenty of places to sit down unless more than or flights going at the same time its not a very busy airport

Its very small but convenient airport There is small duty free area and coffee bar in upper floor after immigration and also one coffee bar before immigration Toilets are clean Immigration procedures on arrival and on departure are simple and fast

I really like this airport it is small and not complicated It is really clean and they have a small but nice section for kids to play Just wish there were more restaurant for the US side There are usually no delays The airport is a bit far from downtown so a bit expensive in taxi but hey they have Uber and lot of parking space

Excellent flight more leg room than other airlines cabin stewardess who was excellent and tended to all passenger requirements served all passengers with complimentary food with drink which is unknown nowadays Good old fashioned service and customers do count Flight from Waterford VG th June

Pretty good airport Nice restaurant shops and post security amenities They recently finished a terminal expansion project which I must say looks very nice Not many cheap airlines though Overall good airport

Victoria Airport on arrival the terminal was easy to find clean and well laid out Friendly and helpful staff who went out of their way to guide you checkin was a breeze and no surprises with our luggage Even the customs staff shared some humour with us On the other side of security it was just as impressive with clean well laid out waiting areas and washrooms Water fountains available that you could fill up your water bottle from and not have to pay the rip off price for bottled water like at other airports We will definitely use this airport again in the future
A very tiny airport at km to Valladolid Only a little number of flights a restaurant and a drinks and snacks machine Clean safe and quiet

Small and old airport One small ugly terminal with long queues Once past check in counter and paid php airport fee you are in a waiting area Waiting area is on two floors with several stalls selling food and drink but nothing spectacular One small duty free store as this place is an international airport but anybody can buy in this store Lavatorys even if not easy to be found are just ok Gives you the feeling you have been parachuted back to the this airport but all ended well

I believe myself to be semiwell traveled and have experienced many airport scenarios in my lifetime middle aged and will have to give kudos to Dallas Love Field TSA agents for their remarkable work getting me from the baggage claim area for general boarding all the way to my gate with time to spare in as little time as I can possibly fathom I actually witnessed a family who did not make their flight one prior to mine but same gate and persisted by raising their voices that the gate agent should have known they were there but because TSA took so much time they were late The truth later came out that they were ONLY in line for one hour on a holiday weekend That is exceptional but poor timing on their part Everyone in the aviation world knows that on a holiday weekend there is a hour minimum time preparation period to make your flight So a free plug for DLF consider this Saying all of this not only was TSA awesome in their timeliness but the gate agents kept their cool and handled the situation with excellence

Guayaquils airport has most of the services that we have here in Australia they even offer jetways into planes There are restaurants ATMs machines banks coffee shops and entertainment it passed our expectations without doubt

If you like large airports with lots of shops restaurants and people then Sanford is not the sort of airport you would appreciate However if you prefer a small regional type airport that you can pass through quickly both in and out without stress then I strongly recommend Sanford We now look at TUI flight options first simply because they use this airport The staff are friendly including immigration and security and yet its only about miles north of Orlando and roughly a minute drive to the Disney resorts We havent been here since but I can confirm from the time we started queuing for immigration to collecting baggage was only minutes Compare this to Orlando International where you would probably be held in a holding area due to congestion

Security was good because you didnt have to get liquids or electronics out of your bag Airport was clean and spacious My one huge complaint however is the service in Autogrill Italia The staff member asked me if I would like to pay times without putting it through to the card machine She would just point at it and then say PAY There was a language barrier but I feel there may have been an intelligence barrier because I stood there for mins wanting to pay and not being able to

Super tiny Airport like a bus terminal in my town but it was a quite clean and cozy place Location is nice not far from city and you can get there from city center by local bus for about euro There were nice sofas inside and the toilet was neat and clean

Old airport looks like a s relic which it is Only used for transfer which was so simple just a short walk In that sense convenient but not much to do air side and unable to comment on passport or check in services Staff pleasant and very helpful So my one hour in the Seychelles was smooth and pleasant Departure area airconditioned which was handy in c humid outside temps

Entebbe airport sets good standards for an airport in Africa Though I do not recommend staying in it for hours it is still a clean safe place Coming from Sydney it is ok Its clean and the lounge is amazing Though having kids with me did make a hassle Otherwise its a nice quiet airport to go to Especially when the border security allowed me to go from the back to the front of the line I like it

Nice small low cost but very aged airport needs full reconstruction asap Everything looks like the s but not nice way The floor was dirty so they need to improve cleaning as well Restaurant was closed so there was nowhere to even get a coffee Staff were kind and helpful Will fly there again as FR and W operate nice cheap flights otherwise no chance will be back

This was a ok flight At the airport my bag got stuck on the baggage belt and then a worker hit it really hard but thankfully I had nothing that fragile in it When we were boarding there was a delay because a seat was stuck reclined and they had to bring an engineer onboard The flight was very smooth and the cabin crew were very nice although not as nice as their biggest competitor Ryanair The landing was really good and the pilot kept giving us information about the flight

Its nothing too special but it was definitely an affordable price The inflight food and beverage was comprised of a juice box and bottled water The customer service is ok There was in issue with the website where it continually declined my card but it actually charged my card every time I attempted meaning with four attempts there were in false charges Fortunately the customer service could be reached by WhatsApp and they were able to refund me for the imaginary flight bookings

This is a pretty nice small airport where you can find anything you would expect from it There are flaws like anywhere else They definitely need more staff which is obvious The offering of time killers are updated with new shopping places but still have to work on it My main issue was the parking which was pretty expensive so I had to search around for other solutions since the parking at the airport ended up more expensive than my Wizz Air ticket I use Google and found a private parking spaces but you can also look for others I suggest this one definitely Overall it is a decent airport that keeps on upgrading every year I visit it
I have went with Novair four times OSLLPA x OSLTFS OSLFUE Great service good looking planes comfortable seats No delays new clean A The only less good thing the food

The staff are very friendly The queue times for checkin and security are almost always very short or non existent making for a very smooth fast and pleasant experience all the way to boarding For such a small airport there are also a good amount of amenities ample seating and it is always clean

Modern airport departure and arrival were quick efficient and smooth This not a big nor busy airport so there is never any big queues Immigration police cordial and friendly Almost feels like there is too much airport staff for volume of passengers particularly when departing staff in the multiple cafs looked bored I appreciated the clean toilets and multiple drinking water fountains where you could fill up water for free Duty Free felt was the biggest letdown very generic and poor Not much local Dhofari or even Omani products I think it could be better used to sell the country and region one final time before visitors leave instead of overpriced cheap souvenir tat or the usual generic Toblerone you can find at any airport in the world Even local products like the luxury Amouage perfumes were at the usual price with no deals which was a shame

A very new airport with few flights Lots of parking and an outdoor cafe Checkin easy because it is not very busy once past security the gate area is small but with plenty of seats Duty free is expensive priced in US costa coffee pizza ice creams and a cafe provide more food than at many airports Toilets are clean Free WIFI is good and fast Buses to the planes no airbridges at all Very good for an Egyptian airport
Great airline Very friendly staff Flown with this airline around times and never had a bad experience only of my flights have Been delayed and none cancelled

This is my local airport and not a bad little place Yes at times TSA slows things down to a crawl but the TSA workers here seem to actually have a sense of pride and a sense of humor I have a steel hip and this has caused numerous delays in other airports but either they know me by now or they have their collective ish together Food offerings are decent and the Powells Bookstore is a great place to grab a book for your flight My only bummer is that it IS a smaller metro airport and thus fewer international nonstops

Excellent flight comfort service politeness The flight is around hrs long and we were served a decent meal a good selection of beverages provided good entertainment in comfortable seats MTotally recommended

The airport has a nice design but it is not well maintained and you always feel its aging fast The waiting time to reach immigration might take more than an hour in summer while bags might take on average minutes in nonpeak times Duty free is good and the RJ lounge is very good with plenty of options Toilet and hygiene facilities dont have consistent standard

Narita to Naha Okinawa recently Flight was excellent On time clean new aircraft and great flight crew Check in and boarding no issues Professional and friendly staff Highly recommended for travel in Japan I am a world traveller and have flown many airlines Skymark is by far one of the best
