Leonardo da Vinci Fiumicino Airport is a huge welldesigned welldecorated airport with clean and huge facilities I waited there for hours as the checkin security check and immigration were completed early However I spent good time as the airport facilities made easy travelers to navigate and browse for shopping and restaurants Airport staffs were good They speak English well Only bad thing is that travelers have to walk long to get into the boarding bridges

Benghasi Domestic to Tripoli Domestic What a nice surprise Buraq Air is the year old private airline in Libya that operates domestically as well as to Cairo and Istanbul It is the vastly preferred carrier to Libyan Arab Airlines My flight from Benghasi domestic to Tripoli domestic was easy to purchase in town not on Sabre or Galilleo unfortunately and was just one way The domestic airport is nothing to write home about but is clean and Benghasians are very friendly with smiles all round This flight operated with a rather longinthetooth you know the ones with long cigarshaped engines but was clean and the cabin crew were polite engaging and presented themselves in smart uniforms smiles all round again This was an all economy configuration but legroom was more than European airlines in J class Soft drinks hot drinks and some cakes made a break during the minute flight

Airport was much better than expected In the general area are a few food options incl coffee shop icecream bar and a few fast food choices They even have a small duty free We were in the TAAG lounge called the Pearl lounge Clean comfortable with basic drinks food Staff are very friendly Did not see showers Internet is available but weak Other than internet this lounge is better than many US lounges I have visited I was expecting something much worse

Moscow Domodedovo to Chisinau Ive been using services of Air Moldova already for years and I have a very positive impression Airplanes are in good condition come on time and the service is great Especially I would like to point out excellent work of online help service of Online Booking I made a mistake choosing the date of flight and noticed it only after order has been placed The operator gave me a fast reply to my email and was very friendly and helpful so we could correct the date to the right one So the problem was solved within minutes Excellent work Totally recommend to use this airline
When I got out of the plane there was no bus shuttle to the terminal but this is understandable because of the Coronavirus Border control was fast and my experience at the airport was pleasant

Bahrain Airport is very nice not compare with Kuwait airport that was so awful Bahrain is clean with nice little sofas and comfortable armchairs The staff at the restaurant and the cleaners are courteous and friendly It was a nice experience

Quito is a really nice new airport about km from the city there is very little available around it The airport has free wifi which is always a bonus As it seems with all airports now the prices of small things like coffee etc are expensive My experience with the new airport was excellent not so though with the employees of American Airlines at Quito Airport beware

Flew KigaliNairobiDar and return midMarch Aircrafts were all on ageing B except the st leg was on the smaller Embraer A flight cancellation was clearly announced days in advance allowing for alternative and even better options compared to original schedule All flights on time FAs catering and seating were all good Could select my preferred exit seat free with amble legroom through KQs homepage Transfers in Nairobi were smooth Twothree pieces of luggage were received well both ways Paid access to lounge in Nairobi discounted to USD due to Silver status with Kenya airways Miles earned and given generous luggage allowance together with the inexpensive ticket make this detour over Nairobi worth the trouble as compared to direct flight alternatives All flights on time

A poor low cost experience with full service airline Lufthansa for which I paid a high fare Got a cup of water and a chocolate gr Kindly enough they let me have a second chocolate because I nicely asked In their Tourist Class not that their intraEuropean Business Class is anything great much better Lufthansa Co are nothing better than any other low cost airline when flying in Europe The only difference is that most of the European low cost airlines are consistent you get what you pay for and there are no surprises Not with Lufthansa pay higher fares add luggage seats etc and get the full noservice experience

Nanjing to Xian The check in process for this flight was smooth Cabin crew were friendly and courteous Hot meal with beverages were served However the standard of the in flight catering was neither appealing nor appetizing The passengers who sat next to me even returned the meal to the flight attendant It is indeed below average Only Chinese movies is available from the drop down LED screen Tianjin Airlines have plenty of room for improvement

Very impressed with Korean Air my first time and hopefully not my last Smart clean modern plane good legroom Meal offered was near excellent fresh and tasty other airlines take note Cabin crew pleasant and efficient flight took off on time and landed slightly ahead of schedule Would I recommend most definitely yes

Toronto to Paris via Reykjavik with WOW air The plane was smaller than any trans Atlantic flight that I had flown in the past but the boarding process was so smooth Although food is available for sale the crew were very friendly

Chisinau airport is the only international airport of Moldova and sometimes seems to be out of proportion with the growing traffic But anyway despite its small size after the latest restructuration it became a very efficient and easy to fly from The ground staff are very productive and manages the traffic with a great dexterity The number of shops and food choices remains low but its not really an airport of transit The main flaw of Chisinau airport is access to and from the airport without real shuttle service provided There is a minibus marshrutka route to the railway station but it doesnt service all night long and you often need to require a taxi very cheap Airport is very clean and staff is very professional

First time I have ever used this airline Service was impeccable on the plane Business class configuration Pyjamas given The bed is fully flat with a mattress and duvet comfortable The food quality was excellent with options of light meals when you want Breakfast was a delight The plane was fairly empty in business class but service was attentive Movies good selection not the best but good noisecancelling Headphones The Flight was on time into Brussels The lounge option is a bit weak in Shanghai the view lounge is used in Brussels Overall will use again

I was subjected to a very intimate search three times by two different TSA agents The scanner was obviously malfunctioning How do I know Well I was clean but it kept saying I wasnt Then walking on the tarmac to the plane a baggage handler insisted that I had to valet my carryon bag Once inside seeing the mostly empty luggage bays I complained to the flight attendant She went and brought the bag to me with apologies Arrival was okay but the I had to follow a bread crumb trail of corridor stairs and turns all with inadequate signage Eventually I arrived at two luggage bays and was at first relieved to see my flight posted as unloading But it turned out that we did not get our luggage in hand for hr mins No information from the uncommunicative employee in the Baggage Office She said they were trying to find the agent to see if he has any more bags Im being generous here She told me to scan a lost baggage claim code which did not work

I would not call Terminal of Sofia Airport a terminal for international flights This T is more like an intercity bus station unclean with insufficient seating with only three kiosks called I dont know why Duty free provided that the prices in them are equal and in some cases even higher than those in stores in Bulgaria Boarding organization is bordering on ZERO The socalled gates are indicated by some signs but in no way are they separated into separate areas Duty free

Ive been through ABJ Airport a number of times over the last couple of years and consider it the best airport in West Central Africa possible one of the newest Very clean and friendly with good security Customs and Immigration take a while to get through but post its no worse than in the States or Europe Air france the main carrier tofrom Europe has additional security prior to boarding the plane Check in staff and airport Staff both landside and airside very helpfull generally very good Duty Free taking both CFA Euro Dollars and credit cards

An excellent short flight with great onboard service from a friendly attentive cabin crew Leg room was ok and the seats were comfortable enough for a short flight Overall a good experience and good value

A short and very pleasant morning flight Efficient boarding airport is small nice seats Professional staff which served water and a sweet Very soft landing All in all a nice experience meeting again the high expectations for AegeanOlympic Air

Wenzhou Airport is for me one of best airports in China The New terminal is very big and very beautiful the checkin security check and boarding is fast and easy At this airport they start the automatic checkin and it is fantastic and very simple The airport staff are kind and happy to serve you

Shenyang airport traffic is not very convenient only airport buses and trams especially few flights no subway After entering the terminal the design is more atmospheric Except for China Southern Airlines other airlines can only check in minutes in advance which is not good In addition there are few automatic checkin machines so the queue at the manual checkin place is serious Security is fast and funny There are a lot of rest areas and mobile phone charging areas after security check WiFi is fast The fly in the ointment is that there are a few restaurants In addition there are many turntables at the baggage claim area and the luggage will arrive soon The guidance signs are perfect

Ground staff of LAN was ok not overwhelming nice but ok Seats in row ok IFE slow and quality ok Service of FA was good friendly and attentive Quality of food as you can expect in eco We had a transit at GRU to SCL and had to pass a security check where our water bought at FRA was taken Strange Upon arrival at FRA I had a damaged piece of baggage But the ground staff wasnt interested in any way of alpologizing but pointed out the rules for such case only Overall nothing special but a decent choice to travel to South America on long haul

An excellent Domestic terminal very large and clean The security screening upon entering the airport for a am departure was fast and thorough Plenty of check in counters and efficient agents manning them The food is very expensive but I dont buy at the airport so no problem A very nice airport all in all

Very nice regional airport convenient access to the city via metro clean and well organized not many shops and restaurants but only minutes away from city and all flights are shorthaul who need to spend couple of hours at airport for shoppping Staff are all friendly and helpful

We misplaced our passport which was very stressful However Ashley and Phil at the Canberra airport made sure that we still made it onto other flights back to New Zealand Their service was outstanding they were both so helpful nothing was a hassle which helped to alleviate a very stressful situation for us We cant thank them enough

City of Derry is a small regional airport however check in was very straight forward the Logan Air staff were very friendly The security process was a little over the top however it was fast There is a small cafe within the terminal and its servers drinks and snacks which was more than sufficient for the short wait prior to boarding the aircraft Boarding the flight was by seat number however this was orderly and efficient The flight from City of Derry to London takes just over hour The cabin crew are extremely friendly and provided some teacoffee and biscuits After landing the plane was parked in a remote apron however there was a bus to take us to the terminal upon arrival My luggage was also coming out of the carousal by the time we got to the terminal which meant I was on my way to next destination very quickly Overall this is a great service by Loganair from a regional airport

A small airport divided into mini terminals domestic international arrival and international departure Border control was fast and efficient despite the large amount of passengers The terminals itself are clean and well maintained but rather s looking Access to the aircraft is by bus boarding only There are many taxis to the center but negotiate well A few busses are available too but look like from a museum

The checkin process at Nagoya Centrair Airport was a smooth and pleasant one with kind staff assisting you if needed However the checkin counters opens only exactly hours before departure Apart from check in there is an amazing skydeck for aircraft photographers like me to photograph planes free of charge Also there are many food options to choose ranging from Japanese cuisine to Western cuisineThe central security screening was smooth and quick and I cleared security within minutes The airside had a lot of duty free shops vending machines to buy drinks and a clear view of the apron and runway Overall it was a very pleasant experience and I am happy to fly out of Nagoya Centrair Airport

Please dont heed old reviews Baku airport is modern immaculately clean entirely non smoking It has plenty of landside facilities including business lounge when it is open toilets cafebar and McDonalds Plenty of comfortable seating areas Sheraton hotel on site Good free WiFi Staff speak English and are helpful No hassling taxi drivers Cant fault it

What a pleasure We arrived into Murcia on the nd June and greeted by cheery ground staff straight to passport control a little queue at passport control nice and polite customs officers Went to baggage belt and there were a few others in front of us but mins at the most wait for our baggage Through the exit and outside in under half an hour how amazing was that The return journey went just as smoothly I was blown away by this efficient friendly and calm airport staff are amazing

Very small Airport on the Northern German Island of Sylt During Summer Season served by Lufthansa and Air Berlin with flights to major German Cities Only a handful checkin Counters and during busy hours on weekends which means or planes within a couple of hours long lines Upon Arrival only one Baggage Belt and Baggage Claim Area crowded But due to the small size of the airport and short distances from the planes to the Baggage Claim Area baggage arrives very fast Staff very friendly and efficient waiting lounge can get very crowded during peak hours Small shops and one nice CafeRestaurant Short distance to Parking Area Delivery service by Rental Car Companys No public Transport Overall a different but nice experience And flying to Sylt gives You a great chance to visit the island even from Southern Germany for only a few days

Clean plane totally indifferent crew but what is absolutely amazing is that on such a long flight the flight attendants did not distribute a single drop of water to passengers except to those will to pay for overpriced items not even the cheapest low cost airlineand this was not a low cost would do better

TLLAMS a busy morning flight on the perennially cramped CRJ Compared to my last flight with Estonian a year ago the service much better and Tallinn airport keeps improving and is now probably the nicest small airport in Europe clean free wifi comfy seats and even a library No service whatsoever on Estonian Air which besides being governmentowned is on par with Ryanair for what it offers But as a way to get from Point A to Point B its acceptable

Saint Marie to Antananarivo What an absolute pleasure flying with this new airline Madagasikara Airways Finally competition to Air Madagascar with prices half the price of the national airline reliable ontime departure convenient schedules and complimentary drink and snacks onboard with an extremely friendly cabin attendant who made announcements in languages Planes are serviced in South Africa Sad to see that despite all this the plane was only half full hopefully more will hear of it as it really deserves to succeed

I fly with IB express a few times a month Usually on time or even ahead of schedule Service on board is really good Welcome drink online entertainment full meal service with really nice food Drinks available during all flight I truly recommend them Only issue the comfort of the seat If you fly the old seat comfort nonexistent no headrest no recline If you fly the new Aneo seats are comfy for a hr flight to the Canary Islands they do recline and have headrest Good service for a low cost airline

ANA might not be the cheapest airline but every time I fly with them I conclude that the premium is worth it This was my tenth flight with ANA and like all the other flights it was a good experience Takeoff and landing were smooth and on time The cabin attendants and airport staff are the best out of all the airlines I have experienced I just wish for the snack before arrival in the paper box to be of better quality I knew what I was in for so I passed on it this time If they scrap it altogether that would be fine as well I could also be happy with more bags of senbei instead The in flight wifi is also quite weak Its hard to load videos The most you can do is some light web browsing and email

Harry Bauer lounge at Port Vila Airport is located airside after passing through Immigration and Customs We travelled Business Class on Air Vanuatu and were handed lounge invitations Its best kept secret that this lounge is also a pay as you go Lounge so anyone Economy Class passengers as well can actually access the lounge on paying a fee when the lounge is open before each departure I didnt ask what the fee was but did notice they accept credit cards by way of a credit card machine contrary to some reviews some years back stating they only accept cash The lounge is air conditioned very welcoming after walking through the nonair conditioned public waiting area There is a refrigerator with nonalcoholic drinkssodas as well as a selection of local beers Minimal snacks are on offer and comfortable seating with views out across the tarmac and runway A quiet haven to sit and relax before the flight There is sufficient seating for some or more people so not a small lounge but cosy enough Sure beats waiting in the public area where there is no air conditioning

Made three flights in a week with three different aircrafts The aircraft is clean and so are the toilets Decent food Comfortable seat No WiFi on the last flight The service on board is amazing All flights punctual Would fly them again anytime

My flight was to Milan from Toronto and return Checkin was fast the crew were polite and efficient on the ground and in flight For the most part both of my flights were on time just on the way back there was a delay of hours but Expedia had informed me through email days prior of my flight I was pleasantly surprised regarding the meals served on board to and from Italy not only you can choose from a menu but the food was delicious Also I found that choosing the option to pay for checked baggage on Air Italy site was much cheaper than paying at the airport I paid in Canadian dollars instead of euros I usually fly with Air Canada but Air Italy was much cheaper in comparison The only thing that I would appreciate is that when choosing the option to pay for my checked bag online that it would indicate checked baggage included at time of booking The flight was smooth and very pleasant I will definitely fly with Air Italy again in the near future

Ted Stevens Anchorage Airport South domestic Terminal is a pleasure to navigate through Modern uncrowded spacious scenic with many wonderful Alaskan artifacts Seems that almost everyone photographs the giant stuffed moose upon arrival A nice variety of storeseven a McDonalds with a cent ice cream cone Comfortable and roomy observation deck Short walk to be connected to People Mover city bus Alaska Railroad and rental cars no need to ride shuttle bus The most complete and careful security check I have experienced

EWRYUL late evening flight The seat CRJ was halfempty so I managed to get two seats to myself It still does feel very tight though The overhead bins wont even take a smaller backpack and the seats are very confining in terms of personal space plus you really cant see out of the window due to its low position There was a single FA serving the flight which she managed with grace and efficiency even with a drink run and some small snacks served The service in general is OK but to spend more than an hour aboard the CRJ would be a torture

Travelled late Marchearly April Completely empty extremely clean overlooking the runway walking distance from town checkin queue was non existent for me travelling to London Car hire is fine quality food available but all very cosy and empty of huge hordes of people The best airport Ive been too

This airport on Floridas East Coast is a beautiful little facility Upon deplaning I was greeted by a small but spacious and superbly appointed sixgate terminal which was quite welcoming The terminal is remarkably wellmaintained and is very userfriendly with nice short distances good signage and a few clean shops to pick up a magazine or a quick meal The personnel both Delta and the airport security were some of the most courteous airport employees that I have seen in a while with an genuine eagerness to serve The only downside to DAB is the relatively small number of airlines and flight choices prices are often higher than Orlando or Jacksonville and you will probably have to catch a connecting flight through a major hub to get to your destination And auto racing fans can catch a good view of Daytona International Speedway right across the street from the airport on landing if they are lucky

Flew out of Maputo up the coast to Inhambane Found it to be clean well organised free of queues and with fairly friendly staff We used the domestic terminal which was largely devoid of facilities apart from a couple of shops but also virtually devoid of passengers A surprisingly pleasurable experience

This airport has undergone a transition from ugly duckling to something of a beautiful swan Spacious beautifully furnished comfortable are just some of the words that come to mind There is plenty of signage and even passengers on discount airlines are treated as if they are appreciated Although it doesnt have a butterfly garden I would compare this in ambiance to Singapore Changi on a much smaller scale of course Burmese charm is everywhere The CIP lounges are spacious well stocked well staffed and offer a good selection of local and international snacks I wish every airport in Asia was more like this one

Gatwick to Monastir return We took off on time both ways the aircraft are dated but seat was comfortable Food going was fine but only a stale sandwich coming back Crew pleasant The toilets are a lot to be desired and we made sure that we used the airport facilities before boarding on the return flight

BudapestVenice Marco Polo Malev put me on this Moldavian Airlines flight without warning of a code share Proved to be a fairly pleasant flight in the end Food consisted of a chocolate bar and a glass of Hungarian red wine On the way back the flight was a little late arriving and they clearly rushed everyone on without having time to clean up The connection between Malev and Moldavian airlines is confusing The pilot thanked us for flying with Malev but the stewardesses were in Moldavian uniforms and the plane was clearly Moldavian
The duty free staff especially the fragrance section was very unprofessional Poor customer service No please to give feedback Otherwise the food and airport is good

When we arrived at Luxor airport got off the coach all I can say was what appeared like a pack of wolves were waiting to help with bags Now Im a ft stone bloke so am well capable but even despite this I ended up almost having to wrestle my bag away from a very eager helper who all the time was whispering under his breath drink please interspersed with something It appeared as if there was a supervisor or someone that they didnt want to hear their requests if so they were spectacularly unsuccessful in stamping out this sort of overaggressive help Having managed to wrestle free of the initial wave of helpers get inside the building once again there was another helper to lift bags onto the xray belt This time however as he didnt have any English phrases apparently the helper was saying something in Egyptian again whispering while showing me an Egyptian Pound note folded in the palm of his hand as a prompt Having now managed to get through these levels of assistance there was of course another helper at the other end of the xray machine who was equally helpful in taking the bag off the belt similarly looking for money Next up was the checkin desk itself yes you have guessed it there was yet another helper at the head of the queue to again lift the bag onto the checkin conveyor There is a sign on display at the desk stating that all baggage assistance was free of charge but this was clearly not having any effect on the various helpers that have to be negotiatedovercome Finally naturally there is the customary help in the toilets where even though I am at yrs of age well capable of washing drying my hands I was presented with some toilet paper with the by now customary demand for money All in all never again

We flew from Dubrovnik to Athens and then Athens to Zagreb on Croatia Airlines They were on time within minutes for both flights You drop your bag on the tarmac and they load it into the belly of the plane And then you pick it up directly from the tarmac after the flight so there is very little chance for lost luggage which I like They allow a smaller carryone bag as well They did not weigh our bag or try to charge us for anything extra We were allowed to pick our seats for no charge The seats are standard and comparable to Southwest airlines for leg room and space We were served water and drinks on both flights For the price we paid it was a great deal Some people might be nervous about flying a propeller plane but it was a very smooth flight in both directions with almost zero turbulence and a very smooth landing If you had to fault them for one thing it would be nice to have some in flight entertainment Other than that it was a perfect flight Definitely recommend
This flight was just the dream hrs of first class service with top quality crew amazing food great Q Suite The flight was so smooth and pleasant the hospitality was amazing

Flying from AEP to IGU in Prem Economy I was nervous about what to expect on Aerolineas I have to say that I was really pleasantly surprised once we got on the plane Check in at Business was a breeze Security and Boarding was polite chaos They had two flights going to two locations boarding at the same gate at the same time However the premium economy was great simple but worth the extra The seats were comfortable and clean think that armchair type of seats you use to get in business class Service on this flight was friendly on others it was nonexistant They provided a sandwich and soft drinks The best thing though is on every Aerolineas flight my bags were on the carousel as I arrived there They have some amazing expedited system to get premium bags off which is great

They canceled my flight and no refund My boyfriend and I booked tickets from Cusco to La Paz for just on I received an email saying that the flight was canceled Reason From that moment on they were no longer flying to La Paz We were already in Cusco when I received the email so we looked for a customer service point Arriving we were super poorly attended the lady who answered us checked the system that was really canceled was when we knew the reason and could not do anything We had to swallow it dry for to make a scandal was not going to do any good We returned for our stay and started looking for air tickets again Great illusion at that time of the championship prices were very high and schedules that did not favor us because from La Paz we went to Uyuni where we had reservations that we did not want to have to change them Anyway we had to buy same bus tickets and face h of travel We put it in our head that if it was happening this way it was because it was supposed to be like that and in the end we were saving I contacted them as requested in the email I received advising about the cancellation to this day nothing I only receive automatic responses I already sent to the emails available on the site and also nothing these nor automatic response I receive The phones look like nonexistent I do not know what to do to get my refund
Newquay airport is excellent apart from the abysmal state of seating in the main departure lounge Seating all torn and very scruffy It has been like this for a long time Unacceptable

The Plaza Business Lounge at Brisbane Airport was comfortable enough with a range of food and drinks but no tonic for a GT There were very few toilets in the lounge though On board the A the seat was comfortable and the service was friendly and responsive My vegetarian meals were good but breakfast was served far too early interrupting sleep The plane for the connecting service to Sapporo was an unreconstructed A with oldstyle business class seating but comfortable enough for a hour flight The service and vegetarian food out of Taipei were both excellent Overall China Airlines is a good way to travel between Australia and Japan at a reasonable price

My experiences with customs and immigration have always been exceptionally pleasurable Over the past year I arrived in Cayman a dozen times to meet with immigration lawyers on the basis that I will move here The officers greet me warmly and I am processed efficiently I usually try to fly in in midweek when it is less crowded However yesterday I arrived on Saturday This was an interesting experience because the airport was almost full to capacity causing long lines and delays I suggest any traveller to avoid arriving or departing on a Saturday or Sunday because there can be many flights arriving and departing The airport is safe clean and convenient Everyone is friendly and easygoing I love it here I suggest everyone come visit at least once in their lifetime This is paradise an expensive paradise though

I fainted in the flight and where some crew may have panicked in some cases this crew handled the situation very well Provided me with all the necessary assistance and first aid and was very kind and humble till the end

MontpellierMditerrane Airport is a tiny but nice airport Facilities are clean some computer charging desks are available reasonable amount of seats can be found at the gates Shopping and eating options are according to the size of the airport The airside area also features a lovely terrasse taking advantage of the sun drawbacks however The terrasse does not offer a direct view on the movement area and its the spot where all smokers endup Bagages delivery on arrival was a bit long especially for such a small airport Traffic right outside the terminal can be abot messy as the pickup dropoff zone seems to be on the street so cars are jammed Wifi connection procedure should be simplified and streamlined

A very small airport ours was the only plane there when we landed so visa immigration and luggage was quick though I doubt if they could manage with more than one plane at once Departure check in quick and efficient The airport is clean with a number of duty free shops bit tacky

I flew Yeti Airlines June from Bhairahawa the airport near Lumbini the birthplace of Buddha to the capital Kathmandu It was a morning flight on time the ground staff were friendly cabin crew was friendly They served soft drinks on this minute flight Reading material offered The jetstream is a turboprop engine aircraft and has seating capacity for person in an x arrangement The flight was smooth Yeti Airlines has the reputation of flying on time Though its safety record is not very encouraging but has been spotless and blemish free since it separated its mountains region operations in the name of Tara air as its subsidiary Sky miles their frequent flyer program is very popular and has many other benefits like discounts in hotels than award tickets The name Yeti also is an attraction to the visitors

On our return from our Christmas break we sadly had a long delay in Milan Linate in transit due to the inclement weather in the UK which meant poor visibility at many airports and especially in London City where would be landing At first this was frustrating as we werent told about the delay until through passport control and at the tiny nonSchengen gate area after essentially having our boarding pass scanned for boarding The previous flight had been cancelled already and we could have waited in the lounge as status holders but the lounge is in the Schengen area before passport control However from then on I was surprised how well ITA had handled this after an minutes it became clear conditions in London werent going to improve for the day so ITA escorted us all through immigration via bus to departures where they arranged accommodation for the night During all this we got an automatic email with our new flight the next morning After a short wait at the checkin counter our names and room requirements were taken down given new boarding passes and within minutes we were able to head to our hotel near to the airport where a room and dinner was provided The flight the next day operated on schedule Other passenger who we met who couldnt be accommodated on ITA were accommodated on BA flights which I thought was impressive given they are competitor and in a rival alliance I was very worried initially but impressed in the end how well ITA handled these irregular operations and staff seemed to cope well this gives me a lot of confidence to fly with them in the future as they made it very stressfree Recommended

Love Ryanair efficiency Does what is says on the packet nothing pretentious Crew were great and even managed to go down with aisle with the trolley on a minute flight My th flight with them just wish they flew to Frankfurt theyd get all my euro business

The new airport in Miri is a blessing to all of us frequent travellers Although it is small it is efficient clean and cool If anything needs to be imroved on is the charges we have to pay for a small cup of coffee or a meal The charges are much too high for a domestic airport

A small airport with few flights Single storey building with Departures at one end and Arrivals at the other end Some international flights to Dubai Colombo Busses across the tarmac from aircraft to terminal Baggage Belts international Belt with CustomsPassports Usual selection of car rental and other booths Car Park directly in front of the terminal building Very quick inout Nice airport

The mid morning flight took off on time from CCU and as I had to go to Bangalore for work my company had booked this flight for me Web checkin and baggage drop were smoothly done Boarding also started on time Landing and disembarkation also happened swiftly along with baggage retrieval which was good IndiGo may not be a glamorous carrier but it gets the job done of taking you from point A to point B efficiently

Pricequality is unbeatable Airplane was on the same standard as most European Airlines and Food and service as well Regarding the transfer in Shenzhen it works perfectly It is a huge modern international Airport I was advised that I could enjoy my time outside the aiport as Austria is one of EU countries that are now Visa free Went to the city with public transport and visited the KK Mall and St Regis Highly recommended Plane was empty that was nice as well

Fantastic service from bag drop to landing and getting my baggage on the other end All staff played their role in providing the excellent customer service It was an early morning flight and it was really nice to start the day on the right track

I will stay away from most recent reviews I have only one severe criticism and that costs them a star checkin luggage per person in business class of only kg between Europe and the new world Caribbean in this case More for a fee depending on how much you want to take Most decent Airlines even EW Discover let alone famous carriers like Air France and many others allow you X kg per person That has to change absolutely All the rest was plainly EXCELLENT Their ranking around stars has become obsolete The fleet has been completely renewed brand new As replacing the old faithful Boeing otherwise an excellent aircraft

The meals were very good and the portions generous The crew were efficient and were on time both ways Seating assignments seemed ambiguous but my family of four ended up with one window seat on return to Vancouver from Amsterdam which was a nice surprise None of my children had any complaint throughout the two long journeys and that would be the measure of a pleasant flight experience by my standards I would fly with Martinair again in future

Surabaya airport is a very quick and efficient airport On arrival the visa on arrival queue was very short immigration there was a short wait of about minutes by the time I was done with both the bags had already arrived Probably one of the quickest experiences for me from exiting the aircraft to curbside Similar experience on departure quick efficient checkin with Cathay Pacific short lines at security and immigration The terminal is spacious and has a lot of natural light from the full height windows on either side the restrooms were very clean Food options are limited to a Burger King and Starbucks the duty free has a good selection for a small airport The premier lounge which was in a temporary set up was the only disappointment Chose to sit at the Starbucks instead Free wifi at the airport is also quite good

Birmingham to Amritsar via Ashkabat No nonsense air line Great Indian vegetarian food There was no flight screens no seat screens We stopped at Ashgabat for one hour its nice modern airport with all facilities The good thing was that the time at Ashgabat and time in India is only minute difference

CVG is my home airport and I have always had a good experience compared with other large cities However I recently returned from a trip and had parked in Long Term parking Previously I had only to walk out the door and across the pick up lane to the well marked shuttle buses and ride to the long term parking Apparently they have revised the whole set up and there is zero accessible signage to direct you to a brand new pick up spot for the shuttle buses There should be a sign at the old spot telling of the new one signage in the actual terminal near where arriving customers will see it as they enter the luggage retrieval area arrows and signage that distinguishes the east and the west pick up areas are for different things eg the East is for Uber etc and the West is for parking shuttles note there is a sign for the bus shuttles in the west end only after you have walked about of the way there once in the line designated for different shuttles there needs to be signage that distinguishes which shuttle lot bus will be stopping where there are at different shuttles stopping in this lane and the bus itself needs to have signage eg long term parking This is such a huge oversight please correct it so you can maintain your excellent reputation

EWRYUL late evening flight The seat CRJ was halfempty so I managed to get two seats to myself It still does feel very tight though The overhead bins wont even take a smaller backpack and the seats are very confining in terms of personal space plus you really cant see out of the window due to its low position There was a single FA serving the flight which she managed with grace and efficiency even with a drink run and some small snacks served The service in general is OK but to spend more than an hour aboard the CRJ would be a torture

As an Arkansas native I have flown in and out of LRN several times LR National is exceptionally clean and easy to navigate For an airport with only gates there is plenty to do nice places to eat and even a museum The airport just underwent a million overhaul which gives it a nice modern flare It has also recently added a threelevel parking garage which is reasonably priced and has easy access to the terminal LRN is now undergoing construction on their baggage claim area to make it more user friendly although a little burdensome in the meantime and there is also some landscape work being done to the main entrance to get ready for the opening of the Clinton Presidential Center in November Easy transportation to city downtown is only mi from LIT Also cheaper fares than nearby MEM

Arrival Clean and spacious airport However the luggagebaggage arrival area appears small and congested Taxi counters are available near the exit Departure Checked in online and print ticket using the kiosks available in the airport Thumbs up However upon entering the departure gate the officer who are on duty did not recognise the ticket ticket from kiosk is thinner more plasticky compared to thicker ticket from the counter and questioned me of having a fake ticket She maintained her politeness though but still how come your own staff didnt recognise ticket which you own airport albeit kiosk produce Otherwise the rest of the experience was good Spacious and clean airport with abundant seats A bit too cold

For departures Algiers new airport is fairly spacious functional and the staff is friendly I might have been lucky but I found the police controls and security to go fairly quickly Shops are limited but I found them sufficient also they are open very early and close late The choice of restaurants is limited to for each hall and they are of the same provider They offer reasonable selections of light eating and drinking On arrivals I find it inadequate to have to walk down stairs after coming off the plane I did not see an elevator available The wait for the luggage is too long I was told it was due to the luggage scanner being undersized for the traffic One important deficiency is the absence of English signs they are all in French and Arabic only A shame for a brand new International airport Over all I was satisfied mainly due to efficiency at departure and the feeling of space which is lacking too often in aging European airports

ArkhangelskARH to TromsoeTOS with a stop in MurmanskMMK Fast and easy checkin and boarding Decently comfortable and rapid security check Aircraft Antonov has seen better days but was OK for a short flight Cabin crew polite and professional Got served drinks on the first leg to Murmansk then snacks selection of meats with bread and piclkes on the way from Murmansk to Tromsoe Departure and arrival according to the timetable Luggage arrived OK Overall experience fine apart from the high price

Madrid to Punta Cana Long queues to check in Only counters for people Aircraft clean and well maintained Standard seats with no PTV only overhead screens with English Spanish movies They offer a free hot meal with two options of main course and a snack breakfast before landing Flight on time and friendly crew Considering they have packages with child for free and good prices and airplanes are newer than other Spanish charter airlines I would recommend Evelop

When you get off the plane at Quito Mariscal Airport you are greeted with a stunning view of the mountains The staff are all very friendly and the airport itself is quite modern While there arent tonnes of bars and restaurants like the airports at home in Britain it doesnt matter Because the facilities are satisfactory and the staff behave the way staff should I arrived in Quito after transit in Panama which was a total dump with extremely rude staff so to arrive in my final destination where I now live and to be greeted to my new country in such a friendly manner by immigration and customs was lovely

Finally the new terminal is in operation Arrival and departure were a breeze no queues no trouble with signage nothing to complain about Toilets are clean overall facility is still under final touches of construction The terminal is too big for the amount of flights served so very few people there Pity they have no food and drink outlets landside yet and just a small stall with snacks airside Overall impression very good everything worked there and up to the international standards From plane to taxi in minutes from check in to plane in Good

The airport claims it has smooth transit and easy to read signs in English helpful staff and an efficient process My experience was the complete opposite After arriving and trying to find my departure process I was told to go back backandforth to the same places by people who could not understand what I was saying this took minutes to an hour and each time I had to rewait in line again So finally I said Im not leaving till you direct me to the right place

Airport staff very friendly and helpful but airport is actually the modern building with a minor older satellite terminal from where a low cost company exclusively operates It needs better highlited signals

This was the first time we had used Coventry Airport to travel to Barcelona Having been used to departing from the larger airports oh how we laughed The porter cabin style check in and the cattle shed style arrivals made us laugh and laugh The coffee shop was like having a cup of tea in your front room What fun to be escorted to the plane by the same person who checked us in we wouldnt have been suprised if they had flown the plane too The only hitch was when we arrived back there was already a flight in we were held on the plane while they found someone to escort us to the so called terminal We giggled at the thought of someone shouting Stan Can you leave the loo cleaning and get the next lot off the Barcelona flight We will be using Coventry again if only for a good laugh

Small simple and clean everything you want in an airport Love coming home to this beautiful airport Pros extremely clean efficient great signage short wait times never any traffic to and from and never any plane traffic Cons no lounges not a lot of shopping very limited food choices things close early a bit far outside city centre parking can be pricey

There were no people at the airport it may be due to the Corona virus but they have smiling staff at checkin I had to wait for a staff unfortunately but she was incredibly helpful calm and smiling Their security staff may seem a little stiff this day was not busy but they still did not have the profits for a smile However they must be praised for being very quick to get guests through This airport had a passenger record a few years ago with million passengers annually therefore they chose to expand the airport But instead of giving passengers the more space they deserve they chose instead to expand their very fine lounge which is never filled as well as the office for the staff a disgrace to people who travel a lot The design of the airport is great even though it is old as mentioned the staff are some of the friendliest staff and they are the reason why I love coming here On a busy day of travel it is impossible to find a place outside the lounge to sit down

The renewed Helsinki Airport is probably one of the best in the world at the moment The airport itself is not only beautifully designed but it works like a dream The departure lobby is equipped with multiple automatic bag drop stations with staff to help you with them The security was fast and smooth with the new machines The airside of the terminal is very clean and easy to find where to head to The variety of shops and restaurants is great too The passport control is quick with both robotic and manual checkpoints

Pleasant smaller airport Parking is easy as is dealing with rental cars if necessary Ive used both Tucson and Phoenix Airports Phoenix had a direct flight and was less expensive for traveling between Boston and Tucson From now on Ill be using Tucson Airport due to the ease of access and human scale

Its a LCC and as such they do a great job Check in was smooth Without major hassles The flight departed on time only to be held up by the tower for half an hour due to traffic The seat was comfortable They did something strange for a LCC They fed all of us a free meal It wasnt the best meal But it was a hot chicken Meal And also due to some social media content They gave everyone on board a free gift of a tshirt Im sure that was a once off But all in all great flight experience Note no wifi and no screens But thats minor now days Because we all have Content

Quito is a really nice new airport about km from the city there is very little available around it The airport has free wifi which is always a bonus As it seems with all airports now the prices of small things like coffee etc are expensive My experience with the new airport was excellent not so though with the employees of American Airlines at Quito Airport beware

I did not find Antigua as bad as some but it was not exactly trouble free Immigration took about minutes bad but I have suffered worse elsewhere and the officer was polite and welcoming Departure is rather chaotic you queue to checkin about minutes in our case and to go through emigration over minutes though security was cleared quickly Once in the terminal it was crowded but had just enough seating The snack bar was reasonably priced but souvenirs can be found cheaper elsewhere on the island The good news hopefully is that the new terminal building is complete and due to open in the next few weeks according to locals it is much larger than the present one and looks a better design there are several dedicated piers for large aircraft Antigua is a great island and I look forward to experiencing the new facilities

Nanjing to Kunming on a new B As I was sitting in in seat F had a lot of legroom Cabin crew was excellent I was served a tasty dish on the hour flight For the return flight the ground staff Ticketing Desk in Kunming was outstanding

The security person that checked me was so rude I went through the body scanner and it beeped which it was not a surprise it was always happens to me for some reason and she shouted for me to take my shoes off and go again through it Then during the search done by hand she even lifted my top up without even asking resulting in me being almost half naked in front of everyone I would not recommend this airport at all as I never had such a bad experience in any airports I have been to The pros are that the food is generally good there and there are lots of shops so if you have time to kill it is a good airport for that

Having gone through so many different airports around the world Kuching Airport is definitely one of the better airports to use Airport workers here checkin counters security immigration etc are generally fine but can be improved especially on the level of professionalism in their communication with passengers The airport may look very new but there is a need to improve some facilities such as seating areas especially the terminal Air Asia uses at one end of the single terminal and the automated passport gates at the arrival hall Cleanliness can be improved as well particularly on the toilets Overall Kuching Airport is a good and hasslefree airport to use

Please note this review is for Terminal This terminal was opened years so its relatively new Terminal looks classy with the palm trees outside it Had a good experience at Guarulhos Security line was quick and efficient Passport control was also light in traffic and staff were polite as is often the case in Brazil Not too many shops but the terminal is manageable and not huge so walking distance is good What lets Guarulhos T down a bit is the signposting needs to be better The Free WIFI was great

Johannesburg to Lilongwe via Blantyre Very impressed with Malawian Airlines On time departures and arrivals excellent food served both outbound lunch chicken and return breakfast fried eggs lovely coffee and generous baggage allowance Crucially Ethiopan Airlines the part owner has timed the flight with an early morning departure from Malawi such that a large majority of passengers were connecting on our flight in Johannesburg onto regional Southern Africa routes and donestically within SA whereas SAA schedule from Lilongwe would require an overnight stay in Johannesburg clever scheduling Both flights nearly full No entertainment or music onboard

A quiet afternoon at PDX Short queues to get through security with efficient and helpful staff As the space allocated for security was fairly small I can imagine at that at busy times there could be problems

All flights were on time and comfortable Cabin crew were friendly and welcoming On board snacks to buy were good value Seat pitch good average Last year we few with this company from Madrid to Malta and return Both flights very good

Really pleasant and convenient airport Minimal queues and pleasant staff A really nice touch is the free coffee tea and newspapers for all passengers in the departure lounge I just wish that the runway was long enough to permit direct flights from the UK to land here

I wanted to fly by Air NZ After finding out the Perth route was now going to be flying with WAMOS Air I researched I nearly canceled with all the negative star reviews Wamos Air is the best airline I have ever flown service was fantastic and the seats comfortable Everyone was given a blanket and pillow the food good for airline food You could get extra drinks and food if wanted and periodically they would come around with water On return to Perth it was the same The plane was not dated The lady next to me on returning was quite ill and the cabin crew couldnt do enough for her They even reseated me so I wouldnt be concerned and they could access that traveller in case of added complications

Qazaq Air from Almaty to Shymkent returning a few days later Very good value considering tickets were booked less than hours before departure Nice new aircraft and smartly attired crew who were all trilingual Baggage is included in the ticket price and hand luggage was not strictly monitored but since both flights were not full there was plenty of space in the overhead lockers Check in at both ends was perfunctory and more or less wordless but the flights were punctual the return flight leaving minutes before the scheduled time of which was greatly appreciated by all on board There was even a snack service with a good choice of drinks all included in the ticket price Another retro touch was the basket of sweets offered round before take off I would definitely fly this airline again and hope they expand their destinations The only thing I would say against them is that at present their small fleet seems to mean that certain routes are served with en route stops that added to the slower speed of the Q aircraft could make some trips around Kazakhstan quite arduous Overall though excellent and amazing value

Great experience Early check in possible and done quickly staff super friendly Security fast and lets you go faster with a baby Nice tax free zone that you can actually enjoy as the check in and security is done quickly At least two amazing playgrounds for children great cafes everything clean

My experiences have always been pleasant Security lines are extremely short and there is a lot of open space Checking in is never a hasslewe have been able to pass by the checkin desk in minutes or less on the worst of days Bathrooms are clean and theres always a cafe or news store open Delta seems to have the largest concentration of flights at the airport most of them being on their regional affiliates running under Delta Connection Overall the airport is very good clean and friendly
I visited Victoria BC two weeks ago and for a small international airport I enjoyed the experience Security was quick the facilities were good and checkin was quick I recommend this airport

Great airport small and friendly Not too bothered about duty free shops its an airport for quick in and out like most should be flights seem to be moving to Alicante but lets support this little airport and its staff Car hire very easy

I just booked through this airport in October on my way to Australia It was such a dream no queues friendly efficient staff Luggage scanned without having to remove Ipad small bottles etc It must be one of the better airports in the EU

Kefalonia Airport has a new hall which is big enough for passangers waiting The queing went fine although there are not many desks The toilets were new and clean Coffee and sweat breads are in the hall In de waiting area is a small shop Personnel was very kind and helpful

Flew with them TR Delayed because late arriving from previous sector Thats rad only two out of four Scootee crew members who were performing the safety demonstration It was a night flight and I see no cart being pushed out Realize an enthusiastically male FA had been chattering in to different passenger throughout the flight and this route considered a very short flight but the aircraft change direction leading to rwy R so it take hrmins to landed Overall a pleasant experience

Templehof is a dream The architecture is beautiful and the departure hall is stunning Some of the original features can be found a true jewel It oozes nostalgia and would be a tragedy to lose such a wonderful piece of history The most civilised journey Ive embarked on to date was Templehof to Brussels

Vladivostok is a fairly modern airport built in the last years it has lots of space for check in and a decent departure area There is one major problem though there is limited foreigh language support if you are a non Russian speaker If you have problems with your baggage all the forms are written in Russian with no translation all the support staff only speak Russian The people at check in have limited English language skills enough to check people in but I estimate of staff in the airport only speak Russian If you dont have any issues when you fly into or out of Vladivostok then it is a nice airport to travel through but if you do have any problems it can be a nightmare to try to find any people willing to help you they just dont care if you have an issue

Infrastructure lacking excellent welcoming courtesy Plane from VIE landed on the one runway turned around and taxied to a parking area from which we descended staircases promptly rolled up to the front and rear doors This airport does not know the concept of gate We walked to a huge barn of a building and all joined the line of nonUkrainians At this point some passport control official undertook a mental exercise called thinking lets open the other line for Ukrainians for these passengers That immediately cut the wait in half my wait was minutes The passport official who stamped my passport smiled note to US CBP agents thats when the ends of the mouth go up and said Welcome Then enter the other half of the huge building with a currency exchange a clean bathroom and not much else Overeager taxicab drivers were in abundance but I and many of us took the Viking bus to our river cruise ship

Due to a mechanical fault the plane that landed was too small for all of the passengers So the ground staff at Nevsehir had to work really hard to deal with about people who could not fit The staff in this small office tried so hard to identify the most urgent passengers who had connecting flights then they prioritised everyone The staff were faced with passengers who all thought they were the most important person in the airport We did not have a connecting flight and were lower priority So the team arranged for about of us to be bussed to nearby Kayseri airport our flight was going to be hours later than expected So the ground staff refunded the cost of our flight not once but twice We were able to collect the money from a counter at the airport immediately then we were upgraded to Business class which meant we were able to sit in quiet and cool comfort while we waited Then on the flight we were very impressed with the food and service and priority baggage service I know the fault was not due to the ground staff but they really tried hard and were very successful at getting people through to their connecting flights and what they offered us really helped ease the pain of our delay I am really impressed with the people in that small office I wish I da their names to thank them personally I highly recommend flying with Turkish Airways after this experience

BMAMMX one way The flight was comfortable with professional and friendly staff The free food and drinks served onboard were top quality The central location of Stockholm Bromma was very advantageous for our city break but checkin and boarding was a hassle Checkin closes minutes before departure which means that half the passengers were cramming at the check in desks in the last minute Free seating onboard the plane resulted in more cramming after the security because everyone wants a good seat It was a real circus In my opinion min checkin deadline instead of min and allocated seats instead of free seats would have been optimal

I really enjoyed the service provided helpful friendly and assertive cabin crew on all four flights Also the ground staff were also helpful The food was really nice on board and i had loads of free drinks I had managed to use the online portal with ease Will definitely recommend and fly again with KA

Most of the airport was hot Only felt moderately cool at the quiet area which wasnt quiet at all It was right next to noisy escalators and on top of an area where staff I assume they were staff would congregate and loudly converse The rest of the time I thought staff were loudly and the airport was nice enough Lots of restaurants and little shops although most closed at night I arrived and was in transit for hours Outlets everywhere and potable water available

Great space Felt secure and secluded as a solo traveller Staff were great in a full cabin they were onto everything The wifi was dreadful though Food plentiful and tasty An hour and a half late leaving but with snow in UK thats hardly surprising

Airport uses a lot of natural light The design is modern especially the departure lobby the ceiling its so high The staff in the airport have good manners The luggage arrived quick and theres plenty of checkin counters too The bad thing airline lounges terrible

Just had to leave this review on th May returned from Rhodes and my flight was delayed two hours Just after midnight left baggage reclaim to go to my car I had a flat battery and was unable to get into my car It was exceptionally cold and all I was wearing was shorts and a tee shirt I returned to the terminal where I met the staff at the parking desk At this time the terminal was empty and they were locking up The staff came out and helped me gain entry to my car but I had a two hour wait for the Green Flag breakdown The staff waited with me almost an hour and had to go home leaving me alone in the car park freezing cold but not before he returned to his office made me a hot cup of tea and brought it to me in my car A beautiful act of kindness and one I will never forget

A couple of points firstly there is now a new terminal so most of the tips above do not now apply Agree about the prices for coffee etc they are outrageous They now handle more international flights for example to Bangkok so I would like to think they are better equipped for international flights now I have Never been stopped by the immigration people I find them very friendly Last point the taxis There is no doubt they are expensive They are on the clock but from the airport the clocks run fast From my old apartment it was km to the airport and on one occasion km back Better to pay rmb for the bus directly outside the airport then get a taxi from the Aviation hotel in the city Hope this helps

This was a day Southwest Gourmet Tour of Tasmania The same aircraft stayed with us the entire time It was a great size and seemed very efficient All staff were very friendly and professional We were most impressed

Greatly improved airport with better immigration facilities on arrival fast track lane for business passengers on departure entrance into departure hall entrance to immigration much faster retrieval of luggage and more smiling people The departure zone after security has been revamped and is now more frendly too

Pros Very good interiors and wellmaintained seats cleanliness lighting Ample space available between knee and seat in front of you Wellmannered and clear language English and Hindi speaking crew led by Ms Unnati Didnt have food nor used washroom so cannot comment on that Journey was comfortable and no bumpy rides encountered Communication from cockpit was also clear everytime Cons Boarding was not done in zoneseat number wise Quite some mosquitoes seen before take off which bit me and some passengers Crew applied some spray but wasnt enough Pricing was a big letdown as huge increase seen while booking on Feb for my journey date of Feb in a short span of time Slight delay in takeoff after closing of doors

Nice new Airport I have been travel through his airport for last one year and it is very nice and good airport overall It is relatively new but still there is a lot things which can be improved like Air conditioning and bathroom cleanness etc

TIPATH A very comfortable flight on leather seats on new CRJ Breakfast well served with a generous portion Service went smoothly and efficiently crew were English speaking Plane interior clean Flight left on time and seemingly no worries about cent for cent baggage weight checking All in all a very pleasant experience

I used to live in Albany and have used this airport many times Albany is a really nice regional airport It is very close to the Interstate The standard parking is extremely convenient across an indoor footbridge no shuttles The airport is physically very appealing and flow through checkin to the gates is generally smooth Same on the return also note that rental car stuff seems to be a convenient arrangement as well ALB is as close to get there at the last minute and be OK as any these days B terminal is the nicest Of course this is a regional airport without many of the amenities of a large one The coffee shop and barrestaurant are better than most though I now live in LA and have a much greater hassle Burbank airport seems similar in size to Albany but Albany is much much nicer

During the checkin we paid a lot for having a few kilos over the weight limit This was dissatisfying The takeoff and landing were on time Boarding the plane was easy because it was done based on groups Extremely skilled pilot who took off and landed very safely We barely felt anything when the plane touched the ground Seats were very comfortable and the AC was strong Meals were alright given the trips short time I liked the entertainment system but was disappointed to see the WIFI was only limited to it You cant use WhatsApp for example Overrall my experience with Iberia Express was very positive and I recommend this airlineaw for a budget flight

Used this airport multiple times for international and domestic arrivals and departures Nice and clean Airport staff are friendly Provides jet bridge at almost every flight In my opinion it needs more coffee shops eateries and lounges Parking spot is located conveniently close to the airport entrance

Omsk to Krasnoyarsk I was a little unsure as to what to expect from a second tier Russian company However the check in process was quick and efficient although it was done only in Russian and I had to move a little weight from my checked in luggage to my hand luggage The flight departed and arrived on time The plane was quite small but legroom was still adequate It was subject to turbulence as we were approaching the landing The cabin crew appeared not to speak English as announcements were only in Russian A good snack was served on the almost two hour long flight My luggage came off the flight fairly quickly All in all a satisfactory experience

The airport is big upon my arrival I passed through the electronic gate and it did not take more than a minute to complete my entry procedures into the country and it was more than wonderful The treatment of the airport staff is wonderful we received our bags quickly and there was no delay Upon our departure the treatment was also professional friendly and fast from the staff and there was no delay in stamping passports security check or check in We tried two restaurants to eat at the airport and the food was very tasty travelling through Dubai Airport is a wonderful experience

This airport has terminals one for USA flights and one for non USA flights Not big airport Inside is very clean and staff are very helpful However there are long waiting times at immigration and customs Customs has no scanner machines so they have to open all bags for checks Needed almost hours to finish immigration and customs When departing it is very quick Inside the airport there are only a few shops

Really lovely small but clean airport Passport Control was really smiley and friendly and our bags were ready on the cute luggage belt by the time we were through which was quick albeit from a small BA Embraer jet Toilets were absolutely spotless

This is a small airport but over the past couple of years it has improved a lot The customs and immigration are polite and fast with the baggage also coming fast There is a coffee shop outside the secure area and also one inside but the coffee outside is better There is also now free WiFi in the airport There is a lounge but this is not connected to the airlines but for payment No need to arrive to early

Clean efficient and friendly The Norwegians do these things very well There is everything you need at this airport cafe bar shop etc but without the hassle of larger airports I would recommend the region for any tourist and Trondheim is a very attractive city

I was transiting with Air China in Beijing Capital Airport Terminal Most international flights operate from Concourse TE but some use TD In my cause both arrival and departure were from TE On transit passengers need to go through document and security and customs check The walking times are not really long and mostly travelators are available There are transfer service checkpoints one from each side of the concourse The crowd is not really well organized and staff is not really helpful Not everyone speaks English which is quite frustrating when you actually need to communicate with airport or security staff Arriving early in the morning get ready to spend h queuing for transit Other than that I have to note that Terminal is very modern by its looks and layout The ceiling is high which makes it seam like the airport is free and spacious Walking distances are not too long Most gates are accessible in less than minutes of calm stroll Between TE TD and TC there is an automated people mover train which is easily accessible after security I didnt use it but I located its station and observed it a little There are few restaurants which in my opinion are quite reasonable priced Early in the morning only few Chinese restaurants and Western cafes were opened The food is actually quite delicious I would note good availability of seating spaces Some are equipped with universal power outlets and USB chargers If you want to use WiFi better use WiFi kiosks as SMS sometimes doesnt go through Be aware that you wont be able to use most messengers and social networks Also it was nice to have drinking fountains within short reach from most seating areas I would suggest considering Beijing Capital Airport as transit hub for Asia Clean and modern airport with all the necessary facilities for longer transits

Quite a small airport compared to the Dubai or Abu Dhabi International Airports Only half a dozen or airlines serve this airport On arrival myself and wife senior citizens were treated with compassion and helped by the airport customs and immigration staff No difficulties faced by us we found the airport quite peaceful neat and tidy I wish more flights were available to and from this Airport in UAE Travel to city center of Al Ain a charming city in the midst of the Arabian desert was also a pleasant experience with hardly any traffic problems

No traffic problems getting there The long term car park is but mtrs from the main entrance The check in is mtrs from the gate The security checks are a breeze especially when those passengers approaching the scanners have remembered to remove the required articlestheir scanners are the most sensitive of any I have ever encountered There is a very nice restaurant area cum bar The area is generally clean and well kept The security staff should appear more friendly accepting that they have a very important job to do

Departure was on time and check in was quick and easy The service was very friendly and efficient They offered a pizza as a meal which was quite tasty They also offered a second pizza which was generous It was nice they offered beef and wine Overall a very enjoyable flight

Gatwick to Banjul Surprisingly comfortable hour journey to The Gambia for Christmas The cabin was clean crew were friendly and helpful and the flight was comfortable I didnt suffer from my skin and eyes drying out as much as with other airlines I got the feeling they didnt stint on the air quality The food was fine and typical of airline food There was plenty of water juices tea and coffee and you could buy booze if you wanted The wines were very nice Outward on December we flew a Boeing with seating layout and on return December it was an A with seating The seats on the A felt more spacious and comfortable although they had no adjustable headrest like the Boeing We are both tall and it was no hardship The time passed pretty quickly perhaps also due to the decent times of the flights and the same time zone both ways The only negative was the lack of working entertainment although they have an app for your phone it didnt work and headphones were not issued Outward on the Boeing I was able to listen to their radio stations on my seat controls through my own earphones and on return Id downloaded some movies on my mobile phone I have no hesitation in recommending Titan Airways who I believe sub contract for other airlines when they are busy Nothing to worry about in fact it may be a better experience

I took domestic flights with Iraqi Airways from Basra to Baghdad and then a return to Sulaymaniyah One was on a smaller Bombardier and the others on a B The Basra flight was delayed a couple of hours because of fog No problems with that it happens I missed my next flight on a different ticket to Erbil The later flights were all full so they changed my ticket to Sulaymaniyah at no cost All aircrafts were good particularly the B which was not very old at all The B had good leg room was clean in flight entertainment and a reasonable snack was served The smaller Bombadier whilst a little older was perfectly OK Overall a good experience

Not the newest airplane but the cabin is clean and it is in the new configuration where you do not need to cross your neighbors if you stand up Food on this short route is classic Air stewardess always perfect as expected from Korean Air

HELOSL Checkin was rude and dismissive but otherwise the flight had very nice crew and the plane was spotless clean as well BOB meal is cheaper on Blue than on SAS due to the currency and I found the quality to be rather reasonable as well Ontime departure and arrival in Oslo Ticket price was great as usual
Wonderful airport with great hospitality only wish some other airline other than Ryanair flew into there from the UK

What a pleasure We arrived into Murcia on the nd June and greeted by cheery ground staff straight to passport control a little queue at passport control nice and polite customs officers Went to baggage belt and there were a few others in front of us but mins at the most wait for our baggage Through the exit and outside in under half an hour how amazing was that The return journey went just as smoothly I was blown away by this efficient friendly and calm airport staff are amazing

After a week away we returned to Atlanta and couldnt find our vehicle Somehow the parking space location was deleted in my phone Nokuthuba Bray found us wandering around trying to find it It took about an hour but she went above and beyond to find it We are grateful for her great effort

CPHNRK and quite satisfied with this regional airport Only a few flights per day so baggage reclaim understandably very quick Bus line connects with downtown Norrkping every half hour travel time is mins and costs SEK Beware that bus drivers do not accept cash any more the only option is the selfservice machine inside the terminal or to purchase a SMS ticket Checkin efficient and hasslefree online seat preselection is available Security staff very friendly Boarding area is limited to two gates and rather cramped do not go airside too early I recommend the airport restaurant which serves tasty and hearty Swedish meals

Istanbul Sabiha Gokcen to Cairo and back A comfortable and cost effective alternative airline to use between Istanbul and Cairo Its quite an acceptable airline especially considering the price is about half of its main competitors prices The check in process seemed a bit slow at SAW the flight was a bit late to depart but arrived on time into Cairo Terminal On both flights the crew were friendly and helpful and the cabin interior of the former Air Arabia A was clean and tidy The meals served were nice with a selection of non alcoholic drinks available This airline arrives into and departs from Cairo Terminal which is an older smaller terminal that seems to have mainly flights to and from the Middle East During busy periods it was very crowded in the small terminal On the return flight the check in was again slow at Cairo Terminal Passport Control confusing make sure you check which queue to join as the Turkey flights have separate counters for passportimmigration Overall a good experience when taking into account the cost saving Down side is perhaps a bit more time spent waiting in the Cairo Terminal and flying into and out of the less popular airport in Istanbul
The airline was fantastic Left and arrived on time You get a snack provided by the airline Very tasty Would always choose to fly with Air North in the future

Excellent both coming and going Good selection of shops and restaurants Layout easy to navigate Well signposted in both Spanish and English Clean throughout Ample restroom facilities Best of all the passportcustoms control personnel both incoming and outgoing are courteous efficient and multilingual They smile I hope they can give US officers the basic lesson Corners of mouth go up not down
