My first time flying easyJet and I had a good experience Both flights were ontime the planes were clean and comfortable and the crew were friendly and professional A relatively short hop between London and Sicily The Captains were good at keeping us informed of progress I ordered some drinks on board but no food Perfectly adequate and I would definitely consider them in the future if the price and route are right

Zhuliany airport is located close to the main business district of Kiev Very small and cosy it is pleasant to fly to and from there on international destinations as everything is done very fast However the airport is not made for international travellers who dont speak Russian or Ukrainian The airport has a bad connection to transit system but taxi fares are attractive and solve the problem if your driver as of January asks you more than to go to the city center then he is abusing you Security and passport check staff are professional and polite The domestic terminal is much more simple and has no service at all for passengers

Munich to Kabul Privilege Style is flying this year old Boeing on behalf of other customers as a charter airline The flight was okay seats are comfortable enough and i felt safe throughout the journey

Impressed by this airport apart from the queue at Passport control It took ages once through to Departures everything was fine Duty Free was reasonable and plenty of places to get a drink or something to eat

Travelled again with SunExpresss for a short break to AYT I dont understand the negative reviews as they are totally at odds with every experience I have had with this airline The cabin crew both out and back were fantastic Very friendly polite well groomed and nothing was too much trouble I would not hesitate to travel with them again

Arrived at Langkawi International Airport at pm after my AirAsia flight No aerobridge here so we had to disembark the plane by stairs First impression of the airport was good because it was clean and simple perfect for an island airport Toilets were very clean Baggage reclaim area and customs come just after we enter the terminal very convenient Small airport so not many shops and restaurants At least there is a small lounge there Lots of seats for you to relax Found this airport really nice

Medellin to Palonegro via Bogota The Colombian subsidiary of the Chilebased LAN Airlines It was a pleasant experience to fly Although the checkinbaggage drop process was a little slow personnel was kind and professional LAN Colombia mostly operates As which are wellkept clean and spacious No complaints about punctuality Luggage delivery was fast IFE was ok considering the short duration of the flights as was the cabin service Good choice if you ever need to fly any of their routes

You often have to wait on a remote parking slot for buses to arrive flights have narrow time windows to land or take off which leads to delays both at the origin and destination Can definitely be better managed Geneva airport model would suit it perfectly It is extremely central and convenient You almost arrive on the historic zone of Lisbon

At Brussels airport the check in service was smooth they even accepted my luggage although it was kg overweight The boarding was quick due to the small plane The trip was around hours I prefer bigger airplanes for longer flights as these smaller planes tend to rock a bit more and the legroom isnt the best either The flight attendants were polite and nice The landing at Tallinn was smooth managed to clear customs very easily

The Airport is actually very nice and there are many comfy sofa beds It has a good amount of shops and places to eat and it has a clean and comfy atmosphere The airline Gulf Air was a nightmare but the airport was very good Recommended to transit through

My first experience on Uniteds ER was spectacular The ground crew was good and helped me board the flight according to standard procedures The seating was pretty good even though it was Economy Class I was sitting in Economy Plus the same seating as Economy Class but with more legroom The cabin crew were all friendly people even though we had moderate turbulence that made everyone anxious However my only issue is that the food did not meet todays standard for Economy Class The entree portion was too small and they didnt notify the mobile app for a lastminute change I thought I would have a chicken entree because I had reviewed it via Uniteds mobile app But instead when I was onboard I had beef which confused me Therefore I recommend that United improve its Economy Class meal service to provide nicer better portioned and more options for all customers

Arrived early for check in and flew through very quickly as it had not yet offically opened Unlike last year when I was a little late and it took more than minutes while my Passport was checked and rechecked Immigration was quick took about two minutes and the security check was also quick I came through here last year and had to be pushy to get both to Passport Control and then through Security as otherwise qiven the queues I would have missed my flight The airport is quite spacious and there are a few shops I went straight to Turkish Airlines Lounge and stayed there until it was time to board the place This was straightforward This was my third time going through Vnukovo and the experience was similar to that of my first time

Not that much leg room If you are over cm tall you will be bashing your kneecaps but otherwise the seat is pretty comfortable The services from the cabin crew were friendly and efficient Due to Covid restrictions no snack was served on this flight There is no screen in the seats so you must supply your own inflight entertainment Would definitely use the airline again as their routes are handy and they were punctual

Guangzhou Baiyun Airport is the most impressive airport for me The ground staff of China Southern Airlines are very warm and have a good attitude This aspect is much better than many domestic airports Since I booked the hotel next to the boarding gate I needed to get the ticket to pass the security check and customs one day in advance The staff of China Southern Airlines helped me to coordinate with the customs and security check departments and finally I checked into the airport transfer hotel successfully

Very disappointed to see that you are busy aping the western culture and forget our own roots As an Indian I am very proud of my heritage and all my traditional food However Cochin airport is a far cry from that You will happily serve cappuccino coffee to please a foreigner while completely omitting to serve a traditional Indian masala tea or a nice bru coffee It is very sad what Cochin airport has come to

First and only visit to a Nang on a transit back in Oct No complaints overall easy navigation not crowded amenities were up to expectations considering it to be only rd largest airport in Vnam Immigration was surprisingly nice asked me for a CS survey which I was delighted to do Staff was also friendly put me on priority queue to my connecting flight international to domestic Fast and efficient everything was done quickly Would love to fly there again as soon as I get the chance
The best assistance so far for arrival and departure For someone who has less mobility and needs a wheel chair Superb and faster assistance Everything in place on time

Small airport with a coffee shop domestic travel only Local bus is there when a plane arrives and takes you into town The bus company keeps up to date with flight delays so there is no panic it will be there when you land No smoking room once you pass the security check

TPEMFR via SFO RT All flights on time Seat bedding and entertainment are good Staff very professional and food service was very quick Food is edible but certainly not like the meals on Singapore Airlines or Emirates The food at the EVA lounge United uses in TPE is mediocre at best and the lounges at SFO are incredibly crowded to the point of being ridiculous and uncomfortable All in all competent but not especially glamorous experience I would have given this a or if the lounges werent so crowded

We use the BA lounges here to avoid the horrendous crowds everywhere in the terminals This airport needs at least two more terminals to offer the space and experience many of its rivals offer When we landed at Terminal we had another interminable wait for our luggage Not a great experience again Id recommend it only because it is better than the other London airports

Vancouver to Phoenix We sat on the tarmac waiting and waiting for passengers to make their connection The flight attendant already announced that everyone was on board and the captain comes up and says we are waiting for more passengers What is fair To give us an on time arrival or wait for passengers and get everyone delayed No brainer

A wonderful airport very cosy and friendly The only drawback as it is vast it has very long walking distances The design is very Dubai in style elegant with an affordable Duty Free You can buy almost everything in very low prices Definitely a very nice airport

Excellent safe clean on time and we got a hot meal on board which I did not expect given the fact that during the ticket purchase I was prompted to buy a meal which I did not want to do They are a little bit expensive but the flight took a long time hrs Excellent service thank you

Pittsburgh International is a modern wellkept airport but it has been sad to its usage steadily decline over the last years or so The US Airways hub is no longer and the airport has had a difficult time with the transition Unfortunately this has meant plenty of vacant gates and ticket counters For the passenger PIT offers free wifi though the signal is really only active near the Skymall McDonalds right in the centre of the terminal Security lines are wellorganised While I was joining the line an employee suggested to a group of us that we use the special annex screening gate which had no waiting That was really good advice which had all of us through and into the secure area in no time Overall it is still a clean comfortable airport I just really miss the days when so many more people used it on a daily basis

Stewart Airport in Newburgh NY is simply good I love to use this airport and often choose international carriers based on their landing at Stewart My experiences with Play Airlines have also been great Lorraine in checkin is a gem and keeps things running smoothly It is wonderful that the airport keeps adding domestic flight carriers as well Now travel is possible from Stewart International to Charleston SC No other airport is as easy to navigate as Stewart International The atmosphere is pleasant the staffing is topnotch and the TSA agents are respectful and helpful The entire process from checkin to boarding is smooth and efficient International arrivals are quick and Ive never had an issue with my luggage I highly recommend Stewart Airport to anyone who wants a simple hasslefree international travel experience

Second busiest airport in Finland after Helsinki now really quiet thanks to covid Terminal is reasonably big and has jet bridges so you dont need to go outside while boarding unless its a small turboprop like we had which cannot use jet bridges There are couple of shops a bar and a cafe and just like most other airports in Finland there are rocking chairs where to relax and even a piano anyone can play Checkin security and baggage claim went smoothly and fast since there were only a few passengers Airport is well connected to the city by buses and taxi

I wanted to take a moment to express my heartfelt gratitude to your team and particularly to Ruzia for the exceptional service provided recently She truly went above and beyond the call of duty when my parents accidentally left their bag at gate I was extremely stressed and worried at the time but she handled the situation with such professionalism and reassurance She took the time to look for the bag and kept me updated throughout the process When the bag was found I asked if it could be sent on the next flight She followed protocol and checked with her superiors to see if this was possible Not long after she called back to confirm that it was indeed possible The bag arrived safely at Heathrow on Sunday with everything intact My parents and I are incredibly grateful to she and your team for going the extra mile Thank you once again for everything

I cannot say enough positive things about the staff at the Delta part of this airport I had badly hurt my knee at Logan and I was to have a wheelchair to take me up the ramp to the luggage return When I got to the walkway there was no wheelchair The flight attendant called to the desk who apologized and said they would get one to me asap Within a minute literally the manager on duty was there beside me He was absolutely wonderful He was on the walkie talkie tried to help me get up the ramp some and we both gave up The flight attendants and even the pilot were attempting to help me get to the terminal Finally biting the bullet the manager got me up there just in time for another young man to arrive with the wheelchair He was sweet friendly and so very helpful We had an Uber coming and he got our luggage and took us to wait for the Uber These men and women are to be commended for their kindness and dedication to the passengers Kudos to all

A small yet very convenient airport in the south of France From the plane to the exit takes no more than min Signaling shopping etc is all fine given the size and role of the airport Its not the most modern airport but everything is well maintained Theres a convenient bus service to the city center

MSL continues to be a good alternative to larger nearby airports Flew to see family in Late Nov and Early Dec of NWA continues to have flights a day to its Memphis Hub As with my previous experiences traveling through MSL the NWA and Airport Staff did a great job in taking care of their passengers Again a job well done by the MSL Airport and Airline Staff Also the New Marriot Hotel and Spa has opened the Robert Trent Jones Golf Course is also open for the avid golfer both of which are just minutes from the airport My round trip flights were flawless and running at or ahead of schedule outbound and inbound from the North West Alabama Airport

PBHCCU CCUPBH Y class Check in staff at Paro very helpful friendly smiling Cabin crew similarly accommodating and friendly Clean cabin decent space for Y class Light refreshments and sandwiches veg or nonveg served on this short minute segment Every flight has been spot on time or slightly early Good announcements from cockpit to point out Himalayan peaks when near Paro Competitive prices A good alternative inout of Bhutan from Drukair

Bozeman Yellowstone Airport is a rather small airport but its cabinlike design make it unique and special The concourse is easy to maneuver and the directional signs are very helpful and easy to read Security is usually a breeze on days with less travel Bozeman does have TSA PreCheck The seating areas are nice with stations for charging Internet Access is also free but it may not work on some devices The terminal is spotless and there are many little shops to have a coffee in as well as a Yellowstone Association store which offers indepth information about visiting Yellowstone National Park Grand Teton National Park and the surrounding areas

Booking Mostly smooth except could not select seats and when selected the selection would not be saved Checkin Got reminder and was easy to conduct online checkin except no boarding pass as the document verification is not online Boarding Chaotic as boarding was not by zones but first come first serve So lot of traffic jams in the isles and many people sitting in seats they were not assigned to Broken seats with stained covers and strange smells Handrests chipped seatbacks cracked Enough legroom Inflight entertainment Many screens and controls not working broken Wireless entertainment worked smoothly but no clear directions on how to access it Inflight meals Very basic many drink choices eg gin and tonic not available Deplaning Long wait before people could get off not sure if it was the ground staff or the plane Baggage checkin and collection Smooth Got ontime notifications about baggage being loaded on different planes along the route Collection was also easy

Another charming African airport where you can bribe your way into any area of the airport and where power cuts tend to be a problem and staff have to run to the generator to get lights back on Surprising that KLM actually lands here no other western airline company does such a thing

I really like this modern airport It is efficient and clean Staff are polite and sost can speak at least a reasonable English and in case of any difficulty they would call a colleague The general public cannot access the main terminal for security reasons A separate building called Meet and greet hosts the first baggage and traveler security inspection facilities A large free parking for private cars and taxis is available From here a bus every minutes brings the passengers and only them to and from the main terminal a few hundred meters away In the same way those waiting for passengers on arrival wait for them at a waiting space at the Meet and greet building Only registered VIP vehicles usually diplomats and high ranking officials can access the main terminal The terminal itself is modern clean and spacious and includes all the expected services The duty free shop is not big but the choice of articles is good for a small airport When arriving I experienced a dozen arrivals in the past years both during the day and the night I never had to wait more than minutes for my baggage While information is always available and efficient inside the airport the same cannot be said for the website Here updates on flight status are unpredictable sometimes wrong sometimes late sometimes correct and on time

This is a small but tidy and well run airport that I suspect will increase in demand in near future Everything is laid out well there are modest food and drink facilities clean toilets and small offices for several car hire firms Hertz Europcar Sol etc An excellent starting point for exploring northern Spain Currently Ryanair flies there twice a day from Stansted and I believe Liverpool Good overall

Brussels to Lanzarote Nice little airline Both outbound and return flights on time Food premium menu delicious Swift and attentive service of the staff Clean aircraft on both ways We booked emergency exit seats which offered extra legroom which is a bonus on h flights Would recommend this airline for sure such a shame that this brand will probably disappear

We were running late due to heavy unpredicted traffic in Ayodhya It was a surprise to see even the airport route was blocked We drive to airport and called Akasa Airlines and they helped us to wait for few min Many thanks to ground staff where they waited for us and helped us to get in faster Akasa accommodated my request and waited for me for boarding Really appreciated the efforts
Worst company Never gonna take this company again I should have look at the reviews before booking Hate their service The price can be good but youll prefer any other companies its a promise

Arriving late at night from Brisbane on a delayed flight we were quickly off the plane and through customs without a long delay for baggage but remember PGK for a visitors visa Security is fairly tight due to the general problems of PNG and only passengers with tickets are allowed into the terminals The domestic terminal is somewhat more crowded and more confusing with limited facilities but is relatively clean Returning from outside POM you may well find that there is no international baggage transfer you need to walk the three hundred or so metres between the terminals with your baggage but it is a covered walkway with lots of security staff everywhere After checkin there is then a wait with few available chairs until customs is opened about an hour before the flight Once through things go fairly smoothly though there is not much airside apart from the small Air Niugini lounge which is pleasant enough For the size of Port Moresby a reasonable enough experience though more seating would be good

Nice modern clean airport with plenty of checkin rows Food options fine with a McD and noodle shops WiFi not always present The only nuissance in this airport on departure is the number of times you have to show your boarding pass and passport times yes

Economy class SVOIST BER RegRA First of let me start by sharing the details I paid around for the ticket and it granted me cabin baggage and bag for the under seat i bought additional checked bag of kg max for around Seat selections were cheaper for the middle and more expensive for the window I paid for AYou could chose your meal before without any cost latest hours prior to the flight there was a lot of options but I chose not to chose and eat the standard meal given on the flight It was the best flight i have ever had Crew was super helpful greeted us at the beginning were helping some passengers to put their luggage in the overhead bins Blankets were handed when requested The seats were comfortable had plenty of legroom my recommendation for the view is A or K because it will have two windows Safety instructions were given as normal and we rocketed out of SVO Moscow During the meal service turbulence occured and they had to stop it several times in the we got our food they had choices for the breakfast I opted for an omlet it was very good served with a small salad salami butter jam croissant and a bar of chocolate with and aeroflot a picture on its packaging whereas there was also Russian pancake blincikhi with raspberry available and a msli kind of option Because of the turbulence only cold drinks were served during that period but hot drinks were available with a request this was announced several times by the crew There was meal service and service of drinks Lavatories were clean nothing special Inflight Entertainment was OK and they were also an Aeroflot magazine and a duty free catalogue We departed Minutes late from scheduled arrived Minutes early Crew made sure everyone had a nice flight They saw us off as wishing the best and hoping meet again in future I can surely say that they were happy with us being on that plane they were doing their job amazing Thanks for the flight Aeroflot hope to meet again
St Petersburg to Moscow Efficient check in Comfortable seats and a fairly decent snack sandwich Certainly good value for money and spot on with departurelanding times Would use again

Brisbane to Honiara return on Solomon Airlines IE flying on a Qantas code share QF in economy An aging but wellmaintained A which does the journey in a shade over three hours Flying on a Qantas Code Share and with premium FF status my luggage was booked through to my final destination and I was able to access the Qantas Business lounge in Brisbane and the Belama Lounge in Honiara Seats are leather and well spaced by economy standards with sufficient leg room There is no inflight entertainment but the meal service was generous for a relatively short flight with constant refills of wine available The cabin crew are among the friendliest I know and give very good service The only competition on this route is Virgin with a similar fare structure and limited service so airfares are not particularly low but if purchased well in advance are not unreasonable for a fairly lowtrafficked route

Gothenburg to Cambridge with SunAir a franchise partner of British Airways Aircraft are painted in British Airways livery and operate under BA flight numbers The flight was only half full making the seat Dornier more like a private jet than a small airliner Full meal and bar service on this hour flight Crew very good

As a resident of Chattanooga I have used this airport on several occasions With just gates it seems to be a bit undersized for a city of However speaking from an architectural perspective it has more character than most airports I have flown through and is very clean besides There is virtually no chance of getting lost owing to the small size and simple layout The security checkpoint is neither intimidating nor cumbersome but the agents are thorough and will search your bags if needed CHA recently added a daily direct flight to DallasFort Worth and will soon follow up with direct service to Houston and Orlando Other cities with direct service to and from CHA include Atlanta Chicago Charlotte Washington DC Cincinnati and Memphis CHA really is a connected airport and getting moreso all the time apparently

Wonderful regional airline from Luebeck I had a chance to try this airline and the experience was quite comfortable Boarding procedure is in order and each passenger must disinfect hands The legspace is good and cabin is simple yet neat The crew were happy to engage with passengers and the best part was that they serve a small meal on each flight I really appreciate that and the meal was simple yet very tasty and filling You can even book a veggie meal while booking flight Beyond what LH can even offer on regional flights While deboarding they served caramel candies This experience with Lbeck Air took me back to old school days which I miss terribly in aviation world Keep up the standards and service because this will set you apart

Lovely airport and great shops for an airport of this size Paying a the counter for taxis removes the touts that descend on you in other places Food options are limited but then who would want to spend too long checking in too early and getting hungry when on such a lovely island

Outstanding views when arriving in on a fair weather day Pass through Airport in little time due to size of airport Friendly staff and facilities need to step up with any increase in flightpassenger numbers Sligo City is only miles form the airport or Euro taxi Journey Area beside airport is popular for running golf surfing and sea sports with international surf competitions held regularly

Ground staff of LAN was ok not overwhelming nice but ok Seats in row ok IFE slow and quality ok Service of FA was good friendly and attentive Quality of food as you can expect in eco We had a transit at GRU to SCL and had to pass a security check where our water bought at FRA was taken Strange Upon arrival at FRA I had a damaged piece of baggage But the ground staff wasnt interested in any way of alpologizing but pointed out the rules for such case only Overall nothing special but a decent choice to travel to South America on long haul

I had a bad feeling as we queued for the temporary drop off zone at Luton airport as I had heard horror stories of this airport in the past but I went into the journey with an open mind We flew out with Ryanair and check in was an absolute breeze with no hold ups at all Security was very busy but we had FastTrack purchased and cleared the lanes within a few moments the staff were very friendly and helpful to us as we passed and even were open for a laugh The departures area can feel a little claustrophobic with low ceilings till you reach the main area There is good choice of FB as you pass through with a nice selection of shops to spend some money Seating is decent as well outside the FB areas so there is space to take a load off I spotted a nasty spillage on the floor and spoke to a cleaner who told me she would attend to it straight away The gate are for Ryanair and Wizz was a little cramped down the corridor with limited space but if you time it right you wont be there long Overall a very surprising experience at LTN and one I didnt expect

The airport is good and surprisingly large for a city of this population due to large number of tourists Most depart on Terminal S South note the terminal as the other terminal is far away Check in and security were smooth and fast There are adequate facilities for shopping or a drink The airport as well as Alaska Airlines have a good record of on time departure A good airport though there is not many lounges

Small airport very friendly staff not too many food choices but the best for long layovers if you need a place for sleep plenty of big chairscouches comfortable and with outlets for charging electronics

Flew Air Niugini because of the B very nice cabin in a xx configuration Took seat A bulkhead seat very comfortable with heaps of leg room Staff were amazing and very attentive food was OK entertainment was enough for this flight of approx hrs

JAL economy class is outstanding The seats are the widest in the business if a bit hard and the food was healthy and tasty Flight attendants were polite and attentive My only complaint is that the offerings on the inflight entertainment service were subpar it was hard to find a movie that rose above mediocre
Yangon to Lashio in November ATR plane Allocated seating and good snack served with excellent customer service Would fly with them again any time

Just like winning the lottery there are some things that you just do not expect to do Giving Kabul airport a good review is one of them But here it is I have been travelling to Kabul for many years and have always hated the airport battle But the new airport is different If all you want to do is got on and off of a flight quickly and efficiently Kabul airport does that very well The hour queues at immigration are gone More like minutes now Baggage reclaim is as good as anywhere else in he world It took about half an hour from landing to being out of the airport No problems with check in either My Turkish flight left exactly on time Dont expect too much in the way of shops or business lounge in the departures area but it is adequate Wifi Internet is working well and free There are lots of security checks on the way into the airport Expect lots of Xray checks and various vehicle and body searches That is just a part of life in Kabul these days Overall a good and efficient experience and a big change from the old Afghan way

Super easy to navigate this tiny welcoming airport parking garage fees are reasonable car rental is close by drop off and pickup is efficient airport management does actually care facilities are clean food is sparse but there and it is secure Top notch tiny regional airport

A good airport to fly in and out of Lines are not long and staff are friendly While it is outside of the city there is OC Transpo service via busways directly to downtown The only down side is that there arent many food options past security

Flying from Saint Petersburg to Prague Rossiya is providing an excellent service punctuality in time Professional cabin crew working so hard they accept Aeroflot points highly recommended I believe the company should be at least categorized as a Star airline

This is a small airport but the new passenger terminal is great Fast service helpful people and clean This is a good alternative of Brussels airport We like it and for sure if possible we will try again

Cusco airport is not big but it is very organized and does have boarding bridges This airport m high from sea level Excellent view from aircrafts This airport is always busy There are some shops and staff are helpful However it does need more seating because I saw many passengers standing up Free wifi is only available for minutes
I visited Victoria BC two weeks ago and for a small international airport I enjoyed the experience Security was quick the facilities were good and checkin was quick I recommend this airport

Fantastic well functioning airport all the shops and facilities you need it took almost no time to get through passport control and security check friendly staff all in all an exceptionally good experience

I was impressed with my trip through LGW south terminal I experienced no issues with my journey I went to check in and was done within minutes Security was fast and easy as well The departures area is well kitted out with shops and restaurants Seating outside of these areas is limited however so be aware of that The walk to the gate areas is extremely long so book assistance if you struggle with distance walking Overall mostly clean only issue was a few dribbles in the toilets but when I asked a cleaner he was more than happy to have a look Really cannot complain even on arrival the experience was smooth and without issues

Kaimana to Manokwari Plane left and arrived minutes late really on time in this part of the world The check in staff were very flexible about cabin luggage size On board seats were reasonably comfortable and crew pleasant

Forl airport is very small The service before leave and after the arriving is very good and friendly The location is good also because is possible to join city like Rimini Bologna and Ravenna in a very few time Quite good the service for the disable people
Nice and very effective Airport With an Business Class Ticket your within Minutes at the Lounge The Security Check also Works smooth Great experience

I recently had the pleasure of flying with Japan Airlines on a flight to Tokyo NRT and was incredibly impressed by the exceptional customer service I received from Ha a ground staff agent From the moment I approached the checkin counter She was incredibly friendly helpful and professional She went above and beyond to ensure that my checkin process was smooth and efficient Her genuine care and attention to detail made me feel truly valued as a customer She went out of her way to make my travel experience as pleasant as possible and I am incredibly grateful for her assistance I was so impressed with her service that I immediately sought out her manager to express my appreciation I am confident that she is an asset to Japan Airlines

We were totally amazed by their services since none of us have ever heard of this airline The trip was arranged by the travel agency who arranged our tour Even during a short trip they provided us gourmet sandwiches and a warm cookie while beverages was served twice which is far much better than what we experienced from those larger airlines How we wish they can cover more routes

I was here on a stopover on the way to Bangkok I didnt have too many problems and the terminal wasnt that crowded it was early morning Also free internet worked well which was helpful Staff seemed friendly though not really helpful The toilets were overcrowded and not clean Not many shops or restaurants that I saw Overall this airport is nothing to right home about but my experience wasnt that bad Qatar airways is a good airline and hopefully the new airport in Doha is better than Doha international

Super small airport and wonderful if you are meeting someone from Hamilton Car rentals from site were out of cars and were no help Cost bucks to take cab from airport to in town car rental agency Tim Hortons only outlet in airport on arrival side or vending machines Flying with Flair and can only get tickets printed and drop off suitcases two hours before flight What we thought we were saving to get to a Blue Jays game in Toronto cost us more by flying to this back wood airport than what it would have been to fly WestJet to Toronto Never again will stick with West Jet friendly and helpful and reliable And the Blue Jays lost which made the trip even more horrible

A great small airport Staff pleasant even down to the security staff which makes a pleasant change from the usual boredrude staff in most airports Free internet in departures and from landing to leaving teh front door only mins A bus to the city would be good

The onground experience was great very pleasant checkin experience the Adani lounge has a separate section for Vistara Frequent Fliers and Business Class which is quite nice The onboard experience is a bit soso the legroom in economy is fairly tight and feels less than Indigo They have cutdown on the quantity of food in meals visibly in economy class The IFE was good enough to keep oneself entertained and thankfully with the middle seat remaining empty the flight was quite comfortable

I was impressed with my trip through LGW south terminal I experienced no issues with my journey I went to check in and was done within minutes Security was fast and easy as well The departures area is well kitted out with shops and restaurants Seating outside of these areas is limited however so be aware of that The walk to the gate areas is extremely long so book assistance if you struggle with distance walking Overall mostly clean only issue was a few dribbles in the toilets but when I asked a cleaner he was more than happy to have a look Really cannot complain even on arrival the experience was smooth and without issues
Excellent flight Water served during the flight Landed ahead of schedule staff was polite and friendly

I traveled into and out of Cardiff Airport in June I found the airport to be quite user friendly and compared to some of the reports Ive read a pleasant surprise A couple of negatives the one pound coins needed for the baggage trolleys seems rather tight and petty Although its close to Cardiff and the M it isnt easy to get to and from unless you have a car Even in a car there seem endless roundabouts and traffic lights to get through Check in was fine I arrived in plenty of time The security on departure seems over zealous compared to say Heathrow and would if the Airport were busier lead to very long queues The shopping was okay toilets were adequate seating in the new departure lounge was fine I didnt try the food outlets or WiFi As I said at the start not an amazing airport but it did the job it is after all a small regional airport

MEX consists of two terminals with Aeromexico Delta Copa and LATAM taking up the newer Terminal and everyone else essentially taking up Terminal Terminal is definitely more userfriendly with Terminal being well over capacity This honestly I dont think will change given that its proximity to the center of Mexico City makes it quite convenient in spite of its shortcomings

I arrived in Nur Sultan Airport from Novosibirsk Russia and left to go to Almaty The Immigration control was quite fast and no problems in getting a day Visa on arrival The airport is relatively new and modern Security was efficient and effective I had a couple of hours between flights and wanted to recharge phone and computer There was plenty of seating but there were very few places and none adjacent to a seat where I could charge my computer I watched it from about metres away The airport has all the things that interest some people money exchange tourist souvenirs etc I seldom shop in airports

I used Olympic Air to fly from Athens to Paros and return The aircraft used was an immaculately clean ATR that despite its year of age seemed brand new It seems the airline is really focusing on maintaining the cabins pristine The cabin crew consisted of flight attendants on each leg groomed to perfection and showcasing exceptional customer service skills A very short flight of roughly and we were offered water and sweets This is quite the rarity these days and highly appreciated treated as a guest and not simply as just another passenger Flights departed with a slight delay due to the air traffic restrictions but made up most of the time lost during flight Bags arrived on time and very prompt I would definitely recommend this legendary brand and i am so happy to see it operating in such high standards even on such short flights

It always a good experience to fly from to Nuremberg airport because you have short ways It is connected with the metroline U so you are in minutes at the city centre You can eat some local stuff The staff is friendly and helpful The most important to the end WIFI is free
The conveyer belt was not working ground staff are limited and quite unsupportive no canteen to eat food But the airport is very clean Newspaper stand and water filter is well in sight

Stockholm Vsters is a tiny airport located around minutes drive west of Stockholm The name is therefore misleading as Vsters is a proper mediumsized town in its own right The place has a very friendly easygoing feel to it There is very little to do save buy a cup of coffee or something stronger if thats to your taste but then I have never had course to spend more than minutes at the airport There are special very efficient buses to Stockholm and elsewhere which connect with incoming and outgoing Ryanair flights It is also possible to take a regular bus into Vsters A totally hasslefree calm place to begin or end a journey

We were originally booked in Premium Economy with Air Canada Due to a substitution of aircraft we were switched onto Omni in economy class While the aircraft was fairly old and we were delayed hour in takeoff everything else was fine Seats were comfortable food was okay and cabin crew were very friendly and efficient Air Canada processed the promised refund due to us being downgraded We would be okay with flying Omni again but prefer flying on an aircraft with a premium economy cabin
Kuala Lumpur to Pangkor Island return This is the most pleasant way of flying for those who love airplanes

Louisville Airport is a great airport very clean and improvements being made all of the time Arrived from Chicago off of the aircraft and by the luggage claim within minutes Local staff are all very helpful and polite as well as being professional For some passengers there were some issues with delayed or lost luggage but the American Eagle ground staff were very professional and sorted out their problems quickly

I flew China Airlines from Singapore to Vancouver on the st June by Premier Economy The flight was not very full but dep from Singapore again delayed by minutes Due to this the Airline allows another extra minutes in its schedule We landed at Taipei minutes late only after a wait of hrs took off for Vancouver on the second leg of my journey This flight was unfortunately delayed by minutes at Taipei due to baggage loading issues etc We landed at Vancouver minutes late as a result of the late take off The flight however was very smooth comfortable Cabin Crew was very good cleaned the toilets every hrs so they remained spic span were well stocked Entertainment system was very good though on SingaporeTaipei sector my Screen had no sound I had to change my Seat The food I always eat on flights is AVML Indian Veg Meal this varied in quality SingaporeTaipei meal was very good though it lacked Indian Bread bun provided No Plain Yoghurt I would rate it On the Taipei Vancouver Sector the Dinner was below par only the fine quality basmati rice north indian tasting veg fruits was edibleI would rate this only The breakfast second meal was better as they provided Parotta with Indian cauliflower potato curry cabbage curryboth tasty Again fruits were provided Banana should have been given I would rate this meal No Plain Yoghurt an essential part of every Indian Veg meal was Airlines the Flight can be described as relaxed comfortable with good service ambience A last word on the A Aircraft which in my view is excellent for such a long flight smooth stable very spacious I will continue to fly by China Airlines in my future flights to Asia

The only international airport of the tiny island of Malta The building isnt the most modern one its renovated but doesnt offer enough seating or space at all especially during peaktimes Security was fast tho and they use the latest equipment Theres the usual food beverage all British shops and some dutyfree Malta has a huge busnetwork and the airport is served by several buslines too Staff is friendly and speaks fine English Dont forget to bring your Britishstyle power connector because European ones are hard to find

The Airport is pretty decent in a lot of aspects The duty free is vast the airport staff and security are ultra professional helped me guide through the terminal on where to find my gate However the WiFi experience could have been better because doing facetime calls was a problem considering whatsapp is not allowed Anyhow it is massive

The airport has definitely improved and it looks a lot more modern than it used to be before They have a decent dutyfree shop with a good selection of items I really liked the sports bar that they had there which was also showing the Fifa World Cup games live and the food was good too The airport staff is very friendly and welcoming and there are also stalls where you can get a massage There is also enough seating if you are traveling in transit

On one of my recent flights I had the pleasure of experiencing the exceptional service of a remarkable cabin crew Their service made me truly appreciate what it means to go above and beyond in offering warmth and professionalism This cabin crew was not just doing their jobthey were truly caring for every passenger making everyone feel like they were being treated with the utmost attention and respect From the moment we boarded the crew greeted each passenger with sincere smiles Whether they were guiding us to our seats or answering questions they were always patient and considerate making everyone feel at ease Despite the long flight they maintained a cheerful and relaxed attitude making the time pass much faster than expected Throughout the flight the crews service was even more impressive During meal service they paid close attention to each passengers needs and even proactively asked if anyone required additional assistance What truly stood out was the crews high level of professionalism As we prepared for landing they didnt rush to tidy up or prepare for descent Instead they walked around the cabin gently reminding passengers to check for any forgotten personal items ensuring nothing was left behind This cabin crew with their genuine smiles attentive service and professionalism made this flight truly exceptional Im grateful for this outstanding crew who made my journey both pleasant and reassuring

Ive flown through this airport or times now and its always a good experience Its a lovely modern building the staff are very helpful securitycustomsimmigration has always been quick and painless It only takes mins by train they have a decent airport hotel located in the domestic arrivals terminal and its always spotless

Coxs Bazar to Dhaka with USBangla Airlines The checkin process was smooth The plane arrived exactly on time But had to refuel for mins We were on a full family trip The staff was friendly and helpful The seats were a bit tight and narrow Food was average Landing was smooth We got our baggage in time I dont know about others but my experience was satisfactory

The airport was shining new and clean with clear signs and directions both in Vietnamese and English The international departure was smooth though queuing time for immigration and security screening was a bit long due to the jam in the morning Not many dutyfree shopping compared to some other international airports in SEA Dining was expensive seemed the restaurant was trying to make money from tourists Boarding gate was good with a lot of seats Toilet was clean

I have gone to this airport several times the past two years Beside my bad experience with sixt car rental I can not find any reason to complain Friendly and helpful staff check in and security done in minutes Small duty free and nice coffee shop Well functioning small airport

Winnipeg to Abbotsford I flew with Swoop for the first time and I absolutely loved it There were no delays and Winnipeg airport was not busy The signs were easy to follow Airport crew were very friendly

Bremen Airport Terminal E is a big shed with Ryanair inside No doubt noisy in a hail storm its open and breezy Staff efficient Plenty of natural light skylights in the roof The light rail service line service from the station is great too Beware it does not take credit cards or bank notes over Euros functional

Cheap prices comfortable seats decent legroom inches on the former IndiGo airplane Check in at Bogota was done online but tourist pass for San Andres and bags had to be dropped off at the check in counter which was pretty easy Boarding was a breeze After take off many people switched seats since most didnt pay for an assigned one Flight was minutes late but otherwise good The only problem were kids running up and down the aisle like wild animals and nobody from the crew stopping them Unfortunately due to Colombias COVID rules there was no inflight service but you are able to bring your own drinks and snacks

There is a reason why this airport was ranked among the top airports in the country Its very easy to navigate the facilities are very clean and there is free wifi for minutes Security is a breeze with the lines moving very quickly The TSA staff are pleasant and friendly There are several food options here ranging from fast food coffee to sit down restaurants Wolfgang Pucks and the Providence Oyster Bar are highly recommended There are also a number of retail shops with Brooks Brother among the more prominent ones Plenty of restrooms which are not only clean but maintained at regular hourly intervals

Check in at Penang quick and easy and only small queue at security Used the Plaza Premium Lounge ok but nothing special Flight boarded slightly late but the boarding process was well managed Cabin was clean and included the latest short haul business class seat comfortable and ample legroom for a short flight Even on a minute flight business class passengers get a hot meal in this case chicken satays which were very tasty Flight landed on schedule and baggage already on the belt by the time we had walked from the gate Good experience with Malaysia Airlines

Very cramped space for legs I am and you cant get enough space for legs so I put my right leg in corridor Arm support cant be lowered and not just on my seat I was flying with Delta Qatar and Turkish intercontinental but this plane was just overloaded with seats Entertainment choice ok Food was ok but also much better on other companies wine also ok Ladies and men cabin crew were great Funny and polite very useful must say one of the best Ive met

Gatwick to Venice We were hesitant about this airline having read reviews but booked it for the low price I have to say the flight exceeded our expectations Checkin and boarding were both an extremely smooth process I think we were at the bag drop desk for a total of minutes and boarding was much quicker than with other lowfrills airlines We paid in advance for extra legroom seats my partner is so this is an essential for us and were surprised by the amount of space and comfort We sat at the front of the plane with plenty of room to stretch out unlike Ryanair and EasyJet whose exit row seats only have an extra inch or so Flight took off and landed on time and was far more comfortable than wed anticipated There are definitely some areas to be improved upon in terms of the preflight process I have not come across any other airline in the past few years that makes you print out your own boarding pass rather than making it available electronically Its also pretty irritating to be told you cant check in online unless you pay for it this could potentially lead to long queues at the airport on the day These points lower my overall score for the airline but the flight experience itself was very pleasant

I was pleasantly surprised by Safi on a hop from Dubai to Kabul Yes the aircraft was old and the legroom poor But the flight was on time the staff friendly and the food free excellent A shame there is no chance of a glass of wine A big advantage of Safi is that it operates from the very civilised Dubai Terminal making it ideal for connecting to most of the major carriers except Emirates FlyDubai offers a slightly more comfortable service on the same route but operates from Terminal which is little more than a shed and a very long and tedious bus ride to other terminals
The airport is very small however the staff provided a very good service We went through the airport very quickly

We had a great flight with French Bee from Paris back to NYC We booked late for our first ever Europe trip so we didnt want to buy expensive tickets We took a risk going with French Bee since its cheap about one way We were nervous seeing all the bad reviews especially with cancellations Turned out to be an awesome experience on time good foods no turbulence

Flew on Loganair on flight No LM from City of Derry Airport to London Heathrow It was an early morning however checkin was fast and efficient Check in staff were very friendly City of Derry airport is a small regional airport however the service for early morning check was good We took off on schedule and during the flight there was tea coffee and biscuits serviced The cabin was extremely friendly and welcoming We land in Heathrow ahead of schedule and luggage was delivered very quickly I was very impressed by the service provided Loganair on this flight

I fly with IB express a few times a month Usually on time or even ahead of schedule Service on board is really good Welcome drink online entertainment full meal service with really nice food Drinks available during all flight I truly recommend them Only issue the comfort of the seat If you fly the old seat comfort nonexistent no headrest no recline If you fly the new Aneo seats are comfy for a hr flight to the Canary Islands they do recline and have headrest Good service for a low cost airline

Boarding by bus transport Flight on time cabin crew friendly They served water during the short flight Got an emergency exist seat based on my frequent flyer status No entertainment available Landing ahead of schedule Nothing special but effective flight

Ive traveled through this airport quite a few times due to its location bw Boston and New York Overall its a quiet airport that never seems to be too busy Theres a reasonable share of shops but none too interesting Flights are generally on time in my experiences and airport staff are helpful although you most likely may never need to utilize their assistance The signage is perfectly laid out and food cafes are sprinkled all over The new terminal and parking garage are super convenient

Des Moines KDSM is an all round great airport It is a very easy airport to navigate in and it doesnt take long to get through security at all It always seems to be clean and free wifi is always a plus While there seems to be a lack of shopping and food choices there are a few that all seem to be good places of business Terminal seating is in the process of being expanded as it doesnt hold the demand all of the time Its a great airport to depart and arrive to It isnt very big but will get you where you need to go

Ljubljana Airport has undergone a major update over the last few years and has increased in size quite substantially Line of sight signage is good making navigation around the airport very easy Arriving from a Schengen country results in a very fast entry procedure to the country Departing was also a breeze with very friendly and efficient staff we were checked in through security customs and in the lounge in very short time Waiting areas are comfortable and duty free shopping and other outlets well staffed and spotlessly clean
Small airport with few but good services Reasonable time to check in and pass passport checks Excessively expensive duty free It offers a good free wifi service also available outside the air side

Auckland to Chengdu Their cabin was fresh and clean and being a newer aircraft was kept very well The service is warm and professional The seats fold flat and my kids slept for most of the hour flight We arrived relaxed and stress free considering that we had young kids to look after and worry about Night flights with kids are the way to go The food was very tasty The flight attendants were very polite and accommodating They never made you feel you were a burden to them I will happily fly Sichuan in the future
Thai smile offers convenient service through their app and self service at Suvarnabhumi Airport with staff support The time of flight is in time Staff gave service with hospitality
Pleasant short flight Plane was clean and on time Boarding was efficient Staff cheerful Very convenient to reach other Caribbean islands Will fly with them again

I flew one way from Melbourne to Canberra I paid extra for more leg room and extra for priority boarding It came to The flight left on time and arrived on time The seat was comfortable The staff were courteous Based on my experience I wouldnt hesitate to fly with this airline again

My experience was very smooth no flight changes or surprises in the departure flight In the arrival flight there was a security threat in Beirut Airport resulting in flight delays for ALL airlines The way Ajet dealt with the situation was outstanding and professional Given the unintended delays we missed the next flight Without even asking and as soon as we arrived to their desk they fixed the flight for the next day and offered us free transport hotel and meals The air and ground crew is very nice and helpful The only setback is in communicating with the Airport employees in English Until this improves communicate with a smile and nice attitude and youll get what you want eventually
Small but very pleasant Nice staff and decent facilities Better than any of the larger airports
Very new very clean lots of natural light Easy and fast arrivals process Departure area spacious
Taipei Hualein TaiChung Both flights by ATR cabin was clean and comfortable Very friendly crew Drinks service on both flights

SINNARSapporoNARSIN trips for last two years Sapporo NewChitose impressed me Comfortable massage chairs located around airport dining options fair but still better than others small and somewhat ageing but still cosy Checkin fast for domestic Glad to go there again

I live in Kampala and fly in and out of this airport regularly It is a rather small and quiet airport clean and modern after the refurbishment There is not much to do a few duty free shops overpriced craft shops and a restaurant Checkin area can be very crowded especially for BA KLM and Emirate flights For all other international flights it is sufficient to arrive at the airport hour before departure The best this airport has to offer is probably the lounge Clean extremely comfy sofas big TV screens friendly service hot showers internet access and an electronic massage chair
Contrary to another review there are good facilities after passport control Including shops Bistro and cafe Very clean and definitely not a shed

Passenger wise Indias th busiest airport but infrastructure wise one of the most smallest airport in India When flight lands they dont even provide bus to arrivals but needs to walk from aircraft to terminal via on tarmac Arrivals is very small only baggage belt in a limit spaces but baggage can take more time Toilets are just ok should be more clean Prepaid cab and also uber have pick up point just after exit no issues finding them at the same time many taxi drivers will approach you offering ride Airport needs proper management new terminal is under construction and hope that it is better managed

We arrived well in time for our flight and stood in line for terminal entrance During our time in Pakistan we have been guided to the front of lines quite a few times so were not surprised that this happened here as well by members of airport staff We gave a small tip when inside but soon they asked for big amounts of western money we gave which is quite a lot for Pakistani standards they wanted We ripped away our luggage and walked away They dripped off Once inside long lines for passport control lounges closed but a decent departure hall with enough seating

I had a better experience than most of the other people who posted reviews here The airplane departed on time in Tblisi and arrived even a bit earlier Seats are comfortable Checked luggage is free which is very rare these days Be prepared for zero interaction with the staff members in the plane though Only at the entrance the staff greets you They seemed quite friendly though Theres no option to buy food and no information apart from an announcement that the landing has started The life vests looked quite old frayed and stained at least the one that the safety instructor showed maybe the ones stored under your seat are newer If you dont need luxury and you bring your own food this airline is really fine I dont know how they act in case of delays or cancellations though
Flight RGNTVYMGZ on an old ATR Plane very worn from the inside and outside Cabin crew very friendly and efficient Small snacks and drinks offered on each sector Recommended
One of the best domestic airports in the country Wellsituated Come prepared for delay gate changes and high prices Be careful with illegal taxis

Moscow to UlanUde in economy on a Boeing The plane interior was clean and in good shape the dinner was edible staff polite and reasonably efficient Seat pitch is tight for the tallish me cms But the whole experience was better than Id expected from an offbrand carrier

I concur with the comment below Confins is underused But there is a big plus Conexao Aeroporto buses that take you to the city centre are punctual and efficient Things have changed since and there should be more improvements in the future

Kazan to Baku Its not really a low cost airline because the cost is not low and quality is even lower than a usual lowcost But I had no choice Hand luggage is not included it is made clear on their website But the problem is that you cant pay for the hand luggage on their website you have to pay at checkin counter And they force you to pay in different currency using their crazy exchange rate so you will overpay for it a lot The reason as they explained it it is because they need to check your bag size and weight to see if it will fit Cant they allow to pay for it online and deal with overweight bags at the airport for extra cost My bag was within the limits but I had to pay more Surprisingly seats were pretty comfortable and spacious enough for tall people They even gave a free sandwich But teacoffee was not free Anyway I cant recommend to fly with Buta

I recently flew out of Manchester Terminal A great experience from leaving the car at the pre booked car park No queues at bag drop off or security even though I had bought a fast track pass The terminal is clean bright and well appointed Within minutes of arrival I was eating breakfast in San Carlo My return trip was as efficient within one hour of landing I had collected my car and was at home Terminal is a revelation after the dire experiences of Terminal Well done from me

Flight was ontime small propellerdriven aircraft seats Large cabin bags do not fit into the overhead compartment they are stored in the front of the cabin The seat was comfortable enough for a shorthaul flight staff was friendly and helpful Would fly within again

Ive come across old reviews of Bandungs Husein Sastranegara Airport and I have to say that the airport today doesnt look as bad as it used to be The new terminal building is a welcome addition for an airport that handles nearly flights a day There is a security check for both international and domestic passengers before the checkin and another one at the entrances to the international and domestic departure halls Checks were quick and cleared the immigration checkpoint in less than a minute Apparently most of the shops after the security area are in the domestic departure hall The new international departure hall consists of only one gate Gate i a tiny magazine stand a kids playground and a food kiosk that looks more like a mini warehouse There is free wifi to keep people occupied charging points for mobile phones as well as plenty of seats Since there are few international flights the international departure area doesnt feel crowded As the airport is tiny there are no aerobridges so you have to walk to the plane rain or shine While this can be annoying for some it is pretty great for aviation enthusiasts you can get really close to planes that are taxiing to the runway Would be happy to use Bandung Airport again

Excellent airport I agree completely with the last two reviews I would say to Alastair Finch that he should not worry the airport seems to be holding its own Having flown from Doncaster recently I was expecting a far better level of service from the UKs newest airport but all I found were closed shops and poor customer service Access from the A and M is excellent meaning it can be reached within minutes from all of the nearby population centres Customer service is second to none and one can be off the plane and through to the car in minutes The only thing lacking is the range of direct destinations but it seems that is more to do with the economy than the competition Certainly the KLM service is a godsend and far better than travelling to Heathrow or Manchester for direct flights I would highly recommend people from the Humber region and Lincolnshire to give this place a try if they havent already Given the choice I would sooner travel from Humberside over Leeds Doncaster and East Midlands any day despite living closer to Doncaster

I had forgotten what the airport was like but it was great very small and compact no air bridges to aircraft just a quick walk across the airfield Immigration was very easy and efficient as international flights seem to land one at a time The luggage was swiftly off the aircraft and minutes you are in your taxi off to your Hotel Check in again was very quick we arrived very early and were first in the queue your taxi drops you off curbside and you walk about paces and the checkin is in front of you Immigration was very quick minutes and you are airside very limited space and a sad sight of a Burger King Fortunately we went upstairs to the BusinessFirst Lounge shared by most airlines it was empty when we arrived but filled very quickly good tea and coffee a bit limited offerings but ample really Called when the flight was boarding chaos downstairs but they were calling priority boarding and eventually all went as planned

We were on a chartered flight taking a group of very special kids to Lourdes in France Team were so friendly and welcoming Lovely comfy accommodation clean and spacious Lovely touch was a special package snack for our VIPs Thank you Titan

Kingston Norman Rogers Airport is the best kept secret of southeastern Ontario I enjoy taking a minute drive to Kingston instead of driving hours to Toronto It is a small terminal building Checkin is quick and easy Air Canada Jazz operated flights daily to Toronto and seasonal service to Montreal using the Dash and Beech D It is worth the connection in Toronto A lot less trouble There are rumours that WestJet is going to be launching daily service to Calgary

What a wonderful feeling entering the Bermuda airport Friendly thoughtful staff and the wonderful band playing Bermuda is Another World were quite the contrast to American and Canadian airport experiences My wife and I just returned from a wonderful stay in Bermuda if possible tell the band that their beautiful music is still in our heads a week later
Professional courteous security Definitely a credit to the management and the leadership team Well done Definitely recommend the team for their professional approach and execution of their duties

Upon leaving Europe back to Los Angeles my flights had me departing LJU to connect at CDG for my flight to LA For some reason my travel agent had booked the two flights separately under two different confirmation numbers while in Slovenia I had called the airline and even the hotels concierge did as well and we both found out only the gate agent can make sure and both flights are listed as one continuous trip mainly for the sake of routing checked luggage all the way through The gate agent with the assistance of a coworker easily got this done and I was only charged for an extra checked bag my initial flight was in economy while my connecting flight was in business Thankfully both flights were on the same airline in the end everything went smoothly Upon arrival at LJU I was amazed how much of a small town airport feel it had You could walk through the entire airport in minutes There were only about four checkinticket windows and no one was in line Proceeding to security there were about three rows to enter through and once again no one else was in line My time initially at checkin took about minutes to get my flights worked out and to pay the extra checked bag fee and then within ten minutes I was through security and enjoying a drink near my gate A very laid back and friendly experience Sort of a calm before the storm I would have at CDG in three more hours

My first time flying easyJet and I had a good experience Both flights were ontime the planes were clean and comfortable and the crew were friendly and professional A relatively short hop between London and Sicily The Captains were good at keeping us informed of progress I ordered some drinks on board but no food Perfectly adequate and I would definitely consider them in the future if the price and route are right

As I live in Belo Horizonte this is the most used airport by me Before the renovation this airport was very bad but now after the renovation it looks great it is clean the queue time is good there are many options for shopping and eating and the airport is spacious The only problem is that it is far from Belo Horizonte city centre

I Flew on flight TK on the th February from Istanbul to Bangkok which was an excellent business class flight experience The food on board was as usual very good indeed as was the superb service provided by cabin crew hostess Grulsah She was extremely friendly and very professional for which I would like to thank her for If I had one perhaps negative comment to make and that is regarding the dated seating layout on the airbus A Which with a layout of doesnt provide much in the way of privacy and should if possible be changed to a layout That aside the flight itself arrived into Bangkok exactly on time Highly recommended

I enjoyed lengthy stop overs here on a recent flight to BKK in Biz class with Gulf Air The airport is amazing clean and transit was smooth The lounge was fantastic and food and drinks were excellent Staff throughout the airport were amenable and friendly Overall it is a much less stress free and agreeable experience in comparison to transit through Doha or Dubai

For departures Algiers new airport is fairly spacious functional and the staff is friendly I might have been lucky but I found the police controls and security to go fairly quickly Shops are limited but I found them sufficient also they are open very early and close late The choice of restaurants is limited to for each hall and they are of the same provider They offer reasonable selections of light eating and drinking On arrivals I find it inadequate to have to walk down stairs after coming off the plane I did not see an elevator available The wait for the luggage is too long I was told it was due to the luggage scanner being undersized for the traffic One important deficiency is the absence of English signs they are all in French and Arabic only A shame for a brand new International airport Over all I was satisfied mainly due to efficiency at departure and the feeling of space which is lacking too often in aging European airports

Having lived in the area all of my life Ive flown out of Syracuse Hancock for years It is a smallish regional airport with a few places to eat The bathroom facilities are abundant and clean while gate areas are somewhat outdated and a little shopworn The airport is divided into two main departurearrival wings previously each had its own TSA screening area Recent renovations resulted in consolidation to a single TSA screening area with capacity to manage both gate wings Because I was not aware of the renovations I took my usual path to my assigned gate only to find that I had to backtrack to the TSA area and then back out to the gate Perhaps further renovations andor improvements in signage could result in more a more direct and efficient pathway to TSA Once through the mostly efficient TSA process the walk to the gate was fairly quick and straightforward TSA lines can be long but not like LAX DCA etc during peak periods so be prepared Parking is adjacent to the terminal with very reasonable rates Ive left my car there for a few days at a time without concern While sometimes flights are less expensive out of nearby cities Rochester Buffalo Albany for example I choose to fly out of Syracuse because it is so accessible Lastly the Syracuse illuminated sign on the gate area has welcomed passengers for decades with its comforting deco appearance

My wife daughter and I used Eastern Airways to fly from Humberside Airport in the UK to Esbjerg in Denmark We had a number of reasons for choosing Eastern The proximity as Humberside is only a minute drive away and our daughter has a disability that requires her to have lots of medical equipment with her in the cabin she requires mechanical ventilation via a trachea when flying and it was our daughters first flight We believed Eastern as a small local airline could provide the service we would need to make the trip a success They did not disappoint From my initial communication with customer services to our flights all the staff were helpful considerate and went above and beyond Nothing was too much trouble and they pulled out all the stops to ensure the medical equipment could be accommodated At one point the captain of the plane enquired with the air steward about our daughters welfare Very impressed and would not hesitate to use the airline again We have told friends and family about the route offered by Eastern and recommended them for a break to Denmark Cannot praise the airline enough and special mention to customer services the staff and the captain who was on both journeys
Not as big as Airports in Beijing and Shanghai that it is hard to navigate It is very efficiently run and very clean It is the best midsize international airport in China

Unexpectedly Good I wasnt really sure what to expect and feared a tricky experience but in fact Fiji Airways were excellent I paid for extra legroom on the first leg but even on the long routing from Nadi to Vancouver the standard economy seat had excellent legroom Ive been more cramped in Qatar economy than this especially their recent seat config So this was a real bonus Crew were good and friendly I guess the weaker points are the food which is pretty basic and entertainment Both flights were ahead of schedule Id definitely fly with them again

KIXHND a stylish airline Cabin staff service efficient Cabin which is coordinated in white and black elegant and personal monitor is easy to use Seats are made of black leather and seat pitch is enough

Brilliant Airline Very pleasantly surprised I recently flew with Oman Air on two sectors One was very short haul and one was mid range Both flights were nice The crew were polite and helpful the food was very good and the IFE was quite impressive The planes were clean and comfortable The prices were very competitive

Jashore to Dhaka A not wellknown domestic airline in Bangladesh The flight was late but we did get to our destination in a straight flight with no circling around Being a short flight the cabin service was basic but adequate Not a bad airline

Arrived into Grand Cayman from Miami on Saturday night Immigration took minutes and bags were already off the belt when we came into baggage hall Only recommendation is a larger canopy by car pick up point as needed during heavy downpour we got very wet On departure took minutes from arrival to check in and clear customs check Limited seats at gates but more seats to right hand side as you enter departure lounge A bit warm but not too bad More space needed by desks at each gate as gets crowded Food and shopping limited but sufficient Few restaurants and duty free but food items very expensive Boarding is via walk to plane which is great if weather is good Passengers were crowding the gate before Boarding Zones were called All in all a good airport experience at a small airport
Seattle to Dallas Great flight and spacious cabin Had a connection from Vancouver Staff went above and beyond First class meal was very delicious and the crew was extremely nice

Bloemfontein airport is currently undergoing improvements to its buildings and facilities This is with a view to the FIFA Soccer World Cup to be held in South Africa I love this little airport because there is an air of excitement and a bustle of activity While the upstairs cafeteria is undergoing improvements there is a downstairs cafeteria where refreshments may be purchased The airport personnel are some of the friendliest i have ever met Their are ample parking and car rental facilities available

Recent Improvements have made this small airport quite reasonable There are a few dining and shopping options and the area is fairly large and pleasant They still play terrible elevator music Free internet is a bonus The airport is conveniently located to the city but there is no public transportation available Parking is day bit it is often difficult to find a spot

I had have one of the best experiences with Air Astana because my April trip from Dubai to UstKamenogorsk via Almaty and Astana and back included flights and all were in time Different types of aircrafts such as B from DXB to ALA Airbus long range from ALA to NQZ Astana and Embraer E to UKK all were clean and their condition was also good Of course in this challenge ALong range definitely wins because it was brand new As for food everything was nice and wide choice of beverages is still available as before pandemic And one more thing I took part in air Astana stop over holidays program for international travellers and my hosting in Almaty and Astana in hotels was very friendly On international flights airline gives complimentary amenity kit even in economy class I just have to mention that my screen of entertainment system on my way from Dubai to Almaty didnt work Thats why I took one point from my overall mark

Toronto City Center while dwarfed in size by nearby Toronto Pearson Airport provides an exceptional experience for travelers Most notable is the terminal cafeteria stocked with free coffee soft drinks and light snacks In an era where nothing seems to be given out for free in air travel it is refreshing to see this at City Center The terminal is designed differently than those at most other airports As opposed to separate waiting areas for each gate there is one central waiting area which serves every gate the airport has gates At first glance the sight is a bit jarring but travelers will feel at ease as they settle in to the comfortable seats with their free snacks City Center is also recommended because of its location Views from within the airport and during approaches are beautiful as the airport is situated over water Lake Ontario Meanwhile the airport is very close to downtown Toronto making transport to and from the airport quick and cheap

Corruption and extortion are alive and well at this airport Both myself and four colleagues in the following days were asked for our passports and then dollars to return them from officials at this airport It has been a while since this last happened to me in any country at any airport but this place stands out Who would want to visit this place for business or vacation Never again
