I flew from and to Varna Airport in April The airport is good but the lounges were closed early in the morning There is only duty free shop and the prices there are good One bad thing is that boarding the plane is always by bus otherwise it is a good experience

Went to Anchorage in late Airport has some restaurants on the security side of the airport but not a good choice and the quality was not too good The gift shops on the other hand are excellent especially if you are looking for Native American art Be warned that quite a few souvenirs are like snow shakers with water which will be taken off you by security if you need to pass through them again Information screens were useful Plenty of seating and quite a view out of the terminal window

Geneva to Zurich I was a bit nervous about flying with this airline because of bad reviews but my experience was the complete opposite True boarding was done a bit late but we took off only minutes after scheduled departure time and landed minutes before scheduled time which means the flight was only mins Despite the short flight time passengers were handed a pack of small biscuits and a brioche together with a ml bottle of water each Seating on the Saab is x which means that the passenger sitting on the left hand side of the aircraft gets a window AND the aisle in economy class Truly stunning morning views of the Swiss Alps during sunrise The Saab aircraft is a small turboprop aircraft which is pretty fun to fly on for true aviation enthusiasts like me Cabin pressure is good and the noise level is a bit higher than on other aircraft but thats quite cool for av geeks Definitely better than what I was expecting and I recommend this great airline and the Saab

Overnight flight from KL to Shanghai on their relatively new B plane Was impressed on the cabin cleanliness and seat was pretty comfortable But would preferred to be on a wide body aircraft for a flight time longer than hrs Cabin crew were polite Food was ok But for the price I paid for it was cheaper than some low cost carrier Would not hesitate to fly with them again

The terminal is Sovietstyle and a little big for just or flights a day to Moscow and the occasional charter Checkin was slow with initially only one desk open but the service was friendly and efficient when eventually obtained With a blizzard on the tarmac it was unsafe for the bus to drive out to the plane Stumbling across the whipped up snow and ice is not something for the fainthearted The early offer of an onboard drink was appreciated

Cant fault this airport at all the staff are very friendly helpful I found the experience of arrival departure stress free Its nice clean one of the friendliest airports I have ever been to on my holidays abroad

Efficient and helpful service from reservations to ground staff and cabin crew You feel like you matter as a customer and are very accommodating with any changes Food and Beverage selection on domestic route is fantastic nice to have that surprise option Would I fly again of course yes Well done Thai smile airways staff and crew

We had great experiences with Coastal on separate flights within Tanzania Our planes generally had passengers on board plus pilot and copilot For peace of mind we were permitted to check that our bags were in the cargo hold of the plane before boarding I was nervous about flying on such a small aircraft but all flights were smoother than expected and relatively short in duration We experienced excellent customer service via emails when arranging for our XL bags due to equipment for photography and diving and the staff member was able to answer our questions about transfer from the Dar Es Salaam domestic to international terminal Note Its a minute drive and there is a Coastal shuttle that runs between them Only a couple of minor flaws The air conditioning did not appear to be working on one of the planes while we were on the ground so it was very hot One of our flights inexplicably was delayed about minutes but fortunately it did not affect our itinerary in the least Overall I was very happy we chose Coastal Aviation for our interTanzanian flights and would not hesitate to fly with them again

My sister and I flew from LGW to Banjul I have nothing but praise for the cabin crew We flew out on th Nov at The crew were amazing we have flown many times and although some passengers were difficult they never wavered from the job in hand and seemed to be happy genuinely I wish I took the crews names as they were on the go the whole hrs

Terminal is the area I am reviewing this trip We used the short stay car park as you can walk undercover into the terminal Very easy although not the cheapest option Finding the Aer Lingus checkin was simple and as we stood in line the single checkin operator asked for passengers for Belfast to come forward first which was great The airline uses T for short hops to Belfast and Dublin the main activity for long haul is in T Security was very quiet and efficient for those of us who understand and stick to the rules One family was annoyed at having to surrender much of their liquids and cosmetics because they did not know the rules My partners bag was sidetracked for search Apparently her paperback novel attracted their attention Mine thankfully did not so go figure Once through we ran the gauntlet of the Duty Free maze and found our way to the Aspire Lounge included with the economyflex ticket Boarding was simple with the ATR aircraft having only seats Returning the aircraft was parked very remotely for some reason and we were bussed to the terminal at times I thought we were on an executive allareas tour By the time we got there the bags were on the belt and we were away

High marks for YOW Transited from USA to international There is no sterile transit area One has to enter Canada and then go through security again but the process was fast I was number at passport control Service personnel uniformly nice and helpful Reasonable number of shops and eateries for a small airport Well done Ottawa

Very clean and well taken care of This airport is served by so many great airlines with diverse destinations I do think that GRR needs more international routes At GRR the airport is not too big so it makes efficient travel Also they have a good selection of shops and stores The airport facility looks really modern and cool for being over years old The only cons is that sometimes it can get a bit crowded and the staff doesnt manage high groups of passengers well Would give an if I could

I have flown several legs with Qantaslink over the past months The Q has a more comfortable seat than the new seats in Qantas Boeing and soon to be Airbus s apart from their newest aircraft VHA which has seats so hard that a wooden bench would be more comfortable Ground Service Im pretty disappointed that you cant select your seats until hour before you leave for us less desired Red FF or no FF customers and all the seats up the front are blocked off for Qantas preferred customers Baggage drop and collection has been efficient on all flights where I have checked my luggage On board cabin crew do their jobs and the pilots are friendly Most delayed departures have ended in on time or early arrivals Food they may as not bother I dont consider tiny cent sized corn chips with some sauces a meal or even a snack I think Qantas and Qantaslink need to do alot better here One bonus is that unlike Rex you can purchase a lounge pass with your flight to allow you to relax have some food or drinks and get away from the crowds before our flights out of capital cities Lounge passes unless youre a Qantas Club member or Gold FF and higher cost Boarding disembarking When they dont use those ramps which are great for people with mobility issues disembarking is pretty efficient but when the ramps are used it can take up to minutes for them to put the ramp onto the aircraft The buses that take passengers to and from remore stands are a safety hazard if you have mobility or balance issues then sit in a seat as the drivers seem to be very heavy on the brakes

Airport is a km miles scenic riverside drive south of Chittagong City Center reachable by taxi or car No local hotels or serious restaurants available within the vicinity There are snacks and confections available in a couple of spots on the grounds side within the terminal Renovated recently the interior is unusually modern and comfortable for a regional airport in a small country like this The new aerobridges serve the airport well and efficient and courteous staff make it easy to find ones way through the facility Toilets are fair to middling but thats expected Overall not bad at all

I wasnt very impressed by the staff The two woman on duty did not appear to be helping visitors much Several of us didnt know which queue to join to go through passport control When I finally got there it was like questions They made me feel like a criminal Is this your first time in Cyprus Do you have house here Where were you in As if anyone can remember that I assured them it was my first visit to the island After some discussion between two if them they eventually stamped my passport and one of them slammed it down onto the counter I know they have to do their job but it wasnt very welcoming and they didnt have to be so rude

Impressed by this airport apart from the queue at Passport control It took ages once through to Departures everything was fine Duty Free was reasonable and plenty of places to get a drink or something to eat

I had to fly with Air Carabes to Paris to connect back to Canada as due to COVID there are no Canadian directs I initially chose Air Carabes because the flight was ridiculously cheap only for a transatlantic flight The airport and gate were typical for a midsized Caribbean airport it had what I needed but nothing more When I first saw the plane I realized how brand new it looked it was an A Getting on board the modern feel of the cabin was obvious I had a seat in the very back row but still the seat was comfortable and it had aboveaverage legroom It came with your usual screen equipped with a good number of entertainment options What really caught my eye with the screens though was the exterior cameras I had a middle row so it was amazing to still be able to watch the takeoff from a tailfinmounted camera and now I wish every plane had that The food was excellent there was only one option as far as I could tell but I did really enjoy the food yet it was simple enough that most people would like at least some portion of it Communicating with staff went fine with the basic amount of French I know as a Canadian and anyone who complains about them not speaking English is obviously a little selfcentred and doesnt realize that this is a local Caribbean airline serving only French locations they shouldnt have to learn English to help out the American traveller on a flight Even with all of that all of the gate announcements and inflight announcements were also said in English so I dont really get how this could be much of a problem I will say that it was unfortunate that their main website had an English page but the booking screen was only in French but again I dont really hold it against them and got it booked with a little help from Google Translate If you cant handle that just book it from Expedia or something All in all this Air Carabes flight might just have been the best Economy experience that Ive ever had and I would definitely fly with them again especially if the price stays that amazing

Volaris is starting to grow on me It is quickly becoming my favourite Mexican airline The nofuss booking procedure and easytounderstand and reasonably priced baggage options are just some of the perks this airline offers They are just a good allaround no fuss no frills good airline

Ryanair flight operated by Lauda Europe was on time Legroom wasnt great but was only just slightly worse than the same route with Austrian Airlines The crew were awesome a special shoutout to the female crew member who managed the iceinthecup situation for me I would happily fly this airline again its about the same as Austrian Airlines except you dont get a free small chocolate Recommended

Berlin Schnefeld to Tel Aviv Fast and efficient check in flight on time very friendly crew Clean plane seat comfort in Economy Plus good Compared to Ups competitors on this route Up has the best flight schedule Have flown Up repeatedly in Economy Plus and never disappointed

Flew in and out of Rio Galeao airport in October Terminal was quite clean and quiet and quite a lot of shops but not too many which is neat The walking was a lot though and there were no conveyor belts to speed from the security to my gate all the way at the other end of the airport This is one of two points that could be improved The other one is is that some employes doing reaserch and statistics about client satisfaction were walking aroud the gates to get info No problem there But there are far too many I got interupted almost every minutes and I think that the airport cancould relax on that An otherwise great airport

We use the BA lounges here to avoid the horrendous crowds everywhere in the terminals This airport needs at least two more terminals to offer the space and experience many of its rivals offer When we landed at Terminal we had another interminable wait for our luggage Not a great experience again Id recommend it only because it is better than the other London airports

The airport is very nice and average The check in is a bit slow Be at the airport terminal at least hours prior to the flight The arrivals is busy and crowded The washrooms are wet and needs improvements The airport needs more duty free shops The WIFI and connectivity is very fast and quick to connect

The Airport was quiet and everything went really smooth The staff were professional and did not give me a hard time while checking in and during customsimmigration Toilets and lounge were clean and comfortable to use The wifi was also very reliable

Exceptional Service from Ground Crews I recently had an experience that despite starting off on the wrong foot turned into a testament to the incredible dedication of the airlines ground crew Unfortunately we mismanaged our time and ended up missing our flight It was a stressful situation for our family of four and we were worried about what would happen next However the ground crew went above and beyond to assist us They were understanding and reassuring immediately helping us to rebook our tickets What truly impressed us was their effort to ensure that we could sit together on our new flight The staff worked diligently and communicated openly throughout the process making a stressful situation much more manageable Thanks to the remarkable support from the team we were able to travel together without further issues I cant express enough gratitude for their exceptional service It truly made a difference in our travel experience Highly recommend this airline for their commitment to customer care

This is a wonderful airport Staff providing good services to pick up luggage when arriving It has a good transportation centre with taxis bus routes to downtown and shuttle buses to other cities near Wenzhou Many shops in the airport selling products with affordable prices Wifi is fast This airport is expanding to have another much larger terminal by

My stay was in A Coruna and I got a Monbus coach to the airport Theres only a couple a day and there was just other passenger on board The journey took around minutes and was very comfortable Currently the airport isnt very busy Id checked in beforehand for my Ryanair flight to EDI and getting through security was straightforward with no queue The airport is relatively small but clean and modern I was impressed Airside much the same For an airport this side the facilities were pretty much what I expected I had lounge access and this was a cut above with efficient and friendly staff and a very good selection of food and drink The location was excellent wit good views over the southerly gates and runway

There was hardly any delay just minutes The plane was old but reasonably clean Staff were friendly I could buy a good sparkling white wine The flight was safe and uneventful So bring your own noise cancelling headphone and enjoy a decent flight at low cost

A huge airport with multiple terminals and layers thereby distances are big Large lifts and automated people movers do help a lot Border control was fast and efficient they hand out a sim card for free on arrival Security was efficiently organized too Staff is mostly friendly and helpful Transport to town can be by metro busses or taxi It easily takes hour or more

Nauru to Brisbane via Honiara I have flown with Nauru Airlines numerous times They are one of the best international airlines I have flown with Qantas Emirates Singapore Airlines Cathay Pacific Malaysian etc The cabin staff were very friendly and hospitable Ground staff are polite and efficient Nauru Airlines Cabin staff kept serving drinks time to time My special meal requests had been fulfilled and the meals were delicious Seats had decent leg room Toilets were clean Had a smooth take off and landing

Stavanger is a comfortable and bright regional airport Arrival is hasslefree with short walking distances and quick luggage delivery Departure is easy too with selfservice checkin machines Although I flew on a busy Sunday afternoon waiting time to clear security control did not exceed mins However the departure lounge clearly lacks seating areas An airport bus connects the airport with the city centre every mins note that it only accepts cash and no credit cards
I had special assistance booked here The check in staff were incredibly kind and helpful and the assistance staff were fantastic Could not fault my experience

Faleolo airport in Apia Samoa is a small airport We found immigration customs etc very quick and efficient as well as baggage handling At the moment the airport is not really pretty to look at but a new terminal is being built which should be spectacular when completed Its really refreshing to be able to walk through the airport on arrival departure and not be forced to navigate through a giant shopping mall like at Sydney The airport has done duty free shops which you are free to go into or not go into rather than having to go through them to get in out of passport control a few small food shops reasonably priced and a bar Parking is Samoan Tala Staff at the airport are friendly welcoming and helpful The only negative side is that there is no air conditioning outside the security areas and check in is a bit uncomfortable when its humid

Not a lot to say really as the Mandarin Airlines flight from Hong Kong to Taichung was only about an hour It was a pleasant experience though nice staff clean plane and comfortable Just a snack for refreshments nothing to complain about would be happy to fly with them any time

Fortaleza Praia February The flight was operated in a reasonable B by no means new but not as rickety as I had been led to believe The seating was alleconomy and the leather seats fine but slippery Seat pitch was OK and I am a tall chap certainly an inch or more greater than its competitors The flight departed minutes late at and due to the hour I declined the meal offered which looked bland but edible We arrived in Praia on schedule and my bags did the same connecting to Sal and Mindelo without delay All in all a reasonable experience

Airport Facility Check in staff service Staff was not really friendly Lounge the airport Lounge not airBaltic In this Lounge you can find some light snacks and beverages but the price of entry is not worth it Seat comfort Seats were good for Economy on domestic European flights Seat pitch A bit more than enough Legroom A bit more than on the vast majority of European flights Cabin safety videoinfo they have video displayed on screens above passengers seats Comfort items almost do not exist Cleanliness Its usually clean on airBaltic flights Lavatory cleanliness it was clean Selection of meals preorder the passenger has a lot of options Selection of drinks onboard a wide selection several seasonal drinks are available Selection of snacks onboard different snacks are available and light meals are available Good quality Food a bit overpriced Only one magazine but it is mostly advertisement WiFi was not available on that flight This airline is good for flights up to hours Ticket prices are not high so if person needs to get from point A to point B airBaltic would be a good option

The airport is functional and adequate for a shortish stay But it is unbelievably expensive There is a simple measure for this Terminal Heathrow The Perfectionists Cafe Heston Blumenthal proud holder of a few Michelin stars food delivered by friendly waiter etc Burger San Jose airport Smashburger fast food burger in plastic tray And sadly that sums up too many experiences in Costa Rica I spend a lot of time here and the feeling that everything is horribly overpriced just grows and grows The airport is a good example of that feeling they are abusing their visitors

Atyrau to Uralsk I had a few meetings to attend in Uralsk and Aksai and was not looking forward to the hour or more arduous taxi journey from Atyrau to Uralsk in C heat I was recommend to use Qazaq Air as they now have a direct flight from Atyrau to Uralsk I booked a return flight online selected a seat paid via card and my eticket was immediately emailed On arrival to the airport checkin is simple and efficient The flight was serviced by a Bombardier Dash Next Gen aircraft which was very clean and the aircrew well dressed and welcoming The flight h m was very good with a surprisingly powerful takeoff and flight landing mins earlier than scheduled I certainly was impressed with the overall service and the value for money I will be using Qazaq air again for direct flights around west Kazakhstan

Duesseldorf Timisoara return This airline has been a pleasant surprise The Saab was comfortable seats very good and legspace excellent Food on board was among the best Ive seen The return from Timisoara was operated by an Air Nostrum CRJ Checkin counter at Timisoara opened only minutes before scheduled departure but checkin smooth Cabin crew was Carpatair staff and they deserve a compliment On both flights they were friendly helpful and competent

I read terrible reviews and I was a bit concerned before boarding todays flight July at However we had a great experience The A was just fine and the service was impeccable They did not speak Swedish but that was not an issue The one hour flight was excellent and the Captain calm and absolutely no issues No inflight entertainment but it was just an hour flight We were min late taking off from Stockholm Arlanda but we were on time coming into Lulea Kallax We loved the service and that the two attendants in the front was always smiling and very accommodating Loved the fact that the staff and pilots greeted us as we left the plane

As living in the north of The Netherlands Bremen airport is a good alternative for Amsterdam Recently flown from the new low cost Ryanair terminal Its basic clean and blue There is a multipurpose shop which sells everything from a to z at somewhat inflated prices and small coffee shop Seating is mostly in plastic chairs which you could find at your local dentist Reasonable but we had an early flight so it was not so crowded Would not like to be there when its get full There are also some paid internet terminals The airport is well situated from the city center and freeway from the parking garage you are within minutes in the main terminal building Bremen is still a great small airport but they need to get some other low cost airlines on board besides Ryanair

Economy class SVOIST BER RegRA First of let me start by sharing the details I paid around for the ticket and it granted me cabin baggage and bag for the under seat i bought additional checked bag of kg max for around Seat selections were cheaper for the middle and more expensive for the window I paid for AYou could chose your meal before without any cost latest hours prior to the flight there was a lot of options but I chose not to chose and eat the standard meal given on the flight It was the best flight i have ever had Crew was super helpful greeted us at the beginning were helping some passengers to put their luggage in the overhead bins Blankets were handed when requested The seats were comfortable had plenty of legroom my recommendation for the view is A or K because it will have two windows Safety instructions were given as normal and we rocketed out of SVO Moscow During the meal service turbulence occured and they had to stop it several times in the we got our food they had choices for the breakfast I opted for an omlet it was very good served with a small salad salami butter jam croissant and a bar of chocolate with and aeroflot a picture on its packaging whereas there was also Russian pancake blincikhi with raspberry available and a msli kind of option Because of the turbulence only cold drinks were served during that period but hot drinks were available with a request this was announced several times by the crew There was meal service and service of drinks Lavatories were clean nothing special Inflight Entertainment was OK and they were also an Aeroflot magazine and a duty free catalogue We departed Minutes late from scheduled arrived Minutes early Crew made sure everyone had a nice flight They saw us off as wishing the best and hoping meet again in future I can surely say that they were happy with us being on that plane they were doing their job amazing Thanks for the flight Aeroflot hope to meet again

Ive flown in and out of Pau several times Its a lovely airport with a pleasant smallness about it The only downside for me is that from the UK it is only served by Ryanair On principle I will no longer fly with them If any other UK carrier starts using Pau I will happily fly there again

Cochabamba is a very small international airport some flights of Boliviano de Aviacion arrive from Buenos Aires Sao Paulo and seaonsally to Madrid It has enough space for the flights and people who use this terminal One of the most interesting things about this airport is its food court has plenty of choices and types of food and best of all if you are traveling on low budget there is a public transport service that will take you straight to town for almost nothing cents If traveling for tourism or business there is no other choice to get to the center of Bolivia Wifi runs great and its totally free

Returning from my honeymoon to Mexico we flew via Qantas business on the way there and now our return trip is with Fiji Airways We have just finished the first leg and Im writing this while enjoying the Nadi business class lounge The flight was amazing I had my reservations because Im aware Fiji airways doesnt provide pyjamas and their menu and offerings are a little more restrictive than that of Qantas but I felt compelled to write a review because of just how great Fiji Airways were The cabin crew were the most attentive I have ever experienced and they memorize everyones names Even when youre not in your seat walking to get a snack or to go to the bathroom they were calling me by name asking me how my flight is and if I want a snack Comparatively on my Qantas business class flight the cabin crew dont speak to you unless they have to The seats were comfortable and felt nice and private When I went to make my bed crew ran to me to do it for me The pillow is nice and full they give you a mattress cover for your seat and a nice full doona as well as a blanket They served Mumm on board as the champagne which is a personal fav so that gets extra marks The food was not as good as Qantas But it was not bad I enjoyed the pumpkin and ginger soup a lot Was probably the highlight of the meal As my main I opted for the Fijian bbq chicken The potato rostis were a little mealie the chicken was flavorful although a little tough The passionfruit mousse was alright but nothing to ring home about The fruit plate had a nice selection of grapes blackberries raspberries pineapple rockmelon and honeydew I also opted for the standard brekky which consisted of an omelette tomato a chicken sausage Im not a breakfast person but it was ok Another comparison to Qantas no barista style coffee on board So I had to settle for an American style coffee which Im not a big fan of The entertainment system is really functional but needs a bigger selection of new movies Wasnt a whole lot on there that I was too keen to watch but I made do Overall the flight was really comfortable and I would definitely fly and recommend Fiji Airways The attentiveness and kindness of the crew really made the flight

Took the tourist flights around Myanmar all flights departed and arrived ahead of schedule Planes clean with good leg room friendly and efficient cabin crew On the longer flights a very pleasant snack was served and the best cup of airline coffee I have had in almost years of air travel plus a choice of juice on the small flights

Moscow to Thessaloniki I usually use this company in my trips to Moscow Even if i was wondering about this new company that they use leasing airplanes i tried it and i want to say just one thing these are our lovely Greeks Every trip is small party specially when the destination is a Greek airport People are drinking free alcohol Greek wine they are eating and are enjoying their trip Staff is very goodThey use more than languages

This airport is probably one of the best I have been to Every employee I encountered was friendly and eager to help The airport itself was clean and efficient I flew in and out of this airport at busy times of the week and did not experience any problems When I landed I went through baggage claim quickly and was waiting for my friend in a matter of minutes When I was flying out I had the same experience I said goodbye to my friend and five minutes later I was at the gate What a pleasure compared to flying out of Orlando and there is free wifi

Had an excellent experience travelling through Dublin airport to Miami The security was efficient We precleared US customs and immigration which took minutes saving us from having to do it through Miami There was a good choice of food and drink but very limited once you enter the US zone

The airport has definitely improved and it looks a lot more modern than it used to be before They have a decent dutyfree shop with a good selection of items I really liked the sports bar that they had there which was also showing the Fifa World Cup games live and the food was good too The airport staff is very friendly and welcoming and there are also stalls where you can get a massage There is also enough seating if you are traveling in transit

Flew out of EMA on the to CFU on an afternoon flight Pre booked short stay car park online entrance and exit worked without problem via number plate recognition Short walk to departures and through luggage drop off with minimal delay Security was very quick and staff friendly Used the escape lounge whilst waiting for boarding and this was very relaxing and the staff were friendly and working hard to keep the food topped up a very good experience Boarding went smoothly and flight away only minutes behind schedule On return on the flight landed minutes ahead of schedule deplaned quickly and through passport control via Egates with no delay Baggage already available to collect by the time we entered the collection area and straight out to the car So all in all another very positive experience at EMA

On arrival Very long queue for passport control over an hour They have plenty of staff but processing time per person is simply very long On departure queues were fine We were told to arrive hours in advance which meant waiting doing nothing for a long time There are no restaurants after security just a few fast food options Also WiFi only works if you can receive an OTP by text ie you already have data Clean and pleasant but some of the details could be thought through a bit more

We arrived late at night nearly midnight so were exhausted We went through passport control reasonably quickly and the baggage reclaim was also very smooth Very modern airport and due to less passenger traffic very efficient Taxi to railway station was done in under minutes Very clean toilets included which is often a rarity Overall I would have to say I prefer Zhulyany over Borispol which I have been flying through for years due to its better connections to the city Though in London it is not very convenient as Wizz Air fly from Luton

My flight had been delayed so I arrived later at the airport however checkin had closed as checkin times had not been amended The security team were really helpful in scanning my bike box and ensuring it got to the gate to be loaded on the plane The team were very friendly and supportive with a great result Thanks
A very nice small airport with all that is needed except a coffee shop if I remember correctly Access is easy and clear the terminal clean and there is free parking

I flew on Ravn Alaska with my girlfriend back in February We flew from Anchorage to Homer and back with ease The flight was brief and enjoyable The staff were friendly and welcoming Checkin a breeze Boarding a breeze Baggage pickup a breeze The overall experience was fantastic Looking forward to flying with Ravn again and taking in those unforgettable Alaska sights

Almost everything I saw in New Zealand is well organized Auckland Airport is the exception We waited minutes to get through international departures due to long lines for boarding pass scanning passport co tell and security there were only lanes open for the latter plus one for premium passengers Really not up to spec if Auckland wants to be an international hub

This airport is improving In recent days they had added more space and departure gates also arrival area and baggage belt Security checks is most of the time relatively smooth not so long queue clean toilets Need to improve food options and also lounge experience

CHA has the misfortune of being too close to Atlanta Over half of Chattanooga flyers drive to Atlanta or Nashville or Birmingham to fly However CHA offers competitive fares and I would guess most flights now are regional jet The airport itself is beautiful with a large copper dome as the facilitys trademark in honor of the citys railroad heritage CHA is a modern stateoftheart airport and is where I choose to fly out of even though I live in the northern Atlanta burbs

I simply love Norwegian Its a no nonsense airline that has been incredibly reliable on of the legs that I have recently flown with them Seat pitch is sufficient pricing is fair and predictable and everything just works The service is fine and the onboard menu contains all you need for a few hours in the air I regard them much higher than most old airlines now saying this as a Lufthansa Senator

Dulles Airport is located in Virginia and bit far from Washington DC Very large and wellmaintained airport very clean Few sitting places Immigration process takes long time Boarding bridge works as bus to the airport terminal Taxi and bus services are there

You often have to wait on a remote parking slot for buses to arrive flights have narrow time windows to land or take off which leads to delays both at the origin and destination Can definitely be better managed Geneva airport model would suit it perfectly It is extremely central and convenient You almost arrive on the historic zone of Lisbon

I flew with Boliviana de Aviacin from Cochabamba to Madrid with my wife and two children We flew on a B for the first shorthaul flight from Cochabamba to Santa Cruz and then on a A from Santa Cruz to Madrid Very friendly service on board Personal screens on each seat for the long flight They could make some progress on the food tthey serve though This being said we had two full meals dinner and breakfast unlike other airlines who only offer one free meal for the same hour flight Santa CruzMadrid We arrived to Madrid on time All in all a very pleasant experience with BoA

The more I travel the more I appreciate Port Moresbys Jacksons International Airport Whilst the speed at checkin is dependent on the systems sometimes it takes longer but usually its quite fast its always a breeze moving through this terminal from checkin to security to immigration and into the departure lounge The lounge itself has great seating with good food options and drink options as well as shopping POM isnt Changi but then again Changi is matchless

I traveled with people from NYC We entered the airport and had no problems coming in Pretty fast service with immigration and getting our bags Outside was rather chaotic Too many men standing around to carry bags They should control them better maybe like cabs take turns as requested On the way out we found the airport entrance very clear Our bus pulled up and emptied better than it could in JFK It was comforting to see the UN security team right outside The building was well air conditioned which was great The ticketing area was easily accessible We found that there was a ton of security checks not sure why as it seemed to be for baggage mostly We had our IDs checked times and our bags screened twice We were told at the ticket area that once inside there were no rest rooms That was not completely true There is a rest room area inside TSA but before the final jetBlue secure gate area baggage screening Also the signs for the duty free shop inside could have been betterhigher to see Overall it was not horrible but just a little cramped in feeling and the double check of the bags while offering a feeling of security sent red flags up as to why they were doing that It seemed like a jetBlue thing as Spirit did not do that Also the place was clean

Airport was new and very nice Immigration friendly and welcoming Nice first impression on Egypt upon arrival Washroom need to be cleaned regularly though Other than that its a very nice airport for travellers to Alexandria

Efficient and helpful service from reservations to ground staff and cabin crew You feel like you matter as a customer and are very accommodating with any changes Food and Beverage selection on domestic route is fantastic nice to have that surprise option Would I fly again of course yes Well done Thai smile airways staff and crew

The flight was a bit late departing from Gaya but I wondered if we would even fly given the dense fog The flight was beautiful scenic in a half empty cabin with cleanest and beautiful interior The crew distributed snacks and drinks quickly and we could enjoy our view Everything was really nice and their flight magazine is informative of the country and sites A really beautiful experience

The Papeete airport PPT has to be experienced to appreciate how fortunate we are to have competent wellrun modern airports throughout the world Its not third world Worse It is an astounding perfect storm of incredibly slow TSA total indifference indecipherable in so far as where to go how to get there The one happy experience we had was the people the airport service employees Im in a wheelchair they were friendly helpful and made up a little for the amateurish functioning of PPT Our larger issue was United Airlines They cancelled our return flight at am hours after departure timeand immediately a wheel chair attendant showed up to deliver us to two of a few hundred cotsno blanket pillow waterin a warehouse near the airport I looked at a picture of a prison cell and the bed was superior to what United provided for us We never saw a United person in the multihour process Never again will we fly United OR go through through the Papeete airport PPT

Johannesburg to St Denis Service like it was years ago professional attentive amenity kit handed out on a hour flight and the quality and quantity of the catering Ive not seen for years Thoroughly recommended

The TSA crew at this airport are notoriously overwrought I was a TSA precheck customer with a carry on bag It contained a sewing machine which had to be nitrite screened These folks for all the years Ive been traveling there to visit my daughter make the most of their authority Its become a source of jest as it appears they need to justify their existence by overdoing the job to the point of inconsequential increments Where is the common sense The rest of the airport is a nice place The remodel is excellent The airline crews are friendly and helpful Could we please calm down the TSA crew

ADD YOUR COMMENTS Very pleasant and open design Arrival was easy and there was absolutely no hassle once we cleared the secure baggage area Marked taxis were available outside Check in was conducted in a secure area which you cannot leave once you enter so ensure you are not hungry because nothing other than a small cafe and some duty free stores are available on the gate side Compared to other airports in the region this one is very good

Palonegro to Cucuta with Easyfly Was put on this flight after Satena cancelled one of the legs I was hesitant since I had to make it to CUC that day The JS are quite small yet efficient planes Easyfly ground staff at Palonegro was quite helpful and professional Flight was smooth and punctual No complaints at all Despite the short duration of the flight minutes refreshments were offered Would consider it if needed

Like many airports food and drinks are much too expensive I do therefore I also do not want to buy water It is not allowed to take bottled water through customs so most airports have free tap drinking water Also this airport But they are all disconnected I find this outrageous To have access to drinking water is a right

Yangon to Nyaung My wife and me flew three routes with Air KBZ over our holiday in Myanmar and we got outstanding service every time The cabin crew all have excellent presentation and are very courteous and attentive We had a cold snack tea and coffee all of which were very tasty on all flights Its unusual to be given cream cakes at am but they were very nice All aircraft used were very clean and in good condition and all flights departed and arrived exactly on time Air KBZ is way better than we expected

I had travelled from LHR to Muscat and had a day tour in Muscat The lounge at Muscat was amazing and staff were attentive Boarding to KUL there was clearly an issue as no welcome drink was served The cabin manager checked in and apologised once we got going Food plentiful entertainment was fine wifi poor The staff were aware I had an hour before my next flight and helped me disembark first Great airline

Very impressed with HiSky The trip from JFK and back from OTP was on par with major airlines we had entertainment and good food I loved the breakfast Romanian sausages crenwurst The flight attendants were pleasant and helpful flight was on time each way It would be useful if they partnered with United or a US airline to connect flights Right now its a hassle to connect into JFK on two tickets

Flew with Alitalia on both arrival and departure used jetbridge which was a plus It is compact and functional There is train service to city center Its quite convenient Security line moved quite efficiently during my Saturday morning departure The space is quite small on airside Seats are located at the gate where boarding passengers would walk pastline up while you wait Bari will need to expand the airport very soon

I had two flights with Atlantic Airways Flight Bergen Faroe Islands and Faroe Islands to Copenhagen one week later Both flights on time Comfortable seats clean aircraft good food friendly service I will flight with Atlantic Airways again with pleasure

BOSMKE I have flown to and from Mitchell countless times I grew up in Milwaukee and moved back here in June I agree with other reviewers that it is a clean friendly wellrun airport What stuck in my mind was how swiftly and well the baggage is handled I flew Southwest and sat fairly far forward in the cabin walked directly to the baggage claim area and by the time I arrived my baggage was already on the carousel This is something of a record in all of the flights I have experienced over the past few years at the other end is Copenhagen Kastrup in July where I waited close to minutes for the baggage to arrive with my own valise arriving some minutes later There is also a rapid bus to downtown with the stop now just outside the baggage claim area now that renovations of that area are completed There are also a couple of good Bartolotta restaurants on the concourses Piccolo Pizzeria and Nonna Bartolottas which I have enjoyed on previous departures All in all Mitchell is an excellent airport Now all they need is more nonstop flights

The airport is outside the capital and it could be a minute drive depending on the traffic Aesthetically its not the nicest facility and in some places it seems like a warehouse The security is really good and the immigration formalities for Iranians are fine Im not entirely sure how immigration is for non Iranians but I heard that its alright but they have their own line which could take them longer to clear immigration if the line is long The customs formalities are alright I never had any problems as a regular traveler there The toilet facilities are not so clean but there is almost always an attendant there cleaning the place and offering to watch your bags in return for a small tip The staff in general are pleasant enough The duty free isnt the best in the world but the prices are reasonable Good opportunity to buy some Iranian products as gifts for friends and family The eating options are pretty good with two open air cafes after passport control with deserts and sandwiches and beverages at reasonable prices Theres a decent fastfood restaurant in the international departure area and the prices are alright there too If you have a long transit there is a mosque at the departure terminal where you can prey relax and even take a nap Theres no public transportation to and from the airport so the only way to get there is by car A taxi to Tehran for Iranians is about USD I heard the business class lounge is good as well as the VIP terminal WiFi is basically non existent for passengers Enjoy your time in Iran

I had my period during the departure and didnt have sanitary paper with me My departure was from Terminal and after entering it there was no place where I could get it It is important that such things as sanitarny paper or diaper for babies are available to buy on an airport It should be available in the toilet or in one of the shops I had to ask several women which were also waiting for a plane whether they have sanitary paper It was uncomfortable I found sanitary paper cause one of the women had it but I could be less fortunate

Checkin would not accept passengers until hours before the flight despite the monitors advising us to do so Check in person was blunt and almost rude not acceptable we are the customers It isnt my fault she was talking quietly and I had to ask her to repeat every time Then security they take possession of my backpack and without comment put it on a unit away from me and left it there A couple of minutes later another security man came along and started swabbing the bag because I had lots of camera equipment inside The toilets in departures need a good refurbishment Otherwise a great little airport modern clean with duty free and so on

Have used this airport twice in the last year and found it very smooth From plane arriving at terminal only ten minutes to clear border control collect bags and exit airport Bus to Gothenburg outside terminal to meet each flight and in to city in about minutes quicker than from the main Gothenburg airport Adequate facilities in airport and an outside area airside for smokers to sit in the sun with a drink

The airport has basic facilities and I think it works when it has little traffic The staff are nice and friendly There are very limited options if you want to eat something at the airport After the security there are only two cafes without good meal options The seating at the gates is limited Most of the gates are located upstairs with limited space Considering the fact that passengers arrive and depart from the same gates they sometimes get very crowded

Honiara on the island of Guadalcanal is the capital of the Solomon Islands in the South West Pacific and the only international airport in the country The traffic flow into Solomon Islands is minimal about six or seven flights a week mainly filled with Australian government officials Asian businessmen and the odd tourist The terminal itself was built by the Japanese Government about It is not airconditioned and can be very warm and humid inside given that Honiara is in the middle of the tropics Due to water and plumbing problems the toilets can be unpleasant It is a good idea to check in two hours before hand as checkin queues can be long as departure time approaches Flights are often delayed but airport staff are unlikely to be able to tell you much one way of checking to see if your departure will be on time is to check the Brisbane Airport website to see if the flight left Brisbane for Honiara on time Customs and security is usually quick on departure but customs and immigration can be somewhat slower on arrival Forget duty free shopping on departure shop in Honiara town instead On arrival sometimes the duty free booth is open and if so it does offer good prices on alcohol All in all a hot humid experience which will not leave you feeling terribly comfortable On the plus side staff are usually helpful and cheerful and cleanliness has improved considerably over the last couple of years

American Airlines to Miami Check in was quick and smooth I had multiple segment flights on one booking Miami Madrid London Manchester and my luggage was checked all the way though to Manchester The check in opened at hours before flight and there was a priority lane for business class and One world status customers Although the general queue was small I was there at Outgoing passport control also very quick Security efficient shoes and belt off but iPad and electronics remained in my carry on There are lanes so this could get busy if travelling on the Air France or KLM widebody flights The departure area is still being rebuilt but it was pleasant non the less Large fans in the first upstairs seating area kept the place cool A couple of sandwich outlets including Dominoes I had a large Turkey and Cheese panini hot and a bottle of coke for Small duty free kiosks as well Down a ramp to the gate area a lot of seating and not crowded despite the KLM flight waiting as well as my AA There a large central bar area I didnt buy anything so cant comment on price Boarding about mins before departure If you are travelling with hand luggage and have not had to check in make sure the gate agents check your passport before attempting to board We walked along the apron passed the KLM A to our plane boarding front and rear Boarding completed well before departure time Left early unfortunately we took off towards the sea so we didnt see the tourists on Maho beach preparing to get sand blasted Overall a great experience much better that I envisaged

Excellent airport clean spacious excellent traveler services quick luggage check and very friendly staff easyaccess panoramic terrace with degree view of departures and arrivals restaurants and shops with normal prices are positioning several lowcost airlines and it is the base of AirAsia Japan I hope it will increase international connections and always maintain this trend having for several years won the best regional airport in the world

The flight was about one hour and yet the flight attendants managed to hand out refresher towels then they gave each passenger a snack box and on the the third service round each passenger was given a drink All this was done unhurried with poise and a smile Such an unexpected level of star service In addition boarding was ontime flight departed and arrived on time What a great airline

The flight from Kiev to Tel Aviv was delayed by about an hour and a half You can print your boarding pass at a selfserve counter in Kiev which is nice if you dont have access to a printer the queue for check in is long because of the extra security The security personnel were very friendly and professional The aircraft was clean I got a salad which was tasty and inexpensive Legroom is very tight my knees were touching the seat in front of me The crew were friendly and proactive with customer service but lacking when it came to safety and controlling passengers During the safety check they ignored a man talking on his phone as we taxied On landing in TLV many people started running down the aisle and opening the lockers while we were still braking on the runway The crew didnt say anything for a few minutes which only encouraged it Even when they did make an announcement it was ignored and they took no further action I would avoid flying them again particularly on this route where fares are cheap anyway on the way to Kiev I flew with Aegean for only a slighter higher fare and they were excellent

Despite a delay of about minutes overall it was a good flight Check in was easy the flight attendants were friendly and efficient and the plane was clean and comfortable The only free beverage was water which was no issue on such a short flight

Orlando to Manchester with Thomas Cook Airlines A low cost airline which provided a really good experience especially given the very low price of the ticket The flight departed one hour late but caught up and arrived on time Food was really good The entertainment was limited only a few movies but good Excellent flight for a cheap price

The airport itself is nice as others have commented I travel through here about once a month and the new terminal is very comfortable and pleasant However the local security is capricious at best They seem to give security agents very little guidance but a huge amount of leeway I have had toothpaste confiscated no pastes they said a bar of soap no soaps they said and the list goes on and on I am all for reasonable and tight security but it seems like every trip I have a random item confiscated And it is not just me I see it happen to others all the time too

My favourite airport Fast efficient and very pleasant Easy to get to easy to navigate checkin and security is always fast and friendly and the lounge above Security is great Extremely roomy and classy great for work or relaxation even offers open smokers cabins that dont feel like a cage and a chess game for those with plenty of time Almost everywhere in the airport can you overlook the runway and the whole place is just modern roomy and open The airport size is an advantage without doubt the distances between parking checkin security lounge gate and flight are minimal so getting in and out is always a pleasure Much better than Copenhagen in almost all aspects

Basically a well designed terminal that requires upgrading Immigration and visa on arrival procedures are quick as foreign passport holders go to separate counters both for arrival and departure Luggage delivery is fast but then you will have to queue for at least minutes as every piece of luggage has to go through the only screening machine in the customs hall No taxi or airport shuttle is available and you will have to rely on touts or on military staff very friendly to help you find a vehicle to take you to town unless you have prearranged transport with your hotel Departure hall is not airconditionned and was infested by mosquitoes out of duty free shops were closed and the single airline lounge has been closed for a long time One positive point all areas including toilets are kept very clean

Was a very pleasant flight the crew was very helpful at all times I was an unaccompanied minor and throughout the journey the crew helped me with all the procedures the flight was very comfortable Would definitely use Ethiopian Airlines whenever Im traveling and would recommend it to friends and family Most of all Ms Leli was the best

Its mainly a domestic airport Internal sign and direction system is clear and well arranged Immigration check procedure is efficient The Japanese officers are well organized Public transportation from Komatsu airport to city downtown only relies shuttle bus The schedule is not frequent The time interval is often more than one hour

Interesting experience This airport is very close to the city mainly for domestic flights and is extremely busy However even though really crowded all queues seem to move very quickly A reasonable mix of retail outlets and I thought the prices were OK Plenty on taxis on return there are prepay ones but for journeys into the city a metered cab is fine

Berlin to Paris Flight on time clean and modern plane It was impossible to buy any drinks due to an issue with their visa machine The crew was ok but they could smile a bit more At Orly airport we had to disembark by bus which took minutes to finally be at the south terminal

The toilets are the cleanest I have seen Im years The customs was quick and efficient I travel every year to Curaao and was a pleasure to see that they are much better than Schiphol Las Americas American airports European airports

Beijing to Macau Air Macau is the only one carrier operating daily flights from Beijing to Macau The aircraft they use on this route is A The flight attendants can speak English well but the service do not have any shining spot Dinner is provided on this flight which tastes not too bad Although the plane delayed for min to get airborne due to traffic of Beijing Airport the flight made landing min earlier than estimated which surprised me

Wonderful regional airline from Luebeck I had a chance to try this airline and the experience was quite comfortable Boarding procedure is in order and each passenger must disinfect hands The legspace is good and cabin is simple yet neat The crew were happy to engage with passengers and the best part was that they serve a small meal on each flight I really appreciate that and the meal was simple yet very tasty and filling You can even book a veggie meal while booking flight Beyond what LH can even offer on regional flights While deboarding they served caramel candies This experience with Lbeck Air took me back to old school days which I miss terribly in aviation world Keep up the standards and service because this will set you apart

I had arrived two weeks ago had cruises then returned to airport for return to UK Plane had a technical fault so going nowhere for hrs The check in immigration security shop staff cleaners handling agents were brilliant So helpful and cheerful food pretty good as well All in all an experience that they helped to make easier and I appreciate that very much thank you Grantley Adams Airport Barbados

This was my first flight with Starlux and was most impressed Checkin was quick and easy The plane is new quiet spacious and spotlessly clean featuring a large screen with many entertainment choices The flight left a few minutes late from Terminal One which was recently renovated and quite comfortable The onboard service was caring and professional My two oriental veg meals were somewhat bland but were generous and wellprepared

Taupo is a tiny regional airport servicing the central North Island of New Zealand When I say tiny I mean tiny arrivals departures check in security lounge and facilities are all in one room Its serviced by the regional arm of Air New Zealand and is a a great option for getting into the Heart of Lords of the Rings country Theres rarely any queuing the staff are very friendly helpful and polite Bags are delivered just a few minutes after stepping off the plane Food and drink options are limited Theres a cafe but it seems to closed more often than open
Flew Tokyo Narita Sapporo Tokyo Narita Flight from Narita was on time while from Sapporo to Narita was delayed for hour Overall flight was ok Ground staff very professional

Coxs Bazar to Dhaka with USBangla Airlines The checkin process was smooth The plane arrived exactly on time But had to refuel for mins We were on a full family trip The staff was friendly and helpful The seats were a bit tight and narrow Food was average Landing was smooth We got our baggage in time I dont know about others but my experience was satisfactory

Since my last review Karlsruhe airport has improved beyond expectations Regular flights to more destinations and vastly improved bus services to Baden and Rastatt Eating and shopping facilities need to be improved especially on Sundays when the duty free shop and gate one bar are generally closed

The Embraer continues to be a gamechanger for the American Airlines Group especially on shorthaul routes like the minute flight from Washington Reagan National DCA to Philadelphia PHL Despite the brief duration and some turbulence the crew efficiently completed firstclass service while maintaining a friendly and professional demeanor The firstclass seat provided more than enough comfort for the journey reinforcing the Es reputation as an excellent aircraft for regional operations Given Republic Airways strong performance American Airlines should seriously consider adding Republic to its wholly owned subsidiaries

Excellent service very good meals and plenty of fresh coffee I have flown EVA several times in the past but this trip was the best and most efficient by far far better than that so called new luxury carrier from Taiwan that I used in EVAs flight attendants are very professional and interact with passengers with a big smile and speedy service best in the industry

Airport was new and very nice Immigration friendly and welcoming Nice first impression on Egypt upon arrival Washroom need to be cleaned regularly though Other than that its a very nice airport for travellers to Alexandria

Facing similar difficulties in redeeming miles as mentioned in our recent BKKKIX review we had to additionally pay for possible unusable future miles for this route class We were contacted at least thrice for seat changes to end up with this aircraft The aircraft has seat configuration seats A G K The seat seems narrow storage space is limited fully reclined bed is possible but youd need to rise up to use this feature Although the A seat is a window seat but your feet always point to the aisle and some seats may not be able to see out of the window The G K seats are worse since both have feet pointed to the opposite and face each other Thus no privacy is assured as hypothesised The IFE has no map features only elapsed times are available aircrew couldnt get the map features for me Honestly we notice that service quality varies depending upon who youre ROPStar Alliance status ages familiarity with crew etc This flight was over booked and some were offered to downgrade to PE with USD compensation experiencing what just described we regret that we didnt take that offer As THAI loyal customers wed suggest the airline to consider our comments to improve its quality to be competitive with other Star Alliance carriers in the similar routes which we had rated all of them as excellent

Good transport connection via BAB Moderate parkingrates close to the terminals CheckIn only minutes prior to departure Short distances More than daily flights major Star Alliance hubs MUC and FRA and direct flights to holiday destinations Daily lowcost flights to London STN Vienna Rome FMO is a good choice for travellers in northern NRW western Niedersachsen and eastern Holland who want to start their journeys business travel as welll as holiday travel relaxed and in a friendly atmosphere
Chiang Mai to Yangon return and pleasantly surprised by the standard fairly new aircraft and meal service for minute flight Flight attendants were somewhat offhand Reasonable leg room in economy

Good experience flying Finnair Tallinn to London via Helsinki No need for security as transfer flight helpful staff everywhere and for big airport very spacious Loved MOOMIN COFFEE and no queue or questions at border control after I was interrogated at Riga Airport due to long stays on my British Passport Loved Finnair too would fly again from Helsinki with this airline

Completely pleasant airport Small very clean shopcaferestaurantprices much lower than in Borispol Easily accessible from center by taxi or trolleybus just plan enough time in traffic peaks of Kyiv and Close to very recommendable planemuseum in pedestrian distancemaybe mins to walk Customs working attentively but very polite Immigration takes usually more time mins in average than emigration but much more quickly than in Borispol The same about security Free wifi works properly and fast Have no post office in terminal but one across parking lot located left direction of entrance behind the power plant of the airport

Frank Pais International Airport at Hologuin has two terminals one modern deals with international charter and scheduled services and the other older deals with flights to and from Havana My comments relate to the older national terminal The tone is set when passengers see the huge portrait of former President Fidel Castro on the airport terminal plus the slogan on the perimeter wall Socialism or Death This sets the tone for what is usually a pleasant visit to the city of Holguin Incoming passengers walk to the terminal where an excellently designed baggage conveyor promptly brings the luggage to be reclaimed The design of this conveyor requiring passengers simply to reach their suitcases off the belt is in contrast to those at much newer larger UK airports On arrival for your return flight check in is swift and simple and the waiting lounge has somewhat noisy Cuban TV playing loud music all the time

Noumea to Tokyo in economy and it was a good experience for a hrs flight The crew was warm and welcoming The seat was comfortable with a lot of space for my legs and the entertainment system was complete However the A cabin looked quiet old but these aircraft have to be replaced by mid The food was correct but not exceptional Overall it was an appreciable flight

Entire flight was smooth however boarding time was a little confusing and the assigned gate they suddenly changed it so it caused more confusion I ordered prebook meal it tasted good but the food itself was somehow cold For me airlines baggage policy was highly favorable as I was able to check in kilos regardless of number of luggage

Richmond International is a new stylish and perfect sized airport on the outskirts of Richmond major air carriers serve RIC flying to over domestic and international destinations in the USA and Canada The airport is mediumsized and easy to find your way around The security lines are short and hasslefree The airport atrium has a large glass roof giving the airport interior a very open feel A restaurant in the atrium has a large window with a full view of the apron for all the plane spotters Travel into and out of RIC is always hasslefree and fun

I found the airport to be more than adequate We were there in July and it was busy but check in was OK as was security The waiting area is small and there are not enough catering facilities but the roof top terrace was brilliant it was a pleasure to wait for the plane for once and you can have a cigarette in peace The toilets were clean and tidy wastebins emptied frequently so all in all not a bad airport have certainly spent time in much worse

Good small airport for a short transit Not as big as NRT which makes it not as daunting Small shopping selection but pretty good food Efficient staff and quick security measures makes transit quite painless
Very decent airline Crew very friendly although their English command could be better The cheese sandwich is fantastic

Very small airport but there still are jet bridges which was surprising Everyone I met was so friendly and welcoming The bags were out very quickly Just remember to arrange the transport before arrival

Beijing to Weihai with Shandong Airlines Comfortable clean and modern plane with ample leg room far more generous than Etihad and the other premium airlines I have experienced Some delay due to air traffic congestion however bags promptly delivered on arrival Water provided by friendly and attentive crew for the short flight

Transiting in Dakar airport from Cape Verde to New York Bussed in from the plane waited for a while at the space marked Transit until someone arrived with some prodding Then he said I shouldnt go through there as I had a European passport I should faire le tour meaning go through immigration Anyway he let us in and then someone came to the transfer desk but said No we cant do this here you have to faire le tour So luckily have a UK passport so didnt need visa I filled out the entry form queued up went through immigration and past baggage claim then found a queue to get into the checkin area and a monster crowd around the checkin desks Happily as I was in business class and had no bags to check and was anyway on transfer they let me bypass the queues to check in and then bypass most of the amazing queues for immigration to leave Senegal again But it still took an astonishing minutes from getting off the bus to arriving back in the departure gate and got to the really comfortable businessclass lounge

I had just gotten to Khartoum from Dubai and I really had to use the washroom I went to the mens washroom and man oh man It smelled like people went there and forgot to flush I didnt use the washroom I ran back to my father because there was faeces on the floor of the toilet as well Outside I saw a janitor sitting in his chair comfortably and as I do not know how to speak Arabic I just decided to hold it instead of telling someone to clean up Other than this the airport was alright but not even close to ideal A month later my mother came via the same flight and airport and she had to wait hours at the luggage belt for her luggage to arrive

I flew from Prague to Rome Ciampino on Ryanair I prefer using public transport Metro the very comfortable Trolleybus combo especially during rush hours The AE airport express is risky using very busy roads Both Terminals are modern easy to navigate and especially love the large supermarket charging regular prices with fresh pastry bread and fresh fruits The mornings are busy with many flights departing but security in T was very fast I had no luggage to dropoff this time The air side is getting better with various shops and eateries I still think the gates and corridors Gates C are a bit bland with more seating needed but thats just a personal taste I rarely had any negative experiences flying from or to Prague with arrivals equally easy I appreciate the Uber reservation kiosks with clear instructions for those taking a car to the city My only big criticism is that I strongly advise against exchanging currency here due to lack of choice Some minor works on the exterior of T causing mininal disruption Looking forward to seeing the planned green transformation of the areas Infront of both terminals with greenery and trees on the surface traffic below

Dundee Airport provides a convenient link direct to London City Birmingham Belfast The airport is small and there are no shops There is a Costa coffee stall and the airport terminal is modern and comfortable I would recommend flying from Dundee Air France now provide the Dundee to London City route and Fly Woosh the Birmingham Belfast services My only gripe lies with the airlines themselves who do not seem to realise that if they lowered their weekend prices they could cash in on a lucrative leisure market which is put off by the high prices Dundee to London route is only worthwhile for leisure if booked way in advance and you can fly out with peak periods

For an African bush airline I have to hand it to Mack Air for having its act together I arrived in Maun Botswana from Cape Town and after clearing immigration walked to the Mack Air desk where I saw my name posted The staff promptly and courteously took me in tow gave me my boarding pass and took care of my luggage Shortly thereafter the staff escorted me to my plane which was a very presentable Cessna Grand Caravan The pilot and a few other passengers arrived and soon we were off to the air strip and safari lodge The procedure was very much the same following the stay at the lodge when I flew on to Kasane Botswana The plane was spotless the crew very good and safety briefings were properly handled And at Kasane Mack Airs folks were on hand to see that I connected with my onward ground handler As a pilot and as a former airline employee I can honestly give Mack Air a fine rating It is a good bush airline with all the trappings of larger carriers I would fly with them anytime

I took KE from HKG to ICN in July As I have already known that it was a top airline I had high expectations on it The ground service was very good The seat was quite wide and the cabin crew were very polite The food was average but not many movies to watch Although it was delayed for two hours I think the whole experience is worth the price

Yangon to Thandwe and pleasantly surprised by Air KBZ Snacks served onboard seats generally comfortable Organisational issues with boarding and a slight delay in departure from Yangon Check in at RGN was not very organised however once inside the departure terminal ground staff were more helpful They give you a coloured sticker to put on your shirt to ensure you get on the correct flight Would use again

DUD is a small but efficient airport with everything you need Landed from Wellington bags out very quickly The airport is quite far from city centre mins cost nearly dollars by Taxi and dollars by super shuttle Departure is well organised checkin sufficient airline lounge is located upstairs security check right before you board

Ive lived in El Paso for two years now for school and I often use the airport to visit my hometown as well as other destinations The busiest Ive ever seen the airport from the time of walking through the doors checking baggage going through security and getting to my gate was about minutes Christmas vacation time Ive even got through in minutes Its a smaller airport with only one terminal thats ever used and about gates so from security to walk to your gate takes maybe minutes This isnt one of the airports youll need to devote hours in order to get through it Id say hour is fine because you never know even if it does only take minutes to get to your gate and maybe during busy holiday times or if youre going to have to check the whole family might even be hours for that

The airport terminal was built from scratch beside the old building currently closed It has a huge skylight from end to end making good use of natural light that reaches all floors through an atrium Many sculptures are integrated in the project which gives it an interesting touch Facilities are good enough The local delicacies stores are surely to be visited Totally sets itself apart from most Brazilian airports whose problems usually begin at finding a parking spot and extend through all possible aspects up to the boarding ramps

Flew Air Nostrum from Madrid T to Ibiza Nice short flight on a sunny afternoon Fast dropoff baggage a gentle Iberia staff member helped us to print boardingpasses halfhour late boarding walked to the plane Comfortable seats very kind cabin crew Flight itself was great splendid manned by a Ladycaptain So we started our summer holiday relaxed One week after second leg Ibiza to Valencia mins flight on turboprop Bit cramped seats bit noisy but for a such a short time wasnt important Final approach was rather steep but landing was OK Both flight were on time less than mins late arrival uneventful luggage claimed fast and in good situation decent priced I will not hesitate to use Air Nostrum for Spanish domestic flights in the future

I arrived at T Terminal Hongqiao Used the Sky Priority Customer Service Lovely helpful staff who helped me with my oversized baggage I was stressed about it and the team helped me without a problem Then even showed me clearly were to go as well as showing me were Sky Priority Lounge was I couldnt be more grateful for their good service

Unprofessional but aircraft is new and clean They cancelled my flight replaced with one with stopover and to change it for a flight on the same day took me a lot of emails to do it New flight was on Lisbon to Sal via Praia they issued tickets to Lisbon to Praia then they corrected it and then my reservation was appearing on a different date Finally after a month of exchanging emails they got it right On their site there is web checkin but is not working They want physical checkin to make sure you preregistered to enter the country and paid euro to do it They have often delays but our flight was on time because aircraft arrived to Lisbon on time Plane BM was new and clean front rows have great legroom Crew was friendly There was no IFE but inflight service was good and sandwich was tasty

Lives up to its name no signs chaos rude airport staff overflowing rubbish bins of flight delayed and no aircon but great food Unless one wants to fly to Rome and drive not many options to visit Campania and it is worth visiting so just have to roll with it and accept it

Thank you so much for a wonderful service Nurit and her great teamstaff were professional attentive friendly and very helpful I was traveling with my mom and they made it easier for me and took care of her needs Id like to thank you all for being so nice and giving such a great service Youre awesome Arzo Diana Chen and special thanks to Mara In addition the food was great

Good arriving experience domestic Not too busy not long walk from aerobridge Baggage arrived fast wifi available but as most of the airport in India only if having Indian sim almost impossible for non Indian sim Washroom were ok should have better and cleaner Only one cafe at arrival not any other option No public bus from airport only option is auto or cab prepaid cab counter is there also UberOla

Shanghai to Tehran return July Direct flight to Tehran Economy class Aircraft A Fare was quite good Checkin fast Cabin crew showed Iranian hospitality No individual inflight entertainment but fairly speaking since the flight was at night One toilet closed for whole trip the other two were not clean and almost out of tissue Food was enough and fine for me Many drink options Flying time was less than hours on my way to Tehran and less than on the way back to Shanghai Considering all the above I will certainly choose this airline next time for my trip to Tehran
I was super impressed with this airline Highly recommend it for travel within Africa Im not sure what else to say Glad airlink is available now for travel in Africa
