Departed and arrived at Darwin on an international flight from Dili Timor Leste As we were the only flight out and then back in an Airnorth Embraer seating passengers we had the international part of the airport to ourselves Darwin Airport has been refurbished over the last couple of years and is now a midsized regional airport with good facilities There are two times of day around am to pm and pm to am when due to the peculiarities of Australian airport curfews down south Darwin Airport is very busy But it still copes Outside these hours it is quite relaxed with short queues I find the ground staff and even security to be polite efficient and even cheerful and there is an adequate range of food and shopping outlets Virgin and Qantas have good lounges in the domestic section of the airport there is a small paylounge once you have gone through passport controls and the usual nonsense of the obstacle course of an overpriced duty free shop blocking the way between immigration and the departure lounge On this occasion as previously from checking in to the departure lounge took about twenty minutes and a similar amount of time between landing and catching a taxi

Tontouta International Airport is located km outside of Noumea If you catch a cab to the airport be prepared to pay for a twoway journey as cabbies are not guaranteed a return fare back into town Theres no point turning up early for your flight The airport only operates when flights are due to arrivedepart Checkin counters the small souvenir shop and cafe dont open till minutes prior to scheduled departures Duty free shopping is only available airside which can only be accessed minutes prior to departure Surprisingly smoking is permitted in all parts of the terminal In summary Tontouta is a very basic facility offering very basic services On a more positive note all the airports ground staff were exceptionally friendly helpful and good natured including checkin agents security immigration and customs officials

This was the most amusing flight I have ever flown as I got to share some laughs with not only fellow passengers but with a hostess Anyway I was seated in row row was an exit row so I was invited to sit there since it was empty and was willingable to assist in case of an emergency Te leg room is excellent and I measure cm The staff were professional and courteous Bags came out quickly We were given water upon boarding then a chocolate bar then a croissant filled with chocolate sauce worth the calories and finally a small drink

The Papeete airport PPT has to be experienced to appreciate how fortunate we are to have competent wellrun modern airports throughout the world Its not third world Worse It is an astounding perfect storm of incredibly slow TSA total indifference indecipherable in so far as where to go how to get there The one happy experience we had was the people the airport service employees Im in a wheelchair they were friendly helpful and made up a little for the amateurish functioning of PPT Our larger issue was United Airlines They cancelled our return flight at am hours after departure timeand immediately a wheel chair attendant showed up to deliver us to two of a few hundred cotsno blanket pillow waterin a warehouse near the airport I looked at a picture of a prison cell and the bed was superior to what United provided for us We never saw a United person in the multihour process Never again will we fly United OR go through through the Papeete airport PPT

This airport is good but there is no wifi and check in desk is one There air two shops and one cafe The best thing is that there is an outdoor square and a fountain after passport control There are international gates The gates area is modern

Much nicer than the concrete block that was YWG open and bright Staff were friendly checkin a breeze and clearing security has never been a problem for me Despite being an International Airport it is small even if you have to walk the furthest distance Gates you can be out of the Airport in minutes if not waiting for checked baggage International travel out of YWG is quite limited so the International secure side is small MAYBE gates with just a couple Restaurants including the required Tim Hortons kiosk Others have complained of the lack of moving sidewalk but dont let that concern you as I said the longest walk is less than minutes from gate to exit so a moving sidewalk would actually be pointless While shopping and Restaurants are an improvement over the old Airport they are still very limited when compared to most other International Airports YWG serves its purpose but it wont wow you

A very small but easy to navigate airport It is small to the extent it could kind of be a bus station I arrived in Mexico through SLP but did not depart from this point thus my experience is based on arrivals only However I could see almost the entire airport anyway Upon arrival I was greeted with very friendly immigration officials I left my information documents that I was given to fill out enroute on the plane I didnt realise until I got the counter and went to hand them over The friendly official was extremely helpful and gave me replacements and helped me fill it in as I looked tired My bags arrived very quickly through the small carrousel and I was able to pick them up and move to a customs check point At this point you are randomly picked for checks I was picked however I was dealt with by another very friendly and helpful official who made me feel very welcome to Mexico Finally I took a taxi to my hotel Once out of the control area there is an area with information and helpers on hand to get you a well priced taxi or bus into town Overall a great little airport that punches well above its weight that could serve to much larger airports as an example of good customer service

I flew Ariana Afghan Airlines from Kabul to Delhi Timing was good but very crowded while boarding The flight was enjoyable but no entertainment Good and enough food provided Very friendly and helpful staff on the flight The ticket was very reasonable price

Nice little airport There is a kiosk selling food and drinks Terminal is open to the elements but seating is provided outside Just prior to boarding the friendly security staff check your belongings in a separate air conditioned building where you wait until boarding Buses wait outside the terminal to take you to the jetty for transfer by ferry to Thursday Island

Heho to Yangon Another very good flight same ATR aircraft no seat numbers given but all very easy boarding Plenty of space seating and inflight snacks given with coffee or Tea One member of crew not happy but not the end of the world At I had no problem with the seat space in fact better than many European airlines

I passed through Keflavik Airport September and October on my way from Helsinki to Toronto and back The airport does not deserve the negative reviews so often published on this site The transit terminal is crowded during peak hours with many incoming and outgoing flights between Europe and North America but you manage to transfer within an hour which often is the time you have between Icelandair flights The automated passportID document control lines were long on both travel dates but not worse than on other airports The logistics are not the best especially not for older people since you have to go up and down a couple of times If you follow the signs there is no problem I have travelled through Keflavik and to and from the airport many times and find the selection of shops and eateries very good

I flew Skymark Airlines from Kobe to Tokyo Haneda on August th and I must say that I was pretty impressed by the quality of the airline They do not provide any food but service is good I had too much luggage and they only charged me for the extra kilos I had checked Seats are very comfortable and legroom is better than most international airlines I guess its at least inches maybe Nice flight and on time I will fly Skymark Airlines again in the future when I return to Japan

I wanted to acknowledge the entire ground staff including the Security who helped us a great deal to arrange boarding the aircraft We reached airport just min before scheduled departure and the checkin was closed After requests since we as a family had to take onward flight from Delhi the ground staff went out of their way to help us

A very shortened Flight due to favourable Tail Winds saw us arrive minutes early into Bangkok excellent My goal was just to sleep on this overnight flight That goal was achieved and a comfortable hours sleep was enjoyed The actual Seat was looking shabby old No Food or Drink were taken so I can not comment on the service Would fly Gulf Air again if going to the UK
I found very good customer service by each and every worker at the airport whom we dealt with Wifi facilities were excellent with no interruptions Overall it passes the required tests

I recently flew American Eagle operated by Republic from Washington DC to Philadelphia and I was really impressed The E was comfortable and wellsuited for the short hop between cities Even though the flight was only minutes and we had a slight delay leaving Washington due to congestion the crew still managed to offer a full beverage service in first class which I really appreciated Despite the delay we landed in Philadelphia on time It was a smooth and enjoyable flight overall

AmsterdamCancun bought Comfort Class seats The cabin attendants were friendly food served was a little less good it wasnt bad just average The legroom in Comfort Class was good and other benefits are the complimentary alcoholic beverages and personal media player that you get So overall a satisfying flight
Hanoi to Hong Kong There are new business class seats on the plane very pleasant and comfortable The food is good the choice is standard Stewardesses good and pleasant service

I returned this week from Tyumen to Munich Another B this time with vintage business cabin and seats As I was alone in the section I missed the Europeanstyle seats that would have allowed me to completely lie down instead of sitting with a recline Crew were smiling and helping with more polyglot aptitudes than during my preceding flight Excellent tasty lunch with Sardinian I checked red wine Takeoff and landing right on time I shall not hesitate to fly with UTair again
This is a really nice airport the arrival and departure terminal are separate which is very convenient The airport hotel was amazing

Noticed some improvements from last visit about years ago Basically it is the same structure but only interior is much fresher I noticed some new shops inside and outside Inside the arrival hall there is a traditional Javanese music band playing live music with traditional Javanese instruments It is quite a welcoming nice charm There is dedicated taxi stand outside the domestic arrival hall Get a voucher and walk to the taxi pier It is quite organized

I will stay away from most recent reviews I have only one severe criticism and that costs them a star checkin luggage per person in business class of only kg between Europe and the new world Caribbean in this case More for a fee depending on how much you want to take Most decent Airlines even EW Discover let alone famous carriers like Air France and many others allow you X kg per person That has to change absolutely All the rest was plainly EXCELLENT Their ranking around stars has become obsolete The fleet has been completely renewed brand new As replacing the old faithful Boeing otherwise an excellent aircraft

Harry Bauer lounge at Port Vila Airport is located airside after passing through Immigration and Customs We travelled Business Class on Air Vanuatu and were handed lounge invitations Its best kept secret that this lounge is also a pay as you go Lounge so anyone Economy Class passengers as well can actually access the lounge on paying a fee when the lounge is open before each departure I didnt ask what the fee was but did notice they accept credit cards by way of a credit card machine contrary to some reviews some years back stating they only accept cash The lounge is air conditioned very welcoming after walking through the nonair conditioned public waiting area There is a refrigerator with nonalcoholic drinkssodas as well as a selection of local beers Minimal snacks are on offer and comfortable seating with views out across the tarmac and runway A quiet haven to sit and relax before the flight There is sufficient seating for some or more people so not a small lounge but cosy enough Sure beats waiting in the public area where there is no air conditioning

The airport is good and surprisingly large for a city of this population due to large number of tourists Most depart on Terminal S South note the terminal as the other terminal is far away Check in and security were smooth and fast There are adequate facilities for shopping or a drink The airport as well as Alaska Airlines have a good record of on time departure A good airport though there is not many lounges

Departure from Louisville was excellent the First Class checkin was efficient and fast with great service from the American Eagle ground staff Security was quick about ten minutes to line up and go through the security they are using the new body scanners now which improve and speed up the process The TSA staff as polite and very professional and ensure that your time with them is minimal as well as ensuring standards are kept After security the Lounge is good with excellent views over the runways aircraft Boarding areas are clean and airy with plenty of seating for passengers

Very clean airport arrival and departure very well organized Lots of places to sit with a view of the runway in the departure hall The Billa supermarket located in the airport terminal is a good choice Transport fromto the airport very easy

A small very effective airport with few flights Checkin is notorious quick and staff friendly arrival very quick and busses to Aalborg frequent Usually no problems getting taxis as well There used to be a cafeteria but nowadays just a kiosk but good cafeteria with reasonable prizes inside terminal Security check quick and friendly as well There is a nice viewing pavilion at one end of the airport Outside note the famous kiss and goodbye signs Restrooms outside terminal however few
The plane was modern and the cabin very clean and appealing The crew was very friendly and professional Fast check in and at Belgrade Airport the suitcases arrived very fast

Astana to Almaty Staff was polite and the plane seemed new I hope it will continue to work like this After long stagnation in Kazakhstan aviation industry this was like fresh air even not considering the price of the flight Only inconvenience was lack of credit card payment support only cash support

Phnom Penh to Siem Reap with Bassaka Air and I found this airline to be brilliant in all aspects Their prices are phenomenal and I couldnt complain about anything Check in was super fast and done with a smile The plane is a little outdated but its still new and growing The flight itself was mins and for such a short flight you even got a complimentary drink

Nice modern airport Efficiently run Arrived here on an international flight from ICN and was bussed to terminal despite most finger docks being empty Immigration was a breeze and luggate was efficiently delivered On outgoing domestic flight to SZX our flight Shandong airlines didnt appear at all on the departure screens but was correctly displayed at the gate Flight delayed and no announcements made Good selection of outlets Pleasant environment waiting for the plane big bright airy About minutes drive out of Qingdao

Koh Samui Airport is a lovely little airport and probably the most attractive airport I have ever travelled through Check in seemed to be very efficient and no long queues There is a large number of shops and restaurants available outside after you have checked in Toilets were ok and reasonably clean but quite a lot of insects buzzing around As many airport in Thailand they mix passengers on domestic flights through different parts of the airport and therefore passengers with international departures clear immigration and board the flight through a different gate to the domestic passengers on the same flight Seems a bit odd but they have a system and it works

One way Jetairfly flight from Antwerp to Berlin Tegel minute delay was only announced at the planned time of departure Nearly new aircraft the largest that is able to fly on Antwerps runway thin seats but ok for short holiday flights Very quiet and clean Friendly professional cabin crew excellent service Prices of onboard food and drinks are for airline service reasonable This airline often has very good deals available even on short notice Very reasonable price but the available fares vary a lot Flight was about full so they dont seem to be doing too bad The airline tries to be something in between a fullservice carrier a charter operator and a lowcost operator

Very good facilities as there are plenty of shops and restaurants Great transport connection particularly as the JR station is just at the basement However capacity at the international terminal seems to be pretty constrained There can be very very long queues at both checkin and security when a few flights depart at around the same time

Orlando to Manchester with Thomas Cook Airlines A low cost airline which provided a really good experience especially given the very low price of the ticket The flight departed one hour late but caught up and arrived on time Food was really good The entertainment was limited only a few movies but good Excellent flight for a cheap price

Lovely experience through check in and security at around am this morning th July The chap at Tui desk was friendly professional and helpful All four members of staff at security were great Helpful friendly and professional Lovely atmosphere At the caf a lovely women served me Smile on her face Finally going through to boarding gate yet again a friendly cheerful and helpful lady checked me in am by this stage Its a small airport The shop and caf are small Im not here to shop or sit drinking Im here to have an ideally stress free start to my holiday The staff make this place Thank you

Easy to park easy to whiz through security super friendly clean good services I got there a bit late for check in and people let me skip the line So nice Security was extra careful to check bins so I did not leave anything behind in my rush My airline pages me to board
The cabin is clean Flight attendants are friendly and polite Seats are comfortable and can be reclined easily The food is delicious Flights departed on time

Astana airport is small but very good The staff is ok The wifi connection works pretty well queuing times are very short There is only a few shops in the airport but that seems to be enough for it The exterior and interior design is very good

Miami to Brussels On this Boeing plane Jetairfly has a separate cabin called comfort class and I was able to book seats there for an extra fee Only seats in this cabin with FAs doing a great job Seats configuration in xx while regular economy is xx Legroom was very good After take off we were offered Champagne followed by a hot meal together with wine coffee and digestif Before landing breakfast was served I would recommend this airline if you can get seats in this cabin

I travelled last December to Saint Martin with the new Dominican airline PAWA Dominicana The service was pretty good The flight was punctual cabin crew was kind and served a pretty good snack some chips and the drink that you wanted On the return flight was the same treatment but there was a hours delay because of the traffic over SXM and SJU but the service was the same with nice treatment They have some old airplanes but in a good condition the interior of the MD was shiny and clean They also have DC but I havent flown that

Small company but very friendly and efficient staff All passengers treated as business class travelers even though Atlantic Airways only offers one class economy Small planes Bea and Airbus but the comfort is all right for the short trips between Scandinavian countries Faroe Islands and Britain

Gothenburg to Cambridge with SunAir a franchise partner of British Airways Aircraft are painted in British Airways livery and operate under BA flight numbers The flight was only half full making the seat Dornier more like a private jet than a small airliner Full meal and bar service on this hour flight Crew very good

Check in was fast and efficient Boarding was set out in groups the gate was small but boarding was very speedy Our seats were in economy but the IFE screen was larger than most economy cabins Ive been in Seats were comfortable and legroom was okay The cabin crew were so friendly and attentive We were offered drinks and snacks to begin with followed by a sandwich then a hot meal before landing with a few more drink and snack services in between Ive flown with Virgin to JFK a few times and wouldnt hesitate to fly with them again Never have any issues and staff are always on hand to help

I flew Skymark Airlines from Kobe to Tokyo Haneda on August th and I must say that I was pretty impressed by the quality of the airline They do not provide any food but service is good I had too much luggage and they only charged me for the extra kilos I had checked Seats are very comfortable and legroom is better than most international airlines I guess its at least inches maybe Nice flight and on time I will fly Skymark Airlines again in the future when I return to Japan

The seat was spacious but the recline function was lost on my seat Crew were friendly They offered one meal plus one snack for just hours The onboard announcement was inaccurate that they claimed to be landing soon hours before the actual landing Surprisingly personal onboard entertainment was offered

Such a fantastic flight Our flight attendant Jay was incredible His demeanour was cheerful and friendly and I truly wish every attendant was like him From the moment you got on the plane he had a positive energy and was respectful and helpful of all the guests Love United and kudos for such a great team

Izmir airport is way over priced for food and drinks Most of the food outlets were empty and I cannot understand why the airport magagement dont make it more affordable I would probably use it rather than bring my own food as I will not pay these extortionate prices The airport is clean and very thorough security wise Their WiFi near impossible to get as you need a Turkish phone to recieve the special access code they send you giving you only hours of access The access code procedure was so difficult I couldnt even make out the verification letters even with my glasses on Their tightness with the WiFi doesnt do them any favours Very petty on this point

Small but perfectly adequate airport On arrival we were through the airport within minutes of touch down though dont forget the US tax taken at passport control On departure we found the airport was shut and locked with lights off until am for departures that started at however it is modern enough with self service check in quick but thorough security with plenty of space in a light and an airy atmosphere There are now screens for departure information as well as the usual unintelligible tannoy calls and the only downsides were the exorbitant prices for snacks and drinks Duty free was a bit better but not particularly cheap either US for a coffee was times the price in the Best Western Hotel across the road

The food wasnt that great and theres no inflight entertainment but we were comfortable and had our iPods With regards to the cleanliness of the aircraft weve been on worse We found the cabin crew to be friendly their English is not great and they all had smiles I think if you expect high standards from a star airline youre bound to come home and write negative reviews Overall we were happy with what we got

NRT to TPE with JX on AUG and back with JX on AUG in Business Class for both legs I had always wanted to take a Starlux flight Before boarding at NRT I spent time in JAL Sakura lounge as Starlux doesnt have its own The inflight meal on the flight bound for TPE didnt satisfy my appetite Concretely speaking a grilled pork shoulder in sauce was tasteless I regretted not having preordered it Also champagne was served not so cold For my part I am not so interested in inflight entertainment On my return from Taipei prior to boarding I entered the Galactic lounge at Taoyuan airport T What surprised most was that they offered an a la carte menu on which I found an appetizing salmon steak and ordered it How tasty The dish served on the flight one similar to beef steak was totally different from the previous one It was superb The generous flow of chilled BOLLINGER champagne delighted me well Meticulous services offered by a Japanese flight attendant are worthy of a special mention Though this was a short haul or a hourandminute flight I could not help wishing it would be much longer Both flights were punctual
Their airport is pragmatic on the right size to be passenger friendly and with all major needs served like SIM cards and ATMs available Beware of overpriced rides to the city center or your hotel

Tehran to Dubai Mahan Air is the best airline in Iran The business class is convenient with a variety of dishes The quality of food in this airline is great Stewardess are very affable and responsible In the longterm flights the amenity kit will be given to you Generally the flight will be satisfied

SkyUp is definitely an interesting airline Going into this trip I was not really sure what to expect from a low cost airline that tends to receive high ratings We had booked second row seats for dollars each My original seat which was located on the left side of the aircraft ABC did not have the extra legroom that was promised However since the flight was mostly empty I was able to move to the right side of the aircraft seats DEF These rows had substantially more seatpitch and could definitely be compared to that of other airlines premium economy As for the seats themselves they were quite thin and similar in shape to that of spirit airlines or easyjet but nonetheless it still had a great recline angle In terms of service itself the airline does not have any food or drinks besides water on flights to or from any city but Kyiv so beware and plan to bring your own food onboard There was no in flight magazine or wifi only a QR code for you to download an online journal before takeoff The aircraft landed on time and overall it was a smooth flight

Very clean and modern airport New terminal added in New access highway to Shenyang Limited air traffic with few delays Baggage area is poorly lit Not sure why As the Chinese economy grows who knows what will come of this airport Right now its a clean well run airport albeit with little air traffic Interesting for an American to see Air Koryo planes and personnel at the airport

For international flights Lusaka now has a brand new airport and it is considerably better than the old airport which is now only used for domestic flights The new airport is spacious and currently clean and well maintained and well ventilated Check in is usually quite speedy Airside there are a few shops and cafes and currently a basic lounge though another is opening soon My only criticism is limited use of the airbridges but I was told that the airlines need to have a correct tow bar which some have and some do not hence some planes parking and passengers walking tofrom the terminal In rains you can be bussed Lots of immigration officers means it is quite quick to enter Zambia now

Thank you to the flight attendants of flight hx today Monday the th I left my phone in my seat on my flight and my phone made it to my next gate very quickly because the staff not only were wonderful but they care enough to not just put my phone in a box I thank you from the bottom of my heart

When I compare the Pittsburgh Airport to my most frequented airports Denver Chicago OHare Washington Dulles Orlando MCO LAX Pittsburgh wins hands down The airport itself has good signage to get you on and off Route The terminal is also easy to navigate although the security procedures are more intense than any other major airport that Ive seen Show your boarding pass and ID when you get in the security line Show your boarding pass and ID before passing through the metal detector Show your boarding pass and ID AGAIN before leaving the security area and getting on the train to the gates Once off the train and up the escalators there is ample shopping and many places to eat The gates branch off of this main area like spokes on a wheel There is an added bonus for computer users FREE wireless internet access is available in the food court area Get a bite to eat check your email catch up on the latest news Other airports have wireless available but they use clients like TMobile or ATT who charge for a couple of hours use I was able to pick up a mid to low wireless signal while sitting at my gate Surfing the web made the time go by a lot faster The major city airports like OHare Dulles and LAX could learn a lot from Pittsburgh Intl

Internal flights in Colombia BOGSMR CTGBOG were real value for money The planes were clean the service was good and the free Juan Valdez snack peanuts and some little cookie were delicious Excellent value for short flights

I have flown from Sligo airport a few times in the past A very clean and well maintained airport and a pleasure to fly from Very freindly staff and parking very cheap and beside the terminal Security fast and efficient Cafe bar and toilets are open to left of check in area Sligo airport in a sense can now be called an international airport because of new flights to Manchester in the UK Expansion of the runway is in the pipeline and the airport hopes to have a new route to London in the future Aer Arann serves the airport with all flights a good airline with cheap return flights and usually always on time Always a taxi near by the main entrance and bus service available from strandhill town into Sligo city centre that is about miles away Road network is basic but acceptable Overall a pleasant airport

First time with Swiss and first time ever in Business Class Could not fault in any way from the moment we got on board until we disembarked Actually felt like a valued customer and the crew could not do enough for us The food was top notch better than some restaurants we have been in The lie flat beds are comfortable but was unable to get much if any sleep due to turbulence and excitement at seeing my son at the other end The IFE was very good with loads to choose from I watched all episodes of Almas not Normal Brilliant comedy on duch a long flight The BC section was tastefilly done with light wood and soft colours giving the sectuon a nice intimate feel I would not hesitate in flying Swiss BC again an all round great experience

Flew GA Amsterdam to Jakarta from Madrid Spain GarudaIndonesia had arranged with the Schiphol VIP Center to meet me at the plane door upon arrival from Madrid and I was taken to the VIP centre for check in security and immigration formalities This is a great service as it bypasses all queues Within the VIP Lounge at Schiphol Airport there are full service including a full Al La Cart dining When I it came time to board the aircraft I was assisted by a member of the VIP team that took me by car to the aircraft stairs At the aircraft door I was meet by the cabin crew Fauziah Pradita Maurenia Ade Indrawati and Chef Aris Gumilar who give me a very warm welcome and guided me to my seat The First Class Team gave outstanding service from boarding in flight dining and general overall service There was a very good selection of food for both evening meal and for breakfast The meals can be served on demand however as I wanted to have some sleep I requested my meal two hours after takeoff The quality portion and presentation of the food was outstanding There was quite some turbulence throughout the flight however I still had an excellent sleep We were slightly delayed arriving in Jakarta but this was caused by the delay in departing Schiphol as it is over minutes taxi to the remote runway When I arrived in Jakarta I was meet at the aircraft door by Yudi from the First Class Team who help and assisted me through immigration luggage collection and through customs and out to a car provided by GarudaIndonesia to take me to my home I used the onboard Wi Fi and connectifity and speed was excellent This was another excellent flight and I thank the Cabin crew for their outstanding service

Optimal infrastructure parking is good the check in is very fast thoughtful attendants the security is good The airport has a lack of restaurants that is somewhat annoying but has a good service and good wifi

This is a fairly good airport Nice and clean easy to get around This airport is also very small and therefore has less wait time thus you can probably get away with arriving only hour prior to departure and still make your flight On the other hand there is not very many options to eat or shop

This airport is clearly not equipped to take the number of pax departing after the winter break Check in was too crowded so we had to wait on another floor Conveyer belt at check in blocked by heavy usage Boarding never indicated on screens but was only announced via PA system Shambles Shame as we had such a great time in Finland

Pyongyang to Beijing with Air Koryo The departure and arrival were punctual staff smiling and friendly the aircraft including toilets was clean and there were magazines and newspapers at the entrance The food was a chicken burger but the drink selection was rather limited either water or one type of soft drink It is maybe not the most luxurious airline but the service for a shorthaul flight is better than European or American airlines I have used for the same distance

Malaga to Birmingham I booked this flight online one week before flying I needed to book for adults one child and one infant However I found when checking prices it was cheaper make two separate bookings than the whole group at once I booked for two adults then another booking for one adult and two children This is unbelievable Also you arent allowed to check in online until hours before you fly unless you book a seat for euros each Which is a bit impossible as you are in holiday at this point Just another money making scam However we booked for free while in Spain and our hotel were kind enough to print our boarding passes for us The plane was clean but the seating is just too cramped My husband had sit with his knee protruding into the isle and the trolley kept knocking him when going past Food and drinks are too expensive luckily we bought some snacks and refreshments from the departure lounge before leaving Malaga The staff however are really helpful and Im sure they know its not the comfortable of places to sit for hours and do make an effort in making people feel welcome and providing a good service They were quick to help with the needs of my month old The pilot kept us informed of any changes as we were experiencing a lot of turbulence We were also informed as we approached the UK coastline and also times for arrival were given The plus side we didnt have any hold luggage and were able to check in infants pram at the departure gate Meaning we didnt have to wait in the long bag check in queues Overall we paid premium prices for seats on a below average quality plane Thanks to the stewards for their efforts in trying to compensate for this

Amsterdam to Paramaribo Surinam Airways has good service unfortunately the A had some maintenance so they leased an A from Wamos Air but they have the service from Surinam Airways The food was amazing with hot meals The crew was very friendly but the airplane from Wamos Air wasnt so good no IFE for a our flight you can download the app for movies no power outlets just a standard seat with table Overall the service was good but the aircraft not
I loved the flight and service the crew was very helpful and friendly Found the seats comfy and because of the low fares we booked make this trip to Iceland Thank you WOW airWe will miss you

Excellent both coming and going Good selection of shops and restaurants Layout easy to navigate Well signposted in both Spanish and English Clean throughout Ample restroom facilities Best of all the passportcustoms control personnel both incoming and outgoing are courteous efficient and multilingual They smile I hope they can give US officers the basic lesson Corners of mouth go up not down

I fly weekly for business and flew in and out of GreenvilleSpartanburg for the last quarter of and a bit of Its a small airport with only one runway and one long concourse with arbitrary A and B separation The major airlines serve GSP but flights are limited I mostly flew on American which only seems to connect via Charlotte an mile flight First being so close to a major hub like CLT caused almost weekly delays as my flight was often held on the tarmac by CLT airtraffic control so we could fit into the traffic pattern I never actually missed my connections in Charlotte but did have several walkjogs across the airport to reach my gate while the final groups were boarding But GSP itself is nicely maintained with superfriendly staff They offered TSA PreCheck when I flew in and out I got to know the Avis rentalcar staff by name and theyd give me free upgrades Best of all if you use GSP you have to order a tuna melt from the snack counter on the lower level outside security They mix the tuna salad from scratch in front of you and make the besttasting tuna melt Ive ever eaten

I agree entirely with Fernando Immigration staff also very helpful as well as friendly and efficient Only problem now is the collapsed bridge on the road to Caracas A diversion has been made but is only two lanes and is operated on a tidal system Can add an hour or two to the journey

Tulsa is a nice small to medium sized airport It now has free wifi available throughout the airport Only or so airlines fly out of the airport and it seems quite a few flights have been cut the past years or so The lines for TSA are rarely bad anymore I have been through security in less than mins after arriving at airport Obviously there are times when it is busier New seats at gates have plug ins available and this is a very nice touch

We are longtime members of another airlines frequent flyer program and lounge but ion this occasion chose Rex at the th hour as it was the only airline that hadnt hiked its fares dramatically for the last couple of days before departure We were very pleasantly surprised for want of a better term Despite costing us less than half what the competitors were offering the service was exemplary On needing a booking matter checked and dealt with by customer service I was very happy to find myself speaking to someone local who understood the exact situation and fixed it quickly and easily The airliner itself was modern clean and well presented staff were friendly and relaxed We also won a bid to get bumped up to business class which was a first Cant fault Rex we will fly them again in the near future

First time contributing to this thread and I must say Kuala Namu International Airport looks pretty modern and roomy indeed something I truly want to see in a functioning airport I mean yes it has opened recently yet I saw in the preopening photos a lot of modern features from streamlined checkin desks and a variety of shops Im surprised I saw a branch of Cotton On at the airport to modern jetways and small plants placed along the waiting areas near gates I wonder if those are actual palm trees

The onground experience was great very pleasant checkin experience the Adani lounge has a separate section for Vistara Frequent Fliers and Business Class which is quite nice The onboard experience is a bit soso the legroom in economy is fairly tight and feels less than Indigo They have cutdown on the quantity of food in meals visibly in economy class The IFE was good enough to keep oneself entertained and thankfully with the middle seat remaining empty the flight was quite comfortable

This was a lovely flight from Hobart to the Gold Coast on Tigerair Boarding was orderly We walked to the plane and boarded through the rear I had row to myself in the second last row I will travel with them again

I used Olympic Air to fly from Athens to Paros and return The aircraft used was an immaculately clean ATR that despite its year of age seemed brand new It seems the airline is really focusing on maintaining the cabins pristine The cabin crew consisted of flight attendants on each leg groomed to perfection and showcasing exceptional customer service skills A very short flight of roughly and we were offered water and sweets This is quite the rarity these days and highly appreciated treated as a guest and not simply as just another passenger Flights departed with a slight delay due to the air traffic restrictions but made up most of the time lost during flight Bags arrived on time and very prompt I would definitely recommend this legendary brand and i am so happy to see it operating in such high standards even on such short flights
Check in was easy as was boarding Staff coped well on a flight that was completely full The departure was punctual and the staff were efficient and helpful Overall a pleasant experience

I fly to LGB twice a year or more to visit family I really cannot say enough good things about this airport especially after the remodel a couple of years ago The place is beautiful It is well laid out it is small and so very easy to deal with I fly Jet Blue and it is almost always on time The restaurants in that terminal are quality and very reasonably priced This was one of the first airports to provide unlimited free wifi I love that you can board and leave the plane from both the front and rear It is so quick If you have to fly to So Cal this is the place to fly too

IG Milan Malpensa to Cairo Comfortable aircraft outstandingly attentive and polite cabin crew considerate to all passengers Competitive price delivered safely to Cairo All good Based on this first experience with Meridiana I have booked two more flights with with them No complaints whatsoever and no hesitation in offering a recommendation

My first time flying with Malindo now Batik Air Fabulous experience smooth checkin luggage included Friendly attentive staff Much more comfortable seats that either Air Asia or Jetstar Good pricing I have already booked another flights Impressive economy airline for the price you pay

We boarded on time but we had hour delay due to traffic at ATH get too hot so crew open doors again and served water Plane was nice and clean Crew were very friendly We landed with half an hour delay Nice inflight service for hm flight

Landed at Hangzhou Airport around using AirAsia X from Kuala Lumpur Immigration clearance was smooth and no hassle I claimed my luggage in just a few minutes Washroom services are as good as other airports in China The only lacking is the number of available seats on the departure floor at the checkin counters area

Used Entebbe airport yesterday to fly to DaresSalaam and was pleasantly surprised Terminal is very small but clean staff are friendly and welcoming and the facilities are fine to while away a couple of hours One of the best airports Ive used in the East Africa region and wish all border control staff could be as pleasant

It is a small airport no long queues or big crowds quick checkin and boarding It has quite good services if you consider its dimensions It is clean and comfortable I always start my trips here when possible also for overseas flights because it has good connections with the main hubs Rome Paris Munich London Istanbul

I flew into this airport on Islay island from Glasgow on a Loganair flight in the morning and returned almost a week later This is a rural airport close by the sea and is extraordinarily easy to use The SAAB aircraft was parked close to the small terminal building we picked up our bags that had been unloaded on the tarmac and walked in The walls were decorated with posters of the many distilleries for which Islay is justly famed There were also individual displays of whisky bottles and other items from these distilleries A small cafe provided a good range of snacks and also some souvenirs for last moment purchases There were ample spaces to sit A short conveyor belt brought in checked luggage quickly Across the check in counters are kiosks for the local car hires I had a car to be picked up The agent had all the paperwork ready The car was parked just outside I was out of the airport grounds driving on the left in less than minutes after landing On my departure I parked my rental car across the terminal building and slipped the keys into a slot in the kiosk The check in counters were staffed by Logan Air personnel in their uniforms that sported the easily recognized tartan plaids Security check was very thorough including patting The waiting area after security check had a rest room and was enclosed by glass which offered panoramic views The aircraft was just outside and we walked to to it It was a very relaxed experience with a high degree of friendliness and efficiency The airport is situated midway between the islands two larger communities Bowmore and Port Ellen

Easy to park easy to whiz through security super friendly clean good services I got there a bit late for check in and people let me skip the line So nice Security was extra careful to check bins so I did not leave anything behind in my rush My airline pages me to board

Just like winning the lottery there are some things that you just do not expect to do Giving Kabul airport a good review is one of them But here it is I have been travelling to Kabul for many years and have always hated the airport battle But the new airport is different If all you want to do is got on and off of a flight quickly and efficiently Kabul airport does that very well The hour queues at immigration are gone More like minutes now Baggage reclaim is as good as anywhere else in he world It took about half an hour from landing to being out of the airport No problems with check in either My Turkish flight left exactly on time Dont expect too much in the way of shops or business lounge in the departures area but it is adequate Wifi Internet is working well and free There are lots of security checks on the way into the airport Expect lots of Xray checks and various vehicle and body searches That is just a part of life in Kabul these days Overall a good and efficient experience and a big change from the old Afghan way

Lovely and clean little country airport offering frequent flights to BNE Short and long term parking in front of the terminal is free Restroom facilities very clean and in good working condition Airport has gates but they are pretty separate doors right next to each other leading on to the tarmac no air bridges Security staff well mannered and friendly Free Wifi in the terminal Only one fast food type of restaurant with very average food and rather expensive prices Seating in the terminal is rather uncomfortable hard metal type of seats so suggest you buy a coffee or chocolate bar and find a seat at the fast food restaurant Overall a very friendly and efficient environment

I have been through Abidjan a few times and whilst I was impressed on my first visit progressive improvements since then mean that it is definitely the best airport I have been to in Africa There is now decent and free wifi in the departures area a comfortable new cafe and the information boards are clear

A good airport Lots of places to eat including burger and many seats with places to charge you devices I sat there for hrs just streaming Netflix on the wifi May I say the wifi Is great Highly recommend

On our flight with LAN we had to change flights in Sao Paulo to TAM Airlines retrieve our luggage and check it in again as we were flying a domestic flight to Rio and then to Santiago There wasnt much time between the connections in Sao Paulo and going through immigration and changing terminals made it almost impossible With minutes before departure we didnt have our luggages checked in and there was a big line at the counter The staff on ground made a great job in checking our baggage and then taking us to the plane in a minibus as we were the last ones to board The luggage arrived safe in Santiago and both flights were on time On the way to Rio there was a new A with lots of leg room and for Santiago an old A which gave us a lotof trouble with many turbulences The food served on TAM wasnt different from the one of LAN but the staff were extremely friendly Still the experience in Sao Paulo looked very chaotic to us and we would prefer LAN for further flights

I would like to sincerely thank flight Stewardess Irdina from royal brunei BI dubai to london for her excellent hospitality She was very attentive cheerful friendly helpful and professional Other crew members also giving excellent service to the passengers Thank you for making our flight more enjoyable meaningful and memorable Looking forward to fly RB again soon

Small airport with few services Long enough customs procedures and passport control if you land late in the evening when there is little staff on duty However it offers a good free wifi service also available outside the airside

I was recently on a short hop from Sevastopol to Kiev Airport checkin was fast and polite Plane was pretty old Embraer with tight legroom Catering consisted of tea coffee water all looked and smelled uninspiring The crew was young and nice Ticket price was a good deal Flight was on time Ok for min flight

General Mitchell is a breath of a fresh air Its clean friendly and efficient Theres actually a classy little used book store and a museum full of model planes and blimps and whatnot If you get lost it is your fault my friend The whole place is like one of the models in the museum accurate well labeled and miniature Everything is right in front of you Theres an Amtrak station a block away minutes and to get to Union Station in Chicago is hard to beat This airport is tiny but its the easiest one Ive ever dealt with

Antananarivo to Fort Dauphin via Morondava and no notable issues with Air Madagascar service Easy website to navigate and book All flights were on time with pleasant crew and ground service as well Snacks on outward flights only and return flight had a fruit danish and coffee only minute flight Nice very nice and bright interior on the ATR first time Id flown this aircraft But and this is a well known issue for Air Madagascar they did move the departure time up for my return flight to Tana From am to am Grrr At least they emailed me and informed my hotel the afternoon before Note though domestic flying is cheaper if you fly into Madagascar with them I didnt given their spotty record and flying from Canada to Madagascar on a tight time line

Toluca Airport located about minutes away from Mexico City is a nice alternative to Mexico City Airport It mainly has flights within Mexico and limited service to the USA Florida Las Vegas Houston The best thing about this airport are the short lines Check in and security took less than minutes Its small but has a new feeling to it and covers the most basic needs It has a few shops and a Food court consisting of Subway Dominos hamburger joint and smoothly All seems clean and tidy Boarding is done via Airplane stairs and several ground transport options exist to Toluca and Mexico city

Manchester to Tenerife On the morning of our flight TUI informed us that due to scheduling issues they have enlisted Privilege style as a charter airline The seat was comfortable only issues were my tray table was loose the window was in a position that caused pain on my neck to look out of it The interior felt somewhat tired Apart from this the flight was comfortable and landed safely

My recent experience of flying through Tuscon reminded me that in the contemporary climate flying through smaller American airports is generally a lot more pleasant than megaairports A case in point was the security screening I have some metal in my leg that occasionally triggers the metal detector and it happened while going through security at Tuscon The TSA person that dealt with me went through the standard procedure for dealing with this sort of thing this wasnt the first time for me but they also managed to be human about it in stark contrast to what Ive encountered at some other airports where the TSA person I was dealing with might as well have been a robot I would agree that the dining options at Tuscon arent the greatest but I was still able to get something satisfying to eat We even had some entertainment courtesy of the Arizona Air National Guard also at Tuscon airport who were doing training flights in their Fs and treated us to an impromptu airshow There is much to be said for flying through smaller airports In general the experience is faster and less stressful than their larger equivalents

Pyongyang to Vladivostok Clean classic aircraft with amazing engine sound Seats were a bit narrow but okay for a flight of around one hour and ten minutes Cabin staff was friendly sandwich and lemonades water were provided free Excellent experience

Small quiet regional airport with small turboprop aircraft from a single airline There is no separate security screening staff have always been exceptionally helpfull Late arrivals for departures are handled efficiently The cafe is an offshoot of a nice respected cafe in the city serving exceptional coffee There is little point trying to fly from the bigger airports of Ballina or the Gold Coast The planes might be bigger there but flight times to Sydney are the virtually the same you are less comfortable waiting in those bigger airports Mother nature is the only downside with early morning fog causing some concerns but has never really affected me when I have wanted to travel

I would like to give a commendation to the staff of Cebu Pacific working at the Roxas City airport who helped my father recover his lost luggage which was mistakenly picked up by another passenger These people worked hard and I have also witnessed all the efforts they made to give all the help that we needed Thank you for your hard work and dedication You guys are awesome

Overall a great airport with great facilities and ample outlets to eatdrinkshop The only issue about this airport is the queues at immigration and security which is serious For instance immigration at arrival took minutes although there were only people in front of me and this was because only windows were open for processing

Our outbound flight was delayed which caused us to miss our connecting flight to Toronto with another airline The delay was due to a late inbound flight This created a small issue in Montreal but the other airline was able to get us on a later flight The flight itself was uneventful Service on board was good flight attendants were fantastic and friendly

San Francisco to Indianapolis I was on my last leg of journey home from New Zealand I flew out with American an then Fiji Air New Zealand Jetstar in New Zealand and they were all great The staff on Virgin America need to fly with these airlines and learn how to smile be friendly and not look grouchy A smile goes a long way

Though it is small it is one of the best efficient and beautifully designed international airports in the Philippines Been using it when I am visiting for business and leisure and Im not disappointed everytime I used this airport I do hope the government will expand this soon

Ottawa Airport is one of the best airports I travelled from The security line is fast the airport is clean and you dont have to wait one hour just to get to your gate Its a well made good looking fast and efficient airport

Airlink do so much right and so many other carriers in the region can learn from them Reliably on time on time across all their flights into Joburg for example great convenient connections through OR Tambo Johannesburg for regional Southern Africa departures onto domestic SA ones generous baggage allowance kg per passenger from Lusaka to SA ever smiling welcoming cabin crew and checkin staff on sectors without exception coupled with tasty cold meals on intl sectors and good South African wines and juices on all really help them to stand out alongside now even a loyalty rewards program Keep doing what you do Airlink we are so grateful and you will be rewarded with custom

Very small but friendly efficient airport Not a great deal to do and not many shops particularly airside but staff are always remarkably friendly and helpful which makes a change from most other airports I visit

I recently had the opportunity to fly with Batik Air Malaysia and my experience was a mix of satisfaction and simplicity Batik Air is known for providing basic services without the frills and it certainly lived up to that reputation The seating arrangements on the plane were comfortable but dont expect any luxurious features The seats were standard with enough legroom for a short to mediumhaul flight However the absence of inflight entertainment and limited amenities made the journey quite straightforward For those who prioritize a nofuss travel experience this may be a positive aspect One notable issue was the apparent lack of thoroughness in the cabin crews safety checks during the landing phase It was concerning to observe that the crew did not seem as attentive as one would expect in ensuring that all passengers were securely seated and that all items were stowed away properly The usual announcements and visual checks were noticeably absent creating a sense of unease among passengers Safety is paramount in air travel and any oversight during critical phases of the flight such as landing is a cause for concern It is imperative that the cabin crew conducts meticulous checks to guarantee the wellbeing of passengers This lack of attention to detail on Batik Air raises questions about the airlines commitment to ensuring a safe travel experience

Arriving into Landvetter was fine had to get a bus to the other side of the airport to go through immigration As I was on a nonschengen flight we had to go through immigration This part is quite small with European check desk and two noneu that are hidden in the corner and there are no signs to show that the noneu passport holder check is on the side Waited in the wrong queue for a few minutes till I had to ask and the immigration office put me right Immigration was quick with very friendly staff on arrival and departure Im the baggage reclaim you can see the bags come out from the conveyed overhead which is cool On departure airport queue times were quick with security very quick as well Gates has a small eating area with minimal seating and lack of plug sockets and as you have gone through immigration you cant leave this part Plenty of food and shopping options very modern clean airport that is nice to travel through

Bragana to Cascais with Aero VIP Seven Air provides the services The pilot was very nice and made sure everyone was comfortable and explained there would be some turbulence which was normal Flight arrived minutes late

While this is a very attractive airport with few flights off season transfer between plane and terminal can be hazardous to elderly and infirm passengers A bus with very high steps caused my wife to hurt her leg and later she needed medical attention We witnessed other elderly travelers and children finding the bus steps difficult On our return trip to Buenos Aires the Pluna station manager alerted by our hotel concierge arranged for a golf cart transfer and early boarding to the second row of the all economy jet Why the Airport authorities dont operate a more customer friendly vehicle is a mystery The airport departure tax at each for the minute flight is way out of line considering Ezieza in Buenos Aires charges for long haul flights to the US Once through the first of two security checkpoints travelers find themselves in a sizable duty free considering the size of the airport For those heading to and from Punta del Este and other nearby Uruguayan resorts PDP is certainly the most convenient and is an hour closer to those towns than Montevideo Airport

Seattle to Edmonton returning Bombardier Q plane small but with comfortable seating even for a sixfooter as I am Great cabin crew and nice free drinks An inflight snack might have been nice but overall a pleasant experience

Gatwick to St Petersburg I was slightly apprehensive about travelling with Rossiya Airlines but need not have been This was full flight from Gatwick to St Petersburg on an A The plane had seen better days but was clean When I checked in I asked for an aisle seat and was denied one Boarding was very quick and I soon found myself in a rather uncomfortable seat for the just over min flight The cabin crew were very nice people and efficient The service included a complimentary sandwich and drink which was appreciated I plan to visit Russia again in August and will gladly use this airline The friendly staff won me over Disembarkation was via a bus transfer to the main terminal

I hope Boutique Air continues this service to altoona I have been able to get my mother who lives in Altoona back and forth to Pittsburgh for medical treatment and advanced care she needs The drive to Pittsburgh is atrocious and I hope boutique continues this route for a very long time A total life saver and an awesome experience Out of about flights i have taken only have been delayed and very short about minutes or so Their customer service is outstanding and always so friendly

SanaaParis on A Ontime departure in spite of elaborate boarding procedures All pax bussed to aircraft Inflight fine choice of meal and range of nonalcoholic drinks Cabin crew courteous with passable English Economy cabin looked a real mess after meal service not cleaned Limited inflight entertainment

I had read the worst reviews about NDjili International Airport and did not exactly look forward to the experience of arriving and departing there But my hopes were set on some other articles I had found about a new international terminal that opened end of built by Chinese contractors I must say the new terminal the staff working there and the guarded parking and dropoff areas in front of it are exceptionally good It is a small but very bright and clean building Customs officers are professional and nice to the passengers same applies to security staff at Xray machines and where one must pay for an exit visa when leaving DRCongo Airconditionong works well and there is a nice business class lounge Do not expect any shopping outlets there is only one bar but the latter can easily compare to those in the better European airports Thumbs up for the new terminal hope it stays like it is today The road from the airport to downtown Kinshasa was also completely refurbishes good pavement lighting at night Travel times tofrom the airport to the embassies area of the capital are now only h to be compared to h a few years ago I was said

Very pleasant and helpful staff With my arm in a sling it was hard to do most things but staff were ready to help and the canteen staff were friendly and professional Could do with more shops and a better variety

Recently flew to and from Roissy CDG to Biarritz International in the Basque country in south west France for the first time The airport itself is small but there is a good bus service which will take you into the city centre pretty quickly On arrival on the HRS AF flight from CDG this flight seemed to coincide with a number of other flights from the UK which made the baggage arrivals area chaotic In addition the toilet facilities landside need some upgrading and definitely could do with the cleaners visiting there on a more frequent basis especially midafternoon which seems to be the peak time for the airport The rubbish bin in the gents toilet was overflowing when I was there which left a poor initial impression The airport does have an excellent tourism booth with very helpful staff however In addition from the airport one can get onto the nearby motorway very quickly and the care hire agencies also had very helpful staff at the airport especially Europcar On departing Biarritz back to Paris however I discovered that the departures area has only one very small cafe so passengers may not want to enter this area too quickly as the wait could be long and somewhat boring In summary the airport is convenient but it falls well short of the new fresher and modern design of nearby Pau airport which is excellent

The checkin process at Nagoya Centrair Airport was a smooth and pleasant one with kind staff assisting you if needed However the checkin counters opens only exactly hours before departure Apart from check in there is an amazing skydeck for aircraft photographers like me to photograph planes free of charge Also there are many food options to choose ranging from Japanese cuisine to Western cuisineThe central security screening was smooth and quick and I cleared security within minutes The airside had a lot of duty free shops vending machines to buy drinks and a clear view of the apron and runway Overall it was a very pleasant experience and I am happy to fly out of Nagoya Centrair Airport

From Gothenburg Sweden to Stockholm Sweden and back the same day A min flight Id developed a fear of flying from avoiding flying for years Before boarding I talked to the staff about this and they were very nice Very nice and considerate Perfect takeoffs and landings My advice for those in a similar situation would be tell the staff Dont rush be in plenty of time and tell the staff I had a very pleasant flight they served coffee tea or water with a small brownie Hot miniature towels afterwards Very attentive and polite Highly recommended

Travelled through all terminals at Manchester over JuneJuly this year Experiences as follows June Arrival into T Singapore Airlines No waiting for gate immigration fast and efficient bags delivered promptly taxi waiting to take us June T departure Ryanair Early morning rush busy terminal Security brisk and efficient If you are prepared then there should be no dramas Departure Lounge a zoo with limited seating Eventually got a table for breakfast Many many people drinking alcohol pre am Not an issue to me it made flight to Majorca interesting Unlike any airportflight I have ever encountered Boarded by aircraft stairs June pm Returned to T Ryanair from Majorca Day after power delays caused disruptions Arrived early slight delay getting onto stand Disembarked via steps Straight through immigration with no delays Evidence of huge snake queuing system that may be used at busy times I guess Hand luggage only so no comment there Waited minutes bus to car hire Green Motion but picked up car very quickly Courtesy buses to car rental village and other parking came and went Overall good arrival experience July Terminal EasyJet departure Awkward getting lifts to check in area Very busy check in area Left suitcases at Left Luggage Hand luggage only again Passport control again automated and swift No queue for security once again Staff brisk efficient and polite One bag out of for our party pulled for further inspection Clear explanation as to why this was the case Busy terminal Got very good seat at Giraffe eatery right by window Surprisingly good food and excellent service Clear explanation as to why bag was selected for secondary screening lounge very pleasant Once renovations complete this will be a very good terminal Overall while Manchester Airport is no Singapore Changi our experience across all terminals was perfectly satisfactory As long as you turn up on time well prepared and organised you should be fine Its not the hell hole some of these reviews would have you believe

Used Zhulany for arrival and departure domestic services No queues things went fast From car to plane in minutes and minutes from plane to car no hold bags The domestic terminal B looks bad but the new International terminal A is a good quality facility Overall ok but just for regional low cost flying

Freetown airport was always a miserable place to be Even after it was refurbished it only became tolerable In a completely new terminal was opened I have the pleasure of sitting in the business lounge writing this review The new airport was I believe built by a Turkish company Sitting here I could be in another continent Or perhaps not since FNA is rather better than the overcrowded airports in Europe Lots of African countries have built new airports and Sierra Leone is one of the latest and have achieved something remarkable The airport is not huge of course but it is modern very clean with good facilities and for my Brussels Airlines flight no queue anywhere I found the staff to be welcoming polite and on top of what they are doing There are a few but enough shops and places to eat The lounge is a good place to be Food is more than adequate Strangely no beer but the wine is good The airport must have been expensive but it does give a good first and last impression of Sierra Leone

ISP is an excellent alternative to LGA JFK or Newark Ive flown out and in to there at least times and I have never been delayed The makeover they gave the airport is great too It would be nice to see ISP expand a little bit with some more airlines going out of there

A generally good experience at Durban airport Arrival is quite simple and they seem to keep the touts out of the waiting area The checkin is well organized and immigration outbound proceeded quickly There are a number of shops and restaurants The food and the shopping are forgettable but not expensive Decent amount of seating at the gates Wifi works fine

Stockholm Tallinn Kiev and back Clean and nice Embraer on the first leg and a new CRJ on the second Overall a pleasant experience Transit at the small Lennart Meri ariport in Tallinn smooth and easy Staff rather dull but agreeable I would gladly fly with them again

The new Hanoi international terminal opened at the end of December excellent and well planned a big improvement on the old terminal It only took me a few minutes to check in and pass the security very efficient happy helpful staff all the way
I travelled from Istanbul to Bangkok via Delhi service was good as compared to low the fare and staff behavior is also very good but for extra luggage they charge extra money

I had an excellent experience at Taoyuan Airport Very impressed with the smooth and efficient baggage handling process The staff were incredibly helpful offering assistance with moving my luggage at the baggage carousel It made the entire process much easier and stressfree Really appreciated the level of customer care and attention to detail in ensuring that everything went smoothly Im highly satisfied with the service and would definitely recommend it

Flew with Canadian North on two occasions Found both flights to be very enjoyable First flight was Edmonton to Norman Wells and the next was Edmonton to Yellowknife Found check in staff to be friendly and helpful both times Flight Attendants were very courteous and friendly No corny jokes unlike Westjet Meals are also included with the fare For breakfast it was a hot or cold meal For dinner on the way home it was pork or chicken with free wine almost unheard of today on domestic economy flights The airplane was an older but in nice condition and lots of baggage allowance Would fly with them again and strongly recommend them

Felt like flying in the old days Flew this one hour flight from Kerman to Tehran in a packed sold out flight operating by an old Airbus A which was refurbished immaculately and very clean The flight attendants were nicely dressed and friendly It was rather hot at Kerman and I was surprised to find a cold bottle of water on seat back pocket for every passenger on this massive jet They a light dinner free of charge Over all it was the best domestic flight I have ever taken
TSA worker screaming at everyone She removed purse shoes and jacket from the bin where I was told to place them She threw each item on the belt individually Never stopped hollering

Very small Airport on the Northern German Island of Sylt During Summer Season served by Lufthansa and Air Berlin with flights to major German Cities Only a handful checkin Counters and during busy hours on weekends which means or planes within a couple of hours long lines Upon Arrival only one Baggage Belt and Baggage Claim Area crowded But due to the small size of the airport and short distances from the planes to the Baggage Claim Area baggage arrives very fast Staff very friendly and efficient waiting lounge can get very crowded during peak hours Small shops and one nice CafeRestaurant Short distance to Parking Area Delivery service by Rental Car Companys No public Transport Overall a different but nice experience And flying to Sylt gives You a great chance to visit the island even from Southern Germany for only a few days
From Prague to Saint Petersburg great service nice food professional group price of the ticket was higher than competitors but worth it highly recommended

Rigolet Labrador to Goose Bay Labrador on October on an Air Labrador twin Otter Aircraft has been well used over the years but provided a comfortable and quick way back to Goose Bay Bush flying copilot loaded and unloaded the bags seating well wherever there is an empty seat No complaints about the service and would not hesitate to fly with them again

Little expense has been spared to make DRS a spacious and stateofthe art An allround highly agreeable experience with the added advantage of DRS being very close to the city centre A halfhourly rail service connects DRS with Dresden Hautbahnof a minute journey with several intermediate stops all for a princely EUR oneway fare BA has recently launched an LGWDRS service great views of the heart of the city on the landing approach from the starboard side but the airport remains somewhat underutilised

This is a comparatively new airport in Tunisia and I have nothing but praise for it It is clean smart and well organised Check in and Security were quick and once through to airside a really good duty free shop and a bar Great views from the glass fronted terminal although the view of some aircraft can be obscured by the piers Everything ran smoothly and just a pleasure to travel through this airport

Its for T international arrivals Newly operated T pleasant experience no rush hardly min for immigration still under construction no eatingforex options within the terminal whatever available is outside the terminal Bag arrived on time hardly min to exit with baggage Clean toilets and facilities

Flights to Kefalonia from Athens Arrival smooth with reasonably quick bag delivery Departure less good I felt sorry for the people stuck in a long queue waiting to check in for their charter flight Olympic Air was fairly speedy Terminal facilities are basic at best One shopcafe before security The toilet facilities are dire Very poor signage in the airport domestic departure lane was closed with no instructions to join the long international queue and no gate information once through security However as there are only gates the guess was easy Such a shame that Greek islands have such poor airports for really wonderful places

An enjoyable flight It left on time and check in was easy The seat was quite comfortable for a short flight The staff were very friendly and efficient The food was surprisingly good as well The flight offered refreshments twice In fact more food then my flight on QANTAS from Sydney to Cairns

I like KM Malta airlines Between a faulty departure screen and me not paying attention I panicked when I saw my flight status on screen said gate closed Ran to the gate in minutes and it was indeed closed Much to my obvious delight and surprise they still let me board and ordered a bus to take me to the aircraft where having boarded they shut the doors and we departed No persuasion was necessary and I cant imagine any other airline being this reasonable Onboard service and food excellent

As with many small airports travelling to and from Altenburg is a pleasure The terminal is about as big as a DriveThrough burger restaurant and there is free parking within m of the building This airport is an excellent option for passengers travelling to or from the southern part of the former East Germany or to the north of Bavaria I live in Bamberg and the drive is much shorter and more pleasant than to the next nearest Ryanair airport at Frankfurt Hahn On the downside if you arrive early the Duty Free shop is very small and the restaurant is basic but the staff are friendly

Nice atmosphere friendly staff and excellent hospitality The staff was courteous and welcoming the food was good and hot and there are drinks to choose from The lounges are good the service provided was great and checking in is simple Early landings and timely flights

I very much enjoyed flying with SAS Very attentive and cheerful staff ontime departures and landings free coffee and tea service incl refill clean and modern planes A delightful experience My only little complaint is the ticket fare but after all it was in highseason and ok for such a good service

Airport conditions are fairly reasonable given the recent difficulties Do try to have your visa in good order before arriving Visa on arrival is only possible if it has been arranged in advance and takes some time to issue at the airport Apart from that the arrivals process is OK Just follow everyone else Departing is also not too bad However as has been pointed out the signs are all in Arabic so it can be difficult to know where to go Check in is a little chaotic Finding the departure lounge may not be that easy Staff are actually quite helpful and polite There are a few shops and a basic business lounge Wireless internet is available and works quite well
