Do Book the First Class lounge as soon as you arrive ready for your return I didnt and sat jealously sweltering and being zapped by mozzies as I waited for my inevitably late flight Otherwise if there is only one flight due there seems to be enough room and seats probably get too crowded if more than one flight waiting to depart Arrival and getting through customs is a fuss and very slow although the security people are friendly I got my passport stamped as well as the visa when I asked nice free souvenir Toilets were a bit smelly and not totally functioning but did have toilet paper Gents Stuff is sold in both duty free shop and kiosks around the departure lounge Note as expected the duty free shop is much cheaper You can only pay in CUCs or at an exorbitant markup by credit card Good views of the apron from the lounge and the only downside is if you are a fervent antismoker This is cuba they sell cigars you can work it out Tip a few people had stuff confiscated from their hand luggage tobacco and spirits I think it was all stuff that the proper export tax hadnt been paid on Keep a few CUCs to slip the staff at the airport and they also really apreciated a drink or two As everywhere the porters are quite bullish Dont get upset at being asked for a tip just for loading the suitcase into the coach Look how much you earn and then realise how much is worth to them

Free food and snacks provided Great wifi Nice comfortable chairs like a business lounge I was able to walk to my accommodation which Ive never done before Very easy access to Toronto with a short free ferry ride and then streetcar available on Bathurst St Very nice small airport

Airport on Arrival no problem We hired a car and having found the car hire desk we were directed to the car pick up point which turned out to be a considerable distance away No shuttle service You just have to leg it If it had been raining we would have been soaked Cant imagine what it must be like for people in wheelchairs or families with pushchairs plus luggage Car hire needs to be closer to the terminal or shuttle service provided Departure was not good We had to leave our bags to be scanned go to the other side for Security check which meant leaving our bags and personal belongings unattended When called for our flight we were herded into a holding pen not enough seats stood for minutes while members of staff called out peoples names to re check their flight details this was done in a very unfriendly and unapologetic manner Took the shine off what had otherwise been a very pleasant trip to this beautiful island

Been coming to GCM for years Yes tourism has increased based on reports by almost over last years which is fantastic for this beautiful Island But the airport although complete remodelled is poor at best Aesthetically pleasing it is too small and very uncomfortable Why go half way for something inadequate from the start Fortunately the entire staff are awesome and eased the pain Suggest a change in schedule of when flights arrive may assist even by minutes Two recent issues I dealt with The runway pothole was a total screw up From accounts in paper it appeared that new asphalt from night before was destroyed by a jet blast Asphalt needs to cure Second and personally involved is that our plane needed to wait one hour after everyone was boarded for maintenance to return a log book This made our connection for our next flight impossible with all the inconveniences associated How can you allow this calamity to occur is still not sitting well with me If you expect tourism to continue to visit your beautiful Island you need to improve

Flew Vanilla Air from Tokyo Narita to Okinawa Naha Boarded on time and with no troubles staff were friendly and welcoming Seats were reasonably comfortable Im ft tall and my knees werent touching the back of the seat in front of me which was definitely a welcome surprise on a low cost carrier No entertainment systems available but not an issue as I usually travel with my iPod and something to read anyway Flight was calm and we experienced no turbulence en route You need to purchase on board food or bring something with you but we knew this in advance so brought some food bought at Narita departures terminal All round good flights cheap and efficient and did exactly what we wanted Took us from A to B with no fuss or issues A solid experience Id recommend and plan on using again in the future

I am pleased to commend Mdm Novia for her exceptional professionalism during our recent flight cancellation on November After our Citilink flight from Pontianak to Jakarta was canceled Novia managed all the necessary arrangements for our next flight with outstanding efficiency and kindness Her assistance made a challenging situation much easier and we are very grateful for her dedication and hospitality She truly goes above and beyond in her service

Excellent small airport clean spacious good restaurant airline lounges collectively available to a great many airlines Arrival was to jetway Departure was by bus to plane from gate E the gates uses buses to go to aircraft The departure flight needed deicing since the aircraft was not parked at a gate it could be deiced in place before taxiing Frequent reliable bus service tofrom city Security personnel on departure efficient and courteous Time in security line minutes

RGNSNW Quick boarding with allocated seating for minute flight in ATR to Ngapali Beach Good safety briefing before time take off and light snack and drink en route Pleasant FAs smooth flight and great landing over the surf and through the palm trees to this small exRAF WW strip on the Bay of Bengal Luggage is delivered by handcart to the entrance gatesexpect to pay kyat per piece

Berlin Tegel to Vienna On my short weekend trip to Vienna I ended up in a Niki aircraft although booked with Air Berlin You can see a small difference between Niki and its bigger sister for example the crew wear an pinkviolet uniform and probably the main difference being that Niki still gives the complementary drinks one hot and one cold and a little snack a vegetarian and a nonvegetarian option and it was like in the old days at Air Berlin The flight was of course on time The crew were very friendly the seat was very spacious I got one with extralegroom as a topbonus platinum A nice airline for a nice flight

A moderate sized airport with fast security processing times decent dutyfree shopping and enough seats with a power socket Signaling isnt the clearest however as the airport was build in steps Half of the gates are bus boarding only It has a convenient metro connection to the city center Wifi was quite good and staff friendly and helpful

Arrival on Sunday morning Apr Good airport quick luggage delivery clean airport Departure on Thursday evening Apr Check in correct no air conditioning very hot temperature more than C on the evening very crowded due to small boarding lounge and not enough seats Only one small bar in international area for more than large aircraft B departing at the same time

arrivals and one departure Arrival is one part and departure is the other Super efficient clean and pleasant Taxis out front Departure area maybe could use more seating Interesting there was a ping pong table there and it was quite popular It has a relaxing feel about it Probably one of the nicest airports anywhere Arrival has a store where you can buy a bus card and load it for say or days travel

Boarding an A was a unique experience and you will enjoy a pleasant flight thanks to the spaciousness and comfort The cabin crew were admirable and friendly the food was good and delicious Highly recommended

Nice and small airport at El Alto La Paz The process to get my bags was average in time and customs was friendly and polite There are a few cafes and a couple of restaurants I could see Ground transpiration is readily available by taxi or minibus The airport is not a big building but it has wifi it is clean and has many standard services

Bahrain Airport is very nice not compare with Kuwait airport that was so awful Bahrain is clean with nice little sofas and comfortable armchairs The staff at the restaurant and the cleaners are courteous and friendly It was a nice experience

The airport is clean nicely compact and easy to navigate once on the property It has clearly been renovated in the relatively recent past and that is seen in how spacious the security area now is and how modern the architecture now is Checkin was quite easy and hasslefree Security is quite timeconsuming tedious trudge if you dont have TSA PreCheck but if you do have PreCheck youre pretty much golden There are several pretty nice stores and restaurants postsecurity nothing fancy nothing even particularly Texan but satisfactory However I cant bring myself to particularly like this airport Unless the much nastierinalmosteveryway Bush airport across town which has friendly personnel the people that work at Hobby seem to have taken on a mission to be snarky and powertrippy toward passengers From shuttle bus drivers to ticketing agents from TSA personnel to store clerks and from restaurant employees to gate agents hardly anybody at Hobby seems to appreciate the fact that they actually work at a fairly beautiful modern airport If Bush employees can have a positive attitude so too should Hobby employees but maybe thats asking for too much Furthermore this airport does have some of the worst signage Ive ever seen at least approaching the airport and within the terminal presecurity the quality of the signage is great but the directions can be confusing Also the economy parking lot fills up easily and often forcing unfortunate drivers to park in the parking garage adjacent to the terminal which costs something like USD daily All in all this airport has a lot of the aesthetic measures on point but the management there seem to fail to remember that airports always serve as introductions to cities and regions Are snarky and powertrippy personnel who they really want to represent Houston and Texas I really want to like this airport but I just cant What a shame

Flew on th of February Checkin staff in Miami was the best I ever experienced Fast friendly efficient pleasant Travelled with pet in cabin all formalities were dealt with rapidly and in a friendly way Boarding rapidly inflight crew very friendly We got the feeling that the flight attendants had pride in their job Food offering very good however service could have started slightly earlier Flight left delayed due to late arrival of incoming flight snow storm in Toronto But as we got an email from Porter advising of the delay we were able to leave to the airport later All in all a nice experience

Everything was great and professional from the moment we arrived There were two other flights at immigration one from Europe the other from Buenos Aires and immigration lines was moving fast When we got there the officer was very friendly and welcoming she even wished us to enjoy her country that was very nice Airport is very modern has all the amenities to pass by time really fast free WIFI is available plus charge stations

Usual poor service Only booked with Air Europa to use up my air miles They cancelled my seat reservations made at time of booking They never explained but I guess because by the time of flight my status has changed from elite plus to elite Always good to see their ability at annoying their regular customers is at its finest once again I would recommend they do not serve food as it is revolting and just adds to the perception of them taking their customers for mugs

XIYCTUAUH Arrived from Xian on domestic flight in Terminal which was newly opened in Spring All very clean and tidy with clear signs in Mandarin and English Quite a long walk to Baggage Reclaim for the furthest gates but not unreasonable Toilets clean and plentiful with both squat and regular options For International Departures there are main dining options before Checkin either KFC or local Chinese food There are a few stores selling various local foods and some souvenirs CheckIn pretty good and Passport Control and Security all pretty smooth No requirement to remove belts or laptops for security scanning but do enforce the ml liquid rules from Europe In the International Departures no dining opportunities but a couple of coffeeshop options along with the usual array of Duty Free shops Most departures are from one of the airbridges Announcements made in both Chinese and English Toilets are clean

This was my first time with Korean Air and I chose this return flight to travel to Hong Kong even though it was not the cheapest option We were extremely satisfied with Korean Air and the service they provided The cabin crew was amazing and the plane was very clean I would fly Korean Air again without any hesitation

I found this airport to be surprising good for a European airport Getting through the airport was smooth and the terminal was busy but not crowded The Marco Polo Lounge was again very pleasant one of the best I have been to in Europe it even has an outside terrace with views of the apron which is a rare treat My only complaint would be the strange approach to the use of airbridges there were so many available and yet slow and cumbersome bus boarding seems to be standard operating procedure at VCE strange
This is a smashing little airport friendly well laid out and very well run Because of its location very attractive to fly in and out of too always a big shock returning to Gatwick Good ice cream too

This is my home airport Completely renewed a few years ago its now a very good and modern airport Near the city center just minutes by car Its a small airport but its probably the better choice to come to Sardinia Depending on winds you can have a fantastic view over the famous sardinian beaches from your airplane window In the summer sometimes you may find crowds at security checks There are just a few overpriced shops but this is common in italian airports Car rentals taxis and bus are easy available

I commute regularly between Perpignan and Manchester and it is my favourite airportIt only has one cafe and one shop but these are conveniently situated and adequate for the number of people there I can walk yards to check in there are rarely any queues and there is no need to rush through security The place is small but thats its charm no hassle no long walks and friendly and helpful staff To fly from most airports you need to allow a good two hours to get from a dropoff point to check in and then to a gate In Perpignan minutes suffices
One of the best choices in Brazil The airport is very modern pretty and clean it can be considered an architecture beauty Way better than So Paulo and Rio

I always have great experience flying with GOL It is efficient and provides great value for money The crews are friendly and the plane looks well maintained They provide snacksmeals during their flights depending on flight duration and Decent entertainment system together with a free wifi for messaging

Two years on from my last report and improvements continue to happen The check in area has been updated making for a comfortable experience and the new TSA security area is large and works efficiently A new hotel is now connected directly to the terminal Staff as usual friendly and helpful Forced to deduct one point for the lack of baggage carts If they are there they are well hidden

The airport is very small so there is a lot of queuing Check in was fairly smooth once it opened and the check in lady was helpful and efficient Oversized baggage also taken at the desk which is good when youve got ski equipment There was then a long wait until we were announced to go through security Waiting area was limited and the food sat in a semi outside area where smoking was allowed There was a very long windy queue through security Limited facilities before and after security There is no lounges available

Saint Marie to Antananarivo What an absolute pleasure flying with this new airline Madagasikara Airways Finally competition to Air Madagascar with prices half the price of the national airline reliable ontime departure convenient schedules and complimentary drink and snacks onboard with an extremely friendly cabin attendant who made announcements in languages Planes are serviced in South Africa Sad to see that despite all this the plane was only half full hopefully more will hear of it as it really deserves to succeed

Excellent services as usual by Singapore Airlines from Darwin to Singapore on March even though I was fasting and unable to eat my foods they didnt forget to give me a box of dry foods and drinks to break my fasting Thanks a lot to the cabin crews Flight from Singapore to BKK SQ on March was great too Always excellent service

Waiting area is too far from the entrance a lot of mosquitos in waiting area as its open crowded too My flight at am and I arrived long hours before my flight in which they decided to let me stay in waiting area overnight and mosquitos enjoying to eat you alive Please do something

A moderately sized airport some km away from the city center Its clean and modern and during the offseason security check was very fast and efficient Dutyfree shopping is in abundance and has some good offers Staff is very friendly far nicer than what you experience at other airports All arrivals and departures are busboarding only as there are no jetbridges Connection to the city is by taxi or bus X which cost only euro

Flew KigaliDoha and onwards with Royal Air Maroc afternoon th January on a B On time Ticket issued by Qatar Airways which caused limitations on seating food and miles crediting as Rwandair cannot exhibit flexibility cum overrule the QR booking in any way Eg I could not preorder meal due to differing booking systems typically a codeshare issue Checked in hours early to enjoy Dream lounge in Kigali Checkin smooth luggage checked in to final destination though BPs could not be issued beyond Doha Eventually I got my favourite exit seat Could choose among the two lounges in Kigali Dream and Pearl Both are well stocked only hot snacks are not offered any more Dream has an upper hand with city view Onboard FAs are good polite well rested and groomed Service impeccable Only meal service on this hours flight No WiFi nor personal IFE only childish movies shown on shared monitors Seats well bolstered spacious Fine boutique airline with only aircrafts which are few in case of irregularities Good trip recommended

I agree that it is a small tidy airport with close proximity to the city It is great that the tram is literally as you walk out the front doors with a frequent service to the city Bremen is such a great little city

Departure from Louisville was excellent the First Class checkin was efficient and fast with great service from the American Eagle ground staff Security was quick about ten minutes to line up and go through the security they are using the new body scanners now which improve and speed up the process The TSA staff as polite and very professional and ensure that your time with them is minimal as well as ensuring standards are kept After security the Lounge is good with excellent views over the runways aircraft Boarding areas are clean and airy with plenty of seating for passengers

Like many airports food and drinks are much too expensive I do therefore I also do not want to buy water It is not allowed to take bottled water through customs so most airports have free tap drinking water Also this airport But they are all disconnected I find this outrageous To have access to drinking water is a right

Johannesburg to Bloemfontein This review is more for compliment for one of your service staff at domestic departures I had a connecting flight from CPT to Bloemfontein via JHB I flew Mango to JHB and SAA Express to BFN There was only hour between arrival in JHB and departure to BFN The baggage claims for Mango took way too long and l was going to miss my flight Without my bag l ran up to the SAA express checkin counters for assistance Staff really went over and beyond to assist me and make sure l didnt miss my flight He assisted to check me in and help to carry my bag from baggage claim up to the checkin counter and safely on the correct plane All in time Without is quick response and help l would have surely missed my flight Well done for excellent customer service Thank you
Great airline You get what you pay for Outstanding staff Do not listen to all the negative reviews online Have never had a bad experience problem

Anchorage airport north terminal is clean and spacious with very fast and efficient checkin and security There are lots of interesting things to look at in the airport Plenty of eating options and shopping Clean bathrooms and good WiFi No complaints at all
Very easy to reach and easy to move around inside terminal Clear signs polite and friendly staff Plenty of seats by gate

Flew this airline from Nadi to Honiara and have to give credit it is pretty good The legroom is abundant the crew are efficient with the service Although the airline could benefit from seats with power outlets wifi and IFE Other than that I cannot really fault the airline Gets you across from point a to point b the flight was on time as well

arrivals and one departure Arrival is one part and departure is the other Super efficient clean and pleasant Taxis out front Departure area maybe could use more seating Interesting there was a ping pong table there and it was quite popular It has a relaxing feel about it Probably one of the nicest airports anywhere Arrival has a store where you can buy a bus card and load it for say or days travel

Brive to ParisOrly with HOP Seamless reservations through Air France Brive is a tiny airport and very easy to manage On time departure for Paris Both ground and cabin staff very pleasant Aircraft was aging but clean and seemed well maintained Inflight service was beverage and snack fine for a hour flight Only drawback is the limited schedule between Orly and Brive which means I usually have to fly via Bordeaux Fares occasionally high but generally very reasonable Will certainly fly them again

Check in and security very fast and efficient but then you hit the overpriced shops and the limited and expensive catering options They should let the cafe outside arrivals take over a spot inside they offer decent food at good prices The place is clean the staff are pleasant and helpful but it doesnt make up for the over priced shops and the limited choice of food

Kuala Namu International Airport is it is the second largest airport after SoekarnoHatta International Airport but the first airport which has a direct rail link to Medan city the capital of North Sumatra Kuala Namu is the most comfortable and the most modern airport in Indonesia

Only used this airport in transit tofrom FrankfurtQingdao so this is a comment on the transit facilities Speedy visa check and immigration service quick security check and throughout friendly English speaking staff Excellent signage to transit space which features plenty of seating souvenir and duty free shop coffee bar and small childrens play area In transit one is issued a transit card which has explicit instructions on how to proceed

Smooth flight and comfortable seat Premium economy still a good value on Finnair The cabin chief was competent as I got a problem with only one choice of meal Im platinum and I was upset to see the poorest service during the dinner on board he went to apologize so its good but when you pay euros you expect a better service concerning the food The flight attendants have to be more smiley

The terminal is Sovietstyle and a little big for just or flights a day to Moscow and the occasional charter Checkin was slow with initially only one desk open but the service was friendly and efficient when eventually obtained With a blizzard on the tarmac it was unsafe for the bus to drive out to the plane Stumbling across the whipped up snow and ice is not something for the fainthearted The early offer of an onboard drink was appreciated
The cabin is clean Flight attendants are friendly and polite Seats are comfortable and can be reclined easily The food is delicious Flights departed on time

Return Edinburgh to London City BAs CityFlyer remains the most pleasant way to get to and from London from Edinburgh The Embraer has much better legroom than the so look out for the type flying when booking The blue leather seats and layout make for comfort Trip to London City on Oct at on the EMB was wholly smooth Fantastic view of the three Forth bridges on departure So much legroom and space and Im ft in st On time more or less pleasant crew and a free breakfast of bacon rolls or a platter of fruit salad and organic yoghurt Water and hot drinks Just what was needed LCY is so easy to get through in arrival and I was on the DLR to the city in minutes flat A great start to the day Returning home on Oct at the on the smaller EMB was much less comfortable due to turbulence for at least mins thanks to the tail of a US hurricane passing over GB The reassuring captain apologised several times and explained he was trying to get clearance to a higher level Good to be kept informed The crew were marvellous Kind cheerful the best of BA Drinks and snacks served despite the plane lurching about All comp including a good Glenlivet malt Edinburgh arrival fine and into tram within mins of touchdown These jets arent new and it does show a bit but its a cutabove experience still compared to the alternatives The tickets to LCY on the travel app I use are a little more than Gatwick but if you can miss the absolute peak flights the difference isnt much and to me anyway worth it for the good service and central location and efficiency of London City Airport

Small Domestic Terminal in Male Fast and efficient no Food or Drink facilities Quick boarding by bus New ATR with comfortable seat pitch Short Minute flight very friendly Maldivian Crew Water Juice and Fruits offered Smooth Landing in Dhaalu Bags delivred in minutes Perfect short and comfortable flight

Stansted to Ercan via Istanbul I booked my flight then checked reviews most of which hadnt been complimentary My experience of flying with Atlasglobal for the first time was entirely positive Unlike most other budget airlines I had kg baggage allowance and basic food and drinks were served on each leg of my journey at no additional cost One flight attendant in particular deserved a special mention on the Istanbul to Stansted leg of my trip from Ercan on Sunday morning she was genuinely helpful and very friendly She literally greeted everyone getting on and departing the plane with a sincere nice smile

We decided to fly from Santorini to Heraklion rather than take the fast ferry as there wasnt much difference in price and it was more convenient to arrive at Heraklion airport We hadnt heard of Ellinair and there werent many reviews We were a little apprehensive but we were pleasantly surprised The flight was ontime the aircraft clean and comfortable and the crew were friendly and professional

The current airport consists of two buildings The first houses the security scanners and the second an open air thatched building the manual check in Very pleasant for small groups A new terminal is being constructed and should be ready in a few years Like most things in Lamu this is a simple functional relaxed airport From the terminal you walk meters to the fast boats for the minute ride to Lamu Town or to Shela Beach

Book flight for Thanksgiving Left Nov one way to Fresno Flight was nice and comfortable no complications Book flight back from Reno Nevada December at am direct flight to Portland only to have canceled and reschedule for over booking Unable rescheduled on Sunday to fly so forced rebook by airline for Monday No base seat available so force to buy a higher price ticket or be reschedule for Tuesday Refunded dollar from Sunday then force to pay dollar Monday or be scheduled There more but I book flight through Alaska and flight was Via Skywest So their more even late leave airport on Monday and ground stewardess take minute to play with another passenger tablet before being able board plain Flight suppose be am left Reno after am

First time the flight left on time and even earlier for the first time in years I thought we were going to be landing way in advance Unfortunately we were then in a holding pattern in Bangkok for mins You win some you loose some It was a ten year old Boeing The first meal service was lovely the breakfast was poor I didnt eat that The recline on my seat was broke which isnt a deal breaker for me anyway Crew were great I still think they can improve but the convenience is the key with a direct flight

Tehran to Copenhagen Excellent value For money Traveling alone with a baby can be challenging but I found Check in and boarding procedures smooth and without delays The flight attendants were young and very nice to us A with smart and clean cabin Food and nonalcoholic beverages was plentiful as a hot breakfast was served at the beginning of flight and a cold refreshment before landing in Copenhagen This was a hour flight and I did not expect that Inflight entertainment could be improved This was a great flight and I would consider to fly with this airline again in the future

At first I was not impressed by the airport as from outside it looks small and not modern But once in I was happily surprised with the efficiency of the airport both in the arrival and departure halls The wifi woked perfectly The facility is simple but clean and fast to navigate through The airport business class lounge was a great surprise Beautiful design very attentive staff great food and drinks selection Well done CKY

A very small but easy to navigate airport It is small to the extent it could kind of be a bus station I arrived in Mexico through SLP but did not depart from this point thus my experience is based on arrivals only However I could see almost the entire airport anyway Upon arrival I was greeted with very friendly immigration officials I left my information documents that I was given to fill out enroute on the plane I didnt realise until I got the counter and went to hand them over The friendly official was extremely helpful and gave me replacements and helped me fill it in as I looked tired My bags arrived very quickly through the small carrousel and I was able to pick them up and move to a customs check point At this point you are randomly picked for checks I was picked however I was dealt with by another very friendly and helpful official who made me feel very welcome to Mexico Finally I took a taxi to my hotel Once out of the control area there is an area with information and helpers on hand to get you a well priced taxi or bus into town Overall a great little airport that punches well above its weight that could serve to much larger airports as an example of good customer service

Great airport for small aircraft Twin OtterCessna used primarily for safari transfers Courteous and friendly staffsecurity as well as satisfactory washrooms and a nice snack bar Wilson airport is a welcome change from the chaos of Jomo Kenyatta Note due to its small size there is no souvenir or duty free shopping

Nice friendly airport Quick check in usually efficient security screening everybody keeps moving Gates are easy to findnavigate Short on food options nice bar after security near Gate Good coffeebagel bar near Gate The new airport is about finished Will be nice to see the improvements Eisenhower is the new airport name excellent choice

Lovely small airport with one of the best views of any Ive ever visited About km from the town but generally one plane at a time so queues transport etc not really an issue Great coffee bar go upstairs for views to die for coffee is also good Planes can go early and beware of the winds when leaving Sympathetically installed to harmonise with landscape as much as an airport can Still need to pay in cash a departure tax about GB Pounds Also dont carry fresh food in hand luggage even if on an internal flight it will be confiscated on arrival due to some strange Argentinean regulations

This is a nice airport people are friendly check in efficient It is a clean airport and it has a nice building with plants and water fonts Brasilia is a modern City and it is airport is like the city just fantastic

Zagreb Airport is a small but clean airport The airport staff were generally friendly helpful and efficient Moderate queuing time Seating area was a bit crowded during busy hours and lacking charging sockets around seats Fast and free WiFi

As a well travelled Belgian who has been to countries and used over different airlines world wide I can tell Uzbekistan Airways really satifisfied me despite the negative reviews I have read over here and other websites Due to the fact that the online checkin wasnt possible not on the website nor on their app we had to be early at the airport to make sure we were seated next to each other From the moment my girlfriend and I entered the air vessel we were welcomed with a smile and notice some Spanish extra cabin crew members to the staff of the flight HY as well as the Uzbeki who also served us in English Our seats on the left side were spacious the meal was suprisingly very varied and rich of side dishes such as extra fruit dessert some burek sauces such as ketchup olive oil and mustard We were served many times with drinks during the flight The cabin crew were very available very caring and had a really nice level of customer service This air vessel had the problem of non working screen entertainments Keep that in mind if you are taking a hour flight or longer Also some of the locals dont really care about queueing correctly as entering the plane as well as embarking the plane even we noticed them being a bit rude towards the airplane staff Also I have to confirm the entire staff showed the safety flight procedures so they value the safety on board If the screens would have been worked I would give a

Small airport arrival was smooth half hour queue at immigration but bags waiting for uson departure ten minutes from check in to be sat at the gate on comfortable seats and soft carpetairport is very clean and did not come across any rude staffin fact they were very polite

I love flying Ontario Airport Its convenient never busy like the LAX nightmare Its small fast and convenient They have China Airlines flights but not many International flights Popular flights to Las Vegas Hawaii and Seattle Nice and clean

Found arrival experience excellent Check in on departure was good and quick Security was good and quick However toilets before security were not good no lock or even handle on gents toilet door Cafe was ok but no toilet After security there where vending machines but if you had no euros you couldnt get anything aircon lacking
Family trip from Montral to Edmonton Boeing Canadian North is a nice airline Food great No inflight Entertainment Beverages and Cabin Service nice It was a calm nonturbulent flight
The most wonderful airline Its the best food i have ever had on a short haul flight I wish they flew to Australia Service was friendly and as someone who is cm tall legroom was ample

The service was simply outstanding on this my first flight with Hainan Airlines Very comfortable business class seat on B provided with plush Sofitel duvet and bedding beyond anything I have received on other airlines Food was excellent many courses and beautifully served Cabin staff service was exceptional friendly and very attentive more than Singapore Airlines and seemed very genuine Onboard entertainment was okay but lacking compared to many airlines Look forward to further flights with this airline

Copenhagen to Keflavk in Saga Class on a MAX Saga Class is Icelandairs take on Business Class comfortable though not quite a true premium offering The seats are spacious with generous pitch though they do not recline into a flatbed That said for a short threehour flight this is hardly a drawback Service was quintessentially Icelandair friendly efficient and professionally businesslike Among options connecting Iceland to Europe and the Nordics Icelandair remains the most comfortable premium choice Complimentary WiFi was a welcome perk for Saga Class passengers though connectivity proved inconsistent

SAPBZEFRS I had two flights with this regional airline this past month Ssmall grand caravan planes but both clean and spotless flights on time crew friendly Due to the size of the aircraft theres no FA on board Price paid fair I do recommend if youre flying to Belize

The airport is wellorganized secure and clean with nearly all services available The crew at Air Mauritius is extremely professional and they go above and above to execute their jobs in a courteous and professional manner Nishi the travel consultantpassenger service is amazing in terms of customer service and taking care of passengers with a smile and enthusiasm

Flew LIAT from Dominica to Martinique via Bridgetown Excellent experience on this regional airline Ground staff in Melville Hall very helpful and attentive on time wonderful flight and all in all great fun

nd largest airport in Philippines has terminals T is for international flights Checkin Level has main banks of Checkin counters AD at the back is the Departures area firstly Passport Control with manned counters and then Security Scanning both of which were quickly achieved Main Departures has the usual array of shops and duty free shops and cafes Some views of the gates and airfield There is lounge which covers most of the carriers premium customers its tired but has a reasonable selection of food on offer and seats with view of the apron Airport busy but did not feel overcrowded

Flew in to SavannahHilton Head International September and departed October Once again an absolute pleasure to use My wife and I use this airport frequently when we travel to Hilton Head Island South Carolina On arrival my wife goes straight to the car rental desks about yards from baggage reclaim and I get the baggage from the belt Baggage retrieval usually takes minutes or so and by this time the car rental formalities have just about been completed The cars are just outside the Terminal doors and in about minutes we are on the Interstate On departure checking in with United Express is a breeze after handing back the rental car and then there is a very pleasant courtyard with retail caf outlets before going through security Even through security there are a surprising number and variety of eating and drinking outlets with a few retail shops Usual caveat if you have a late departure they may not all be open If only all Airports were this charming and nice to use

I used this airport twice over the last two weeks Given the few international flights the international section was uncrowded Immigration was quick and hassle free Security check too was smooth no need to take off shoes or belts or jackets or pull out toiletries The business class lounge is used by all the airlines and it is a quiet place with a buffet of Indian and Bengali foods and a tended bar Limited number of shops and even limited number of eating places There is a duty free liquor shop just after exiting customs and before exiting the airport with a good selection of whiskeys at prices markedly cheaper than in the city All in all a functional airport that is easy to use with only essential facilities

I have never experienced such patience ever since I started travelling I became late because as we got to the airport my year old son fell and injured himself and had to take care of him The two ladies working at the boarding gate that afternoon called me twice to check up and make sure we got onto that flight and waited until the last minute before they closed check in I was in awe of their patience and care for me as a passenger this has never happened to me before especially to go to the extent of calling me Genuinely grateful and can never thank them enough We need more of this kind of understanding with airlines Best flying experience ever

Ribeiro Preto to Curitiba regional airline on a regional flight very nice experience with this type of flight the aircraft and ERJ seats was clean but could be better with a small delay minutes nice board service for an hour flight Theres only one flight attendant there and could have one more because the flight was completely full Im very happy with this new way of flight here in Brazil you can go to many cities without go via So PauloGuarulhos you just have to choose regional flights and go via Campinas or Ribeiro Preto MUCH BETTER good airports clean no delays long delays I recommend Passaredo for other passengers Just one thing if you choose the left seat theres an individual window for you only one seat not or seats like other jets

This is really a different airline The plane was impeccable clean looked young Cabin staff is really amazing taking care and checking during the hole flight Food was exquisite The Samsonite amenity kit was amazing sleek and modern A real pleasure to travel on this airline

One of the better airport experiences in recent times This may be due to this airport not being the big hub type with all its unpleasant experiences that come with it But from curb to boarding everything went smoothly Friendly bar tenders checkin agents emigration officer and security staff A pleasant surprise The building appeared very well designed For urban explorers theres the old brutalism style icon of soviet times next door to explore from outside Only downside is the air conditioning in the air side waiting area too windy and cold

Stunning new terminal friendly staff pleasurable experience only thing missing was the airlines One scheduled flight to Moscow once a week and winter charter flights is not justified hope to see the scheduled operators move in soon

I am grateful to the staff at DEL airport for the cooperation on th Jan Flt noVS I had a problem with my luggage as by mistake I had left a charger battery in my checked baggage One staff member helped me to a great extent to settle the issue The support given to me by her was exemplery

As I live in Belo Horizonte this is the most used airport by me Before the renovation this airport was very bad but now after the renovation it looks great it is clean the queue time is good there are many options for shopping and eating and the airport is spacious The only problem is that it is far from Belo Horizonte city centre

This review is for T Arrival is smooth and quick as there are only few passengers and many open immigration counters There are counters for Chinese passport holders foreign passport holders APEC and crew as with other airports The signs and direction from arrival gate to the immigration baggage customs and exit are all clear A few steps from the immigration is the baggage carousel and then another few steps is the customs counters and then the exit There are taxi bays outside the terminal building and a bust waiting area I am not sure if the airport is connected by a train to the city proper as I did not use nor check it On departure checkin counters a less crowded as it ws an early flight There is a security check upon entering T and then another one after checkin and then a final and more detailed one after immigration There was no long queue and so I made it quick and fast to the boarding area Just at the back of the immigration is Gate which is my boarding gate and opposite it is Starbucks There are only few stores and restaurants Seats are not a problem as there are many empty ones The toilets are clean and well maintained Directions and signs are clear and understandable Visa and Mastecard are accepted The terminal is old but spacious The thermostat just needs to be adjusted as it is warm and it makes me feel uncomfortable The wifi si not working as well Overall I enjoyed this airport as an airplane enthusiast as it gives me a good view for plane spotting while waiting to board

My AirAsia Zest flight was a short flight from Manila to Cebu but a good trip I arrived minutes earlier than scheduled my seats were upgraded for free and my check in luggage arrived on time in the baggage claim Everything was good but unfortunately during my flight they took off the headrest covers on the seats and the head rest looks unclean For money I paid for and the service I got I was satisfied

Flew to FLL days before Christmas The roadway into the airport and the terminal were beautifully decorated for the season For preholiday travel the terminal was busy but not at all crowded There was plenty as seating available as well as plentiful dining options from sit down restaurants to fast food to choose from The terminal is bright and very spacious with plenty of windows through which to see the airfield Even though it was night time one could look out across the well lit airfield and see planes taxing and taking off Going through security was a breeze with TSA Pre clearance

I flew Motor Sich this past July from Kyiv to Odesa and it was a great experience It was on one of their AN s and to my surprise the seats were the most comfortable economy seats I have flown not to mention the most room Also when checking in my bag was a few kilos overweight and they let me check it with no extra charge Would definitely fly Motor Sich again

Decided to fly this route to mainland China instead of my usual HKG Flew from TSAKNH return on what seemed to be a new Embraer E This airline is the domestic offshoot for China Airlines and the English language version of their website is a simple cut and paste from the international airline However the baggage allowance for domestic Taiwanese flights is only KG so I had to really point out that the English information states KG and after some trouble I was able to fly without having to pay extra Despite that the actual flight to and from Kinmen was quick comfortable and care free Only a snack and water was served on the flight but it was only minutes long so it was not an issue I was pleased to have been given the Emergency Exit row on both flights too handy being the taller westerner that I am Except for the baggage allowance issue I can not find fault with them

CVG is my home airport and I have always had a good experience compared with other large cities However I recently returned from a trip and had parked in Long Term parking Previously I had only to walk out the door and across the pick up lane to the well marked shuttle buses and ride to the long term parking Apparently they have revised the whole set up and there is zero accessible signage to direct you to a brand new pick up spot for the shuttle buses There should be a sign at the old spot telling of the new one signage in the actual terminal near where arriving customers will see it as they enter the luggage retrieval area arrows and signage that distinguishes the east and the west pick up areas are for different things eg the East is for Uber etc and the West is for parking shuttles note there is a sign for the bus shuttles in the west end only after you have walked about of the way there once in the line designated for different shuttles there needs to be signage that distinguishes which shuttle lot bus will be stopping where there are at different shuttles stopping in this lane and the bus itself needs to have signage eg long term parking This is such a huge oversight please correct it so you can maintain your excellent reputation

We had airport assistance for my elderly mother and the chap who met us at the plane Giorgious was excellent He spoke very good English and was super courteous and respectful and helpful throughout our transit He took us through immigration and then onto our lounge for a flight to London with Aegean Airlines He knew us by name within an instant and always explained what was happening next He should be celebrated The staff at the boarding gates were also very courteous and respectful as well I cant speak highly enough of everyone we dealt with at Athens Airport Even the ladies serving at the cafe considering how busy it was was excellent friendly and on point Its always a pleasure when you meet good people doing good things Well done Athens airport

I wanted to acknowledge the entire ground staff including the Security who helped us a great deal to arrange boarding the aircraft We reached airport just min before scheduled departure and the checkin was closed After requests since we as a family had to take onward flight from Delhi the ground staff went out of their way to help us
Lots of seating Not enough electric plugs or charge points WiFi was hopeless it didnt work Tannoy too loud Staff seem nice enough Appeared clean

Malaga to Birmingham Originally a Monarch Airlines flight this was operated by Omni Air International chartered in by the CAA The aircraft was excellent and spotless and the comfort was amazing However the reason for my review is the excellent staff They were kind polite helpful considerate and lovely people it was only a short flight from Malaga to Birmingham but we all said that we wished it was a longer flight they gave us drinks and the most lovely toasted sandwiches which were fantastic Please pass on the thanks of the passengers and myself

EMA has always been a great airport for me and my family when we fly out of it Recently I was lucky enough to go to Paphos via EMA and here is my honest review of the experience Check in was amazingly fast with queues bearing in mind we got there at PM Our bags were took and its just a quick stroll to security in which at first the queues seemed long however moved very fast I personally had no issues at all and I do recommend if youre not a frequent flyer or not used to security to watch the informative video provided It helps makes your and everyone elses experience faster and easier Moving on duty free is your typical British airport duty free with a wide range of products Leaving it there was main bars to choose from which I must unfortunately say was not the best for accommodating the amount of users at the airport The queues were huge however the beverages were very nice but if you intend on having more than drink Order your rounds in go Its not worth the wait The airport signs and departure boards are very informative and give a clear indication on where to go The walk to the gate is very short and the longest youll have to walk is no less than mins at max We boarded without hassle and the staff were very kind to all of us who flew One main issue is the WiFi I did pay a pound for WiFi that was not good at all Very slow Thanks for reading and I hope you have a good experience at East Midlands the next time you fly

A very new airport with few flights Lots of parking and an outdoor cafe Checkin easy because it is not very busy once past security the gate area is small but with plenty of seats Duty free is expensive priced in US costa coffee pizza ice creams and a cafe provide more food than at many airports Toilets are clean Free WIFI is good and fast Buses to the planes no airbridges at all Very good for an Egyptian airport

Rhodes to Birmingham We would just like to say a big thank you to all the crew on our aircraft from Rhodes to Birmingham that brought us back on the th September due to Thomas cook not trading anymore The staff was so friendly and professional Thank you once again

Since the new modern terminal was inaugurated traveling to Pristina has become more convenient and a more pleasant experience than before All needed facilities are here in a minimum amount of space But it feels very fresh and airy though The new terminal really is great and pretty much everything has improved since the old terminal isnt used anymore
Nothing to do Old airport looks like some maintenance is needed Not a lot of shops or seating Toilets not clean at all No ventilation in terminal humid Definitely not what I would expect in Nice

Terminal International Departure Efficient passport control and security check within the terminal an incredible amount of dining and bar options for every budget Wonderful new terminal maybe with not many toilet facilities as only negative point

My wife and I flew return trips on Druk Air from Kathmandu to Thimpu for a section of our honeymoon There are very limited options to get in and out of Bhutan so I was a bit concerned about the ability to choose exactly what airline and flights we were going to take However it all went really smoothly We were warned beforehand that the flights are often several hours late ours was close to on time We were told that wed see the Himalayas as we flew past including Mt Everest which we did The crew were courteous and helpful and the food surprisingly good for such a small airline The plane was old but appeared to be well looked after There is no inflight entertainment system so bring a booktablet to keep yourself entertained or read the airline magazine which will mainly feature articles about how much the Bhutanese love their King they are crazy over their monarchy If we are ever lucky enough to go back to Bhutan Id be very happy to fly Druk Air again

Flew to FLL days before Christmas The roadway into the airport and the terminal were beautifully decorated for the season For preholiday travel the terminal was busy but not at all crowded There was plenty as seating available as well as plentiful dining options from sit down restaurants to fast food to choose from The terminal is bright and very spacious with plenty of windows through which to see the airfield Even though it was night time one could look out across the well lit airfield and see planes taxing and taking off Going through security was a breeze with TSA Pre clearance

Hong Kong to Xian Being the second time travelling with Cathay Dragon my impression towards this airline is greatly improved In my flight to Xian except for my IFE that failed to show the flight map everything just went right and nothing special happens the cabin crew also provided good service to us However as things went wrong in the return flight back from Xian to Hong Kong the excellence of the Cathay staff is well demonstrated As the Hong Kong Airport Authority restricted flights from landing in Hong Kong that day after we entered the cabin with the door closed we were still not sure whether we can fly The cabin crew reacted professionally to answer many enquiries from passengers meals were served on ground and we could just wait for further notifications from the pilot Finally the flight was delayed to the next day we were then forced to leave the cabin and went back to the airport the only thing that made me discontented is that there was no any compensation from the airline though the airport restriction issue is not the problem of the airline In the delayed flight next day we saw the same crew and they also showed how professional they are After knowing that it is the birthday of one of our friends they even provided snacks and gifts to us Their quality of service was just awesome and left us very deep impression It is really an unforgettable experience travelling with Cathay Dragon and it is definitely a yes if I have a chance to travel with them once more

Everyone working at the ground services at LPB airport gave us excellent service We somehow missed that we could not board Laos Airline flight to Vietnam without proper documents We had read we could get on arrival visas in Vietnam A staff member helped us considerably instructing and helping us get emergency visas I think we might have missed our flight if it was not for her Just wanted to acknowledge her excellent service

I had two flights with Atlantic Airways Flight Bergen Faroe Islands and Faroe Islands to Copenhagen one week later Both flights on time Comfortable seats clean aircraft good food friendly service I will flight with Atlantic Airways again with pleasure

Birmingham to Amritsar via Ashkabat No nonsense air line Great Indian vegetarian food There was no flight screens no seat screens We stopped at Ashgabat for one hour its nice modern airport with all facilities The good thing was that the time at Ashgabat and time in India is only minute difference

Hilo International Airport was once THE airport on the Big island before Kona International Airport on the other side of the island opened in the ss Now Hilo Airport is a shadow of its former self with jetways no more than of which are in use at any given time The decor is kitschy s Hawaiiana and the terminal is warm and welcoming Hilo is one of the few US airports where the gate area and the ticketingbag claim are in separate buildings separated by an atrium The ticketingbag claim area has a bar a bookshop a souvenir shop selling Hawaiiana and packaged tropical fruit and a lounge area The gate building has no facilities The parking and car rental areas are just across the street from bag claim and the total walk from gate to kerb is only a few hundred feet Access to and from Hilo town is easy and traffic is usually light

I flew from Blantyre airport a number of years ago and was struck by just how quaint the whole set up was It is a very basic airport not far off the common tin shack analogy that comes with most African airports There is very little to do and there is just a bar to distract you The best thing about Blantyre airport is the Duty Free shop A selection so limited it is almost refreshing Malawi Gin Whisky JW Cane spirit macadamia nuts coffee and nick nacks I bought to W light bulbs that had been turned into paraffin lamps Wonderful
The airline was fantastic Left and arrived on time You get a snack provided by the airline Very tasty Would always choose to fly with Air North in the future

Return leg of my round trip Again the great thing about this airline is the departure from Bangkoks main airport rather than the budget terminal across town Check in was done smoothly and boarding is by passenger ramp instead of being bussed about the airfield so is very convenient and quick Flight departed on time and was fairly uneventful Flight arrived minutes ahead of scheduled time The only let down of the journey was deplaning at Ha Noi was by ground service ramp and bus to the terminal

Shanghai to Kota Kinabalu Shanghai Airlines code shares with China Eastern Airline It was a new plane and the flight experience was good Although one of the air steward seems like he hates his job but overall it was a pleasant experience The meals served was exactly the one I was served on my trip to Shanghai Nothing special something to fill an empty stomach The seats are comfortable whereby the headrest was tiltable We were given pillows and blankets on the flight but the flight was kinda warm even though we flew during the night Coming from someone who cannot really stand on cold the flight was really warm Overall it was a pleasant flight nothing special to praise or criticize about at least it got me safe back home

I flew China Airlines from Singapore to Vancouver on the st June by Premier Economy The flight was not very full but dep from Singapore again delayed by minutes Due to this the Airline allows another extra minutes in its schedule We landed at Taipei minutes late only after a wait of hrs took off for Vancouver on the second leg of my journey This flight was unfortunately delayed by minutes at Taipei due to baggage loading issues etc We landed at Vancouver minutes late as a result of the late take off The flight however was very smooth comfortable Cabin Crew was very good cleaned the toilets every hrs so they remained spic span were well stocked Entertainment system was very good though on SingaporeTaipei sector my Screen had no sound I had to change my Seat The food I always eat on flights is AVML Indian Veg Meal this varied in quality SingaporeTaipei meal was very good though it lacked Indian Bread bun provided No Plain Yoghurt I would rate it On the Taipei Vancouver Sector the Dinner was below par only the fine quality basmati rice north indian tasting veg fruits was edibleI would rate this only The breakfast second meal was better as they provided Parotta with Indian cauliflower potato curry cabbage curryboth tasty Again fruits were provided Banana should have been given I would rate this meal No Plain Yoghurt an essential part of every Indian Veg meal was provided Fortunately I always carry my own Yoghurt Indian Pickle packets so I could repair the meals enjoy them I hope China Airlines pays attention to my comments modifies their AVML meals to include more Yoghurt Indian breads in future The Seat was very comfortable with seating in Premier Economy Baggage was well handled no damages was quickly discharged at Vancouver Airport Overall view of China Airlines the Flight can be described as relaxed comfortable with good service ambience A last word on the A Aircraft which in my view is excellent for such a long flight smooth stable very spacious I will continue to fly by China Airlines in my future flights to Asia
This airport has beautiful views of the tarmac and a nice and comfortable lounge with easy check in and very friendly staff The food is amazing with an amazing variety of restaurants

A good experience overall with Eastar Jet flying from Jeju to Gimpo The flight was cheap and easy to book on the airlines website I was sent an email a couple of days before flying Pity it was only in Korean I assumed it to be a routine one that airlines commonly send and assume I was correct as there were no repercussions Baggage is a stingy kg why and mine was I was charged for one extra kilo which seems like taking rules to extremes Everything else was satisfactory Checkin was quick the flight was more or less on time and reasonably comfortable and baggage reclaim quick

Tibet Airlines offered great service and comfortable seating with ample legroom Chengdu to Lijiang is a relatively short flight of hour but crew were very accommodating They had inflight entertainment showing on screens in both English and Chinese Water only served on this flight but would recommend Tibet Airlines

Probably the best island airport in the Indian Ocean Well designed structure the only challenge is the long queue in the immigration hall The authorities need to arrange extra officers during peak timings
Short trip Arlanda to Helsinki Very nice people working on board Cold but nice meal nice experience

Flights to Kefalonia from Athens Arrival smooth with reasonably quick bag delivery Departure less good I felt sorry for the people stuck in a long queue waiting to check in for their charter flight Olympic Air was fairly speedy Terminal facilities are basic at best One shopcafe before security The toilet facilities are dire Very poor signage in the airport domestic departure lane was closed with no instructions to join the long international queue and no gate information once through security However as there are only gates the guess was easy Such a shame that Greek islands have such poor airports for really wonderful places

Outstanding Customer Service from Air China Jakarta Airport Ground Staff On October nd I arrived from Sydney to Jakarta Qantas planning to board within hours on Air China CA to Beijing then to Madrid and Sao Paulo Due to Qantas airplane problems the Qantas flight arrived hours late leaving me with only hours to board Air China Unfortunately Qantas refused to give any assistance to facilitate the very short time for check in Talking to the Indonesia immigration agent he called Air China ground staff who sent an agent with a mission to help meI did not have a Visa on Arrival no boarding card and a checked luggage at Qantas The agent did everything to make me board the Air China flight talked many times to the immigration officers called Air China office to send a letter to the immigration and ran times to the Air China counter to try to solve all bureaucratic issues The agent and other Air China agents issued all documentation needed and ran with me and my luggage through Jakarta terminal be able to catch the flight Boarding the Air China flight CA in such a short time was a small miracle that was possible because of the competence and excellent service of Jakartas Air China ground staff

Nice pleasant airport Checkin usually fast security queue depends on the number of flights departing at the same time Airport gives you everything you need for a quick departure and arrival Before security check one cafe on st floor that opens too late in the morning and closes too early in the evening After security check one cafe no shops Toilet cleanliness depend on the time of the day but worn out

This airport is functional Not what one would expect of an international Airport It is NOT a beacon of luxury as another review indicated Obviously a joke The staff is mostly courteous some are abrupt and seem tolerant with an air of irritation they keep to themselves Definitely not friendly or welcoming I had hours to spend here let me just say if you are hungry get a small snack and hope your flight crew serves you something you can eat One actual restaurant with a long line and I passed by several times to get a view of the food understaffed and very long wait times to get a seat and have food brought to you I saw several tables waiting about minutes without anything The souvenirs mostly cheap junk I passed The decor Missing or dated Interesting picture of a woman serving tea at the Dublin airport in the s I believe ATTENTION ENTREPRENEURS There is a huge opportunity here Travelers with money and nothing really to spend it on Food Souvenirs Coffee Restaurants Even a good bookstore All modern endeavors would make a killing There is one decent coffee place The pastries are not fresh or very good Save yourself for Italy or France I dont normally rate things so poorly and i personally enjoy my time wherever I am and enjoy different experiences This airport though could be so much better with a refreshed management vision Safe travels

Flew Shanghai to Tinajin Although crowded at times in the summer heat everything went well Checkin queues were very long I was lucky to check in at one of the numerous golden pass counters as have been invited by my companion Although Hongqiao is for domestic flights it is not difficult for a foreigner like me to have the right orientation Airport is clean and very clear and correspond to high international standards

Flew GA Amsterdam to Jakarta from Madrid Spain GarudaIndonesia had arranged with the Schiphol VIP Center to meet me at the plane door upon arrival from Madrid and I was taken to the VIP centre for check in security and immigration formalities This is a great service as it bypasses all queues Within the VIP Lounge at Schiphol Airport there are full service including a full Al La Cart dining When I it came time to board the aircraft I was assisted by a member of the VIP team that took me by car to the aircraft stairs At the aircraft door I was meet by the cabin crew Fauziah Pradita Maurenia Ade Indrawati and Chef Aris Gumilar who give me a very warm welcome and guided me to my seat The First Class Team gave outstanding service from boarding in flight dining and general overall service There was a very good selection of food for both evening meal and for breakfast The meals can be served on demand however as I wanted to have some sleep I requested my meal two hours after takeoff The quality portion and presentation of the food was outstanding There was quite some turbulence throughout the flight however I still had an excellent sleep We were slightly delayed arriving in Jakarta but this was caused by the delay in departing Schiphol as it is over minutes taxi to the remote runway When I arrived in Jakarta I was meet at the aircraft door by Yudi from the First Class Team who help and assisted me through immigration luggage collection and through customs and out to a car provided by GarudaIndonesia to take me to my home I used the onboard Wi Fi and connectifity and speed was excellent This was another excellent flight and I thank the Cabin crew for their outstanding service

As AC has given up this route we again flew with this Lufthansa subsidiary from YYC to FRA and on to Venice Boarding went smoothly as AC staff now handle this aspect for Eurowings which they didnt do last year The plane left and arrived on time which allowed us to make our connection with Lufthansa Cabin crew were very helpful and fluent in both English and German The seating in business class in and the seats were very comfortable As we chose the evening flight we were able to sleep for a number of hours The seats recline into a fully flat position Comfortable blankets and pillows were provided The food was excellent with a choice of three entrees A fairly good selection of movies was available All in all a much better experience than the one we had last year Lufthansa must be having success with this route as there are now two flights daily from YYC to FRA I find it curious that AC gave up this route

I had a heartbreaking day on my departure day So when I was checking in at Delta I was crying actually more like bawling Well I wasnt at first but when Ms Carol asked me how was my day tears just fell and couldnt stop itfelt heavyso I really appreciate that question a lot she gave me some small talk which made me open up a bit and thats when I started crying She didnt have to continue comforting me but she did and I felt it in my heart Ms Ammi saw me crying and offered me some juice and orange and a Chocolate cupcake and also comforted me despite how busy they were They are the best strangers Ive encountered at that moment too for the longest time and that made me feel way lighter So I think its not about the place or the airline its the people that works within a truly unforgettable experience even though that was a month ago I am talking about the Ground staff of Delta Airlines in Baltimore Airport They did their jobs with passion and understanding and I salute them all

This was the busiest I had ever seen Sydney Airport but things ran smoothly the staff were very efficient getting everyone through security and was very impressed to how friendly the security staff were that is really appreciated I was also impressed when my flight with Air New Zealand was ready to board they called the Business class passengers first and policed it by checking everyones boarding pass which is good as one pays a lot more money for Business Class so should have the privilege When departing Auckland it wasnt policed hence so many more people were in the line An impressive airport overall

I have a been a frequent traveler of AustinBergstrom Airport AUSKAUS since the airport opened back in I have seen the airport grow and change over the years The changes over the years have been for the better Notable things about AustinBergstrom International AUS there are two terminals the main Barbara Jordan terminal where all the restaurants lounges and stores are and the South Terminal currently Allegiant and Frontier Airlines there is a family viewing area outside the airport for watching planes and having a picnic There are currently lounges AA UA DL and a Chase Sapphire Terrace there are many good places to eat including many local restaurants my favorite are Taco Deli Salt Lick BBQ Second Bar Kitchen Annies and Juiceland it takes about minutes to walk from one end of the terminal to the other along the way you will see lots of places to eat drink and shop Pros clean great dining bars and rest areas The Delta lounge is the nicest lounge in the airport Cons restaurants close early so if you arrive on a lateish flight you will not have food options

A rather small airport serving Firenze I used the airport in the winter season so imagine it during the busy summer season Theres bus boarding only and max small gates It has a abundance of dutyfree shops and food beverages counters Prices are reasonable Staff is friendly and efficiently working

DubaiKabulDubai The price of tickets is very high It costs more to get to Kabul than to the UK from Dubai Kam Air were OK on this trip It was a MD both ways and were were almost on time The only problem was the return because of some stupid security procedures in the airport They apologised for that though it was not their fault Neither flight was full so was able to get a row to myself which helps Kam Air along with Safi is still the best way to get to Kabul from Dubai
It was a really nice flight friendly people started on time and regular updates from the crew The airplane itself was very clean and entertainment on board was provided

Not much to complain about nowadays there is bus service offered by Centrotrans bus company and GRAS as well from airport to down town Personnel at checkin counter need to be more friendly for example our flight to GOT via BUD was cancelled by Malev but we were issued tickets to fly with Austrian and people at checkin counter were making faces exhaling loudly while printing boarding passes for flight via VIE
No problem with this airline Pleasant onboard service Schedule respected Aircraft ESSAA leased from an Estonian company Very good experience

Gatwick to Denver I was placed on a Wamos flight by Norwegian and almost cancelled due to all the terrible reviews but I didnt find it that bad at all We brought our own movies to watch and our own food which I normally do on a flight anyway as I like healthy stuff Ive had worse legroom on other flights and the staff were more friendly and helpful than many others Ive known and I fly a lot The plane was pretty old but perfectly functional The staff were so great that I told them Id write a review because I felt that the pasting theyre getting online is unfair and makes us travellers look rather spoilt to be honest

Landvetter airport is a rather small one well organized and neat Security checks have seldom long queuing and are generally fast Lots of toilets are available very clean with taps to fillin bottles with water So do not hesitate to pass security with an empty bottle Shopping options are limited as the airport is small but the choice is more than correct This airport seems well managed

I highly recommend traveling out of COS if you live in Pueblo Colorado Springs even Denver COS is a very cozy and convenient airport with easy parking checkin security and baggage claim Its main terminal has gates so it isnt at all huge but it is a very comfortable size In the past several years the planes flying into and out of COS have sadly gotten smaller think regional jets and the routes served are mostly to hub cities That said I would personally rather fly out of COS and connect than drive the extra hour and a half to DEN and fly nonstop because it is a lot less stressful The airport recently purchased new furniture for each gate area and it is a vast improvement They even have padded benchs in the center of the terminal that you can lie on and sleep before you fly This little extra is great because lets face it when people come from sea level to ft it is nice to lie down and adjust to the high altitude That said one downfall of COS is its lack of shops and restaurants though the variety isnt horrible The free WiFi throughout the terminal though helps compensate for this shortfall

Great experience using Norwich airport Efficient and cheerful checkin personnel Compact WH Smith outlets land and airside Fast friendly and helpful security people Sweet little duty free Great hotcold snacksdrinks areas Lots of seating with airfield and runway view Downside was no development fee spent on arrivals Walk from aircraft hoping its not raining then queuing under draughty plasticcovered outside waiting area before clearing customs Not good TIP On arrival phone whoever is picking you up to let them know youve arrived its best if they wait for you away from the airport Most planes arrive late so the minute parking fee becomes

Kalmar is a small regional airport Only gates but we have to walk out to the planes the same way Only a few airlines serve this airport The staff are friendly and efficient and the mood is quite cosy There is actually no stress and the place seem to be very relaxed There is a small bar and a small tax free shop which is open only when there are some international departures mainly some charter to Mediterranean destinations Main airlines using this airport are SAS and BRA for domestic flights mainly to Stockholm SAS to Arlanda and BRA to Bromma BMA The airport is clean even the toilets are of a high standard Even though this airport lacks a lot of things it is one of my favourites

I found that I couldnt make my Ryanair flight back to London and to my astonishment found a BA flight to London City my favourite airport for euros The flight was on time and very good My one slight hesitation is that I wish BA had told me that I couldnt check in online at San Sebastian Other than that I have no complaints Indeed at the airport I asked the checkin desk if they might block the seat next to me and they agreed Once on board I drank wine and ate a snack and was very content If only flying was always like this

In spite of a delay of one hour at LHR the flights to and from Australia were the most pleasant that I have made on this route The cabin service is outstanding and my dietary requirements diabetic were met and were some of the best I have ever eaten The cabin crew at all times were top class

A brand new airport which is large and spacious but lacking in facilities Our gate was in an area where there is no catering and no access to a part of the airside where we could even get a coffee Staff are not all that friendly here but it seems to be efficient with little queuing though not all the many flights either
A small but full service airport Doesnt have some of the amenities of larger airports but you would not expect them Clean Great service Short wait times Highly recommended

We were initially a bit disappointed when Etihad did not use its own aircraft on the route between Abu Dhabi and Jakarta but used wetleased Wamos equipment However the entire experience was good Clean and spacious plane with pleasant configuration so ideal if you are traveling with people The staff was professional and friendly They carried out very thorough safety checks before departure and landing The only real downside was the entertainment Little choice and that should really be different no flash path information Furthermore only praise for Wamos A Basic experience on time and comfortable

Ive seen a lot of bad reviews of this airport but I wanted to reassure people that the airport is not as bad as it seems Most of the travel crisis in July was not the airports fault Yes it is slightly run down but the service was excellent and it serves as a good base for EasyJet and Jet Security was a breeze and Jet queues were non existent I actually found the toilets clean and the airport was clean with clear signs to the gate and there was no delays I am sorry if you had a bad experience during the travel crisis but with more airlines joining in I can only assume the airport will improve Jet has locations from Belfast I found it clean convenient and will travel again with Jet next year Staff were polite even when I accidentally left my aftershave in my hand luggage going through security They gave me a plastic bag to put it in and were friendly with me Ive never had any problems with the airport The other thing is the Northern Ireland economy isnt Dubai economy so its not
