The food wasnt that great and theres no inflight entertainment but we were comfortable and had our iPods With regards to the cleanliness of the aircraft weve been on worse We found the cabin crew to be friendly their English is not great and they all had smiles I think if you expect high standards from a star airline youre bound to come home and write negative reviews Overall we were happy with what we got

The terminal offers an array of restaurants and shops which gives passengers a well rounded experience The security was smooth and quick with just only a few passengers waiting in line The airport has a very white theme which makes the interior very bright Staff at the airport are generally helpful and able to speak basic to intermediate level of English I had troubles connecting to the WiFi network I asked the airport staffs to help me out because they couldnt figure out the reason of not being able to connect the WiFi All in all Bahrain Airport is one of the nicest airports to travel in addition to Doha and Muscat Airports
A small but friendly airport which is quite central The facilities are adequate for the size of the country It is clean and tidy and the staff are helpful

Bloemfontein airport is currently undergoing improvements to its buildings and facilities This is with a view to the FIFA Soccer World Cup to be held in South Africa I love this little airport because there is an air of excitement and a bustle of activity While the upstairs cafeteria is undergoing improvements there is a downstairs cafeteria where refreshments may be purchased The airport personnel are some of the friendliest i have ever met Their are ample parking and car rental facilities available

LHR T BA Gold Wing worked well Pleasant check in and very fast security screening Concorde room service attentive C gate boarding OK but nothing special for First Passengers Latest BA version of first with only suites with privacy doors Comfortable seat with plenty of stowage Good screen and good choice of IFE Amenity kit good quality and bedding pillows cushions and blankets all good Excellent menu and food very well presented Cabin crew could not have been more attentive and helpful without being obtrusive On time departure and early arrival Bags delivered relatively swiftly and priority tagged bags were first off All in all one of the best BA First flights Ive had in many years Whilst not touching the Middle Eastern carriers BA First on this showing is easily the best way to cross the Atlantic

Very small airport with not many destinations to fly to from Free parking in front of airport very fast check in One restaurant coffee shop with nice local food Arriving at Antwerp airport it will take you around to after disembarking until you receive your suitcase and are in a taxi home
I just experienced Asiana Airlines Business class food delicious flight attendants good service I give stars because flight is delay minutes and does not have wiFi

Hong Kong Airport has not lost its lustre beauty elegance cleanliness And its employees are highly professional respectful and friendly Every time I travel through it I discover something new and this time I discovered the following A breathtaking and Epic view from the Sky Deck In late Hong Kong International Airport opened its new Sky Bridge a metrelong bridge built metres above the ground This is the worlds longest bridge over an active runway allowing even an Airbus A to pass underneath This bridge allows passengers and aviation lovers to enjoy breathtaking panoramic views of the airports aircraft movement and watch aircraft take off land and pass beneath them an experience unparalleled at any other airport If you are travelling through Hong Kong Airport you must visit this bridge

We travelled to Dubrovnik out of season so unsure what it would be like during the summer season when it is significantly busier What we did experience was a very clean modern stateoftheart airport that has been built and designed to an excellent standard It feels premium and polished not something I expected if I am honest before setting of on our holiday Arrival was very simple walked off plane on to a beautiful bright glass airbridge and into modern terminal structure made of glass and metal Immigration was quick and efficient not overly friendly but not antagonistic either We were airside probably within minutes from leaving the plane There is only one shuttle that goes to the city and it meets each flight leaving half an hour after each flights arrival and the cost was reasonable On Departure the checkin hall is bright and airy and the checkin staff for BA were friendly and helpful Security was a breeze and staff seemed generally fine we were the only flight taking off that evening though so it was very quiet The departure area was clean and well organised there isnt a lot of shopping opportunities or much to do but it is a small airport so that wasnt expected Do be aware of the extortionate prices charged by cafs for water you can buy it cheaper in some of the dutyfree shops at more reasonable cost Also only minutes of free wifi stingy and charging for more in this day and age is deeply odd These niggles aside however overall quite impressed

My jewel among low cost airlines Courteous efficient and highly safety oriented cabin crew Very enjoyable flying experience thru out Every time the washroom had been used the crew checked it for cleanliness Great public announcements

The airport is much improved since I was last here in Arrivals not much to say there was just my flight in so the baggage queue was pretty tame Departure check in was a breeze even though there were three flights due to depart that morning There is free wifi and plenty of seating The new terminal building is spacious and modern with a nice outside seating area overlooking the runway and apron Security was also a breeze with only a very small queue and security staff seemed pleasant enough No air bridge though so if its raining you have a couple of minutes walk before you get to your aircraft Overall a nice little airport

DubaiKabulDubai The price of tickets is very high It costs more to get to Kabul than to the UK from Dubai Kam Air were OK on this trip It was a MD both ways and were were almost on time The only problem was the return because of some stupid security procedures in the airport They apologised for that though it was not their fault Neither flight was full so was able to get a row to myself which helps Kam Air along with Safi is still the best way to get to Kabul from Dubai
It is clean modern spacious and well designed The efficiency of security is high The WiFi connection is good Employees are helpful and polite

I fly this airline regularly between Yellowknife and Edmonton Staff is generally friendly and the complimentary food service is a nice touch but generally inedible Unfortunately they have the tendency to change your seats without notice and you will not find out until checkin time Much of the reason for this change is that if they notice a flight is only half booked they use half of the plane for cargo which eliminates the first rows of seats Thus when booking on Canadian North make sure you book the back row of seats between and you likely wont have to worry about your seat being changed Prepare to be packed in like sardines on most Canadian North flights though Seat pitchwidth is standard

Birmingham to Zurich I am an incredibly nervous flyer and was flying at weeks pregnant so much more anxious than usual When I checked in the airline immediately clocked that I was pregnant and told me to come and queue up with priority customers even though I was flying economy When I did they showed me to a seat to sit in while I waited for the coach which was so helpful and kind On the plane the hostess noticed my anxiety during takeoff and throughout the flight they checked in with me constantly with such patience and kindness offering me a bottle of water to sip and calm my breathing down giving comforting reassurances at the slightest sign of turbulence and before we landed coming and offering a little cuddly toy plane for my unborn baby The genuinely caring nature of all the staff was absolutely superb and such an enormous comfort to a more vulnerable person I was so grateful and thoroughly impressed with every staff member involved at each step of the way

I flew United from San Francisco to Melbourne and returned from Sydney in Polaris Overall it was a positive experience The Polaris lounge at SFO is superb and a great start The product on United is among the best The seat is comfortable and the entertainment options plentiful Both crews were pleasant and accommodating The main downfall was the food The menus were uninspired and the presentation was subpar for a business class service The taste was ok but compared to the competition they fell well below the mark For instance the breakfast had a bowl of cut up fruit that was less interesting that what I make at home We were fed but with little originality or style If they could improve this offering they would truly rate with some of the best Too bad

Pokhara to Kathmandu I received very good service by Yeti Airlines at Pokhara and Kathmandu airport on st Dec Due to fog my flight was delayed I had a connecting flight to Delhi from Kathmandu to Delhi at The Staff at Pokhara Airport were very helpful to my request to advance my booking to an earlier flight and ensured my luggage was loaded in the cabin itself so that I could get it first when I landed at Kathmandu At Kathmandu the staff unloaded my luggage and took me in the small van to the terminal so I could leave the airport quickly I would rate this as excellent service On my next trek in Nepal I would fly this airline again

Please note booking was made directly with Etihad Trip started great with a visit to Etihads excellent lounge at Term at LHR It became time for boarding and it was clear the flight was going to be delayed Etihad ground staff did their best to keep us informed and they had a large number of staff at the gate to answer questions We were assured that any missed connections would be dealt with in AUH and we departed about hours late The A is as always an excellent plane and the seat and staff were to match on this flight Etihad offers dine on demand and I opted for a sandwich prior to landing in order to get some sleep I did connection to the wifi prior to getting some rest and about minutes after take off I received an email stating I had been rebooked to a later flight from AUH to BKK I was able to accept the rebooking and get my boarding pass within an hour of taking off from LHR The seat is excellent both for sittinglounging and sleeping Staff were on the ball and offered me food as soon as I woke up At AUH ground staff were waiting for us with a number of counters set up with preprinted boarding cards for passengers with missed connections All you had to do was go to the right counter and get your onwards boarding card I skipped all that and went straight to the impressive business class lounge at AUH and spent a few hours there before my connecting flight A B took me the last leg to BKK The seat consistency Etihad has across their wide body fleet is impressive and gives a familiar feel regardless of the aircraft type Once again staff were excellent The only downside I could find on this flight was they have cut the prelanding snack service but the flight is relatively short so not a massive issue Overall a very enjoyable flight despite arriving at my destination about hours later than expected but I wish all airlines would handle delays that well big praise to Etihad on this one The only place they have fallen down a bit is they have not proactively offered me compensation as I am intitled to and finding that on their website is not straight forward however once the process is started it is very quick and easy

HELCPHHEL HELCPH on Avro RJ ontime both ways Clean aircraft crew and service are nothing special but seats comfortable and spacious in the x configuration CPHHEL on B food for purchase in both directions drinks free In general this is competitive to SAS on the same sector but definitely a lowcost feel without a particularly lowcost price

A short but enjoyable flight Staff were friendly and helpful Check in was easy and the plane left on time A small snack was provided which is fine on so short a flight They also offered free beer and wine which was a nice surprise

Flew on th of February Checkin staff in Miami was the best I ever experienced Fast friendly efficient pleasant Travelled with pet in cabin all formalities were dealt with rapidly and in a friendly way Boarding rapidly inflight crew very friendly We got the feeling that the flight attendants had pride in their job Food offering very good however service could have started slightly earlier Flight left delayed due to late arrival of incoming flight snow storm in Toronto But as we got an email from Porter advising of the delay we were able to leave to the airport later All in all a nice experience

Security thorough and lines short thrilled to find that one of the TV monitors at the Southwest gates showed the local PBS channel a nice alternative to the usual cable news and sports programming Custodial staff cleaned gate areas twice in one hour Spacious naturally lit gate area was a nice oasis from usually crowded departure areas

PM on a Monday night no restaurants open other than fast food No beerwinecocktails available in the whole airport even outside of security I just busted my butt working for four days at my elderly parents yard and flying home sore but happy to have spent time with them Four days of hard labor vacation and I cant relax with a beer and a burger

Geneva to Zurich I was a bit nervous about flying with this airline because of bad reviews but my experience was the complete opposite True boarding was done a bit late but we took off only minutes after scheduled departure time and landed minutes before scheduled time which means the flight was only mins Despite the short flight time passengers were handed a pack of small biscuits and a brioche together with a ml bottle of water each Seating on the Saab is x which means that the passenger sitting on the left hand side of the aircraft gets a window AND the aisle in economy class Truly stunning morning views of the Swiss Alps during sunrise The Saab aircraft is a small turboprop aircraft which is pretty fun to fly on for true aviation enthusiasts like me Cabin pressure is good and the noise level is a bit higher than on other aircraft but thats quite cool for av geeks Definitely better than what I was expecting and I recommend this great airline and the Saab

Luang Prabang Airport arrival was late at night so almost everything was closed It was a little hectic with long lines probably because I was arriving on a larger international flight and everyone self included were queueing for visa on arrival It was fine once I stood around very informal No one is pleasant or unpleasant The taxi stand drivers did rip me off but only by its a set fare which I didnt know Leaving from Luang Prabang was lovely I arrived about two hours in advance Check in and security was a breeze It was about noon and everyone was friendly I was glad to have a glass of wine in the bar and some excellent lunch surprisingly good honestly and the WiFi worked too I even did a bit of shopping in the small stalls since amazingly the prices were not all that marked up compared to other parts of Laos I was there long enough to get a good sense of real prices They even had a small bookstore and I got tons of cheap snacks and some duty free Lao Lao to bring home Everything about this airport while not the cleanest in the world or with the greatest signage was easy and fine I liked it overall very much It was selfexplanatory

Our flight was on time checkin was smooth The staff on board were friendly I highly recommend this airline despite several negative reviews I think it is much better than many European low cost airlines Il nostro volo stato puntuale il checkin stato veloce Il personale a bordo stato cordiale Consiglio vivamente questa compagnia aereanonostante le diverse recensioni negative penso sia molto meglio di molte low cost europee
Very new very clean lots of natural light Easy and fast arrivals process Departure area spacious

Juan Santamara International Airport has gotten much better over the years Clean and modern The arrival process customs and immigration are as smooth as they can be Departures are easy too they could do better with the Exit Tax process long lines and no where to fill out the forms I understand some airlines will start allowing you to pay in advance which is excellent The food inside the terminal is ridiculously expensive I paid for a fast food breakfast sandwich I still dont understand why they have to check each carryon bag again at the gate when we were just screened and xrayed going through security It just slows the boarding process down

A first class airport with a good range of facilities There does not seem to be the usual hectic atmosphere of most airports bringing back the pleasure into flying Decent food at non ripoff prices particularly recommend the caferestaurant on the mezzanine floor

A very small airport that mainly serves Trieste Udine Gorizia and the western part of Slovenia More similar to a train station as it often happens for small airports A few shops that mainly sell local food and wine a very small duty free and a couple of bars It also features a small but comfortable lounge

Yangon to Mandalay Really good flight the seating was and actual seat numbers given on boarding pass plenty of space even at inflight catering offered light snack and good coffee Nothing to worry about despite ATR aircraft type and would definitely fly again

Great airline punctual The cabin crew is very welcoming and provides excellent service Excellent flight tracking with announcements from the captain Great loyalty program with MegaVolotea Super compagnie ponctuel Le personnel naviguant est trs accueillant et propose un super service Bon suivi de vol avec des annonces micro du commandant de bord Super programme de fidlit avec megavolotea

Newark to Paris As a result of the delays in receiving their ALR aircraft Premera air contracted EuroAtlantic to fly the Newark ParisCDG routeThe check in took about mins as it was a full flight It took about mins to get through security at Newark due to the lack of TSA staff and screening equipmentThe seats were comfortable ahd a personal TV screen in each seat which had a limited selection of films and TV shows There was also a USB port to charge personal devices There were no headphones offered on board luckily we had our own set The scheduled flight time was hrs mins we took off about mins late but we managed to arrive on time into CDG The EuroAtlantic staff were friendly and attentive and looked after the passengers on the flight Meals and drinks were provided to those passengers who booked their meals through the Primera air website Overall this flight was great value for money

This airport is located in a train station next to it which is pretty cool but can cause major traffic getting in to it The inside is clean and well kept with plenty of restaurants Security is just ok not many lines open so it can take a long time to get through The issue I have like most Chinese airports is that they dont use the jetways much and make you walk out on tarmac and take buses sometimes to and from aircraft In our case it was in the rain which made for an uncomfortable trip Not sure why when jetways were open and they have enough but from what I can tell is that when the plane is not to depart after landing it gets stored over night and if you fly in later at night you will have to take bus so I try to avoid night flights into this airport

Work required me to go on very short notice to London so I decided to fly with VLM which offers you three flights per day from Antwerp to London City with their Fokker Decided as well to fly from Antwerp as they offered reasonable prices for their flights while my usual airlines I usually take from Amsterdam or Rotterdam were extremely expensive for just flying of less than a hour Arriving a touch early at Antwerp Airport checkin and security were quite quiet so it was just a matter of a few minutes to pass both checkin and security while waiting to board Very small airport so dont expect much to do after security Once the aircraft was ready to board it was just minutes to be fully ready to start up and depart The Fokker they were using was surprisingly neat and clean from the inside for an aircraft of this age and was quite spacious to stand in the aisle After an ontime departure out of Antwerp the flight was quite smooth and the flight attendant started to serve us with a complimentary drink and snack of your choosing while the flight crew kept us up to date about their procedure into London City and the estimated time of arrival which to me was well done Turbulence appeared into approach of London and landing was ontime The most surprising factor of the flight was that the noise was quite low for a turboprop within the cabin After a ontime landing the boarding was quickly done in a safe and mannerly matter and all that was left was to wait for our luggage to arrive on our belt which probably was the longest wait

SJO is a very modern airport immigration is friendly but asks to see all your papers come prepared if you do not hold your tickets carpeted floor free wifi Internet expensive gift shops and food carts taxi fare is high usd for a minutes drive before checking in you must pay departure tax it now costs usd you can pay with credit card overall good experience I will be back in the summer

Jan From TLVVKOALA TSEVKOTLV All flights on B but the last flight to TLV onboard B Food is really pathetic Im usually not picky with airline food but this time all segments were awful in quantity and quality Flight attendant mostly nice and accommodating The flight from VKO to ALA was on a brand new B with IFE and WIFI so it was much fun all the rest segments were without IFE Seats are leather and quite comfortble Flights departed mostly on time despite deicing in every station but TLV Fare was good VKO airport new and welcoming All in all a good deal

Manchester to Lanzorote We booked our flight with TUI but they changed to Privilege because of an issue I had a year old and year old with me The staff on board were amazing They were friendly great with my children and when my year old was crying before take off they came to play with her distracting her My year old went to the front to play with the staff at one point of the flight I found the seat comfort fine it was clean and just what I expected If I knew the names of these staff I would have contacted the airline direct and thanked them personally

I want to commend staff at Alicante airport on what was my first airport visit post covid Arriving and departing was prompt and hassle free When I accidentally broke a mug at the Starbucks counter the staff were just concerned about how I was feeling Also the girl at the EasyJet gate took my postcards which I had forgotten to post and promised to post them for me They all arrived eventually so thank you
The plane was in a good condition even for an old plane Both flights were on time On the minute flight there was no service Staff of the airline were professional and quick at check in No echeck in
Quite amazing that Bangkok Airways manages to serve a warm meal with drinks and coffee on a minutes full flight free of charge Even though the food wasnt very special but still edible it impressed me

Miami to Brussels On this Boeing plane Jetairfly has a separate cabin called comfort class and I was able to book seats there for an extra fee Only seats in this cabin with FAs doing a great job Seats configuration in xx while regular economy is xx Legroom was very good After take off we were offered Champagne followed by a hot meal together with wine coffee and digestif Before landing breakfast was served I would recommend this airline if you can get seats in this cabin

Modern and clean airport The transit is really strange like you have to get into China and leave China again Came from Beijing to Singapore via Shenzhen Convenient airport lot of shops reasonable price airports many eateries Western Chinese Easy to find your way to the gate Ground staff do not smile

The wheelchair assistance at Mumbai Airport was exceptional From the moment my parents landed on an early morning flight they received excellent support through immigration and luggage collection ensuring a smooth and hasslefree process A special thanks to the young gentleman whose name I unfortunately cant recall for his kind assurance and attentive care Truly appreciated the respectful and seamless experience Highly recommend their service

I Flew on flight TK on the th February from Istanbul to Bangkok which was an excellent business class flight experience The food on board was as usual very good indeed as was the superb service provided by cabin crew hostess Grulsah She was extremely friendly and very professional for which I would like to thank her for If I had one perhaps negative comment to make and that is regarding the dated seating layout on the airbus A Which with a layout of doesnt provide much in the way of privacy and should if possible be changed to a layout That aside the flight itself arrived into Bangkok exactly on time Highly recommended

I flew in one of Sky Expresss ATR aircraft from Kythira to Athens The ground staff at Kythira airport and flight attendants were very friendly and professional The aircraft was old but clean and comfortable enough Boarding was completed on time and the door closed That the takeoff was delayed by an hour was not the airlines fault A clearly annoyed pilot explained that there was some sort of lightning air traffic control strike at least that is what the other passengers told me because the explanation given by the clearly annoyed pilot was given only in Greek Otherwise the flight was perfectly enjoyable and I have no complaints about the airline Inflight service on the minute flight consisted of a predeparture sweet a bottle of water and a small biscuit
It is clean modern and spacious Employees are friendly and helpful Goods in the shops are bountiful and various Signposts are clear WiFi connection is stable

Thoroughly enjoyed our experience Friendly staff seats felt spacious Delicious meals Our inter island flights were great too loved being able to disembark through both doors Take note interisland flights have lower weight for carry on but checking a bag is free so it was just fine

Pleasant small airport Excellent parking far far nicer than Alicante and better than Murcia San Xavier Its in Spain so some Brits may find things a little slow but nothing is slow enough to annoy any but the really intemperate We like it and will use it as our Andalusian airport of choice for as long as we can

Small airport dealing mostly with flights within Canada and USA Security was quick and easy no language problems either and we were through into the departure lounge which only has a shop and cafe but does have good free wifi to give you something to do while you wait A good experience

Even though I had done my web check in successfully I got notified few days before my flight that the airline was looking for volunteers to go for an alternate flight with the amount credited for that flight accordingly for those who were willing to be flexible I did not use that as I had to travel on this flight back to CCU Unfortunately I also got news of my flight being delayed from the original departure time of to now and then more delayed till due to the delay of the incoming flight from Mangalore As a compensation at the time of boarding the staff provided a bag of chips and chocolates which was a nice touch We did try to make up for the time enroute though I believe IndiGo handled the delay well keeping everyone informed and also providing that little snack chololates bag as compensation which was appreciated

The seats in the Terminal waiting areas are very comfortable The security process looked ominous at first but I was constantly moving and when it came time for the scan I did not have to take off my belt or shoes and got through the security process comfortably I wish Portland Airport was like that

XIYCTUAUH Arrived from Xian on domestic flight in Terminal which was newly opened in Spring All very clean and tidy with clear signs in Mandarin and English Quite a long walk to Baggage Reclaim for the furthest gates but not unreasonable Toilets clean and plentiful with both squat and regular options For International Departures there are main dining options before Checkin either KFC or local Chinese food There are a few stores selling various local foods and some souvenirs CheckIn pretty good and Passport Control and Security all pretty smooth No requirement to remove belts or laptops for security scanning but do enforce the ml liquid rules from Europe In the International Departures no dining opportunities but a couple of coffeeshop options along with the usual array of Duty Free shops Most departures are from one of the airbridges Announcements made in both Chinese and English Toilets are clean

I was stopped by the airport because i had a problem with my passport the bluebird staff did everything to help me get on the plane on time The staff ran with me to the place where they make you a new passport and the Security head took me in his car to the airplane they all did a great effort to let me fly to my destination and not cancel it Thank you guys

While I found the Jacksonville airport to be very clean with exceptionally friendly professional employees my review is regarding one in particular His name is Alejandro a wheelchair provider for people departing and arriving at the airport I first met him on October when I arrived at JAX He was prompt friendly and a very nice person Well when I left JAX I ran into Alejandro again and he recognized me after a week and all the people hed met He was so pleasant I have required wheelchair assistance when traveling for over years and Alejandro is hands down the best

Fortaleza Praia February The flight was operated in a reasonable B by no means new but not as rickety as I had been led to believe The seating was alleconomy and the leather seats fine but slippery Seat pitch was OK and I am a tall chap certainly an inch or more greater than its competitors The flight departed minutes late at and due to the hour I declined the meal offered which looked bland but edible We arrived in Praia on schedule and my bags did the same connecting to Sal and Mindelo without delay All in all a reasonable experience

I expected the worst but to my surprise its one of the smoothest flight I have ever hard Everything was good other than the seats that needs a mattress to make them comfortable for sleeping The staff were good I will fly it anytime I prioritise feeling safe

The negative reviews of this airport have been highly exaggerated Bangladesh is a third world country so no its not quite up to the standards one would expect from a big international airport but its really completely fine I did not have any trouble getting through immigration or customs and didnt have to pay any bribes nor was I ever approached by someone who attempted to bribe me The Bangladeshi people are the best part of Bangladesh and thats true of the airport as well at least from the perspective of an English speaker Many of the staff speak English and were all polite friendly and welcoming The airport was reasonably clean and there were a few bugs though its not infested by any means Theres plenty of space It can get a little hot though as it is poorly airconditioned but its not any worse than any other airport in other poor countries Once you are out of the official airport you do need to be careful because there are some scammers mostly unaffiliated with the airport running around who will try to get you to put your bags on their carts and then charge you exorbitant fees to get your bags back As usual when travelling to a place with a lot of poverty dont engage with these people and you will be fine

The airport is mostly new after months of renovation and expansion As usual now both domestic and intl passengers undergo passport control and customs either departing or arriving Make sure when departing to get your tourist permit and your passport stamped Immigration personnel were friendly but the lady at Customs wasnt I usually get immigration cleared at the land border point when coming from San Diego but the office at the border closes at night TIJ Immigration is so no worries for late nightearly morning flight Checkin is a bit messy though not slow with Volaris the largest tenant but otherwise smooth with other carriers If you fly Aeromexico well lets say Ive enjoyed better lounges than theirs at terminal A Better spend time at the terminals Starbucks Food is the airport biggest failure small gates too perhaps I believe with nothing other than the aforementioned cafe and some overpriced bad tasting and cramped restaurants Terminal B isnt any better at food its upside is a great local wine shop Free wifi available everywhere

I chose this airline for the simple reason of its aircraft type Boarding was completed quickly for on time departure On board seat pitch was a little tight snack service box was offered water and a sweet coffee bun and a sales trolley after that Cabin was quite warm and no walk though by cabin crew offering water Cabin is showing it age for sure but still enjoyed my flight

The TSA crew at this airport are notoriously overwrought I was a TSA precheck customer with a carry on bag It contained a sewing machine which had to be nitrite screened These folks for all the years Ive been traveling there to visit my daughter make the most of their authority Its become a source of jest as it appears they need to justify their existence by overdoing the job to the point of inconsequential increments Where is the common sense The rest of the airport is a nice place The remodel is excellent The airline crews are friendly and helpful Could we please calm down the TSA crew

Modern airport and very efficient Upon arrival by taxi one of the porters thoughtfully brought a cart for the luggage Checkin area wide and modern No queue at check in airport security or even for payment of airport charges Gate area very clean and equipped with a wide selection of dining options The view of the imposing Mount Pinatubo is something unique

I arrived on a national flight from Guadalajara The gates of the Tijuana Airport are quite modern with jetways at each gate There are restaurants and shops along the concourse It was necessary to have my passport checked by an immigration officer who saw it was a US passport and waved me through without looking at it The customs inspection was minimal The baggage claim area is OK When I checked in for my departing flight I found passengers were required to go through screening and customs inspection to enter the checkin area It is possible to exit and go outside while awaiting boarding time after you check in The street entrance to the airport is under construction and it is necessary to walk past the boardedoff areas to enter the terminal There is a bus station at the airport right by the terminal for shuttle buses to CA Overall this airport is not bad and will be very good once construction is completed

These were our outbound flights to Sicily to visit family for Xmas which we had booked over months in advance but as usual ITA had changed flight times in this case cancelling our connection from Milan to Palermo which meant a hour layover in Milan Linate This made our overall journey time very long for what is a short haul destination We luckily have Executive status with ITA and lounge access but had we not this would have been even more tiring and uncomfortable in what is a very small airport Also despite there being no lounge in London City ITA give no dining credit like BA for their top tier status holders which feels poor of loyalty Onboard we were lucky to have fairly new planes on both sectors The A that are used on the London City sector is an excellent plane with great leg room and I appreciate the seating row on one side of the plane which is good for us as a couple On the Linate to Palermo sector we had a new Aneo with ITAs new interior scheme which was nice Complimentary onboard snacks and drinks could be better And cleaning of plane interiors needs to be done to maintain these fresh planes Overall a very mixed bag but they remain our preferred airline to Italy at the moment against very poor competition and provide relatively good value

Windhoek to Frankfurt After having read reviews I was prepared for bad service and problems during the flight but luckily everything was fine and I am quite happy with the overall experience The aircraft is spacious and clean seats are comfortable and have a pillow and a blanket for each passenger The crew was very friendly and not so good cop bad cop The food was quite good however it might have been better maybe a dessert could be added Big selection of drinks but only one type of juice orange On the long overnight flight dinner and breakfast have been offered During the flight the crew also offered water The entertainment system is still not working it seems to be a persistent problem that the airline is not willing to solve

Flew from CKGLHW on Sichuan Airlines a pleasant enough flight We used an airbridge in the older Terminal while the booking hall is now closed the baggage hall and arrivals remain the same for Terminal The high speed railway has been completed so I decided to catch the train to Lanzhou West railway station The train station is a short walk to the left from the exit of Terminal opposite Terminal There was only a short queue for tickets in the Ticket hall to the right of the station entrance about for First class on the very next train Travel time was about minutes All in all it was much better than slow airport bus and taxi options

Kind friendly staff I was due to travel back to Frankfurt on th February when Storm CiaraSabine hit Northern and Central Europe My Lufthansa flight was cancelled before I left for the airport and I was rebooked via text message onto two SAS flights BillundOslo then OsloFrankfurt the next day Unfortunately after hour at the gate on the Monday my SAS flight was cancelled for technical reasons There was no SAS rep at the airport so we all had to call their call centre to rebook our flights I was pretty frustrated but an SAS employee at the call centre was friendly enough when I got through and told me my flight had already been rebooked though I hadnt had a text message or mail at that time The Billund airport staff I spoke to couldnt have been friendlier and more helpful Their hands were tied as they werent responsible for rebooking our flights but they went out of their way to guide me and fellow passengers I had had no info from the airline about the chance of booking a hotelmeal vouchers etc but one kind airport employee took it into his own hands and sorted it all out for me booking a room and printing a voucher which they could clearly then redeem from SAS In short not much more than an hour after the flight cancellation announcement I was in an airport hotel room and had time to have dinner and relax before flying the next morning which all happily worked out I often fly to and from Billund airport and its one of my favourites comfortable good design good shops cafes and restaurants plenty of seating perfect view of the runway etc Since that day Ive added friendly staff to my list of positives

Barra is an amazing airport its tiny shed like and has few facilities The most people there at one time will only be approx as the flights are operated by little twin otters What makes Barra great is the runway its the beach The approach and landing experience are a must Also once youve got off and collect your bag from a shelter in the car park youve got a maximum of metres to walk to your car taxi or bus they meet every flight and are a good way to get around the islands

Genoa airport compares extremely well with our huge overcrowded and understaffed London airports It is nice and small with lovely shops and good cafes There are no long queues at check in or security and staff are friendly and helpful A pleasure to visit

I booked return flights from Sydney to Rome via Guangzhou where the airline provides an easy and comfortable option of a free hotel depending on the gap between your next flight The stopover option is incredibly well handled with transport provided to and from your hotel I thoroughly recommend this as Guangzhou has a great easy to use metro system and its very easy to get around The A fleet used are in excellent condition with pleasant staff although meals can be a let down one on my return journey was actually inedible However the real test of a good airline is when things dont go to plan My return flight from Rome was cancelled due to a technical issue after we had boarded the flight We spent hours on board with regular updates provided before the Captain made the decision not to fly Prior to disembarking which involved reentering Italy and collecting our bags lunch was served on board a nice touch Once back in the terminal we were given further meal vouchers and asked to return an hour later On return we were bussed to the nearby Sheraton where all accommodation and meals were covered for hours while the plane was repaired and put back in service These changes left only hours to change to my rescheduled flight from Guangzhou to Sydney however to my delight China Southern provided a hotel option close to the airport allowing for a refreshing stop and rest before the final long leg back to Sydney So sure I arrived on Sunday morning instead of Friday night as planned but the way I was looked after was very good I would certainly recommend China Southern and will fly with them again
Melbourne to Nouma Surprisingly very good airline and good business seat for a three hours flight Very good staff and very good product in business Among them Nikko Japanese whisky

Subang Airport to Redang The plane was a De Havilland Dash old but in good conditions The flight has been pleasant and crew did the best to offer us a pleasant flight water towels and a little snack The check in area in Subang and the all airport are very nice and clean the service has been very good They will replace their old planes soon with new ATR

Lots of good food and shops Amazing love piano playing and fun Wicked Weed food court However the reason Im writing is because this place is filthy I dont want to touch a surface I know theyre under construction but that doesnt account for counters and corners and floors that obviously havent been scrubbed in a long time Gross Embarrassing The survey asks if I would recommend this airport and my reply is mixed First off airport choice is pretty arbitrary as it just depends on where youre going and also some aspects are great The cleanliness however is terrible

Auckland to Chengdu Their cabin was fresh and clean and being a newer aircraft was kept very well The service is warm and professional The seats fold flat and my kids slept for most of the hour flight We arrived relaxed and stress free considering that we had young kids to look after and worry about Night flights with kids are the way to go The food was very tasty The flight attendants were very polite and accommodating They never made you feel you were a burden to them I will happily fly Sichuan in the future
Fantastic airport I go in and out at least once a month Yesterday I timed my arrival and from walking off the plane to being outside at a taxi was seconds minute check in for departures

Its a gorgeous little country airport The terminal only opened last October and it still has a new smell There are no queues anywhere and in general all ground staff are friendly and laid back There is no need to allow excess time because there will be no queues at checkin or at securitythe largest planes into the airport only seat peopleand they arent always full There are lovely large windows with views over the tarmac runway and ranges in the distance and if its race day you can see the horses too The cafe is good although a bit overpriced Its interesting that whilst Virgin and Qantas passengers have to go through security Rex and Brindabella passengers dont There are no issues to speak of in this small yet very pleasant airport

Ground service is terrible compared to in the air Manual checkin process with no computers This airline seems to be the only one to have a lounge in the domestic terminal in Yangon Airconditioned and friendly associates offering a cheese croissant No bathroom inside so that was a drag People in Lotus class got a private van to the plane which was nice compared to cramming onto a bus Onboard the flight was pretty good The front of the plane is much quieter compared to the back Their inflight magazine was pretty decent and the english grammatically correct Even on short flights they gave you food On my YGNMDY flight which was about minutes they served a full breakfast Seats were pretty comfortable on par with United A first class seats I dont really see the need for inflight entertainment on such short flights

I booked London Mexico City London Business Class tickets Outgoing flight gave us access to the Virgin lounge at Heathrow and it was excellent Return flight had problems could not check in or select meal online using iPad their website only works on Microsoft Though in transit I had to go through immigration baggage reclaim and security before handing back my luggage to be loaded on the flight home Refused admittance to their Heineken lounge because I presented more than hours early just arrived on their flight from Cuba Lounge was noisy cramped and spartan when I did get in But flight was good
Kiev to Odessa but they serve sandwiches and the whole range of beverages B clean Plenty of legroom Flight was ontime Its worth the money

What a great flight of hour and minutes Aircraft was clean departure was on time and crew was very friendly Legroom is reasonable for such a small plane No IFE or wifi but inflight service was very good with options of sandwiches juices coffee and chocolate

Ive been through this airport several times and I must say its incredibly clean and sparkling and definitely puts Gatwick to shame The people of Tunisia are very friendly which adds to the overall positive experience However I have a concern regarding the pricing While all airports tend to charge fees the prices here seem a bit exorbitant I wonder why this is the case Additionally I have a personal issue with the height of the walkway that crosses about meters up I understand this might not be a problem for most but it would be great if the sides of the walkway could be covered for those of us who arent fond of heights Other than these few points its an excellent airport with great service

Arrival Nice short walking distance to baggage claim Fast baggage delivery Comfortable smokers lounge next to baggage claim Relaxed atmosphere but still very efficient operation Car rental easy to find so is the carpark for rented cars Departure Easy car return Clean cheap airport hotel fit for purpose Several breakfast options in the checkin hall Easy and friendly checkin So is security check I got a feeling that they had though about everything in this airport and that maybe that is the reason why everything worked so efficiently the staff had energy to smile and the atmosphere is so relaxed

Great airport to travel from and return to No great distances to walk easy access to check in counters TSA actually seems to care and think rather than defaulting to lowest level of acceptable service ie Denver Early morning flights are great as the food court has great breakfast burritos and coffee The only problem seems to be the luggage getting from the plane back to you Once you have your bags the rest of the trip out is a breeze

TUNTIP Checkin at Tunis was efficient and staff generally friendly Boarding at the gate was chaotic While on the runway the plastic emergency exit covering came off The pilot came and put it back on Plane then proceeded with takeoff The food was standard and staff friendliness on board ok although only with limited English skills Onboard announcements were in Arabic only The interior was worn emergency cards in seat pockets were still from the former owner of the plane a defunct French airline

We were booked to take flights on Yangon in June A little concerned when we fronted the quaint little desk in Yangon to find it unattended but were assured that there are helpers at all Myanmar airports who take your bag to the desk and deal with it The next flights on Yangon were good Planes were all prop aircraft seating about I think we were on the same plane every time Seats are not allocated which worried us at first but it was not an issue The sticker to identify patrons in the departure lounge are a cute touch Nice little snack and drink no matter how short the flight Staff were friendly and helpful

Modern clean and efficient airport Only a few flights per week Airside after security and passport control there is a kiosk for food and drinks and a souvenir shop For Ryanair flights you walk between plane and terminal so the priority boarding works Parking in front of the terminal building is free

AZDMHD Aseman is one of the only airlines that provides domestic flights between Yazd and Mashad Tickets are cheap and service is ok There was a delay of hr which feels endless waiting at a small domestic airport Despite the delay the flight was comfortable on a Fokker aircraft Not much legroom but fine for a flight of about mins Some snacks were included and that was ok Friendly staff

This is a nice little airport as previously stated and one minor comment which persons using it for the first time should appreciate is that there is no ATM or machine for buying tickets for the connecting buses into Stockholm although the information desk is helpful and do accept most credit cards They will try to assist in anyway possible So be prepared

Xian to London on th Feb Aircraft only years old Good amount seat recline with charger available however the entertainment system need an upgrade It is the coronavirus outbreak at moment the crew did an excellent job measuring temperature and disinfected the aircraft Excellent cabin service I went back to spoke with cabin crew they are willing to share their stories and experiences The lack of entertainment system is covered by the excellent crew service

Return Edinburgh to London City BAs CityFlyer remains the most pleasant way to get to and from London from Edinburgh The Embraer has much better legroom than the so look out for the type flying when booking The blue leather seats and layout make for comfort Trip to London City on Oct at on the EMB was wholly smooth Fantastic view of the three Forth bridges on departure So much legroom and space and Im ft in st On time more or less pleasant crew and a free breakfast of bacon rolls or a platter of fruit salad and organic yoghurt Water and hot drinks Just what was needed LCY is so easy to get through in arrival and I was on the DLR to the city in minutes flat A great start to the day Returning home on Oct at the on the smaller EMB was much less comfortable due to turbulence for at least mins thanks to the tail of a US hurricane passing over GB The reassuring captain apologised several times and explained he was trying to get clearance to a higher level Good to be kept informed The crew were marvellous Kind cheerful the best of BA Drinks and snacks served despite the plane lurching about All comp including a good Glenlivet malt Edinburgh arrival fine and into tram within mins of touchdown These jets arent new and it does show a bit but its a cutabove experience still compared to the alternatives The tickets to LCY on the travel app I use are a little more than Gatwick but if you can miss the absolute peak flights the difference isnt much and to me anyway worth it for the good service and central location and efficiency of London City Airport

Not the best but for a smaller city it does the job if you have an early morning flight you can only get there by cab or someone dropping you off The transit that is available at the airport at the day time can be very crowded and infrequent One positive thing is that the airport staff is very friendly and helpful

It was an easy online check in Due to other company flight delays I was short on time to drop my bag in When I arrived it was too late for me to print my bag tag Ricky at LAX directed me to an operator who printed my tag and checked my bag in Flight was also great Service when needed but nice and quiet during the night to sleep I recommend Delta Air Lines

Average airport Ive been here many times since I live in the UK but my experience never really changed There are a lot of shops which I find good and the food is meh I do often see some rubbish on the floor and wet floors with no wet floor sign which is quite dangerous If you come here I do recommend to go to the lounge since it is relaxing you get tasty food and a view of planes taking off The flights are always massively delayed but overall a pretty average airport

Flew with LC Peru from Cusco to Lima H flight Small Boeing old Lufthansa Legroom was limited but okay for the duration of the flight They offered one drink and a small snack two cookies Flight was smooth the price for the ticket was low included one piece of bagage of KG Crew friendly and efficient Plane was old it was ok Overall good value for money Short flights are ok plaen looks good and seats were ok Dont expect to much but I would recommend this airline for domestic flights in Peru

DYU to FRA Somon Air flights are very difficult to book outside Tajikstan so although their flight times suited me I ended up booking my outbound flight to Tajikstan with Turkish Air I did manage to book my return flight with some local help whilst in Tajikstan and was pleasantly surprised Aircraft was a new Boeing flight was comfortable and the cabin crew very good There were only approx passengers on the flight which is probably more to do with the problems booking rather than the quality of their service There is no TV IFE but as most of the Somon Air flights are through the night this wasnt a problem I wouldnt put anyone off flying with Somon Air but they really do need to offer flight booking outside Tajikstan with the major travel agents in order to be competitive

I am incredibly grateful for the staff at Chiang Mai airport I left my phone in my grab unable to get in touch with grab due to my phone being in my grab car and details being on the app on my phone so I immediately went to the staff in line She took me to the tourist police by exit number in the international departure hall They took details such as where I got the grab from my phone number the car colour i couldnt remember the license plate number In less than minutes they were able to get in touch with the car driver and I got my phone in the next minutes after that Thank you so much to the tourist police staff on shift at am on Jan I cant remember the other staffs name that brought me to the tourist police but i took a photo with her I wish them all the best and am so grateful for their willingness to help

Flew Star Peru from Lima to Cusco Pleasantly surprised after reading dire reviews here Departure was more or less on time in small rather old plane It was mostly empty too Seats not incredibly comfortable but very short flight anyway Price not a bargain but not terribly expensive no point booking in advance BTW as fares do not seem to really vary that much Flight was fine and service was rather good and polite onboard with snacks drink and luggage all included in fare No issues at all

Excellent location Good services I appreciate the airport but maybe it is necessary to improve the checkin services during the night time Sometimes the terminal electronic system does not work and personnel seem to have problems with the check in

I recently took two flights both of which provided a great experience First flight No CX from Chengdu to Hong Kong on an A Economy Class It was a very comfortable flight the cabin crew was outstanding and the food was good Second Flight NoCX from Dubai to Hong Kong on a Boeing BER Premium economy class This flight exceeded all expectations It was incredibly comfortable and the cabin crew was exceptional friendly helpful and truly dedicated The service on the ground and onboard was fantastic making the trip smooth The ample legroom allowed me to stretch out and relax while the wider seats extra recline and adjustable headrests provided the perfect setting for a good nights sleep The food was delicious offering a variety and flavour that made the experience wonderful I would like to thank Mr Philip from the Philippines whose outstanding service left a lasting impression This was a wonderful trip that I will never forget

Last time I was in Xian Xianyang airport was in I have visited many times before There was always a Scrum outside the airport building for tickets and to board the airport buses for downtown Returned this year a lot has changed with the airport and getting tickets for the buses You now go to a ticket booth inside the building Then a waiting room for your respective bus What an improvement

Delightful little airport serving virtually all Shetland passengers Internal flights from Aberdeen Edinburgh Glasgow Orkney and twice a week STN plus occasional scheduled flights to Bergen and Faroe Terminal has a restaurant tourist office bookshop and car hire Everyone is friendly even though they have significant disruption from time to time when fog closes down operations The only gripe is that public transport to Lerwick is not frequent enough to meet all flights But overall just like the rest of Shetland it is a refreshing change form the me too culture of most of Europe

Myself and my wife were on our first visit to Lanzarote and my first time as an assisted passenger The team who took care of us were excellent friendly and so helpful This made our holiday so much more enjoyable Thanks to the team well done assistance team at Lanzarote airport Thank You

Flew flybe BE Belfast to Amsterdam on October th Checkin opened hours prior to departure and the check in process was very efficient Boarding was called minutes prior to departure and the boarding process was also fast and efficient The onboard cabin crew were outstanding and very helpful throughout the flight and we landed minutes ahead of the scheduled time There is not a full catering service onboard however teacoffee and snacks are provided free of charge Overall I was very happy with flybe service on this Belfast to Amsterdam fight

I miss my Malaysia Airlines flight and all flight is closed and do not allow to purchase However AirAsia is so kind to let me get a ticket even though the counter is closed after listening to my ordeal in the airport Thank you AirAsia for making my trip possible Appreciate the guy that help me too rush to get his name Thank you

Singapore to Thandwe via Yangon with Myanmar National Airlines This was a very pleasant experience All flights ahead of time great service and food super friendly flight attendants Both the domestic and international terminals in Yangon are modern and well organized Overall highly recommended

Like many airports food and drinks are much too expensive I do therefore I also do not want to buy water It is not allowed to take bottled water through customs so most airports have free tap drinking water Also this airport But they are all disconnected I find this outrageous To have access to drinking water is a right

Frequented CMB many times in the last decade and on the whole its ok It runs pretty smoothly and in fact has improved over the years the immigration particularly seems quicker I do however hate the exorbitant dollar priced fooddrink and duty free etc The contrast between what this cost just outside the door or the airport and the terminal prices must be one of the biggest contrasts in the world That said its a pretty painless experience to pass through

It is a second tier nonhub airport so traffic is lower As others have noted it is surrounded by a botanical garden so the setting is beautiful Recently all of the food options were significantly upgraded Security moves quickly and efficiently The arrivals area is large and conveniently located next to the parking garage for a quick departure Rental car counters are right in the arrivals area Which brings me to the only negative waits for checked baggage are noticeably longer than almost any other airport Figure on a minimum minute wait Would recommend getting your rental car while you wait on your bags

Great little airport used mainly by Porter airlines Check in was efficient and you go down to an airport lounge open to everyone They serve free tea coffee and soft drinks along with cookies and nuts The wifi is free and fast Boarding is effortless and the scenery on take off is stunning The only downside was that when the lounge is busy it gets a little grubby with dishes lying everywhere Otherwise it comes highly recommended

LAN is a true premium airline Flew in their Premium Business from MilanMalpensa to So Paulo Guarulhos late night and the service was fantastic Had only hand luggage because it was a short trip As soon as I got onboard I was welcomed and escorted to my seat by the purser Immediately I was offered a glass of champagne Other offers were Pisco Sour and water Dinner orders were taken quickly and served promptly after the take off Their business class cabin has the configurartion of which is good if you have company If not you might find yourself sitting to a stranger for hours I had this several times and the comfort was still good My breakfast order was taken seriously I got everything I wanted I need to emphasize this because there are other premium airlines who fail to arrange the breakfast according to customers wishes The crew just seem to enjoy their jobs and you can see that the service is personal you get addressed by your name and you pay business class but you get almost first class treatment LAN is always a great choice and will always stick to them

I work on a consumer programme for ITV and would be interested in hearing from anyone who was on the Phuket Air flight which had a reported fuel leak during a routine stop at Sharjah on Sunday rd April We would be interested in hearing your story Please send your contact details using the Comment Form at the bottom of this page and Skytrax will put you in touch with Sarah
It was a really nice flight friendly people started on time and regular updates from the crew The airplane itself was very clean and entertainment on board was provided

Seoul to Busan First time with Air Busan and it was great Price App check in employees serviceluggage and on time At the check in I was offered an earlier flight no fee There were no problems with this airline and trip Recommend
Great little airport all staff friendly and helpful Security checks speedy and done with a smile Could some of the staff be used to show other airports how it is done

Our flight from Murica to Bournemouth was cancelled and the holiday was a disaster but the staff at Bournemouth were so helpful they kept me up to date with information they sorted all the car parking out and made sure we all made it home without any major issues The thing was no matter how many people say about the drop off fee of so what for a local airport min drive parking min walk to the building nice and calm and relaxing food was amazing now they have costa so what else would you need
The Aroport international de Qubec is a good example to follow concerning quality of service and infrastructure Its clean well designed and the staff are professional and customer oriented

March The area around the airport seems clean and pretty organized But that lasts only until you reach the terminals gates Without eticket printed in advance you wont be allowed to enter the terminal The security is oppressive and unintelligent People accompanying you can enter only after paying an entrance fee to the airport police station which is a procedure taking min The terminal itself is spacious with modernistic and actually pleasant looks Even if I had an already printed boarding pass for online checkin I actually waited much longer than other passengers as their system wasnt working and they had to check me in again There were around passengers for members of staff at a time and they seemed totally overwhelmed despite the low volume of passengers The departures level was pretty empty and immigration a breeze as it was very early morning The airside area didnt offer anything special but was clean and pleasant nevertheless No AC sockets working anywhere in the airport All in all the airport seems to be more about looks than substance Nevertheless TRV remains probably the best airport I experienced in India and I would advise it as an alternative gateway to other airports in the South

Small functional airport which is a bit drab for a holiday destination like Langkawi Clean but a bit rusty A decent common hall with shopping and eating before check in after baggage claim but next to nothing to do on the airside Still more pleasant than KLIA or Subang

I would like to say a very special thank you to the security staff that helped my friend and I last week at Naples Airport A friend had travelled earlier that day and inadvertently left his iPad behind in security We only had a short time before our departure to try and retrieve it for him The staff were fast efficient and located the iPad within minutes After running through some security checks we were able to take the iPad home back to its owner saving everyone a lot of time and energy I dont usually write reviews but the service we received from the security staff was first class and deserved a mention

Granada Airport is located about km west of Granada Single runway small terminal Regular buses run into the city If you arrive late no worries as it is only a short taxi ride In recent years the number of flights have increased Mainly to Madrid and Barcelona but with also Liverpool Stansted Melilla The usual facilities for a small airport so dont expect too much

Berlin to Hurghada It was the first time I am flown with Germania It was a good choice after Air Berlin terminated service on this route They offer free baggage kg a complimentary hot meal and three legs of complimentary non alcoholic hot or cold drinks on this hrs trip If the flight is booked more you have the possibility to upgrade to an extra legroom seat containing up to inch more legroom head phones and one beerwhine Flight attendants were very friendly and caring all the flight One documentary and one movie were shown on overhead screens But if you are not interested in their IFE bring your own device CheckIn was a bit confusing because they tell that your seat is advised automatically which I believe is not the truth There were many free seats Therfore this was not a problem but would be if this flight have been more crowded All in all a very good price service ratio

Keflavik to Dresden Germania isnt a great airline I barely fit in the seatIm Check in starts hours before departure which sucked because all the shops were after security Online Checkin didnt work But the staff was nice and the ticket was cheap I recommend if you are under feet tall and plan accordingly

My family and I were due to travel with Phuket airlines in July this year Gatwick Bangkok In January I started to get concerned with the number of cancellations and late flights I then discovered the Skytrax site and am extremely grateful to all of you who have posted comments In January I re booked with Thai Airlines with whom we have previously travelled it appears to be an extra expense well worth making

No complaints about this airline on our flight from Siem Reap to Phnom Pehn in July No queue at checkin comfortable seats with plenty of leg room The A is old but very comfortable and clean Cabin crew and checkin staff very friendly and professional The flight departed early and was in the air for about minutes and they still managed to serve refreshments during the flight Excellent value as well with the tickets for both of us about the same as travelling by bus Would recommend Bassaka very highly and I hope they grow and prosper in the future

My wife and I had a twohour transit at Muscat between flights with Oman Air Our time in the airport was unexpectedly pleasant The terminal building gives a new and modern appearance but with features of traditional Arabic architecture The total effect is aesthetically very pleasing and supported by mellow background music Travel through the terminal was not onerous although distances between gates and other transit points were long most of it could be covered by moving walkways Security check was painless and efficient with short queues At the departure gate there was a nice separation between boarding pass check and seating in the waiting area There was plenty of seating in the gate and we appreciated the boarding procedures being separated by zone One negative there was no obvious place to get a coffee in the transit areas we passed through although signage pointing to another part of the terminal suggested eating and drinking options elsewhere

I travel frequently both internationally and domestically and St Louis Airport provided one of the smoothest travel experiences I have had to date Staff were efficient and seemed to actually care about their jobs food and beverage options were plentiful and the terminal was easy to navigate The security process was also extremely efficient and wellstaffed The only negative thing I have to say about this airport is that the seating areas at the gates could have been cleaner as chairs had dirt and particles of who knows what all over and in between them However not all of the seating was like this and it didnt bother me as there were many cafes and bars to hang out in Overall one of the better airports I have been through and I have been through countless Great job STL

Kaimana to Manokwari Plane left and arrived minutes late really on time in this part of the world The check in staff were very flexible about cabin luggage size On board seats were reasonably comfortable and crew pleasant

I flew from and to Varna Airport in April The airport is good but the lounges were closed early in the morning There is only duty free shop and the prices there are good One bad thing is that boarding the plane is always by bus otherwise it is a good experience

Spotless short flight with NIKI operated with a very clean and good looking plane polite crew and ontime departurearrival which is more than enough for me to be satisfied about this short hop to Vienna where I had to attend a congress A big plus is they fly from Linate airport which is much closer to my house than Malpensa and this is why I did not fly Austrian as I usually do for this route Their website worked well so checkingin online was very easy both ways I will surely fly them again inside Europe

Overnight flight from KL to Shanghai on their relatively new B plane Was impressed on the cabin cleanliness and seat was pretty comfortable But would preferred to be on a wide body aircraft for a flight time longer than hrs Cabin crew were polite Food was ok But for the price I paid for it was cheaper than some low cost carrier Would not hesitate to fly with them again

This airport is so backward its unreal Today you get charged nearly three euros to get hot water for your own teabag You get charged ten euros development fee as you leave Same as Galway airport ten years ago six euros to get out again development fee now its shut Last time I flew from Knock the fee was the same Never went back because of the fee Now the place has hardly changed where did that money go Great idea to put an airport on top of a hill dont have to come down so far but hardly a great advert for Irish aviation or Mayo

A very small airport but well run It has stands which are all a few steps from the terminal building It is no where near Oslo miles south approx hours away The terminal building is a single storey with Checkin Desks on one side arrivals in the middle with belt and Security Scanning on the other side On the Land Side there is a cafshop supplying hot and cold snacks and other things and a seating area It is very small so everything is within easy reach but if more than plane is in at a time it could get busy Outside there is lots of car parking and car rental options along with transport to the local railway station for trains to various points including Oslo If you are visiting Oslo City Centre think carefully before using this airport if you want to access the locality it is a small friendly place

Got to be one of the worlds smallest airports The terminal is the size of a large living room You can literally drive up to the front door and walk in This made the airport very efficient and easy to use but dont bank on having a gourmet burger before your flight You will have to make do with a snickers bar and an Irn Bru from the vending machine To be fair it was very clean and is a good hub for the northern extremities

Apart from a minute delay outbound it is hard to fault my SydneyAdelaide return trip Yes its a no frills carrier but most everything worked efficiently and I was impressed by how smiling and happy all the staff were

Keflavk to Copenhagen This flight was operated on anew Aneo showcasing Icelandairs Saga Class the airlines Business Class product Although the flight was delayed by three hours an uncommon occurrence given Icelandairs excellent ontime performance access to the Saga Lounge at Keflavk ensured the wait was a comfortable one The flight itself was smooth and pleasant While the Saga Class seats are not lieflat they are wellcushioned and provide ample comfort for the short journey The onboard service was warm and efficient Overall no complaints Icelandairs Saga Class delivers the most comfortable option for travel between Iceland and Europe or the Nordics

REX have always been professional I never took much notice of airlines I just know who I will no longer fly with In my recent trip with REX the light bulb went on I understood the Guest ethos that had been taught to me through employment as a driver for luxury travel With REX I finally got it the Guest Experience No other airline has made me feel this elusive Guest experience Ive had some absolute shockers I am now a nervous flyer Not a heart string pull try flying home with your step sons ashes and being treated poorly in the USA which you are transiting through Suffice to say I hate flying This recent trip I engaged brain I saw it and was the recipient of their incredible service The thing that makes airline travel easy seamless safe treat people with respect Dont immediately treat then with disrespect because of a judgement And this is REX

I had a pleasant experience on my Teheran Mehrabad to Shiraz flight It was a little bumpy due to weather but a delicious packed snack and drink were served for the short flight All the crew were very friendly and are a credit to their airline The A EPIEG was clean with a decent seat pitch for my foot frame and I was given a row of seats to myself All in all a very nice company who charged a very reasonable for my one way ticket I wish Iran Air the very best with each new addition to their expanding fleet and this wont be the last time I fly Iran Air

It was really nice experience this was my first journey with Vistara I am feet height and still I was able to sit comfortably They provided food also after long time get food in Indian domestic flight was a good feel Every days we used to get in jet and kingfisher airlines It was a nice experience now waiting for my connecting flight to Dubai

There is a reason why this airport is consistently named among the best small airports in the USA Thanks to COVID some shops and eateries have shuttered and not reopened to date Security was a breeze There was no line and I walked right up to the TSA counter and cleared security in less than minutes There is a spill over of passengers from the gate area to the concourse nonetheless there is enough space to navigate the concourses The Escape Lounge is a welcome addition to this airport

The airport is outside the capital and it could be a minute drive depending on the traffic Aesthetically its not the nicest facility and in some places it seems like a warehouse The security is really good and the immigration formalities for Iranians are fine Im not entirely sure how immigration is for non Iranians but I heard that its alright but they have their own line which could take them longer to clear immigration if the line is long The customs formalities are alright I never had any problems as a regular traveler there The toilet facilities are not so clean but there is almost always an attendant there cleaning the place and offering to watch your bags in return for a small tip The staff in general are pleasant enough The duty free isnt the best in the world but the prices are reasonable Good opportunity to buy some Iranian products as gifts for friends and family The eating options are pretty good with two open air cafes after passport control with deserts and sandwiches and beverages at reasonable prices Theres a decent fastfood restaurant in the international departure area and the prices are alright there too If you have a long transit there is a mosque at the departure terminal where you can prey relax and even take a nap Theres no public transportation to and from the airport so the only way to get there is by car A taxi to Tehran for Iranians is about USD I heard the business class lounge is good as well as the VIP terminal WiFi is basically non existent for passengers Enjoy your time in Iran

Very pleasant airline Friendly and helpful crew Reasonable prices for food and drinks on board There was limited choice but that is ok on a hour flight This was the second time I flew with SmartLynx We had a nice flight and I would fly again with this airline
I really rate Rex airlines On time both ways Helpful staff Free snack and comfy seats All for return Very pleased with the experience would choose to fly with Rex again

Easy to access by train Plenty of shops and eateries even convenience store Lots of toy machines Clean and enjoyable to wait for our departure Signs are clear You can enjoy lunch while watching the airplanes take off Weve got our last minute omiyage shopping like handkerchiefs japan only cute snacks and satisfying lunch

A small but very nice airport just km from the city center The distances are short checkin hassle free and handling staff very friendly I was very happy to hear international traffic had been approved about a year ago Nowadays there are international flights to Brussels and Copenhagen I really support the development of this airport because of the proximity to the city center the short distances and a problem free handling
