Excellent except that the parking is free and hence clogged We landed taxied to within years of the terminal walked straight through the door to baggage arrivals and within minutes were in the car

One of the best flights I have been on between Oslo and Billund I didnt know that this kind of service still exsisted Excellent food and service I know it cost a bit more but it is well spent money I do recommend this airline which operates flights on behalf of British Airways

I recently flew American Eagle operated by Republic from Washington DC to Philadelphia and I was really impressed The E was comfortable and wellsuited for the short hop between cities Even though the flight was only minutes and we had a slight delay leaving Washington due to congestion the crew still managed to offer a full beverage service in first class which I really appreciated Despite the delay we landed in Philadelphia on time It was a smooth and enjoyable flight overall

Great restaurant upstairs that serves main course meals and happy to work in your time frame for your flight Modern building and brilliant to depart and arrive from if you live anywhere nearby Just make sure you check the kind of aircraft being used for your flight If you do NOT want to be on a small regional or propeller plane your choices are limited Nothing better than arriving at HPN and getting home locally in under minutes

When I arrived at this airport from incheon the immigration lines were long It took me more than an hour to get out of the airport I headed to Incheon a few days later Security and immigration was actually fine although I found the facilities a little old There were plenty of places to shop and relax but I wished that there were more food choices Overall this is a small but functional airport

Paris to Newark Service on board adequate and friendly staff But the issue was that my checked luggage did not arrive in Newark From that moment no feedback customer care nonexistent The staff was not concerned and blamed the situation on Orly airport No support

Flew Vanilla Air from Tokyo Narita to Hong Kong To be honest I did not expect much from a LCC The crew onboard were professional and nice and they tried their very best to communicate with passengers using English The plane was clean and tidy I do not mind having to pay for food and beverages and I do not care about the lack of entertainment Yet the seats are hard as rock which makes me feel like I am sitting on a wooden plank The seat pitch is completely ridiculous that I cannot even tie my shoelaces My height M Sleeping or even resting on the flight is simply Mission Impossible no matter how tired I was given the seat lacks basic support and the unbelievable seat pitch If your only parameter is cost and you can forgo all sorts of comfort go fly with them

The airport was a bit far from the city but well connected to the public transportation with clear signs and direction It was in general clean Queuing time at the immigration was not too long for us As many other Asian international airports TPE was full of restaurants and a shopping paradise for passengers to kill waiting time Each boarding gate had a different theme and sometimes did not have enough seats for everyone

I found this airport to be surprising good for a European airport Getting through the airport was smooth and the terminal was busy but not crowded The Marco Polo Lounge was again very pleasant one of the best I have been to in Europe it even has an outside terrace with views of the apron which is a rare treat My only complaint would be the strange approach to the use of airbridges there were so many available and yet slow and cumbersome bus boarding seems to be standard operating procedure at VCE strange

I have travelled to Yangon many times in the past and this was the first time I used the new airport extension On arrival luggage has to go through baggage scanner just like some airports in Middle East Guests are also able to enter the airport too until immigration and passport control The airport is very large and spacious there are international branded shops and some that sell local products The products in the convenience store were not over priced The airport facilities are better than in some western European cities

I suddenly needed to use the special assistance service at Newcastle airport in order to go on holiday in May I had seen in the media the chaotic scenes at some uk airports and in addition the issues for passengers with disabilities I never expected Newcastle special assistance service to contradict the horror stories but it certainly did To put it simply they excelled and you should go on holiday via Newcastle with absolute confidence What an amazing service They have some of the most friendly helpful and professional staff who cannot do enough to help you and put you at ease They explain what is happening throughout the transit process in the airport To and from the aeroplane Through security to baggage collection even right through to getting in the taxis home They get you through

This place should be a model for small airports around the world They even use airbridges which are great for avoiding the cold winds Luggage didnt take too long but all bags have to be xrayed because youre not allowed to bring meat fruit or plants into Patagonia Then there are stalls for taxis and tour bookings and the VES shuttle bus service to hotels is at the stand marked Bus oneway or if you book the return leg at the same time Tourist staff can speak English Great views of the Andes out the right side on approach I think I saw Mt Fitz Roy and some gnarly winds On departure the shuttle bus dropped us at the airport minutes ahead which was plenty Checkin staff raced through the passengers security was fast and friendly wifi was free but somewhat unreliable decent cafe on both sides of security views of the runway and lake lots of toilets Probably the best small regional airport that Ive ever experienced

I flew Lao Airlines from Luang Prabang to Hanoi It was a short one hour flight and the service revised by Lao Airlines was everything you could expect for a flight like this They served drinks and a snack which was a tasty sandwich although there was no vegetarian option The staff were friendly There was no inflight entertainment but that didnt bother me as the flight was so quick

Optimal infrastructure parking is good the check in is very fast thoughtful attendants the security is good The airport has a lack of restaurants that is somewhat annoying but has a good service and good wifi

Given the early morning departure only fast food restaurants were open The terminal was not crowded and there was plenty of seating at the gates Terminal is bright spacious and with plenty of windows through which to see the airfield There was no line going through TSAPre It took me less than minutes to go through I have taken several flights from DAL and have always found TSA officers to polite and courteous Airport was very clean and the WiFI signal was excellent and easy to connect to On return to DAL a week later in the evening rush the terminal was very busy and did not appear to be crowded with plenty of space to disperse the crowds at the gates and concourse

We had some troubles getting to the airport and were so worried we were going to be late We arrived at the check in counter just a few minutes late but the Jin Air employees were so kind and accommodating They got us through security and to our gate and we made a flight we otherwise would have definitely missed Just so grateful Thank you

Juliaca is the smallest commercial airport I have experienced Because of the size it is easy to find your way around There is not very much in the airport so bring something to amuse yourself The good news is due to the size it is a very clean including the bathrooms There was a VIP Lounge that I peeked into It consisted of a few chairs and a cooler with soft drinks and beer

Frankfurt Main to Asmara The crew are most friendly The onboard service was excellent and standard of the aircraft was good though the legroom wasnt great The ground handling done by the airline at Asmara International Airport was efficient even though there were a number of shortcomings at the airport the airline got round them The price of the ticket was worth the service I received

LAN Peru LIMLAX economy flight filled to capacity FAs friendly and competent new with the standard LAN seatback VOD Uusually for a Boeing standard size carryon luggage now actually fits in the overhead compartments noisy as usual but reasonably comfortable flight apart from the seats which have no footrest and dont recline very much good food and drinks service Booked as part of a flight from SJC to SCL the LAN booking system seems to work better now and was cheaper than booking through AAs system

Nice medium size airport Looks new or revamped and spotless clean Easy to move around and offers enough services Serious but very efficient staff which is all I ask for Fast check in fast security even going through passport control was relatively fast it was a late fly though so there wasnt many people

I was visiting family in India so this was the airport we went to and it was actually really good there They had lounge chairs at the gates The only problem was the constant beep during a conveyor belt motion and it was really annoying and it spread throughout the airport I really do think this is a great airport overall

Always a pleasure to fly with Swiss safety comes first with them then the comfort On my flight back to Switzerland from Bucharest I had such a nice experience thanks to Paul who attended the business class passengers I felt like I am flying first Class because of his service

I fly through San Javier about times a year and generally it works fine My only complaint is the boarding process Because there are no seperate gate lounges people queue in the departure hall All pretty chaotic especially if one has paid for priority boarding as it means fighting through crowds to get to the front and in the process putting up with mindless comments from people who dont seem to understand the concept of priority boarding The ground staff do nothing to help

I love Air North and use them whenever its convenient between Kelowna and Vancouver Very reasonable fares which includes two checked bags and advance seat selection for Always on time friendly staff and I love the vintage s Its like what flying was like decades ago much nicer and more relaxed

Small airport in Orange County NY that is a welcome alternative to Newark other airports if you can get a flight Fare was hundreds less flying to PHL connecting to IND rather than nonstop from EWR but lots of time spent sitting in airports It is clean staff are pleasant but not much to do Wish there were more nonstops out of this airport to major cities but I hear it is great if you are going to Florida
We had a challenge with checking due to a third party error Even so Sarah was super kind and efficient She made us feel at ease and resolved the issues we had promptly Thanks again

TokyoOsakaTokyo Starflyer has the best costperformance ratio of the market very comfortable leather seat in A Easy to get emergency exit at check in when requested but still at least inch legroom Drink service PTV footrest for hour flight and professional attendants At a unbeatable rate when booking a bit in advance even less than the Shinkansen The only drawbacks are the lack of frequency for Osaka comparing to JL or NH still OK with flights per day

We arrived at Dinard airport at around in April The airport is tiny so dont expect much The queue for the passport control was queuing out of the door and took around mins to pass The airport has one small baggage belt that gets very cramped When you get into arrivals there are car hire desks Overall the arrival experience was ok considering what a small airport Dinard is On our departure there was only bag drop desk for an entire flight Next step is security where you have to show your passportboarding pass times to different people There is only security lane which took mins clear and when you get into the departure lounge it is no better there either there are no shops whatsoever no not even a magazine shop just a few vending machines Overall this airport was ok
Mediumsized modern airport clean and easy to navigate around Easy public transport to and from city centre

Quite a small airport compared to the Dubai or Abu Dhabi International Airports Only half a dozen or airlines serve this airport On arrival myself and wife senior citizens were treated with compassion and helped by the airport customs and immigration staff No difficulties faced by us we found the airport quite peaceful neat and tidy I wish more flights were available to and from this Airport in UAE Travel to city center of Al Ain a charming city in the midst of the Arabian desert was also a pleasant experience with hardly any traffic problems

This is a very nice airport Very clean and modern Airport staff are courteous and helpful It is definitely the best airport I have been to in the Caribbean and definitely better than some airports in the US especially Miami where you are not even offered free WiFi Nassau airport has complimentary WiFi everywhere Selection of popular restaurants inside the US departure lounge There are some shops but mostly expensive souvenirs A great experience hats off to everyone at NAS

I experienced the best customer service at Skopje Airport During security I found out that my phone was missing I left my phone at the selfservice check in machine on the other side of security But they helped me out They called their colleagues and eventually found it brought it back to me I felt trustful through the whole process and really really het Thanks a lot

Had a great experience Going through security was fast had no wait time They had great local beers on tap and even a smoking section It costs bucks to enter but considering I havent been in an airport that had one in years it made the wait SO much better will layover in

I have used the comfortable Cr Colombo Airport in Genoa at least times in the last years Small comfortable no crowd no queue security check is not the standard paranoia of the EU just lazy smiles Friendly staff excellent shop excellent coffee shop fantastic quality of espresso good grappa and beer reasonably priced And not to forget it is comfortable to rent a car and drive anywhere in the Ligurian Coast easy car return the Airport is before Genova on the road One of my favorite airports

Stewart Airport in Newburgh NY is simply good I love to use this airport and often choose international carriers based on their landing at Stewart My experiences with Play Airlines have also been great Lorraine in checkin is a gem and keeps things running smoothly It is wonderful that the airport keeps adding domestic flight carriers as well Now travel is possible from Stewart International to Charleston SC No other airport is as easy to navigate as Stewart International The atmosphere is pleasant the staffing is topnotch and the TSA agents are respectful and helpful The entire process from checkin to boarding is smooth and efficient International arrivals are quick and Ive never had an issue with my luggage I highly recommend Stewart Airport to anyone who wants a simple hasslefree international travel experience

Domestic arrivals quick and easy No holdups at Baggage Reclaim or delays getting into Arrivals Hall International Departures in separate building which looks like it has just been finished Nov with a number of Islands with associated Checkin Desks and machines all on one level Relatively quick and then onwards to Departures which are up a set of escalators leading directly to a small but efficient security scan area Beyond that was Passport Control split into Argentinian passport holders and everyone else Not much of a queue and things moved quickly into the Departure Lounge Selection of shops selling local things duty free big named alcoholcigarettes etc spreading out left right as the gates were all along one side looking out towards the apron and taxiways Friendly helpful staff at the food cafe with good snackfood selection available Clear announcements and reasonable departure boards around the lounge area Boarding process quite slick with separate clearly labelled queues Quite a long taxi to the runway Pretty good airport for the capital city gateway to the country

Regional onboard service food and beverages LagosNairobi very good International onboard service food and beverages NairobiWashington good Onboard cleanliness satisfactory Nairobi lounge services good Airline customer support at Airport fair Kenya Airways App unreliable Online customer support very poor

I flew on TWay from Seoul Incheon to Singapore I was a bit surprised to find a usb charging port on my seat for a low cost carrier and free of charge some more The tray table included a personal electronic device holder which allowed me to use as a stand for my phone Seat was very comfortable on A in a seating configuration with leather padding for a low cost carrier Flight landed early in Singapore didnt feel so much turbulence also not very strong turbulence so quite a smooth flight

Good transport connection via BAB Moderate parkingrates close to the terminals CheckIn only minutes prior to departure Short distances More than daily flights major Star Alliance hubs MUC and FRA and direct flights to holiday destinations Daily lowcost flights to London STN Vienna Rome FMO is a good choice for travellers in northern NRW western Niedersachsen and eastern Holland who want to start their journeys business travel as welll as holiday travel relaxed and in a friendly atmosphere

Small NW Tasmanian airport with flights to Melbourne Tasmanian destinations Neat tidy with easy checkin baggage collection Small cafeshop enough seating for size of aircraft using airport Not a bad little airport

Sal is a great small airport which is easy to use lots of signs and decent food options Good taxi services and shuttle buses to hotels Clean and airy and bright Would recommend Aeroplanes park very close and many airlines fly to Sal which is useful Friendly staff

Pulkovo new terminal is reasonably good and modern Easy to navigate both on arrival and departure Visa checks are very complex in Russia and Pulkovo stands up to the job with lots of passport check desks queue cleared in less than mins both ways Departures hall has restaurants cafes shops signage is good However the airport still has long way to go There are very few air bridges majority of planes sit on the tarmac and require shuttle bus to the terminal Connections to the city centre belong to previous decade you have to take bus that takes you to the metro then ride the metro for several stops Ending up having to take a taxi which has some risks in Russia if you arent familiar

The airport is new and clean however it is already overstretched For departures there are only a couple of snack bars and small shops in the departure area and for an international departure theres only one cafe Although your plane may be parked at a jetbridge you may not board from the jetbridge but rather have to go outside and use stairs Alternatively you may board at gate but then walk in the arrival corridor to the jetbridge at gate Check in and security were easy and fast At arrivals the tourist information office was closed There is no area for rental car return you will have to go in to the building to tell them you have returned Signage on the roads to the airport is not very good and it is tricky to reach the airport from any direction other than downtown There is construction at the airport entrance and perhaps that will address this issue The airport makes a good arrival spot for the Eje Cafetero Arriving with Easy Fly our bags arrived almost instantly

I was pleasantly surprised by Biarritz a small airport where everything seemed to work fine I was particularly impressed by the fact that the immigration officers on arrival and departure were smiling and courteous I wasnt expecting to see the negative reviews below but they are not too recent so maybe things have improved

A small modern gate airport Smiling and timely checkin security and boarding Pleasant airy shared lounge with good Mongolian and other ethnic items reasonably priced Ours was the only plane at the airport let alone scheduled to fly around midday but all shops and facilities were fully open and staffed Only criticism is the lack of a bar which I would prefer to for example the bridal wear store
The airport is cool clean well ventilation and beautiful The navigation sign is clear help the customer easily navigate inside the airport The staff are considerate and thoughtful

This is a very pleasant airport especially compared to Schiphol Its efficient staff are friendly and the decor resembles a hotel lounge rather than the average airport look At peak times when a lot of leisure flights depart it can however get quite crowded As this airport is labelled as RotterdamThe Hague Airport there has to be a public transport link to The Hague This is inadequate consisting of a small shuttle bus connecting the terminal with the nearby metro station where you need to change Its all a bit of a hassle as the minibus is often too small for the number of passengers and baggage and runs infrequently outside rush hours The schedule should rather be adjusted to the arrival and departure times of flights Better still would be a direct public transport link to The Hague

Leon Bajio to Puerto Vallarta Punctual airline Small plane but confortable for a minute flight and very clean Excellent service and good attitude of ground staff and flight attendants They offer you a small snack on board free of cost The check in process at the airport was quick because the airplane has a passenger capacity

Very comfortable business class Aneo and surprisingly spacious Food includes special ingredients creates premium touch Staff are professional smiles attitudes word choices Free wifi coupon easily redeemed day before flight Not many movie choices especially for children but good noise cancelling headphones

I am incredibly grateful for the staff at Chiang Mai airport I left my phone in my grab unable to get in touch with grab due to my phone being in my grab car and details being on the app on my phone so I immediately went to the staff in line She took me to the tourist police by exit number in the international departure hall They took details such as where I got the grab from my phone number the car colour i couldnt remember the license plate number In less than minutes they were able to get in touch with the car driver and I got my phone in the next minutes after that Thank you so much to the tourist police staff on shift at am on Jan I cant remember the other staffs name that brought me to the tourist police but i took a photo with her I wish them all the best and am so grateful for their willingness to help

The airport is pretty clean Though its small its pretty cute like a park or resort This uniqueness suits the vacation vibe of the beautiful island of Koh Samui Different types of seating areas are available there are a few shops diners and a caf Checkin and immigration were both very efficient A courtesy corner full of snacks and drinks is available for free to all passengers However I wasnt able to connect to the airport WiFi

Passenger assistance is the best we have experienced very polite helpful and well organised thank you very much airport clean good to see it as drinking water fountain also impressed free bottles of water on arrival on inbound flight
Come on CMH pm on a Tuesday evening and not one restaurant on B concourse open The pandemic is easing and everyone seems to be flying again We would like to eat

GRX is fairly spacious for a regional airport Very clean marble interior with plenty of seats landside to use without having to buy anything are you listening UK airports and even though it has only one caferestaurant the food is usually great value edible and affordable lots of tapas dishes too Longshort stay parking amazingly cheap Airbus service to city is aways available and there always seem to be plenty of taxis waiting outside Very friendly security staff too A good alternative to using Malaga airport

As the previous reviewer noted Eilat airport terminal is in the centre of the city and surrounded by hotels I didnt believe the taxi driver for a few seconds when he dropped us there Once inside we got a thorough grilling by security and our bags swabbed throughout for explosives I think we got extra attention as foreigners but the female security official was very friendly and jovial much nicer that the humourless officials who you normally meet Checkin and hand baggage checks were quick and easy as the only flight was our seater Arkia departure There is a shopcafe on both landside and airside parts but we didnt get a chance to try either Overall it does the job well just be prepared for the security

Very early flight out of HK bussed from the terminal near gate downstairs so easy A bit of messing around at check in echeck in you need to show visas etc Plane spotless and staff attentive Bathrooms clean Return we prebooked one bag between us for the hold which we would recommend its about USD to do so whereas on the spot its more like US plane is immaculate and the staff responsive and quick Prebooked meals are served quickly and hot and cold drinks available Walked off to a far gate but train takes you to immigration Great for short flights and I feel they are better earlier in the day as more likely to be on time Seat is fine for a hour flight I would say Drinks arent extortionate nice cold prosecco for HK the app website is a bit tricky I joined it but had to do it all on the laptop first then open the app and register Sort of CX connected but not really Its a bit counterintuitive

Flew Mahan Air economy class from Dubai to Tehran IKA with Mahan Air A felt safe the aircraft was clean and comfortable Cabin crew service was friendly and efficient Quality of food and beverages non alocholic were of good standard Would recommend this airline to everyone

Massive improvement in airport and staff Very clean public facilities are well maintained Staff are a bit friendlier now and fewer queues on departure and arrival securityimmigration clearance due to having extra staff on counters Just need a few more shops in the terminal

We flew Jeju AIr which is South Korean Low cost airline again This time from Bangkok to Incheonseoul back and forth The checkin from Bangkok was smooth and the ground staff was very nice and kind enough to arrange wheelchair for my wife who has probem with the legs and difficulty in walking the staff also arrange the front section seat for us which we were very appriciated The plane was OK and the seat was quite comfortable compared to other Low coat Airline The cabin crew were nice and friendly although they did not serve us water as before The plane was delayed due to the late arrival of plane from Seoul Overall the flighy was smooth On the flight back to Bangkok we experienced a very kind and helpful youmg female ground staff who arrange wheelchair for my wife and change the seat to the front section the flight itself was OK The cabin crew were very nice and kind although threre was no water serving The flight was a little delayed due to traffic congestion Overall Jeju Air is quite good Low Cost Airline although there was no food and beverage serving you can purchase noodles snacks coffee and drinks on flight and no entertainment but the best thing the Jeju Air should be pround of was their nice friendly and helpful crew both ground and cabin crew

AMSAUAAMS I regularly fly ArkeFly between Europe and the Antilles and what a huge difference between the old and worn with barely enough space to breathe and the new with more spacious seats PTV and a so much better experience Furthermore the crew seems to enjoy the Dreamliner much more and even smiles are being made Also the time of always being delayed also seems to be over ArkeFly improved a lot with the Dreamliner and I even prefer Arkefly above KLM now as long as they fly the Dreamliner

Ryanair flight operated by Lauda Europe was on time Legroom wasnt great but was only just slightly worse than the same route with Austrian Airlines The crew were awesome a special shoutout to the female crew member who managed the iceinthecup situation for me I would happily fly this airline again its about the same as Austrian Airlines except you dont get a free small chocolate Recommended

A modern stylish and clean airport with good facilities but rather small The checkin area in terminal was rather crowded as were the departure gate areas Immigration was rather slow and unnecessarily complicated Customs were simple There wasnt enough seating in the gate area and the restaurant was busy There were plenty of Duty Free shops and in fact too many All in all a very nice airport

Super easy to navigate this tiny welcoming airport parking garage fees are reasonable car rental is close by drop off and pickup is efficient airport management does actually care facilities are clean food is sparse but there and it is secure Top notch tiny regional airport

A modern and moderate sized airport for the capital of Finland Staff was friendly and helpful queuing times were very short due to modern handluggage scanners The terminal itself isnt very big but has an easy to follow layout There are a lot of dutyfree stores and foodcourts of course theyre all overpriced as one might expect Connection to town is offered by trainconnection All in all a good experience
You are all so sweet and smiling I travel frequently and for the first time in my life I saw so many smiles and excellent service Well done Keep it up
Flew on th April on day visit to Amsterdam on business Lovely small airport staff friendly good bacon rolls in the cafe A very pleasant relaxing experience

Overall an excellent airport Coming in and going out immigration was fast efficient and friendly The airport is very clean and welllaid out for its size and does not feel crowded at all Decent choice of shops and places to eat

Ground staff at JFK could have been better I had a great deal of luggage and needed a special staff member to handle tagging It was hard to find him and found out he hadnt been informed for several minutes Seats comfortable to Casablanca good flight crew good catering Casablanca to Lagos had an excellent crew and the best airline catering Ive had in decades of traveling Id definitely fly them again

Booking Mostly smooth except could not select seats and when selected the selection would not be saved Checkin Got reminder and was easy to conduct online checkin except no boarding pass as the document verification is not online Boarding Chaotic as boarding was not by zones but first come first serve So lot of traffic jams in the isles and many people sitting in seats they were not assigned to Broken seats with stained covers and strange smells Handrests chipped seatbacks cracked Enough legroom Inflight entertainment Many screens and controls not working broken Wireless entertainment worked smoothly but no clear directions on how to access it Inflight meals Very basic many drink choices eg gin and tonic not available Deplaning Long wait before people could get off not sure if it was the ground staff or the plane Baggage checkin and collection Smooth Got ontime notifications about baggage being loaded on different planes along the route Collection was also easy

The seat was spacious but the recline function was lost on my seat Crew were friendly They offered one meal plus one snack for just hours The onboard announcement was inaccurate that they claimed to be landing soon hours before the actual landing Surprisingly personal onboard entertainment was offered

Ive been using this Airport over the last decade and what is happening in the country did not help a lot with the growth of the overall experience of this Terminal I can admit that compared to the other airports I visited Tunis Carthage kept a Vintage look in its facilities the Departure hall is well decorated with a breathtaking ceiling decoration and paneling the local handicraft shops and the roaming merchants in the airports give a local taste and overview of the country lifestyle The Departures hall offers a multitude of facilities including pharmacies coffeeshops Foreign exchange Post Tourism information desk Banks where passengers should do all their shopping before accessing to the Dutyfree area Once Stamped your exit a central coffee shop is conveniently positioned in the center of the hexagon shaped hall distributing all departure gates offers coffee or snacks before departure but note that beyond the police border and all over the dutyfree zone payments cannot be done in local currency and card payments are not always available due to the immaturity of card payments in Tunisia Duty free zone offers plenty of last minute gift possibilities ranging from local handicrafts souvenirs sweets and clothing to branded perfume chocolates and spirits Cleanliness remains one of the major defects in this Airport make sure you have a pack of tissue or sanitizing wipes when you use the restrooms I wish a pleasant stay in Tunisia for all visitors that would like to discover more about the magic of North Africa

Having stepped off an A a day before it was quite a strange experience to be one of just four passengers on the seater propeller ATR aircraft from Bangkok to Laos But the one hour and fiftyminute flight experience was lovely Following the traditional Sabaidee greeting from the friendly twoperson cabin crew we took off on time The elegantly uniformed flight attendant had a frangipani placed in her hair echoing the countrys national flower as well as it being in the airlines logo The x seating was comfortable with ample leg room Although a small airline it had an inflight magazine It was a sunny day and flying at around feet we had a clear view of the mountainous green scenery below A small snack box was offered which contained a tuna and cheese sandwich and drink and hot coffee was also served On arrival at Luang Prabang stepping out umbrellas were available just in case you found it too hot or if it was raining to walk to the terminal building The return flight was also on time this time with around or so passengers nearly all enjoying posing for photos by the aircraft

There is also an excellent restaurant on the mezzanine floor overlooking the runway It opens at noon which gives adequate time for a good lunch before the departure of the Luton flight at Information on bus transportation to and within Nimes is at httpwwwtcnfr

LIB aka Daniel Oduber International Airport is the second main airport of Costa Rica The current terminal opened within the last year Bright cheerful facility with windows viewing the runway etc Security was tight shoes belts etc to be removed Currently flights a day Sunwing TACA United American Delta and Westjet Adequate ground transport Only issue was the food concession US for a bottle of water and a chicken wrap Our flight was the only one Monday morning other than a small TACA regional plane The other all leave within the pm window
Kualanamu airport is very good Check in counters are good the waiting room is comfortable and clean But the toilets are not too clean but no problem The airport staff are good

Hong Kong to Beijing with Cathay Dragon My seat was at the middle of the aircraft One meal was served and the total flight time was about hours The meal service was good The crew were friendly and nice Nevertheless the inflight entertainment system was not quite updated and the legroom of the economy class seat was not quite enough The area of the restrooms could also be improved In total it was enjoyable flight

I travelled from London Heathrow to Rotterdam on February and returned the following day On the outward journey I was through immigrationpassport control in less than a minute Arrivals area contains an information desk which provided useful information on onward connections and provided me with change for the bus travel recommendations and a complementary city map Bus number leaves from virtually outside arrivals and takes approx minutes to reach Rotterdam Central It costs euros at the time of writing and the driver has limited change On the return journey there was no queue for checkin and virtually no queue for security This is a small airport but there are decent airside facilities including a duty free shop cafe newsagent and an upstairs bar which has an outdoor seating area and viewing platform If you are travelling with BA there are no lounge facilities but you are allowed three complementary items from the airport cafe for which you will need to complete an information card Clear information throughout the terminal and announcements in English and in Dutch Free Internet in departures which was fast and required no password Overall this was a stress free experience and I was impressed with Rotterdam Airport

Small airport which was about minutes on bus to the city center Facilities was good and clean Baggage claim was fast and thoughtful as at many other Japanese airports Signs and directions were also clearly noted in English

Intersky is another airline charging high prices for regional services using and chartering cheap airlines Just flew back from SZG to ZRH Friendly stewardess and good service captain did not say a word Even though Intersky is the only direct Service between SZG and ZRH I would rather fly LH via Frankfurt

One of Brazils better airports although its design is stark and gloomy though airy Used aforementioned Conexio Aeroporto bus service to get there punctual fast and good quality Food wise all the usual airport restaurants are here but on the third floor to the left is a real find if you want real food and youre on a budget the Restaurante Social looks like a university canteen but serves palatable food at nonairport prices

I was a disabled passenger on the Tui flight departure date which eventually took off All Madeirian staff at the airport were polite very helpful in particular the disabled Assistance staff The poor weather affecting the departure will not deter my family from coming back to Funchal All the very best for the new year

Whats not to like about DFW You can park at any terminal and take the SkyLink to whichever terminal youre departing from Departure from Terminal E and arrival at Terminal A Parked across from Terminal E United Airlines gates TSAPre took a little bit longer than usual to clear minutes Both Terminals A E are spacious with plenty of shops and dining options Terminals were clean

This airport is very nice clean and efficient The staff at the airport are also very kind and welcoming I remember I was a little late to my flight and only had around half an hour to the flight from the checkin area They really got me in and out very fast and I had around minutes to spare Very thankful for that

From Prague to Saint Petersburg and back new aircraft Airbus A comfortable seats with a nice legroom space cabin crew were polite friendly and helpful Rossiya Airlines is really good and I can say that they are much better than many other European Airlines

Security was super helpful As we were passing through security someone stole my wifes Apple Watch from the box after we went through the Xray We immediately notice it was missing and reported it Security checked the cameras and found the thief Using the image from the cameras they tracked down the passenger and recuperated our watch All this within minutes Amazing

Every time on arrival from either holiday work meetings interstate or visiting relatives in Melbourne I feel all the renovations look great but please put the car park ticket machines near the carousel arrival hall out of the weather When some people pay at the gate they hold up the traffic I travel with Virgin regularly and cant wait for the renovations to be finished

Bari Airport looks new but they have not yet found a way to avoid a minute wait for security checks Leaving tourists in a minute queue for security is not a good way to attract tourists If the queue is minutes on th April what will it be in July and August Puglia is a great region to visit and Bari is an excellent gateway Pity the local autorities cant run an airport

Impressed Booked a domestic hop at last minute Much cheaper than its competitors Had my flight cancelled from LGW to HAN earlier this month I expected the airline to be unreliablelate how very wrong I was Everything was faultless check in was smooth boarding and departure on time crew very courteous and polite Arrived safely and out of the airport in less than min Overall given a chance Bamboo would be my airline of choice while travelling around Asia

There are terminals terminal A for most domestic flights Garuda Indonesia Lion Air Wings Air Citilink and terminal B for international flights and other domestic flights Sriwijaya Air NAM Air Air Asia and Express Air Terminal B is smaller than Terminal A but the facilities are quite good The security staff and ground staff are good There are some shops that sell food and drink with reasonable prices There are also some toilets and ATM for the passengers Some minor issues are the lack of electrical socket for charging your gadget The seat in the waiting room is adequate in quality and quantity There are some traditional Javanese ornament in the airport

BrusselsAleppo DamascusBrussels Cheapest tickets to Syria direct flights from Brussels to Aleppo and Damascus friendly crew adequate food Although older Airbus they were clean and looked well maintained and a lot of legspace

Flew Phnom Penh to Siem Reap with Bassaka Air As I knew nothing about this airline I was a bit apprehensive but there was no need to be Checkin was fast and friendly Boarding was by bus and once on board the courteous cabin crew made us feel very welcome The plane was definitely old but very clean and our exit row seats had plenty of legroom Other seats looked a bit cramped but the flight was short Surprisingly a quick drink was served during the minute flight which operated minutes early Overall a pleasant experience The only negative was that the Fasten Seat Belt signs in the cabin were not working
This flight was just the dream hrs of first class service with top quality crew amazing food great Q Suite The flight was so smooth and pleasant the hospitality was amazing

Addis Ababa to Sanaa Flight leaves Addis early morning but requested to be at airport two hours before departure making this hmin flight an allnighter Boarding called way too early leaving pax waiting almost an hour at gate before doors opened Old A Economy seats xx config had exit row so okay for space In spite of hand luggage limits several pax carrying huge bundles cramming the overhead bins Bit of commotion as some pax were not allocated desired seats took a while to sort Meal served but didnt eat as trying to catch some sleep Lights left on throughout flight Seats standard economy not too clean though and interior showed serious signs of wear

Budapest and ClujNapoca times return The staff have always been pleasant and helpful food the best I have been served on flights for many years On one flight when the plane landed minues earlier than scheduled the cabin crew were very apologetic because there hadnt been time to serve coffee after the meal One reviewer mentioned the problem of payment I had this problem on my first booking but since Carpatair has been liaising closely with Malev this has not occurred again I would certainly recommend this airline

I decided to fly to Siem Reap from Phnom Penh as it was a much quicker and enjoyable I cannot believe the price of the Bassaka Air flight it was pretty much the same as a bus The checkin was the quickest check in Ive had at an airport anywhere The staff were great and it was the first time Ive ever been on a budget airline where I received a free drink Bearing in mind we were only flying for minutes I cant speak highly enough for this airline

China Eastern Airlines customer service has been improved dramatically since before the pandemic of COVID In economy class I feel well treated by cabin crew and everyone was so kind and well motivated I have ordered the vegetarian meal and I was not enjoyed the the cabin crew brought me nice food to replace Especially flight MU compared to MU I flew with this month the cabin crew did really fantastic job The only thing I was a bit disappointed is there is very limited option of inflight entertainment especially in A which was MU flight But overall both two aircrafts had fantastic leg space for a cm tall guy

I was visiting family in India so this was the airport we went to and it was actually really good there They had lounge chairs at the gates The only problem was the constant beep during a conveyor belt motion and it was really annoying and it spread throughout the airport I really do think this is a great airport overall

Stavanger is a comfortable and bright regional airport Arrival is hasslefree with short walking distances and quick luggage delivery Departure is easy too with selfservice checkin machines Although I flew on a busy Sunday afternoon waiting time to clear security control did not exceed mins However the departure lounge clearly lacks seating areas An airport bus connects the airport with the city centre every mins note that it only accepts cash and no credit cards

BirminghamShuttlesworth Airport is absolutely exceptional across the board Modern well laid out and astonishingly clean Good facilities throughout Parking easy and close to the terminal The modernization of all the facilities done smoothly I live miles away close to another commercial airport but gladly drive the three hour round trip to fly from BHM as I will in April

My recent flight with Binter Canarias from Fuerteventura to Las Palmas was a delightful surprise The flight itself was a breeze clocking in at just minutes and departed right on schedule Binter Canarias impressed me most with their commitment to passenger comfort despite the short flight duration The aircraft a brand new ATR felt incredibly spacious with ample legroom The cabin crew were topnotch professional friendly and accommodating They even provided a complimentary snack of water candy and a chocolate bar a small gesture that went a long way Considering the price I paid for the ticket the overall experience felt miles ahead of what Ive come to expect from many established European legacy carriers Binter Canarias exceeded my expectations in every way If youre looking for a comfortable and hasslefree way to island hop in the Canaries I wouldnt hesitate to recommend them

Colombo International airport is a joke Never had such a horrific experience as a tourist on an international flight This airport is notorious for ripping you off and charging unconventional baggage fees for carrying a personal item such as a purse or even food They weighed our food and charged me over for my purse and food They even wanted to wear my jacket that I was wearing I do not recommend this airport and they are notorious for treating tourist like this as I was advised when I landed in the Maldives Sri Lanka in general is a phenomenal country with amazing people

I flew in one of Sky Expresss ATR aircraft from Kythira to Athens The ground staff at Kythira airport and flight attendants were very friendly and professional The aircraft was old but clean and comfortable enough Boarding was completed on time and the door closed That the takeoff was delayed by an hour was not the airlines fault A clearly annoyed pilot explained that there was some sort of lightning air traffic control strike at least that is what the other passengers told me because the explanation given by the clearly annoyed pilot was given only in Greek Otherwise the flight was perfectly enjoyable and I have no complaints about the airline Inflight service on the minute flight consisted of a predeparture sweet a bottle of water and a small biscuit

Hong Kong to Tokyo Both outbound and inbound flights were ontime Very little or no turbulence experienced during journeys This was very good Checkins at ground were fast and efficient Will choose Vanilla Air again in the future

Hilo International Airport was once THE airport on the Big island before Kona International Airport on the other side of the island opened in the ss Now Hilo Airport is a shadow of its former self with jetways no more than of which are in use at any given time The decor is kitschy s Hawaiiana and the terminal is warm and welcoming Hilo is one of the few US airports where the gate area and the ticketingbag claim are in separate buildings separated by an atrium The ticketingbag claim area has a bar a bookshop a souvenir shop selling Hawaiiana and packaged tropical fruit and a lounge area The gate building has no facilities The parking and car rental areas are just across the street from bag claim and the total walk from gate to kerb is only a few hundred feet Access to and from Hilo town is easy and traffic is usually light

Paris Orly to Newark Longtime customer of OpenSkies when it was business class only and the original Lavion Chose La Compagnie and glad we did Our flight was canceled at Orly back to Newark and it was a mess the gate agents at Orly did not speak English well and there was lack of information given we had to rebook days later on another flight home on our own with the airline no one at the gate could assist us with that and they only have planes and dont partner with other airlines days stuck in Paris with hotel hopping so why the stars The compensation when we got home to the states and quick communication and customer service was great They offered to pay for our meals hotels and cabs for the days stuck in Paris The flights were so comfortable great entertainment on the flights and great food I was able to sleep comfortably with a pillow and the plane seemed very clean The flight crew was lovely both ways and couldnt have been nicer For the price this was a fantastic value for business class and was much better than United First Class to Paris I hope they stay in business

Friedrichshafen Hamburg It was one of my best experiences on a regional flightairline Aircraft was clean The crew CheckIn to cabin crew was very polite as well as highly professional Flight attendant made clearly understandable announcementssafety demos The only downside is that Intersky asks passengers to pay prohibitive expensive prices for onboard drinkssnacks But since they consider themselves as a low cost airline truly providing LCC price level it was no surprise and everybody is free not to buy anything
One of the best choices in Brazil The airport is very modern pretty and clean it can be considered an architecture beauty Way better than So Paulo and Rio

Flew GA Jakarta to Amsterdam I was escorted from terminal kerb side by GarudaIndonesia First Class Team member Vianda who helped me with check in clearing security and immigration formalities and then through to the FirstClass lounge I had fruit platter in the lounge and soft drinks The lounge team are extremely helpful and will go out of their way to help in anyway they can When it came time for boarding Vianda assisted me to the aircraft door where I was meet by the FirstClass cabin crew Rizky Rika Marissa Chef Chrisma who greeted me and directed me to my seat During the flight I also met with one of the First Officers Agam who came out for a rest and I really enjoyed the conversation with him and the cabin crew It really is like flying with friends they treat you with a warm smile and they will go out of their way to help in any way they can There was a good selection of food onboard including snack meals The breakfast meal can be ordered for whatever time you want therefore I chose for breakfast to be served hours prior to landing The quality of food portion size and presentation were outstanding I would also point out the overall cleanliness of the aircraft and the toilets are very well maintained The cabin crew go in a deep clean after every person I give total credit to the cabin crew I also used the free Wi Fi and the connectivity was excellent When we arrived in Amsterdam Schiphol airport we were met at the plane door by the Schiphol VIP Team who took me to the VIP centre where we go through immigration and checkin for my onward flight This is another great service provided by GarudaIndonesia and it very convenient and avoids all the long queues I would like to thank the GarudaIndonesia First Class Team on the ground and to the FirstClass Cabin crew for the outstanding services they provide

Departure from Memphis The airport was ok I regard it as the best airport I experienced during my trip much better than Newark EWR and better than Chicago OHare ORD The stores and restaurants was plentiful but the airport is quite small The staff was friendly and efficient It was also quite clean much better than the other airports I passed through this trip in the USA It was easy to navigate through too Many small airports are better than their reputation

Used Estonian times in the last months AMSTLL vice versa Pleasantly surprised CRJ with a lot of legroom Charming staff Disliked the practice of sending economy passengers to a kiosk in TLL to get a boarding pass where you pay euros Once had a delay of minutes which the captain explained announcements over the speakers were very distorted and hard to understand Boarding at TLL was a mess The plane was a bit late arriving disembarking passengers refuelling no bridge from the gate people kept waiting Catering was okay but you pay through the nose of course No visa cards just cash

There were no drivers for wheelchair passengers We waited and waited In the end I went to desk twice The young lady on the computer was very irritable and no help I as a very old lady was beginning to panic as my flight EZY to Luton was due to depart in half an hour I think they got a lady staff from Security to wheel me to Departures I was nearly the last to board my plane Come on Palma Airport you need to improve organisation of Special Assistance The lady that wheeled me to Departures was lovely and helpful

I am convinced that anyone that has anything bad to say about Stansted is either paid delusional or a banker that hasnt got anything positive to say about anything Ive travelled to airports so not quite as many as some people but Ive been to enough to say that Stansted is bloody marvelous at what it does Its simple clean efficient has a beautiful single terminal building some of the fastest security queues Ive ever seen no matter how many people its trying to push through Stansted is quite simply operationally one of the best ever and Ive never had to wait more than minutes departing Even arrivals moves ridiculously fast and while sometimes you can wait in a queue that looks lengthy to enter the country it never takes that long The people working at Stansted know how to move Its an absolutely marvelous display and it always astounds me whenever I go Its a well signposted airport very easy to navigate the quiet area is fantastic loads of shops and food options My only MINOR criticism is that it can sometimes be difficult to find a place to sit down upstairs but other than that its absolutely a class airport
Uncomfortable poor facilities dirty and crowded Dirty smelly toilets Such a shame at the end of our trip as for the rest of it I found Poland to be so clean and pleasant

I would like to express my sincere gratitude and appreciation Excellent service made me spend a pleasant and unforgettable time during my air journey First of all I would like to thank you for the safe and comfortable travel environment you provided me Throughout the flight the crew members maintained a high level of vigilance and professionalism Their smiles warm greetings and meticulous care made me feel the warmth of home

This is a great airport and the T terminal is newly established everything inside this airport are symbols of a modernized airport Staff were friendly and helpful in helping directing me to the baggage claim area upon arrival as well as help me check in efficiently by asking my seat preference which I havent experienced during check in before Only disadvantage would be the WiFi in the airport when I arrived in the airport I do not have a Chinese mobile phone and in order to connect to the airport WiFi I need to have a valid Chinese phone number so I could receive verification code unlike my transfer flight in Guangzhou where I could simply connect to the WiFi using my WeChat account Overall my experience with WNZ is great but please fix the WiFi issue so international traveler can connnect to the WiFi

A small airport where you can go from the luggage checkin to the gate within minutes There were enough places to sit down and the WiFi is good If you want to eat something before the security there is a restaurant with enough food pricequality top After the security you can also drink or eat something Boarding goes quickly
Chiang Mai to Yangon return and pleasantly surprised by the standard fairly new aircraft and meal service for minute flight Flight attendants were somewhat offhand Reasonable leg room in economy

Singapore to Yangon I didnt know what to expect when I booked this flight but I dont regret The airplane was clean staff was friendly and food was good Also a lot of space for the legs good entertainment and opportunity to charge phonetablet In the EmiratesGaruda league in my opinion

The inflight experience in Aircalin is quite decent Friendly bilingual cabin crew decent enough food and drinks and a nice cabin overall Where my experience really fell apart was the constant changes in flight times I flew from Singapore to Noumea then Noumea to Port Vila before flying back to Singapore the same way First there were minor half hour adjustments a few weeks after booking This in itself is fine Then my Noumea to Port Vila leg was rescheduled weeks before departure and I had to change my tickets because it was no longer possible to catch that flight it took off before I landed in Noumea Then and this is most disappointing my flight from Port Vila to Noumea got substantially changed just days before departure I was supposed to fly from Port Vila to Noumea at pm on a Monday night so I would have spent the full day resting by the beach before heading to the airport and catching my flight I would have then caught another flight to Singapore hours later having a swift but efficient transit in Noumea The flight to Noumea got pulled forward to am in the morning and thus I spent the last day of my holiday sitting around in Noumea airport No attempt at improving the situation was provided and as we couldnt check our bags all the way through me and other passengers on this itinerary were stuck at the airport all day lugging our suitcases around No meaningful attempt at improving this situation was made by Aircalin This is where the Aircalin experience really fell apart for me I booked and paid to spend the last day of my holiday relaxing by the beach then catching a night flight to Noumea a swift layover and a subsequent flight to Singapore Instead I had to wake up early to catch my flight to Noumea and spend my entire day at the airport These experiences are entirely different and considering the fact that I booked the st experience it is not acceptable that I was stuck with the nd with no meaningful recourse The first experience is highvalue and efficient while the second experience is more reflective of a budget itinerary As an airline once you create a schedule you should stick to it Constantly changing the schedule and messing around with passengers itineraries is an easy way to leave a sour taste in their mouth even if the inflight experience is decent

AirAsia keeps getting better its hard to believe they are a budget airline The ground crew was efficient and accommodating the cabin crew was attentive and friendly and the seats were clean and comfy We chose the Thai vegetarian Penang Curry that was yummy Big tip for this flight Tokyo to Bangkok book a window seat on the right side of the aircraft if you want to get an incredible aerial view of Mount Fuji
We flew from Toronto to Paris Flight attendants were very helpful and welcoming We especially appreciated Emersons help He was great Ground crew were great too
Very easy to reach and easy to move around inside terminal Clear signs polite and friendly staff Plenty of seats by gate

This is the major airport for southwest China Flew into Chengdu from Shenzhen where it was quite a lengthy walk from the Terminal gate to baggage claim This was topped off with a further lengthy walk to the opposite end of the terminal for the taxi rank Flying out a week later I had time to look at the airport more closely Terminal is old and definitely looking its age Terminal was shiny and modern with three fingers that extend out Plenty of interesting shops to keep myself amused inside the terminal and the lounges were adequately comfortable The feeling was light and airy inside with a good view to the outside despite the extra glass screen separating arriving passengers from departing ones

There are many different airport choices for this area Harrisburg MDT offers a good selection of carriers United Delta US Air Air Canada Allegiant which does wonders to keep the prices reasonable Which makes it an appealing choice relative to Hagerstown State College Lancaster or Williamsport There are also only gates in the terminal The daily parking garage is an easy walk theres a shuttle to longterm parking and a reasonable number of places to eat The terminal is clean reasonably quiet and very easy to navigate and use Unlike Philly Baltimore Pittsburgh or Reagan National

Nanjing to Kunming on a new B As I was sitting in in seat F had a lot of legroom Cabin crew was excellent I was served a tasty dish on the hour flight For the return flight the ground staff Ticketing Desk in Kunming was outstanding
Needed a wheel chair because of an injury people were so helpful and caring A special thank you to Damian who pushed my wheel chair So grateful Thank you

The airport of Yangon was very clean with good airconditioning the queue for the visa was not long so it was fast the belt with the bags was easy to find Good impression when you arrive Has also a really good conection with bus to the city center

I arrived at PSP from SFO I have used the airport from time to time in the past It is quite capable of coping with its traffic but has experienced one major improvement whereby hired cars can now be collected on site This is very welcome especially when the heat is high

Ground staff at JFK could have been better I had a great deal of luggage and needed a special staff member to handle tagging It was hard to find him and found out he hadnt been informed for several minutes Seats comfortable to Casablanca good flight crew good catering Casablanca to Lagos had an excellent crew and the best airline catering Ive had in decades of traveling Id definitely fly them again

Checkin was very slow with just three counters open for the full flight Boarding was unorganized and chaotic with just two gate agents being overwhelmed controlling the crowd There were no boarding groups and at the end they gave up and it was free for all As a result the flight took off minutes late Seats on the A were comfortable with a responsible seat pitch Service was good with ok food

Izmir Adnan Menderes Airport seems a bit far from downtown but it has a connection of a local rail system called zban and it takes about minutes to reach the airport There are lots of food and beverage options on the ground Prices are high in my opinion but you can find something suitable for your budget Its very clean and safe Also there are lots of taxis and buses you can use

I cannot say enough how much I enjoyed this airline experience From the check in counter to the TSA at the local tiny airport to the pilots It is totally a different way of flying commercial and just so much more personal I wish more routes were like this because its such a nice experience My flight was also minutes early on arrival which allowed me to get to my next gate with ease Thank you Boutique Air and hope to fly you again some day Maybe there will be wifi next time

Great experience at arrival Very friendly staff welcoming all the way Quick check of Thailand Pass with no waiting time as smooth through immigration The bags already on belt when we came to arrival hall

I have mixed feelings about this airport Upon arrival the checkin process took almost no time at all and I was on my way in a matter of minutes Terminal signs presecurity were limited but easy enough that I was able to find the C security checkpoint quick enough Security was a different story The wait was brutal taking over an hour to clear On top of this the staff were not very fast chatting to everyone about travel plans flying etc Terminal signage postsecurity was much clearer and my gate was found quite fast Departure was also very efficient and boarding went by fast and I was departing on time Overall this airport has good and bad but its one of the better airports that Ive been to

Windhoek is a small airport with an increasing number of flights Facilities are limited but everything you need is there and seemed sufficient for numbers passing through Arriving early departing late on Air Namibia fromto FRA arrival took less than an hour and departing security was a reasonable time Staff were efficient and friendly Much easier to pass through than major airports

Nice to Rome was only CAD total compared to other airlines charging close to per person for the same route We did expect to be a baggage fee as they charge you Euros per kg over kg but pleasantly surprised to only be charged an additional Euros total Plane clean staff were very nice The reason everyone lines up hour before the flight we didnt figure this out until too late is because seating is not assigned That being said our seats were fine and flight was great Only complaint was that the flight was hours late in arriving In their defence they had emailed our home email address a day or so before to notify us but we didnt have access to our home email so didnt find out until we arrived at the airport

Simferopol Airport in has one brand new pier and the other two renovated All look extremely busy at peak season but very well organised clean bright well airconditioned spacious and friendly for travelers Large and convenient parking available Airports transfer options include shuttle buses taxis and even trolleybuses there is the longest km trolleybus line in the world between Simferopol Airport and the coastal city of Yalta on the Black Sea There were no queues at the entrance and pretty short ones at registration desks There could be more seats available at the lounge area than the airport now has Security officers are polite and efficient It was a pity the airport still had outdoor boarding halls but we were assured that it was a matter of time a year or two Overall it is an easy airport to use It will be nice to come back here later

The airport was renovated in before the Olympic games it looks like Miami International Airport nothing special good duty free some good lounges all in all good airport with some problems with queues and not so friendly staff

This is one of the nicest airports I have visited The staff are all helpful and cheerful The security system is quick and efficient and the seating areas are comfortable and spacious The woman playing piano in the area prior to security really sets the tone The whole expereince was professional polite and efficient

Despite the difficult situation in Egypt this airport has got no worse since I was last here two years ago neither has it got any better It was clean and it had adequate facilities for the reduced number of passengers now using the airport Duty Free prices are ridiculously high and therefore not as well used as they could be There is free wifi but I could not get a reliable signal Baggage delivery on arrival was astonishingly fast a quality for other airports to copy The longest queues were those going through security at the front door of the airport other security queues were quite short

Just flew from Vienna to Podgorica and on to Belgrade with Montenegro Airlines The first flight was operated by a Fokker and the second leg was operated by a new Embraer jet I was very pleased with their overall product Their flight attendants were active throughout the flight and spoke decent English the services on board were pretty good the seats were relatively comfortable both flights were ontime and the price was cheap Tranzit at Podgorica Airport went very easy due to the small size of the airport Overall great flight Id fly them again

Pretty basic as airports go Way out of town it is simply ridiculous and taxis are well keep your belt on and wear a helmet if you have one The airport sort of works but this is a typical domestic Chinese airport not great not entirely hideous but you know what If you want to fly to Hangzhou its this or nothing I can tell you it is heaven compared to the central rail station

This small airport was a model of efficiency clean cool organised with a friendly restaurant serving Indian and Western food The Kingfisher Airlines ground crew were excellent The short walk to the plane will sadly end when a shiny new terminal is soon completed

Flew both into and out of Lima airport Arrival was a swift process with immigration taking about minutes and then the bags arrived shortly after Met my driver and it was a v short walk to the car Departure was also a breeze quiet LATAM premium check in and then through security and passport control quickly Staff were friendly and helpful The Sumaq lounge was pleasant with good options for food and drink Boarding was on time Im sure the airport could do with some modernisation but it worked perfectly for me

On the th of October i arrived at the airport with a Uber rider Shortly after i left i noticed i left my phone in the uber who has driven off My flight was hour and minutes away from departure I tried asking for multiple people within the airport for help if they had the uber app to help me contact the driver as i would not be able to check in to the flight without my phone The kind police security gentleman by the name of Chris kindly helped me contact uber let me use his phone to call the uber driver and with only minutes left for depart kindly helped me through the security queue Honestly a life saver and I couldnt be more grateful for finding this man this day and i would like to once again thank you if you ever read this review

Over minutes to get through passport control Travelers and staff looking cold and tired as midnight passes flights luggage all coming onto carousel others silent and still It was an opportunity to shine and it wasnt taken even a hot drink would have made it more bearable No explanation for delays given by any staff

It was great to fly out of and into TriCities regional airport again Had no problems it was great From check in thru security and the passenger boarding area Security helped my wife greatly because of back surgery she said they were wonderful

Having travelled to and from Vnukovo twice both times flying on German Wings from Berlin it is an infinitely better introduction to Moscow than Sheremetyevo Immigration on the way in was as foreigner friendly as anywhere else in Russia huge lines officious officers scrutinising every last page of your passport and visa but everything else is great The new international terminal is very modern lots of glass On departure Germanwings flights depart from a gate area in the depths of the basement or so it seems but facilities including duty free and food are good if expensive by Russian standards There is a branch of SberBank in arrivals but the rates are awful so try not to change too much here just enough to get into the city centre As for travel to Moscow the best bet is the shared taxi transit van to Yugo Zapadnaya metro and then take the metro These services leave from just outside the domestic terminal right next to the international one

Main hub in Northeast Colombia Although small the terminal is clean and tidy Tends to get crowded during peak hours As many airports in Colombia renovation is taking place Most of the terminal is airconditioned immigration and customs was fast as was luggage delivery The airport has ATMs some souvenir shops and a small observation deck Flight arrival and departure announcements need improvement with regard to acoustics as information can barely be heard while waiting in the food court airconditioning will be more than welcome in this area Lets see what the airport looks after renovation is completed Pleasant experience Wifi connectivity was very good

Late flight out on New Years day I love this small airport its quick to get though and friendly A surprisingly well stocked duty free shop with a good choice A small cafe before boarding I imagine its how airports were years ago and is a pleasure to travel through

A small airport divided into mini terminals domestic international arrival and international departure Border control was fast and efficient despite the large amount of passengers The terminals itself are clean and well maintained but rather s looking Access to the aircraft is by bus boarding only There are many taxis to the center but negotiate well A few busses are available too but look like from a museum

Toykos nd airport smaller and closer to the city Arrival process OK but suffered from being rather manual with queues for immigration and then passport control despite offering online advanced registration Baggage reclaim quite quick Excellent transport links by bus train or taxi clear signs in Japanese and English Ticket Machines for trains ONLY take cash but do give change and are fantastic value for money Leaving Japan the process is very speedy with Bag Drop etc and then Security and automated passport gates There is a cafe on the Arrivals Level if you arrive too early to checkin or are waiting to be picked up on arrival Within the terminal is the usual array of shops and eating places focused more on the regionallocal travellers rather than the full Duty Free range of goods you might find elsewhere in the region Reasonable seating near the departure gates and overall quite quick turnround of planes
Detroit Metro is always clean convenient and well maintained Staff is usually pleasant and helpful We travel through DTW about times per year and we have always had a positive experience

Hugh brand new terminals both International and Domestic Check in was the usual full baggage screening but the lines were not long Once at check in again everything was easy as we were a group of our tour guide checked all the bags as we just sat and waited all very efficient Airport vast and very clean once in departure lounge on upper level there were shops for snacks and good coffee or tea Announcements made over loud speaker system but very difficult to understand

Klagenfurt is very small and the staff there might not be as busy as their colleagues from other airports Likewise the ground handling is very fast and efficient Moreover the personnel are overwhelmingly friendly and helpful Unfortunately there is no airport lounge and the only small caf is before the security check The seats in the waiting area are not the most comfortable ones as well Travelling to and from KLU by car or bus is just fine however if you want to go by train it might turn out as a nightmare The closest train station is only a stop for commuter trains SBahn and is located more than one mile away from the terminal

Bangkok to Hong Kong and return After several good experiences I only use Orient Thai for my flights to Hong Kong Their price is Set regardless whether youre buying ahead or last moment Other low costs can have their cheapest offers around US less however that distinction quickly fades with slapping you various charges before you click buy Orient Thais fare is all inclusive inclusive of taxes a hot meal and KG of baggage too They used to fly an older B however now they use the version Flights were on time the plane was comfortable Staff active and helpful Seats and leg room superior to other low cost and many full fare airlines out there Only drawback is that there is no online check in and you get seats at the airport so you might not get your favourite seat All in all cannot fault them and love to see them fly to more Asian destinations

VnukovoIrkutsk An eventful and enjoyable flight Everything went smoothly Vnukovo is the closest airport to the city centre and it has also a convenient train connection the train departs from the Kievsky train station This helps to avoid the usual heavy traffic of Moscow UTair uses a new terminal A which is quite handy It is likely that UTair is the only airline which uses a widebody B on this route and the plane seems to be a relatively new and wellmaintained one Friendly flight attendants the flight was ontime onboard catering is not superb but it was OK Would fly them again

I flew in on Lufthansas twice weekly flight via Samara no February st They are the only international carrier Apart from immigration refusing to acknowledge the computer generated form from the Russian Federations London Embassy which meant I had to fill one in by hand everything was fine I was in and out of the airport inside halfanhour
Lots of seating Not enough electric plugs or charge points WiFi was hopeless it didnt work Tannoy too loud Staff seem nice enough Appeared clean

TripVerified Smooth Check In cooperative staff at Beijing Daxing International airport on time boarding very friendly in flight crew and wonderful on board services Very nice in flight meal I had ordered vegetarian lacto OVO meal I was confirmed with a type western vegetarian meal and was served a meal with tag AVML However whatever I got to eat was served hot tasty and was tasty I was given a blanket to use for the mid night flight The in flight entertainment was not of my taste though I used the flight information and enjoyed it The cabin was clean and everything else was good Good experience

The passenger terminal in Fargo has limited but all the essential services I used it for arriving and departing to hub cities for onward connections Taxi drivers were near the baggage belts soliciting fares On departure you check in on the main floor and take escalators one flight up To your left is a large enough gift shop with the usual items plus North Dakota State University memorabilia On the right is a food court with a few eateries including a Subway The security check was smooth Once on the airside there is a coffee shop and a kiosk of a shop a miniatiure version of the gift shop on the other side There are quite a few chairs and signage is good A very easy airport to use and quick to get out of and quick to get in
