Hargeisa to Djibouti Air Djibouti operates one single Boeing leased with crew from a company in Tajikistan as well as reportedly a few smaller aircraft We flew from Hargeisa to Djibouti in November The plane had arrived from Mogadishu with a delay but landed in JIB almost on time It was definitely at least years old but appeared to be in a very good state of repair Seats were tight but comfortable Catering consisted of a single bottle of water which was ok on this min hop Okay was also our general impression

This place should be a model for small airports around the world They even use airbridges which are great for avoiding the cold winds Luggage didnt take too long but all bags have to be xrayed because youre not allowed to bring meat fruit or plants into Patagonia Then there are stalls for taxis and tour bookings and the VES shuttle bus service to hotels is at the stand marked Bus oneway or if you book the return leg at the same time Tourist staff can speak English Great views of the Andes out the right side on approach I think I saw Mt Fitz Roy and some gnarly winds On departure the shuttle bus dropped us at the airport minutes ahead which was plenty Checkin staff raced through the passengers security was fast and friendly wifi was free but somewhat unreliable decent cafe on both sides of security views of the runway and lake lots of toilets Probably the best small regional airport that Ive ever experienced

We had some troubles getting to the airport and were so worried we were going to be late We arrived at the check in counter just a few minutes late but the Jin Air employees were so kind and accommodating They got us through security and to our gate and we made a flight we otherwise would have definitely missed Just so grateful Thank you

We boarded on time but we had hour delay due to traffic at ATH get too hot so crew open doors again and served water Plane was nice and clean Crew were very friendly We landed with half an hour delay Nice inflight service for hm flight

I feared for the crush that is too common at any Indian queuing point but neednt have For an early morning flight the only short delay was getting in to the terminal like all Indian airport terminals you have to show your flight documents After that checkin immigration security all wellmanaged and smooth at least no problems for me

Eilat to Tel Aviv The plane arrived minutes late but that was ok The boarding was quick and nice The cabin crew was good nice and helpful minutes on the flight and we got some snacks I love Israirs snacks Of course you could get some water with it The landing was pretty shaky

John Wayne Airport is all about efficiency and comfort This airport has one of the most direct and easy access to the freeway of any airport that I have been to I took Southwest Airlines from John Wayne to Las Vegas Checkingin my bags at the airline counter and going through security took me no more than minutes There are plenty of open seats at this terminal and a variety of restaurants to choose from Southwest terminal has large windows from which passengers can enjoy views of aircraft taking off and landing John Wayne also provides free wifi

I would like to write about the splendid service given to me my spouse by Air Asia AK Kuala Lumpur to Denpasar on Friday Im so proud to mention about these two cabin crew Ms Camelia Mr Amirul Their love and care is still lingering in our mind Kudos to Air Asia to have them in their crew family Our most sincerest gratitude Love you guys a lot our best wishes in your future

Nauru to Brisbane via Honiara I have flown with Nauru Airlines numerous times They are one of the best international airlines I have flown with Qantas Emirates Singapore Airlines Cathay Pacific Malaysian etc The cabin staff were very friendly and hospitable Ground staff are polite and efficient Nauru Airlines Cabin staff kept serving drinks time to time My special meal requests had been fulfilled and the meals were delicious Seats had decent leg room Toilets were clean Had a smooth take off and landing

Nice and small airport at El Alto La Paz The process to get my bags was average in time and customs was friendly and polite There are a few cafes and a couple of restaurants I could see Ground transpiration is readily available by taxi or minibus The airport is not a big building but it has wifi it is clean and has many standard services

Beijing Nanyuan to Hohhot China United is the only airline that uses Beijing Nanyuan a former military airport in the South of Beijing The airport is easy to get to and flights in and out of Nanyuan do not seem to be subject to delays as serious as those at Beijing Capital Theres also very little taxiing Checkin was quick easy but the checkin area is noisy and dilapidated Toilets at the airport werent great The flight was on a newish and the plane was clean Service was friendly and the bacon wrap for breakfast was actually very nice Takeoff and arrival were both on schedule Id use China United again just to avoid the delays at Beijing Capital

Mumbai Airport never fails to impress me from the dedicated drop off options or the overall efficiency It is my favourite major airport to travel from I am more impressed with arrival facilities but even departure is as good as it gets Only fundamental issue is its very overcrowded
CPHFAE return new aircraft on time friendly and smiling FA snack alcoholic nonalcoholic beverage served

I had read the worst reviews about NDjili International Airport and did not exactly look forward to the experience of arriving and departing there But my hopes were set on some other articles I had found about a new international terminal that opened end of built by Chinese contractors I must say the new terminal the staff working there and the guarded parking and dropoff areas in front of it are exceptionally good It is a small but very bright and clean building Customs officers are professional and nice to the passengers same applies to security staff at Xray machines and where one must pay for an exit visa when leaving DRCongo Airconditionong works well and there is a nice business class lounge Do not expect any shopping outlets there is only one bar but the latter can easily compare to those in the better European airports Thumbs up for the new terminal hope it stays like it is today The road from the airport to downtown Kinshasa was also completely refurbishes good pavement lighting at night Travel times tofrom the airport to the embassies area of the capital are now only h to be compared to h a few years ago I was said
On my flight from Muscat to London WY I was seated on J seat The cabin crew by the name of Kim was very courteous smiling and helpful She was very calm and polite to passengers

The airport is so peaceful and clean the staff at the airport are so calm and friendly The duty free shops are so easily accessible and the food at the airport is so tasty The announcements of the arriving or departing planes are so clear and the sings and directions are so bright
One of the best domestic airports in the country Wellsituated Come prepared for delay gate changes and high prices Be careful with illegal taxis

Nice and smart airport Short taxi time to both ends of the runway User Friendly airport with cafe stuff shop resturant bar and more Nice and open area There are often much turbulence when taking off from Rwy Towards East because of the upper winds from the small mountains after the Rwy A Take off from rwy is my favorite Right over the sea and after a few minutes you are right over Trondheim city There are a very nice Airport hotel a few houndred meters from the Airport You have two options to get into Trondhem city Buss or Train same price and same travel time Aprox a half hour

Amsterdam to Heraklion Low cost budget airline in our case chartered by Neckermann Tickets were very cheap but the service not Good service departure on time friendly personnel Seating tight but thats the trade off for cheap tickets Airplane registered in Germany so safety and maintenance should be ok We had no issues whatsoever

On the th of March I was flying back to Bangkok from Tokyo At the end of an hour flight with N masks I was exhausted and didnt do the usual always look back the trolley search that I normally would I didnt realize it until I was getting ready the next morning that I have lost my expensive skincare that I bought for mom as a gift Brand new and properly packed in the duty free bag I panicked and thought there was no hope that I would find the goods I called the airport just to try our luck The airport staff told me to describe the items that we lost and would contact us after checking with the lost and found department Only a few moments later the airport called me that they found my items at the lost and found A janitor had turned them in We can arrange to collect the items anytime It all seemed crazy to me because the items were in perfect condition I was so grateful and could not believe that my stuff would be able to be found The airport staff were extremely helpful and nice It made my day and I still feel so thankful even until today

The gate agents are great but they might have the most inefficient TSA security checkpoint Ive ever witnessed It took them around minutes to scan bags and only one was flagged out of the They seem to be the only airport where the analogic machines have actually made the security checkpoint slower which is wild considering the technology of those things Everywhere else seems to have competent people to run them

I am writing to express my heartfelt gratitude to the staff of Lost Found at the Venice airport At arrival at Venice Marco Polo airport my suitcase was lost The staff there was very helpful throughout the process in my application and delivery of my suitcase to my home address The luggage was delivered within hours So I was delighted with the service and want to give credit to staff and delivery Thank you

I came here twice an hour layover and an hour layover im from Australia and was seeing some of Dads family in the UK I didnt have that high hopes for China i didnt know what to expect but wow The airport is massive yet its so empty it obviously very government controlled or something staff spoke like barely any English but they were alright i guess Security the first time took forever to que and it was insanely hot the second time was extremely quick though We stayed in a business class lounge because the lounge we paid for was before security the lounge was good it had great food and was nice The airport is pretty intimidating to be honest very foreign barely friendly to foreigners Couldnt wait to get back to Australia

I attempted to book a ticket online to travel from Dubbo to Sydney late for a flight It was indicated that there were no seats available for the flight so I booked for My Sister was dying in the Martor Hospital in North Sydney and her Family called me to say she was in a critical condition I phoned Rex and spoke to a lovely Customer Service person This person could see that I had tried to book online and said even though she was not supposed to that she would change my flight from to Thanks to this wonderful person I was able to be with my Sister before she passed on If I had taken the flight my Sister would have passed before I got to say goodbye I very much appreciated this kind gesture

Absolutely tiny airport but great at the same time has a lot of character Lacking service stalls but thats due to the scale of the airport and the expectations of people derived from visiting larger airports

I flew into this airport on Islay island from Glasgow on a Loganair flight in the morning and returned almost a week later This is a rural airport close by the sea and is extraordinarily easy to use The SAAB aircraft was parked close to the small terminal building we picked up our bags that had been unloaded on the tarmac and walked in The walls were decorated with posters of the many distilleries for which Islay is justly famed There were also individual displays of whisky bottles and other items from these distilleries A small cafe provided a good range of snacks and also some souvenirs for last moment purchases There were ample spaces to sit A short conveyor belt brought in checked luggage quickly Across the check in counters are kiosks for the local car hires I had a car to be picked up The agent had all the paperwork ready The car was parked just outside I was out of the airport grounds driving on the left in less than minutes after landing On my departure I parked my rental car across the terminal building and slipped the keys into a slot in the kiosk The check in counters were staffed by Logan Air personnel in their uniforms that sported the easily recognized tartan plaids Security check was very thorough including patting The waiting area after security check had a rest room and was enclosed by glass which offered panoramic views The aircraft was just outside and we walked to to it It was a very relaxed experience with a high degree of friendliness and efficiency The airport is situated midway between the islands two larger communities Bowmore and Port Ellen

This airport is great Always clean lovely staff few delays and good food The information desk woman was very welcoming and we had a lovely chat Wifi access was good As small airports go Bluegrass is pretty much the model of what a small airport should be Shopping options are limited but you have a nice bookshop and a good bar after security the car park is a minutes walk from the terminal and the surroundings are well kept In years of traveling through Lexington I can think of nothing negative to say about this airport and its staff Even the TSA security check has always been pleasant

Yahukimo to Jayapura Flight was about an hour late quite normal in this remote place Plane was comfortable enough with reclining seats and even a box of tea provided unlike on the sole competitors flights on this route

I take Horizon often between Seattle and Portland after arriving from the UK and always find staff very helpful My last connection was late from LHR due to weather and holding separate tickets was a worry however Horizon staff did all they could to rush me through and I made the original connection Ground staff friendly and nice crew Flight down was operated by a CRJ its a quieter cabin and seems faster not sure it is though but the cabin feels smaller and return flight by Q was much more comfortable Cabin crew nice and you still get a free drinks service on a min shuttle great touch

Uneventful flight with on time departure and arrival Usual Southwest nofrill service Clean aircraft and friendly flight crew In Flight Entertainment was easy to log on and watch live TV NFL football Unusual for this particular aircraft the overhead cabins were not as large as other aircraft

Airlink do so much right and so many other carriers in the region can learn from them Reliably on time on time across all their flights into Joburg for example great convenient connections through OR Tambo Johannesburg for regional Southern Africa departures onto domestic SA ones generous baggage allowance kg per passenger from Lusaka to SA ever smiling welcoming cabin crew and checkin staff on sectors without exception coupled with tasty cold meals on intl sectors and good South African wines and juices on all really help them to stand out alongside now even a loyalty rewards program Keep doing what you do Airlink we are so grateful and you will be rewarded with custom

I read horror stories and read terrible reviews about Kinshasa FIH Ndjilli Airport I was very nervous about going through there What a lovely surprise awaited me A brand new terminal clean bright air conditioned well a big plus in Africa all employees well dressed and polite Procedures took time and were very detailed but nothing out of the ordinary You dont really need to pay a VIP service to go through you will be OK on your own Make sure all your travel documents and stay details ready for inspection
A pleasant small airport very useful for southern Spain A minus point would be being held in the sun before boarding a plane this is quite unpleasant Announcements are very clear Very good airport

Apart from the usual lateness which one comes to expect from some regional airlines this was an excellent flight The aircraft was practically brand new and the cabin crew were professional Between booking and the actual flights it had changed its name from Afrijet to FlyGabon

From Jeju Korea to Taipei and back I was hesitant to fly with an unknown local Taiwanese company but I have to say that I was nicely surprised the service is good and plane clean The hostess are courteous and the planes looks internally and externally wellkept The flight was pleasant and trouble free even with a baby Far much better from the china eastern flight I took from Shanghai to Jeju which was baby unfriendly I would compare Far Eastern Air transport as Dragonair a bit more clean

Simferopol Airport in has one brand new pier and the other two renovated All look extremely busy at peak season but very well organised clean bright well airconditioned spacious and friendly for travelers Large and convenient parking available Airports transfer options include shuttle buses taxis and even trolleybuses there is the longest km trolleybus line in the world between Simferopol Airport and the coastal city of Yalta on the Black Sea There were no queues at the entrance and pretty short ones at registration desks There could be more seats available at the lounge area than the airport now has Security officers are polite and efficient It was a pity the airport still had outdoor boarding halls but we were assured that it was a matter of time a year or two Overall it is an easy airport to use It will be nice to come back here later

Both arrival and departure from MGA was problem free No crowds The only short queue was immigration on arrival If not included in the air fare there is an entry charge of US and a departure charge of US The facility is modern and clean Shopping here is not cheap but the quality and variety of merchandise is excellent Eating is much more expensive than outside the airport but prices compare favourably with European equivalents The waiting areas have ample seating and are cool Unlike many other airports there is a lack of electronic information boards But it has the charm of some of the once small manageable airports we once had in Europe

Pittsburgh International is a modern wellkept airport but it has been sad to its usage steadily decline over the last years or so The US Airways hub is no longer and the airport has had a difficult time with the transition Unfortunately this has meant plenty of vacant gates and ticket counters For the passenger PIT offers free wifi though the signal is really only active near the Skymall McDonalds right in the centre of the terminal Security lines are wellorganised While I was joining the line an employee suggested to a group of us that we use the special annex screening gate which had no waiting That was really good advice which had all of us through and into the secure area in no time Overall it is still a clean comfortable airport I just really miss the days when so many more people used it on a daily basis

The only international airport of the tiny island of Malta The building isnt the most modern one its renovated but doesnt offer enough seating or space at all especially during peaktimes Security was fast tho and they use the latest equipment Theres the usual food beverage all British shops and some dutyfree Malta has a huge busnetwork and the airport is served by several buslines too Staff is friendly and speaks fine English Dont forget to bring your Britishstyle power connector because European ones are hard to find

Ive been through this airport several times and I must say its incredibly clean and sparkling and definitely puts Gatwick to shame The people of Tunisia are very friendly which adds to the overall positive experience However I have a concern regarding the pricing While all airports tend to charge fees the prices here seem a bit exorbitant I wonder why this is the case Additionally I have a personal issue with the height of the walkway that crosses about meters up I understand this might not be a problem for most but it would be great if the sides of the walkway could be covered for those of us who arent fond of heights Other than these few points its an excellent airport with great service

Expecting the worst but a great surprise It was a new building and super clean Great welcome by the airport staff and especially the Passport Control proud of their airport and their country and genuinely do their best to make it a painless process On departure the check in staff were efficient cheerful and helpful A very pleasant little cafe for snacks and once again through to more smiling passport control

I wouldnt want to be a cheerleader for Ryanair So many things can go wrong But when things go right as they did on this trip I think it should be said that the airline provides a good service at a reasonable cost Most of the annoying announcements have gone and by paying a few pounds extra you can get a seat up front and take an extra bag on board The cabin crew were efficient and friendly particularly on the return flight where they were smiling and looked happy to be there

Its big enough for the number of people it serves on a weekday although Id imagine it would get pretty crowded when the larger Virgin planes come in from Melbourne on weekends The staff are friendly the facilities adequate for a regional airport of this size the queues managable and its clean It just feels like its missing something Despite it being refurbished within the last decade or so it feels like it needs a bit of a touch upand the constant use of that sickly blue colour everywhere doesnt necessarily help the situation So yes it is a nice airport in regional NSW that serves its purpose and the needs of the people but I just get the feeling that with a bit of money put in new floorings lick of paint open up the departure lounge a bit more provide wifi it could be have a certain wow factor reserved for NSW regional airports like Newcastle Albury and Dubbo which have been thrust forward into the st Century

It was great to fly out of and into TriCities regional airport again Had no problems it was great From check in thru security and the passenger boarding area Security helped my wife greatly because of back surgery she said they were wonderful

This is my favorite airport There is rarely a line to check in and check baggage or for security On site airport parking is convenient and reasonably priced After getting through security there is a wide assortment of restaurants and shops along with an aircraft observation lounge There is an abundance of seating in the gate areas and the free airport wifi is very fast Definitely recommend

The arrivals hall at the international terminal is clean and tidy but does not cope well with any more than large aircraft arriving at the same time It can take over an hour to clear customs and there is only one baggage conveyor The only ATM is after passport control and you will need PGK if you wish to purchase a visa so it pays to have your currency ready before you depart for POM The departure lounge is also very clean and tidy and customs and immigration are efficient However if you wish to do shopping there is only one very small duty free shop and an even smaller cafe after customs and security
The set of counters of Cathay Dragon was a bit out of order since every counter was excessively full due to the great number of passengers Business Class and Marco Polo Club and Oneworld Members
My mother travelled alone in Air Asia on June The flight was very comfortable Services were good Ground staff was extremely helpful Sincere thanks to the ticketing staff

I dont know what they call it an International Airport because it doesnt look like one Its a small airport and the only positive thing that I can say is that it was clean the rest is all negative People doesnt speak English The customer service is really bad they werent friendly at all the people were mean and rude Theres no restaurants just two coffee shop and one kiosk and two ATMs According to New York Times Panama is one of the best destinations for tourism and I agree that it is a beautiful country However they need to work on the facilities customer service and improve their languages skills because they could loose tourists and clients just for these points that I mentioned before

Once again American Eagle operated by Republic Airways delivered a reliable safe and comfortable flight from Washington DCA to Philadelphia Republic continues to uphold American Airlines commitment to excellence providing a seamless experience despite minor operational challenges Our departure was delayed due to traffic changes at DCA following recent tragic events but the crew handled the situation with professionalism and care Their dedication to passenger comfort and safety was evident throughout the flight ensuring a smooth and reassuring journey While delays are never ideal the priority is always arriving safelyand thats exactly what happened Kudos to Republic Airways and the outstanding crew for their continued commitment to quality service

Birmingham to Amritsar via Ashkabat No nonsense air line Great Indian vegetarian food There was no flight screens no seat screens We stopped at Ashgabat for one hour its nice modern airport with all facilities The good thing was that the time at Ashgabat and time in India is only minute difference

VnukovoIrkutsk An eventful and enjoyable flight Everything went smoothly Vnukovo is the closest airport to the city centre and it has also a convenient train connection the train departs from the Kievsky train station This helps to avoid the usual heavy traffic of Moscow UTair uses a new terminal A which is quite handy It is likely that UTair is the only airline which uses a widebody B on this route and the plane seems to be a relatively new and wellmaintained one Friendly flight attendants the flight was ontime onboard catering is not superb but it was OK Would fly them again

With flights starting at around USD between Seoul and Yantai Shandong Airlines proved to be the cheapest option beating Asiana China Eastern and Korean Air Given the price I was a little hesitant to believe the service to be of a high level however I was pleasantly surprised I was given a friendly greeting in English on boarding crew holding a basket of sweets for passengers to take as they headed to their seat For the rest of the flight the crew seemed to conduct their service pleasantly with a smile On the outbound flight to China apple chips and bottles of water were offered however on the return leg a delicious hot meal was offered consisting of a sweet and sour type meat dish with rice Highly surprising considering the flight time was less than an hour Interestingly on both flights the captain performed a detailed speech in Chinese and English Despite the fact that the Boeing was several years old it was fitted with Boeings Sky interior and its interior seemed to lack any signs of wear and tear The interior including the toilets appeared to have been cleaned well The seats were comfortable and had ample legroom for the short flight The IFE onboard consisted of overhead screens these played the moving map on the outbound flight at Mr Bean on the return journey Overall a good journey

Amazing customer service review delayed due to ill health In May I was flown by Royal Flying Doctor Service to Adelaide where I spent days due to a sudden acute illness and after which I flew with your airline to Broken Hill where we had left our caravan so we could return to our home in Sydney for further medical care Among the passengers on the flight were an elderly frail woman and a woman returning to her regional home after shoulder surgery I was feeling pretty fragile myself We were all at the front of the plane and my husband and I were really impressed with the flight attendant Abby for whom nothing seemed too much trouble and who was very mindful of the particular issues the elderly lady and the postsurgery lady both travelling alone faced Abby had a delightful demeanour and the service she provided was both efficient and compassionate We were very impressed overall

I want to commend staff at Alicante airport on what was my first airport visit post covid Arriving and departing was prompt and hassle free When I accidentally broke a mug at the Starbucks counter the staff were just concerned about how I was feeling Also the girl at the EasyJet gate took my postcards which I had forgotten to post and promised to post them for me They all arrived eventually so thank you

Nuremberg is an amazingly convenient and fast airport You get there easily by public transportation from the metro station to check in its not even one minute walking and you can be at your gate within minutes of arriving Baggage delivery is quick mostly your baggage is already at the conveyor belt when you get there

One of the better airport experiences in recent times This may be due to this airport not being the big hub type with all its unpleasant experiences that come with it But from curb to boarding everything went smoothly Friendly bar tenders checkin agents emigration officer and security staff A pleasant surprise The building appeared very well designed For urban explorers theres the old brutalism style icon of soviet times next door to explore from outside Only downside is the air conditioning in the air side waiting area too windy and cold

A nice airport and frankly I am surprised at the bad reviews I arrived there at approx hrs Entry and checkin were very easy Security was straight forward and immigration was very easy Once on the airside a restaurant was open as were the dutyfree shops The only downside were the grumpy staff of the shops who obviously had not woken up yet Announcements were clear and boarding was orderly and we took off on time
This airport is great It has all the necessities that an airport should have I dont get how it is placed in the world It should be a top airport All the staff are very helpful and friendly

Small and always a risk for bad weather but they do an amazing job clearing the snow closed less than hrs per year despite getting more snow on average than any comparable city Rarely any delays at counters or security Free WiFi Not much in the way of food or shopping No public transportation into Syracuse taxi only

Its a small airport and there is a queue when you depart but it moves quickly they seem very efficient and polite and do the best they can Seating did get very tight just before the flights were called but the toilets were new clean and quite impressive for an Egyptian airport Snacks were expensive but what you expect at the airport Duty free seemed extremely cheap and I have been at many worse European airports

Departing from Terminal Lots of space light and helpful signaling Security was well organized and relatively fast moving but the queue was huge Actually three queues one for facial ID one for carryon security checks and the final one for passport control The automatic passport check did not work for us maybe because we had not come to the country through this airport and there were moments of confusion among us and the supervisor The terminal itself is a bit aseptic Impersonal and way too long Food options could be better And a bit of color or additional greenery would have been great

Small clean airport Close to the city centre If one arrives for a later flight in the evening arrive with a full stomach as nothing is open after It is an efficient small airport with quick security The TV is still on at full volume in the departure area
In this scorching heat ACs dont work Travelers are sweating Even lounges dont have working AC Very uncomfortable atmosphere with direct sun rays

There is a need for some chairs and a table to sit and reorganise after the security check This is especially important for people with knee other implants requiring putting on the shoes Cannot do this in standing position I kept the bag on the only one table and was putting on the shoes in standing position One security lady officer showed her displeasure and asked me to remove the bag from the table Not very helpful

It makes my day to be served by caring thoughtful polite and lovely stewardess that hard to come by as far as SQ is concerned serving own homeland A great applaud to Natalie For the moment we step into the plane and settle down this lady greet us with broad smile I am so grateful of her coming to my rescue to help me ease my gastric by going the extra mile to get me biscuits and hot drinks when they are busy out of their normal routine and SOP Caring enough to come by to check on me that Im well When we ask for drinks that help to soothe my daughter vomiting other staff just cant help and said they cant do anything Here come our hero Natalie whom with her sincere thoughtfulness and care to fetch my daughter a hot peppermint tea which is not serve in economy class Hopefully the next round I will meet her again She deserve to be the one wearing green uniform Well done Natalie You are a role model for rest to follow

Rio de Janiero to Curitiba via Sao Paulo Really good experience really smooth inflight entertainment and free food and drink the cabin crew were really friendly This really beats European customer service the leg room is still the same but just the service outweighs it for me

Domestic passenger Arrived at and departed on from Terminal No issues disembarking Having staff there to ensure passengers with baggage to reclaim dont inadvertently leave without collecting it is helpful On return it took a while to clear security With a number of airports across the UK now using the new scanners meaning liquids can stay in hand luggage its a pity Terminal had not restarted this Good range of shops and restaurants in departures with clear signage and ample seating Flight pushed back on time but there was a wait of about minutes as it sat in a queue for takeoff clearance From previous experience excellent for international travel as most major cities across the world reachable with a direct flight but Gatwick remains my first choice for regional travel

Excellent little airport and the relatively new train stop just a few hundred meters across the parking lot from the terminal building makes it even better Its a shame more airlines arent using this perfect spot as Jerez is convenient to Cadiz Capital Sevilla and even Malaga and the Costa del Sol

Why do we always want to fly the big airlines VLM has the efficiency of a budget airline the service of a high value airline and the punctuality of a German airline They have friendly staff and after landing you are out of the airport in minutes Moreover book well in advance and you have a very attractive fare

Nice medium size airport Looks new or revamped and spotless clean Easy to move around and offers enough services Serious but very efficient staff which is all I ask for Fast check in fast security even going through passport control was relatively fast it was a late fly though so there wasnt many people

Hamad International Airport is nice brand new airport Very spacious and clean Good wifi line and plenty of free desktop for internet Seats are everywhere and they are comfortable Charging points are available throughout this airport Many choices for food and shopping However I find that the price is rather high

Really beautiful airport after the renovations All major fast food places available apart from local cuisine Wifi is free and fast regardless of duration of the connection which is a huge plus Coffee shop was slightly expensive but the food and coffee were fine nonetheless The announcements are a big plus since most airports in the region are switching to quite airports

Mildura Airport is the rd busiest airport in Victoria Australia and is serviced by three airlines Virgin Australia QantasLink and of course Rex It has three gates a great bar really clean check in and the people are nice with the perfect amount of seats They do not have aerobridges obiously a really modern airport its just great

Szczecins Solidarity Airport is one of the smaller regional airports in Poland The cartaxi ride from Szczecin takes a bit longer than expected but once there you will find a pleasant airport located in a wood away from the city It has only a small terminal but it is very modern fresh and complete with all facilities bookstalls shops cafs etc that open also for early morning departures Im told there is a small hotel nearby The staff is helpful Only a handful of flights depart each day so the terminal does not get crowded and the atmosphere is casual and relaxed And the security check was very thorough which I appreciated

I flew on the new jet service this weekend past and I was really pleased no delighted with the experience The checkin teams and boarding teams at both SYD and MEL treated me like a valued customer and couldnt be nicer The crew were welcoming and continued that valued experience through to disembarking and the ramp team handled my bag and delivered it without worry to me The inflight magazines page about inflight exercises was really difficult to read And I didnt know it was a cashbar only I wanted to buy a drink but I only had my credit card Also Manage booking has been down for a while now Otherwise a fresh choice for Australians that places the customers airport experience at the core of the experience

A small airport serving the Transylvania town of Sibiu Its a walk boarding only one constructed new in an off the shelf design barebone Operation is fast and efficient staff is a bit reserved but friendly and professional Romania is now a Schengen country so no more border control to most EU flights Airside theres one food and beverages shop and one dutyfree Both are nothing to rave about There are taxis to the city and a modern bus which is cheaper

I had an excellent experience at Taoyuan Airport Very impressed with the smooth and efficient baggage handling process The staff were incredibly helpful offering assistance with moving my luggage at the baggage carousel It made the entire process much easier and stressfree Really appreciated the level of customer care and attention to detail in ensuring that everything went smoothly Im highly satisfied with the service and would definitely recommend it

Was expecting the worst after the number of negative reviews but was very pleasantly surprised at how quick efficient and friendly the service was Traveling in September probably has a substantial bearing on numbers but we were through checkin and passport control in minutes which is much better than most airports weve used in the recent past Water is available to top up bottles for free or just from a machine as you exit security far from the exorbitant prices encountered at other airports The service selection and seating area at cafe Soho are excellent assuming our flight is on time Ryanair its a five star experience

A beautifully decorated small airport located near the city of Lyon France This airport is not too large but it has all international facilities available Very neat and clean Luggage collection was faster However there are very few chair to sit on for waiting Taxis are available

Clean little province airport with efficient and friendly staff The only drawback I can think of is the traffic jam on certain hours of the day when you try to join from downtown One of the best small airport shops Ive seen when it comes to local wine and edible goodies

Perfect experience After having read the reviews on Fastjet I was very nervous despite friends reinsurance that the airline had improved dramatically in recent years Well everything was perfect The ticket was very reasonably priced Checkin online and baggage drop off were easy The flight left on time and arrived minutes early The air hostess was charming The snacks though not fancy were good and our chairs were comfortable The baggage was on the carousel by the time we arrived Very happy customers
Nepal Airlines is a cheap option for direct flights from Nepal with good service Nepal Airlines improved its service over time The cabin crew were professional and meal served was good

Barcelona BLA to Caracas CCS in Venezuela on a classic Boeing aircraft I experienced Conviasa to be quite nice to fly with Anyhow they do not offer much more than the average European nofrills carriers A costfree nonalcoholic drink was served on that short domestic flight the aircraft was clean and fine despite its age we departed BLA about minutes ahead schedule not every airline in Venezuela manages that Since the ticket costed me less than EUR I can call it a quite satisfying experience

I have flown from Charlotte NC to Pittsburgh many times in the past yrs Today I lost my wallet I was very fortunate to be called informing me someone had turned in my wallet They kindly sent an employee up to gate B to return it to me just minutes before my flight took off That is excellent customer service and I will be forever grateful for their kindness I will never forget this Thanks for such a wonderful and caring staff You guys rock

I had a great experience flying with Cyprus Airways The flight was smooth and comfortable making the journey enjoyable I was impressed with the ground checkin team who were kind and supportive Thank you for the excellent service

London City to Dublin The website is easy to use Checkin and boarding were well organised Staff neatly dressed and and welcoming A drink is included in the cost of the ticket as well as a small snack Departed on time and arrived on time too A very pleasant short flight

Pyongyang to Beijing with Air Koryo The departure and arrival were punctual staff smiling and friendly the aircraft including toilets was clean and there were magazines and newspapers at the entrance The food was a chicken burger but the drink selection was rather limited either water or one type of soft drink It is maybe not the most luxurious airline but the service for a shorthaul flight is better than European or American airlines I have used for the same distance

I would like to express my extreme gratitude to staff who managed to retrieve some personal items belonging to my son I which we left onboard plane on flight in from New York early last Wednesday morning Due to their quick actions we managed to reclaim these items from the plane before it headed out to Heathrow on next flight They were extremely efficient very friendly two great ambassadors for Shannon airport We are very grateful to them both for their assistance in turning what could have been a holiday disaster into a very pleasant experience with Shannon airport They both deserve special recognition for their excellent customer skills

Little expense has been spared to make DRS a spacious and stateofthe art An allround highly agreeable experience with the added advantage of DRS being very close to the city centre A halfhourly rail service connects DRS with Dresden Hautbahnof a minute journey with several intermediate stops all for a princely EUR oneway fare BA has recently launched an LGWDRS service great views of the heart of the city on the landing approach from the starboard side but the airport remains somewhat underutilised

I was really happy for the service provided Although this was a budget airline it did not affect my experience The flight crew were amazing and the pilots the same The only advice or suggestion I would give is allow cabin to accept card payments because not everyone carries cash I would have loved to have purchased a beverage but unable to due to this reason Other than that the experience and all was great and couldnt have asked for anything better
Francistown Johannesburg September Good short flight efficiently run with good crew On time and no problems
The staff are friendly and the seat is comfortable The air ticket is cheap Although theres no TV and wifi I can bring my pad and watch films Not bad

A comfortable nononsense flight which was delayed by about minutes while departing but made up for most of the time difference by the time one landed The crew was courteous and professional the seating comfortable and there was a snack service consisting of a packet of Lays Chips and a Juice which was quite ok for the short flight The luggage arrival was also fuss free and ontime Overall quite a nice flight

Landed at Hangzhou Airport around using AirAsia X from Kuala Lumpur Immigration clearance was smooth and no hassle I claimed my luggage in just a few minutes Washroom services are as good as other airports in China The only lacking is the number of available seats on the departure floor at the checkin counters area

Not Verified I loved this airport I have travelled to NY many times before always into JFK Now that I have discovered the wonderful Norwegian Airlines I arrived and departed NY via Stewart International It is a relatively small airport but efficient and confident There is no masses of hurrying crowds which are the tension you get at large international airports The airport is surrounded by greenery when you leave the terminal there is a brief walk across to pick up rental car taxis or the shuttle bus so relaxing For the journey home everything was relaxed fast and efficient As I mentioned it is a small airport the bar caf shop and duty free is in a small area Some people might want more but I found it more than enough All hands are on deck in the airport to get everyone on their way home Great little airport and great flights and price by Norwegian Airlines

I took the am flight from Basra to Erbil an Iraqi domestic flight I bought the ticket the day before at the Iraqi Airways ticket office in Basra They were friendly spoke English and only take Iraqi dinars no credit cards I paid roughly the equivalent of The flight left on time and was fine The equipment was a B On the short flight they served a breakfast tray with a lot of very sweet things chocolate milk an Iraqi Twinkietype cake a soft roll with jam and a banana It wasnt really to my liking but it was nevertheless an energypacked breakfast which is more than one gets on European carriers these days The flight attendants were friendly and we landed in Erbil on time I was satisfied with my flight and wish other people would also leave reviews for this airline

Newcastle is a small airport which always delights Its not the most modern or breathtaking however its well organised and functions well Checkin zone is excellent and plenty of space clean despite dated toilets and some generic shopseateries The renovated security area is very modern with hightech equipment meaning the check is very thorough despite being completed in under minutes without priority This of course makes the airport feel very safe however security staff arent the most friendly Ive got to admit which surprised me The departure lounge is spacious and has plenty of room with no awkward no return sections Shops are overpriced which youd expect for an airport but theres plenty of choice Theres also a newly renovated lounge which we didnt visit on this occasion but looked fabulous Despite this the area leading to the gates is quite dated and needs upgrading to make the whole experience seamless Arrivals are also great very fast and friendly border agents It took approximately minutes for us from leaving the plane to outside the airport which is simply excellent Despite the excellent terminal one thing that really disappoints me with Newcastle is the parking arrangements Extremely expensive and the shuttle system to the longterm car park is a nightmare never mind the technical issues and problems with closed car parks Id try to arrange alternative transport to the airport if possible as the dropoff zone is good

Best airline in Russia Very nice staff comfortable seats I dont ask much I mean this is coming from a girl who drives tanks good service and power supplies anything you can possibly ask for enough room for my single bag and even more room Great service good crew wonderful meals and so much more Ground service I was pushed around a lot but that isnt the staffs fault I dont remember turning on my inflight entertainment system I was too busy playing World of Tanks Blitz with the incredible WiFi
Superb flight Left on time and arrived early This typifies the reason why Bangkok Airways is world best regional airline You got a little bag with a sandwich and water which was tasty

Back to Pristina in February The airport now has a proper baggage reclaim and is looking a little more finished The departure lounge has another shop and increased size It is still best to use the bar before immigration Overall this is still a good little airport

A budget airline is a budget airline so the expectation is not that much My recent flight with airblue was good It was a smooth ride from Dubai to Lahore The crew were very prompt with your request they are less enthusiastic as compared to other airline They serve the food very late but it was a nice and palatable food It was a good trip and the fares are reasonable The ground staff in Dubai are friendly and have smooth and fast check in

Freetown Lungi International Airport is a small airport terminal building It recieves very few flights the majority being international It has so positive attributes like no congestion speedy check in and checkout A hotel is conveniently located near it There is a duty free shop and restaurant There is also a VIP Lounge for the elite and other first class passengers Beware that the airport is very small It needs renovations and a series of expansions effort due to its small size The government is in the works of expanding it to accomodate the international passengers

I had a flight with Vietnam Airlines in November In the airport the checkin staff was friendly and helpful Checkin progress was fast The flight is a little bit late but it didnt matter Flight attendants were friendly and helpful they served us a bottle of water because of the short flight The seat was comfortable for me to relax We had a magazine and there were some screens for us to entertain The flight was smooth and perfect There was no Wifi I hope that all aircrafts of Vietnam Airlines will have wifi

Nothing special to write it looks more like a train station than an airport but its a small city anyway so thats fair Access from the city center by tram makes it the easiest cheapest and fastest airport to reach Ive seen in my life Fans of space will love the huge International Space Station model in the main hall and aviation fans will love the souvenir shop where you can buy many Airbus collectors items One thing they should put more power sockets

Rio De Janeiro is a good aiirport but was very crowded during the Olympics The new terminal is awesome but GOL VIP lounge is poor the Plaza Premium Lounge is better The duty free is good but overpriced Customs and immigration officers are quite sympathetic and the airport is clean

Faleolo airport in Apia Samoa is a small airport We found immigration customs etc very quick and efficient as well as baggage handling At the moment the airport is not really pretty to look at but a new terminal is being built which should be spectacular when completed Its really refreshing to be able to walk through the airport on arrival departure and not be forced to navigate through a giant shopping mall like at Sydney The airport has done duty free shops which you are free to go into or not go into rather than having to go through them to get in out of passport control a few small food shops reasonably priced and a bar Parking is Samoan Tala Staff at the airport are friendly welcoming and helpful The only negative side is that there is no air conditioning outside the security areas and check in is a bit uncomfortable when its humid

I have to say my second arrival in Dar was much better than the first First time arrived amid a plague of flying cockroachlike insects that were all attracted to the light inside the terminal Spent ages swatting them in a huge line for immigration that took over an hour only to then be told I needed a special permit and had to pay USD I already had a business visa Not wanting to argue I joined the next disorganised line paid my USD and waited another minutes to get my passport back Notable that everyone in the special line was Caucasian Second time all desks open for immigration friendly hello from the official and a quick stamp and on my way No special permit needed this time for some reason Bags came out quickly and was out of the airport within minutes of landing Lets hope that the new terminal will be finished on time and that there will be no more special line

The addition of the new Southwest wing has been a good improvement for all those who enjoy flying on this airline Flying out of this airport has been very convenient because of its location for many Long islanders especially those living in Suffolk and eastern Nassau counties The one drawback to the Southwest facility expansion is the distance from their new gates to the baggage claims area

First time from and to the new A terminal Didnt believe it but everything worked excellently No queues at checkin security passport control customs Bus gate had enough lift capacity so went down without wait On arrival baggage was on the belt in minutes and then in minutes off the airport Again no wait at immigration Food choices are fine both airside and landside Take into account this is just minutes some km from downtown Good choice and far superior to overcrowded Borispol with long queues dingy terminals and km from the city centre

We had an absolutely delightful experience with Privilege Style The staff were very nice and accommodating Seating was exactly as expected and food was fine enough for a flight meal Thank you for a great experience We look forward to flying Privilege again

Although a low cost airline Shaheen Air was quite nice although the airport checkin was pretty bad with only one line and the agents taking forever The flight had a gate change times and we had a one hour delay announced at the last minute before boarding was to finish The flight attendents were very friendly during the flight and the aircraft was decent also the meal some chicken mayo bun with a chicken leg along with marble cake was pretty delicious and filling The plane was leased and originally from SpanAir so the cabin had grey leather seats but it was comfortable though Also a nice touch from Shaheen Air was the pretakeoff water which was provided and newspapers in English and Urdu

Frankfurt Main to Asmara The crew are most friendly The onboard service was excellent and standard of the aircraft was good though the legroom wasnt great The ground handling done by the airline at Asmara International Airport was efficient even though there were a number of shortcomings at the airport the airline got round them The price of the ticket was worth the service I received

I have gone to this airport several times the past two years Beside my bad experience with sixt car rental I can not find any reason to complain Friendly and helpful staff check in and security done in minutes Small duty free and nice coffee shop Well functioning small airport

We flew with Turkmenistan Airlines for flights one from Milan to Ashgabat hrs with a Boeing and another flight hrs from Ashgabat to Kuala Lampur with a Boeing Both flights were much better than expected after reading the reviews Both aircrafts looked modern and clean with very comfortable seats For the very affordable prices the airline offers the service is very good We got meals on both flights and unlimited coffee water or any other drinks The staff was really nice and you can even ask for a blanket if needed The only negative point is that you cant checkin online which leads to long queues at the desk but expect from that everything was fine We would definitely fly again with this airline they deserve more good reviews

The staff are friendly and its clean and offers a good service most of the time I do have two constructive comments however I wish you would put your flights on sale way in advance Eg I want to book for next summer now but have been told to wait until the end of the year This is not good for their own business as most people want to book summer vacations for next year now and if they are not on sale people will go to other countries like the Canary Islands etc and this is a shame I had booked for trip returning to Dublin via LGW on th November and bought flight from Dublin on Ryanair now told change to Heathrow New flight to Dublin from LHR required Additional expense for people using you to route home

Harrisburg MDT is a great airport Small but connected to many international gateways Security lines are short Food options are limited but good I only wish they offered a NYC area connection My airport of choice

It is an efficiently run small low cost carrier hub As long as you consider it as such it is appropriate and convenient I see it more as a kind of bus stop for airplanes to a limited number of countries Parking is great and affordable an in walking distance to the terminal Guess total distance from car door to plane door is appx metres Services are limited and foodshops overpriced Big airport prices here on this small airfield Boarding procedures check in and security OK Kind staff

Excellent modern airport that is complete There was a complete redesign and now it consists of concourses West and Central with the East Concourse still to be built The facility is modern and airy and nicely designed for post with lots of shops and restaurants post security Presecurity it is very tight particularly because people waiting for arriving passengers congregate at the two TSA checkpoints see CHOKE points For the passenger flying into or out of OKC is a breeze

A very good experience arriving and departing The airport is modern clean and efficient No delays or problems arriving Queuing at immigration did not take too long and bags had already arrived after that Departure is also very good No immigration formalities for departure so you get into the departure lounge quite quickly I used the business lounge which was very comfortable with good wireless internet and a reasonable food selection

Busy regional airport with many flights to South Korea Manila and other Philippine airports Airbridges and some remote stands Opened in and relatively modern in terms of layout with level for departures and one for arrivals Speed of baggage retrieval very good and distances from arrival to the carpark opposite the airport very short Free WiFi available

HELLPA return with A Booked flights months earlier and reservation for exit seats for extra charge from their call center was kept at check in Generous legroom Friendly attentive crew flight deck announcements and clean aircraft made hrs flight more enjoyable for a leisure flight Also our pre booked Holiday Meal on outbound flight was surprisingly tasty and hot and portions were more filling than we have had for this route with other carriers Only minus was inbound flight meal which was bit tasteless perhaps due to LPA catering Drinks for purchase but all in all flight with them DK offered more holiday feeling than our national carriers charter flight offers Baggage came fast at LPA but in HEL it took more than min due to ground handling problems

This is a small airport but over the past couple of years it has improved a lot The customs and immigration are polite and fast with the baggage also coming fast There is a coffee shop outside the secure area and also one inside but the coffee outside is better There is also now free WiFi in the airport There is a lounge but this is not connected to the airlines but for payment No need to arrive to early
Flew in and out of here on flights to and from Sao Paulo A striking modern terminal with reasonable facilities Very pleasant

I found the airport to be more than adequate We were there in July and it was busy but check in was OK as was security The waiting area is small and there are not enough catering facilities but the roof top terrace was brilliant it was a pleasure to wait for the plane for once and you can have a cigarette in peace The toilets were clean and tidy wastebins emptied frequently so all in all not a bad airport have certainly spent time in much worse

OsloCopenhagen th Aug on a B Oslo Airport is shamelessly very pricey Timely arrived minutes prior to schedule smooth flight Easy superfast checkin in Oslo Granted nice soft roomy seats and a full row of loads of space Flight only half full Catering onboard good though only at hefty costs Ticket inexpensive No IFE WiFi or frills But no complaints the price does not allow for much complaints Boardingdeboarding very quick through jetbridges Aircraft and FAs were somehow aged but all worked effectively

We flew from Sydney to Zhengzhou and vice versa on Tianjin Airlines recently overall it was a great trip ground staff were very friendly they even reserved a couple extra seats for us so that my two young kids could have a decent sleep on the way home cabin staff were also very friendly they were very helpful throughout the flight Legs rooms great food service was decent as well The only minor issue is their entertainment system was very old there were just a handful movies to select from also their D map system was not functioning for both sectors which meant you couldnt tell where you were currently other than that it was really a great flying experience

Really beautiful airport after the renovations All major fast food places available apart from local cuisine Wifi is free and fast regardless of duration of the connection which is a huge plus Coffee shop was slightly expensive but the food and coffee were fine nonetheless The announcements are a big plus since most airports in the region are switching to quite airports

I recently flew with Saudia from Beijing Daxing to Riyadh and onward to Istanbul Before booking I was quite apprehensive due to the many negative reviews I had read which mentioned issues such as impolite staff and frequent cancellations However my experience was far from those criticisms From the start the airline proved to be reliable and professional Both flights departed and arrived as scheduled with no delays or complications The cabin crew were polite attentive and made the journey comfortable Their professionalism and courtesy exceeded my expectations The only area where I feel Saudi Airlines could improve is in their food service While adequate the meal options and quality could be better refined to elevate the passenger experience further Overall I take my hat off to Saudi Airlines They exceeded my expectations and proved the negative reviews wrong If the need arises I wouldnt hesitate to fly with them again

An uneventful flight to Amsterdam Catering was not the best this time bland food and sides We were served twice it filled our stomach but that was it Service provided by the staff was friendly and speedy despite a full plane Seats were comfortable We landed min earlier in Amsterdam

Because of all the bad reviews I arrived hrs prior to departure There was no security check to enter the building you could just step in As I flew with Ryanair to Cypres EU passport I asked at the Ryanair counter if my printed online boarding pass is ok It was I was the only passenger to proceed the security checks at that time so I could just walk through Overall I was airside in minutes and enjoyed the Cedar Lounge

A typical small Australian airport which operated well Some distance out of the city it is served by a bus and taxis fare Check in was easy there being more than enough desks for the traffic Security was efficient with a bookshop and cafe airside All gates are walk to the plane which are never far away Compared to many this is a nice airport

American Airlines to Miami Check in was quick and smooth I had multiple segment flights on one booking Miami Madrid London Manchester and my luggage was checked all the way though to Manchester The check in opened at hours before flight and there was a priority lane for business class and One world status customers Although the general queue was small I was there at Outgoing passport control also very quick Security efficient shoes and belt off but iPad and electronics remained in my carry on There are lanes so this could get busy if travelling on the Air France or KLM widebody flights The departure area is still being rebuilt but it was pleasant non the less Large fans in the first upstairs seating area kept the place cool A couple of sandwich outlets including Dominoes I had a large Turkey and Cheese panini hot and a bottle of coke for Small duty free kiosks as well Down a ramp to the gate area a lot of seating and not crowded despite the KLM flight waiting as well as my AA There a large central bar area I didnt buy anything so cant comment on price Boarding about mins before departure If you are travelling with hand luggage and have not had to check in make sure the gate agents check your passport before attempting to board We walked along the apron passed the KLM A to our plane boarding front and rear Boarding completed well before departure time Left early unfortunately we took off towards the sea so we didnt see the tourists on Maho beach preparing to get sand blasted Overall a great experience much better that I envisaged

This airport is vastly improved since the previous comment Ideally situated for the catchment area south of the Humber After nightmare journeys just getting to Manchester Aiport my visits to NZ are now via Humberside and Amsterdam Minimum fuss no crowding a relaxed start to a lengthy trip Additional package flights are now offered and the Amsterdam hub is a definite plus There used to be a direct link to LHR with Air UK but this was discontinued before the demise of the airline and never revived Although not essential could be useful on occasion Landing costs I believe
Lisbon to Salvador Bahia Flight plastic free The first one I have travelled with And they had Ipads to comfortable watch what we preferred The distance between the chairs was large

Main hub in Northeast Colombia Although small the terminal is clean and tidy Tends to get crowded during peak hours As many airports in Colombia renovation is taking place Most of the terminal is airconditioned immigration and customs was fast as was luggage delivery The airport has ATMs some souvenir shops and a small observation deck Flight arrival and departure announcements need improvement with regard to acoustics as information can barely be heard while waiting in the food court airconditioning will be more than welcome in this area Lets see what the airport looks after renovation is completed Pleasant experience Wifi connectivity was very good

Would like to give big thumbs up to boarding crew Ms Noor at Tiruchirappalli Airport We are four family flying from TrichyIndia to Singapore Boarding process went very smooth with her providing detailed explanation before keep luggage what can bring and what cannot She is quite knowledgeable and inform the passenger upfront to complete the boarding process smooth and fast

Clean and efficient I was very impressed with Elmas airport Staff are friendly and the airport is very well connected to the city centre by bus The fare is only Only one negative point once youre past the international departures hall there are no shops only one small cafe near gate otherwise this is one of the best regional airports I have visited so far

Had a wonderful flight There was a female black flight attendant who looked after my pregnant daughter and I very well She went into depth about flight safety and when we arrived at our destination gave advice on how to manage the hot weather She was pleasant and friendly to everyone

I had a great experience here Check in was quick and polite immigration and customs were very efficient and there was a good range of shops and restaurants I fly here quite often and it is nearly always a good experience

Upon arrival in Rhodes a suitcase was delayed Indicated at the counter The handling was done very well We arrived on the next flight and were taken directly to our address Super The entire flight also went great Friendly professional staff Flying with Aegean is a relief Bij aankomst op Rhodos was er een koffer vertraagd Bij de balie aangegeven De afhandeling is super gedaan Met de volgende vlucht meegekomen en direct naar ons adres gebracht Super Ook de gehele vlucht was super verlopen Vriendelijk professioneel personeel Vliegen met Aegean is een verademing

Very clean and big airport Nice facilities Good open space Lots of shops and restaurants and fast food services including MDS and KFC All of it was pretty much airside The queue in Security wasnt that bad Nice airport and a lot of air conditioning

Cusco Airport is another wonderfully crowded and poorly designed airfield in Peru ie Lima Chiclayo Byzantine brutalist concrete architecture aside this airport is by far the worst designed for providing any kind of logical flow for a singlerunway airport serving a large metropolitan area It would seem that nobody in government has looked at what can be done with the cramped space and volume of passengers to try and make a more hospitable clean and userfriendly facility Unfortunately this airport will remain the sole thoroughfare for all international Machu Picchu travelers for the foreseeable future Maybe Peru can step up to the plate and make some major changes to this facility and take a field trip to Quito and check out their new airport which is very nice

Juan Santamara International Airport has gotten much better over the years Clean and modern The arrival process customs and immigration are as smooth as they can be Departures are easy too they could do better with the Exit Tax process long lines and no where to fill out the forms I understand some airlines will start allowing you to pay in advance which is excellent The food inside the terminal is ridiculously expensive I paid for a fast food breakfast sandwich I still dont understand why they have to check each carryon bag again at the gate when we were just screened and xrayed going through security It just slows the boarding process down

Astana is a small international airport that is well connected to Europe via Frankfurt London Paris and Amsterdam through Kazakhstans Air Astana The airport has only one terminal for Domestic and International flights A new terminal is being constructed next to the existing facility which is planned to be opening in spring The arrivals and baggage reclaim is small Immigration quite smooth and officers were friendly but remember to fill in your immigration card with a blue or black pen not with a red one as it is not accepted I had almost no queues Taxi pickup at the terminal is not wellorganised and taxi recruiters can be annoying The central hall for departures is quite spacious and there is sufficient seating around the checkin area Checkin areas are small and somewhat oldfashioned but work fine Friendly ground staff Short queuing time at checkin passport control and security Emigration passport control is fine There are few FB and retail facilities at the international departure gates There is plenty of seating at the end of the concourse close to the small cafe in the back Transferring between international flights is quick and easy Passengers do not have to pass immigration only security screening It took me only minutes from arrival gate to departure gate FB and retail facilities are limited especially in the departure are after immigration Food choice is limited Very good wifi while waiting for checkin or for your flight Password can be obtained via SMS Terminal and toilets are clean Remote arrivals and departures via bus in winter when temperatures can go below Celsius can be cold and slippery but also a very interesting experience When the new terminal will be opened in I assume less aircraft will be handled via busses

This is a very nice airport Very clean and modern Airport staff are courteous and helpful It is definitely the best airport I have been to in the Caribbean and definitely better than some airports in the US especially Miami where you are not even offered free WiFi Nassau airport has complimentary WiFi everywhere Selection of popular restaurants inside the US departure lounge There are some shops but mostly expensive souvenirs A great experience hats off to everyone at NAS

Trip VerifiedI decided to opt for an extra legroom seat up in Economy but the website nor app was allowing me to book the seat or make a payment I reached out to customer care on email but the agent said that I can book the seat during checkin so to ensure this I woke up at midnight but the transaction did not go through the second agent was also equally unhelpful and recommended waiting couple more hours I stayed awake and tried again but no luck the third agent then told me that this can be done only before checkin and tried to fob me off with an apology to settle for a seat at airport checkin Finally the third agent was able to help and I got a good extra legroom seat and thankfully the rest of the journey from Maputo to Doha was great except for the food quantity which is really not adequate for me The entertainment selection was not the best but overall this leg was quite comfortable The crew onground and inair were quite good The Doha to Bombay leg was less comfortable given that this leg is operated by Indigo The Indigo service is not up to expectations there is no IFE the food offered was a tasteless sandwich and some chips If you are booking on Qatar Airways tofrom India check that the leg from Doha to Qatar is operated by Qatar Airways and not Indigo I have nothing against Indigo and am perfectly happy to fly them for short domestic flights in India but anything longer than a hour and half with them makes for an uncomfortable flight

Nice little airport which I use regularly Queues for passport control can be horrendous as has been said but staff are mostly friendly and facilities are good Plenty of places to eat and drink and you can use dinars in these though not in the Duty Free

Never had any problems flying in and out of John WayneOrange County Airport Its clean security is quick and efficient and has that laid back atmosphere that is OC Its very convenient even when it comes to flying internationally you can get almost anywhere in the world with no more than one stopover At times Ill fly out of LAX if Im not in the mood for that stopover but OC always offers a pleasant alternative for convenience and efficiency Because of its curfew a lot of planes depart first thing in the morning so getting there early is advised But overall a great airport

As living in the north of The Netherlands Bremen airport is a good alternative for Amsterdam Recently flown from the new low cost Ryanair terminal Its basic clean and blue There is a multipurpose shop which sells everything from a to z at somewhat inflated prices and small coffee shop Seating is mostly in plastic chairs which you could find at your local dentist Reasonable but we had an early flight so it was not so crowded Would not like to be there when its get full There are also some paid internet terminals The airport is well situated from the city center and freeway from the parking garage you are within minutes in the main terminal building Bremen is still a great small airport but they need to get some other low cost airlines on board besides Ryanair

IND is one of our two main options along with CVG when flying Both are excellent Traveling from Indy this week reminded me why I like it In morning and afternoon there are multiple good choices and most are reasonably priced in comparison to many other world airports crowds are nowhere near some airports so it is easy to move around TSA has always been friendly and efficient unlike some airports restrooms are generally cleaner than many other airports We do wish there were a couple of direct flights options to Europe but for flying domestically we like IND
Clean airplane departed on time Crew were professional and friendly Good announcement from the pilot Offered a cookie and a bottle of water No in flight magazine

Small airport dealing mostly with flights within Canada and USA Security was quick and easy no language problems either and we were through into the departure lounge which only has a shop and cafe but does have good free wifi to give you something to do while you wait A good experience

BrisbaneHoniara Checkin a little slow but request for seat changes so our group could sit together handled without fuss A has comfortable seats with good leg room but no IFE despite old style screens throughout the cabin being available Catering is very basic and catering equipment is old and well used Toilets clean but are old and smelly Highlight was the crew who offered drinks throughout the flight not just responding to requests but proactively out in the cabin for the whole flight Recommend having breakfast before the flight and bring a book or iPad but otherwise an enjoyable flight and cheaper than Virgin

This post World War II airbridge landmark is probably the best airport location worldwide Nowadays it is called Zentral Flughafen and that is because the Ubahn is only a minute walk From here it only takes minutes to get anywhere in the city The terminal is completely outdated but very charming Planes park literally in the terminal and boarding and deboarding happen always dry thanks to the roof of the hangar The toilets are clean there is a delishopbar and all major car rental companies have a desk Unfortunately THF is not smoke free passengers still smoke in the smoking area of the already small waiting areas at the gates

REX have always been professional I never took much notice of airlines I just know who I will no longer fly with In my recent trip with REX the light bulb went on I understood the Guest ethos that had been taught to me through employment as a driver for luxury travel With REX I finally got it the Guest Experience No other airline has made me feel this elusive Guest experience Ive had some absolute shockers I am now a nervous flyer Not a heart string pull try flying home with your step sons ashes and being treated poorly in the USA which you are transiting through Suffice to say I hate flying This recent trip I engaged brain I saw it and was the recipient of their incredible service The thing that makes airline travel easy seamless safe treat people with respect Dont immediately treat then with disrespect because of a judgement And this is REX

Cheap prices comfortable seats decent legroom inches on the former IndiGo airplane Check in at Bogota was done online but tourist pass for San Andres and bags had to be dropped off at the check in counter which was pretty easy Boarding was a breeze After take off many people switched seats since most didnt pay for an assigned one Flight was minutes late but otherwise good The only problem were kids running up and down the aisle like wild animals and nobody from the crew stopping them Unfortunately due to Colombias COVID rules there was no inflight service but you are able to bring your own drinks and snacks
