Berlin to Dusseldorf Eurowings flight operated by Germanwings This A was a different configuration then the first flight Legroom was less and was just enough for me m crew were smiling and good The flight delayed by minutes

As a Bahraini Im really proud of this airport Very neat and clean facilities and very well organized with easy signage and boarding procedures Toilets are super clean and well attended Some cons I would give are a lack of food options and the service at check in counters can be a little slow Additionally I wish there was a Marhaba lounge that allowed access to nonAmex credit card holders as well Other than that bravo

Check in in Bangkok swift and friendly lounges and boarding in Bangkok and Hong Kong always top notch Service and catering on both flights good What annoys me with flying economy on CX is their unwillingness to credit any Avios in non CX One World programs I was willing to pay a higher fare to get my points but there isnt any which credits points in Economy That is the reason to make me think twice to fly Cathay again in Y in the future

After reading lots of reviews I was really sceptical about flying with WOW air I still went ahead and booked my ticket to detroit as it was the cheapest option for a one way and I had to book last minute which is always more expensive I decided to pay for selected seats up the front with extra leg room on both flights and got really lucky with having no one in my row for the first flight The second flight I chose a seat with no middle seat and was really happy with this decision As its a cheap airline a lot of people do not pay for the seat upgrade its really not expensive to purchase the extra leg room and well worth it for the comfort Plus you will likely not have many people around The food and drink on board is very expensive but as I knew this beforehand I purchased food and water at the airport to take on the flight with me I think I was lucky with the reliability of both my flights taking off on time as this was the one thing I was worried about The seats are very dirty front seat pocket but all airlines are usually quite unhygienic so this was to be expected The service on board I thought was great very friendly staff and attentive Overall I would say you get what you pay for and you are taking a risk booking with WOW air but lucky for me I had a good experience with them and would book again

Vancouver to Phoenix We sat on the tarmac waiting and waiting for passengers to make their connection The flight attendant already announced that everyone was on board and the captain comes up and says we are waiting for more passengers What is fair To give us an on time arrival or wait for passengers and get everyone delayed No brainer

Before two years I used to fly with them and it was a pleasant one Now its far behind that quality I enjoy Now there is no comfortable space between the two seats Very difficult to sit if the front seater reclines his seat to mine Also there is no entertainment option QR code is not visible Every airlines targets only for maximum profit not the comfort of the pax All other things are okay

In November Phnom Penh air travelers started using a spacious new terminal equipped with percent more checkin counters than now twice as many immigration counters and three times as many Xray machines for carryon bags In Cambodias largest airport expansion mil in a generation the new airport terminal will seem like an upscale shopping mall There is a large food court twice as much floor space for duty free and a host of new food and beverage vendors never seen that far west on Russian Boulevard Last week the VIP and Premium lounges opened and are as good as any in a terminal this size It all looks very clean and organized though I have yet to see the new terminal when there are great numbers of people arriving or departing

Flew Ryanair last week to Tenerife Baggage drop was a breeze as was boarding Well organised The flight itself was excellent operated by a fantastic crew especially the cabin manager who was friendly polite and professional Wouldnt hesitate to use again

London City to Berlin British Airways subsidiary BA CityFlyer really exceeded my expectations for such a short flight London City is a great alternative to London Heathrow as flight prices are similar and it is much more convenient and less crowded as it is in the city centre and is a smaller airport The checkin and bag drop were all selfservice but could be done easily and quickly with staff present to assist We boarded the aircraft very orderly in different boarding groups The seats on the aircraft an Embraer E were wide and comfortable with more than enough legroom for economy class especially for an hour flight The cabin was arranged in a layout so it was pretty spacious Service provided by the crew was excellent and they provided a packet of chips and a drink Overall the flight was very enjoyable and we arrived in Berlin on time

Highly recommended airline offering excellent value for money I booked my flight from Bali to Doha via Xiamen and received three full meals a hour entry permit to explore Xiamen during my hour transit a free single hotel room and a free shuttle from airport to hotel all for It is simply incredible to believe that you can fly from Bali to China to Doha for only

Subang Airport to Redang The plane was a De Havilland Dash old but in good conditions The flight has been pleasant and crew did the best to offer us a pleasant flight water towels and a little snack The check in area in Subang and the all airport are very nice and clean the service has been very good They will replace their old planes soon with new ATR

Bangkok to Hong Kong and return After several good experiences I only use Orient Thai for my flights to Hong Kong Their price is Set regardless whether youre buying ahead or last moment Other low costs can have their cheapest offers around US less however that distinction quickly fades with slapping you various charges before you click buy Orient Thais fare is all inclusive inclusive of taxes a hot meal and KG of baggage too They used to fly an older B however now they use the version Flights were on time the plane was comfortable Staff active and helpful Seats and leg room superior to other low cost and many full fare airlines out there Only drawback is that there is no online check in and you get seats at the airport so you might not get your favourite seat All in all cannot fault them and love to see them fly to more Asian destinations

I did not find Antigua as bad as some but it was not exactly trouble free Immigration took about minutes bad but I have suffered worse elsewhere and the officer was polite and welcoming Departure is rather chaotic you queue to checkin about minutes in our case and to go through emigration over minutes though security was cleared quickly Once in the terminal it was crowded but had just enough seating The snack bar was reasonably priced but souvenirs can be found cheaper elsewhere on the island The good news hopefully is that the new terminal building is complete and due to open in the next few weeks according to locals it is much larger than the present one and looks a better design there are several dedicated piers for large aircraft Antigua is a great island and I look forward to experiencing the new facilities

Ground staff friendly and professional Limited facilities at Albrook Airport but functional Couldnt do online check in but was smooth at the airport Older plane but was on time and smooth flight No real on board service so take your own snack or drink after airport security Flight was only mins so not a problem Plane does have a toilet Its not like flying a major international airline but its a short flight and was a good experience They even gave us umbrellas to walk to the plane as it had started to rain which was a nice touch Id seen other negative reviews so was pleasantly surprised how professional and polite their staff were Id use them again Its difficult to rate the actual on board service because there really isnt any no entertainment or food drinks but its such a short flight its not that relevant So I base my score on the overall experience Good service and on time flights with friendly staff but in flight service not really offered

I had an early morning flight from Terminal to CKG Arrived early due to the scheduled shuttle from my hotel The security arrangements here are very tight but not overbearing CheckIn was simple enough while I virtually had to empty my carry on of all electronic items for separate scanning Once through I headed to the Hainan Airlines lounge but it only opened at am so I waited for minutes Then I had a wait until am until breakfast was served but it was plentiful and delicious My aircraft was at a distant stand so I had to board a bus but the boarding process was smooth and simple
Easy to get to with car from the Autobahn or from Leipzig with the train The airport is large but not confusing or crowded Security was a breeze All the people seemed nice

Staff are very rude They checked me thoroughly and ask to open my bag and not to touch anything i was just standing there and they are also checking the other passengers coming after mins i ask the security if i can go and get my bag she said oh yes you can i forgot She made me wait for nothing They have an overpriced for their food inside the airport I will share this experience to my colleagues and other friends

The Airport is pretty decent in a lot of aspects The duty free is vast the airport staff and security are ultra professional helped me guide through the terminal on where to find my gate However the WiFi experience could have been better because doing facetime calls was a problem considering whatsapp is not allowed Anyhow it is massive

I fly to LGB twice a year or more to visit family I really cannot say enough good things about this airport especially after the remodel a couple of years ago The place is beautiful It is well laid out it is small and so very easy to deal with I fly Jet Blue and it is almost always on time The restaurants in that terminal are quality and very reasonably priced This was one of the first airports to provide unlimited free wifi I love that you can board and leave the plane from both the front and rear It is so quick If you have to fly to So Cal this is the place to fly too

PER to MRU Efficient check in at Perth Airport Air Mauritius provides access to the Aspire Lounge at Perth which is actually a very good albeit open access lounge Aircraft was delayed due to delayed connecting passengers Boarding was around minutes late Aircraft quite modern clean and well presented Good amenity kits Welcome drinks served Business class seat is a standard lie flat but works well On the shorter routes like this they dont provide a mattress topper Lunch and drinks served after take off Food was good smoked salmon starter and lamb main Reasonably selection of IFE Staff responded quickly to any calls I managed a few hours sleep Afternoon tea served prior to arrival For an hours and minute flight the offering was a little limited and not presented with much flair Arrival was delayed and though off aircraft quickly immigration was slow Luggage waiting for us when we had cleared immigration My feeling is this represents a solid mid range business product

A modern medium size airport with ample space airside got plenty of outlets at the departure area and efficient checkin counter The airport is near to the city centre and it is easy to reach by taxi and private transportation Once through the security check you will be greeted by an airy airside with an ample seating area near to the gate and due to the design of the terminal the distance of the gate is really short and gave ample time for the passenger to catch their flight

Mid size airport with Indian standard with connectivity to most big cities in India after covid no international flight For arrival its easy to use we arrives at baggage hall and same hall have a prepaid taxi counter and a snack shop and a liquor shop Toilets were clean and also the terminal looks clean plenty of baggage trolleys also have paid porter facility Cabs are available book through their kiosk and avoid taking from touts outside It is situated within the city so if travelling light may walk towards outside and get auto that would be cheapest option to travel Ola Uber also available

The airport is small yet very well organized There is every service available that a person would require even for a long wait restaurant ATMs banks PO as far as airport seats go I was able to sleep on these in more comfort than others Ive been through many airports and can honestly say that Im impressed

I forgot my prescription glasses in the Duty Free in Tbilisi Following a few emails to the Duty Free department I received a positive response that they were found Two ladies did everything in their power to have them returned to me I cant fault these people they showed care and sympathy to my problems They are Natia and Inna Thank you so much

Airport has a weird system for departure You have to go to a security check point outside the airport to be patted down manually by security guards while your vehicle luggage is sniffed by gaurd dogs Then you are dropped off at a terminal for security check again this time through electronic devices where you get a special colored sticker on your luggage Afterwards you proceed to a shuttle bus carry your own luggage that will take you to another terminal about a minute drive where temperatures reach degrees Celsius in the summer At the nd terminal a security check is done to ensure you have been security checked at the previous terminal Now some of this can be avoided if you have a special VIP pass that skips step And a VVIP that skips all steps The check in counters are ok about of them run by Dubais DNata Immigration is slow and queues are long Duty Free is small with tobacco chocolates and alcohol available One coffee shop available behind Duty Free After passing immigration but before your gate you pass through another security check point remove your shoes belts etc Plenty of seating at the gates plus one coffee shop although AC is never working in the summer and no wifi connection through out the airport Staff are all generally friendly

Free WiFi cleanliness and planning are good Queue for security and immigration took around minutes Should deploy more staff for this purposes Restaurants after check in are less and with no good choice

It is clean quick and efficient passport control Landed at was driving off at My return leg was the same desks open for the flights that were going to London around the same time with CTA Very cheap cigarettes and alcohol airport staff are friendly and helpful The chap that said announcements were not made in English is wrong all flights are announced in Turkish and English You can hardly miss your flight as there are only gates A small airport with only around flights coming and going in one week but very efficient

Even though it was a really full flight I still had a good experience as a frequent flyer for United Airlines Everything was the same on the way and I dont have much to say But what got my attention is that the food is the same thing I had last year when flying from Brussels to Chicago The food tasted great but was familiar to me and I hope I didnt feel deja vu

Guayaquil to Baltra I wish to say a few positive words to review my trip to Galapagos with this nice airline which proved to be punctual reliable and with great customer service I had to anticipate my return flight from Baltra to Guayaquil so I decided to call the customer service on their international line I was a bit scared as reding the previous reviews I was expecting the worse Actually the customer assistant on the phone not only spoke perfect English but also managed to help me with the change easily and at no additional cost In few minutes the new ticket was delivered to my email together with all the information regarding the entrance requirements to Galapagos The whole checkinboarding process was easy and quite fast both ways and departure and arrival time perfectly punctual The plane was probably a bit outofdate but the crew and the pilots did their best to make the flight as pleasant as possible Drinks and a snack were served during both flights and we got lots of announcements from the cockpit Smooth takeoff and landing completed the journeys so overall a nice experience and nothing to complain I have to say that I travelled much better than with other airline companies

Work required me to go on very short notice to London so I decided to fly with VLM which offers you three flights per day from Antwerp to London City with their Fokker Decided as well to fly from Antwerp as they offered reasonable prices for their flights while my usual airlines I usually take from Amsterdam or Rotterdam were extremely expensive for just flying of less than a hour Arriving a touch early at Antwerp Airport checkin and security were quite quiet so it was just a matter of a few minutes to pass both checkin and security while waiting to board Very small airport so dont expect much to do after security Once the aircraft was ready to board it was just minutes to be fully ready to start up and depart The Fokker they were using was surprisingly neat and clean from the inside for an aircraft of this age and was quite spacious to stand in the aisle After an ontime departure out of Antwerp the flight was quite smooth and the flight attendant started to serve us with a complimentary drink and snack of your choosing while the flight crew kept us up to date about their procedure into London City and the estimated time of arrival which to me was well done Turbulence appeared into approach of London and landing was ontime The most surprising factor of the flight was that the noise was quite low for a turboprop within the cabin After a ontime landing the boarding was quickly done in a safe and mannerly matter and all that was left was to wait for our luggage to arrive on our belt which probably was the longest wait

Brasilia airport is probably the best Brazilian airport The shoppingeating area is good and with a great variety The information desk is good and people friendly not to mention the architecture that is beautiful The bad things about the airport are Transportation Buses not as frequent as they should be No metro or train Boarding area once you pass Security the airport is too crowded and not having the same amenities as the preboarding area make the journey less comfortable Too small for the traffic it has Drop offPick Up passengers There is a lack of enforcing the laws and people park in the drop off areas making it difficult to approach sometimes

The renewed Helsinki Airport is probably one of the best in the world at the moment The airport itself is not only beautifully designed but it works like a dream The departure lobby is equipped with multiple automatic bag drop stations with staff to help you with them The security was fast and smooth with the new machines The airside of the terminal is very clean and easy to find where to head to The variety of shops and restaurants is great too The passport control is quick with both robotic and manual checkpoints

Hong Kong to Kolkata An excellent flight where I was doted on by two very amiable and helpful cabin crew members It helped that I was one of just two passengers in the business class section which had seats in two rows of x A menu card was provided and my selection was tasty and filling A good complement of drinks and spirits was on offer However they have not changed their dessert a small cup of Haagen Daz ice cream in at least years It is always served solid frozen I passed on it and had some port wine instead The flight departed on time from a satellite terminal which was reached by a short bus ride from the main terminal Arrival was on schedule Indian government landing cards required of foreigners were provided on board The seats are traditional business class recliners and were reasonably comfortable Boarding was smooth intermixed with main cabin travelers through a jet way Ipads with a small selection of films and shows were provided soon after take off It was difficult to slot them into the metal clasps on the back of the seat in front of you you needed to hold on to the ipad to watch your program Magazines and newspapers on offer Lots of storage space overhead Leg space could be a tad extra once you recline fully your toes juts on the bottom of the front seat Announcements were made in clear English and for a very thoughtful touch also in Bengali the language of the destination city Cathay Dragon had a duty free catalog and three of my four selections were available for purchase This is one aspect of travel I very much enjoy as it lets me pick up last minute gifts

Nice lay out I got to the airport in the morning I just had a bit of some confusion as it was my first flight The automated ticket booths were convenient and quick Security was a breeze No queue the security personnel were nice and polite I didnt feel intimidated The gates are lined up along the back of the building nicely The Tim Hortons was next to my gate Washrooms are clean They even provide you with sanitizing wipes and cleaner to wipe the seat The stalls are private with no big gaps in the stalls Theres tables with outlets to charge your phone Coming back it was alright The luggage carousels are at the main floor where the front doors are

Flew Larnaca to Manchester on the th July Excellent flight arrived in Manchester early after a perfect flight All crew pleasant and attentive Food on board was very good also the in flight entertainment Have flown Cobalt several times and will continue to do so when travelling to Cyprus

Very small airport with very limited facilities I am amazed that this is an international airport If you are stuck in this airport for a few hours there is nothing to do However check in and security a breeze and seems very organised

Decent sized airport with friendly staff Arrivals area was pretty small but the airport itself was well connected to the city with the bus service running just a few steps outside the arrivals I travelled during the peak holiday season so was dreading departure from Glasgow but I was pleasantly surprised as the security was well managed and we went through smoothly The restaurants were bearing the brunt of the holiday season with not enough seating but it was still nice nonetheless

This is no longer called Bajpe airport since the opening of a spanking new terminal building at the end of the newish runway The new terminal has aerobridges that are used for passengers disembarking from the front end of the aircraft While I was there passengers could also disembark from the rear end using air stairs this for a B The airport is clean and spacious not particularly stylish but nice Mine was the only flight that came in at the time so the bags came quickly CarsTaxis park outside where theyre not supposed to so getting out took longer than it shouldve On the departure side there are shops before you get through security which is opened only about an hour before the flight but once you get through theres only a small coffee and snack stand The restrooms were clean

Frank Pais International Airport at Hologuin has two terminals one modern deals with international charter and scheduled services and the other older deals with flights to and from Havana My comments relate to the older national terminal The tone is set when passengers see the huge portrait of former President Fidel Castro on the airport terminal plus the slogan on the perimeter wall Socialism or Death This sets the tone for what is usually a pleasant visit to the city of Holguin Incoming passengers walk to the terminal where an excellently designed baggage conveyor promptly brings the luggage to be reclaimed The design of this conveyor requiring passengers simply to reach their suitcases off the belt is in contrast to those at much newer larger UK airports On arrival for your return flight check in is swift and simple and the waiting lounge has somewhat noisy Cuban TV playing loud music all the time

I fly this airport several times per year The name and location sounds like a bigger adventure than it actually is The airport is small so boarding an A is already something that keeps everybody busy However there are not that many flights ground staff are friendly and helpful

Berlin Tegel to Vienna On my short weekend trip to Vienna I ended up in a Niki aircraft although booked with Air Berlin You can see a small difference between Niki and its bigger sister for example the crew wear an pinkviolet uniform and probably the main difference being that Niki still gives the complementary drinks one hot and one cold and a little snack a vegetarian and a nonvegetarian option and it was like in the old days at Air Berlin The flight was of course on time The crew were very friendly the seat was very spacious I got one with extralegroom as a topbonus platinum A nice airline for a nice flight

I am only writing this review because so many things are off about this airport I definitely expected more as its a huge airport with tons of revenue from the gaming here The companion care restroom was locked as someone who needs this restroom and cannot use the other ones I was waiting for about minutes I knocked several times After minutes I called the courtesy phone operator concerned that someone was in there and unwell or unconscious No one responded then another person called on his own volition and still no one came This is a HUGE security concern After minutes a line was forming so I flagged down a lovely custodian who unlocked the door and discovered thankfully no one was inside He explained It was locked in the night to prevent people from sleeping in it The fact it was not unlocked during the night in the morning means this airport was not ADA compliant and the fact that no body came after securityrelated calls were made to the operator means this airport does not have quick response to security concerns Its filthy theres food crumbs coffee dust and crud on every surface and many chairs The charging stations barely work at least in the AA terminal and nearly all of the USB direct ports are full of grey putty while the ones that arent full of putty dont charge and are loose and broken The staff here are lovely but the facilities are dismal and frankly this place is a security nightmare As a bay area resident I will never fly through here again and will never recommend this airport with a definite preference for connecting CLEAN SAFE airports like Denver IAHHobby Atlanta or Chicago

A small airport serving the Transylvania town of Sibiu Its a walk boarding only one constructed new in an off the shelf design barebone Operation is fast and efficient staff is a bit reserved but friendly and professional Romania is now a Schengen country so no more border control to most EU flights Airside theres one food and beverages shop and one dutyfree Both are nothing to rave about There are taxis to the city and a modern bus which is cheaper

Well where to start Simple straight forward helpful staff at Gatwick They given the passes for the lounge and fast track security The lounge was fairly quiet and so was security mind you it was am on a Monday morning Boarding was quick and once in the seat the service was first class with a team of crew looking after the Premier Economy cabin while waiting we were offered Sparkling wine or Orange Juice Once we had reached cruising height we had the first drinks service and our order for lunch was taken The choices been Sausage and Mash Thai Green Chicken Curry and rice and a Veggie option After lunch which was about hours into the flight and we had another drinks service The Cabin Service Manager then announced that should anyone want more drinks please ring the call bell We had the duty free trolley pass though the cabin about minutes from landing we were served a tea meal of sandwiches scones jam and a drink of our choice You also have a pillow and blanket bottle of water on both legs and you are given amenity kit on the outward leg to use on both legs The head phones are collected at the end of both legs Next thing we knew we were starting our descent into Cancun The return flight was the same format but the food was local sourced but was a choice of beef stew and mash Chicken and Potatoes or the Veggie Option The food was tasty and afterwards the cabin lights were dimmed to allow people to sleep Any drinks etc were ordered from your seat by ringing the call bell We did have a duty free trolley service whilst waiting for the hot meal About minutes before landing we had a breakfast service of Omelette Tomato and Hash Brown which was very nice Next thing we were on finals to land at Gatwick I think the TUI premier economy product is very good value for money the inflight entertainment is very good and has a good range of films TV games music Would I travel Premier Economy again Yes
Once again I used Lviv Airport four times in August Very satisfied with facilities and staff who work there Definitely beats many USA airport who have a lot to do in order to improve

Modern airport medium in Chinese terms Incoming by bus from runway efficient and fast very simple to get your bearings Outgoing fast very clear information very efficient checkin good facilities About min from city center

It is a second tier nonhub airport so traffic is lower As others have noted it is surrounded by a botanical garden so the setting is beautiful Recently all of the food options were significantly upgraded Security moves quickly and efficiently The arrivals area is large and conveniently located next to the parking garage for a quick departure Rental car counters are right in the arrivals area Which brings me to the only negative waits for checked baggage are noticeably longer than almost any other airport Figure on a minimum minute wait Would recommend getting your rental car while you wait on your bags

BUR is a no frills no wow no stress airport and those are the best things about it Easy to park with valet getting through security is usually a breeze and there is little fog to cause delays Theres a Peets coffee and the cafe is overpriced but decent Do you really expect fine dining on what is primarily a short haul airport basically an SWA airport Other than the charming s air about the place you get on and off the planes old school style with stairs and with SWA can enter through the front of back of the plane the latter to avoid the slow pokes SWA boarding lines are well organized If I were to complain the rest rooms are smallish and Terminal B for United is too small Seating can be somewhat tight close to boarding time Baggage claim is usually reasonably fast but there are only two carousels so dont dawdle If you are going to the westside or even downtown youre in for a long cab ride but most travelers live in one of the nearby valleys and if youre a tourist its close to Universal Studios Theres a train within walking distance that will take you downtown or to Ventura County during limited times Overall a very good travel experience because it is easy and stress free
Overall the airline offered a clean cabin efficient crew almost friendly good seat spacing and ontime service Pretty good for a budget airline

Arrived at the airport and one of the customer service agents was very helpful He helped me with picking up my luggage connecting to WiFi and was very friendly His name was Houssem Thank you so much for all the hard work

I was travelling from London to Minsk via Amsterdam for a holiday in Belarus I just about made my connection and the boarding process was efficient and ground crew friendly The Embraer was quite roomy inside because there are only two seats to a row The staff spoke English but not well and the level of friendliness and customer service was adequate but lower than you would find in a western airline We arrived in Minsk a little bit ahead of schedule and I thought the airport there seemed modern and efficient The food and drink on board were quite good The airline is good value for money and their online booking process was very clear and easy to use

Im autistic and was nonverbal unable to speak when I went through security but the staff were incredibly kind and helpful It was very much appreciated as its obviously very difficult to navigate the world when one cannot speak and the staff were completely understanding Be proud

Nice surprise as an Italian I appreciated a lot the food which could be bought on board Pasta alla Norma Red wine Valpolicella Professional and friendly staff tasting and authentically Italian food Proud as Italian to feel these kind of attentions to flyers Strongly suggested

I would not call Terminal of Sofia Airport a terminal for international flights This T is more like an intercity bus station unclean with insufficient seating with only three kiosks called I dont know why Duty free provided that the prices in them are equal and in some cases even higher than those in stores in Bulgaria Boarding organization is bordering on ZERO The socalled gates are indicated by some signs but in no way are they separated into separate areas Duty free

Paris Orly to PointePitre Overall good experience decent food friendly service on the inbound flight Outbound all of the crew disappeared at night difficult to get something to drink Some security concerns upon landing in Paris Crew didnt check the cabin at alltwo teens sleeping in lie flat position until touchdown No one to wake them up no one to remind them to put their seat in an upright position never saw that before Seats are ok but angled lie flat
Hatay HTY I flew into Hatay last year for my daughters wedding celebration airport was small but adequate and staff were helpful

Business classenjoyed a drink of champagne and some refreshments upon taking a seat and theres plenty of room to stretch out Particularly on their trips from Dubai An amazing collection of Englishlanguage movies spanning every possible genre
Very nice airport Small short ways with quick checkin short TSA waits short Gate walks and free wifi for minutes

I left on early BA flight and was very impressed with the helpful staff in the airport check in hours ahead fast empty security and border control Nice airy feel and clean although some cafe prices shocking cost me more than Scandinavian airports euro for potato chips Generally modern and relaxed despite a number of early morning flights and there was a machine where robot gives you jelly beans I like distractions in airports takes your mind off stress BA gate staff helpful and whole experience was stress free compared to disgraceful regional airports in UK

Arriving in Manado from Singapore by SilkAir is always a good experience The greenery around the airport was beautiful and the short walk less than minutes from the plane to the immigration counter is a relief compared to the minute walk I used to have in Changi when rushing from immigration to the gate The terminal building is quite clean and adequate The only downside is the crowd outside the arriving gate exit There were lots of illegal taxis touting arriving passengers The lack of seating area outside the terminal is also a concern as it was hard to find a proper place to sit while waiting for someone to arrive
A fantastic new airport that is miles ahead of the old Durban International Bright spacious and with a feeling of quality

I dont ever leave reviews but wanted to for the first of my flights with SAS I had a great time with this airline on flights over a long weekend trip The first flight from Heathrow to Copenhagen really stood out to me The two air stewardsesses were amazing and stood out as caring and genuinely interested A real asset to the airline The food on this first flight would not be my first choice but once i started eating it i was very happy Cant fault SAS on any of the flights They were on time and good flights Highly recommended

While my arrival at Brunei Airport initially presented a frustrating situation due to a lack of prior communication about the INRS portal requirement the exceptional assistance I received from one of the staff members Mr Asnawi turned things around Despite my frustration he remained calm professional and incredibly supportive His patience and understanding helped deescalate the situation and his dedication to assisting me ensured I could resolve the issue without further stress It is rare to encounter such exceptional service and he truly went above and beyond to make a difficult experience manageable I commend Royal Brunei Airlines for having such exemplary staff who prioritize passenger wellbeing and customer satisfaction This experience reinforced my confidence in the airline and I would not hesitate to fly with Royal Brunei Airlines again
Windhoek airport is small but clean and really well organized The only restaurant at the check in area is situated at the Arrival area food is fresh and delicious Facilities are quite good

Ive flown in and out of Pau several times Its a lovely airport with a pleasant smallness about it The only downside for me is that from the UK it is only served by Ryanair On principle I will no longer fly with them If any other UK carrier starts using Pau I will happily fly there again

Just flew on a oneway flight from Zurich to Sarajevo and was extremely pleased The flight was carried out by their ATR aircraft which looked pretty new and was clean too We both departed and arrived early which I found great however What Id noticed is that the only type of entertainment they offered on board were the magazines in the seat pockets which were rather boring but this was after all a small aircraft so I wouldnt have expected anything else The plane was surprisingly full there were only about three unoccupied seats on board The inflight meal consisted of a very tasty sandwich and a wide selection of drinks Very kind cabin crew and they spoke really good English which was great I definitely recommend flying BH Airlines

It is a nice and small airport but it is in compliance with the city and the air movement in the region The most negative point is the few stores and food options There are checkin machines and circulation is relatively fast

MEX consists of two terminals with Aeromexico Delta Copa and LATAM taking up the newer Terminal and everyone else essentially taking up Terminal Terminal is definitely more userfriendly with Terminal being well over capacity This honestly I dont think will change given that its proximity to the center of Mexico City makes it quite convenient in spite of its shortcomings

Well where to start Simple straight forward helpful staff at Gatwick They given the passes for the lounge and fast track security The lounge was fairly quiet and so was security mind you it was am on a Monday morning Boarding was quick and once in the seat the service was first class with a team of crew looking after the Premier Economy cabin while waiting we were offered Sparkling wine or Orange Juice Once we had reached cruising height we had the first drinks service and our order for lunch was taken The choices been Sausage and Mash Thai Green Chicken Curry and rice and a Veggie option After lunch which was about hours into the flight and we had another drinks service The Cabin Service Manager then announced that should anyone want more drinks please ring the call bell We had the duty free trolley pass though the cabin about minutes from landing we were served a tea meal of sandwiches scones jam and a drink of our choice You also have a pillow and blanket bottle of water on both legs and you are given amenity kit on the outward leg to use on both legs The head phones are collected at the end of both legs Next thing we knew we were starting our descent into Cancun The return flight was the same format but the food was local sourced but was a choice of beef stew and mash Chicken and Potatoes or the Veggie Option The food was tasty and afterwards the cabin lights were dimmed to allow people to sleep Any drinks etc were ordered from your seat by ringing the call bell We did have a duty free trolley service whilst waiting for the hot meal About minutes before landing we had a breakfast service of Omelette Tomato and Hash Brown which was very nice Next thing we were on finals to land at Gatwick I think the TUI premier economy product is very good value for money the inflight entertainment is very good and has a good range of films TV games music Would I travel Premier Economy again Yes

Es una aerolnea fantstica el personal es muy amable el precio muy asequible Me gustara que hubiera vuelos a ms lugares A Gran Canaria solamente hay dos vuelos a la semana desde mi lugar de residencia estara mejor que hubiera mas Its a fantastic airline the staff is very friendly and the prices are very affordable I wish there were flights to more places There are only two flights a week to Gran Canaria from where I live more would be better

VeronaTimisoaraChisinau The flight from Verona departed almost hours late resulting in hours late arrival at the final destination The company didnt provide sufficient information as to the causes of delay Voucher provided for food and drinks doesnt get you much in Verona airport I should commend them for holding the flight TimisoaraChisinau on the tarmac until a number of connecting passengers flying from all over Italy made it to Timisoara Onboard the service was good Offered hot meal alcoholic drinks and good attitude from flight attendants despite the stress and extended working hours caused by the delay Service on the TimisoaraChisinau leg also good Overall three stars Two stars for handling the delay and stars for service attitude and the fact that they did get us to the final destination on the same day despite a long delay

Pros Very good interiors and wellmaintained seats cleanliness lighting Ample space available between knee and seat in front of you Wellmannered and clear language English and Hindi speaking crew led by Ms Unnati Didnt have food nor used washroom so cannot comment on that Journey was comfortable and no bumpy rides encountered Communication from cockpit was also clear everytime Cons Boarding was not done in zoneseat number wise Quite some mosquitoes seen before take off which bit me and some passengers Crew applied some spray but wasnt enough Pricing was a big letdown as huge increase seen while booking on Feb for my journey date of Feb in a short span of time Slight delay in takeoff after closing of doors

Janakpur the capital of Madhesi province in Nepal has the IATA code JKR and the provincial government has recently revamped the airport with a total overhaul new building replacing the old one that means an entirely new terminal but the same old runway It may rank as as the best airport operating domestic flights only in Nepal Belts for luggage handling big hall with sufficient seating facilities restaurant inside and a nice departure lounge Toilets arent clean People are too introvert security personnel needs to improve on behavioural front Not long queue for departure Basic facilities for other things parking enough for passenger load

Simply put the Little Rock Airport has to be the nicest smallersized airport that I have ever used It is very easy to access from downtown and elsewhere Everyone who I encountered there was extremely friendly The TSA folks were all nice and they did their best to move folks through the line as quickly as possible For an airport its size it has a great variety of restaurants

Very small airport with very limited facilities I am amazed that this is an international airport If you are stuck in this airport for a few hours there is nothing to do However check in and security a breeze and seems very organised

We arrived from Rome with Ryanair bussed quickly to the terminal which is new bright and clean Luggage arrived almost in a blink of an eye Easy navigation to the exit with a stop in a clean toilet several ATMs very convenient mins from the moment we landed to the car pick up Highly recommended airport nice experience

As a regular workrelated traveler the most important thing for me is time when flying speed at checkins and flights departing and arriving on time as scheduled I have been using Qatar Airways for a few years for all my international travel and I can plan with confidence my onward travel meetings etc The onboarding process is seamless and the ground staff are knowledgeable friendly and helpful During flights the same level of professionalism can be expected and there are no surprises I fly the same longdistance route approximately every four weeks and the experience remains consistent The food is usually excellent but on my last trip a few days ago the DohaAmman leg the dinner was exceptional serving dishes that you do not usually see on flights to clarify I flew business class Thank you Qatar Airways It remains a pleasure flying with you

Having used Tijuana many times in the past I was surprised while using it recently after a year break The renovations are still under way but it is a clean modern and efficient airport that works well The queues are generally quick and the staff know what theyre doing With some great connections to mainland Mexico and a couple of new discount airlines using the airport it is a great alternative to SAN Only annoying bit is the lack of any decent food and beverage once youre through security Over priced and average The upside is you can check in for most flights in Mexico up to minutes before take off so basically you can just walk through security and to the gate

Check in smoothless immigration great lounge perfect When you arrive at the gate here comes the security check All Xray staff do NOT take care of your stuff You fold your jacket you find it in a wreck when you pick it up Put your expensive bag in a tray they take it out and put it directly on the conveyor belt Really this is not acceptable for Singapore I have a stars not for all airport staff but security staff They need to care more

Koh Samui is usually an excellent airport the tropical ambience laid back staff garden setting and impressive views of the planes make this a quirky experience The recent floods and mass cancellations have regrettably brought this airport to its knees however Under normal conditions I thoroughly recommend this establishment

Great airport to travel from and return to No great distances to walk easy access to check in counters TSA actually seems to care and think rather than defaulting to lowest level of acceptable service ie Denver Early morning flights are great as the food court has great breakfast burritos and coffee The only problem seems to be the luggage getting from the plane back to you Once you have your bags the rest of the trip out is a breeze

The airport infrastructure is generally good and quite modern offering a clean and wellmaintained environment However one major drawback is the long walking distance between terminals and gates which can be tiring especially for elderly passengers or those with heavy luggage While the airport staff are polite and friendly they do not always demonstrate efficiency or resourcefulness when handling issues which can be frustrating for travellers in need of quick assistance Additionally one of the biggest concerns is the frequent long queues at immigration which can cause unnecessary delays particularly during peak hours This aspect of airport operations could be significantly improved by increasing the number of immigration officers implementing more automated systems or streamlining the process to enhance efficiency Overall while the airport offers a modern and comfortable environment there is still room for improvement in terms of staff efficiency and passenger flow management

Arrival procedures efficient Departing procedures our aircraft had hours delay due to a technical problem Ground staff have been professionnal and kind with passengers Embarking area for France the area is small but enough for one long haul flight not for several long range aircrafts Shopping area is too small only small shops and a small snack Cleanliness OK

A small but very nice airport just km from the city center The distances are short checkin hassle free and handling staff very friendly I was very happy to hear international traffic had been approved about a year ago Nowadays there are international flights to Brussels and Copenhagen I really support the development of this airport because of the proximity to the city center the short distances and a problem free handling

Very friendly clean and organized Still in need of more modern technology but above all for being in a poor country it delivers a good service nice food court and souvenir shops although the latter are pricey It has something for everyone

I travelled from Coventry to Naples this year and found the airport limited but satisfactory The checkin area reminded me of the old days with cardboard flight destination signs and this was an area that could be easily changed for the better The lines crossed each other to the destinations and did cause some friction between customers The car parking was an experience but again was satisfactory I do not understand why the local bus companies especially those going to Leamington Stratford do not call in On returning the baggage was certainly a LOT better than Birmingham so a plus there In the departure lounge there was a good choice of food and drink at great prices no rip off here Also a small point The newspapers were out and available from about Birmingham they are still under wraps at Good value and friendly Hope they get permission for the bigger one soon

The booking was easy via Zipair website reasonable price and good flight time The trip was pleasant in general the plane is clean new upgraded the staff were very friendly and polite and flight was on time But need to be more clear about the low price comes from not providing anything in return Like things are granted on other long flights hours for example a screen to watch movies games tv show this is unavailable on zipair there is WiFi to use on your own devices its not that strong anyway Other things are unavailable blankets no free non alcohol drinks even water I dont need to say food or snacks Thats all needed to be mentioned clearly on their website to be prepared ahead There are a few items available for purchase honestly the food could not be worse they bring it in small carton box water bottle thats it no tray no bread butter no dessert Otherwiseall good just needed to add these information and details make a plan to enjoy the trip

Cleanliness of Terminal toilets and food section must be improved Toilets seems to be unattended for ages floor is full of tissues and stains Bins are full Food court tables and chairs are under the same condition which is quite surprising as per Japan standard Air Conditioning is not cool enough seats at he waiting area are also not enough However I still love to come back to visit Japan again

A small pleasant and friendly airport All the staff are really nice and now even the younger staff at security are very friendly which wasnt typical before the pandemic The procedures are very fast However during peak times there is absolutely not enough space around the caf and dutyfree shops in the Schengen section even after the recent terminal upgrade I really miss the newspaper stand in this area I would especially like to praise the staff at Little Slovenia in the NonSchengen section Its truly a small oasis of kindness and wellbeing

Johannesburg to Bloemfontein This review is more for compliment for one of your service staff at domestic departures I had a connecting flight from CPT to Bloemfontein via JHB I flew Mango to JHB and SAA Express to BFN There was only hour between arrival in JHB and departure to BFN The baggage claims for Mango took way too long and l was going to miss my flight Without my bag l ran up to the SAA express checkin counters for assistance Staff really went over and beyond to assist me and make sure l didnt miss my flight He assisted to check me in and help to carry my bag from baggage claim up to the checkin counter and safely on the correct plane All in time Without is quick response and help l would have surely missed my flight Well done for excellent customer service Thank you

Pleasant and easy check in Perfectly organized boarding Clean and new aircraft Spacious seat distance however seat width not as wide as other carrier on this route Pleasant crew Very good food which however was served a bit late At arrival fast border control and bag arrived rather soon however priority sticker did not give the bag priority delivery

Recently flew to and from Roissy CDG to Biarritz International in the Basque country in south west France for the first time The airport itself is small but there is a good bus service which will take you into the city centre pretty quickly On arrival on the HRS AF flight from CDG this flight seemed to coincide with a number of other flights from the UK which made the baggage arrivals area chaotic In addition the toilet facilities landside need some upgrading and definitely could do with the cleaners visiting there on a more frequent basis especially midafternoon which seems to be the peak time for the airport The rubbish bin in the gents toilet was overflowing when I was there which left a poor initial impression The airport does have an excellent tourism booth with very helpful staff however In addition from the airport one can get onto the nearby motorway very quickly and the care hire agencies also had very helpful staff at the airport especially Europcar On departing Biarritz back to Paris however I discovered that the departures area has only one very small cafe so passengers may not want to enter this area too quickly as the wait could be long and somewhat boring In summary the airport is convenient but it falls well short of the new fresher and modern design of nearby Pau airport which is excellent

Flew Air Nostrum from Madrid T to Ibiza Nice short flight on a sunny afternoon Fast dropoff baggage a gentle Iberia staff member helped us to print boardingpasses halfhour late boarding walked to the plane Comfortable seats very kind cabin crew Flight itself was great splendid manned by a Ladycaptain So we started our summer holiday relaxed One week after second leg Ibiza to Valencia mins flight on turboprop Bit cramped seats bit noisy but for a such a short time wasnt important Final approach was rather steep but landing was OK Both flight were on time less than mins late arrival uneventful luggage claimed fast and in good situation decent priced I will not hesitate to use Air Nostrum for Spanish domestic flights in the future

Ottawa is my home airport and given the population that it serves its very convenient It is not very large so it may not have some of the amenities larger airports will have showers multiple lounges etc but its fast clean and provides an acceptable amount of food choices Whenever possible I like to clear customs in this airport vs doing so in Toronto or Montreal

As I live nearby its a convenient airport for me especially because of frequent flights to London and Southern France You can make use of free Internet Parking is cheap Connection to Rotterdam City and Port area is good and quick Hardly any queuing you can arrive mins before departure without any problems Whenever possible I make use of RotterdamThe Hague Airport

I have been using Bangalore Airport for years and as Indian airports go it has been at the better end of pleasant travel experiences The new Terminal for international flights and some airlines such as Vistara is a revelation amazing feeling of space and the plants on nearly every wall and ceiling give a wonderful effect Security is efficient with minimal queues the or times I have departed There are more and more shops and eateries appearing too

Seoul Incheon to Tokyo Narita with Easter Jet This was a low cost airline but everything was fine Check in took five minutes I paid extra for a bulkhead seat and it was worth it The seats were quite narrow but bearable for a two hour flight There was just a small drinks run and no food available but as it was only a two hour flight it was acceptable

HKGBKK I booked with them because it was the only airline available Check in took hr in HKG and plane was a year old B Entertainment was pretty much nothing and seats were the most uncomfortable Ive ever experienced Plane and bathroom were unclean I booked a seat in the upper deck and it was quiet Food was horrible Only good thing was the value because I you pretty much get everything for that cheap price
Everything went smooth from Pyongyang to Beijing Checkin staff were friendly Seats were comfortable Inflight entertainment could have been better Food and drinks decent enough

My partner and I recently flew from Rarotonga to Aitutaki The flights are minutes each direction Well what a professional airline A full service was conducted with complimentary teacoffeewater Buy on board items offered Cookies were and value for money The only flight attendant was professional and courteous the aircraft was immaculate Seat space rivals some international airlines premium economy offerings These flights were very pleasant This airline is a great ambassador for this idyllic part of the world

Zurich to Geneva return with Darwin Airline Booking and checkin was smooth online checkin was not available Boarding was quick maybe due to light load factors on both segments Both flights were on time arrival even early Very nice cabin crew comfortable seats with huge seat pitch s style on the Saab I can recommend them at least for flights from and to Geneva I am aware that Darwin Airline has some punctuality issues But that never happened to me Great value for money

I flew with my husband from Sharm El Sheikh to Cairo to see the pyramids and Egyptian Museum with a return flight to Sharm three days later The flight took off on time the cabin crew were friendly and the seats were comfortable Unfortunately my husband was taken ill in Cairo and I decided we needed to return to the UK I cancelled our return flight on the morning we were due to fly back to Sharm The money was in my bank two days later I would fly Air Cairo again

I would like to express my gratitude to the airport staff for caring about my comfort and positive impressions of the company I would like to express special gratitude to the employee Annette for helping me resolve the issue with my luggage The flight was comfortable and in a safe atmosphere for me

Special assistance staff went above and beyond to help us after huge road delays meant we were late arriving at the airport Cant thank them enough Airport itself was very clean easy to navigate lots of choice for food and drink Fantastic staff

Pyongyang to Beijing with hotcold drinks and a hamburger which was adequate for length of flight Very polite and welcoming service Efficient check in and boarding In flight entertainment limited to a video of recent North Korean hits Pyongyang Times and Korea Today available to take on board

Bangkok to Osaka Smooth check in and efficient seat allocation They didnt check cabin baggage weight nor size Had to buy food and drinks as refused internet preorder because we used a travel agent Seats ok but a night flight which was very uncomfortable Saw in the inflight magazine we could upgrade enroute to premium economy a good idea For B a good flight
The cabin is clean Flight attendants are friendly and polite Seats can be reclined easily The food is delicious and fresh Flights departed on time

Most of the flights use the gates but even though they are empty many lowcost flights all except Air Astana Etihad etc use the ramps The staff were reasonably friendly and the immigration process was no bother compared to Tashkent Airport The airport itself is too small One of my friends in Business class decided to not use the lounge because it was just rubbish The staff dont really care if the people in the business class lounge talk loudly or anything The airports checkin could be improved and the domestic arrivals hall has too many taxi drivers trying to find customers Food choice is also limited but the duty free was actually pretty decent However I would not use this airport again but I have to next year

Ankara airport is lovely clean and a pleasure to be in It feels very new and modern and has a lot of glass to let natural light in Security is very fast and efficient and connecting to and from the city is fairly easy with a shuttle bus that costs TL Unfortunately like all Turkish airports to get free wifi you need a code sent to your mobile so if youre traveling and dont have a sim card that works then youre out of luck Otherwise its not a problem
This airport was very efficient no lines or delayed services There are a lot of shops where you can shop and places where you can have a bite Delicious coffee and bakery items to buy

Orlando to London Gatwick Flight was booked for Norwegian We learned shortly before flight that we would be actually flying with HiFly Did a quick internet search and did not find any alarming negatives We were surprised to see a plain white jet pull up to the terminal We were informed that the flight would be minimally delayed by the crew The boarding process was as smooth as rude impatient customers would allow the crew handled it well The flight attendants were young fresh energetic efficient and very nice a nice change for us The flight crewcaptain informed us right away about the flight route that we were navigating around a storm that he apologized for the initial delay but that he believed we could make up the time He did just that The seats and food were what we expected in economy class so no real complaints there as I choose not to pay for upgrades All in all very favorably impressed with this airline

Boise is a smaller sized airport which takes in most if the states airline traffic Walking into the airport from the parking garage in the winter time can be quite grueling and in summer afternoons the outside can be very hot Check in lines are never too long and the check in area is large with very pretty murals on the walls to look at Lighting in any part of the terminal is not a problem with great natural light Pre TSA there is only one eating area that is nothing special and the baggage claim is older giving you a s esque feel For the size if the airport the baggage handlers do take their sweet time getting the bags to their destination I have waited over half an hour for bags before Moving on to TSA the lines are usually quick and screening does not take long There is only one full body detector but traffic still flows freely Due to the recent TSA problems though the lines have reached back towards check in but lines are never hectic in the morning Post TSA is a set of large windows and an eating area The windows give a great view across the airport Food in the airport is classy but a little sub par The McDonalds that used to be the main attraction is now replaced with more Boiselike restaurants Five guys and Einsteins bagels take up most of the hunger goers On the other side of the eating are is a local brewing company Shopping in the upper terminal is nothing to write home about there is an MSNBC and cute convenience stores The airport has no specialty shops and the stores all sell the exact same things like candy magazines and little Idaho potato dolls The C terminal below is dark and again very s esque Birds have been seen inside the upper terminal before they are adorable and not a nuisance to passengers They give a somewhat natural ambiance One of the biggest problems with the airport is their horrendous seats and very few charging ports Most of the ports are up against walls or beams Restrooms are located in one spot in the B terminal and one location just past TSA Overall the airport seems very clean friendly like most of Idaho A pretty good airport Not great but pretty good

I had lose my hand carry luggage during the security check due to my own negligence I only realized it after boarded to my flight Singapore airline SQ on th Feb I highly appreciated Incheon airport ground staff and Singapore airline staff professional service quick response and putting customer satisfaction at high priority as they managed to quickly locate the luggage ensure me the luggage will be sent back the by the next available flight and I could proceed returning Singapore as per plan Two staff members Im not sure if hes Incheon airport staff or Singapore airline staff I would like to mention in particular who had responded very fast and given me great support at the boarding gate Mr Kang and Mr Lee Both their effort was sincerely appreciated

My daughter and myself were at airport this morning waiting for my sister in law coming from London Her flight was delayed we were concerned that maybe she missed her flight We met a lovely young man Philip He was so helpful friendly kind Philip is fantastic with customers Inquiring about flights out of airport Philip was very helpful

We flew out of Manchester Airport on th January under very trying weather conditions The journey to the airport at am was quite fraught what with fogsnowice Our taxi driver did a great job even getting us to the airport with a challenging journey We were frankly impressed to walk into T just after am to find any number of Jet ground staff waiting to greet us I have no idea what they had to go through to get to the airport but they would all have had a snow day excuse not to turn up I asked the girl at the check in if we would actually be going to Barcelona for my husbands th and she said course you will with a broad smile Boarding was pretty much on time but then we had to sit for a while for deicing which pushed us back hours Not a problem looking at what was outside the plane Good flight outbound Crew very amenable Do wish they would look at the in flight menu now we travel a few times a year with Jet and are not mad on the food or drink offerings Maybe a refresh Inbound flight to Manchester was what you could call challenging We arrived at the airport just over hours early to find that the plane was still on the runway in Manchester The airport was closed due to snow and so it remained there for over hours Jet sent us a euro voucher each attached to our boarding passes for refreshments We looked around but a basic sandwich in the terminal was over euros This voucher should be at least euros now At last we saw the plane had left Manchester and it made good time landing We had a wave from the pilot on boarding which cheered us up We were about hours late but no compensation as weather and not airline related fair enough Just before landing at Manchester we were advised from the flight deck that a wave of fog had moved in over the airport We then completed or circular routes around the moors waiting to land Having never experienced an ILS landing in fog before it was frankly amazing considering that there appeared to be no visibility at all from the aircraft When we landed we couldnt even see the terminal buildings from the plane and the runway markings came into view just as the plane touched down So Jet did a fantastic job getting us to Barcelona in the worst weather conditions in many years and despite airport closure and fog got us back into Manchester and on the ground Thats what the pilots get paid for they probably should be paid rather more Our quibbles about the in flight food pale into insignificance when youre not on a summer flight to Greece

Seats in economy cabin very comfortable compared to a lot of airlines The hot meal was of good quality however on a hour flight it was the only hot meal and a small roll before landing You need hot meals on such a long flight we were so hungry when we got off the aircraft Half of the crew were tui Scandinavia crew they were lovely very glam and hard working the uk based crew could learn a lot from these guys The uk based crew on my flight out looked a mess and done the bare minimum and werent very pleasant Drinks were plentiful also which they only served at specific times throughout the flight as I heard them say no to a few people when they asked outside of the service I think this is great stops people getting drunk and annoying on a long flight which makes it more pleasant for everyone The hours went quickly and Id fly with TUI again

Lao Airlines is wonderful The planes was immaculate and while they no longer serve the little bags of chips they offer small bottles of water on even the shortest flights At least on shorter flights there is no video entertainment but who needs it on a local hop They have a terrific inflight magazine so five stars for that Checkin is a matter of minutes and since Laos is a small place with limited air traffic Ive never had to wait for security This is a tiny airline in a small country and they get it right

China Eastern really surprised me with this recent flight I took with them Their business class product is pretty solid and competitive in my opinion Cabin crew were very hospitable and spoke excellent English Meals drinks and snacks were free flowing and quite scrumptious I had the Asian option and their three course meal didnt disappoint I was even taken aback by pajamas being an amenity that was offered There was free wifi too albeit slow I have a couple of very minor gripes though First is my dislike for the slanted seating arrangment which obstructs the feet when in the lie flat position Next had to do with their website which is barely functional I also would of liked a few more film offerings Nevertheless I arrived well rested and well fed so ended up with a completely different outlook of China Eastern for the positive If they can remedy their website and invest a bit more onto their AVOD system they would be a force to be reckoned with I wouldnt hesitate to fly them again

AMSAAL and quite satisfied with this regional airport Only a few flights per day so baggage reclaim understandably very quick Bus line connects with downtown Aalborg every minutes weekdays but only hourly during the weekend travel time is mins and costs DKK Checkin efficient and hasslefree using selfservice kiosks Free Internet computers are available landside a nice touch Security staff very friendly Boarding area is rather cramped with limited seating do not go airside too early
Beautiful new terminal with excellent check in security and facilities very impressed

First time from and to the new A terminal Didnt believe it but everything worked excellently No queues at checkin security passport control customs Bus gate had enough lift capacity so went down without wait On arrival baggage was on the belt in minutes and then in minutes off the airport Again no wait at immigration Food choices are fine both airside and landside Take into account this is just minutes some km from downtown Good choice and far superior to overcrowded Borispol with long queues dingy terminals and km from the city centre
Clean efficient airport small but with nice stores A variety of airlines and it is never busy

Loved it Takes no more than minutes from entering to get to the gate When you depart minutes It was like heaven compared to Toronto where there are long lines lots of computers and where it takes so long to get to the gate and where you dread the lineups getting off the plane for the same reason It is convenient it is quick clean and has a Tim Hortons

LimaCuscoLima Lima La Paz and JuliacaLima modern planes punctual and well organized good web checkin Although the seat pitch on the Peru domestic flights was acceptable the pitch on the international Lima to La Paz flight was so narrow that I couldnt even open my laptop and it was a very expensive flight Also long queues are to be expected for the morning flights in Lima and Cusco Lan used the web checkin as a way to reduce their staff not as a way to increase the speed of the checkin however they will call the passengers for the flights which takeoff shortly Snacks for the domestic flights are also of the cheapest sort and they only serve orange juice no apple no tomato nothing As a conclusion LAN Peru is well organized and provides punctual and efficient service but they definitively are on a profit spree enjoying their monopoly to cut some corners without fear or shame while charging quite high prices

I have been to many many airports all over the world and Little Rock is one of my favorites It is small but modern and clean There are never long lines and the personnel are always helpful and friendly After being away from home for months I always look forward to the simplicity and comfort of LR airport I like that baggage claim is after you meet up with the people waiting to get you as well

Phnom Penh to Siem Reap The check in was fast and the staff friendly The departure arrival were punctual and the aircraft made an average good maintained impression The seat distance was sufficiently good Despite the short flight there was a small bite and water Overall a good experience

Arrival was a very good experience as the new airport layout is a great improvement Departure was problematic I have always used Brussels Airlines which allows you to check in a dedicated facility in the city This time I was with Kenya Airlines and the check in process was chaotic with only one small kiosk and many people with no idea of a queue trying to check in Once through into the departure lounge things improved greatly and the business class lounge was a revelation comfortable air conditioned and well appointed

Thessaloniki to Athens I was pleasantly surprised by the service on this short flight approx min Service was quick good selection of drinks and small candies and biscuits Friendly staff aircraft was clean The crew are ready to assist the passengers I will be happy to fly them again

Our flight from Auckland was late leaving due to bad weather We arrived at the REX counter in Melbourne flustered and tired The check in for baggage had just closed but Thomas came to our rescue He checked if our baggage could still be checked in escorted us through security down to the REX gate arriving with minutes to spare before the flight was called With out Thomas we would never have made it he went over and beyond to ensure we were able to make the flight Thomas is a credit to himself and REX The cabin crew had no idea we were weary travellers We were greeted warmly and genuinely thankful to have made the flight for home To the REX staff thank you This is why we always fly REX

Smooth arrival domestic in the new airport It is the only airport that I have arrived at that there is actually free onwards buses to most of the tourist resorts north of the airport about every five minutes I did not know about this free service but if passengers have lots of luggage they need to be mindful that it could be a long haul from the bus stop in their resort to their actual hotel I took a taxi from one of the three or four tax agencies outside arrivals they were actually half the price of taxihailing apps There were some nice airy restaurants in the arrival area and presumably these are available to departing passengers Five stars from me

In the UK it is pretty difficult to get a fullservice airline offering direct flights to anywhere except Heathrow or Gatwick The socalled lowcost carriers dominate Having flown the competition we reluctantly tried Jet for our flights to and from Madeira In many ways Jet proved to be a long rung above the competition kg of checked luggage and kg of hand luggage plus a handbag or laptop bag are included as standard The seats are as you would expect on this type of airline minimalist The cabin crew were friendly and the drinks and food onboard appeared to be reasonably priced I cannot vouch for the quality of the hot or cold food as we did not try it Flights out and back were on time and boarding was smooth and efficient

Estonian Air TallinnCopenhagen June Flew Tallinn Copenhagen in flex class premium economy which means free meal and bar service kgs of luggage and flexibility to change tickets The food consisted of smoked salmon on a slice of bread a small but fresh salad and an appetizing Sacher cake Not too much but enough for the hr minute flight Swift boarding and disembarkation aircraft clean and fresh newspapers available friendly staff clear safety announcements over good audio system and interesting inflight magazine to while the time away Estonian Air is a small and pleasant regional airline

We travelled on Air Namibia after our travel company arranged substitute flights to Victoria Falls due to our Virgin Atlantic plane being delayed from London resulting in us missing our connection Virgin were very unhelpful offering a new flight days later The trip with Air Namibia was excellent from start to finish The crew were very friendly on board the food was nice When we landed at Windhoek the ground staff were very helpful ensuring our bags continued the journey and we were kept informed

Firstly poor info there is no airport mapplan nowhere on internet let alone on their web site The good info should also include that the trolleybus minibus works from till So the airport is OK and the queuing times are good At the arrival one waits up tp some min if there are no other planes passengers coming The taxi people are annoying but bearable The airport is practically in the outskirts suburbia and well communicated by minibus also one can walk some min to the nearest tram line if they wished trams work till There is a kiosk with food and drinks plus a freezer with icecream Several exchange offices rates are a bit worse than those of the city centre vs per euro No shopping in departures is rather a pleasant surprise
