I must say that in my experience the staff at the security check are doing a great job I was flying back to Moscow from Yerevan on Tuesday th October The staff were very welcoming polite and helpful Moreover while passing the security check I realized that I lost my cross the thread on which it hung was torn and after passing the security check I informed the security staff about it They were very helpful and helped me find my lost cross

Excellent little airport A bit tired cosmetically but everyone was friendly and everything worked seamlessly Dont rush through security unless youre desperate to look at aeroplanes as theres not much else to do Theres a little smoking box that takes people after security next to gate upstairs Its free and the ventilation works well

A small easily accessible airport with good seating no long walks to gates and helpful staff There is the usual choice of shops and a caf serving a variety of snacks including regional specialities The airport is clean and well signed

Arrival was a very good experience as the new airport layout is a great improvement Departure was problematic I have always used Brussels Airlines which allows you to check in a dedicated facility in the city This time I was with Kenya Airlines and the check in process was chaotic with only one small kiosk and many people with no idea of a queue trying to check in Once through into the departure lounge things improved greatly and the business class lounge was a revelation comfortable air conditioned and well appointed

Sukhothai Airport owned by Bangkok Boutique Airlines is a great little secret gem not to be missed Due to its size you feel like a celebrity A flower festooned approach greeted by security officers in their shorts and old colonial hats checking in outdoors the open feel the gardens water dripping from the roof to keep customers cool The check in staff all line up and wai you to send you off and the ground staff at the aircraft do the same Priority boarding for monks of course Exotic and fabulous with the usual Bangkok Airlines free drinks and snacks

Brussels to Eskisehir with Tailwind Airlines Nice flight The crew was okay the plane was outdated The food was okay too not free or included though There wasnt any kind of inflight entertainment Great if you dont want WiFi connection or when you dont want to know where you are

The airport of Yangon was very clean with good airconditioning the queue for the visa was not long so it was fast the belt with the bags was easy to find Good impression when you arrive Has also a really good conection with bus to the city center

The flight was a bit late departing from Gaya but I wondered if we would even fly given the dense fog The flight was beautiful scenic in a half empty cabin with cleanest and beautiful interior The crew distributed snacks and drinks quickly and we could enjoy our view Everything was really nice and their flight magazine is informative of the country and sites A really beautiful experience

Dusseldorf to Paris CDG return on Embraer E jets The plane was very clean x configuration as standard with extremely wide seats I am cm on pounds and the seats were wide and long enough for my legs There was enough leg space including space for luggage below the seat Some people had trouble finding space for their luggage overhead but that is a problem on regional jets Shortly after takeoff the first round of drinks was served water and coffee without charge On the next run through about minutes later we got pretzels and salted peanuts Overall I am impressed by HOP and would recommend it Great staff outstanding service and a very pleasurable seating experience make it the perfect option for short trips

CDGTIPOUA out ABJTIPCDG return Excellent flight to TIP clean new A with good food and friendly staff Flight to OUA similarly well presented Unfortunately the flight from ABJTIP was operated by Nouvelair on Afriqiyahs behalf other passengers also noticed the difference with grumpy staff and terrible food Happy to return to CDG with Afriqiyah again and more good service

We flew from Minsk to London on Jan MSQ has been refurbished following the hockey world cup one year ago ish Check in area is bright and efficient There is even a nice play area for children Signage is generally clear and in two languages The terminal is very clean Arrival was also smooth and passport control was quick Security was reasonably fast as it was passport control Gates as the lounge at the upper floor have not been renovated thus still look a bit obsolete there are few shops with prices in Euros and few bars for the last cuppa before flying off there are not many seats by the gate meaning that it might be difficult to find a seat if two flights are departing simultaneously from two adjacent gates Overall a good airport

Wattay International Airport in Vientiane is a simple and pleasant airport Perhaps the ease of travel is due to its tiny size at any given time there will only be a couple of flights on the docket so checking in for your flight is very quick One does not need to arrive too far in advance of their flight The departure terminal contains decent seating with a couple of large televisions they were showing muay thai boxing when I was last there The arrival experience is also positive with a reasonably short visa on arrival line and pretty relaxed officials eliminating a potential source of stress on the final leg of ones trip My favorite aspect of this airport is the walkway between the plane and the gate It is elevated and fully exposed to the outdoors so that travelers get a blast of fresh warm air to set the tone for their stay in Laos

I flew from Kerry to go to Alicante ALC and back Parking is not far from the terminal When you go in the door the toilets cafe and checkin area are very close Internet was fast and easy to connect to Toilets were clean enough The caf has good food and there are two vending machines before you go into departures It is a short walk to departures and security is not that long There is two boarding gates with a small gift shop Boarding went through very quick and the flight arrived minutes early We arrived back after ten days and we were early again which was great There is only one baggage belt and it can get very crowded Very satisfied with the airport and the experience
Milan Bergamo to Tirana Lot of comfort reclining seat big leg space cheap food prices on board cabin crew very professional Flight on time

The airport itself is tidy and seems pleasant Being a solo traveler with hidden disabilities I am very pleased with the staff who were able to assist me They were helpful and kind So far on my departures the ques havent been too long a wait or crazy timely manner in my experience Look forward to coming back again as Im a frequent flyer to this airport

Airport on Arrival no problem We hired a car and having found the car hire desk we were directed to the car pick up point which turned out to be a considerable distance away No shuttle service You just have to leg it If it had been raining we would have been soaked Cant imagine what it must be like for people in wheelchairs or families with pushchairs plus luggage Car hire needs to be closer to the terminal or shuttle service provided Departure was not good We had to leave our bags to be scanned go to the other side for Security check which meant leaving our bags and personal belongings unattended When called for our flight we were herded into a holding pen not enough seats stood for minutes while members of staff called out peoples names to re check their flight details this was done in a very unfriendly and unapologetic manner Took the shine off what had otherwise been a very pleasant trip to this beautiful island

Graz is an excellent small airport which has expanded in the last few years and now sees scheduled flights to as far as Luxor as well as German and Austrian destinations plus the UK with Ryanair They have the best answer yet seen to long security queues they immediately open another scanner when the queues build up again yet another sometyhing some of the bigger airports would do well to emulate A good restaurant is available although once passing through security snacks and drinks are all that is available They also prove that Priority Boarding can work with buses being used with Priority Boarding passengers be directed to one bus which goes to the aircraft first Only when those people have boarded do any other buses leave for the plane The train service has improved greatly over the last couple of years although still sparse on Sundays with at least an hourly service into Graz Staff always seem to be very friendly as well based on around a dozen trips through there in the last two years
Check in was easy as was boarding Staff coped well on a flight that was completely full The departure was punctual and the staff were efficient and helpful Overall a pleasant experience

The service was good everything that I ordered came in a minute or less and all my needs were attended to Free snacks of hot fudge and tea Fast and there were no delays not late for take off or landing Really recommend thanks for a great flight I am really happy

Return leg was an older model configured in Business about half full Actually the seating is better than the configuration as you have more feet room Food was really good especially the Salmon Cod and Prawn ceviche a true delight The bed was comfortable and the service attentive movie choice the same as going out days previous One criticism is that priority bags do not come out first I awaited mins for my bag to arrive and nearly missed my connection although arriving at and a departure on next flight at The second leg on older plane entertainment system not working at all Breakfast and service was good arrived on time and again no priority bags first This is one area they need to work on Hence Ground service only star

Glacier Park International Airport FCA in Montana USA is the best small regional airport I have visited After a very long journey from Sydney we were cleared very fast What impressed us was the security guard who stands on arrival exit door greeted us with a big smile and sad welcome to Montana On our return flights we were checked in very fast cleared very fast with smiles by TSA what a difference after LAXTSA The terminal and toliets are very clean

There is also an excellent restaurant on the mezzanine floor overlooking the runway It opens at noon which gives adequate time for a good lunch before the departure of the Luton flight at Information on bus transportation to and within Nimes is at httpwwwtcnfr

The airport and their airlines offer a wide range of European and North African leisure destinations but also large German cities such as Frankfurt or Munich Nice little shops and restauantscafes Staff are very friendly and the waiting times as well as the walking times are unbeatable Love flying fromto the Airport

I travelled from Coventry to Naples this year and found the airport limited but satisfactory The checkin area reminded me of the old days with cardboard flight destination signs and this was an area that could be easily changed for the better The lines crossed each other to the destinations and did cause some friction between customers The car parking was an experience but again was satisfactory I do not understand why the local bus companies especially those going to Leamington Stratford do not call in On returning the baggage was certainly a LOT better than Birmingham so a plus there In the departure lounge there was a good choice of food and drink at great prices no rip off here Also a small point The newspapers were out and available from about Birmingham they are still under wraps at Good value and friendly Hope they get permission for the bigger one soon

That airport is very close to downtown Puerto Princessa and is located around a green area Airport looks quite new and it was efficient to use Got my luggage within minutes Check in was also efficient There are some souvenir shops in departure hall and some simple food stalls After security check you find a waiting hall on second level is a coffee bar and a food stall in the departure level some shops which are not too expensive Overall a no thrills airport which is easy to use in all regards Free Wifi available

Its a small airport at an island abt km from Rijeka Checking in and out goes quite fast at our experience Some staff members in the shop are kind of grumpy Nevertheless we are very happy with this airport how they have arranged a hotel in Opatija for our group when our flight was cancelled all of a sudden in the evening Our flight company Transavia told some people to find and book by themselves a hotel but the airport arranged bus transport and a luxurious hotel so our compliments

Flying from Cape Town to Dublin to attend a conference and later return to Chicago from there I was looking forward to my first chance to check out Hamad Doha Airport Qatar Airways was fine except we arrived late in Doha We had to take a crowded bus to the terminal and it took over a half hour There were traffic jams on the tarmac I then had to run a long way through jammed concourses and just made my connection to Dublin On the way I saw crowds of people a bunch of luxury stores and chain eateries and some trees and plantings in one area Color me unimpressed

Though it is small it is one of the best efficient and beautifully designed international airports in the Philippines Been using it when I am visiting for business and leisure and Im not disappointed everytime I used this airport I do hope the government will expand this soon

Jashore to Dhaka A not wellknown domestic airline in Bangladesh The flight was late but we did get to our destination in a straight flight with no circling around Being a short flight the cabin service was basic but adequate Not a bad airline

I have arrived with pretty bad expectations after reading the reviews here but every single person was so kind to me that I had to come back to leave a positive review Absolute pleasant surprise correct exchange rates that Im not used to clean easy to navigate staff super kind and respectful I am happy that my experience was different from others

I booked London Mexico City London Business Class tickets Outgoing flight gave us access to the Virgin lounge at Heathrow and it was excellent Return flight had problems could not check in or select meal online using iPad their website only works on Microsoft Though in transit I had to go through immigration baggage reclaim and security before handing back my luggage to be loaded on the flight home Refused admittance to their Heineken lounge because I presented more than hours early just arrived on their flight from Cuba Lounge was noisy cramped and spartan when I did get in But flight was good

Once again I booked with LAM Air Mozambique although this time the flight was operated by the South African carrier CEMAIR It was actually a pleasant surprise as I found the crew to be very friendly professional and concerned about keeping us informed and safe throughout the journey The flight was short and was operated by a Canadair CRJ which is a secondhand aircraft most likely purchased from Lufthansa as some of the information was written in German The carryon space is very limited and I had to place my backpack under my seat as I would have to check it in They provided a snack box for free The flight was very quick and basic If I ever fly to South Africa again I would give CEMAIR a chance

Flying from Saint Petersburg to Prague Rossiya is providing an excellent service punctuality in time Professional cabin crew working so hard they accept Aeroflot points highly recommended I believe the company should be at least categorized as a Star airline

This airport has frequent JR rail connections to Sapporo making it very convenient Huge shopping area and many places to eat and drink Support staff was very friendly and helped me make a free Wifi connection as well as find me a restaurant that serves vegetarian food

I hope Boutique Air continues this service to altoona I have been able to get my mother who lives in Altoona back and forth to Pittsburgh for medical treatment and advanced care she needs The drive to Pittsburgh is atrocious and I hope boutique continues this route for a very long time A total life saver and an awesome experience Out of about flights i have taken only have been delayed and very short about minutes or so Their customer service is outstanding and always so friendly
The pleasant experience of arriving and departure in Shannon Airport was above all else Efficiency professionalism courteous Dublin needs to take a look and see how its done Well done Shannon

Lovely airport amazing views of the Alps Checkin was ok Wizz airline desks were poorly managed with long ques but the rest of the airlines seemed fine and so was security Shops were a bit lacking but overall a good airport

Used this airport recently It is nice and efficient Managed to retrieved luggage within mins There are about belts at the arrival hall We booked a taxi at the taxi counter for M for our min journey to the hotel At Langkawi there is no meter in the taxi they offer fixed prices unlike KL Check in at Air Asia counter fro flights to KL was quick Passed through immigrations within minutes They offer an only lady immigration as well Plenty of Arabs in the airport and was told that it was their peak holidays season There is a number of shops and food outlets Overall its a nice airport
Very good airport Satisfied with all aspects of airport Best airport in Kerala Lots of new shops are opening on the airport I am sure this airport will make to top airports in India

The Narita Express train from Tokyo is an excellent means of getting to the airport and comes straight in to the terminal Narita airport was rather quiet when we travelled though it so maybe we were lucky as there were no queues at all in security nor immigration Plenty of shops for last minute gifts The terminal is light and airy and everything well signposted More than happy with our experience

Nice to Rome was only CAD total compared to other airlines charging close to per person for the same route We did expect to be a baggage fee as they charge you Euros per kg over kg but pleasantly surprised to only be charged an additional Euros total Plane clean staff were very nice The reason everyone lines up hour before the flight we didnt figure this out until too late is because seating is not assigned That being said our seats were fine and flight was great Only complaint was that the flight was hours late in arriving In their defence they had emailed our home email address a day or so before to notify us but we didnt have access to our home email so didnt find out until we arrived at the airport
I found very good customer service by each and every worker at the airport whom we dealt with Wifi facilities were excellent with no interruptions Overall it passes the required tests

An unexpectedly pleasant experience The booking process was a bit odd but after using several different credit cards one finally worked on the airline website for a ticket about euros less than any other airline Check in and boarding was smooth Two suitcases allowed at kg each Or one at a maximum of kg There was entertainment with several English language recent films Ample food provided The layover was fine No one was saying anything about not taking photos and it wasnt any more different than transferring in China Seemed the duty free shops take card now too

I arrived at T Terminal Hongqiao Used the Sky Priority Customer Service Lovely helpful staff who helped me with my oversized baggage I was stressed about it and the team helped me without a problem Then even showed me clearly were to go as well as showing me were Sky Priority Lounge was I couldnt be more grateful for their good service

Very nice small airport easy check in with friendly staff Plenty of seating in the airport with small selection of shops and restaurants and bars Parking for cars very close to terminal and with plenty of spaces Easy access to main roads when you leave the airport Baggage reclaim very quick A pleasure to arrive at this airport

While I found the Jacksonville airport to be very clean with exceptionally friendly professional employees my review is regarding one in particular His name is Alejandro a wheelchair provider for people departing and arriving at the airport I first met him on October when I arrived at JAX He was prompt friendly and a very nice person Well when I left JAX I ran into Alejandro again and he recognized me after a week and all the people hed met He was so pleasant I have required wheelchair assistance when traveling for over years and Alejandro is hands down the best

Amsterdam to Heraklion Low cost budget airline in our case chartered by Neckermann Tickets were very cheap but the service not Good service departure on time friendly personnel Seating tight but thats the trade off for cheap tickets Airplane registered in Germany so safety and maintenance should be ok We had no issues whatsoever

On arriving travelling with my Trini wife and child I was met with a substantial queue to immigration There was this very empathic and helpful immigration lady ushering people along She saw our plight along with other families with children and expedited our movement through immigration On return at check in this positive attitude to assisting passengers was also evident with the handling clerk we also had an internal Caribbean flight during our stay and the check in staff was exceptionally helpful as we had left an important document at our accommodation and had to get a copy whatsapped over My only criticism is the system whereby a trolley is available free from the baggage area but you are only permitted to use it as far as the entranceexit to the airport after which one must either carry your baggage to the transport or pay a trolley porter US to move your baggage perhaps meters Its nice that in the Departure Lounge one can obtain such essentials as Royal Castle Pepper Sauce and Mudder in Law Chadon Benni pepper sauce It would have been nice to see a fast food outlet in the departure lounge itself though some people had little difficulty bringing food through from the food court by the entrance Security was efficient no issues there Loud speaker announcements were entirely incomprehensible and impossible to understand this must be a trait in airports

Stockholm Bromma to Malm Sturup Very friendly cabin crew and good service This is the only airline in Sweden that serve free meals during domestic flights The plane were clean and the seats were of standard model I will fly with Malm Aviation whenever I go to Stockholm again Best domestic airline so far

It is absolutely unfair to give only one star to this airline the Tupolev plane is in good condition and perfectly clean the crew are efficient pleasant and helpful and last but not least it is always on time you can find many airlines much worse than that for instance Air China on the same route The route flown is the no route of Air Koryo linking DPRK to Beijing and this entitles you to some patriotic videos on the overhead screen The buns served are not too bad and drinks are acceptable for such a small trip All in all a good experience

Took a trip recently travelling from Sydney to Melbourne on Rex Airlines new intercity jet service It was a chance to test out their new service having many years ago flown on a regional flight to a country NSW town A couple of standouts were immediately obvious starting with the check in staff and process at Terminal in Sydney Not only were the kiosks easy to use for check in but on proceeding to the desk for bag drop the staff were very friendly and helpful On board the planes have good legroom and it was nice although a short flight to at least get a snack and cup of coffee Then on the return leg had to change my flight to an earlier time and again the service stood out The call centre reservations staff member was delightful There was no robot at the end of the phone and they cared about helping make changes Everything about the experience really was good old fashioned country service with a smile It really sets them apart from their competitors

We have been using this airport several times a year for the last ten years Over the years the facilities have progressed From a field for a car park to a proper hard standing area with security The terminal is up to scratch for a small airport generally very clean with all facilities We particularly like the short walk from the arrivals entrance through security to the gate Announcements are clear and there are plenty of arrivaldeparture screens We dont use cafes or shops in any airport but they look to be appropriate for the size of the airport Car hire and baggage reclaim very easy Plenty of taxis usually outside but can be a queue at peak times This is our favourite airport hate Alicante and Gatwick

I would like to write about the splendid service given to me my spouse by Air Asia AK Kuala Lumpur to Denpasar on Friday Im so proud to mention about these two cabin crew Ms Camelia Mr Amirul Their love and care is still lingering in our mind Kudos to Air Asia to have them in their crew family Our most sincerest gratitude Love you guys a lot our best wishes in your future

Chiang Mai to Khon Kaen with Kan Air A small but very efficient airline ATR very clean ground staff did a great job and the biggest surprise options between fish and chicken meal with rice for a minute flight with rounds of drinks I choose this airline as the fastest way to go from Korat airport closed to Chiang Mai via Khon Kaen to avoid a hour bus ride As for the price this was half than a bus ticket to Chiang Mai Excellent

It was the cheapest way to go back after yet another season in Asia and honestly I didnt expect too much But the plane was quite new and the cabin was in a good condition Departed on time unlike the connecting domestic flight by another airline before There was an inflight entertainment system available and it seems to be modern but after a night spent in two different airports I hardly used it for anything other than the D map Although the food was served not as elegantly as some airlines do it was quite delicious and I could choose what I preferred on both meals despite sitting not in the middle of the cabin Note that there are only soft drinks available but for me it doesnt really matter The seats are not exactly Emirateslike but still quite comfortable for an hours flight The headphones were usual cheap earbuds unfortunately but they also included an adapter which I took away and which will let me plug in my own headphones on some later flight great and I just dont understand why airlines besides those smart few who provide multiuse washablecup large headphones couldnt distribute just that on request rather than generating tons of cheap headphones waste The flight was smooth and arrived minutes early Definitely would fly Tianjin Airlines again if the price is right and the route will fit my plans and will stop at Chongqing or Tianjin where I havent been yet as well should I have time for that

Booked gulf air business class UK to China RT not bad last minute About h each way inclusive of layover Cabin is very quiet probably about full Service is ok but nothing to get excited about I unfortunately got woken up for food service despite do not disturb light on theres no lie flat seat cover which makes the lie flat a little bumpy The amenity kit is fine but nothing to get too thrilled over they do not have pyjamas any more which was a shame as I was very looking forward to sleeping in clean clothes on the second overnight leg of my long flight Lounge in Bahrain is good nice food options although they could do with more comfortable seating Airplane food was fine but again nothing thrilling or very tasty I ended up skipping a couple meals just out of lack of interest in the options provided Meant to be a dine anytime service but if you ask for food outside of the service the staff look very irritated I asked for an extra sandwich during the tea service Id slept through breakfast and was told no by the attendant despite the cabin being very quiet and food definitely being tossed given wouldnt be finished Overall value isnt bad for the price youre paying as other airlines would be many multiples more but there certainly could be improvements thatd make it a much more premium experience Cabin WiFi does not work at all Recommend if youre looking for a budget lie flat seat Beyond the seat may not be worth it for those who prefer a premium experience there are better Middle Eastern airlines
I live here and fly regularly New terminals are open airy and plenty of seating Limited but appropriate shopping Nice caferestaurant selection for a small airport Security swift and courteous

Manila to Kalibo I am a frequent flier of AirAsia I am always happy with the service that I am getting Staff are really friendly This is a short trip to fulfil a holiday and fantastic service The best part is being able to sit within the exit row without paying for this

Mid size airport with Indian standard with connectivity to most big cities in India after covid no international flight For arrival its easy to use we arrives at baggage hall and same hall have a prepaid taxi counter and a snack shop and a liquor shop Toilets were clean and also the terminal looks clean plenty of baggage trolleys also have paid porter facility Cabs are available book through their kiosk and avoid taking from touts outside It is situated within the city so if travelling light may walk towards outside and get auto that would be cheapest option to travel Ola Uber also available

I arrived from Phnom Penh and then departed to Bangkok On arrival at the domestic airport there was no air bridge and it was a very short walk to the main building It took a while for the luggage to come out but luckily the arrival area was not crowded Departed from the international terminal to Bangkok The terminal was new and clean and check in staff very friendly and helpful There was only one security line open but the queue wasnt too long After security there were few shops and a great Plaza Premium Lounge if you fly Bangkok Airways they also offer their own lounge The Plaza Premium lounge was quiet well design and spacious Overall a great and smooth departure experience

My son was travelling on Kids Solo as an unaccompanied Minor with a h stop over in Paris The departure from Dublin was delayed by hour The agents Mustafa and Laura at the check in counter went out of their way to arrange a new flight with KLM arriving half an hour earlier than the original flight They were extremely helpful and understanding We were very impressed with their professional approach and excellent customer service

I fly weekly for work and Gerald R Ford Intl Airport in Grand Rapids is one of my two homebase airports Its served by American Delta United Southwest and Allegiant and has nonstop flights to twentysomething destinations I primarily fly American and mostly take flights that connect through Chicago OHare or DallasFort Worth GRR is a larger regional airport with two concourses of gates each but not a large airport by any means I can park in the garage walk in clear security TSA PreCheck and walk to my gate within minutes of driving into the garage I love that kind of convenience Employees are friendly and helpful pretty much across the board at the airline counters security and at the gates GRR recently finished a fairly large renovation in late They now have one central security checkpoint and a central area with new shopping and dining including a local brewpub Starbucks and a Michiganthemed souvenir shop There are also new lounge areas childrens play area and a business center not to mention new large restrooms In general GRR operates on time which is key for me Most delays Ive experienced have come from aircraft delayed at their originating airport mostly OHare Im basically comfortable relying on this airport for my weekly business travel needs

Belfast to Bourgas We were checked in at Belfast international we walked through check out and still had approximately another minute wait on the steps downstairs before the shuttle busses came to get us not very safe or the best place to be waiting a long time with young children The flight over was fine but for some reason even though I booked certain seats over and back they did not show up when collecting our tickets they were very helpful and allocated us the same seats in Belfast but coming back from Bulgaria the seats we requested were given to someone else Staff on the flights to and from Bourgas were lovely But getting back into Belfast after getting through the security checks we went to get our bags and we were waiting at the baggage claim area almost an hour before bags started coming out everyone actually clapped when they started arriving very slowly one at at time for the first mins again not very convenient with tired young children starting to get impatient I honestly dont think well fly with BH Air again or recommend them

The airport is functional and adequate for a shortish stay But it is unbelievably expensive There is a simple measure for this Terminal Heathrow The Perfectionists Cafe Heston Blumenthal proud holder of a few Michelin stars food delivered by friendly waiter etc Burger San Jose airport Smashburger fast food burger in plastic tray And sadly that sums up too many experiences in Costa Rica I spend a lot of time here and the feeling that everything is horribly overpriced just grows and grows The airport is a good example of that feeling they are abusing their visitors

I flew into Kasane International Airport onboard Mack Air a Botswanan bush airline that principally services safari lodges in the Okavango Delta area Kasane boasts a nice new and pleasant airport in spite of it seeing much more than people arriving to go to or from various safari lodges Passangers walk from the airplane into the baggage claim area which though not large is efficient and is air conditioned As we did not require an immigration or customs inspection passengers moved directly from the baggage claim area into the main terminal hall This too is very nice air conditioned clean and pleasant and transportation services are available Airport staff are friendly and there is a small shop where one can buy snacks and drinks Though small and not very busy Kasanes airport is a pleasant surprise and is from all I can tell efficient clean and staffed with pleasant and helpful folk

Leipzig airport is a new modern airport but not very user friendly A major advance is the direct train connection right underneath but the layout is an odd one After check in the passenger has to walk a long distance to the security and passport control This can be a headache of you have to stamp your papers for VAT tax refund as you need to show it to customs It is located at one end and the check in at the other end Good facilities present and staff are very friendly and polite even though not very conversant in English

Checkin at Cairo went smoothly Both flights on time First sector to Bahrain on a very full A Cabin crew did an excellent job Transit in Bahrain was easy Second sector to Singapore on a which had plenty of spare seats allowing passengers to spread out after takeoff Good meal service and very attentive cabin crew Would definitely recommend

Bagan to Heho Very short flight again another ATR aircraft as a nervous passenger I was not looking forward to the flight but it was great Seating was no seat numbers given as only a few passengers on this flight No Inflight snack but coffee or cold drinks were supplied All in all a good flight and would travel again

Fly or times a year Mexico City to Ciudad Victoria Planes are small Fokker Turboprops Always very friendly staff and have been on time Seats are rather small an excellent lounge with drinks and snacks at a number of airports Service onboard with snacks and drinks are adequate

I recently had the opportunity to experience the new terminal at Kempegowda International Airport in Bangalore and I must say it is a remarkable addition to the citys infrastructure Design and Ambiance The terminal boasts a stunning architectural design that blends modern aesthetics with traditional Indian elements The spacious layout is filled with natural light thanks to large glass facades The use of local materials in the design adds a unique touch making the environment both inviting and reflective of Karnatakas heritage Facilities One of the standout features of the new terminal is its stateoftheart facilities From efficient checkin counters to wellorganized security checks the entire process felt streamlined and userfriendly The wide range of shopping and dining options is impressive offering everything from local delicacies to international brands I particularly enjoyed the curated selection of souvenirs that showcase local artisans Technology The incorporation of technology is commendable Free WiFi charging stations and selfcheckin kiosks make the travel experience more convenient The digital displays for flight information are clear and easy to navigate which is essential in such a busy hub Sustainability What truly sets this airport apart is its commitment to sustainability The use of rainwater harvesting systems and solar energy reflects a forwardthinking approach to airport management which is vital in todays context of climate change Accessibility The airport is wellconnected with ample transportation options including taxis buses and ridesharing services The ease of access from the city makes it a practical choice for travelers Overall Impression In summary the new terminal at Kempegowda International Airport is a remarkable blend of modernity functionality and cultural resonance It elevates the travel experience and sets a high standard for airports in India Whether youre a frequent flyer or just passing through this airport is a pleasant surprise that showcases the best of Bangalore

Arrival was great I was at passport control within minutes of landing On the way back it was another story I couldnt do the online check in and I found out at the airport that its not provided when you fly from Bergerac You have to queue with everybody in order to get your boarding pass even if you only have hand luggage Ground personnel very slow until the call was made to invite people for boarding They then suddenly were very quick The toilets arent provided with coat or handbag hangers which I find not practical

Sharm El Sheikh to Amman It was my first time taking Jordan Aviation flight not by choice but that was what my travel agent had chartered and really had no choice but to go on a Jordan Aviation flight I was a bit worried about aircraft age delays unattentative and confused staff and not least expected commotion during a busy season Eid holidays when aircraft could very easily be overbooked delayed and anything that can come to your mind But hey surprise surpriseas an avid aviation enthusiast and frequent flyer and an aviation insurance professional I was pleasantly impressed The aircraft was an older Aircraft was clean comfortable leather seats that could recline the only down side is it needed a bit of wiping of the front trays and the windows which were really smudged the toilets were clean and very much acceptable knowing that this aircraft was a workhorse doing the Sharm Amman flights nonstop to daily flights during a very busy season Great and friendly ticketground staff Easy check in As an avid aviation enthusiastprofessional I pay special attention to anything that seems not quite right Cockpit and cabin crew very professional with smiles Equal to or better than similar carriers and must say National flag carriers On time I lost a piece of luggage on arrival Jordan Aviation staff came to me quickly and assisted me until I found my lost bag I was grateful for his help He did this with a constant and reassuring smile The negative Front trays and back seats need a good wipe The windows too I will not hesitate taking a JAV flight again Seems to me like a well run airline My flight from Amman to Sharm ElSheikh on the th of August was equally good and can replicate was has been said above aircraft JYJAP a Boeing Absolutely no issues Summary No unpleasant surprises I was travelling with my wife and kids and did not want any unpleasant surprises Will fly Jordan Aviation again for sure Well done

The main airport of Armenia has been completely rebuilt and the old Soviet style one is no longer operating The new terminal is clean and modern dutyfree shopping is in abundance As most fights arrive at midnight border control takes at least min During covid times all boarding passes need to be printed so take extra time in mind Taxis easily overcharge dram should be more than enough Overall a good experience

Flew from CKGLHW on Sichuan Airlines a pleasant enough flight We used an airbridge in the older Terminal while the booking hall is now closed the baggage hall and arrivals remain the same for Terminal The high speed railway has been completed so I decided to catch the train to Lanzhou West railway station The train station is a short walk to the left from the exit of Terminal opposite Terminal There was only a short queue for tickets in the Ticket hall to the right of the station entrance about for First class on the very next train Travel time was about minutes All in all it was much better than slow airport bus and taxi options

City of Derry is a small regional airport however check in was very straight forward the Logan Air staff were very friendly The security process was a little over the top however it was fast There is a small cafe within the terminal and its servers drinks and snacks which was more than sufficient for the short wait prior to boarding the aircraft Boarding the flight was by seat number however this was orderly and efficient The flight from City of Derry to London takes just over hour The cabin crew are extremely friendly and provided some teacoffee and biscuits After landing the plane was parked in a remote apron however there was a bus to take us to the terminal upon arrival My luggage was also coming out of the carousal by the time we got to the terminal which meant I was on my way to next destination very quickly Overall this is a great service by Loganair from a regional airport

Long Beach is a great little airport It has the most efficient TSA checkpoint I have ever seen with the longest line ever being about three minutes and I fly through here quite often While the south concourse is the only gate area I have used I am sure the airport is the same throughout the terminal The staff is great and friendly and you can chat with everyone The gate numbering can be a bit confusing but so long as you dont immediately exit the terminal to the left you should be fine They even give you an umbrella when it rains to walk onto the plane

Used Hamilton Airport as an alternative airport to Toronto A much smaller airport than Pearson a good thing resulting in much less walking and waiting and much easier to get in and out of A great option if youre visiting Southern Ontario or Niagara Falls if you want to avoid the Toronto traffic and is km from downtown Toronto Not the greatest airport for public transit links to Hamilton and Toronto and beyond likely due to the airports small size Airport was slightly built on the cheap has exterior siding and drop celling interiors reminding me of a bus terminal and has very limited foodshopping options Despite these minor complaints overall a good alternative to Pearson for direct flights and would use it again

Stansted to Tivat Overall this is a decent airline The cabin staff speak English the plane although old is fine for a short hour flight and the journey was comfortable A few pointers only one of the toilets in the plane were working which was annoying there was a basic selection of drinks and a simple cheese sandwich we took off over hours late but it was unclear if this was the fault of the airline or the ground staff on this flight we arrived too late to land in Tivat it has no night facilities so we had to land in Podgorica They did in the end put a bus for all of us to reach Tivat although the delay was significant

The airport of Medan has been moved from Polonia to Kuala Namu International Airport KNIA KNIA is now the most advanced and the second largest airport in Indonesia It is also the first integrated airport rail link in Indonesia The whole area is free from smoke means that they provide and manage the smoking area well The baggage claim area is welldesigned Restrooms are always clean and have no pungent smell

Flew to Vagar Faroe Islands Smooth flight lasting hrs mins each way Flight attendants were friendly and efficient Seats comfortable and spacious adequate storage space for inflight luggage Free snacks served as well as alcoholic and nonalcoholic drinks

Very small old fashioned terminal nothing wrong with that as check in was a breeze All luggage checked and weighed together then put onto a trolley No computers everything written out including boarding cards Once checked in usual hand luggage screening and off into the small departure lounge Rows of plastic seat along with a few little shops selling the usual goodies from Myanmar and snacks A very good caf with great coffees and teas Usual badge so the staff know which flight you are on All very relaxed and you can watch the flights taking off and landing Toilets worth a miss

We had an enjoyable flight experience with AC Rouge The flight attendants on this crew worked very well together and demonstrated great cooperation and team work The crew was welcoming personable and professional In particular we enjoyed excellent service from Victoria and Heather

Efficient checkin Very simple and small meal for a hour flight with a stop over of another BrusselsMarsa Alam Unbearably limited legroom If you are over m impossible to sit Had to sit with my legs in the isle or stand Seats only recline cm so it feels you sit upright

The cabin crew on my recent Malaysia Airlines flight were exceptional During boarding the lead crew in red colour is standing at the gate to warmly welcome all passengers with a great smile the crew demonstrated a level of hospitality that exceeded my expectations The lead crew manager in particular stood out helping the team with economy class drink service even after finishing their duties in business class This showed impressive leadership and teamwork During the meal service the crew team carefully put ice in the cup They remember my request As the economy class toilet is full of passengers the lead crew member guides me to use the business class toilet The announcement is very clear with a warm feeling of hospitality in dual languages I ordered a special nonvegetarian meal on my flight and I was thoroughly impressed The chicken dish with Malaysian sauce was delicious I would rate the meal quality as starsThe boarding process is smooth and well organized The webcheck in is easy to use My flight is from Bangkok to Singapore via Kuala Lumpur I can get two digital boarding passes from digital checkin without any system issues The autocheckin feature is available too This aircraft does not have IFE as it is a hours mins short haul flight However all passengers can connect to MH studio by their own devices There are many entertainment selections from movies TVs The only reason I dont rate five star is to compare with Singapore Airlines Emirates and those global premium carriers that provide IFE for all flights However it is value for money for the level of entertainment I received I would not hesitate to fly with Malaysia Airlines again and would highly recommend the airline to others

Made three flights in a week with three different aircrafts The aircraft is clean and so are the toilets Decent food Comfortable seat No WiFi on the last flight The service on board is amazing All flights punctual Would fly them again anytime

Today traveled from Lahore to Karachi and a pleasant surprise For the first time I could see smiles on the faces of the cabin crew I asked one of the crew members for a coffee and she returned with a cup remembering my seat and not having me to remind her

Sharm el Sheikh to Dusseldorf When I got to the airport I found out that my flight was delayed by minutes I had asked the ground staff to please check my luggage through to Hamburg as I had a connecting flight with Eurowings from Dusseldorf The agent informed me that he could easily check me through but he would need the permission from Germania He wrote an email to them and so I had to wait about minutes until he had shown me their response The response stated that they had no agreement with Eurowings and that I would need to pick up my luggage and check it in with them again As the flight was already delayed by minutes I would miss my connecting flight in Dusseldorf to Hamburg When I had arrived in Dusseldorf I had found out that my luggage was not carried on my flight Lucky me my connecting flight was cancelled Theoretically the Ground Service does not even deserve a one star rating The Crew on the other side was very friendly and provided great service Seat on the aircraft was very comfortable and I had enough space for my legs as well

Sanya Phoenix Airport is a small and efficient airport serving mostly tourists going to the Hawaiianlike Yayong Bay resorts The airport is close to the city center with about minutes ride It takes about minutes to go to Yalong Bay Once you arrive at the airport it takes very short time to go to the exit gate But when you are exiting there are so many people there waiting for you especially the taxi drivers You have to negotiate the price before getting on the taxi To avoid any confusion you should contact your resort before coming to Sanya Most hotels would have their own hotel transportation at around yuans for Yalong Bay bound trip unless you are are local Chinese who knows about all the tricks Taxi drivers there are usually contract drivers They take you around the area for sightseeing and shopping It costs around yuans for a days tour Most of them are friendly people who just want to make a living Local transportation are almost nonexistence The city center is like a wartorned zone Instead of shopping around the main streets nothing to find anyway try to go inside the food market on the back streets I tried the noodles there yuan and they were tasty But personal security is a main concern When departing Sanya airport has a nice departure hall on the second floor It is well lighted with natural light The big plus is the nice shops there They sell many local items like the yellow chilli and coconut products Prices are only a bit more than the local market Those are very nice as the gift items Overall the airport itself is very clean and efficient The only draw back is the airport connections between the airport and the city center as well as the famous Yalong Bay If they can either open the routes for competition or set one up by the airport or the city itself it will make Sanya even a better resort designation

Landed at the newer of the two terminals Baggage collection was fast and was able to buy a phone card easily on the lower Arrivals level but telephones were only on the upper Departures level Security was tight with baggage tags checked by airport staff No illegal taxi touts hounding you and bus into the city was quick and easy On departing the airline waiting areas were large and comfortable The food in some places was cheap very cheap Same as supermarket price for bottle of Pepsi Had a gate change but was handled quickly and easily Efforts were made to keep me informed despite being the only foreigner on my flight New monorail will soon open from airport to city Airport taxi prices are not too expensive but be prepared for a wild and crazy ride

It makes my day to be served by caring thoughtful polite and lovely stewardess that hard to come by as far as SQ is concerned serving own homeland A great applaud to Natalie For the moment we step into the plane and settle down this lady greet us with broad smile I am so grateful of her coming to my rescue to help me ease my gastric by going the extra mile to get me biscuits and hot drinks when they are busy out of their normal routine and SOP Caring enough to come by to check on me that Im well When we ask for drinks that help to soothe my daughter vomiting other staff just cant help and said they cant do anything Here come our hero Natalie whom with her sincere thoughtfulness and care to fetch my daughter a hot peppermint tea which is not serve in economy class Hopefully the next round I will meet her again She deserve to be the one wearing green uniform Well done Natalie You are a role model for rest to follow

Yesterday I had a pleasant experience from Horizon two airline employees on the Horizon air turboprop that I flew from Missoula to Seatac I had a very short connection time to board an Alaska air flight to Charleston SC I flew this same itinerary MSO to SeaTac to CHS last year and because of airport construction and a long distance between two terminals I nearly missed my flight With this in mind I told the flight attendant named Kyle that I would need someone to help me get to the right terminal in time to make the flight I was quite anxious about it Kyle told me that the first officer agreed to escort me to the terminal as she had a three hour layover She not only made a smooth and soft landing with the plane but she also walked with me all the way to the plane I was to board Please let first officer Emilee know that she went above and beyond her job description She is a lovely person and goes out of her way to increase her customers comfort level I consider it a blessing to have walked beside first officer Emilee

This was my first time with Korean Air and I chose this return flight to travel to Hong Kong even though it was not the cheapest option We were extremely satisfied with Korean Air and the service they provided The cabin crew was amazing and the plane was very clean I would fly Korean Air again without any hesitation

This is a small airport Check in and security are painless Airside there are now gates There is floor to ceiling glass affording nice views of the Tetons There is plenty of comfortable seating in the gate area that would get high marks from the people at Sleeping In Airports You still have to walk on the tarmac to board your plane Sadly the food choices are unchanged from my last trip through That is my only complaint Still this is a very nice tertiary level airport As always be sure to book an F side window seat for your daytime flight in

Upon arrival in Rhodes a suitcase was delayed Indicated at the counter The handling was done very well We arrived on the next flight and were taken directly to our address Super The entire flight also went great Friendly professional staff Flying with Aegean is a relief Bij aankomst op Rhodos was er een koffer vertraagd Bij de balie aangegeven De afhandeling is super gedaan Met de volgende vlucht meegekomen en direct naar ons adres gebracht Super Ook de gehele vlucht was super verlopen Vriendelijk professioneel personeel Vliegen met Aegean is een verademing
It is a shame that the people at security do not speak English This is an international airport For the rest it is okay food is good and it is reasonably clean

First time arriving in this beautiful country together with wife for umrah Arrived by Malaysia Airlines A and departure with same aircraft Facilities well kept staff welcome us with a smile Easy flow for arriving and departing

Pensacola International is a terrific and convenient airport for the entire Emerald CoastPensacola Bay area Flights are rarely delayed airport staff are friendly and the terminal is clean and easy to navigate TSA lines are usually short and there is absolutely no need to fear for safety as the Pensacola Police Department TSA Escambia County Sheriffs Office and United States Military Police due to the extraordinary amount of military bases and armed forces personnel in the area all patrol the airport and its grounds Walking distance away from several hotels and recreation areas Only about a minute car or bus to Cordova Mall and Sacred Heart Medical Center As well as a ride to minute car or bus ride to downtown and a minute ride to Pensacola Beach depending on traffic on the Bay Bridge Being a local to the area I would also recommend taking the minute ride to NavarreNavarre Beach which is usually quieter with a healthy choice of restaurants and hotels and still a relatively convenient distance to the airport

I had not heard of Air KBZ before I made the booking for my Myanmar trip However all of the three domestic flights Mandalay to Thandwe Thandwe to Sittwe and Sittwe to Yangon went very well ontime arrivals food and beverages free of charge although the flights were short friendly staff modern and clean aircraft I would fly Air KBZ again in case I return to Myanmar

Check in at LHR T was quick and easy and minimal queue for security Business Class passengers on Malaysia Airlines have access to the Qatar Airways lounge which is excellent and we enjoyed a nice light breakfast before the flight Malaysia use A for the flight to KL and my wife and I had chosen seats D and G meaning that both seats have aisle access Malaysia Airlines cabin crew are some of the best in the industry and as always the service was very good The meal service starts with signature satays followed by smoked salmon for the main course I tried the Malaccanstyle seabass fillet very tasty An area where Malaysia Airlines could improve is in the inflight entertainment the choice of films is quite limited and well below the standard of airlines such as Emirates Flight arrival into KL was minutes ahead of schedule which left quite a long transfer time for our connection to Penang The Malaysia Airlines lounge in the domestic departures area is ok but can get very busy Our onward flight to Penang was on an B one of the upgraded aircraft with new business class seats and WiFi based entertainment system which you use with your own device We did not use this for such a short flight We were impressed with the service on this minute flight which included a small hot meal Arrival into Penang was on schedule and the bags were delivered promptly Overall a great couple of flights with Malaysia Airlines

Neos airline division of TUI Germany You can web checkin and you can change seat allocation without pay Plane arrived on time boarding and welcome was professional and crew was helping passengers with their carryons to be placed on bins New and clean aircraft service was great with two servings with tasty food and good variety of juices do not offer beverages but have wine coffee tea IFE is only drop screens to see the flight path and you can hear music from channels with earphones buy or your own
The cabin crew was amazing I forgot my earphones near the boarding gate and they found and delivered back to me The flight was LX on March nd Thanks again for a delightful trip

The airport itself is small and easily accessible The downside is the airport security staff The staff who greeted us first were pleasant and friendly but the ones conducting inspections and overseeing direct searches of people and luggage are gruff at best and grumpy at worst I think they need some training on how to be polite and respectful to passengers This isnt the first time that we experienced this kind of behaviour on the security line The washrooms are limited and in need of cleaning and an upgrade They could also use at least one area for passengers with pets so the animals can relieve themselves as seen in many other airports

Phoenix is the easiest of all major US airport to get in and out of I picked Phoenix as my home based in part because I needed a reliable airport considering how often I fly and PHX does not disappoint The new terminal is really excellent and the improved lounge situation at Terminal is really appreciated

Nauru to Pohnpei Small but friendly airline The seat configuration was and the legroom was OK for my ft frame No real inflight entertainment On the relatively shorthaul island hopping only snacks were served but there was beer and wine The best feature of this airline were the charming cabin crew clad in blue and I thought of them as Angels in Blue

Very quiet and peaceful airport well equipped with benches places to sit and even lie down It is not a large airport so the catering facilities with shops are small but sufficient Very nicely designed areas where you can sit and experience Finnish nature For the first time I see an airport where you can relax physically and mentally It is also a bit cold it perfectly reflects the climate of Finland It does not heat up excessively and there is a delicate chorus which can be annoying at first but after some time you get used to it

This is my home airport whilst small it has a basic array of services and amenities you would expect from a larger airport The terminal looks pretty fresh and is thoroughly modern There isnt much landside although there are a couple of shops and restaurants for basic needs The security areas move promptly and the transborder security is easy to get through because there arent that many US departures Once youre airside the domesticinternational area is quite good with a decent array of shops and restaurants This is a small airport so youre out of luck if youre hoping for luxury goods but you can find many of the basic items you might need The seating areas are bright with plenty of glass to let in the prairie sunshine There are two lounges including a small but comfortable Maple Leaf Lounge Transborder is a different story While its an improvement over the tiny TB area in the old terminal its still a very small space with only one restaurant TGI Fridays and a Tim Hortons kiosk that only sells coffee donuts and not much else Baggage claim runs efficiently although its not in a secure area which always makes me nervous Customs tends to process people quickly Transportation is easy with a good array of car rentals onsite and very convenient bus transportation downtown The airport is not that far from the city centre so a bus is actually a pretty good option Also there is free WiFi and washrooms are generally clean and well kept if somewhat small There are three airport hotels a short walk outside and at least two of them have restaurants All things considered Winnipeg Airport delivers what you would expect it to

ITO is absolutely lovely I flew in HNLITO and out ITOOGG Outdoor type airport and probably the most easytouse airport I have ever had the pleasure of using Very tropical theme Car rentals are right across the street from curbside pickup Checking in is very easy for those using Island Air There is a restaurant in the middle that gets very busy during breakfast so get there early if you dont want to stand in a line that goes out the door

I flew into and out of Moscow Sheremetyevo Airport in December for the first time and was quite impressed with arrivals and maybe a little less so with the departure process Arriving and clearing customs and security and getting bags was all pretty straight forward and easy enough and efficient Signage for me was great and easily navigated to the bag carousels and also found an ATM before exiting to take out some cash Plenty of food options once exiting and then I easily followed signs to the Aeroexpress train from the airport to Moscow Belorussky about a min walk through terminalI bought my train ticket online prior and scanned the barcode and all worked fineSo transport to and from the airport is easy on the way back I took a Yango ride and it pulled up easily right in front of terminal On the way departing security is pretty tight but to be expected you go through two screening stations and again check in pretty seamless except for the fact your Departure Terminal indicated on the board may not be the one you finally need to go to as I found out Ended up having a fairly decent walk from one terminal to another Once that finished then we headed to the aerobus as is common in Europe to be driven to the plane waited for about mins with open bus doors for late passengers in Moscow winterthen the drive started and instead of a couple of minutes it turned into about minutes driving from one aide of the runway around the end and over to the opposite apron to the plane But for me all an adventure but just be prepared for a bit of a walk and maybe an extended bus ride Overall a nice clean airport that was very functional and not overly crowded when I went through and easily accessible and a good range of eateries and amenities

Ive lived in El Paso for two years now for school and I often use the airport to visit my hometown as well as other destinations The busiest Ive ever seen the airport from the time of walking through the doors checking baggage going through security and getting to my gate was about minutes Christmas vacation time Ive even got through in minutes Its a smaller airport with only one terminal thats ever used and about gates so from security to walk to your gate takes maybe minutes This isnt one of the airports youll need to devote hours in order to get through it Id say hour is fine because you never know even if it does only take minutes to get to your gate and maybe during busy holiday times or if youre going to have to check the whole family might even be hours for that

If you dont need to go to Denver I recommend COS as the best option for going to Colorado Small but not too small clean efficient quick and centrally located to most points in Colorado Good quick car rentals I use it routinely to go to Pueblo and Denver Yes Denver as it can be more convenient and faster to get to a lot of places especially in south Denver Remember Denver airport is miles east and an expensive toll road from many points in Denver Also traffic is very congested in Denver but only moderately so in Colorado Springs Only problem I have is that most often but not always the cheaper fares are into and out of Denver

A surprisingly large and spacey airport given the size of Porto Boarding times security and seating were all great cuz of the practical layout Even during peak season theres plenty seats available Prices at the foodcourt were lower than youre used to in Europe Theres a convenient metro connection to the city center So all in all a hassle free airport

I have used COS airport several times flying from Nashville to COS and back to Nashville Each time I have been there airport personnel have been very helpful and friendly TSA security officials have been efficient and very observant and the airport has always been clean I would highly recommend this airport to other fliers

Morning flight on PR from Daraga to Manila I have international connection in a separate booking booking but check in agent made it sure my luggage was checked through to my final destination which was so much appreciated as it saved me time and effort at Manila Airport Flight was smooth and on time Ticket price was reasonable
Nordavia has been renamed as Smartavia and reviews can be found on this new linkSmartavia Reviews

I like that Recaro seats were used The seat was very soft and legroom was actually the most I have gotten thus far even for such a tiny plane like the A neo It was very well kept and modern and the cabin was spotlessly clean There was even a meal on the short flight of hours Excellent experience However there was no screens for IFE but there was a cool magazine that kept me entertained so yeah However there unfortunately was a karen or kevin or whatever you call it on our flight The crew were very professional

Very good Clean minimalistic and very nice Its quite a small airport so its impossible to get lost very well constructed and new The only drawback is the duty free very little choice and what there is is expensive

Panama City to Caracas a journey of hrs There was very little legroom but we were served quite a decent meal and considering it was a short flight I was impressed We departed on time but arrived min late

Malm to Stockholm I rebooked on Malm Aviation due to SAS strike in Sweden What a sharp contrast to SAS Checkin was painless using the selfservice machines Flight was operated by an Avro RJ with comfortable seats and sufficient legroom Cabin crew was efficient and smiling But the nicest touch was the free snack on board tasty roast beef sandwich orange juice coffeetea I was rather impressed by the cabin service on this hourflight The only negative point is the free seating policy as usual it resulted in a freeforall at boarding Malm Aviation is a very nice niche airline and I would strongly recommend it

Whilst small and basic its the perfect option for a frequent traveller No queues at check in or security Friendly staff even the security guys are nice No long walks to find your gate Arrive mins before departure travel stress free without the crowds and connect to the world via Schiphol Baggage claim takes minutes Would recommend this airport over flying via Manchester any day unless you enjoy arriving hrs early and shopping

Excellent small airport Arrived from JFK and departed to JFK homepoint DTW Arrival It was raining so as a courtesy we were bussed to terminal ride minutes Passage through passport control took minutes The passport control officer smiled and welcomed me Ample shops landside I was able to buy postcards and stamps to mail them to friends Taxicabs to town do not have meters rate is fixed at euros Careful driver clean taxicab Departure minutes at security minutes at passport control Passport control officer smiled again why are US CBP personnel so unable to master the skill of smiling Airside only tiny snack shop Lovely sunny morning so we walked a few feet on tarmac and up staircase into airplane

Flew into Alderney from Southampton A lovely little airport Very relaxed friendly staff and a good shop and cafe very good considering the airport is tiny Taxis waiting right outside the main entrance and it only takes about minutes if that to get from the aircraft to the terminal entrance Very good all round

The great thing about this airport is its size It is small And that means a short walk from the aircraft through the building and out Baggage reclaim is basic you take it from the baggage truck outside but that is efficient and quick The arrivals area appears unfinished Check in and departure are also quick and easy If you want a drink in a nice bar use the place before the immigration After that there is only a small bar The duty free shop is cheap and quite well stocked There is wireless Internet at the airport but it does not work

Airport is clean has good shops great seating area and has clear signs However the thing that annoyed me the most was the fact that in the entire terminal you could literally i counted just find a total of five power outlets that should really be something to be improved so watch out for that

Pakse to Bangkok Great legspace even for longer people Im cm tall Friendly staff and snacks were served with drinks Ride was smooth plane clean and we were almost on time Would recommend and will fly again with Lao Airlines

Modern clean and efficient airport Only a few flights per week Airside after security and passport control there is a kiosk for food and drinks and a souvenir shop For Ryanair flights you walk between plane and terminal so the priority boarding works Parking in front of the terminal building is free

Panama City to David Pleasant flight experience on an old Fokker A little expensive for what you get but theres little competition in Panama Seats were comfortable spacious though the interior of the plane had not seen an update since the late s or early s Cabin crew were friendly and served soft drinks including diet options and plantain chips Flight departed and arrived about min late

Our arrival was great No problems The airport was clean People were friendly Renting a car was a bit of a pain because it was in another building a long way to drag several bags When departing we arrived hours early but had to wait about minutes before checking our bags There were only people working one for frequent flyers and one for the rest of us The couple at the head of our line had a problem and it took minutes for the lady to get the problem worked out When we got in line there were people in line By the time we were being checked in there were people in line Again everything was clean and the people were very pleasant

Although it is a regional airport it handles two international arrivals Seattle and San Francisco As I avoid YVR Immigration like a plague I spent over hours in one of my latest arrivals I prefer Victoria to get into Canada and then go to Vancouver You can take a taxi cab to the ferry terminal would not work on late flights though and be in Vancouver in less than hours enjoying one of the most scenic rides you will ever find in a ferry Immigration in YYJ is short and pleasant You get your bags in less than minutes usually and go through customs in less than Overall great airport to get to Canada Coming out is also simple and effective Short lines and great staff

Brindisi Salento is a pleasant fairly new airport spacious enough for the level of fights The lurid yellowgreen fluorescent plastic seats are a bit much and I wouldnt want to encounter them with a hangover Transit from city centre by bus A costs cents buy tickets in airport or in town from the bar on the way from the railway station to the bus stop in Via C Colombo and runs half hourly The snack bar prices are silly Coffee more than in town bottled beer more draught beer only more but wasnt available If your flight is from gate which the Ryanair flight to STN was be aware that it is straight in front of passport control meaning that a lot of people cant get through passport control until boarding begins

It was an easy online check in Due to other company flight delays I was short on time to drop my bag in When I arrived it was too late for me to print my bag tag Ricky at LAX directed me to an operator who printed my tag and checked my bag in Flight was also great Service when needed but nice and quiet during the night to sleep I recommend Delta Air Lines

My bag disappeared into the abyss of their care and weeks later Im left with nothing but their hollow promises echoing in my ears Their customer service call begins with empathy sprinkled with reassuring phrases like Well escalate this immediately Spoiler alert immediately is Aer Lingus code for never Ive given up hoping theyll find my belongings Im now just curious if their lost luggage department is a black hole where all the unclaimed bags of the world congregate for a wild party Aer Lingus if youre reading this I dont need another scripted apology I need my bag or reimbursement

My Mom required wheel chair service and we received superb service especially on our departure by Devon He ran to get my Mom as there was a gate change and looked for me as I was getting a snack for her None of the crew advised us but there was Devon with his wonderful smile

Cascais to Bragana with Aero VIP Services are provided by SevenAir The site is easy I had a couple of questions and the support was fantastic The plane was just fine despite being a propeller thus a bit noisy

The airport is not as bad as some of the earlier reports suggest Having a local guide meet you and handle the formalities will help a lot Most people hand over their passports tickets and baggage to these people and allow them to sort out the problems

Really excellent airport I flew to and from Palma De Mallorca airport for a weeks holiday There was absolutely no queues But it was am so it was expected But even when I arrived at about pm the queues were short and went very fast Definitely a great experience No delays or inconvenience except for most of the shops being closed on departure but as stated earlier it was in the morning Highly recommend

PSC airport is currently undergoing remodeling and expansion which are due for completion in early With what is completed thus far the layout is a significant improvement from the old outdated one The look and feel of the airport is definitely more modern in keeping with the times Being a relatively small airport going through TSA is fairly quick At this time the restaurant options are not great but I expect them to improve upon completion I hope the airport is able to lure more flights and more airlines in the future Compared to the two relatively nearby airports YKM and ALW this is the nicest and largest of the three
Short trip Arlanda to Helsinki Very nice people working on board Cold but nice meal nice experience
Makassar to Singapore Crowded flight Long checkin queue and time The takeoff is smooth Great service a good meal The flight attendant is great

Saskatoon airport is small and simple to get around The signs pointing to the right place are just perfect Renovations were being done at this time but it was still super easy to be there and get to my flight on time

Yangon to Mandalay I have flown FMI Air four times now They provide one of the best customer experiences of any airline I have flown Staff is professional and friendly Lounges are wellequipped and comfortable Aircraft are clean In the often confusing and cattleherding feel of domestic Myanmar flight FMI stands out for the comparative serenity of the experience Flights are roughly USDleg more than competitors When you factor in lounge comfort and beverages good internet and the relaxed feel ar both departure and arrival its worth the extra money

Terminal was fairly good Despite the bustling atmosphere the staff were efficient and helpful The terminal isnt very well organized but the clear signage made it easy to navigate The dutyfree area provided a good amount of choices the terminals facilities are old but clean and despite the usual rush of the terminal at the time I found a peaceful corner to relax before my flight Overall its not the best airport I have been to but it has a good potential for upgrades and enhancement and I can see them trying to achieve it

I was returning from visiting a friend in Uruguay and it involves a full day of travel flying TAM Airlines from Montevideo to London via Sao Paolo They had inflight entertainment on loop for h m flight from Montevideo to Sao Paulo the flight from Sao Paulo to London was without concern On the way out my inflight entertainment broke and I had to do without for the flight from London to Sao Paolo The crew were professional seats were comfortable As it was an overnight flight they offered a twocourse eveining meal and breakfast in the moring All in all I would recommend it as an airline to fly to and from South America with
