Kamair could do a lot better with the Kabul Dubai flight the food is still lousy the hostess busy closing curtains to do make up and laze around That is the customer care side of things On the security side of things it looks they are finally waking up My flight to Dubai on rd July was surprising though our luggage was let on the rain as the loaders sheltered under the wings the boarding well done under the supervision of two foreign looking gentlemen a security manager and a safety manager who though serious looking and thorough in their work they smiled at us and even greeted passengers as they boarded That was heart warming to say the least

This review applies to Terminal only American Airlines Transited through a rather busy Reagan National There are great views for the airfield from the D concourse terminal building and E concourse The walk from the end of D concourse to the end of E concourse is rather long and with only a minutes connection I made it to the connecting gate in E concourse with minutes to spare Overall a good airport and terminal to transit through

I had pretty low expectations for this airline but fortunately things turned out well and PIA delivered for me The flight was on time and bags arrived in a timely manner While the meal served was not exactly delicious it was nice to know they at least served some food on this hour flight The seats were standard and flight attendants polite and respectful Would consider using again

Brussels to Punta Cana with Jetairfly on Boeing I was really surprised about this professional service and crew Very good entertainment decent food new plane and friendly service I was lucky to be on a plane which was not fully booked

Johannesburg to Cape Town The SLOW lounge at JNB sets the standard with an impressive array of food even at am and ample seating The bar service is good too and some neighbours had already finished their third refill of pink champagne by the time they boarded the same flight As is common on other BA flights Group passengers were kept waiting on the airbridge before boarding actually commenced Service on board was friendly and efficient but very much old school BA as far as the fourcourse lunch was concerned At least one was able to see the main course before choosing it Departure and arrival were pretty much on schedule and baggage collection was speedy too Overall a decent flight

Have been travelling tofrom this smallish regional airport for around years Have seen a lot of improvements over this time The latest development has provided pax with good eatingdrinking facilities airside On arrival baggage claim is handy to car rentals whose parking lot is only a short walk Departure is easy with security queues usually short and its staff efficient and pleasant Gate lounges have plenty of seating and well placed monitors have the latest flight information Overall clean facilities and friendly mid west staff Always a pleasure to use this airport

It was first time at Louis Armstrong New Orleans International Airport it was is one of the nicest and biggest airports I have come through in the USA anywhere in the world This multi level airport has many boarding bridges There are many shops and restaurants The staff were friendly and welcoming The airport is welldecorated and wellmaintained and easy to get in or out Public areas are a huge clean and bright

The wheelchair attendant verified everything for me Verified with me verified with the LYFT driver by asking his name verify the LYFT ride by licenses plate verified I felt ok and I knew where I was going For me its humiliating to be pushed in a wheelchair I never felt humiliation this time I truly felt cared for This trip wasnt the greatest vacay Ive had but when I got home I felt great I want to thank this positive smart caring young man Some ppl have a gift a few share it in this way If your lucky enough to meet this young man at DFW Airport youll know its him Im talking about here

Omsk to Krasnoyarsk I was a little unsure as to what to expect from a second tier Russian company However the check in process was quick and efficient although it was done only in Russian and I had to move a little weight from my checked in luggage to my hand luggage The flight departed and arrived on time The plane was quite small but legroom was still adequate It was subject to turbulence as we were approaching the landing The cabin crew appeared not to speak English as announcements were only in Russian A good snack was served on the almost two hour long flight My luggage came off the flight fairly quickly All in all a satisfactory experience

That airport is very close to downtown Puerto Princessa and is located around a green area Airport looks quite new and it was efficient to use Got my luggage within minutes Check in was also efficient There are some souvenir shops in departure hall and some simple food stalls After security check you find a waiting hall on second level is a coffee bar and a food stall in the departure level some shops which are not too expensive Overall a no thrills airport which is easy to use in all regards Free Wifi available

KIR is a very small airport In terms of shopping and gastronomy not much is to be expected It can be found easily if you are in the area There are enough parking spaces and they are close to the terminal Terminal cleanliness is substandard especially the restrooms Terminal seating is barely sufficient if only flight is departing Flights can not be handled there is not enough space in the departure area In this case security is overwhelmed The queues extend to the outside of the airport building Airport staff becomes very aggressive and confrontational Under normal circumstances the staff are grumpy at best When flying from Kerry to Dublin Take the train from Killarney instead All in all it does not take much more time and the experience is much more pleasant

Nice cosy airline with very friendly cabin personnel Comfort standard and entertainment through plane WiFi without screens limited choice Food was plain but sufficient wine could be obtained Flight was absolutely ontime a nice experience

First impression of Minsk airport was given by its exterior grand Brutalist Sovietera architecture Very impressive Inside the terminal doesnt feel grand and impressive I was in transit only so I only saw the arrival gates transfer area and the airside departure areas The arrivals area is a bit of a maze and signage not that clear So be sharp when looking for the transit area after arrivals The transfer area was old fashioned with worn fakeleather couches that seem to taken from a landfill Queuing time at the transfer area was OK around minutes After boarding card check passengers process through security which was a bit of a joke as passengers are not checked at all after passing the walkthrough metal detector The departures area with its shops is a bit of a maze and the gate waiting areas are very small There is not a lot of choice in shops what I saw was mostly liquor or food and beverage outlets Seating in the gate waiting areas is limited but on the upper level of the departures area there is sufficient space to take a rest on one of the seats At the upper level there are also seats on which you can recline but these seats are quite hard and not very comfortable to take a good nap There are also sleeping cabins here Wifi works great login via SMS Terminal and toilets are clean especially at the upper level where not a lot of people go The terminal it not really fit for PRM passengers as there are a lot of stairs but not escalators and just a few lifts They did install stairlifts at the gates a rather silly solution in my opinion but is works This airport is fine when you have a short transfer In case of a long transfer it can be boring and FB options are very limited

There in December Jan and Mar times very quick handling of luggage etc comfortable waiting area and free internet No queues for Immigration desk One point that is minor if you dont know where the bus to Rotterdam centre is located you may have a problem however I took a taxi and then it takes only minutes Its much more agreeable than the big airports like Toulouse Orly JFK or even Schiphol also in the Netherlands

Both terminals are badly designed and difficult to get around Getting to baggage claim on a WestJet arrival means going up and down a flight of stairs or escalator about times The most ridiculous way to baggage claim I have ever seen No one to help at baggage carousels It is worth the drive to Buffalo Niagara International Airport if you are going to a US destination from Toronto That airport is clean easy to get around and very nice people working at airline counters TSA etc
Good airport nice shops and the seating is comfortable great restaurants very respectful staff and flights always on time

Earlier I reviewed here the disastrous departure with AA from MIA and it seems only fair that I should write about the excellent arrival procedures at Santo Domingo airport On the short walk from the plane to the arrival booths there are some people randomly checking Covid documents At the booth you need to show by phone or paper your electronic E ticket and then it is a breeze When I arrived at the booth there were officers on duty and the line was very short The luggage was on the carousel within minutes of landing and an official will check your bag tag with that on your luggage Plenty of taxis but a bit pricey and a great start to arriving in the DR

RGNMDL on ATR We were a bit sceptical when our travel agency booked on Air Yangon because we couldnt find much about this airline in Skytrax The plane left twenty minutes earlier than in our tickets stated so do reconfirm the day before No hassle with luggage and weight security checks as in the whole country very relaxed but efficient Comfortable seating on this short trip little snack for those who are extremely hungry Friendly staff clean plane and very pleasant flight We felt safe and would fly with them again

I recently flew with China Southern Airlines from Gatwick Airport to Changchun Airport via Zhengzhou to visit my family in China As I bordered the Boeing I was greeted with kind flight attendants who directed me to my seat On my seat was a pillow a thin blanket and headphones for the inflight entertainment We departed on time around in the evening UK time There was meals served and many drinks services with a variety of drinks ranging from fruit juices alcohols beer fizzy drinks and waters The meals were served on trays made up of a warm main dish with a side dish such as vegies and a desert Overall the food was tasty and plentiful There was a wide variety of movies which included Chinese and Western movies in many languages there was also fun mini games and an inflight map showing the progress of our flight I would say my flight to Zhengzhou took around and a half hours The seats were reclinable and padded well In my opinion it was quite comfy and I fell asleep quickly after watching a movie The cushion was soft and surprisingly the blanket offered a good amount of warmth The bathrooms and seats were all cleaned and maintained well and overall the flight was relaxed and peaceful My only complaint is that the cabin was a bit warn out and old with some pieces of fabric missing from the front bit of my seat This did not serve as an issue to me it was only aesthetically unpleasing Another suggestion from me is to offer an amenity kit as the flight was long haul Overall I had an amazing experience with friendly staff delicious meals and extreme comfort and good entertainment that kept me busy

A small domestic airport in Taiwan Fast and friendly staff Surprisingly many shops Looked very clean Because this is a military airport too you can spot military aircraft taking off and land taking photos is forbidden though On time nonchaotic boarding and the plane took off in schedule Recommend

I flew from Glasgow to Halifax in August with Europe Airpost I was attracted by the great ticket price and a direct flight to Halifax Nova Scotia The ticket was almost half the price of the major international airlines An extra leg room seat cost Euro each outward and Euro return each fantastic value The flight was very pleasant a clean aircraft complimentary newspapers headsets and meals The crew was pleasant but unobtrusive Flights in both directions departed and arrived on time It is the first transatlantic flight I have made in a small aircraft like this Boeing it resulted in smaller than normal queues to embark and disembark and also to reclaim baggage Not much else can be said except great flight great price I wish air travel was always like this

Very good airport clean little queue times wifi works well and there are many options for eating One thing that I liked very much about this airport is that on the third floor there are many food options This airport is not very big but its space is very well used

It was years ago I used this airport and wow so much has changed The check in on nd level had moved to a much more spacious rd level It made the experience totally different in a positive way No longer does it feel cramped Staff are friendly and signage are very clear The only thing that still need improving is the variety of shops available air side and food options It is still pretty basic at this stage With more and more airlines flying to OKA they can be more ambitious and open up more shops and restaurants to cater for us

Weve flown with Jetcom a few times and always been impressed This flight was similar Sure its not a scheduled flight like Air France or BA so dont expect it to be formal or upmarket Checking in at both airports is really easy and queues were managed well Plenty of staff around to help who were all friendly and helpful Fast and efficient despite some airport issues Boarding was also really easy and organised staff extremely friendly and creating conversation while waiting to board due to the abundance of staff without anything to do which is good for passengers I guess Onboard the seat was relatively comfortable and Extra Legroom was great Cabin crew extremely attentive and actually liked a conversation presented excellently and put a few peoples mind at rest who were nervous of travelling The plane was also quite clean for a holiday airline Id not buy any food though the toastie left a lot to be desired despite generic drinks being good I also love they offer Starbucks onboard Id highly recommend Jetcom and far better than other holiday airlines despite the fares not really being low anymore However Id still rather fly scheduled if possible but a great alternative

Superb airport Small Friendly service No queuing went through security in under minutes Fast free wifi with constant connection and no connectivity issues Burger and chips SEK cl beer SEK Decent viewing facility but minimal air traffic to view

Small airport yet very efficient Dont come too early as there is not much to do Queuing is almost nonexistent staff checkin and security are very friendly There is a restaurant with view on the tarmac and a small airport shop before the security Arrival is very fast to minutes including bagage reclaim There is a bus stop right before the terminal taking you to AntwerpenBerchem train station a major train station with fast connection to Brussels or anywhere in Belgium Very close to the city center Highly recomended for users who like fast airports

Modern airport and very efficient Upon arrival by taxi one of the porters thoughtfully brought a cart for the luggage Checkin area wide and modern No queue at check in airport security or even for payment of airport charges Gate area very clean and equipped with a wide selection of dining options The view of the imposing Mount Pinatubo is something unique

The airport is mid being rebuilt arrivals still in progress but departures all complete Departures was very quick no checkin or security queue it was a Tuesday but our plane was fairly full Great clean toilets friendly staff the only major fail is despite it all being brand new there is nowhere near enough seats expect to be sitting on the floors also not much food on offer if you cannot eat wheatbased food groups

I knew that Xiamen is known for being not so passenger friendly when it comes to transfering and long stayovers I read that most of the time they wont transfer your bag onwards meaning that you would have to go through customs and claim your bag on landside Knowing that I was pleasantly surprised that there was ground staff waiting for all transfering passengers at the arrival gate where my KLM flight rolled in to They guided me all the way through security and told me that I wouldnt have to reclaim my bag at first but in the end thay said I needed to The airport itself is quite clean and has a simple layout although I had only seen terminal intl flights All the signs were in english too So from then on it was playing the waiting game I must say that that the amount of shops and only cafe wasnt to nice Nothing to kill time unless trying something to eat Only staff at the gate could speak proper English I was surprised by the drinking water fountains to be found everywhere on the airport After waiting for hours was able to check in for my flight to Sydney Once boarding commenced there was a problem with a lot of carry on bags so that took a while After boarding was finished everything was ready to go until the captain made an announcement that we were going to be delayed by almost an hour due to traffic Once the flight departed it was a pleasant journey onwards to Sydney where we arrived on time

Spacious clean well located well serviced bright naturally illuminated airport Large halls with folk articles shops and chemist money exchange bureau and wrapping baggage service A breeze Fine areas for check in and spotless lavatories Once checked in fast track to security and immigrations available Smiley faces all over the airport Excellent Duty free shop Very good VIP lounge

Amazing experience I want to thank you all of the flight attendants for being so friendly and helpful I am afraid of airplanes and they helped me calm down and relax Special thanks to Maria for being there whenever I need her The best flight attendant Her customer service was super She was there to help and make me feel comfortable

Awful airport On arrival was very smooth to be fair but the passport control queue was horrendous for those with UK passports and no accessibility and on departure despite wearing the sunflower lanyard and having booked fast track I was declined at fast track and made to queue for security and with my disabilities I struggle with long queuing The departure hall was very busy and hot with not many places to sit I had a great holiday in the Algarve but it was tarnished by the atrocity that is Faro Airport on a positive note however the toilets were very clean

Flew Solomon Airlines from Brisbane to Honiara We boarded to be greeted by smiling attendants The flight was not too full so we had seats to ourselves Leg room was quite good IFE was just a screen panel lowered from the ceiling watched a movie The meal was lunch we had the beef and it was delicious Staff came around to check if we needed any more drinks throughout the flight

Just wanted to shout out the excellent customer service and help I received recently at Denpasar Bali airport I stupidly left two bags on the carousal when I went through customs Airport security were very friendly as the guided me through a secure area to go back behind the luggage area to retrieve the bags and customs did not hassle me for going through twice Cant imagine doing this so easily in a North American airport Bali people are great

Zurich to Dresden via their hub in Dusseldorf Both flights on As Checked in in ZRH without any hassle or feeling entering a lowcost carrier Gate bridging in airports convenient and saved time Flights were both precise on timing and arrival Luggage inscribed transferred and delivered within Minutes on final destination Transit in Dusseldorf smooth Payable catering service onboard rendered several interesting options from printed menu leaflets The airline was better than most reviews indicate I must render them credit at least out of If I had access to their lounges in ZRH and DUS the trip would have been perfected Not cheap but reliable no faults and could fly them again
Stansted to Ajaccio Excellent all round On time drink and a snack served no hassle to board or have onboard bags Seats were comfy for a hour flight fare reasonable Would recommend

Tehran to Dubai Mahan Air is the best airline in Iran The business class is convenient with a variety of dishes The quality of food in this airline is great Stewardess are very affable and responsible In the longterm flights the amenity kit will be given to you Generally the flight will be satisfied

Skopje is a small airport but quite spacious you can see that there are not many people flying international But there are some coffee shops burger king and car rentals The only shuttle bus goes every hour The toilets could be cleaner they were dirty even when there weere almost no people

This is a very comfortable and affordable airport There are a number of shops on the ground floor with very reasonable prices also Thai massage at the end of the ground floor again with very reasonable prices Theyve replaced the lounge chairs in the past two years and the new chairs are nicely padded The only negative is that you will likely have to walk across the tarmac to board your plane No problem in the winter but Im not sure how that works during the rainy season

Really nice modern and clean airport The shopping options after the security check are limited but food and beverages are no problem The security staff is friendly especially during the more quiet times The possibilities for transit stays are limited but its good for departure or arrival

Skopje is a small airport but quite spacious you can see that there are not many people flying international But there are some coffee shops burger king and car rentals The only shuttle bus goes every hour The toilets could be cleaner they were dirty even when there weere almost no people

Newark to Paris As a result of the delays in receiving their ALR aircraft Premera air contracted EuroAtlantic to fly the Newark ParisCDG routeThe check in took about mins as it was a full flight It took about mins to get through security at Newark due to the lack of TSA staff and screening equipmentThe seats were comfortable ahd a personal TV screen in each seat which had a limited selection of films and TV shows There was also a USB port to charge personal devices There were no headphones offered on board luckily we had our own set The scheduled flight time was hrs mins we took off about mins late but we managed to arrive on time into CDG The EuroAtlantic staff were friendly and attentive and looked after the passengers on the flight Meals and drinks were provided to those passengers who booked their meals through the Primera air website Overall this flight was great value for money

Honeymooning in various resorts in Borneo so visited Kota Kinabalu several times during our trip Check in area busy and crowded and Air Asia check in process a bit confusing but staff very kindly helped us out Rest of airport very well laid out and signage very helpful with ample seating at boarding gates

Airport has a weird system for departure You have to go to a security check point outside the airport to be patted down manually by security guards while your vehicle luggage is sniffed by gaurd dogs Then you are dropped off at a terminal for security check again this time through electronic devices where you get a special colored sticker on your luggage Afterwards you proceed to a shuttle bus carry your own luggage that will take you to another terminal about a minute drive where temperatures reach degrees Celsius in the summer At the nd terminal a security check is done to ensure you have been security checked at the previous terminal Now some of this can be avoided if you have a special VIP pass that skips step And a VVIP that skips all steps The check in counters are ok about of them run by Dubais DNata Immigration is slow and queues are long Duty Free is small with tobacco chocolates and alcohol available One coffee shop available behind Duty Free After passing immigration but before your gate you pass through another security check point remove your shoes belts etc Plenty of seating at the gates plus one coffee shop although AC is never working in the summer and no wifi connection through out the airport Staff are all generally friendly
Everything went smooth from Pyongyang to Beijing Checkin staff were friendly Seats were comfortable Inflight entertainment could have been better Food and drinks decent enough

Great airport but it is huge and can take up to minutes to get from gate to gate if in transit Good variety of shops and restaurants lots of toilets which are always clean Its a shame theres no areas to relax apart from at gates Singapore Doha KL etc all have sofa areas and big TVs to watch which is great when you have a long lay over I always thought there were smoking rooms here but werent Not an issue if you have a lay over of more than hrs as you can go through immigration and leave the airport I did however find cigarette butts behind floor standing AC units on two occasions at unmanned gates where passengers and probably staff hide and have a quick smoke I even smelt cigarette smoke at one point so people obviously are smoking in the terminals Some staff seemed quite unhelpful and standoffish though when I asked about a few things but mainly young ones who were more interested in what was on their mobile phones

I fly this route regularly but usually in Economy as this was a busy weekend there were no economy tickets remaining so I booked BusinessClub Europe I never deal with checkin as Im always hand luggage only I headed straight into the airport and decided Id try out the OneWorld lounge at Schiphol as this was included There was a huge queue with people being turned away from the Lounge front desk this however turned out to be for another providers lounge I checked with the front desk and was allowed to enter the OneWorld lounge This lounge was nicely furnished with plenty of food and snacks available nice quiet restrooms within the lounge were also available This space was a welcome change from the hustle and bustle from the rest of the terminal and I relaxed here for a while before my flight The staff were very friendly and attentive When boarding time came I made my way to the gate of course passengers ignored the boarding order and all just crowded the gate this left multiple priority boarding passengers unable to board until most of economy had seated Schiphols ground staff need to be more organised in this respect On the plane as this is only a seating layout the seating was no different to economy I expected this and the Embraers are quiet spacious despite being smaller planes Our food and drinks orders were taken before take off so the dedicated ClubWorld staff could serve as soon as possible on the short flight Food was a cold dish but was a very tasty Asian style chicken and slaw various other snacks were included and I had glasses of champagne because why not Staff were very friendly and attentive despite how short this flight was Arriving at London City was like it is in any class quick and simple Overall the experience was good and for the difference in cost in Avios points I will now be doing this journey in ClubWorld rather than Economy in the future

Johannesburg to Lilongwe via Blantyre Very impressed with Malawian Airlines On time departures and arrivals excellent food served both outbound lunch chicken and return breakfast fried eggs lovely coffee and generous baggage allowance Crucially Ethiopan Airlines the part owner has timed the flight with an early morning departure from Malawi such that a large majority of passengers were connecting on our flight in Johannesburg onto regional Southern Africa routes and donestically within SA whereas SAA schedule from Lilongwe would require an overnight stay in Johannesburg clever scheduling Both flights nearly full No entertainment or music onboard

Ronald Reagan Washington National Airport is a welldesigned and highly efficient airport that makes traveling a seamless experience The terminal layout is intuitive making navigation easy and stressfree With a wide range of dining and shopping options passengers have plenty of choices to enjoy before their flight The airport is clean modern and offers a comfortable atmosphere with ample seating and wellmaintained facilities Security is wellmanaged ensuring a safe and smooth travel experience Whether youre on a quick layover or starting a journey DCA provides convenience comfort and efficiency at every step

This is a small airport Single terminal concept Security was quick and since my flight was to Sao Paulo it is internal and there is no passport check All the gates are in a single long corridor Distances to walk are short The shops and cafes directly face the gates so you can drink a coffee and see when your gate is boarding The free WIFI was excellent Good stress free experience airport

Tehran to Cologne with Iran Air A wonderful airline with good service The flight took hours and we had meals breakfast with breads and a lot of other things and lunch was chicken with saffron rice and a small salad yogurt and a cake Drinks were also for free My seat had enough space and it was comfortable A small delay of minutes but that was because some passengers were late

This was the first time I flown with Vanilla Air parent airline is ANA They have a different terminal for low cost airlines Terminal at Narita Airport for LCCs and also at Okinawa Check in was smooth for both flights I had no expectations whatsoever The inflight service was basic and for and hour flight is just fine Seats were comfortable and the cabin crew was nice This is a low cost carrier and I will recommend it and I will be flying again Within Japan is it rather difficult to get a bad service
Flew LUGFLR via GVA and back Excellent airline Flights on time FA very friendly and service excellent Would fly with Etihad Regional again

Small minimal facilities not much to do while you wait Staff are friendly and efficient The day we arrived there was live music playing in the customs area nice touch We walked out of the terminal to be greeted immediately by our tour arranger

Flight from Karachi to Islamabad plane flight was pleasant and no turbulence during the whole flight enough leg space to stretch your legs as being a domestic flight there wasnt any entertainment available but the food was excellent Even though the airline is cheaper than other airlines in terms of service and satisfaction it has an edge over its competitors

This place is clean and efficient Lots of room and well staffed airport Both the internationaldomestic terminal and the USA pre clearance terminals are modern and the lines are usually moving very quickly US Customs is exceptionally efficient and considering the volume of persons traveling the process is smooth and the staff is excellent and friendly US citizens get to experience an even smoother passage with the automated terminals Just make sure you follow all the rules because some of them might seem unnecessary but if you have had a big win at the casino declare it or loose it after a night in a terrible local lock up and a visit to a magistrate back in town the next day if it is not a Friday

I am beyond happy with the assistance I received from this airline and staff I had back pain and an injury before my flight and walking at the airport was very difficult for me They immediately provided me with a wheelchair and a wonderful staff member who took care of me all the way until I boarded the plane The ground staff the crew and the entire experience were absolutely perfect I cant believe how kind helpful and professional everyone was I feel truly blessed Thank you so much

Quito to Galpagos Islands and return to Guayaquil First leg UIOGPS was with a stop in GYE to collect more passengers there was an hour delay announcements were made only in Spanish but when I asked I was informed anyway A short hop to GYE and short stop there and then hrs to GPS both legs were on an older version of A no inflight entertainment but I wasnt expecting as its domestic and not really long flights besides I was enjoying the scenery from the window Their inflight magazine is also only in Spanish which is strange being an Intl airline and a lot of tourists come to visit Ground staff in both UIO and GPS were very helpful and cheerful and when I asked for seats with extra leg room I was offered first seat in Economy on both flights Crew on board doing their jobs but werent very enthusiastic but polite and helpful A sandwich and a coffee were offered which was a sufficient snack Crew constantly talk to me in Spanish a language that I dont speak Return flight to GYE was on time and arrived on time to catch my Intl connection to AMS Luggage was delivered quickly and no hassle for connecting from domestic to Intl at GYE even if its with a different airline I was really surprised with the good service all in all and worth what I paid Just planes are old and need renovation Toilets were kept clean all the time Will recommend it for future if I go to Ecuador again

Little Rock National Airport LIT is one of my favorite midsize airports It is on par with the Bob Hope Airport BUR and Ft LauderdaleHollywood International Airport FLL in that it is easy to get in and out of the airport complex the location is close to downtown and the presence of lowcost airlines keep overall ticket prices among the lowest in the country

I fly out of Winnipeg many times Although its not the best in terms of stores and flight choice it is very spacious bright and traveler friendly Its one of the nicest airports Ive traveled through Massive glass windows give a wonderful view of the planes and surrounding area Check in is usually quick and easy although the self serve machines are useless Lots of parking and room to drop off as well Security is quick and simple dropping you in the middle of the terminal Moving around isnt hard either since it only takes mins to walk the entire terminal length The only issue I have with this airport is that there isnt many food and store options The food court has a Pizza place and sandwich store along with the necessary Tim Hortons in the airport They sell some snacks at the usual travel stores though quite expensive Wifi and staff are great along with bag claimcustoms being quick to get through Overall great airport

Louisville is actually one of the nicest airports in the United States poundforpound In fact Louisville on steroids gives you an idea of what more of our true international gateways should look like but dont I mean Detroit and Minneapolis are good but LAX and JFK Ill start with the good about Louisville Parking is easy and reasonably priced So easy in fact that its literally at the back door of the terminal and nicely covered for all those inclement weather situations The airport is super clean The personnel are aboveaverage in friendliness some of the security and restaurant staff could learn to smile but its hard for me to recount any particularly rude experiences with personnel The terminal is very Louisville and Kentuckythemed making the airport an unmistakable part of the state of Kentuckys cultural identity Security is usually a breeze even if you dont have TSA PreCheck which I have Its almost immediately next door to the state fairgrounds minutes from downtown and minutes from serene natural areas like Jefferson Memorial Forest The terminals are straightforward and wellsigned The public art is very localspecific and themed and attractively positioned As a bonus the airport is UPS primary North American hub so its neat to see the massive cargo planes regularly flying in and out of there The real drawbacks of flying into and out of Louisville are that baggage claim takes a little longer than it should for a relatively small airport and you have to pay close attention to signage right as youre driving off the property to access the freeways and fairgrounds In summary Its hard to go wrong with flying in and out of Louisville Ive been doing it for years and it just feels almost like putting on a comfortable pair of shoes

I recently slipped a disc and needed assistance at Gibraltar airport I cant say just how heartwarming it was to be met by the lovely Sam and guided through what can be a pretty stressful experience with genuine humanity and not a few laughs along the way Shes a real gem as were all other staff involved from check in to departure Another client asked what happened as we were raised into the transport and an attendant whod had a similar injury gave some really good supplementary advice as we disappeared I do a fair amount of travelling and that was a rare experience Thank you all

From the moment you set foot inside Dublin Airport immediately distinguishes itself as a beacon of luxury especially noticeable within the sleek and sophisticated confines of Terminal Its modern aesthetic and design set it apart from the majority of international airports presenting an atmosphere not just of transit but of refined travel experience The layout of Dublin Airport is a testament to thoughtful design and planning The checkin areas are remarkably clear and wellorganized making navigation a breeze for travelers This accessibility extends throughout the airport with ample space lifts and escalators ensuring that everyone regardless of mobility can easily move around Perhaps most impressive is the airports commitment to leveraging cuttingedge technology for security processes The advanced systems in place mean that passengers dont need to remove liquids or electronics from their bags streamlining what is often a cumbersome process This efficiency is further highlighted by the minimal queues with most travelers getting through security in less than five minutesa clear indication of Dublin Airports effective use of technology and operational management The warmth and helpfulness of the staff at Dublin Airport cannot go unmentioned Each interaction is marked by genuine care making the travel experience exceptionally personal and pleasant Dublin Airport also excels in its retail and dining offerings The dutyfree selection is impressive featuring soughtafter brands and exclusive products at prices that challenge those of high street shops The food outlets including some newly launched ones offer a wide array of options catering to diverse tastes and dietary needs all at reasonable prices For travelers seeking a moment of tranquility or needing to attend to work the airport provides numerous lounges and workspaces alongside impeccably clean toilets and abundant seating areas Navigation through the airport is foolproof with gates clearly marked and the overall layout intuitively designed Also has free reliable WiFi unlike other major airports A unique feature that sets Dublin Airport apart on the global stage is its US Customs and Border Protection Preclearance facility allowing travelers to complete all immigration procedures before boarding This means arriving in the USA as if on a domestic flight bypassing the usual long queues upon arrivalan invaluable convenience In summary Dublin Airport is not just a travel hub but a remarkable experience in its own right Its commitment to luxury modernity and efficiency makes it a mustuse airport for anyone looking to elevate their travel experience The seamless blend of advanced technology outstanding customer service and thoughtful amenities positions Dublin Airport as a hidden gem in the world of air travel My advice Run dont walk to Dublin Airport for your next journey Its an experience that not only facilitates travel but inspires more of it
Melbourne to Nouma Surprisingly very good airline and good business seat for a three hours flight Very good staff and very good product in business Among them Nikko Japanese whisky

One of the smallest airports Ive ever encountered Due to required visas for Laos there was a bit of a hold up at immigration but staff were thorough Luggage made it off the aircraft in an efficient manner so waiting times were minimal The whole arrivals area was so compact you could see the baggage hall from immigration and visa versa Interesting as the chaotic arrivals hall had all doors continually open and once you left the baggage collection area you could easily go back Our arrival was an evening one so most retail outlets were closed and inconveniently also the money exchange Not a bad little airport but renovation and refurbishment needed

We arrived and departed on the BA flight from LGW Arrival was amazingly quick It took less than half an hour to deplane go through passport control and collect bags Being a Club World passenger undoubtedly helped but even so we were pretty impressed There was almost no queue to go through security at the time of departure lunchtime midweek so the process was painless Again we were lucky that it was so quiet A new business lounge has just opened by Gate Its rather small but has good food choice Getting to San Francisco is a cinch using the BART connector shuttle to Coliseum and thence onwards to downtown San Francisco In fact the whole experience is much better than at SFO And because of the competition between BA and Norwegian fares from the UK are very reasonable at present

Impressed with this airport Quick and easy process for arrival and departure Yes we had to queue for passport control but they got through the lines reasonable quick The luggage had still not hit the belts so we would have queued anyway On departure the line again for both check in and passport control was quick The food courts were excellent and great choice at very reasonable prices for sw What I was more impressed weee the cleanliness of the toilets Having had the worst experience through Heraklion this was a complete surprise Well done Corfu Very clean and modern

The airport is very small with just about million passengers a year The few checkin desks are enough service is fast no queues travel agencys most big car rental companys have a desk and restaurants and visitors terrace with a nice view are available

A small airport serving only main highlight in the Red Centre of Australia the tourist attraction of Uluru and Kata Tjuta I arrived by domestic service I understood some international flights do use this airport so customs were negligible The airport is built on the edge of the desert and is surrounded by picturesque desert panorama Being tourist orientated all sorts of tourist services were available immediately upon retrieval of baggage A free tourist bus is available for pick up for everyone staying at the huge monopoly of Ayers Rock Resort about minutes away from the airport which unless you are a local thats where you will be

I have used Polonia six times in the last four year both international and domestic arrival and departure No problems with taxis overcharging just as for any airport do your research Be affirmative informed and polite

Moroni to Moheli Turned out to be a pretty decent airline Online booking worked well checkin and boarding was fine and the plane looked well maintained Its a very short flight just minutes or so so i didnt expect much but they still managed to hand our a bottle of water and some biscuits which i though was very nice Both flights on time

The largely renovated and rebuilt MCO airport is absolute class Clean well organized from the signage to the dropoff to security and aesthetically pleasing in most areas Returning to the US the new international arrivals area and postcustoms area so arrivals really is just gorgeous If you have Global Entry you breeze through in seconds with courteous officers that speak English and Spanish That alone is unique for a large US airport where many passport control officers are known for their powertripping belligerence but Orlando pleasantly provided the opposite of all that The signage to trains rideshare and hotel shuttles is granularly specified such that its easy for anybody to follow at least when leaving terminal Cinternational Leaving MCO the next morning arrivals at terminal A had clearly been renovated and was looking quite sharp CLEARPreCheck in tandem reduced security from a minute wait to a minute one The shuttle tram facilities between gates and terminals are showing their age and the terminal A gates area is also showing its age and could also use some more and better seating throughout but I wouldnt necessarily consider them dumpy I suppose that MCO will get to renovating those facilities as they can Truly MCO seems to be running like a welloiled machine that is geared to leave visitors to their city with a first and last positive impression

The usual service everything ok Lounge at Madrid airport is just great Late boarding and late departure due to traffic control arrived min late On board crew is just great as usual very attentive full lunch served with open bar Seat comfort nothing special but fine for a hr flight Everything worked out well they need to pay attention to punctuality

Seoul to Busan First time with Air Busan and it was great Price App check in employees serviceluggage and on time At the check in I was offered an earlier flight no fee There were no problems with this airline and trip Recommend

On June airport started renovation of taxiways as well as the installation of a new apron The inside of the airport is very clean it is easy to orientate the construction of a new terminal will begin The runway lighting is bad but will also be updated soon I very much hope that everything will be fine and that it will be easier and safer to travel

Tampa International Airport is huge and very confusing that I ended up going to the wrong direction upon exiting I ended up in the sky center I asked one of the people who I assume work there because he has an ID and he happily helped me and walked with me back to where I supposed to go He worked as a chef in PF changs yet he helped me He was waiting for his ride after a long busy day at work yet he got up and assisted me Thank you Sir for going above and beyond There really is hope in humanity

Larnaca to Athens This is registered as a Cypriot airline yet it seems that they are against the local language in that safety instructions are given only in english On this airline it is impossible to select a free seat only paid seats can be selected via web The aircraft was more than perfect clean but was not near jetways and bus was used for boarding In flight magazine price list and safety instructions were overused Nothing was offered during the flight if you want a drink you pay for it

Arrival at this airport was simple with its connection to the Hanover SBahn suburban train system Hanover airport is a convenient size not an overwhelming number of gates but large enough to have plenty of connections Checkin today with Swiss Airlines went smoothly we were asked for our destination visa but not grilled and luggage was processed without difficulty Security checking was slow today probably because of Middle East tensions but security personnel were good humoured and friendly Cafes and shops on the land side closed before pm there are limited shopping possibilities on the air side but one good cafe

Its pretty good for a budget airline As long as you have followed predeparture guidelines packed properly and have your passport valid visa and PNR number checkin is easy even if it takes a while for people in front of you to repack their bags as they were NOT prepared or were taking chances with their baggage allowance The rest of the flight was uneventful the crew cabin and seating were efficient beyond what you would expect from a budget airline

Flew WAWLWOWAW last week The airport is very big and airy and clean No problems going through passport control either way and no issues with security The airport is quite empty but it has a duty free section some places to drink a coffee or have something to eat both inside and outside the departures so quite satisfactory With the huge fall of the Hryvnia the prices in the coffee shop are reasonable the gift shop Baltona is not a bargain as they quote in Euro Travelling to the city is about Hryvnia by taxi which is now about Euro There is free wifi that worked fine for me I would not hesitate to fly through Lviv again

I would like to give a commendation to the staff of Cebu Pacific working at the Roxas City airport who helped my father recover his lost luggage which was mistakenly picked up by another passenger These people worked hard and I have also witnessed all the efforts they made to give all the help that we needed Thank you for your hard work and dedication You guys are awesome

I arrived in this airport for transit My destination is Bangkok Thailand In my opinion the airport is quite small and kind of boring especially if you have a layover for more than hours There should have been some facilities that make the airport more interesting for example a reading corner some cool spots for taking a picture fun games and more cafes or restaurants The good thing is its easy to follow the signs or directions and you dont have to walk that far to reach the gate transit area departure or arrival hall So it would be a great idea to make this airport bigger and larger with more facilities

Travelled in transit LGWTIPACC back in November and on both outward and return legs I found the staff helpful and courteous Although the airport may not be up to the international standards of LHR or AMS nonetheless a compact tidy terminal It also has an excellent duty free shop Remember though that Libya is a dry country The only Becks you can buy is non alcoholic

Barcelona BLA to Caracas CCS in Venezuela on a classic Boeing aircraft I experienced Conviasa to be quite nice to fly with Anyhow they do not offer much more than the average European nofrills carriers A costfree nonalcoholic drink was served on that short domestic flight the aircraft was clean and fine despite its age we departed BLA about minutes ahead schedule not every airline in Venezuela manages that Since the ticket costed me less than EUR I can call it a quite satisfying experience

A fairly typical African airport I was not hassled for bribes or other payments Immigration and baggage reclaim were not a problem on the way in Departure was a bit confusing and facilities limited on the way out They are rebuilding the airport at the moment whilst it is in use So it is in a poor state but looks like it will be very good when complete No business lounge at present The airport is very close to the centre of Ouagadougou so no long drive is required to get anywhere

Kamair could do a lot better with the Kabul Dubai flight the food is still lousy the hostess busy closing curtains to do make up and laze around That is the customer care side of things On the security side of things it looks they are finally waking up My flight to Dubai on rd July was surprising though our luggage was let on the rain as the loaders sheltered under the wings the boarding well done under the supervision of two foreign looking gentlemen a security manager and a safety manager who though serious looking and thorough in their work they smiled at us and even greeted passengers as they boarded That was heart warming to say the least
It is clean modern and spacious There are many restaurants and shops Passengers would not be bored during the waiting time Employees are friendly and helpful Signposts are clear

I was transiting with Air China in Beijing Capital Airport Terminal Most international flights operate from Concourse TE but some use TD In my cause both arrival and departure were from TE On transit passengers need to go through document and security and customs check The walking times are not really long and mostly travelators are available There are transfer service checkpoints one from each side of the concourse The crowd is not really well organized and staff is not really helpful Not everyone speaks English which is quite frustrating when you actually need to communicate with airport or security staff Arriving early in the morning get ready to spend h queuing for transit Other than that I have to note that Terminal is very modern by its looks and layout The ceiling is high which makes it seam like the airport is free and spacious Walking distances are not too long Most gates are accessible in less than minutes of calm stroll Between TE TD and TC there is an automated people mover train which is easily accessible after security I didnt use it but I located its station and observed it a little There are few restaurants which in my opinion are quite reasonable priced Early in the morning only few Chinese restaurants and Western cafes were opened The food is actually quite delicious I would note good availability of seating spaces Some are equipped with universal power outlets and USB chargers If you want to use WiFi better use WiFi kiosks as SMS sometimes doesnt go through Be aware that you wont be able to use most messengers and social networks Also it was nice to have drinking fountains within short reach from most seating areas I would suggest considering Beijing Capital Airport as transit hub for Asia Clean and modern airport with all the necessary facilities for longer transits

Palonegro to Cucuta with Easyfly Was put on this flight after Satena cancelled one of the legs I was hesitant since I had to make it to CUC that day The JS are quite small yet efficient planes Easyfly ground staff at Palonegro was quite helpful and professional Flight was smooth and punctual No complaints at all Despite the short duration of the flight minutes refreshments were offered Would consider it if needed

Kirksville IRK is served by the federal Essential Air Service with one or two daily jet roundtrips to Chicago OHare provided by Contour Airlines This small airport was a joy to fly into and out of its definitely preferable to driving into town from Des Moines or Columbia The highlight was the friendliness of the staff everyone from the airline counter staff to the TSA screeners was very pleasant and helpful The building itself is clean and compact I understand there are plans to build a new terminal maybe because the addition of TSA screening equipment ate up some of the interior space That left the seating space in the departure area a bit tight but not uncomfortable The main waiting area is roomier and quite comfortable Deplaning and boarding was quick and easy a short walk to the aircraft no jetways with luggage handled efficiently Outside the grounds were very well kept Overall the impression is of a wellrun facility that gets a lot of care The parking lot free is immediately outside the terminal and my rental car arranged in advance there isnt onsite car rental in the terminal was easy to find Its only a short drive to town Returning to the airport for my departure the terminal wasnt directly visible from the highway but the entrance is wellmarked with a large sign Overall I cant remember when I last had such a good experience at any airport I guess Midwest Nice is really a thing
We were booked on Condor but last minute this flight was changed to Wamos Our experience was very good with this airline The crew was polite and efficient The service and food was very good
Brilliant Airport new clean clear spacious Shame so few airlines do fly into MVD

Arriving in Manado from Singapore by SilkAir is always a good experience The greenery around the airport was beautiful and the short walk less than minutes from the plane to the immigration counter is a relief compared to the minute walk I used to have in Changi when rushing from immigration to the gate The terminal building is quite clean and adequate The only downside is the crowd outside the arriving gate exit There were lots of illegal taxis touting arriving passengers The lack of seating area outside the terminal is also a concern as it was hard to find a proper place to sit while waiting for someone to arrive

OV th March and OV th March AmsterdamTallinn Decent legroom nice inflight magazine and even boarding with a proper jetway at Tallinn for the return flight Good inflight service featuring a solid drinks menu with Estonias superb A LeCoq lager and Viru Valge vodka not a bad little airline at all I had flown them before in on a CopenhagenTallinn round trip with similar results

Very satisfactory flights Adequate leg room with blocked off seats Rapid checkin and security Good three course hot meals both ways Swiss had subcontracted to Baltic outbound and Helvetic for the return with little noticeable change in service

I flew China Airlines of Taiwan from Vienna to Taipei in December with an onward journey to Bangkok and Taipei to Vienna in January in their business class The cabin of the A was kept clean and the equipment is modern despite not having a privacy door the privacy was great A is definitely my favorite airplane I have much less jetlag after long haul flights I heard the airline is upgrading its product in years Service on both flights was truly first class Very engaging and friendly and nothing is too much trouble for the crew On the outbound flight the crew working in my section was super professional on par with the standard offered by Singapore Airlines On my return journey Magret was super friendly and take personal care of the passengers The cabin manager on the return journey was also very pleasant and helpful Food onborad was excellent China Airlines unlike its competitor EVA or Starlux doesnt offer an intensive menu but the food and drink quality is really good On the way back I chose the course prepared by a Michelin star restuanrat in Taipei but my favorite is always the special vegetarian food which is also Michelin star and you need to preorder online The lounge in Taipei is either very busy morning peak hours and also evening or very quiet There is no natural light so it is dark However it is tastefully decorated and the food was very tasty Service like their onboard standard was very personal and friendly There is always a queue for the shower due to the terminal size the lounge isnt large Hopefully this will be addressed once Terminal opens so make sure you put your request in early Onboard wifi worked well and there is no data cap that is a huge bonus Now comes the cons the business class seat on A is equipped with a very large and clear monitor but the entertainment choice is fairly limited not sufficient moviesTVmusic to keep me occupied Also the seat and amenity is great especially the duvet but when the seat is fully flat the leg space becomes a bit constrain

This review is limited to Terminal only Terminal is about years old and a significant upgrade over Terminal The terminal is very clean brightly lit and wide concourses There are dining options aplenty and plenty of seating at the gates Immigration was a smooth process with biometric screening epassport line Took no more than minutes in line Upon exiting customsbaggage claim one has to run the gauntlet of the time share vultures Surprisingly there are no benches for passengers to sit awaiting ground transportation pickup Departure experience was very pleasant Easy checkin with minimal wait times for security and immigration

As you pull into Long Beach Airport the parking structure is conveniently located right across from the terminal Checkin and security screening took less than minutes in the afternoon hours Long Beach has an open natural and airy terminal You will find palm trees small birds and abundance of sunshine on this terminal There are enough seats for you to sit and relax Dining options are very good Free wifi also works well This airport does not use jet bridge so you will enter and exit the aircraft using stairs or ramp Baggage claim area is small but appropriate for an airport with a vintage look

I flew roundtrip to visit family for Christmas week On the outbound leg all the flight attendants were decked out in their fanciest tackiest holiday finery We even had the Grinch try to run down the jetway at LaGuardia Plentiful snacks and the WiFi worked well enough for the inflight entertainment bring your own device for that I was also able to use the WiFi to track my luggage through the Southwest website The best part is unlike other airlines one can check up to two bags for free very important when youre bringing NYC goodies to Brooklyn expats Flights took off on time and arrived on time the outbound to SMF arrived early in fact so early we had to wait for a gate Ten out of ten would recommend

I have flown in and out of this airport on several occasions although I dont live in Kentucky I mean it is a small airport serving a small city so dont go expecting any big city amenities other than just a couple of sitdown restaurants a Dunkin Donuts and a small store But it is surprisingly spacious extremely clean and very modern Signage is clear staff and security are friendly the terminals are small and manageable and there is even complex and beautiful artwork on the floor in security honoring the regions thoroughbred horse racing heritage Lastly where else can you park in the parking garage that is only around feet from the terminal The ease simplicity and friendliness of this airport makes it one of my favorite airports in the world and Ive been all over North America and Europe

First time to use this Airport and I have mixed feelingsThe poor signage makes this a difficult airport to find on a first trip However it is a rare pleasure to be able to park mere yards from the terminal Mind you at Euro a day it is far from cheap Yet the automated pay machines do not accept Euro notes or Laser debit cards Staff are very friendly and the small size of the building is makes a pleasant change from most other airports At present catering is limited to drinks and snacks Beware of one outrageous thing each passenger is required to pay a fee of Euro at checkin to fund the future development of the airport Nowhere during the booking process is this mentioned Furthermore when other busineses plan expansions there is no requirement for current customers to pay upfront I would have thought that as with most business plans additional facilities would be funded from the additional revenues received

SkyUp is definitely an interesting airline Going into this trip I was not really sure what to expect from a low cost airline that tends to receive high ratings We had booked second row seats for dollars each My original seat which was located on the left side of the aircraft ABC did not have the extra legroom that was promised However since the flight was mostly empty I was able to move to the right side of the aircraft seats DEF These rows had substantially more seatpitch and could definitely be compared to that of other airlines premium economy As for the seats themselves they were quite thin and similar in shape to that of spirit airlines or easyjet but nonetheless it still had a great recline angle In terms of service itself the airline does not have any food or drinks besides water on flights to or from any city but Kyiv so beware and plan to bring your own food onboard There was no in flight magazine or wifi only a QR code for you to download an online journal before takeoff The aircraft landed on time and overall it was a smooth flight

Hiroshima Airport is a small domestic airport and international services at this airport have only been commenced recently so I do not have a high expectation upon my visit in midNovember The airport is small and there are only limited facilities and restaurants available and they charge JPY for people who wish to visit the observation decka down side compared to the major airports in Japan where the observation decks are free of charge Access to the airport is not at all convenient as no trains or subway lines can reach the airport The only choices are limousine buses and rental cars from other cities Nevertheless the airport is very clean and the ground staff both immigration and airline staff are efficient It took me shorter than minutes from disembarking the aircraft to leaving the airport The limited number of restaurants can also provide a satisfactory range of food choices for visitors Given that Hiroshima Airport is only a small regional airport the airport has met my expectations and I would not hesitate in using this airport again upon my next travel to Japan

Cleanliness of Terminal toilets and food section must be improved Toilets seems to be unattended for ages floor is full of tissues and stains Bins are full Food court tables and chairs are under the same condition which is quite surprising as per Japan standard Air Conditioning is not cool enough seats at he waiting area are also not enough However I still love to come back to visit Japan again

The brand new terminal is now open and is spectacular Any deficiencies from previous reviews are now remedied More gates with jetways more shops and restaurants Check in was seamless as was immigration facilities Clean and modern and when the new train system is functioning it will be easy to get into the city

Mahan Air from Kuala Lumpur to Tehran Check in was fast and friendly The signage to find the premier lounge in Kuala Lumpur airport was almost nonexistent and took me a while to locate the lounge which offered minimum amenities Boarding was efficient and the A was packed for this flight The aircraft interior was new and clean with smiling crew The flat bed was great and plenty of food was offered for this hour flight Perhaps the refreshment pizza and a burrito at the end of the flight was a bit too much Only negative thing I can think of was not much entertainment and it was limited to public LCDs Considering the business class fare was almost cheaper than other airlines which operated indirect service it was a good buy I was especially impressed by the very attentive flight attendants Overall a good flight

Tibet Airlines offered great service and comfortable seating with ample legroom Chengdu to Lijiang is a relatively short flight of hour but crew were very accommodating They had inflight entertainment showing on screens in both English and Chinese Water only served on this flight but would recommend Tibet Airlines

A quick efficient security check just inside the door then youre in a big lobby and go to a checkin counter which you must do at any rate for a flight out of Russia even if you printed a boarding pass online so dont bother There are plenty of shops and places to eat both before and after formal passport control and formal security each of which involved less than minutes queuing Quintessentially Russian the passport officer never smiled but he was efficient and in no way discourteous Restrooms are clean and wellmaintained I awaited boarding in a nice lounge but almost all the newspapers to read are in Russian which I cant read Ample seating area at gate My flight to Paris had boarding via a jetway

Air New Zealand representative named Leanne was very helpful when I needed help to check in my ft surfboard she was helpful when I needed help to print out my boarding pass exceptional patience and excellent customer skills

Volaris is starting to grow on me It is quickly becoming my favourite Mexican airline The nofuss booking procedure and easytounderstand and reasonably priced baggage options are just some of the perks this airline offers They are just a good allaround no fuss no frills good airline

A great airport only one hour from New York City that is still a secret A major stop for SouthWest it is a welcome relief from the congestion at La Guardia or worse JFK Nice new buildings with convenient parking for locals or access to a train station with links to all of long island and NYC

A lowcost airline and they enforce bag weights and sizes and number of bags very closely Despite that if you buy early its a good value for travel in and around Kazakhstan Purchase bags early as they charge a lot at airport My flight however was fine arrived on time with no issues Overall satisfied for what I paid

Air Belgium for Srilankan Airlines Uncomfortable business class seat looks well used only good thing was the massage function Mix of crew from Air Belgium and Srilankan mostly friendly Food was tasty and filling a good variety to chooses from Toilet wasnt overly clean

Very nice and comfortable Estonian Air flight from Copenhagen to Vilnius via Tallinn crew friendly and smiling Even if Tallinn airport is very small connection time was too tight Smaller aircraft to Vilnius but comfortable For reasons unknown there were no sales on this h min flight A good experience for the price and safety was taken seriously

I Flew on flight TK on the th February from Istanbul to Bangkok which was an excellent business class flight experience The food on board was as usual very good indeed as was the superb service provided by cabin crew hostess Grulsah She was extremely friendly and very professional for which I would like to thank her for If I had one perhaps negative comment to make and that is regarding the dated seating layout on the airbus A Which with a layout of doesnt provide much in the way of privacy and should if possible be changed to a layout That aside the flight itself arrived into Bangkok exactly on time Highly recommended

Clean efficient and friendly The Norwegians do these things very well There is everything you need at this airport cafe bar shop etc but without the hassle of larger airports I would recommend the region for any tourist and Trondheim is a very attractive city

KigaliParis th Dec on one of their A aircrafts Checked in online smooth but is unnecessary and does neither add value nor gain time I chose an entire seatrow for free due to my Gold Status with Rwandairs Dream Miles Program Marburg declarations forms have to be filled prior to enter the airport Checkin slow minutes per pax but they managed to checkin luggage onwards with other airline Dream lounge in Kigali is a pleasure with panorama windows over town Catering options varied a bit sparse the best hot snacks appear not to reach the lounge easily only on firm request I suspect that they are consumed by lounge staff have seen indications hereof Wines are subpar No sparkling wine offered Flight on time full on time Seafood meal preordered and given Generous catering They gave me on early request an entire row onboard for better sleep Blankets earset and pillows given Very affordable ticket USD tr purchased months before departure Extremely good value for money Miles given
Great airport Easy to park easy to get to terminal and fast security Beats almost every other larger airport I have been to Not much to do but you wont be there long anyway

Easy access by bus or taxi Two terminals International on the right Domestic on the left as you face them but only metres apart Signs in English as well as Russian although all announcements are in Russian as you would expect How many of the staff speak English may be a good question one who does is the AviaNova manager Easy layout to navigate in domestic terminal although there is not much space for the checkin queues so they snake around the room However the staff for my flight anyway were very efficient and the queue moved quickly Security check was quick and easy Airside has an expensive cafe and coffee shop as well as a newsstand and gift shop Plenty of comfortable seating WiFi is available good signal but every site I tried came up with Security Certificate not issued by Trusted Source so theres possibly some bug in their software I didnt do any more than just log in Bussed to plane only complaint as with so many of these airports is that you go upstairs to a departure lounge and then have to walk back down for the bus

My wife and I had a twohour transit at Muscat between flights with Oman Air Our time in the airport was unexpectedly pleasant The terminal building gives a new and modern appearance but with features of traditional Arabic architecture The total effect is aesthetically very pleasing and supported by mellow background music Travel through the terminal was not onerous although distances between gates and other transit points were long most of it could be covered by moving walkways Security check was painless and efficient with short queues At the departure gate there was a nice separation between boarding pass check and seating in the waiting area There was plenty of seating in the gate and we appreciated the boarding procedures being separated by zone One negative there was no obvious place to get a coffee in the transit areas we passed through although signage pointing to another part of the terminal suggested eating and drinking options elsewhere

This was a short flight Just under two hours Checkin a breeze with many selfservice kiosks Plane is turboprop Seats are firm and do not recline One small toilet at front of plane Aisle narrow Overhead storage small Board and exit from front and rear This is great for passengers Also larger carryon luggage can be placed at no cost into luggage storage This is helpful Horizon offers free craft beer and wine and serve Starbucks coffee Cabin crew very personable and efficient Overall very satisfied with Horizon and this flight Will use again

Hong Kong to Kahsioung A quite nice flight It was my first time flying an Embraer jet I know it is small but the seat is comfortable and wide A delicious hot meal was served in a mins flight The crew is friendly and fluent in English The only bad thing is that the flight was delayed for hours
Mahon is clean light and airy with reasonable shopping facilities and bars the seating area is particularly good with a view of the airfield and runway and plenty of space

New international terminal is ok but nothing special departure gates in total so not very big On arrival most people did VOA visa on arrival so queue to get it and then another queue to pay it took quite long On departure checkin and security went smoothly on airside there were only one shop and a caf open so there wasnt much to do Wifi is free but works onoff not good for streaming anything but good enough for basic surfing At least terminal is new and clean with decent air conditioning

Frequented CMB many times in the last decade and on the whole its ok It runs pretty smoothly and in fact has improved over the years the immigration particularly seems quicker I do however hate the exorbitant dollar priced fooddrink and duty free etc The contrast between what this cost just outside the door or the airport and the terminal prices must be one of the biggest contrasts in the world That said its a pretty painless experience to pass through

Darwin Airport is a small to midsized airport It has limited food options during the off peak times of the day but is sufficient enough There are plenty of seats to wait on before boarding and the maximum time taken through security is about minutes

Brisbane to Honiara return on Solomon Airlines IE flying on a Qantas code share QF in economy An aging but wellmaintained A which does the journey in a shade over three hours Flying on a Qantas Code Share and with premium FF status my luggage was booked through to my final destination and I was able to access the Qantas Business lounge in Brisbane and the Belama Lounge in Honiara Seats are leather and well spaced by economy standards with sufficient leg room There is no inflight entertainment but the meal service was generous for a relatively short flight with constant refills of wine available The cabin crew are among the friendliest I know and give very good service The only competition on this route is Virgin with a similar fare structure and limited service so airfares are not particularly low but if purchased well in advance are not unreasonable for a fairly lowtrafficked route

What a pleasant airport easy check in good facilities cool and well organised As enjoyable as an airport experience can be This was in complete contrast to our home airport of Bristol UK Everything seemed so well organised and customer focused
Makassar to Singapore Crowded flight Long checkin queue and time The takeoff is smooth Great service a good meal The flight attendant is great

Pensacola isnt a fancy airport but its fine functional and beautiful Even the exterior architecture greets travelers in a way that reminds them of the waves and big skies of Florida This is also a better alternative in my opinion to flying out of other Gulf Coast airports such as Mobile Tallahassee and GulfportBiloxi Pickup and dropoff are a breeze Checkin is hasslefree Security is a breeze and even more so with TSA PreCheck Dining and shopping options arent ample but do get the job done nicely remember PNS is a small airport Boarding the flight is easy Pensacola is just a very modern efficient airport one that reminds me a lot of other smaller airports like Louisville however no small airports in this country set the world standard like Wellington and Christchurch both in New Zealand do

My first experience with Malm Aviation flying from StockholmBromma to Malm Cheap fares friendly cabin crew comfortable aircraft free meal and coffee on that domestic flight Do you recognize SAS Youre right it isnt SAS It is Malm Aviation

This is a small airport to say the least It only has gates and this is after it is being modernized and expanded Construction is still going on so it can be a bit noisy Security is fairly painless There is only one restaurantlounge airside or curbside Hopefully this will change when construction is complete Airside has floor to ceiling windows affording views of the spectacular Tetons Almost as impressive is the array of private jets lined up toward the south end of the airport If you fly here be sure to take a daytime flight in and book an F side window seat for a jawdropping view of the Tetons on approach

Yangon to Mandalay I have flown FMI Air four times now They provide one of the best customer experiences of any airline I have flown Staff is professional and friendly Lounges are wellequipped and comfortable Aircraft are clean In the often confusing and cattleherding feel of domestic Myanmar flight FMI stands out for the comparative serenity of the experience Flights are roughly USDleg more than competitors When you factor in lounge comfort and beverages good internet and the relaxed feel ar both departure and arrival its worth the extra money

The obligatory show of your boarding pass on boarding the plane Dont expect duty free air conditioned waiting areas business lounges or facilities smiles hello thank you goodbye catering information desk assistance even from airline representatives or toilet facilities and you wont be left disappointed But once outside the Worlds Worst Airport you will meet the most pleasant courteous and honest people that I have ever personally encountered Welcome to the real Sudan
