Chicago OHare to Savannah and return October Have used Savannah HHI International for many years when flying to Hilton Head Island SC A really very pleasant little airport serving mostly Delta and United Express internal flights Friendly check in staff quick luggage retrieval and absolutely the best Car Rental desks just yards along the same floor from Luggage Retrieval with the cars park right outside the Terminal This is a relatively small International Airport but there is a pleasant courtyard with a couple of shops and eating choices with lots of tables and chairs and a great information desk Once through security there is a surprising range of nice eating choices BUT of course they may not necessarily be open for a late night departure Have used many USA Airports over the years but this and RenoSparks in Nevada is the gem would unhesitatingly recommend

Always a pleasure to fly with Swiss safety comes first with them then the comfort On my flight back to Switzerland from Bucharest I had such a nice experience thanks to Paul who attended the business class passengers I felt like I am flying first Class because of his service

Bangkok to Osaka Smooth check in and efficient seat allocation They didnt check cabin baggage weight nor size Had to buy food and drinks as refused internet preorder because we used a travel agent Seats ok but a night flight which was very uncomfortable Saw in the inflight magazine we could upgrade enroute to premium economy a good idea For B a good flight

RGNSNW Quick boarding with allocated seating for minute flight in ATR to Ngapali Beach Good safety briefing before time take off and light snack and drink en route Pleasant FAs smooth flight and great landing over the surf and through the palm trees to this small exRAF WW strip on the Bay of Bengal Luggage is delivered by handcart to the entrance gatesexpect to pay kyat per piece

Ive flown through this airport or times now and its always a good experience Its a lovely modern building the staff are very helpful securitycustomsimmigration has always been quick and painless It only takes mins by train they have a decent airport hotel located in the domestic arrivals terminal and its always spotless

The airport is very big so you better arrive early if you have international flight Immigration queuing might take more than an hour and duty free is very far away from lounges and gates so you might have to choose between duty free or visiting the lounge Staff are generally friendly even under pressure

Nice Airport Well organised checkin for B and speedy transit through TSA roomy concourse and nice Buffalo wings There was a fire alarm while we were there which was dealt with with only minor disruption good views of the apron and active runway A good alternative to Toronto for Niagara

From Zanzibar to Arusha ATR arrived on time from Dar el Salam Friendly staff and they offer snack and juices and alcoholic drinks On arrival our suitcases arrived in a short time Overall good experience
No one checked our vaccination upon entry which raises alarm bells Jetstar staff as usual are incredibly rude and money grabbing The facilities are cute and basic

No frills quick easy safely and clean flights from Dagestan to Moscow The airplane was clean the staff in nice uniforms professional They packed us quickly flew us safely the baggage was out sooner than I made it to the carousel Only a glass of water for the whole flight but it is only hours Nothing to complain about would fly again and recommend

No traffic problems getting there The long term car park is but mtrs from the main entrance The check in is mtrs from the gate The security checks are a breeze especially when those passengers approaching the scanners have remembered to remove the required articlestheir scanners are the most sensitive of any I have ever encountered There is a very nice restaurant area cum bar The area is generally clean and well kept The security staff should appear more friendly accepting that they have a very important job to do

This airport is highly recommended Many of the reviews below are pre which is when the facility completed a full upgrade of terminal and gates I would discard any pre reviews as irrelevant to the current condition Long Beach Airport is a welldesigned and pleasant experience compared with LAX and to a degree John Wayne Its a smaller but more efficient facility with competitively priced parking within an easy walk of your gate The TSA Security Checkpoint is relatively fast compared with other airports The facility boasts two outdoor seating areas for two of its restaurants a comparative luxury in this age of airport design being little more than shopping malls with airline gates The central area between the two terminals is an outdoor seating area allowing for a retreat from the madness at the gates One of the unique aspects of LGB is the lack of jetways Walking out onto the tarmac to board a plane is a fun and different experience which adds significantly to the charm of this facility Long Beach doesnt have the cold and sterile feel of most modern airports and that is a welcome aspect of flying here There are a number of restauranteating choices available though the shopping is a relatively weak area In general Long Beach is easily my favorite American airport and is qualitatively far better than the vast majority of facilities I use

Very clean airport arrival and departure very well organized Lots of places to sit with a view of the runway in the departure hall The Billa supermarket located in the airport terminal is a good choice Transport fromto the airport very easy

My flights were delayed for many hours due to weather in Dallas El Paso airport is the best airport to be stranded in It has an easilyaccessed smoking area in a lovely courtyard Its small enough to get around quickly but big enough to have decent food My delays would have been much worse in a larger airport but El Paso airport made my delays manageable Staff were also great Security and the like especially outside directing vehicle traffic were nice and helpful offering extra help or information if I needed it Love this airport The only minor annoyance was that it did not have a lot of charging ports in the seating areas so I had to stand while my phone was charging

As per a previous review on checkin was advised that bags could only be sent as far as Haikou At that point I would have to enter China collect baggage then checkin for BKK flight And thats despite both flights being on a single ticket Upon arrival then had issues at passport control They wanted evidence of my nd flight The print out I had on me simply said SYD BKK And had no wifi access Eventually was allowed in The flights themselves were great Relatively modern planes with attentive flight attendants in business on the A and on the Western food options on the way over Very much Chinese on the way back For the price I paid it was a great option but hrs to BKK instead of hours might turn others off

Originally booked through Canaryfly Upon arrival at airport we saw that our flight was cancelled We didnt receive any notice but it turned out very smooth as we were already booked on a Binter flight at the original time To us it seemed as this happens frequently and they have a good system in place The flight was enjoyable and the cabin crew did a very good job

This is an efficient and wellequipped airport For travellers on AA beware that ground staff and security dont seem to communicate The security channel for US departures remained closed until beyond the scheduled time of departure with no explanation given The departure boards didnt show that there was a minute delay and instead left all boarding passengers to wait outside the secure area This seems to be a specific AA problem

This is a nice airport people are friendly check in efficient It is a clean airport and it has a nice building with plants and water fonts Brasilia is a modern City and it is airport is like the city just fantastic

Excellent airport and decent size it is not as huge as other asian mega hubs but it means getting in the out of the airport is very quick From touching town to the taxi it took mins maximum Signposts are very clear and there are so many staff to help you all very friendly The airport is dated and is due for a refurb yet it is spotless Departure experience was also great Check in was easy immigration and security very fast and smooth despite not having priority lane for business class custmers There are some interesting shop aside the global boutique and plenty of seats to rest There are even free lounge area which is like a living room Airlines lounges in TPE arent good quality with the exception of Cathay Pacific but there are a lot of FB offers especially in Terminal

Ronald Reagan Washington National Airport is a welldesigned and highly efficient airport that makes traveling a seamless experience The terminal layout is intuitive making navigation easy and stressfree With a wide range of dining and shopping options passengers have plenty of choices to enjoy before their flight The airport is clean modern and offers a comfortable atmosphere with ample seating and wellmaintained facilities Security is wellmanaged ensuring a safe and smooth travel experience Whether youre on a quick layover or starting a journey DCA provides convenience comfort and efficiency at every step

I specifically chose to fly with TransNusa to try out flying on the COMAC ARJ of which the carrier currently operates two of these aircraft at the moment and is also the first airline in the world outside of China to operate this small commercial jetliner Thankfully there wasnt much of a negative experience everything from checkin to boarding to the inflight experience was prompt and precise even if it werent spectacular As TransNusa opts for a singleclass layout the aircraft has a capacity of passengers seated in rows of The smaller capacity of the aircraft meant that boarding and disembarkation was completed fairly quickly and smoothly Arguably the only sore point of the flight was having to use a bus to board the aircraft instead of using an aerobridge TransNusa includes kg of checked bags as part of the basic air ticket so thats a nice gesture to have Despite having to land in heavy rain at KLIA the entire journey was uneventful and decently pleasant and it suggests that the COMAC ARJ will prove a contender in the regional small commercial jetliner market in the years to come

On arrival the airport was very clean There was water fountains and music It was very peaceful When we departed checkin was so easy and security was simple There were lots of shops and dutyfree Overall One of the best airports in the world

This airport is very small for the number of passengers and airlines it is serving Everywhere seemed to be crowded and felt cramped I thought they needed more space for better facilities and customer service Transferring from the train coming from London to the terminal and between terminals was very easy and well signage The prayer room is available and wellmaintained and the toilets are clean Not a pleasant experience for shopping and dining as there are too many people in a cramped space

Flying from LHR to BKK Went through additional security checkpoint smoothly No big queues New clean and pleasant terminal All information were given very clear Hope to have such terminals more often in Europe Glad to be here again

Booked with TUI and we were informed the flight had been changed to SmartLynx I was initially nervous about this change as I had not heard of them But it was an excellent flight and service Pilot was great communication throughout the flight adding extras talking about places we were flying over and could spot etc Just put us all at ease more I felt The plane was clean and comfortable and had more room than any previous TUI planes I had been on One of my best flights

Burbank provides a convenient and easy alternative to LAX although the departure hall in Terminal B is too small to accommodate more than flights at a time There were flights an MD a and CRJ regional jets boarding simultaneously and the small space and cramped conditions caused confusion and delayed boarding for everyone

ITO is absolutely lovely I flew in HNLITO and out ITOOGG Outdoor type airport and probably the most easytouse airport I have ever had the pleasure of using Very tropical theme Car rentals are right across the street from curbside pickup Checking in is very easy for those using Island Air There is a restaurant in the middle that gets very busy during breakfast so get there early if you dont want to stand in a line that goes out the door

While waiting for passport control I felt very hot and dizzy I asked a make member of staff if I could have some water He got me through security got me water and made sure I was ok Very helpful and I wish I knew his name to thank him
Very pleasant service on Madrid flight and Vigo flight Professional pleasant crew who were attentive and friendly The food was of a good quality nothing spectacular but good

Apart from the fact that the crew at Incheon were a little rude everything was perfect For a low cost airline the seats were very comfy and the legroom was amazing I would definitely recommend this airline

Very modest airport that clearly cannot handle a high volume of flights Check in is very modest and slow and people speak very basic English Undoubtedly we are facing a country that urgently needs tourism and foreign funds to improve the quality of its infrastructure Fortunately the new international airport in Phnom Penh will open in a few years and I hope they will be able to guarantee the cleanliness of the space a better quality of service increase the number of places where you can sit and also the spaces before boarding
Newquay airport is excellent apart from the abysmal state of seating in the main departure lounge Seating all torn and very scruffy It has been like this for a long time Unacceptable

I chose this airline for the simple reason of its aircraft type Boarding was completed quickly for on time departure On board seat pitch was a little tight snack service box was offered water and a sweet coffee bun and a sales trolley after that Cabin was quite warm and no walk though by cabin crew offering water Cabin is showing it age for sure but still enjoyed my flight

I recently flew from PHL to DCA on American Eagle operated by Republic and it was another fantastic experience The E remains my favorite aircraft for regional travelspacious comfortable and perfect for short flights Despite the flight being only minutes the crew went above and beyond by offering beverage service which exceeded my expectations for such a short route As someone who travels this route twice a week I deeply appreciate the attentiveness of the regional air crew who consistently provide a level of care and attention that rivals the mainline carrier Excellent service all around

I arrived early for checkin at GIG Staff arrived just under hours before departure but then spent the better part of half an hour getting ready Once opened checkin was a breeze No line at security or immigration as this is the first international flight departing Rio Priority checkin for business class so I boarded as one of the first people Clean cabin but recliner seats with rather limited recline The really bad part was that the neck rest was at shoulder height so the seat was rather uncomfortable The flight attendant spoke Spanish and offered a drink Later breakfast was served omelette and croissant Omelette was good and included half a slice of ham Croissant had no resemblance to any croissant I have had before Portions generally too small Arrival in Peru without any waiting time at Immigration or Customs Bags were amongst the first to hit the carrousel Checkin was easy as I had to go to a special line to pay the change fee No queue at neither immigration or security Access to Sumaq lounge which is so so Once again priority boarding and a clean plane The seats were older in this aircraft and very hard old school recliner seats Much better male attendant who spoke excellent English Drinks just after boarding and dinner Choices were fish or lasagne I opted for the fish which was a nice tilapia with rice Again very small portion Despite a pm departure time I got little sleep due to the poor seat Reached Rio on time and no lines anywhere as this is the first international flight to land in Rio Bags were among the last to hit to carrousel which once again shows that regardless of airline the priority tags are largely decorative Overall an ok experience To be honest I would probably not book TACA if alternatives were available

Tallinn is my favourite airport of all airports Ive been to Its so small lovely and there are never crowds flowing around There are about gates The Business Lounge is quiet and comfy and theres always enough food Its main difference is the low ceiling compared to other airports There arent many restaurants or shops but the Tax Free Shop has almost everything needed for your flight Staff very friendly and WiFi works well

Pleasant surprise Planes were new and clean Staff was attentive and efficient Flights were on time We prebooked meals which were quite nice We booked during holiday season so tickets were on the more expensive side but all in all good value Would fly with them again
We loved Lynx It was Super affordable planes were on time and no delays We dont eat on planes anyway so who cares Will definitely be flying again
Lovely crew Very clean plane and rather comfy seating The seat belt sign was on most of the flight although not much turbulence Quite many announcements The food was fine but wine glasses very small

I absolutely love the WilkesBarreScranton International Airport Small enough to accommodate us easily friendly staff and yet large enough for us to easily reach any destination We especially love the fact that they now have Breeze Airlines which will allow us to increase our travel from this airport Great move on both parts

Marseille to Zurich A lazy checkin not Helvetic employee who did not want to check my luggage through its final destination neither to release a lounge voucher Star Alliance Gold I finally had a great trip in this old Fokker Crew was extremely attentive flight on time and aircraft clean as snow

Titan Airways flew us back from Mytilene to Manchester Flight ZT as part of the repatriation after TC collapsed The flight was excellent particularly the stewardesses who were helpful efficient and courteous The plane was very clean with better leg room than Ive had before on a typical economy class carrier at anytime in the past outside of long haul flights The only gripe I had was the in flight entertainment it didnt work even though it said I was connected I got no connection to it at anytime of trying This is why its only a and not a star review

Two LAN Colombia return flights inside Colombia from Bogot to Cartagena and then Bogot to Pereira One was shortly delayed because of the bad weather conditions in Pereira heavy rainfall and another one because a passenger decided in the last minute not to fly In both cases the cockpit keeped us informed and apologized for both delays Being a domestic flight there were only complementary drinks served and because the flight to Pereira was very short like minutes not everybody got something but a good manage from the crew Checkin using their App is piece of cake There was entertainment using their new App via WiFi on one of their flights and it did work without problems Overall a very good experience

Moscow to Thessaloniki I usually use this company in my trips to Moscow Even if i was wondering about this new company that they use leasing airplanes i tried it and i want to say just one thing these are our lovely Greeks Every trip is small party specially when the destination is a Greek airport People are drinking free alcohol Greek wine they are eating and are enjoying their trip Staff is very goodThey use more than languages

One of the easiest domestic airports to figure out Just a couple of restaurants but each one has great selection of food Theyve been getting better flights and it is transitioning to more of a transit type airport Staff is scarce but ticket counters are fast to checkin and the security line is real quick minutes at the most I now start my journey to any destination from here

The seats in the Terminal waiting areas are very comfortable The security process looked ominous at first but I was constantly moving and when it came time for the scan I did not have to take off my belt or shoes and got through the security process comfortably I wish Portland Airport was like that

Reykjavik to Akureyri I have never been on a friendlier serviced aircraft than this Absolutely wonderful flight only minutes and quite a unique experience on a propeller plane Absolutely love the onboard travel journal where you can read other passengers adventures and write your own in very sweet Would love to fly with them again next time Im in Iceland

Flew direct from Paris to Kigali New Years evening on A Change of terminal in Paris can take hours best is to leave the transit and use the trains Rwandair has only aircraft and only two airline partners thus potentially things can go wrong Luggage transfers are often not accepted by other airlines Checkin in T went smooth though the lady was not experienced neither knowing aircraft type nor terminal well I have a goldcard with this airline which gave access to the very nice Extime contract Lounge in T Despite that the flight was full I managed at boarding to get seats for myself and could recline and stretch out Catering faultless my preordered special meal was quite good Drinks given generously at all times Wines were acceptable Headsets pillows and blankets given to everybody IFE was working well and choices were sufficient In the morning a modest breakfast was served without any hot drinks these could be obtained in galley Staff were humble polite well groomed and in general very active On time all luggage handled well Cheap promotional ticket bought months prior to travel Recommend

Airport is away from city and not good public transport available better to use cab Not too busy most of times so not long queue at entry check in and security mostly min to complete all formality Limited food options needs more there is one lounge but one of the smallest and least food options i found in India only suggested if having complementary lounge access Shopping options is also very limited only recommend tea shop if didnt got time to buy tea in city which is famous for Toilets needs to be more clean Shortage of sitting space on both floors Free Wifi only for min This airport need proper maintenance now

It was an exceptional experience from start to finish The checkin process was efficient with friendly staff who were more than willing to assist Boarding was wellorganized and the flight departed on time Onboard I was impressed by the cleanliness of the cabin and comfortable seating The flight attendants were professional attentive and ready to help with a warm smile Their hospitality made the journey even more enjoyable

Wonderful customer service Great staff at the airport and on the plane Even better we needed to make changes to our flight and the customer service centre responded to a web enquiry within minutes at oclock at night on a Friday Simple and easy to deal with and a very comfortable clean aircraft

Well the airport is small so no comment there Toilets pretty clean However theres a bus every hour The bus driver doesnt sell tickets so I missed my bus at am for having to go back inside find the ticket machine somewhere and stay in a queue and buy it Theres no shade for the people and there are lots of children and pregnant women Information point nowhere to be seen

Travelled from Dusseldorf to London Stansted booked as Air Berlin flight but actually it was Etihad Regional operated by Darwin Airline I could not book the seat in advance and were forced to wait at the airport until checkin counter opened Flight was stated as delayed by minutes but actually this was more than minutes with very few announcements Flight itself was comfortable SAAB is unique aircraft with one seat on one side and two seats on the other side of the cabin which I like Fortunately I sat on one seat which was good for me As it was an evening flight they gave a bread snack which for a short flight is fair As I like this aircraft maybe if I have a chance I will take this flight again however I would not recommend to my friends

This is an excellent new airline everything was perfect from the checkin to boarding onboard experience meals video entertainment the flight and baggage retrieval All the staff were friendly and very helpful Will definitely choose this airline again At Chiang Mai the airline uses the Thai Airways lounge

I have flown times on La Companie so far and could not be happier It makes me laugh to see complaints about ground accommodations and old planes etc this is an airline that flies to a manageable airport Orly with lower taxes than for example CDG it is a boutique operation with limited flights and proposes business class flights RT for as low as vs on poorer major airlines It is great value for the price and grumpy people can still spend their on a coach ticket booked on United coping with the CDG mess and see if they are offered hot towels full meal champagne and most importantly business class seats with better air quality

Albury is a pleasant airport The staff are kind and knowledgeable There are gates departure and arrival The lines are short but it is still good to get in early The seats in the boarding lounges are somewhat comfortable When it comes to security its okay The airlines that you need to go through security for are Qantas and Virgin Australia but not Regional Express The terminal is clean especially the toilets The caf is overpriced but the food is ok The only shopping in the terminal is the caf Unlike most airports it is almost impossible to get lost in ABX The only drawback is that to get to and from the terminal to or from the plane you have to walk across the tarmac Out of all the airports I have been to ABX has been the best

PointePitre to Paris Orly Good service on this route in Classe Madras business class Flight took off and arrived on time A good dinner was served shortly after takeoff and a breakfast shortly before landing The cabin crew were friendly and professional However I have to say that I prefer the layout in the business class on their A The layout on this newer aircraft certainly has more functions but it looked quite cumbersome and crowded to me Incredibly the selection of French songs was also very limited Lounge in PointePitre was also quite small and very limited food good if you are on a diet as they were very slow to replenish the food supply Overall I think Air Carabes is good for this route but a few improvements can be made

I passed through this airport in July They had done a lot of improvements since the first time I flew through in and I know that its not totally finished now The price of food and beverages is pretty expensive The airport looks good and clean The staff are professional

Tiny yet functional airport which serves this remote South Pacific Island with regular flights by LATAM from Santiago and Papeete Airport is only open when these two flights arrive The terminal is a single storied structure very user friendly The airport has all the ambience of a tropical island palm trees open structures walk across the tarmac to disembark and board the aircraft even a moai a specimen of the islands iconic stone statues Before the baggage claim area is a stall where one can buy the National Park ticket in Chilean pesos or by credit card or US dollars On exiting the baggage claim area you find you hotel pick drivers waiting holding up your name There are also taxis The town is so close that you can even walk to your hotel if you have light luggage On departure the terminal hall becomes a bazaar with many stalls selling local souvenirs There is also a cafeteria Bathrooms are clean There is an exit check by the security services where they collect the stamped form that you have fill out before boarding the flight to IPC Rules limit stay on the island to days for both foreigners and Chileans There are also souvenir stalls restaurant and bathroom beyond the security check The covered gate area is open and you can watch your plane getting readied for your flight All very relaxing

I have to say I was quite impressed with this place The two terminals are easy to navigate and there is plenty of space Plenty of retail if such is your thing an I enjoyed my Stella as I waited for my next leg One thing I really liked is the ability to get WhatsApp updates for your flight schedule checkin gate departure gate etc I hadnt seen this before Surprised that all the announcements are in English

We flew the wonderful StarFlyer aircraft from Kansai to Tokyo Haneda The checkin staff was extremely friendly and quick and their security line had nobody in it The boarding was speedy we timed it and we got on and took off within minutes We were dissatisfied by the fact that we could not redeem United miles as the airline is partly owned by ANA overall the flight was above and beyond

This was a short flight Just under two hours Checkin a breeze with many selfservice kiosks Plane is turboprop Seats are firm and do not recline One small toilet at front of plane Aisle narrow Overhead storage small Board and exit from front and rear This is great for passengers Also larger carryon luggage can be placed at no cost into luggage storage This is helpful Horizon offers free craft beer and wine and serve Starbucks coffee Cabin crew very personable and efficient Overall very satisfied with Horizon and this flight Will use again
Airport is quite small and toilets are not so clean Not much to do while waiting for your flight but for a short wait the experience is not that bad
St Petersburg to Moscow Efficient check in Comfortable seats and a fairly decent snack sandwich Certainly good value for money and spot on with departurelanding times Would use again

I arrived at the airport from London Heathrow and travelled via Beijing On arrival at Terminal it was nearing pm and I had been travelling for over hours I wanted to get a taxi to the hotel and go to bed However none of the ATMs in the terminal accepted any of my debit cards I have had trouble in the past in rural areas but never at an international airport I was told to go to terminal one which had international arrivals and try there Fortunately the shuttle bus was free and I go to terminal Only one of the ATMs there which also happened to be the last one I tried accepted my card with one other machine down At other Chinese airports Beijing and XiAn Xingang they have always had ATMs from the big four banks Industrial and Commercial Bank of China Bank of China China Construction Bank Agricultural Bank of China I have never had a problem getting cash from these banks I would also note that the underground station just outside terminal one has multiple big four ATMs and is an excellent way to travel into the city I finally got to my hotel at midnight I wrote to the Airport while in China but never received a response

I used Tempelhof for the first and I guess last time last week It is wonderful why are modern airports not like this The history and architecture are fabulous of course but it also works incredibly well admittedly having so few flights means nothing is really under pressure As noted elsewhere public transport links are excellent one can be in the city centre within minutes of walking off the plane From the departure lounge to seat on the aircraft takes less than a minute I guess it is an anachronism in the st century but it is sad to say goodbye to an airport with real character

I recently flew with China Southern Airlines from Gatwick Airport to Changchun Airport via Zhengzhou to visit my family in China As I bordered the Boeing I was greeted with kind flight attendants who directed me to my seat On my seat was a pillow a thin blanket and headphones for the inflight entertainment We departed on time around in the evening UK time There was meals served and many drinks services with a variety of drinks ranging from fruit juices alcohols beer fizzy drinks and waters The meals were served on trays made up of a warm main dish with a side dish such as vegies and a desert Overall the food was tasty and plentiful There was a wide variety of movies which included Chinese and Western movies in many languages there was also fun mini games and an inflight map showing the progress of our flight I would say my flight to Zhengzhou took around and a half hours The seats were reclinable and padded well In my opinion it was quite comfy and I fell asleep quickly after watching a movie The cushion was soft and surprisingly the blanket offered a good amount of warmth The bathrooms and seats were all cleaned and maintained well and overall the flight was relaxed and peaceful My only complaint is that the cabin was a bit warn out and old with some pieces of fabric missing from the front bit of my seat This did not serve as an issue to me it was only aesthetically unpleasing Another suggestion from me is to offer an amenity kit as the flight was long haul Overall I had an amazing experience with friendly staff delicious meals and extreme comfort and good entertainment that kept me busy

A fine small airport great personal service clean well decorated easy parking simple and efficient signage has a luxury feel befitting the Palm Beach Clientele Food selection adequate and reasonable Parking is a breeze Always many security personnel and queue times very short A pleasure to travel to or from

One of the smallest airports Ive ever encountered Due to required visas for Laos there was a bit of a hold up at immigration but staff were thorough Luggage made it off the aircraft in an efficient manner so waiting times were minimal The whole arrivals area was so compact you could see the baggage hall from immigration and visa versa Interesting as the chaotic arrivals hall had all doors continually open and once you left the baggage collection area you could easily go back Our arrival was an evening one so most retail outlets were closed and inconveniently also the money exchange Not a bad little airport but renovation and refurbishment needed

Used T this time for both departure and arrival I fancy this strange facility with flavor of s after its recent refurbishment Overall clean and well looked after with all lifts and escalators and travelators working with meaningful food options bearable security queues and convenient transportation access via bus and monorail it does the job and does not irritate Well done

Its a smaller airport compared to Mumbai not a problem actually Some toilets on the arrival hall are not good This airport has more shopping options now and its enough actually There are spa and lounge facilities available here The lounges are okay I have never experienced any delay to date Overall an above expectation feel It gets my job done

Even though it is small this is one of my favourite airports Its a minute walk from the plane to the terminal baggage is normally on the belt as soon as you arrive in and the best part is the cafe not only is it cheap but they have excellent hot bacon rolls and the fresh cakes are excellent too If only public transport links were better though I have been told the National Express service to London will soon call at Kent International

Air North describes its class of service as Yukoner Economy which I thought probably referred to a concept of warmhearted hospitality and generosity This held true for my first flight in their but after flying in the HS Im wondering if the term is actually more about resilience in the face of harsh conditions Cramped conditions in the HS aside the service overall was pretty good staff were almost all friendly and efficient flights ran on schedule and reasonable food was provided No inflight entertainment system but at the time I flew the stunning everchanging landscape below was all the entertainment I could want

The girl who initially was nice to us at the information desk then proceeded to question us at the departure lounge She looked disappointed when we produced our negative results and examined them very closely Travelling right now is stressful enough without somebody who is having a bad day create more stress

Surprisingly good experience departing Lisbon Airport Terminal on a Sunday evening with only hand luggage Far less crowded than I remembered from previous visits maybe I was lucky and security was a breeze The duty free area has been updated and toilets were clean It still has the low cost look and feel and does not have very attractive departure lounge or places to plug your phone and laptop but overall pretty efficient

From Gothenburg Sweden to Stockholm Sweden and back the same day A min flight Id developed a fear of flying from avoiding flying for years Before boarding I talked to the staff about this and they were very nice Very nice and considerate Perfect takeoffs and landings My advice for those in a similar situation would be tell the staff Dont rush be in plenty of time and tell the staff I had a very pleasant flight they served coffee tea or water with a small brownie Hot miniature towels afterwards Very attentive and polite Highly recommended

An unexpectedly pleasant experience The booking process was a bit odd but after using several different credit cards one finally worked on the airline website for a ticket about euros less than any other airline Check in and boarding was smooth Two suitcases allowed at kg each Or one at a maximum of kg There was entertainment with several English language recent films Ample food provided The layover was fine No one was saying anything about not taking photos and it wasnt any more different than transferring in China Seemed the duty free shops take card now too

Staff all very helpful in particular a lady from the special assistance team She went above and beyond what a lovely lady who clearly is very devoted to her job role We would choose to fly from Eindhoven airport again as our experience was so smooth and professionally handled Thank you such a small thing to say I hope this gets back to the whole team
Tried Premium Economy class and I was surprised about the seat quality and onboard meals This class also included amenity kit which I appreciate Cabin crew nicely handle my yo child

I was extremely impressed with Providence TF Green Airport It is high up on the list of my favorite small airport and heres a lowdown on it The Terminal It is all very straightforward with everything well signposted and not complicated at all Security is efficient and the multiple times weve gone through there wasnt much line at all After Security there is a decent selection of Shops and Dining The shops include the standard souvenir and news shops plus a few interesting clothes and accessory shops Foodwise there is a small but good variety of places to eat ranging from a Dunkin Donuts to an Oyster Bar The seating in the terminal is comfortable and regularly equipped with charging outlets The WiFi is nothing special free for minutes but at least its there Connections Norwegian Air advertises the airport as BostonProvidence While Providence isnt too far from Boston it is still a good hour driving The RIPTA bus service passes reasonably frequently and is a good way to get to downtown Providence I recommend that or the Peter Pan Coach over the MBTA train as that passes infrequently and only works on weekdays To get to Boston using Public transportation I would recommend taking the Coach as the train not only rarely passes but it takes forever as it stops at every station along the route And there it is A nice little airport clean and with good amenities The main problem is the lack of connections especially late at night which might make an uber the only option I really recommend it though even as a lowcost alternative to Boston

Flew in to SavannahHilton Head International September and departed October Once again an absolute pleasure to use My wife and I use this airport frequently when we travel to Hilton Head Island South Carolina On arrival my wife goes straight to the car rental desks about yards from baggage reclaim and I get the baggage from the belt Baggage retrieval usually takes minutes or so and by this time the car rental formalities have just about been completed The cars are just outside the Terminal doors and in about minutes we are on the Interstate On departure checking in with United Express is a breeze after handing back the rental car and then there is a very pleasant courtyard with retail caf outlets before going through security Even through security there are a surprising number and variety of eating and drinking outlets with a few retail shops Usual caveat if you have a late departure they may not all be open If only all Airports were this charming and nice to use

Lao Airlines is wonderful The planes was immaculate and while they no longer serve the little bags of chips they offer small bottles of water on even the shortest flights At least on shorter flights there is no video entertainment but who needs it on a local hop They have a terrific inflight magazine so five stars for that Checkin is a matter of minutes and since Laos is a small place with limited air traffic Ive never had to wait for security This is a tiny airline in a small country and they get it right

The security staff at Aberdeen airport are not up to standard Many of them are aggressive and argumentative and their main aim is not to be friendly or courteous I have been fortunate enough to travel to many countries and I say without hesitation that the security staff at Aberdeen airport are either the most poorly trained that I have encountered or that they are paying no attention to the training they receive The management team needs to review the training of the security staff at Aberdeen airport urgently

Frankfurt Main to Asmara The crew are most friendly The onboard service was excellent and standard of the aircraft was good though the legroom wasnt great The ground handling done by the airline at Asmara International Airport was efficient even though there were a number of shortcomings at the airport the airline got round them The price of the ticket was worth the service I received

Checkin at Gatwick Airport was smooth and efficient The airline uses the No Lounge which is nothing special but with comfortable seating and is WiFi more than adequate Boarding was done quickly and the cabin crew was super diligent in helping each of the passengers find their seat and stow their baggage Although the business seats on this were not new they had ample storage space the flat bed was comfortable and everything worked The food was well presented but tasted a little bland and the cabin crew were extremely quick in removing trays when passengers had finished The WiFi on the aircraft was patchy at best and being Chinese quite a few sites seem to be blocked Running a VPN actually made it quicker with no blocked sites There were a few Western movies but the choice was limited Loos were spotless Overall I have no complaints and would happily fly with the airline again

Sawyer is a small airport in the Upper Peninsula of Michigan with flights to Detroit and Chicago provided by Delta and American respectively There is a small store selling Northern Michigan University paraphernalia some basic snacks and coffee The major car rental firms have desks in the terminal with the cars parked just outside The parking is excellent you walk out of the terminal into the parking lot Less than a minutes walk from the airport entrance to the security check area The terminal has excellent free wifi service courtesy Northern Michigan University Very friendly and efficient staff Taxi service is available to the city of Marquette about miles away

This airport is clearly not equipped to take the number of pax departing after the winter break Check in was too crowded so we had to wait on another floor Conveyer belt at check in blocked by heavy usage Boarding never indicated on screens but was only announced via PA system Shambles Shame as we had such a great time in Finland

Budapest to Zrich Even though the F aircraft was rather old the comfort was very good The seats were very comfortable and had a lot of leg space The crew was very nice and had a beautiful uniform The onboard service provided was the same as on every other Swiss international Airlines flight The information given by the crew was accurate ond easy to understand I really liked this flight

Vintage airport that has been updated and serves lots of people on domestic flights The energy level is high and the view of the runways and operating area is excellent Fun place to arrive or depart with plenty to see and no end to the peoplewatching opportunities Pretty efficient as well

Small simple and clean everything you want in an airport Love coming home to this beautiful airport Pros extremely clean efficient great signage short wait times never any traffic to and from and never any plane traffic Cons no lounges not a lot of shopping very limited food choices things close early a bit far outside city centre parking can be pricey

Couple of short flights with HOP An Embraer to Paris then a Bombadier down to Perpignan Both aircraft cabins were nice staff were friendly and helpful and the snacksdrinks on board were satisfying Flights were on time As a platinum cardholder my connection between CDG and ORY was without charge saving Euro which is a really practical and helpful perk of Flying Blue membership thanks Air France for that I fly a lot with HOP and they always do a good job well done again

I have so far fly times with Moldavian Airlines in Saab airplanes I have always bought tickets through Malev Hungarian airlines and fly fro CopenhagenChisinau Moldova through Budapest Airplanes are OK seats good and space similar to what I am used to with other airlines Service was excellent and staff on board very nice and take good care of everyone on board even take there time to make you feel good Both times I fly from Moldova was early in morning and then I got bread with ham cheese and paprika red pepper yogurt and chocolate biscuit but when I fly to Moldova in evening fly I got very good chicken meal and I could have many different drinks for free I took good Moldavian red wine

The best airport in the Middle East and Europe Staff service is very good Checkin procedure was fast and efficient The airport amentities are quite good good cafes to eat something Segafredo for coffee Duty Free is really very big and the selection is quite large

From the moment I boarded the crew exuded warmth and professionalism Junu and Reeza provided assistance wherever needed The inflight service was impeccable Bhoomi and Nisha managed the meal service efficiently The crew went above and beyond to ensure passenger comfort Whether it was providing extra blankets assisting with luggage or attending to special requests they were attentive and proactive Their kindness and willingness to help truly stood out Looking forward to flying with Akasa Air again

Legaspi Port to Manila with PAL Express The flight I was on was full so it was an excellent decision that I checked in online a day before as PAL Express is very strict about being at the airport on the designated time for check in The flight was on time But what happened to coffee and sandwiches on this route We were only served small piece of biscuit and a cup of water As usual the crew were amazing both on ground and on board

Arrived via DME from LHR and MAN with S airlines and same route return Probably the fastest ever transit through an airport I have ever experienced even if it is only a small provincial one Had to return the day after I arrived and with the assistance of friendly helpful staff collected my late luggage All in all a great little airport if a basic one

KIVKBPODS Both flights were codeshared with Aerosvit but operated by Dniproavia planes KIVKBP Embraer that has seen better days KBPODS plane was an oldlooking Boeing Service onboard was good Offered drinks and a double sandwich despite both flights being under hr Flights departed on time They almost lost my luggage on the first flight as it was sent to connecting flights but were able to locate it relatively quickly and hand it back Overall a relatively good experience for the price paid

Terminal is the area I am reviewing this trip We used the short stay car park as you can walk undercover into the terminal Very easy although not the cheapest option Finding the Aer Lingus checkin was simple and as we stood in line the single checkin operator asked for passengers for Belfast to come forward first which was great The airline uses T for short hops to Belfast and Dublin the main activity for long haul is in T Security was very quiet and efficient for those of us who understand and stick to the rules One family was annoyed at having to surrender much of their liquids and cosmetics because they did not know the rules My partners bag was sidetracked for search Apparently her paperback novel attracted their attention Mine thankfully did not so go figure Once through we ran the gauntlet of the Duty Free maze and found our way to the Aspire Lounge included with the economyflex ticket Boarding was simple with the ATR aircraft having only seats Returning the aircraft was parked very remotely for some reason and we were bussed to the terminal at times I thought we were on an executive allareas tour By the time we got there the bags were on the belt and we were away

This review applies only to Terminal Arrival Departure For one of the busiest days of the travel season Sunday after Thanksgiving the terminal was busy but surprisingly uncrowded From the boarding areas there are views of the airfield and parking apron Seating is plenty though at busier times there can be a dearth of seating Food options are limited given the size of the terminal To order food the iPads which contained flight info links to newspapers and magazines have been eliminated U now have to us a QR code to scan the menu from your phone WiFi service is excellent Easy to connect and fast There was barely a wait to go through security with TSAPre The bathrooms on both arrival and departure were clean with an attendant cleaning the bathrooms frequently Terminal lacks a lounge nonetheless its a good terminal

I had to visit Abidjan this January There is no doubt the airport is more than a pleasant surprise One would expect the worst for any West African ariport in general and even more for this one keeping in mind that the country is fairly isolated and suffering from heavy civil unrest and at the edge of civil war keeping most western travellers and business away In fact the airport corresponds totally to European counterparts of the same size fairly small thus The terminal building is very new and has been totally rebuild in a quite recent past with all confort one can expect Aircondition normal sanitary facilities and yes all is clean and in good working condition On arrival jet aircrafts just dock at a direct tunnel connection to the building distances are quite short All controls are very smooth with absolutely no bribes to give to any official While standing in line for passport control a doctor passes trough the lines and checks vaccinations Yellow fever is compulsory every where there is security passport control is smooth and efficient although every one tries to be closest to the luggage belt this also goes quite smoothly including inspection of luggage No unauthorized people in the arrival area and nowhere unpleasant people insisting on helping you carrying your luggage and then trying to run away with it apparently some people do have a sort of authorization to enter customs area for helping passengers but not insisting Departure also is quite smooth Check in is done in an enclosed area with identity check at the entrance so here also one is safe after checking in there is just a short way up the stairs passing customs and then to the departure hall Here also with all normal facilities duty free shop large restaurant area some smaller shops and sanitary facilities still clean and in good working order Altogether thus a pleasant experience

Malaga to Birmingham I booked this flight online one week before flying I needed to book for adults one child and one infant However I found when checking prices it was cheaper make two separate bookings than the whole group at once I booked for two adults then another booking for one adult and two children This is unbelievable Also you arent allowed to check in online until hours before you fly unless you book a seat for euros each Which is a bit impossible as you are in holiday at this point Just another money making scam However we booked for free while in Spain and our hotel were kind enough to print our boarding passes for us The plane was clean but the seating is just too cramped My husband had sit with his knee protruding into the isle and the trolley kept knocking him when going past Food and drinks are too expensive luckily we bought some snacks and refreshments from the departure lounge before leaving Malaga The staff however are really helpful and Im sure they know its not the comfortable of places to sit for hours and do make an effort in making people feel welcome and providing a good service They were quick to help with the needs of my month old The pilot kept us informed of any changes as we were experiencing a lot of turbulence We were also informed as we approached the UK coastline and also times for arrival were given The plus side we didnt have any hold luggage and were able to check in infants pram at the departure gate Meaning we didnt have to wait in the long bag check in queues Overall we paid premium prices for seats on a below average quality plane Thanks to the stewards for their efforts in trying to compensate for this

Check in at Port Vila was somewhat chaotic in the Domestic Terminal however certain check in desks for certain flights ensured you checked in for your flight ontime Very strict closing times for check in be warned to check in on time Boarding announcements were not very clear and any announcements were very hard to hear due to echo in the terminal Boarding was efficient greeted by the Smiling crew and that was it really Pre takeoff checks and we didnt see the crew again until the prelanding checks were done There is NO refreshments offered so take your own We did on this flight and so glad that we did Beautiful views to be had heading north to Santo however things turned to custard on coming into Santo It was midafternoon when the thunderstorms tend to pop up and we could not land at Santo due to the weather We then endured another minutes back to Port Vila where more chaos ensued I must say it was the Australians and Americans who were demanding on arrival wanting compensation and accommodation their pleas went unanswered as weather issues are not the responsibility of the airline folks Found our own hotel for the night turned up back at the Airport the next afternoon for our replacement flight and off we flew back to Santo and landed on a beautiful afternoon Cabin crew again were full of smiles on boarding and deplaning but really they did nothing else Aircraft was clean toilet was clean and announcements on the aircraft were much clearer than on some airlines we have travelled In fairness to Air Vanuatu they got us there and back and then there again safely they accommodated us onto an extra special flight due to the disruption you could not ask for anything else
Very convenient airport as it is not very large Signs are clear getting to and from the airport is easy too Shops are available post office included The terminal is clean

Windhoek is a small airport with an increasing number of flights Facilities are limited but everything you need is there and seemed sufficient for numbers passing through Arriving early departing late on Air Namibia fromto FRA arrival took less than an hour and departing security was a reasonable time Staff were efficient and friendly Much easier to pass through than major airports

Wenzhou Airport is for me one of best airports in China The New terminal is very big and very beautiful the checkin security check and boarding is fast and easy At this airport they start the automatic checkin and it is fantastic and very simple The airport staff are kind and happy to serve you

I flew into Douala on Swiss and departed on Virgin Nigeria Both experiences were quite pleasant I had only hand luggage and was in and out of the airport quite quickly When departing we waited at the gate which was quite calm and cool Yes its a bit manic as you walk out of the airport with people and noise everywhere but lots of places are like that If you know where you are going or have someone to meet you its fine

Set off from my home in Pudsey on the morning of my flight and was in the duty free shop within minutes Check in with Jet was a doddle Security was reasonably busy but staff were efficient and polite new scanners were in use Used the Boots store perfectly fine Made use of the Starbucks great coffee Used the toilet facilities They were clean Boarding the plane was swift had the luxury of an Airbridge which was great but have used the much maligned bus shelter walkway on many occasions and had no problems kept dry in wet weather does what it was designed to do I have flown from many UK airports and my experience of this small airport is up there with the best Wish I could say the same in respect of my arrivals experience at Malaga Airport and an hour long wait at passport control

The Port Elizabeth airport is compact and well laid out and it is very convenient to the Summerstrand beach area Car Hire is in a separate building across the entrance road which is close to the terminal but requires dodging traffic with everything in tow Baggage retrieval seemed to take an extraordinary long time considering ours was the only arriving flight and the plane was sitting on the tarmac meters away from the baggage claim but these things happen Check in on return was polite and efficient and there is a modest selection of shops to pass the time waiting for departure but only on the street side of security

One way Jetairfly flight from Antwerp to Berlin Tegel minute delay was only announced at the planned time of departure Nearly new aircraft the largest that is able to fly on Antwerps runway thin seats but ok for short holiday flights Very quiet and clean Friendly professional cabin crew excellent service Prices of onboard food and drinks are for airline service reasonable This airline often has very good deals available even on short notice Very reasonable price but the available fares vary a lot Flight was about full so they dont seem to be doing too bad The airline tries to be something in between a fullservice carrier a charter operator and a lowcost operator

Ribeiro Preto to Curitiba regional airline on a regional flight very nice experience with this type of flight the aircraft and ERJ seats was clean but could be better with a small delay minutes nice board service for an hour flight Theres only one flight attendant there and could have one more because the flight was completely full Im very happy with this new way of flight here in Brazil you can go to many cities without go via So PauloGuarulhos you just have to choose regional flights and go via Campinas or Ribeiro Preto MUCH BETTER good airports clean no delays long delays I recommend Passaredo for other passengers Just one thing if you choose the left seat theres an individual window for you only one seat not or seats like other jets

Even though it was a really full flight I still had a good experience as a frequent flyer for United Airlines Everything was the same on the way and I dont have much to say But what got my attention is that the food is the same thing I had last year when flying from Brussels to Chicago The food tasted great but was familiar to me and I hope I didnt feel deja vu

Flew Ryanair last week to Tenerife Baggage drop was a breeze as was boarding Well organised The flight itself was excellent operated by a fantastic crew especially the cabin manager who was friendly polite and professional Wouldnt hesitate to use again

Manston is an excellent small airport The staff immigration customs and police are friendly but still professional Checkin was handled well Security was a little laborious but was thorough and in no way objectionable There is a small shop and a barcafeteria which considering the short amount of time needed to check in is all that is required A great option for those traveling to or from the south east corner of England I hope the route to Amsterdam is successful as it is so much more pleasant than flying from one of the big London airports Heathrow in particular I have heard that a rail link will be coming

Flew Monarch from Alicante to Gatwick on the ZB on the th May on board A GZBAK Seated in row seats were very comfortable and leg room generous Cabin crew really helpful and also very cheerful Flight left on time and also arrived promptly despite a missed approach initially into LGW Overall a great flight experience and far more superior product to some of the other UK based low cost and charter airlines My only criticism and something I was not happy with was that Monarch do not appear to apply a crew rule in the cockpit at all times

Gatwick to Banjul Surprisingly comfortable hour journey to The Gambia for Christmas The cabin was clean crew were friendly and helpful and the flight was comfortable I didnt suffer from my skin and eyes drying out as much as with other airlines I got the feeling they didnt stint on the air quality The food was fine and typical of airline food There was plenty of water juices tea and coffee and you could buy booze if you wanted The wines were very nice Outward on December we flew a Boeing with seating layout and on return December it was an A with seating The seats on the A felt more spacious and comfortable although they had no adjustable headrest like the Boeing We are both tall and it was no hardship The time passed pretty quickly perhaps also due to the decent times of the flights and the same time zone both ways The only negative was the lack of working entertainment although they have an app for your phone it didnt work and headphones were not issued Outward on the Boeing I was able to listen to their radio stations on my seat controls through my own earphones and on return Id downloaded some movies on my mobile phone I have no hesitation in recommending Titan Airways who I believe sub contract for other airlines when they are busy Nothing to worry about in fact it may be a better experience

Very nice very small domestic regional airport I arrived from IAH Houston on a tiny little Saab and I collected my luggage and was outside in about minutes I also departed there for IAH with eventual connection to LHR and was surprised by the very welcoming attitude of the Continental staff The security staff seemed less happy to be working but I was through in under minutes Its a nice little airport with a nice little cafe and a few static displays to look at Its also used by USAF so its common whilst waiting for your flight to see an FA land or depart

DSA to BOJ Balkan Holidays airlines have got better and better prices onboard are expensive and prices are not in seirling Leg room is great and the newer aeroplanes are comfortable for hours Cabin crew helpful and friendly

I would like to express my gratitude to the airport staff for caring about my comfort and positive impressions of the company I would like to express special gratitude to the employee Annette for helping me resolve the issue with my luggage The flight was comfortable and in a safe atmosphere for me

Rex Airlines is a standout in terms of professionalism and helpfulness Their call centres are here in Australia staffed by knowledgeable and problem solving women sorry men I have just dealt with amazing women Rex is our airline of choice when it flies where we need to go It is hands down better than the other airlines based in Australia and is a reminder that an airline can work well and treat customers with personal and professional service

The crew were extremely nice the flight was about hours and hours for the flight back to Hong Kong The flight was really smooth Props to the pilots The food was light and average The drinks were cool the in flight entertainment was out of service but pretty sure the airline is on a budget Warning that the ticket only includes kg of luggage to take on the plane and have to pay individually for luggage in cargo hold kg round trip more than HKD Seat was alright had decent recline trying to avoid flying with Hong Kong Airlines until maybe a few years later when they earn some money back Overall above average flight

Perfect trip throughout except for one strange thing that comes first I partly paid the fare with miles This can only be done via agent by filling the form on the site and waiting for the response Also miles paid booking doesnt appear at your regular account so some difficulties to access it Otherwise it was fine Online check in no problem Bag drop with automatic counter didnt work well but resolved within minutes on the regular desk Boarding efficient take off on time ordered meal arrived and was ok Landing on schedule Legroom is ok no problem with overhead bag allocation Toilets clean Crews nice and efficient The plane was clean cabin in good condition The room for improvement is booking with miles and legroom Tighter than Ryanair

An uneventful flight to Amsterdam Catering was not the best this time bland food and sides We were served twice it filled our stomach but that was it Service provided by the staff was friendly and speedy despite a full plane Seats were comfortable We landed min earlier in Amsterdam

Leipzig airport is a new modern airport but not very user friendly A major advance is the direct train connection right underneath but the layout is an odd one After check in the passenger has to walk a long distance to the security and passport control This can be a headache of you have to stamp your papers for VAT tax refund as you need to show it to customs It is located at one end and the check in at the other end Good facilities present and staff are very friendly and polite even though not very conversant in English

Checkingin for a seat flight without any other flights at the same time was never going to be busy Checkin staff who was also baggage handler flight dispatcher and Im sure other things was very friendly and efficient The small terminal had good restroom facilities car hire drinks and food dispensing machine Surprisingly large number of security personnel for a tiny airport I counted at least security staff Nice experience

Landing in Carrasco is a nice experience if the plane approaches the tarmac overflying the nice beaches and architecture Immigration did not take more than a few minutes and luggage was efficiently delivered it is necessary to go through a dutyfree in order to reach the hall where the conveyors are placed After customs the main lobby is very illuminated with natural light and spotlessly clean Taxis are abundant and comfortable and the airport is located about minutes from downtown However some of the carhiring companies are not located in the terminal but there is an efficient shuttle service to their offices

Nice terminal though no seating space at the checkin area seems to be very congested After security check the seating area is much better though limited options of food and shopping The terminal itself is new and well maintained not much walk times The view of the runway from the terminal is good so you can pass your time quite well Free wifi with reasonably good connectivity available Announcements are adequate Overall quite good
The flight was good but it lacked in terms of inflight entertainment and food plus the wifi service which was without any surprise very bad Still it was a decent flight overall

Freetown Lungi International Airport is a small airport terminal building It recieves very few flights the majority being international It has so positive attributes like no congestion speedy check in and checkout A hotel is conveniently located near it There is a duty free shop and restaurant There is also a VIP Lounge for the elite and other first class passengers Beware that the airport is very small It needs renovations and a series of expansions effort due to its small size The government is in the works of expanding it to accomodate the international passengers

Pleasant surprise Planes were new and clean Staff was attentive and efficient Flights were on time We prebooked meals which were quite nice We booked during holiday season so tickets were on the more expensive side but all in all good value Would fly with them again

Great employees service schedules but I have stopped flying with Horizon because they are now using Turbo Prop planes Q Its slower has more noise and vibration and most of all they cannot fly at altitudes where the ride is smooth This is compared to the full size jets that Southwest flies on the same routes as Horizon I used to have the credit card had Frequent flyer status and earned oodles of miles Those days are gone

Excellent airline Flights outbound and return were on time if not early Service and staff were helpful and friendly and the plane was very comfortable Definitely recommend them The only negatives the film choice was not great for an English speaker and there was if anything too much food served

Excellent new terminal spacious and with lots of checkin counters Flew China Southern to Nanjing and the checkin was swift as was security All passengers get patted down regardless of whether you beep or not which was a bit of a nuisance Beyond security good amenities and restaurants We had an early morning departure and the terminal was very busy but it is definitely large enough to handle the number of people One downside is we got a bus to the plane which took minutes

Check in at LHR T was quick and easy and minimal queue for security Business Class passengers on Malaysia Airlines have access to the Qatar Airways lounge which is excellent and we enjoyed a nice light breakfast before the flight Malaysia use A for the flight to KL and my wife and I had chosen seats D and G meaning that both seats have aisle access Malaysia Airlines cabin crew are some of the best in the industry and as always the service was very good The meal service starts with signature satays followed by smoked salmon for the main course I tried the Malaccanstyle seabass fillet very tasty An area where Malaysia Airlines could improve is in the inflight entertainment the choice of films is quite limited and well below the standard of airlines such as Emirates Flight arrival into KL was minutes ahead of schedule which left quite a long transfer time for our connection to Penang The Malaysia Airlines lounge in the domestic departures area is ok but can get very busy Our onward flight to Penang was on an B one of the upgraded aircraft with new business class seats and WiFi based entertainment system which you use with your own device We did not use this for such a short flight We were impressed with the service on this minute flight which included a small hot meal Arrival into Penang was on schedule and the bags were delivered promptly Overall a great couple of flights with Malaysia Airlines

Cusco to Uyuni via La Paz My experience with Amaszonas was good actually Luckily the weather was in my favor too Initially I was a little skeptical after reading reviews but the trip was pretty smooth Flight was on the smaller side although not as small as people had initially mentioned Theres about to rows of seats and I was comfortable THe only thing is they board like minutes prior to departure which makes you a little nervous but the trip as such was okay

I recently had the pleasure of flying with Eastern Airways from East Midlands and I must say that the experience exceeded my expectations in terms of genuine warmth friendliness and personability Right from the moment I stepped foot on the aircraft I was greeted by a genuinely friendly crew who exuded a warm and welcoming Throughout the flight the crew members went above and beyond to ensure the comfort and satisfaction of the passengers What truly set this flight apart was the crews personable approach They took the time to interact with passengers on a personal level engaging in friendly conversations and offering helpful recommendations It felt more like flying with a group of friends rather than being mere passengers This personal touch made the journey feel special and created a pleasant and memorable experience In conclusion my experience with Eastern Airways was characterized by a genuine friendly crew who made the flight enjoyable from start to finish Their warm and personable approach created a positive atmosphere and left a lasting impression I would highly recommend Eastern Airways to anyone seeking a memorable and pleasant flying experience

This airport is head and shoulders above any other airport I have been to and Ive been through a few Every person I interacted with form check in to security to service staff were all over the top friendly with great senses of humor The security line is the fastest I have ever seen I have never waited in a line here even during the holidays maybe minutes max The gates are clean and modern tons of outlets and different seating arrangements lots of space for only having gates Loads of parking for an airport of this size I was able to park my car like meters from departures and left it there for a week I know how infuriating flying can be especially when things go wrong but it goes a long way when people are so friendly This is my favorite airport and I go out of my way to fly out of here please give these people the recognition they deserve

A totally stressfree experience as sampled on a return charter flight from the Tampa Bay area Just eight departure gates but ample seating and a friendly barcafe No TSA hassle either A good gateway to Biloxi the Mississippi Gulf Coast and even Mobile AL Close to I

After reading several negative reviews on this page regarding LPA Gran Canaria airport I wish to make a defence I find the airport similar to many of the Spanish airports operated by Aena in that it handles the volume of passengers proportionately and professionally Bear in mind the vast majority of passengers passing through the airport are there for leisure purposes this has always been a difficult balancing act to please the foot traffic Knowledge and preplanning are the key to success Informative information can be found online about the airport for example httpsgrancanariaairportcom is just one example Especially in this day and age with covid and the uncertainly about travel with changing restrictions it is paramount that planning ahead to provide a heads up of potential problems and issues is a must

The flight attendants are top notch service is gracious and consistent Little things like coming by often to take trash asking your preferences clearly and sincere friendliness that I think is sadly lacking in some airlines these days I dont know how they manage to do it but the eggs are truly good Also this is the only airline in which I was served a dish I tried to recreate once I got home a corn salad with red onions and feta Delicious They do not serve typical Korean food but all I ask of airline food in economy is that the food not be disgusting Air Premias dishes can actually be described as good The legroom in economy is by far the biggest selling point of this airline Even though their entertainment options are severely limited I am completely happy with economy on Air Premia

This airport is consistently name among the best small airports in the USA Shops and eateries that were shuttered because of Covid have now reopened The airport is in the process of adding more amenities and concessions The newly renovated bathrooms are amazing Theyre brightly lit and significant improvement over the preexisting bathrooms Security was a breeze There was no line and I walked right up to the TSA counter and cleared security in less than minutes The distances from the security area to either end of the terminal are manageable WiFi is fast and worked flawlessly

Me and a few friends flew to the Dominican Republic in August and the experience upon arrival was outstanding The immigration service was fast and most shops where open The staff help us with our bags and had us out in no time On our way back it was the same very friendly staff no delays food was great on the terminal shops
Little and very nice airport Clean well organized with helpful staff The way it should be All in all a good arrival and starting point for any trip

Winnipeg to Abbotsford I flew with Swoop for the first time and I absolutely loved it There were no delays and Winnipeg airport was not busy The signs were easy to follow Airport crew were very friendly

Pretty basic as airports go Way out of town it is simply ridiculous and taxis are well keep your belt on and wear a helmet if you have one The airport sort of works but this is a typical domestic Chinese airport not great not entirely hideous but you know what If you want to fly to Hangzhou its this or nothing I can tell you it is heaven compared to the central rail station

Small airport that you would not want to spend too much time in but that manages to get you on your way reasonably quickly Inbound immigration and visa on arrival facilities are slightly chaotic though not too bad Outbound once you clear passport control facilities are limited to notsoclean toilets a sad looking duty free shop a bar that did not have any change when we visited and a seating area that seemed to be full of mosquitos If youve stayed in the Kempinski you can use their lounge which is probably the best part of this airport
You can change your seats at echeck in without charge Both flights were on time Aneo was clean there were no inflight service for the hour flight Stewards were efficient and friendly enough

Most of the flights use the gates but even though they are empty many lowcost flights all except Air Astana Etihad etc use the ramps The staff were reasonably friendly and the immigration process was no bother compared to Tashkent Airport The airport itself is too small One of my friends in Business class decided to not use the lounge because it was just rubbish The staff dont really care if the people in the business class lounge talk loudly or anything The airports checkin could be improved and the domestic arrivals hall has too many taxi drivers trying to find customers Food choice is also limited but the duty free was actually pretty decent However I would not use this airport again but I have to next year
