I flew out of Athens on July th with American Airlines and I had requested wheelchair assistance The gentleman who assisted me at the airport Aggelos was absolutely amazing He took great care of me and was extremely respectful and helpful in anyway possible He actual went out of his way and even performed beyond his job responsibilities and provided excellent customer service In my years of travelling I have never experienced such superb customer service He is a very valuable employee who needs to be recognized for his outstanding customer service skills He went above and beyond for a customer I will never forget my positive experience with this Greek fellow

This airport is amazing I was connecting from a very small airport from a regional flight I step off the plane in concourse b I then go through the underground tunnel to connect to Paris CDG I take the tram and stop at chickfila The tram is very nice and quiet with lots of room I stop at the skyclub and it is one of the best Ive ever seen You can walk take moving walkways or the tram The airport is very efficient from connections with seats for everyone If you want to shop there are stores there too The McNamara is the only terminal Ive been in and that will be the only terminal I will use If I have the option to connect through here then I will go for it because it is seamless clean and very efficient

Travelled late July Arriving from Edinburgh late afternoon found the airport quiet Standing at the back of a long line for passport control I thought we could in for a long wait But they virtually waved the entire plane load through in around minutes By which time the luggage had already arrived So we were out of the airport within minutes Ive never known anything like it On the way back there were several flights delayed due to a storm However everything still worked well for our flight and we departed on time Not a big airport but I was happy with my time there

Travelled in and out of this Burmese provincial airport early last year arriving from Mandalay and leaving to Rangoon Pretty basic but it was OK and really belonged to another age of flying This because you could wander out onto the runway between planes arriving there werent many and if you wished you could go to your hold luggage which was stacked on a trolley awaiting the planes arrival and put things in or take things out of it Many of the Burmese passengers availed themselves of this facility as our plane was an hour late arriving When its light appeared in the sky on its approach an airport official suggested we all go back into the terminal so we did An airport still in an age of innocence with no apparent need for security of any kind

The plane was a CRJ operated by Skywest I was warmly greeted at the door by a very nice FA Service was excellent The seating on the CRJ is rather than on the larger planes The plane was very comfortable and quiet No entertainment system due to the short flight
The short journey was very pleasant the staff were very friendly and the food onboard was excellent I would recommend them to anyone flying to the Faroe Islands

Handy and efficient airport and friendly service However complete disregard of Government standards in respect of refunds Coronavirus Car park booked and paid for in advance on non flex basis Refund refused despite HM Government Competition and Markets Authority direction Beware sharp practice

I agree most strongly that passport control is a nightmare I could not believe the length of time it takes to get passengers through and especially when the airport is so hot and lacked air conditioning I have visited this Airport twice now and hope that in future they can implement a more effective way of getting through control The rest of the airport was fine and even homeward bound found it was comfortably set out with refreshments and enjoyed a last encounter of some traditional Tunisian retail shops
Great regional airport Min check in time for Lufthansa flights is mins Good connections via MUC to international destinations Reasonable amenities at the airport

In August Johannesburg to Maun and Kisane to Johannesburg Both flights were spot on time Service on board was fine with drinks and light snacks served for the roughly hour flight in each direction Aircrafts were in good shape and the seats comfortable for this type of trip Checkin in Joburg was easy and very quick Check in in Kisane was a breeze as the airport is tiny All in a good experience and a great way to enhance your Botswana experience

Small airport with few services Long enough customs procedures and passport control if you land late in the evening when there is little staff on duty However it offers a good free wifi service also available outside the airside

On our departure from Simferopol to Moscow we were very pleased with friendly and efficient service at the checkin and the information desks But upstairs in the waiting area we were struck by absolutely different attitude The attempt to have some drinks before boarding finished with success only at the third cafe Its name somehow Happy potatoes Sorry not very sure But I am absolutely sure about the names of the cafes where we were met with rudeness and unhelpful attitude The names of those cafes are Skybar and We were flying on the st of July Such a shame to be let down by such a beautiful airport

Spotlessly clean airport Fantastic cakes in departure Travelling to and from Kiev for Champions League final from Liverpool via Venice and Lviv Very smooth transit through Lviv Airport both ways Cakes were more memorable than the game unfortunately
The staff are friendly and the seat is comfortable The air ticket is cheap Although theres no TV and wifi I can bring my pad and watch films Not bad

Freetown airport was always a miserable place to be Even after it was refurbished it only became tolerable In a completely new terminal was opened I have the pleasure of sitting in the business lounge writing this review The new airport was I believe built by a Turkish company Sitting here I could be in another continent Or perhaps not since FNA is rather better than the overcrowded airports in Europe Lots of African countries have built new airports and Sierra Leone is one of the latest and have achieved something remarkable The airport is not huge of course but it is modern very clean with good facilities and for my Brussels Airlines flight no queue anywhere I found the staff to be welcoming polite and on top of what they are doing There are a few but enough shops and places to eat The lounge is a good place to be Food is more than adequate Strangely no beer but the wine is good The airport must have been expensive but it does give a good first and last impression of Sierra Leone

Its a small airport with the most basic of facilities but there were no delays in either direction I hope that means they have sorted out immigraton though it may be that my BA flight from London City arrived at a quiet time My only gripe is about one woman on security who was quite unfriendly when she told me I had to return to checkin because she didnt like the look of a vase I had in my carryon bag Otherwise the staff seemed quite friendly

I took the am flight from Basra to Erbil an Iraqi domestic flight I bought the ticket the day before at the Iraqi Airways ticket office in Basra They were friendly spoke English and only take Iraqi dinars no credit cards I paid roughly the equivalent of The flight left on time and was fine The equipment was a B On the short flight they served a breakfast tray with a lot of very sweet things chocolate milk an Iraqi Twinkietype cake a soft roll with jam and a banana It wasnt really to my liking but it was nevertheless an energypacked breakfast which is more than one gets on European carriers these days The flight attendants were friendly and we landed in Erbil on time I was satisfied with my flight and wish other people would also leave reviews for this airline

Airport is clean has good shops great seating area and has clear signs However the thing that annoyed me the most was the fact that in the entire terminal you could literally i counted just find a total of five power outlets that should really be something to be improved so watch out for that

I arrived at Yangon airport about am today Dec and proceeded to be processed through security Xray machines I was in a hurry and thus quickly pickedup my luggage but forgot and left my phone wallet and spectacles behind It must have been about minutes later at the airline checkin when I realized my mistake I was in panic and so backtraced my steps However I requested the wrong counter for my belongings But the officers were very helpful and apologetic that they could not find my belongings I then remembered the correct counter near row D and there the security officers were able to retrieve my belongings very quickly I believe they had followed strict procedures and had kept my belongings safe while awaiting my return to claim them After a simple verification I have all my items returned in good order I wish to thank security staff for their prompt and helpful assistance and making my return trip pleasant

Adelaide to Melbourne Staff were lazy and unhelpful They appeared more interested in selling extras and assessing baggage weight than providing service While nobody expects luxury from a budget airline courtesy shouldnt be dependent on ticket price

I was recently on a short hop from Sevastopol to Kiev Airport checkin was fast and polite Plane was pretty old Embraer with tight legroom Catering consisted of tea coffee water all looked and smelled uninspiring The crew was young and nice Ticket price was a good deal Flight was on time Ok for min flight

Burbank provides a convenient and easy alternative to LAX although the departure hall in Terminal B is too small to accommodate more than flights at a time There were flights an MD a and CRJ regional jets boarding simultaneously and the small space and cramped conditions caused confusion and delayed boarding for everyone

Arrived on the last evening flight from Barcelona tourist desk very helpful and received our luggage within minutes No taxis available so took the airport bus driver was very helpful and even dropped us a short distance from our hotel
The area looks is not designed for such a huge passenger number some of the staffs are rude and unfriendly The terminal has a nice overview of the taxiways and runways
It is clean modern and spacious There are many restaurants and shops Passengers would not be bored during the waiting time Employees are friendly and helpful Signposts are clear

The Seat I sat in seat A next to the window this seat was spacious and much better than other airlines Ive flown in this region There was ample legroom the width was reasonable and the window on the Embraer was large as normal The configuration of the cabin is interesting and is incredible due to lacking a middle seat The Service The staff were perfectly friendly kind and polite with us and offered us gingerbread men and water during the flight The gingerbread was better than I expected and the water was normal The Ground Service The flight was perfectly on time and we landed on schedule The boarding was normal and was completely seamless which was surprising at Gatwick Overall the flight was seamless and comfortable I booked this flight using miles so I cant comment on the price but I would definitely recommend Helvetic Airlines if you are flying to Switzerland over lowcost airlines like EasyJet in the same region

Overall everything went well on the hour flight to Dubai A large meal was presented The small entertainment screen however did not work But flight was uneventful and arrived on time Exceeded my expectations

Kefalonia Airport has a new hall which is big enough for passangers waiting The queing went fine although there are not many desks The toilets were new and clean Coffee and sweat breads are in the hall In de waiting area is a small shop Personnel was very kind and helpful

Flew GA Jakarta to Amsterdam I was picked up at home by a car provided by GarudaIndonesia and was them met at the terminal kerb side by GarudaIndonesia First Class Team Nidya Ahda who helped me with check in security and through immigration formalities Although the airport was very busy this process was very quick In the Jakarta airport FirstClass lounge there is full menu and drinks service available however I chose a sandwich When it came time for boarding Naiya assisted me to the aircraft door where I was meet by the FirstClass cabin crew Romad Wanda Cartika and Chef Angga who provided me with a very warm welcome I was quite tired therefore after a short snack after takeoff I bedded down and had a very good sleep for hours There was a good selection of food available for breakfast The breakfast meal can be ordered on demand therefore I chose for breakfast to be served hours prior to landing The quality of food portion size and presentation were outstanding and refills of tea and coffee are none stop When we arrived in Amsterdam Schiphol airport we were met at the plane door by the Schiphol VIP Team who took me to the VIP centre where we go through immigration and checkin for my onward flight This is also a great service and it avoids all the queues I used the onboard Wi Fi and the connectivity was very excellent I would like to thank the GarudaIndonesia First Class Team on the ground and to the Cabin crew for the outstanding service they provided

Bangkok to Taipei Having now taken four flights on V Air my comments remain virtually the same as my earlier review I arrived at the newly opened international terminal at Bangkoks Don Mueang airport about minutes prior to the scheduled departure Checkin took less than minutes even though the plane was around full The aircraft pushed back minutes late but arrived precisely on time The seat is comfortable with more leg space than is usual on budget carriers my preordered meal of chicken teriyaki was excellent and the FAs are efficient and cheerful One even came to my seat to welcome me back having seen me on my last flight almost months earlier I wish all budget carriers were of a similar standard
From Prague to Saint Petersburg great service nice food professional group price of the ticket was higher than competitors but worth it highly recommended

Surabaya is my hometown airport I was really happy when Terminal opened but I think they could improve the facilities such as food and stores Surabaya is a simple airport the terminal is quite clean toilets huge spacious check in and waiting room I spend a lot of time here but I have never used the WiFi so I dont know about the speed Airport staff are attentive

I absolutely love the WilkesBarreScranton International Airport Small enough to accommodate us easily friendly staff and yet large enough for us to easily reach any destination We especially love the fact that they now have Breeze Airlines which will allow us to increase our travel from this airport Great move on both parts

I traveled with people from NYC We entered the airport and had no problems coming in Pretty fast service with immigration and getting our bags Outside was rather chaotic Too many men standing around to carry bags They should control them better maybe like cabs take turns as requested On the way out we found the airport entrance very clear Our bus pulled up and emptied better than it could in JFK It was comforting to see the UN security team right outside The building was well air conditioned which was great The ticketing area was easily accessible We found that there was a ton of security checks not sure why as it seemed to be for baggage mostly We had our IDs checked times and our bags screened twice We were told at the ticket area that once inside there were no rest rooms That was not completely true There is a rest room area inside TSA but before the final jetBlue secure gate area baggage screening Also the signs for the duty free shop inside could have been betterhigher to see Overall it was not horrible but just a little cramped in feeling and the double check of the bags while offering a feeling of security sent red flags up as to why they were doing that It seemed like a jetBlue thing as Spirit did not do that Also the place was clean
Lovely crew Very clean plane and rather comfy seating The seat belt sign was on most of the flight although not much turbulence Quite many announcements The food was fine but wine glasses very small

A great airport only one hour from New York City that is still a secret A major stop for SouthWest it is a welcome relief from the congestion at La Guardia or worse JFK Nice new buildings with convenient parking for locals or access to a train station with links to all of long island and NYC

Another pretty solid trip with Jet A full package holiday was booked through them and they did not disappoint The flight times were good as they offered a decent early flight to get there and a leisurely enough time to return Checkinbag drop at Belfast was quick and easy with friendly staff and the boarding process was fast and well managed leaving the experience hassle free Onboard the plane was clear well kept and pleasant decent leg room for taller passengers as well The inflight shopping options seemed OK although this wasnt something that I would usually avail of however food and drink options were good enough Not bad in terms of range and price to match granted more than you would want to pay on the High Street but OK for a flight The staff really made the experience good with the crew friendly and very efficient getting food and drinks out quickly and picking up the rubbish after in good time Jet has been like this the last few times weve travelled with them so hoping this keeps up

ChisinauBudapest roundtrip Both departures on time Served breakfast on the way out and lunch inbound Luggage transfer handled efficiently despite relatively short connection time in Budapest SAAB plane offers plenty of legroom and is not so noisy compared to other prop planes Friendly FAs and my favourite option for flights from Moldova to Europe

The airport is very very small when arriving However it is clean and staff are kind When leaving the check out is done outside and some companies are not as efficient as others but the airport is at no fault When leaving there are two relatively small waiting room with limited selection of snacks and duty free Based to buy souvenirs and keepsakes before the airport The people are what make this airport pleasant they are friendly and work very hard
The new Delta Terminal C is elegant convenient and modern Restaurants gate areas and restrooms were all immaculate Checkin went smoothly Keep it up

Air Belgium for Srilankan Airlines Uncomfortable business class seat looks well used only good thing was the massage function Mix of crew from Air Belgium and Srilankan mostly friendly Food was tasty and filling a good variety to chooses from Toilet wasnt overly clean
It is easily accessible from the city center by metro within minutes It is clean and modern Employees are friendly and helpful Signposts are clear Goods are bountiful

New airport opened around and much better than the old airport at the military airbase Plenty of checkin counters and smooth handling in security check First class lounge good As most Chinese airports it is noisy from continuous announcements

Very clean and modern airport New terminal added in New access highway to Shenyang Limited air traffic with few delays Baggage area is poorly lit Not sure why As the Chinese economy grows who knows what will come of this airport Right now its a clean well run airport albeit with little air traffic Interesting for an American to see Air Koryo planes and personnel at the airport

Short flight in a newly refurbished Embraer The cabin looked very clean and the seat was comfortable enough for this quick hop Early departure and early arrival Really nice and efficient male purser Fredrik was just perfect

Frankfurt Main to Asmara The crew are most friendly The onboard service was excellent and standard of the aircraft was good though the legroom wasnt great The ground handling done by the airline at Asmara International Airport was efficient even though there were a number of shortcomings at the airport the airline got round them The price of the ticket was worth the service I received

The seat was spacious but the recline function was lost on my seat Crew were friendly They offered one meal plus one snack for just hours The onboard announcement was inaccurate that they claimed to be landing soon hours before the actual landing Surprisingly personal onboard entertainment was offered

The wheelchair assistance at Mumbai Airport was exceptional From the moment my parents landed on an early morning flight they received excellent support through immigration and luggage collection ensuring a smooth and hasslefree process A special thanks to the young gentleman whose name I unfortunately cant recall for his kind assurance and attentive care Truly appreciated the respectful and seamless experience Highly recommend their service

Copenhagen to Vagar Faroe Islands and the Atlantic Airways A was still quite new and had the feature of mood lighting which you dont see on many European short haul aircraft The cabin layout was very nice The food was simple but good a nice little wrap salad with fresh salmon bread and little miniRittersport chocolate Very surprised that only minutes after the meals drinks service they did a second drink service a full aircraft on a hr flight The service was friendly and the lady who served me was most charming A simple short haul flight but very pleasant

Flydubai provides a pleasant and comfortable travel experience from Dubai to Kerala I am feet tall so I had plenty of leg room The food was tasty and sufficient and the service was good The positive experience is made better by effective boarding

Antananarivo to Fort Dauphin via Morondava and no notable issues with Air Madagascar service Easy website to navigate and book All flights were on time with pleasant crew and ground service as well Snacks on outward flights only and return flight had a fruit danish and coffee only minute flight Nice very nice and bright interior on the ATR first time Id flown this aircraft But and this is a well known issue for Air Madagascar they did move the departure time up for my return flight to Tana From am to am Grrr At least they emailed me and informed my hotel the afternoon before Note though domestic flying is cheaper if you fly into Madagascar with them I didnt given their spotty record and flying from Canada to Madagascar on a tight time line

One of the smaller airports by Chinese standards but a very positive experience for the passenger Good signage short distances to walk from plane to baggage carousel and a mere minute wait for luggage to be on the belt Good public transport to greater Qingdao region including resorts area by the sea Beware of taxi touts go to the official taxi line where you get a taxi from a dispatcher who registers the ride and also hands out a complaint info card just in case When departing from Qingadao dont come to the airport too early Checkin also for international flights is min before scheduled takeoff and there is not much to do in this airport Just some shops and two socalled coffee shops with a limited choice of snacks Found out too late about a VIPlounge which is hidden in a corner to the far right of the international departure lounge Access charge is yuan but had no time to use it Friendly airport staff quick security check plenty seating at gates one restaurant one coffee shop and one airline lounge airside duty free and souvenirs Facilities clean and well maintained All in all a very positive impression

TimisoaraMunich The flight was h min and operated on a SAAB which was in pretty good shape I believe these are former Crossair props Was offered a decent breakfast on this flight although a little bit disappointed that the cheese omlette was cold Otherwise good selection of drinks and friendly crew Overall a good deal for the price Would fly them again

Heho to Yangon The aircraft was pretty new and very clean We have been greeted with a smile and the personnel was kind and professional We have been served some basic breakfast that for such a short flight was appreciated Flight on time and overall very comfortable and enjoyable experience

Luang Prabang to Vientiane CheckIn was fast well organized and the staff friendly The departure arrival was on time and the aircraft made a very well maintained impression During the flight despite the short flight time of only minutes there were small bites and drinks The seat absorbency was slightly larger than other airlines Overall a good surprising experience

Functioning but nonair conditioned air bridge to terminal Terminal building is easy to navigate and path clearly leads after heading down escalator to baggage pickup Baggage arrives after minimal waiting time of minutes Many people in terminal besides passengers and employees Mainly porters Everyone appears to know everyone else so I guess that security is not an issue Inside and outside terminal many drivers call out offering lifts in carsvans heading to Gorontalo city as airport is to hour from regional capital Fares are negotiable but is the norm Bules may pay more Toilets ATMs and lower end eating facilities as well as souvenir stalls are easily accessible Forget having a drink

Three trips between CCS and BLA I found Conviasa to be clean modern friendly and welcoming My Spanish is functional but quite basic and when I struggled there was usually multilingual staff even on the short hop from Caracas to Barcelona and back Luggage allowance on this flight is a generous kg and a free drink is provided despite the flight time being only minutes Seats comfortable with more room than I was expecting All in all Conviasa offer a superior albeit slightly more expensive service on this short route than do their competitors Avior

ANCFAIANC Economy Open Seating Check in was difficult The checkin agent did not understand how to read my ticket and almost seemed to blame me for the error Once on board however the flight attendants both on the outbound and return were very nice especially on the return flight a definite sense of humor Era offers low fares between Anchorage and Fairbanks and I will be flying with them again Its also nice not to have to go to security when flying on the smaller planes

Recently returned from a return trip to Florida with Thomson and as per usual they were fantastic Aircraft was a month old DreamLiner and its such a brilliant plane Im ft and the legroom was perfect with plenty of space unlike years ago when my knees were jammed into the seat infront Decent choice of movies and a few games to play which kept us occupied as our tablets had to be in hold luggage do to the US Ban The crew both ways were friendly and attentive the free drinks were plentiful and it was never an issue getting more if required The food both ways was fine and wiped the floor with what Ive had on our Flag Carrier during the past year The return flight was the same aircraft as the outbound leg and we landed into Gatwick hour early after a smooth overnight flight I really cant fault Thomson in anyway I fly long haul a lot and the larger airlines dont even come close We are already booked on them again to Barbados in February

A friendly airport if you just want to watch the planes from the viewing area but not passenger friendly poor layout Up a lot of stairs for passport checks when you arrive Had to go through security the past twice on departure the both times they claimed I had passed through a public area after the first check Security patdowns are embarrassingly intimate

Excellent airport Clean organized and wonderful architecture Courteous airport security and immigration staff Good mix of retail and attentive service by staff Wonderful lounge and facilities Thoroughly deserves Star rating

We had a really good experience at Luton Started well with the official meet greet parking in Car Park this is clearly signposted and we were met by a very pleasant and helpful gent quite a contrast with our rather dismal Heathrow experience in May It was a short walk to bag drop in the terminal which was also done quickly and on to security This was a real standout with short queues and friendly staff No need to remove liquids computers and so on and they do a fullbody scan for everyone that saves the palaver of being beeped by a standard gate and going for the full scan My bag was selected for extra checking that was swift and polite It took about minutes from car park to airside where we found plenty of decent options for breakfast All in all a very positive start to our holiday

I will like to thank entire staff of Air Asia We were on family vacation with my year old child and got amazing cooperation Without any hassle we could book seats and the entire journey was enjoyable Will like to be thankful to the pilots as the landing on all the flights was smooth I paid my gratitude to the staff personally too

I am delighted to share my exceptional experience with Officer Lucas at San Francisco International Airport His assistance in locating my lost phone and guiding me to the correct boarding gate was invaluable Not only did he ensure I found my belongings but he also took the time to ensure my wellbeing before departing I am sincerely grateful for his kindness and assistance
Nordavia has been renamed as Smartavia and reviews can be found on this new linkSmartavia Reviews

I have flown times on La Companie so far and could not be happier It makes me laugh to see complaints about ground accommodations and old planes etc this is an airline that flies to a manageable airport Orly with lower taxes than for example CDG it is a boutique operation with limited flights and proposes business class flights RT for as low as vs on poorer major airlines It is great value for the price and grumpy people can still spend their on a coach ticket booked on United coping with the CDG mess and see if they are offered hot towels full meal champagne and most importantly business class seats with better air quality

We arrived at Dinard airport at around in April The airport is tiny so dont expect much The queue for the passport control was queuing out of the door and took around mins to pass The airport has one small baggage belt that gets very cramped When you get into arrivals there are car hire desks Overall the arrival experience was ok considering what a small airport Dinard is On our departure there was only bag drop desk for an entire flight Next step is security where you have to show your passportboarding pass times to different people There is only security lane which took mins clear and when you get into the departure lounge it is no better there either there are no shops whatsoever no not even a magazine shop just a few vending machines Overall this airport was ok

Adelaide to Melbourne Staff were lazy and unhelpful They appeared more interested in selling extras and assessing baggage weight than providing service While nobody expects luxury from a budget airline courtesy shouldnt be dependent on ticket price

A small yet very convenient airport in the south of France From the plane to the exit takes no more than min Signaling shopping etc is all fine given the size and role of the airport Its not the most modern airport but everything is well maintained Theres a convenient bus service to the city center

I take this airline from Hangzhou to Lisbon th May The food is good taste and various I have stony insomnia problem and i did not pay attention and lost my sleeping medicine into rubbish I told the air hostess she is warmheart and patiently helped me search the rubbish patiently almost taking hours and finally searched my sleeping medicine I am thankful for this

A small but efficiently operating airport Arrival was smooth and fast even when there was an additional covid document check There are enough small shops and food and beverages available Transportation is best done by train which will cost only euro

Very small but clean and cozy airport with only gates Going through the passport control and customs was a breeze I do agree with the previous comments about taxis There is no public transportation from the airport to the city so unless someone is picking you up or youre picking up a rental youre forced to take a cab which will routinely rip you off and not even turn on the meter For a minute ride I was charged marks currently USD If you can arrange some type of transportation other than the taxi my advice is to do so

I left on early BA flight and was very impressed with the helpful staff in the airport check in hours ahead fast empty security and border control Nice airy feel and clean although some cafe prices shocking cost me more than Scandinavian airports euro for potato chips Generally modern and relaxed despite a number of early morning flights and there was a machine where robot gives you jelly beans I like distractions in airports takes your mind off stress BA gate staff helpful and whole experience was stress free compared to disgraceful regional airports in UK

Flew Amsterdam to Belfast International on Easyjet EZY and I found the overall experience to be very good There was a slight delay in take off due to ATC however not a a major issue The onboard cabin crew lead by Clark were excellent and very customer oriented Great flight on Easyjet

I usually fly budget so dont expect too much Had my first flight with Mihin Lanka from Chennai to Colombo Plane was not new but Im glad the flight was only hour as the seats felt like they had lost all their padding The flight went smoothly except the Stewards did not offer any option to purchase refreshments It may seem unnecessary on a short flight except by the time you have got to the airport and followed all procedures a few hours have ticked over and some refreshments would come in handy Probably what concerned me most was the fellow passenger pouring a hot drink from his flask to his wife How did that get through security There was someone on his mobile phone as we were landing The other fellow who grabbed his luggage and made his way to the front door before the plane had stopped

On October th we flew from Vienna to Karpathos which turned out to be the last passenger flight with this Airline to this destination due to the sad development The crew worked flawless as ever and was extremely friendly despite the fact that they are not quite sure about their professional future Not a single mention came up about that but you could see and sense their feelings We are exceedingly angry about the fact that many thousand passengers loose their money and some thousand well working employess lose their job Many many thanks and good luck for the crew and all the other employees of ABNiki

This was my first time on EVA Air and I must say that it was a highly impressive experience Yes it was pricey flying premium economy but at this will be the only way to fly when traveling to Asia from here on out unless traveling business I found the premium economy cabin to be more than satisfactory The seats of course were not lie flat but they still had enough pitch to be comfortable And the one thing that stood out were the cushions in seating There was enough padding that I wasnt even remotely uncomfortable throughout the entire flight I arrived in Taipei from LAX comfortable and refreshed The service was good and the food though not Michelinrated was still perfectly fine I would fly them again While some may say its not different enough from coach to make it worth the money when youre it makes a big difference Ive flown economy to Asia and never again

Nice airport Fairly modern The washrooms were clean and well maintained Its a fairly small airport There seemed to be a lot of security around the day we departed Airside international there is not much choice of food however I noticed across the road seemed to be popular with locals There was a coffee shop ouch for an iced coffee also some food there very expensive Going through security etc you go upstairs via escalator The oddest sight all booths open for both security and immigration yet we were the only ones there First time thats ever happened and I suspect last There were a few places to eat or drink airside and they seemed ok although we were not hungry Definitely liked this airport A very positive experience

Hakodate airport is fairly small but the building is modernised with only two floors Before the security gate on the second floor a small shopping arcade selling mainly Japanese goods Like all Japanese domestic airports Hakodate is well organised clean and efficient It caters mainly for passengers travelling with ANA and JAL two of the major Japanese airlines and Do airline a subsidiary of ANA If you are staying in the downtown area there is direct airport bus from JAL hotel the Grand hotel and the Hokodate train station to the airport The bus fare is yens and it takes only minutes

A modern medium size airport with ample space airside got plenty of outlets at the departure area and efficient checkin counter The airport is near to the city centre and it is easy to reach by taxi and private transportation Once through the security check you will be greeted by an airy airside with an ample seating area near to the gate and due to the design of the terminal the distance of the gate is really short and gave ample time for the passenger to catch their flight

Back to Pristina in February The airport now has a proper baggage reclaim and is looking a little more finished The departure lounge has another shop and increased size It is still best to use the bar before immigration Overall this is still a good little airport

Living in South Florida and used to departing from and connecting through massive airports GRR was a breeze Now the new parkingbuilding is fully functional and beautiful it is all in a natural colour of brown The checkin area itself is nothing to admire and very basic Than you walkup to a shortramp and there you are Steps away from all the terminals This area does have a small foodcourts with the basic pizzaburger fare It also has floortoceiling windows bringing in plenty of natural light GRR had a major problem its airfare were outrageously expensive even the discounted ones However after lowcost Allegiant started servicing Grand Rapids tickets prices dropped dramatically even last minute ones This can only bring more business to West Michigan

This is a fantastic airport Short walking distances nice staff good easytonavigate easytouse layout a stressfree atmosphere nice cafs I used Billund as a transit passenger on my way from Copenhagen to Berlin and my only minor remark is that the TRANSIT signs just pointed to a locked door I had to walk back exit and go through security again Never mind there was no queue and I doubt the locked door is standard procedure since the security folks got a little bit puzzled when they saw my Copenhagenissued boarding pass Dont hesitate to use this airport

I want to make a sincere gratefulness to your information service staff I recently lost my passport on Feb and boarding pass before the security check Since it was late at night and the information kiosk on departure lobby was closed I called the hotline a kind lady staff name as Kuje who checked for me again and again if any lost report She also suggest me to contach to related staff THE PASSPORT WAS FINALLY FOUND Thank you Kuje San I hope this message could be read by you Cheers from Hong Kong
The service is good as a budget airline Cabin crew is helpful I did not encounter any bad issue along my flight I will recomment this airline if oyur having a tight budget The fares are reasonable

Nice clean provincial airport handy for Asturias Cantabria and Galicia The checkin hall is spacious and on the occasions Ive used it it has always been hasslefree The cafe is large and reasonably priced and the toilets clean There are a half dozen care hire booths in the airport I always use the bus to get into and out of Oviedo It is cheap euros single and runs regularly from the stop outside the arrivals hall Regular buses also run to Gijon and Aviles There are plentiful taxis if you want a more expensive drive in The only mild criticism I have of the airport is the time it takes to get through customs on arrival Other than that a pleasant airport which nearly makes flying pleasurable

Graz is lovely small airport From our hotel in town centre it took mins to get airside at the gate including taxi ride checkin and security doesnt get better than that Friendly staff a quick service nice glass walls to view planes runaway etc from each gate Cafe duty free wifi access and not crowded I guess not a huge selection of destinations to fly to from here is the down side Overall a great airport experience

A delightful regional airport set amongst the lush valleys and hills of the Northern Rivers District of New South Wales Nice well designed terminal and with more convenient flight schedules with Regional Express down to Sydney than nearby Ballina which handles mainly tourist traffic Lismore Airport is close to town and has all the usual car rental facilities and is only minutes to the coast Byron BayBallina etc Only downside is as is usual at most airport terminals in Australia blaring televisions all around the terminal causing a racket and breaking the pleasant peace of this delightful place

A small domestic airport on Hamilton Island Queensland Australia very small but tidy and efficient Check in was a breeze and through security very quickly Lots of seating and only a couple of gates as planes restricted to daytime flights only Basic refreshments available and toilets although small were nice and clean You had a nice view of planes landing and parking close to the terminal and could see bags being loaded unloaded and the plane being refueled Very small but pleasant airport to wait for your flight

I love the PVR Puerto Vallarta airport It is clean and well organised It is reasonably well airconditioned allthough a few areas might be considered too cold Security is quick and efficient Walk ways and waiting areas provide plenty of space and there are work stations with plugins Directions are clearly marked and the airport is not huge There is a good selection of restaurants and shops My only complaint is that all the restaurants in the departure lounge close around pm That is unfortunate especially when your flight is delayed It is interesting considering that most people in Mexico do not go for dinner till about pm You also would expect them to stay open longer since this is an international airport and there are plenty of late flights This is by no means the only airport that has that problem though stars for food and beverages just because of times open The quality is great

Its always a pleasure going through this airport It is clean spacious and easy to navigate Immigration and customs are always fast and efficient There are a good number of dutyfree shops although not as many food outlets

Albrook Panama City to Bocas del Toro After reading comments about this airline I was a bit worried but our flight with Air Panama was really okay Checkin at the airport was quick there were no lines My bag was kg so I had to pay dollars for the kg overweight Totally fine There are no infoscreens at the small airport of Albrook but as there are only leaving a couple of flights a day its obvious when boarding starts The flight left at so right on time The fokker used for this flight is old but seatpitch was okay for this minute flight to Bocas After a loud and bumpy take off the crew handed out some crisps and a soda After minutes of cruising with some wonderful views at the rainforest and Caribbean beaches the pilot started decent into Bocas airport After a soft landing and a short taxi to the small apron our luggage appeared within minutes We really enjoyed this flight in this old air Panama fokkerairplane

Ive seen a lot of bad reviews of this airport but I wanted to reassure people that the airport is not as bad as it seems Most of the travel crisis in July was not the airports fault Yes it is slightly run down but the service was excellent and it serves as a good base for EasyJet and Jet Security was a breeze and Jet queues were non existent I actually found the toilets clean and the airport was clean with clear signs to the gate and there was no delays I am sorry if you had a bad experience during the travel crisis but with more airlines joining in I can only assume the airport will improve Jet has locations from Belfast I found it clean convenient and will travel again with Jet next year Staff were polite even when I accidentally left my aftershave in my hand luggage going through security They gave me a plastic bag to put it in and were friendly with me Ive never had any problems with the airport The other thing is the Northern Ireland economy isnt Dubai economy so its not like you are walking into Dubai International with Etihad Airways and expecting everything to be made of glass Belfast City may be more efficient for short haul flights but Belfast International has more destinations overseas I think for an airport in Northern Ireland with the current economy Belfast International is actually an excellent airport despite the reviews Its probably best to bear in mind Dublin Airport and London Heathrow Airport faced the same kind of issues as Belfast when it came to delays so Belfast isnt the odd one out It probably gets more of a bad reputation just because its slightly run down But I think its excellent and is set to improve I have heard reports of vomit on the floor and rude staff but perhaps that was sorted by the time I was travelling Many external factors meant there was delays and issues It could do with being updated and prices reduced but apart from that it is excellent I dont have a photo but the lounge looks first class I would highly recommend this airport and would give it stars all the way considering the issues it faces were not its fault its just got a worse reputation than it actually deserves Airport Hotel nearby means its efficient and there are plenty of car parking spaces too Brilliant Would highly recommend this airport

A quick visit to Rome from Prague on Ryanair The airport location close to the city is great with a painless connection via Airport Link Bus Train The entire trip easily purchased on the Trenitalia app for only to Termini The airport terminal itself is large enough to accommodate flights at the same time could be stretched to capacity with more traffic Boarding and disembarking on foot with some shops available Staff was curtuous so our departure was on time The proximity to Rome is a strong selling point when comparing to FCO
Nothing to do Old airport looks like some maintenance is needed Not a lot of shops or seating Toilets not clean at all No ventilation in terminal humid Definitely not what I would expect in Nice

Sydney Santiago via Auckland on Above average flight with an average meal very good crew and reasonable IFE selection However the abreast in economy is too tight The seats are too narrow and the aisles are tiny The meal trolley only just fits through The tray table is also very small On the return leg a passenger fell ill immediately after takeoff The crew managed this very well About hours into the flight it was determined that wed have to return to SCL The airline put us into hotels As a transit passenger through SCL the airline arranged to pay our reciprocity fee US to enter into Chile This was a long process over hour but at least they paid for it The airline wasnt able to arrange a single large bus to take us to the hotel at the last minute and so there was another long process about hours of getting all of us into separate mini buses The hotel was excellent and included free food Back to the airport this time in a big coach and a very long checkin process Our bags were checked through to SYD and we were advised wed been put onto a Qantas flight from AKL to SYD The flight was again reasonable good crew OK food definitely not up to Emirates standards and bathrooms kept clean Due to our delayed arrival into AKL we had to overnight there and again LAN had arranged a hotel meal and bus transfer for us Overall LAN managed this stressful situation which was out of their control quite well ensuring we had a place to rest and food to eat and made sure we all got to our final destinations My lower marks are for the standard and quantity of the food and the cramped seating that almost all operators of the have adopted

Recently opened airport because the former airport in Matshapa is now being used as something else The new location is quite inconvenient because it takes more than an hour from Mbabane city centre and I would strongly recommend that you use the road from Johannesburg to Mbabane because it takes only four hours from SA Cost wise it is also efficient to use the road

Hakodate airport is fairly small but the building is modernised with only two floors Before the security gate on the second floor a small shopping arcade selling mainly Japanese goods Like all Japanese domestic airports Hakodate is well organised clean and efficient It caters mainly for passengers travelling with ANA and JAL two of the major Japanese airlines and Do airline a subsidiary of ANA If you are staying in the downtown area there is direct airport bus from JAL hotel the Grand hotel and the Hokodate train station to the airport The bus fare is yens and it takes only minutes

I am only writing this review because so many things are off about this airport I definitely expected more as its a huge airport with tons of revenue from the gaming here The companion care restroom was locked as someone who needs this restroom and cannot use the other ones I was waiting for about minutes I knocked several times After minutes I called the courtesy phone operator concerned that someone was in there and unwell or unconscious No one responded then another person called on his own volition and still no one came This is a HUGE security concern After minutes a line was forming so I flagged down a lovely custodian who unlocked the door and discovered thankfully no one was inside He explained It was locked in the night to prevent people from sleeping in it The fact it was not unlocked during the night in the morning means this airport was not ADA compliant and the fact that no body came after securityrelated calls were made to the operator means this airport does not have quick response to security concerns Its filthy theres food crumbs coffee dust and crud on every surface and many chairs The charging stations barely work at least in the AA terminal and nearly all of the USB direct ports are full of grey putty while the ones that arent full of putty dont charge and are loose and broken The staff here are lovely but the facilities are dismal and frankly this place is a security nightmare As a bay area resident I will never fly through here again and will never recommend this airport with a definite preference for connecting CLEAN SAFE airports like Denver IAHHobby Atlanta or Chicago

Nice terminal though no seating space at the checkin area seems to be very congested After security check the seating area is much better though limited options of food and shopping The terminal itself is new and well maintained not much walk times The view of the runway from the terminal is good so you can pass your time quite well Free wifi with reasonably good connectivity available Announcements are adequate Overall quite good
Perfect and uneventful flight left in time boarding in BKK was done professionally and efficient Staff were polite and helpful Enough space in overhead lockers

I dont know what they call it an International Airport because it doesnt look like one Its a small airport and the only positive thing that I can say is that it was clean the rest is all negative People doesnt speak English The customer service is really bad they werent friendly at all the people were mean and rude Theres no restaurants just two coffee shop and one kiosk and two ATMs According to New York Times Panama is one of the best destinations for tourism and I agree that it is a beautiful country However they need to work on the facilities customer service and improve their languages skills because they could loose tourists and clients just for these points that I mentioned before

Genoa airport compares extremely well with our huge overcrowded and understaffed London airports It is nice and small with lovely shops and good cafes There are no long queues at check in or security and staff are friendly and helpful A pleasure to visit

I arrived from Phnom Penh and then departed to Bangkok On arrival at the domestic airport there was no air bridge and it was a very short walk to the main building It took a while for the luggage to come out but luckily the arrival area was not crowded Departed from the international terminal to Bangkok The terminal was new and clean and check in staff very friendly and helpful There was only one security line open but the queue wasnt too long After security there were few shops and a great Plaza Premium Lounge if you fly Bangkok Airways they also offer their own lounge The Plaza Premium lounge was quiet well design and spacious Overall a great and smooth departure experience

Kuala Lumpur to Kuching return on Feb Overall vey satisfied with the experience An exceptional service by the friendly cabin crew The airline offers an exceptional value for money The economy class cabin very clean and features new seats and wifi entertainment using own device The food is good for a domestic flight In both sectors boarding by groups and strictly follow The ground staff is good but can be better For one and half hour flight am not complaining

I went to Jamaica for a week on vacation and I have no complaints regarding Caribbean airlines Not the best airline on the planet but theyre definitely by far not the worst they are reasonable and if youre willing to spend a bit more than business class definitely is substantially more comfortable The only drawback that I can think of but that isnt their fault is the fact that on the return trip I had to make four stops in four different countries

Had an excellent experience travelling through Dublin airport to Miami The security was efficient We precleared US customs and immigration which took minutes saving us from having to do it through Miami There was a good choice of food and drink but very limited once you enter the US zone

Yangon Terminal is very nice It is not too large immigration may be slow but they are friendly Atmosphere is modern clean and nice including good restroom Check in counter are totally empty at the time of my departure Once can spend minutes for check in process and wait at a few nice cafe they have noted that you cant find anything to eat after passing immigration

Very quiet and peaceful airport well equipped with benches places to sit and even lie down It is not a large airport so the catering facilities with shops are small but sufficient Very nicely designed areas where you can sit and experience Finnish nature For the first time I see an airport where you can relax physically and mentally It is also a bit cold it perfectly reflects the climate of Finland It does not heat up excessively and there is a delicate chorus which can be annoying at first but after some time you get used to it

Went through Cairo airport during my recent trip arriving from Emirates and leaving to the UK both in terminal Despite the long queues in departure being a bit of a hassle the coordinators were incredibly helpful They did their best to address any issues and kept things moving as smoothly as possible The terminal itself is pretty modern and clean the lounge is amazing and while it could use a few more amenities i would say it was an overall satisfying experience a solid out of

La Paz Sucre in an exMexicana Ticketing process is manual and very slow beware and get your tickets before the airport We were handed a little snack bag as we boarded then served drinks on board a great way to provide good service on a short flight

This airport is newly refurbished and very clean Unfortunately there is absolutely nothing to do here so its best not to arrive early My biggest problem with KGL is that the processes are extremely slow staff seem to lack motivation and sufficient training in customer service It also took over one hour to clear immigration and collect my luggage yet there was only one flight arriving at the time

Fantastic flight Despite a delay departing Narita due to weather I really enjoyed my flight on Air Calin The crew were fantastic very friendly and helpful Excellent onboard service great food a very comfortable seat and the cabin was clean I would fly them again

Quite impressed as I was not expecting much the ticket was very cheap brand new aircraft very cleaned and smelled nice Pretty good legroom seat next to me vacant so it was comfortable flight Two hot meal services main meals not very good but was happy with fresh fruit on the tray insider tip when offered SEAFOOD NOODLES dont expect wok stir fried asian style noodlesyou will get something that I would expect in Swedish kindergarten see photo below crew dont speak much English and the service is somehow chaotic but not too bad IFE quite limited but enough for me

Very nice cabin comfortable seats and good entertainment systems The food tasted very good and there was enough food for the flight length The flight attendants were all very friendly except steward Plane TVJA Date July

Bangkok to Yangon retjurn in midMay This is my first experience with this airline and it did not disappoint The checkin at the airport for both flights were uneventful efficiently handled and most notably having little or no queues which is always a welcomed sight when there are snaking queues at neighbouring counters for other airlines The boarding for the outgoing flight started a little after the scheduled time The planes do not have any seatback entertainment units but for the outgoing flight there was onboard wifi which allow you free access to a selection of movies and TV shows on the MAI app which can be preloaded onto phones Ipads etc The selection was limited For a min flight it is impressive that the cabin crew is able to come round with wet tissues followed by a meal and drinks service The cabin crew were polite and cheerful The captain made announcements regularly which were spoken in clear English

What is happening with some Italian Airports As Florence and Pisa Bologna is completely and horrendously overcrowded One cannot walk around at the gate area which is immediately after a socalled DutyFree With people queuing to get on a plane or for a sandwich or coffee there is no space to get anywhere without pushing your way through The worse there is absolutely no air to breath with all these people standing around Probably much is because of some low cost airlines which let you queue well before effectively boarding planes but whatever it is Bologna should think about some solution as it is an ordeal A pity because personnel is generically very friendly and there are lovely food options in the terminal

Our flight was on time checkin was smooth The staff on board were friendly I highly recommend this airline despite several negative reviews I think it is much better than many European low cost airlines Il nostro volo stato puntuale il checkin stato veloce Il personale a bordo stato cordiale Consiglio vivamente questa compagnia aereanonostante le diverse recensioni negative penso sia molto meglio di molte low cost europee

Hannover is a medium sized airport with all facilities you expect Great plus are the short ways good signage short waiting times at the checkin security and baggage delivery Always very clean Easy to reach by car bus or train They have a good selection of restaurants like high quality Mvenpick or even McDonalds supermarkets decent duty free and a great aviation exhibition Welt der Luftfahrt and observation deck When you fly Lufthansa or Star Alliance and have a status you get access to a stylish lounge with great apron views A nice airport I like to use a lot

I dont know how things were in the past but there is no current reason for a one star review Flew from Beijing to Pyongyang From a comfort perspective Air Koryo was just like any international economy class seat Yes the inflight entertainment for the hour flight was basically North Korean propaganda and magazines from North Korea but surely if you are a tourist to North Korea that is exactly what you are interested in In fact youd probably prefer that to say Big Bang Theory episode reruns The food was average The service was perfectly passable

I recently flew out of Manchester Terminal A great experience from leaving the car at the pre booked car park No queues at bag drop off or security even though I had bought a fast track pass The terminal is clean bright and well appointed Within minutes of arrival I was eating breakfast in San Carlo My return trip was as efficient within one hour of landing I had collected my car and was at home Terminal is a revelation after the dire experiences of Terminal Well done from me

Overall I like BHM Its small staff at least at Delta check in and gate are super friendly The amenities are good for a small regional airport Bags are usually quick to retrieve My one gripe is parking The parking deck is always almost very nearly completely full so finding a space can often take as long as the short flight to connect in ATL The one other thing that annoys me every time I do find a space is total lack of smart carts in the parking lots Hey listen up Airport managers This is an airport and customers travel with baggage Dont you think it would be a great idea to facilitate this process of getting bags to terminals by offering a cart service in the parking lots

Such a fantastic flight Our flight attendant Jay was incredible His demeanour was cheerful and friendly and I truly wish every attendant was like him From the moment you got on the plane he had a positive energy and was respectful and helpful of all the guests Love United and kudos for such a great team

Airport uses a lot of natural light The design is modern especially the departure lobby the ceiling its so high The staff in the airport have good manners The luggage arrived quick and theres plenty of checkin counters too The bad thing airline lounges terrible

I flew fom Bergerac airport to Stansted today When i had cleared baggage body and passport check I went to the lounge to realise to my horror that I hadnt got my belt from the body check I spent minutes contemplating how I was shortly destined to be walking round London with my trousers falling down because I didnt have my belt on As we were summoned to the gate I was overjoyed to hear an announcement from Bergerac Airport or Ryanair saying that my belt had been found I am so happy I feel moved to thank and complement whichever staff or system meant that I was reunited with my belt Well done

I recently had the opportunity to fly with Airlink South Africa for a short domestic flight Although the itinerary was relatively brief I was pleasantly surprised by the overall experience The booking process was straightforward and userfriendly without any unnecessary complications or hidden fees I appreciated the option to check in online and generate a boarding pass saving time and effort at the airport The staff at the checkin counter was friendly and efficient guiding me through the process with a smile I was delighted to board an Embraer jet a spacious and comfortable aircraft known for its exceptional legroom and modern amenities The cabin felt roomy and airy providing ample space to stretch out and enjoy the journey The cabin crew was attentive and welcoming ensuring that passengers were comfortable and wellserved Before takeoff they offered a selection of boxed juices and small snacks a nice touch for such a short flight The crews friendly demeanor and genuine care for passenger satisfaction were commendable Although Airlinks fares may be slightly higher than some budget airlines the overall experience justifies the additional cost The airline offers a combination of comfort efficiency and friendly service that makes it a worthwhile choice for travelers seeking a pleasant air travel experience My recent Airlink flight left me with a positive impression The airlines commitment to efficiency comfort and customer service is evident in every aspect of the journey While it may not be the cheapest option Airlink South Africa delivers a value proposition worth considering for those seeking a reliable and enjoyable flying experience

Visited Uganda on and departed on Both arrival and departure experiences were smooth Arrival hall is rather large There is mandatory health screening before one can proceed to visapassport control Obtaining a visa is relatively easy Present valid passport and make payment Baggage claim appeared to be a rather large area with perhaps carousels At departure level the lighting seems rather deem There is the mandatory screening of bags before you can enter and check in for the flight The staff is very friendly The facilities are clean and the departure hall appears small given the amenities gift shops dining and duty free The Karibuni Lounge is excellent It puts to shame US airline lounges in the USA with its food offerings and amenities Bathrooms are cleaned frequently by an attendant Overall no issues with EBB airport Immigration control staff are very friendly The only drawback to this airport is that passengers have to be dropped off in the parking area and then make their way around the roadway to the departure level

Clean and efficient nice ground staff homemade pies in the cafe upstairs You feel you are welcome Then sq foot or less per person when Ryanair process their passengers from flights at the same time through the only gate Just dont get into that huge black hole after the checkin thats not the entrance but the place to drop your luggage in A bit confusing But the good thing is that upon arrival you walk no more than yards from the plane through the custom and luggage reclaim to the coachtaxi Beware there is no ATM around Nice service but very basic facilities

Very pleasant flight from Athens to Thessaloniki with Ellinair Easy process of booking and echeck in the boarding pass is sent to the mobile so no app or printer is needed Athens Airport was a breeze the fee included checked baggage so I chose to check in my hand luggage also for free the company did it with a smile Departure and arrival on time flight about full Good legspace service included very small snack and drinks Immaculate and smiling crew Quick retrieval of baggage in Thessaloniki Excellent experience

Airport is brand new after going through modern reconstruction Airport surrounding has also gone through a modern reconstruction Signage was seen throughout the airport passport control and security is upstairs accessed through an escalator Pens used to fill out a departure form were running out with no other pens in the surrounding area Passport control was quick and so was security despite there being a long line it soon disappeared Couple of food shops Chinese dim sum Khmer etc Overall the airport has been refitted to a modern state gates shops etc were new and staff were friendly

The seat was spacious but the recline function was lost on my seat Crew were friendly They offered one meal plus one snack for just hours The onboard announcement was inaccurate that they claimed to be landing soon hours before the actual landing Surprisingly personal onboard entertainment was offered

Thank you so much for a wonderful service Nurit and her great teamstaff were professional attentive friendly and very helpful I was traveling with my mom and they made it easier for me and took care of her needs Id like to thank you all for being so nice and giving such a great service Youre awesome Arzo Diana Chen and special thanks to Mara In addition the food was great

Flew Phnom Penh to Siem Reap with Bassaka Air Nice short domestic flight with a very courteous B crew nothing but smiles and the Best of Cambodian hospitality during this minute flight Was the cheapest option at incl baggage and an onboard refreshment and everything went smoothly througout Would definitely recommend

Another charming African airport where you can bribe your way into any area of the airport and where power cuts tend to be a problem and staff have to run to the generator to get lights back on Surprising that KLM actually lands here no other western airline company does such a thing

We travelled on Air Namibia after our travel company arranged substitute flights to Victoria Falls due to our Virgin Atlantic plane being delayed from London resulting in us missing our connection Virgin were very unhelpful offering a new flight days later The trip with Air Namibia was excellent from start to finish The crew were very friendly on board the food was nice When we landed at Windhoek the ground staff were very helpful ensuring our bags continued the journey and we were kept informed

Great experience Early check in possible and done quickly staff super friendly Security fast and lets you go faster with a baby Nice tax free zone that you can actually enjoy as the check in and security is done quickly At least two amazing playgrounds for children great cafes everything clean
Despite the poor reviews I kind of had to use Safi on the Dubai to Kabul route I was pleasantly surprised that we got reasonably new As with normal leg room and the planes were dead on time

A small airport right in the east of the city center with a convenient metro connection readily available The terminal itself is small but well organized and has enough small shops for food and beverages Security queuing times late in the evening were nonexistent border control only inbound was equally fast Best airport if youve to be in London itself

Fantastic service from bag drop to landing and getting my baggage on the other end All staff played their role in providing the excellent customer service It was an early morning flight and it was really nice to start the day on the right track

It is a small airport no long queues or big crowds quick checkin and boarding It has quite good services if you consider its dimensions It is clean and comfortable I always start my trips here when possible also for overseas flights because it has good connections with the main hubs Rome Paris Munich London Istanbul

Interesting experience This airport is very close to the city mainly for domestic flights and is extremely busy However even though really crowded all queues seem to move very quickly A reasonable mix of retail outlets and I thought the prices were OK Plenty on taxis on return there are prepay ones but for journeys into the city a metered cab is fine

A long but pleasant flight Cabin crew were kind and friendly gave me snacks when I walked to back of the plane to stretch my legs Food was good The only hiccup was the website has glitches on some of the pages for online checkin when accessed from mobile phone I had to use iPad to find a workaround in the end hour call centre hotline based in Brunei was very useful and answered the call with no queue You dont get that efficiency from many carriers these days

The checkin staff was very helpful and I had a smooth checkin process I received an aisle seat in the exit row with loads of legroom However that is where the good part ends the aircraft was not very clean and the inflight service consists of a juice nuts and the thinnest bar of Cadbury Diary Milk chocolate you will ever see They did not seem to have any menu for purchase as well After spending hours in the Domestic Terminal at Male where nothing is available to purchase and then going through a hour flight with nothing to eat is not the best experience There is a single attendant on the flight who passes by once to hand out the food and once to take the trash The experience is certainly not comparable to domestic flights in Asia and a tad disappointing especially given the premium prices in Maldives The good thing is that the flight was absolutely on time

The flight was great However it could still improve Bring your own tablets as the IFE systems were kind of laggy and the choices were very limited The seats were quite hard and on my nd flight the seat recline was broken so I had to manually force it back to the original position The food was wonderful and so were the staff
Out on QF on Premium Economy back on QF Business Class Premium economy very good and business class great Cabin crew really good and service superb

Would like to give big thumbs up to boarding crew Ms Noor at Tiruchirappalli Airport We are four family flying from TrichyIndia to Singapore Boarding process went very smooth with her providing detailed explanation before keep luggage what can bring and what cannot She is quite knowledgeable and inform the passenger upfront to complete the boarding process smooth and fast
Excellent service very cheerful and professional cabin crew Delicious catering punctual Honestly EgyptAir deserves a much better rating Keep up the excellent work

Fantastic Service Booked from Australia for Joburg to Maun flight Kept great communications for any changes and even transferred me on a SA flight no extra charge for my KasaneJoburg leg when I explained about connection time with my Qantas flight due to schedule changes without having to be asked and emailed me back a new booking Great service nice snack on a short leg clean modern plane on time friendly ground staff I hear things might have been different a few years back but certainly my experience was very good and would fly with them again
Great service safety standard met Comfy seat and nice snacks The staffs in all aspects are very kind and very helpful Sad it will merge with Thai Airways

My mother and I experienced Tokyo Narita International Airport Good service the staff smiled when my mother and I went in to buy things When I transited at Tokyo Narita International Airport To return to Lax International Airport to continue studying I did not know where to go There were two guides very polite the first staff held a map The second staff asked me if I needed a car to gate B At that time I was at gate because flight NH Ana Airlines departed from Ho Chi Minh City to Tokyo Narita International Airport I will come back many more times because the staff is very good

A brand new airport which is large and spacious but lacking in facilities Our gate was in an area where there is no catering and no access to a part of the airside where we could even get a coffee Staff are not all that friendly here but it seems to be efficient with little queuing though not all the many flights either

If youre on a budget going on a trip to Jamaica fly Swoop while you can before it shuts down I dont know what a flight is like going to other locations but flying to Sangster airport in Jamaica was perfectly fine It was after tax roundtrip for a hr flight I know there a ton of negative reviews about Swoop but perhaps thats dependent on location Its a low cost flight so YES everything is going to cost you but you cant fault them for that You have the choice to pick who you fly with The flight attendants were nice seats were actually very spacious The only unfortunate thing is that our return flight was cancelled but that wasnt even Swoops fault the airport was doing construction Ended up being a blessing in disguise Swoop covered a free stay in Montego Bay since we had to wait for following day to fly out It was pretty seamless to be honest I dont know why some other passengers didnt have it sorted maybe they didnt book through swoop but I got the email for a complimentary accommodation and they gave me options I picked the thats a minute drive from airport and it was perfect The hotel manager was there waiting for us and everything worked out great we had booking and she checked us in It was awesome another day in Jamaica I couldnt complain The return flight next day was fine Id def fly with Swoop again

Phnom Penh to Siem Reap The cabin crew on our flight were amazing They were smiling and managed to provide every passenger with a beverage on this very short minute flight We will definitely be using Bassaka Air in the future due to the affordable prices cleanliness awesome flight attendants and speedy service

Auckland to Shanghai via Chengdu The food was very good from a Chinese perspective The service was impressive The crew members were nice and passionate Also for transit in Chengdu the passenger is able to claim yuan voucher free hour baggage storage free transit commendation in Chengdu Based on this price you cannot ask more Thank you Sichuan Airlines for the wonderful memory

Arrived TRS on March Airport under a great deal of construction Departed on March and most of the construction apparatus and scaffolding has disappeared Airport seems newly refurbished Small pleasant airport I used the new airport train station Bit of a hike from the terminal but still got through security minutes after departing the train There were two people in line for security One restaurantbar post security and a small comfortable notwellstocked lounge Train station a welcome addition as the bus to Trieste takes an hour and the taxi journey is expensive

I took LAN airlines from Santiago to Easter Island I was in business the seats were very comfortable and cabin crew were very helpful and kind The food was good the flight was on time and the cabin was clean It was a very good experience with LAN for my first time Would recommend

Birmingham to Amritsar via Ashkabat No nonsense air line Great Indian vegetarian food There was no flight screens no seat screens We stopped at Ashgabat for one hour its nice modern airport with all facilities The good thing was that the time at Ashgabat and time in India is only minute difference

Koh Samui is a real unique airport almost everything is openair As they dont have any air bridges all passengers will be carried by little unique trolleys from and to the planes They do have a roof on most parts of the airport but no walls a very airy experience and a fine contrast to the usual

This airport is located in a train station next to it which is pretty cool but can cause major traffic getting in to it The inside is clean and well kept with plenty of restaurants Security is just ok not many lines open so it can take a long time to get through The issue I have like most Chinese airports is that they dont use the jetways much and make you walk out on tarmac and take buses sometimes to and from aircraft In our case it was in the rain which made for an uncomfortable trip Not sure why when jetways were open and they have enough but from what I can tell is that when the plane is not to depart after landing it gets stored over night and if you fly in later at night you will have to take bus so I try to avoid night flights into this airport
