I was surprised with the cleanliness and efficiency of the airport in Guayaquil Really modern and easy to navigate I liked the zen garden at the domestic arrivals which really was a nice touch Toilets were clean Passport control very organised and staff are polite also duty free staff were very helpful Nice WiFi and view of the runway watching planes goes by Happy using it

I traveled with Caribbean airlines flying out of Toronto Canada into Trinidad and Tobago I havent flown with this airline in about twenty years I must say I was totally happy with the service they provided Staff was very welcoming The pilot was amazing with the way he took of and landed I was very hesitant about flying with them because of what negative reviews and experiences I heard Thanks for making my trip a great one to the team and staff at Caribbean airlines

CPTGBE GBEJNB First flight a clean Bae in very good condition half empty with loads of leg room Food excellent for an airline and service find Second flight on an equally clean ATR with equally good snacks All flights on time Much prefer them to SAX or Airlink

Norman Manley Airport originally Palisadoes Airport is an old military field that like MBJ has grown As most tourist arrivals are via MBJ KIN gets overlooked when improvements are in the works Indeed an old tired airport with crowding a problem both inside outside the buildings There is an improvement programme underway for the airside facilities with pax facilities coming in second place Walking tofrom the plane is interesting but the smell of jet fuel can be nauseating Like MBJ the approach provides interesting views Kingston and surrounds notably the hills above town The drive in from the airport is a beautiful ride along the peninsula though if going into town will be through some rough spots Recent hurricane damage has been repaired for the most part Overall a far below MBJ in all aspects but workable

I recently had the pleasure of flying with Eastern Airways from East Midlands and I must say that the experience exceeded my expectations in terms of genuine warmth friendliness and personability Right from the moment I stepped foot on the aircraft I was greeted by a genuinely friendly crew who exuded a warm and welcoming Throughout the flight the crew members went above and beyond to ensure the comfort and satisfaction of the passengers What truly set this flight apart was the crews personable approach They took the time to interact with passengers on a personal level engaging in friendly conversations and offering helpful recommendations It felt more like flying with a group of friends rather than being mere passengers This personal touch made the journey feel special and created a pleasant and memorable experience In conclusion my experience with Eastern Airways was characterized by a genuine friendly crew who made the flight enjoyable from start to finish Their warm and personable approach created a positive atmosphere and left a lasting impression I would highly recommend Eastern Airways to anyone seeking a memorable and pleasant flying experience

Very basic domestic airport Probably the most basic Ive ever experienced Probably built late s early s and left Old Lino on the floor broken last Id strips where your luggage goes straight to the tarmac one coffee shop Surprisingly the toilets were very clean even with fresh flowers Nothing airside just uncomfortable plastic chairs I felt offended in that only non Caucasian people were scanned with the wand Did not seem right or fair Boarding of course was by steps Despite its limitations it was ok Just annoyed when those with too much baggage holds up the rest as they argue about it

Larnaca to Athens This is registered as a Cypriot airline yet it seems that they are against the local language in that safety instructions are given only in english On this airline it is impossible to select a free seat only paid seats can be selected via web The aircraft was more than perfect clean but was not near jetways and bus was used for boarding In flight magazine price list and safety instructions were overused Nothing was offered during the flight if you want a drink you pay for it

Sapporos New Chitose airport is very effective and user friendly facility Located somewhat far from Sapporo it is perfectly linked to the city and the region by rail Quick checkin quick baggage delivery good choice of food outlets landside but not a lot of things to do airside The train station is underground as almost everywhere in Japan All in all very good star
Rating Cabin Flown Economy Value for Money Seat Comfort Staff Service Catering Entertainment Recommended

One of my favorite airports to make a connection through Ive flown through MKE maybe times or so and never have had to wait in a line to go through security There is also a very nice bookstore decent food options nice play areas for kids and an aviation museum The airport is also fairly stress free for making connections

Although Westchester County Airport is awfully small compared to JFK or Bradley it is amazing It has car rentals an actual baggage carousel five airlines going in and out of there local planes accepted too and even have gates This is so much better than some small airports Ive been to

I had read many bad review with Swoop so I booked with an open mind primarily because of the low cost of flying with a family of We had a month old with us and had her gear in tow car seat and stroller we were told it would be easier to gate check the baby equipment Right from our first interaction with the staff they were very accommodating with our situation and the stewardesses were phenomenal in explaining the safety protocol with a baby Our outgoing flight was smooth and no issues our return flight was delayed mins because of weather but we were given ample notice Once we were cleared to board we were delighted to see the same staff who recognized us and came over to say HI Its a shame that Swoop will be no longer I would fly with them again
Changes made for the World Cup have improved this airport from small and efficient to small and very slick New access to departures security is welcome

Small airline but a good one Despite heavy turbulence on the flight from Kuala Lumpurs old airport to Tioman Island I felt safe and that the FAs knew what to do in the event of an emergency Cant be sure of course but it felt that way Good information from the crew about the turbulence Small planes but comfortable for the relatively short flight Good service during the flight

Amazing customer service with this airline I booked this flight from Quesnel to Comox for my father who is having cognitive difficulties and I was worried about him making his connection in Vancouver I contacted CMA and they made a point to call me back to discuss the situation and then ensured someone would be there to make sure my father didnt feel lost and got on the right plane Due to weather and traffic accidents on the way to the airport we were late picking my father up and again I was able to contact someone who sent an attendant to relay the message to my father who doesnt own a cell phone I was so impressed

This airline is world class and knows how to treat its customers with professionalism and respect Hands down the best airline Ive traveled with and Ive traveled a lot If their standards remain top notch Ill be a customer for life

Cascais to Bragana with Aero VIP Services are provided by SevenAir The site is easy I had a couple of questions and the support was fantastic The plane was just fine despite being a propeller thus a bit noisy

Very smooth and pleasant checkin The Dynasty Lounge at Narita is very large and comfortable but with a limited range of food and drink Onboard the service was excellent and my vegetarian meal was tasty The seat was an old style regional seat with limited recline and storage At Taipei the lounge was comfortable with a range of delicious snacks and meals We transferred to another regional A with more comfortable seats than the previous flight They converted into a rather lumpy angled bed This flight had been advertised as an A with modern lieflat business class seats a plane which was now under maintenance As compensation an upgrade voucher with months validity was provided but with our current travel plans it is difficult to see how we could use it On board service was excellent again and the vegetarian meals were copious and of good quality The flight arrived in good time but our baggage took a long time to arrive though business class luggage was delivered first Despite the aircraft downgrade I think that China Airlines is a good value way to fly between Australia and Japan

Nice new Airport I have been travel through his airport for last one year and it is very nice and good airport overall It is relatively new but still there is a lot things which can be improved like Air conditioning and bathroom cleanness etc

The new terminal is very spacious and it was apparent they were putting in additional shops and services but was under construction when we departed Very clean and modern One thing I miss about the old terminal is that it was right on the end of the electric tram line So you could walk out of the airport to a tram and pay about dollars for a ride into the city You can still get to the tram but its an awkward walk You have to walk about minutes to reach it Also the kantorcurrency exchange was outside of security so after we had gone through passport control I couldnt exchange money So hopefully theyll fix that There was free internet near a cafe but couldnt easily find power So most people had to run off of battery There was a nice hotel we had used in the past affordable and clean but it was closed for renovation Hope they dont raise the prices upon reopening They really jazzed up the airport and city for the world cup

The Puerto Princesa International Airport had just opened its new terminal The terminal was clean and brand new The airport terminal had no jet bridge or ramp stairs so we had to deplane via an old fashioned staircase at the mercy of the weather thankfully at that time it was already dark The airport lacks formal transportation to the city center although the city streets is just a mere minutes walk away Definitely one of the best provincial airports in the Philippines if you consider dirt runways the norm

HELLPA return with A Booked flights months earlier and reservation for exit seats for extra charge from their call center was kept at check in Generous legroom Friendly attentive crew flight deck announcements and clean aircraft made hrs flight more enjoyable for a leisure flight Also our pre booked Holiday Meal on outbound flight was surprisingly tasty and hot and portions were more filling than we have had for this route with other carriers Only minus was inbound flight meal which was bit tasteless perhaps due to LPA catering Drinks for purchase but all in all flight with them DK offered more holiday feeling than our national carriers charter flight offers Baggage came fast at LPA but in HEL it took more than min due to ground handling problems

Kazi Nazrul Islam airport RDP Durgapur is a new greenfield airport in the the industrial city of Durgapur West Bengal Eastern India It is a growing airport which holds much promise for improving air connectivity to this part of the state and can become a major player in boosting tourism and business in the area The connectivity from the city to the airport has improved but still needs more intervention including development of the surrounding areas

In spite of a delay of one hour at LHR the flights to and from Australia were the most pleasant that I have made on this route The cabin service is outstanding and my dietary requirements diabetic were met and were some of the best I have ever eaten The cabin crew at all times were top class

Excellent airport and decent size it is not as huge as other asian mega hubs but it means getting in the out of the airport is very quick From touching town to the taxi it took mins maximum Signposts are very clear and there are so many staff to help you all very friendly The airport is dated and is due for a refurb yet it is spotless Departure experience was also great Check in was easy immigration and security very fast and smooth despite not having priority lane for business class custmers There are some interesting shop aside the global boutique and plenty of seats to rest There are even free lounge area which is like a living room Airlines lounges in TPE arent good quality with the exception of Cathay Pacific but there are a lot of FB offers especially in Terminal

Tontouta is a fairly basic international airport There are no skybridges so on arrival you descend the stairs and cross the tarmac to the single terminal and vice versa on departure Customs and immigration are fairly straightforward although a little bit of French will help The airport is a long way from Noumea so it is best to arrange a transfer with your hotel pre booking before you leave is the best Arc en ciel was the best company we thought Heading back out is always a nightmare at Tontouta there is no order for anything Customs is always straightforward when departing Only a small duty free on the other side and only cafe not much to do There are no tv screens or monitors for the flights You just have to rely on the French announcements and a piece of paper at the gate Overall was a good experience and a very good airport for a small tropical island

Portland to Klamath Falls one way Flight was delayed about an hour due to the need to get a part for the aircraft from another plane Ground staff did their best to keep passengers in the loop Aircraft was clean enough but is clearly an old plane Onboard service was friendly and professional The single aisle row seems to be the most comfortable

Its a pleasure to travel with Cyprus airways They are so kind and really try to help The staff in Dubai is super friendly and playful with my daughter Im a nervous flyer and I always feel at ease when travelling with Cyprus airways

The cabin crew were amazing They really took control of the cabin and looked after all the passengers The thing Ive never seen is how they controlled the disembarking of the plane ensuring specific rows would get up in an orderly fashion Ive flown Kulula for over a decade and theyve really upped their game

We adults kids came here about a year ago YOWPUJ nothing bad but nothing good Very clean and a lot of Sunwing Workers are nice and there is a great viewing area for kids But the downside is long waiting times for everything Otherwise it was pretty good and we will be using it again on Mar for a flight to London UK then Warsaw Poland and back Will review it again then

Overall our experience my wife and myself in transit twice in KGL has been satisfactory certainly compared with airports in the region with regard to seating not very comfortable but OK cleanliness including toilets signage and announcements attitude of official personnel security and boarding procedures Free WIFI did not work However we have been ripped off when purchasing goods from the VIVA GLOBAL DUTY FREE SHOP billed much higher prices than advertised no receipt received for some goods which we also paid far too much in USD We did not have our luggage on arrival at destination travel with Rwandair to BRU our suitcases arrived early next day via another company but we had to collect them from the airport since Rwandair does not have a policy of sending delayed luggage to the home

I used Tempelhof for the first and I guess last time last week It is wonderful why are modern airports not like this The history and architecture are fabulous of course but it also works incredibly well admittedly having so few flights means nothing is really under pressure As noted elsewhere public transport links are excellent one can be in the city centre within minutes of walking off the plane From the departure lounge to seat on the aircraft takes less than a minute I guess it is an anachronism in the st century but it is sad to say goodbye to an airport with real character

Good checkin and boarding excellent lounge but a disappointing experience with an unfriendly and ignorant worker at the security check There were only a few passengers at the airport no queue at the checkin counter The lounge was impeccable with a friendly staff a very good choice of snacks drinks and reading material The only negative moment was in the priority security line despite that there were no passengers in the line right after am The worker who checked my passport and boarding pass sternly told me that next time she would not allow me to use the priority security line if I dont present my Silver Finnair Plus card The Priority Security note was boldly printed in a big font on my boarding pass which she was holding in her hand so Im afraid to think she could not read English RIX in general is a good airport but the management has to teach priority security line workers to read and understand at least two words in English Priority Security
I agree with the previous reviewers comments This is a great little airport An added bonus is that there is now a direct train link to Jerez centre as well as Cadiz and the surrounding cities

Flight was ontime small propellerdriven aircraft seats Large cabin bags do not fit into the overhead compartment they are stored in the front of the cabin The seat was comfortable enough for a shorthaul flight staff was friendly and helpful Would fly within again

Well organised for the transit process Airport service persons picked us up at the exit and allocated us in a special area There are free services for water wifi access and breakfast A lady registers and reminds each of the customers in the waiting area for boarding Very good experience

Was not impressed with food service and attitude Ordered glasses of wine at Mike Kitchen Charge AUS Is this reasonable Can get bottles for this price Was then told could not take wine into food court where we wanted to get something to eat Could not get food at Mikes Kitchen as kitchen was going to close in minutes Was not permitted to bring food from another outlet to have with my wine Shortly after wine was served was asked to hurry up as premises was about to close We were not advised hen purchasing wine that we would have to hurry up and drink Do not use Mikes Kitchen And then in a rush to buy food went to KFC where the very young staff had no interest in serving me and I was then told that most menu choices were unavailable and only zinger burgers were on sale My wife does not eat any spicy food Will avoid Sydney Airport on future visits to Australia or bring my own sandwiches and but wine in duty free Sadly spoilt an otherwise great visit to Australia

I am flying FDHDUS regularly and I am fully satisfied with this airline Due to the smaller sizes of their aircrafts the flight takes some time about hr min but service onboard is excellent Good regional snacks and plenty of drinks are served during the flight Ground handling in FDH is very quick and efficient Prices are high but still recommendable

Its always a pleasure going through this airport It is clean spacious and easy to navigate Immigration and customs are always fast and efficient There are a good number of dutyfree shops although not as many food outlets

Its pretty good for a budget airline As long as you have followed predeparture guidelines packed properly and have your passport valid visa and PNR number checkin is easy even if it takes a while for people in front of you to repack their bags as they were NOT prepared or were taking chances with their baggage allowance The rest of the flight was uneventful the crew cabin and seating were efficient beyond what you would expect from a budget airline

This review is for International arrivals and US Departures Ive used this airport in December and then again in March In general a much better experience this time around On arrival sufficient immigration desks were staffed and customs was quick enough so that I was in my hotel within minutes of touching down On departure the new US Departures terminal is much improved from the older version Check in and security is quick and efficient The only place where there are lines is the US immigration pre clearance Airside the terminal is quite pleasant with lots of shops restaurants etc While the main restaurant Kafe Kalik I think is pleasant with outdoor seating I would not recommend ordering food there unless you want to risk missing your flight they took minutes to bring our food

Manado airport is one of the best in Indonesia It has a small delay rate and has a very good view from the waiting room The airport terminal faces east of Manado and oversees the beautiful nature and mountain ranges with the planes takingoff and landing

Not a bad little airport Plenty of space and seating if you need to wait a while But like all most Chinese airports the departure shops are terrible and expensive Bring your own snacks drinks or something to read Nothing to see there but it is comfortable enough

It is a very clean airport and very easy to move around Departures and arrivals are well defined and separate It is very safe and there are good shopping areas in the departures My experience at this airport is flights all without problems at the airport and the last flight was in January Nice views from airport we can see Desertas Islands and the sea sunrise and sunset

I read some scary reviews here which made me leave for the airport more than hours before my flight But after a very good journey on the excellent Aeroexpress train I have nothing to report DME is no Changi for sure but it is a completely average airport No big queues and from checkin to lounge it took me minutes max The bulk of it spent with a slow passport officer who did not speak English and was confused by my dual nationality and me living on a third country But the rest of the security measures XRAY of all luggages on entry second check of boarding pass and passport are on pair with other specially Asian airports Granted this is a Sunday afternoon so things could get busier during the week But this is it just an adequate airport Not one of the modern Shopping Centers you find these days but just a regular place to wait for your next flight Maybe the view from the lounge is different but I learned long ago to not leave home without my Priority Pass Contrary to some of the reviews here the airport does offer wifi and it does accept any international number Maybe this is one of the benefits of traveling after the WC

The airport has a quick checkin counter right outside where you arrive with the taxi This led to a checkin time for our Delta flight including one checked in luggage of just minutes after I got out of the taxi Security was fast too never experienced such a comfortable on boarding on any flight

It was the cheapest way to go back after yet another season in Asia and honestly I didnt expect too much But the plane was quite new and the cabin was in a good condition Departed on time unlike the connecting domestic flight by another airline before There was an inflight entertainment system available and it seems to be modern but after a night spent in two different airports I hardly used it for anything other than the D map Although the food was served not as elegantly as some airlines do it was quite delicious and I could choose what I preferred on both meals despite sitting not in the middle of the cabin Note that there are only soft drinks available but for me it doesnt really matter The seats are not exactly Emirateslike but still quite comfortable for an hours flight The headphones were usual cheap earbuds unfortunately but they also included an adapter which I took away and which will let me plug in my own headphones on some later flight great and I just dont understand why airlines besides those smart few who provide multiuse washablecup large headphones couldnt distribute just that on request rather than generating tons of cheap headphones waste The flight was smooth and arrived minutes early Definitely would fly Tianjin Airlines again if the price is right and the route will fit my plans and will stop at Chongqing or Tianjin where I havent been yet as well should I have time for that

It is a privilege to be able to travel via GMP in Seoul Not because the airport is extraordinary but because it is within the city of Seoul and much closer then the island of Incheon GMP can be be reached by metro It is a domestic and an international airport the international connections are through towards Asian destinations GMP has the Advantages and the disadvantages of an old city airport easy to reach more efficient security procedures but old facilities like lounges

I had a great experience flying with Cyprus Airways The flight was smooth and comfortable making the journey enjoyable I was impressed with the ground checkin team who were kind and supportive Thank you for the excellent service

Wonderful airline Both going to and coming back from Whitehorse I really enjoyed flying with them Flights were on time No trouble with checked baggage Staff were super friendly They even provided a complimentary sandwich and warm cookie on a flight that was just over two hours I have a high opinion of this airline and would gladly fly with them again Thank you Air North

I would like to say a huge thank to Yasmin who went to great lengths to find us a new flight the same day but from Bristol airport flight missed just Start of holiday delayed by hours only her professional and helpful support was greatly appreciated Thank you again

On our flight with LAN we had to change flights in Sao Paulo to TAM Airlines retrieve our luggage and check it in again as we were flying a domestic flight to Rio and then to Santiago There wasnt much time between the connections in Sao Paulo and going through immigration and changing terminals made it almost impossible With minutes before departure we didnt have our luggages checked in and there was a big line at the counter The staff on ground made a great job in checking our baggage and then taking us to the plane in a minibus as we were the last ones to board The luggage arrived safe in Santiago and both flights were on time On the way to Rio there was a new A with lots of leg room and for Santiago an old A which gave us a lotof trouble with many turbulences The food served on TAM wasnt different from the one of LAN but the staff were extremely friendly Still the experience in Sao Paulo looked very chaotic to us and we would prefer LAN for further flights

First time to this airport When we arrived it was such a pleasant surprise to see how small it was The time from landing to being on the transfer bus was minutes The cases were already waiting after passport control On the return visit it was much busier as several flights were taking off in a short period However they dealt with the people quickly with no issues at all I wish all airports were like this one

Nice and clean airport As an avgeek I love watching planes and there are so many big windows next to restaurants to watch planes Security wasnt long The checkin staff were really nice On arrival Immigration was really quick and baggage claim was surprisingly quick Very quick and free wifi

Very comfortable business class Aneo and surprisingly spacious Food includes special ingredients creates premium touch Staff are professional smiles attitudes word choices Free wifi coupon easily redeemed day before flight Not many movie choices especially for children but good noise cancelling headphones

Beijing to Pyongyang The Tupolev aircraft is as comfortable as many that are flying around the US The checkin experience was quick at Beijing and Pyongyang The crew were friendly and smiling during the flight The burger was quite tasty and I got a beer with it Baggage quickly delivered at both ends

I prefer using this airport over almost any other in Texas major cities but in true American airport form there are advantages and drawbacks to using San Antonio SAT Here are the pros Access from either I or US is pretty easy considering that interchange is one of the busiest in the city Access to the very busy touristic downtown is relatively easy as the airport isnt far away by rideshare Parking is easy access from the parking garages to the terminal is easy signage leading to and within the airport is pretty easy to follow Delta checkin was quick and friendly Gate agents were professional and helpful Staff in the stores generally seemed friendly The terminal is mostly clean the presecurity checkin area is very spacious and modern Using CLEAR and PreCheck I breezed through security However here are the drawbacks Security TSA had an officious dour attitude that Id expect much more in Houston Miami LAX or NYC not San Antonio Dont know what that was about The restrooms were filthy Seating throughout the terminal was not at all ample for the crowds of people waiting to fly out the airport desperately needs expansion and that includes more seating and general modernization postsecurity Upon return baggage claim was remarkably slow for a small airport albeit a small airport serving a large metropolitan area So pound for pound SAT is an overall good option and Id still rather use them than anything in Houston or Austin but there is still room for improvement

Clean airport Fairly good coffee and muffin place inside The cafe takes Som or US Power for charging stuff in the cafe Duty free a bit sad separate security screenings but all fast enough minutes from kerbside to airline gate better than many civilised airports Bags checked there arrived ok at destination on time after flights Take off minutes late without explanation The indicator board was never altered The information desk had no better advice Maybe the airport could insist airlines provide up to date information The waiting masses were getting restless One announcement was made in a language that may have been Korean but none of the Korean passengers could understand it It was not English or Uzbek

We were initially a bit disappointed when Etihad did not use its own aircraft on the route between Abu Dhabi and Jakarta but used wetleased Wamos equipment However the entire experience was good Clean and spacious plane with pleasant configuration so ideal if you are traveling with people The staff was professional and friendly They carried out very thorough safety checks before departure and landing The only real downside was the entertainment Little choice and that should really be different no flash path information Furthermore only praise for Wamos A Basic experience on time and comfortable

Flew in and out and had no problems despite the fact the airport is partly under reconstruction On arrival our plane parked close to the terminal and bags soon arrived on the single very small belt Car Hire has moved across the road and is a short walk away Plenty of buses and taxis were there to meet passengers Departure checkin was quick the lounge has enough seats for flights and there are adequate cafes and shops to keep most people content This is a small rural airport which works well and gives a flying experience like it used to be in the old days

Flew KigaliDoha and onwards with Royal Air Maroc afternoon th January on a B On time Ticket issued by Qatar Airways which caused limitations on seating food and miles crediting as Rwandair cannot exhibit flexibility cum overrule the QR booking in any way Eg I could not preorder meal due to differing booking systems typically a codeshare issue Checked in hours early to enjoy Dream lounge in Kigali Checkin smooth luggage checked in to final destination though BPs could not be issued beyond Doha Eventually I got my favourite exit seat Could choose among the two lounges in Kigali Dream and Pearl Both are well stocked only hot snacks are not offered any more Dream has an upper hand with city view Onboard FAs are good polite well rested and groomed Service impeccable Only meal service on this hours flight No WiFi nor personal IFE only childish movies shown on shared monitors Seats well bolstered spacious Fine boutique airline with only aircrafts which are few in case of irregularities Good trip recommended

I recently flew round trip from San Francisco to Clark international with a layover at Taoyuan International both ways Because of my own financial resources I flew economy class on all legs of the journey I did pay for an aisle seat on the two transPacific flights I flew to the Philippines in order to speak at a conference and needed to find the most economical way to get there I was pleasantly surprised to find that EVA Air offered a roundtrip option for about half the price After checking some reviews on YouTube I booked my trip using the EVA Air website The process was easy and took very little time To say that I was pleased with the experience would be an understatement I am tall and not a small person I found the seats to be comfortable with plenty of leg room The customer service was excellent and the flight attendants were friendly and professional I received two meals on both of my longer flights and surprisingly one meal on each of the shorter hour flights All the meals were well prepared and quite tasty The inflight entertainment was a bit limited but adequate Overall I would recommend using EVA anywhere they fly
I can understand why Incheon airport is one of the best in the world The airport is very clean and peaceful There were various seating options and different shops I definitely recommend it

The new airport in Miri is a blessing to all of us frequent travellers Although it is small it is efficient clean and cool If anything needs to be imroved on is the charges we have to pay for a small cup of coffee or a meal The charges are much too high for a domestic airport

A small airport serving the capital Its a bit of a chaotic place long queues staff arent the friendliest and generally messy The terminal itself is clean tho and seating is comfortable As its the only major airport in the country this it what they can offer Taxi trip to the center is lek

Singapore to Yangon I didnt know what to expect when I booked this flight but I dont regret The airplane was clean staff was friendly and food was good Also a lot of space for the legs good entertainment and opportunity to charge phonetablet In the EmiratesGaruda league in my opinion

The airport was shining new and clean with clear signs and directions both in Vietnamese and English The international departure was smooth though queuing time for immigration and security screening was a bit long due to the jam in the morning Not many dutyfree shopping compared to some other international airports in SEA Dining was expensive seemed the restaurant was trying to make money from tourists Boarding gate was good with a lot of seats Toilet was clean

Des Moines KDSM is an all round great airport It is a very easy airport to navigate in and it doesnt take long to get through security at all It always seems to be clean and free wifi is always a plus While there seems to be a lack of shopping and food choices there are a few that all seem to be good places of business Terminal seating is in the process of being expanded as it doesnt hold the demand all of the time Its a great airport to depart and arrive to It isnt very big but will get you where you need to go
Very good array of shops ahead of security Very modern very clean Far nicer than the other airports that Ive encountered in Brazil
Rating Cabin Flown Economy Value for Money Seat Comfort Staff Service Catering Entertainment Recommended

An unexpectedly pleasant experience The booking process was a bit odd but after using several different credit cards one finally worked on the airline website for a ticket about euros less than any other airline Check in and boarding was smooth Two suitcases allowed at kg each Or one at a maximum of kg There was entertainment with several English language recent films Ample food provided The layover was fine No one was saying anything about not taking photos and it wasnt any more different than transferring in China Seemed the duty free shops take card now too

The meals were very good and the portions generous The crew were efficient and were on time both ways Seating assignments seemed ambiguous but my family of four ended up with one window seat on return to Vancouver from Amsterdam which was a nice surprise None of my children had any complaint throughout the two long journeys and that would be the measure of a pleasant flight experience by my standards I would fly with Martinair again in future

Verona to Mahon Flight at full hour aircraft slightly dated but maintained better than others very comfortable seats In mid flight we were served a very good snack nice and elegant and above all professional hostesses volo in pieno orarioaereo leggermente datato ma tenuto meglio di altri sedili molto comodi a met volo ci stato servito lo spuntino molto buono hostess carine e eleganti e soprattutto professionali

A fantastic little airport Arrived from GLA plane pulled up outside the terminal building One Luggage Belt very quick reclaim The terminal is one open plan shed type building with Checkin Desks for the main flights to the rest of the UK and Europe The Departure Lounge opens about minutes before the flight is due to depart usually once the inbound flight has arrived Once through Security large waiting area with seats and a toilet look out onto the apron There are Doors to allow for flights to be dealt with In the main part of the terminal there is a Tourist Information Desk with local information a Cafe offering a range of hot drinks and snackssandwiches and a small shop with a few basics and small souvenirs There is also quite a large seating area connected to the eating section There is also a nd lounge area by the Inter Island part of the terminal this deals with the flights out to the islands that form Orkney handled by Loganair Here Checkin and Baggage Reclaim are handled and DeparturesArrivals are handled completely separately from the other flights Maximum aircraft size is passengers so it is all very cosy and informal but very efficient Flew out to PPW for worlds shortest scheduled flight and back later in the day and could not fault the whole experience

Dhaka to Coxs Baza Booked a discounted ticket more than a month ago Didnt expect too much Just on time departure arrival Thats what I got Boarding luggage handling was smooth Cabin crew wasnt exactly cordial but professional enough It was a min ride but the captain was able to make it bumpy despite clear weather Cheese sandwich cake was good enough for a shorts haul flight like this but as expected no IFE Aircraft was manufactured in so common for local Bangladeshi carriers But the seats were good pitch even for a Dutch national who flew alongside me was well over Hope for a similar experience with Regent next time

Just recently MacArthur Airport here in the middle of Long Island recieved a makeover The makeover included a big new concourse added terminals and new concessions Its beautiful It is a big relief to see the airport go from old and small to new and bigger The new concourse was built and is now primarily owned by Southwest Airlines The layout of the airport is very simple and easy to navigate As soon as you walk in the main entrance you can either make a right to get to the checkin counters or make a left to get to the carousels and pickup a friend that just arrived Security is fairly fast There are a number of concession stands as well as souvenir shops located before after the security checkpoint The following airlines service MacArthur Airport some of the airlines may use a codeshare partner for some flights Southwest Airlines Delta Connection Continental Express US Airways express Brand new concourse terminals concessions

Nice little airport which I use regularly Queues for passport control can be horrendous as has been said but staff are mostly friendly and facilities are good Plenty of places to eat and drink and you can use dinars in these though not in the Duty Free

We have flown twice into Bermuda and each time were inout in under minutes For an island of just residents I am mightily impressed We really appreciated the smiling and welcoming airport staff along with the friendly curbside taxi operators The new terminal is quite impressive and the signage reflects what is commonly used in other international airports The duty free shops sadly offer no bargain prices In fact alcohol products are cheaper in Hamilton Yes the food offerings in the terminal are quite limited but they do attempt to reflect local culinary tastes While local favorites are mostly featured the prices are high but generally commensurate with elsewhere on the island In fact prices are definitely comparable to any of the NY area airports FACT CHECK Bermuda is an island that largely relies on marine shipments of imported food and supplies including oil and gas Closing Thought I have circled the globe and on reflection choose L F Wade airport as my preferred southern transit stop

Last time I was in Xian Xianyang airport was in I have visited many times before There was always a Scrum outside the airport building for tickets and to board the airport buses for downtown Returned this year a lot has changed with the airport and getting tickets for the buses You now go to a ticket booth inside the building Then a waiting room for your respective bus What an improvement

The airport and their airlines offer a wide range of European and North African leisure destinations but also large German cities such as Frankfurt or Munich Nice little shops and restauantscafes Staff are very friendly and the waiting times as well as the walking times are unbeatable Love flying fromto the Airport

Dusseldorf to London City Very nice flight including free Snacks and drinks Legroom was okay and staff was friendly but seemed a little stressed due to a huge amount of hand luggage in this flight Inflight magazines were old

On the plane the staff hardly gave us any water and the water tasted like the plastic cup it was in I am not surprised if anyone got dehydrated The legroom was good and the seat was okay Overall it was okay I wouldnt recommend it

The mid morning flight took off on time from CCU and as I had to go to Bangalore for work my company had booked this flight for me Web checkin and baggage drop were smoothly done Boarding also started on time Landing and disembarkation also happened swiftly along with baggage retrieval which was good IndiGo may not be a glamorous carrier but it gets the job done of taking you from point A to point B efficiently

Dhaka to Jessore I find the name of this private airline in Bangladesh a bit funny Other than that no complaints Arrived at the domestic terminal in Dhaka minutes before the scheduled morning departure due to being severely delayed due to road traffic The checkin desk completed all formalities rushed us through security had a limo ready for us to escort me and my partner to the aircraft at the remote stand The flight left after our boarding and exactly on time I have never experienced this kind of dedication and professionalism with an airline The flight to Jessore lasted minutes onboard a clean and attractive Dash Q and we were served a sandwich cake and a water bottle by friendly and smiley flight attendants The return flight to Dhaka a couple of days later was just as good but we made sure we arrived promptly for checkin this time We were served a mini burger cake and water bottle

Return journey Clean modern aircraft comfortable seat tasty food and drying and great cabin crew On the way back ground staff checked our bags through to EDI on BA even though we did not have the journey on a single ticket Impressive and enjoyable journey and I would happily use them again

I had an early morning flight from Terminal to CKG Arrived early due to the scheduled shuttle from my hotel The security arrangements here are very tight but not overbearing CheckIn was simple enough while I virtually had to empty my carry on of all electronic items for separate scanning Once through I headed to the Hainan Airlines lounge but it only opened at am so I waited for minutes Then I had a wait until am until breakfast was served but it was plentiful and delicious My aircraft was at a distant stand so I had to board a bus but the boarding process was smooth and simple

I arrived at the airport from London Heathrow and travelled via Beijing On arrival at Terminal it was nearing pm and I had been travelling for over hours I wanted to get a taxi to the hotel and go to bed However none of the ATMs in the terminal accepted any of my debit cards I have had trouble in the past in rural areas but never at an international airport I was told to go to terminal one which had international arrivals and try there Fortunately the shuttle bus was free and I go to terminal Only one of the ATMs there which also happened to be the last one I tried accepted my card with one other machine down At other Chinese airports Beijing and XiAn Xingang they have always had ATMs from the big four banks Industrial and Commercial Bank of China Bank of China China Construction Bank Agricultural Bank of China I have never had a problem getting cash from these banks I would also note that the underground station just outside terminal one has multiple big four ATMs and is an excellent way to travel into the city I finally got to my hotel at midnight I wrote to the Airport while in China but never received a response
Hatay HTY I flew into Hatay last year for my daughters wedding celebration airport was small but adequate and staff were helpful

Awful from front desk to boarding airport is like a sauna staff are rude and dont want to be here but then there is only a handful of staff No information for English lucky I speak Italian it makes you appreciate Gatwick and Heathrow

Contrary to all of the recent negative press about airports and their staff our experience flying and coming back in was seamless Given the pressure that all airport staff are under they are doing an amazing job and are doing it with a smile We travelled down to Newcastle from Scotland and stayed in the Premier Inn the night before I would have no hesitation in using this airport again Well done to all of the staff

The airport is a small regional airport However there is a nice souvenir shop and a decent number of places to eat given its modest size One thing you will see in the airport is life size cardboard cut outs of the famous Boise State American Football team the towns most famous export There is a bus link from the airport to downtown but when I went it appeared to be having serious delays A cab into downtown is not too expensive The queuing times are very quick as this airport never really gets too busy as it is small

Mandalay airport is not very big so is very easy and fast to go around The ground staff are very friendly like all the burmese people The airport was clean lots of light and good airconditioning There is a smoking area inside There are also some souvenir shops and a few places to eat To get the stamp at customs it took a lot of time as there werent many desks open and many flights at the same time so many people started to stress a little

Was surprised how good it was Very nice and smiling crew bed quite comfortable good choice of drinks Did not really like the gluten free option as I got the same meal twice Ground service was a disaster

Pyongyang to Vladivostok Clean classic aircraft with amazing engine sound Seats were a bit narrow but okay for a flight of around one hour and ten minutes Cabin staff was friendly sandwich and lemonades water were provided free Excellent experience

The queue for the border was moving quite fast the border guards were working fast The toilets in the baggage reclaim area was clean although there was a queue to them one of the two urinals wasnt working The toilet would be better if they were bigger albeit they were quite clean

Paris Orly to Newark Longtime customer of OpenSkies when it was business class only and the original Lavion Chose La Compagnie and glad we did Our flight was canceled at Orly back to Newark and it was a mess the gate agents at Orly did not speak English well and there was lack of information given we had to rebook days later on another flight home on our own with the airline no one at the gate could assist us with that and they only have planes and dont partner with other airlines days stuck in Paris with hotel hopping so why the stars The compensation when we got home to the states and quick communication and customer service was great They offered to pay for our meals hotels and cabs for the days stuck in Paris The flights were so comfortable great entertainment on the flights and great food I was able to sleep comfortably with a pillow and the plane seemed very clean The flight crew was lovely both ways and couldnt have been nicer For the price this was a fantastic value for business class and was much better than United First Class to Paris I hope they stay in business

Rotterdam airport is small but very easy to get to as I live only min away People are very friendly and helpful I travel on average x per year sometimes more normally I only have hand luggage and have only once encountered extra checks and body search I find check in and arrivals no problem and never had to wait very long I do think it could use a few more shops and especially as I fly early morning it would be nice to have some kind of breakfast that is not too expensive
Not Verified Courteous and friendly staff Flight left early by about minutes when it was confirmed all planning to fly were on board Crew was great Seating was great

Las Palmas to Tenerife Not a great experience The plane had SwiftAir livery even though it was CanaryFly flight The plane was old and produced terrible noise during takeoff I have flown the ATR not once but it was only such experience The airline had a free seating policy It was OK as there were only people in the plane capable of The crew provided only water

The current airport is small but efficient A new much larger terminal is being build Border and security control was fast and efficient All gates are currently in one large terminal with bus boarding only Staff was acting friendly and speedy Bus brings you to to city in for only Lei

For a small beachside city developed as a getaway destination for North Americans this little modern airport did not disappoint me Getting through security was a breeze very friendly TSA and compared to other airports Ive been to navigating is easy enough If you are someone who goes to the airport not just to fly but to shop mountains of stuff this airport might not be for you granted it has somewhere between and gates total and there is no gargantuan walkway of dutyfree shops to be found The terminal is very modern and clean For some reason despite being first in line for takeoff it did take us about min to get off of the ground Lots of general aviation so this might be a regular thing Bottom line would I fly here Absolutely This airport is all about convenience and efficiency

The airport is much better now since the renovation is complete Plenty of parking when you arrive There are a range of shops Patchi chocolate Bookstore Coffee bean tea leaf bodyshop in the predeparture area and a restaurant There are ATM machines a baggage sealing service and currency exchange stand but they never have Singapore dollars Check in was a breeze done in several minutes Passport control is quick Once you enter the departure lounge to the right is a food court that sells food to order manly Asian dishes There is a convenience store some stores that sell traditional Bruneian foods and watch perfume stores I was told more stores will be added soon The waiting area has good lighting there are priority seats near the gate for those with young children and elderly people The toilets were clean There is a prayer room for Muslim travellers On arrival there is a short walk to customs and immigration Separate counters for local ASEAN Diplomatic and foreigners There are plenty of trolleys at the baggage carousel There is a green and red channel there are several officers always on duty I left a hand luggage on the plane luckily I was able to retrieve it There is a door at the side of KFC which leads back to the arrivals hall The bag was aleady in the office for me to collect In the arrivals hall there is a KFC and Burger King also Counters for DST and Progressif which are the mobile phone carriers You can purchase tourist sim cards which have minutes and data pre loaded There is a counter for tourist information and Hertz Avis car rental Upon exiting the terminal there is a taxi service taxis are metered You can also use the ride hailing app Dart There is a local bus service but its not available for the late flights If you have a long layover and and your passport lets you exit the airport the Airport mall is a minute drive or minute walk away but but be careful as there are no footpaths
Checkin for the flight was on time the reception by the staff was excellent confidential space The control is efficient and fast the boarding lounge comfortable

This airport has a extremely large number of visitors Ground transport and flow to and from are fine Concessions facilities and restaurants are far and few between sit down bar restaurant for many gates waiting lines everywhere all facilities both male and female have long lines Very far behind the times would rather fly to any other airport in they area

Bradley is my home airport I fly from and to here multiple times a year to visit friends and family While it isnt as big as the New York airports or Boston fares are usually among the cheapest in southern New England and southeastern New York and BDL provides service to all major eastern hubs such as Atlanta Detroit Cincinnati Charlotte Minneapolis ChicagoORD Washington Philly and Baltimore as well as numerous Florida destinations Las Vegas Denver Toronto Montreal Cleveland Raleigh San Juan Cancun and starting later this year LA and Dublin Ireland Concessions are ample and security is usually manageable in under thirty except some mornings I nearly always fly Delta and their service out of BDL has been fantastic Flights to Salt Lake City Seattle San Francisco and Nashville would be ideal additions

I have no complaints whatsoever about the new airport in Wichita Lobby is wide and bright with helpful staff at the information desk There is a wonderful exhibition on the aviation history of Wichita on the second floor Go to the airport early so that you can read all the displays Not a wide assortment of food choices but good enough Car rental area is well organized and staff is welltrained A most pleasant experience there The signage for getting to the city center and on the highways could be better but I think that is the responsibility of the city not the airport A very pleasant airport to use

New York JFK to Naples with Meridiana I was very apprehensive about flying Meridiana after reading some reviews but Im glad to say everything from the use of the Air France lounge at JFK to the courtesy and service onboard was as good as any airline I have ever flown And it was equally true on our return flight from Naples to JFK The only area that found on my flights that need help is in the condition of the cabin and seats The business class seats are well worn and ready for replacement as well as the carpets etc Our flights were generally on time and the ground people were organized and efficient The gods of aviation smiled on us

I had a wonderful experience flying with Vistara Airlines recently and I cant praise their staff enough especially Ankush and Manisha From the moment I arrived at the airport they made the entire checkin process incredibly smooth and stressfree Ankush was welcoming and guided me through each step with such professionalism making sure I had all the information I needed His calm and friendly demeanor made a normally hectic process feel easy and seamless Manisha was equally attentive helping me with my questions and ensuring I felt comfortable with every detail of my journey Their teamwork and dedication truly reflect Vistaras commitment to exceptional service Not only did they make the checkin experience smooth but they also set a positive tone for the rest of my trip The flight was equally enjoyable with clean cabins comfortable seating and excellent inflight service Thank you Vistara and a special shoutout to Ankush and Manisha for going above and beyond to make my journey a pleasant one I highly recommend Vistara Airlines for their superb staff and topnotch service

Flight BA Durban to Cape Town was a disaster plane had technical issues and we were not able to use that plane I was informed visa a phone call from BA while on the way to the airport that there would be no Business Class on the new chartered flight Im not a snob but it was a surprise gift for my year old mother Long story short we flew on Global Air a chartered plane from JNB It was late and cramped but comfortable enough and staff very attentive We were offered ZAR flight voucher as compensation for no Business class The difference between the two classes was ZAR each per ticket Upon return I emailed Comair and was very expertly helped by David who did some bartering regarding refunds At the end of the day I was given a ZAR KululaComair voucher to be used for year as compensation Well done on customer service and well handled by all involved

Tashkent Airport can be difficult to navigate Regulations are strictly enforced especially at departure Upon arrival I noticed that the people do not observe lines and not speaking Uzbek or Russian can be a disadvantage Make sure that you fill out and keep all official forms you receive There is one for each hotel you stay in and there are matching customs forms for arrival and departure you need to list valuables and cash and produce both forms when leaving the country Departure gate is a floor below the departure area There is now an escalator and carts are available for taking bags from the entrance gate to the escalator but only passengers may enter the departure gate Good luck if you have more than one or two bags There are no porters or at least not when I was there I had forgotten about the customs forms after I had to repeatedly insist to the airline representative that I was allowed to check in more than one bag and the customs official said I could not take my money out of the country without submitting both forms You will have to remove your shoes and socks and put on blue plastic booties before going through security The airport personnel were courteous and even friendly but it was clear that no exceptions would be made

Upon arrival in Chiang Mai we had to take the bus to the terminal which thankfully was a quick trip Customs was fast and the baggage claim was easy Even as a small airport there were friendly and helpful employees It was easy to get around especially finding taxis I would prefer Chiang Mai over Bangkok airport and I will continue to go to this airport

Free food and snacks provided Great wifi Nice comfortable chairs like a business lounge I was able to walk to my accommodation which Ive never done before Very easy access to Toronto with a short free ferry ride and then streetcar available on Bathurst St Very nice small airport

Kuala Namu International Airport is it is the second largest airport after SoekarnoHatta International Airport but the first airport which has a direct rail link to Medan city the capital of North Sumatra Kuala Namu is the most comfortable and the most modern airport in Indonesia
Very decent airline Crew very friendly although their English command could be better The cheese sandwich is fantastic

Prague to Copenhagen Flight was operated by Czech Airlines A reg OKMEL not with lowcost Smartwings like almost all other CSA flights Departure was delayed only about minutes we arrived on time Staff was nice and friendly Ordered food was so expensive CZK but delicious Aircraft was clean and seats were comfortable

Upon arrival at MRV discovered a new arrivals hall since my last visit in October last year Baggage very quick into hall Outside a pleasant array of kiosks should you need anything food wise Departures hall is spotless and some nice Caucasian shops to spend your Rubles in Security quick and easy and departure lounge has a nice cafe and a few more shops A pleasant experience before the hassle of Domodedevo

I had flights with this airline and found them to be very reliable st Maarten to Statia and St Maarten to Saba and back planes are very small but perfect for these minutes hop ground crew were friendly and even tagged my bags to Antigua on a codeshare with LIAT I was surprised they all arrived without major problems they are quick and professional sometimes slow sometimes not The prices are very high though The only worriesome moment I had with them was when one of the pilots shouted agressivily at the other just before engine started
In this scorching heat ACs dont work Travelers are sweating Even lounges dont have working AC Very uncomfortable atmosphere with direct sun rays

Gatwick to Venice We were hesitant about this airline having read reviews but booked it for the low price I have to say the flight exceeded our expectations Checkin and boarding were both an extremely smooth process I think we were at the bag drop desk for a total of minutes and boarding was much quicker than with other lowfrills airlines We paid in advance for extra legroom seats my partner is so this is an essential for us and were surprised by the amount of space and comfort We sat at the front of the plane with plenty of room to stretch out unlike Ryanair and EasyJet whose exit row seats only have an extra inch or so Flight took off and landed on time and was far more comfortable than wed anticipated There are definitely some areas to be improved upon in terms of the preflight process I have not come across any other airline in the past few years that makes you print out your own boarding pass rather than making it available electronically Its also pretty irritating to be told you cant check in online unless you pay for it this could potentially lead to long queues at the airport on the day These points lower my overall score for the airline but the flight experience itself was very pleasant

Everything went smoothly on this short flight to Paro We flew a new plane with lovely grey leather seats seat pockets with metal springs it all just smelt new that was a bonus Crew friendly and accommodating So from Katmandu to Paro you need to have window seat on the left of the plane It was my most scenic commercial flight ever stunning views of the Himalayas and Mount Everest for over half the flight sit on the left ABC seats and then the remarkable descent into Paro airport landing at the prettiest airport I ever been to and I have travelled a fair bit Unless the flight in darkness your baggage lost or severe delay non of which happened for me I cannot see how this short flight could fail to impress A cheese roll and drink included Get to Bhutan on this flight

The new terminal is very spacious and it was apparent they were putting in additional shops and services but was under construction when we departed Very clean and modern One thing I miss about the old terminal is that it was right on the end of the electric tram line So you could walk out of the airport to a tram and pay about dollars for a ride into the city You can still get to the tram but its an awkward walk You have to walk about minutes to reach it Also the kantorcurrency exchange was outside of security so after we had gone through passport control I couldnt exchange money So hopefully theyll fix that There was free internet near a cafe but couldnt easily find power So most people had to run off of battery There was a nice hotel we had used in the past affordable and clean but it was closed for renovation Hope they dont raise the prices upon reopening They really jazzed up the airport and city for the world cup
The staff are friendly and the seat is comfortable The air ticket is cheap Although theres no TV and wifi I can bring my pad and watch films Very good

Two LAN Colombia return flights inside Colombia from Bogot to Cartagena and then Bogot to Pereira One was shortly delayed because of the bad weather conditions in Pereira heavy rainfall and another one because a passenger decided in the last minute not to fly In both cases the cockpit keeped us informed and apologized for both delays Being a domestic flight there were only complementary drinks served and because the flight to Pereira was very short like minutes not everybody got something but a good manage from the crew Checkin using their App is piece of cake There was entertainment using their new App via WiFi on one of their flights and it did work without problems Overall a very good experience

This is an efficient and wellequipped airport For travellers on AA beware that ground staff and security dont seem to communicate The security channel for US departures remained closed until beyond the scheduled time of departure with no explanation given The departure boards didnt show that there was a minute delay and instead left all boarding passengers to wait outside the secure area This seems to be a specific AA problem
This is a well designed airport There is no hassle from porters and taxi operators Checking in is very fast and efficient Arrival luggage handling is very good

The seats were excellent with a feel of much more room than the official seat pitch I am ft in We could sleep for a couple of hours daytime flight with the blinds down as they should be no point booking a window seat in my view I focus on seat quality much more than smiley faces and food the food was middling and the second meal before landing was distinctly subpar
Thai smile offers convenient service through their app and self service at Suvarnabhumi Airport with staff support The time of flight is in time Staff gave service with hospitality

ADDAMM via Sanaa Overnight in Sanaa where Yemenia provide hotel and breakfast Pleasant flight attendants and acceptable food A good flight and a lot cheaper than competitors I had to change this flight and put it forward by one week which was no problem and didnt cost anything to change

Minsk to Gatwick A very pleasant flight Boarding was quick the aircraft was clean and the seating was Leg room was adequate The flight took off on time and landed on time Meal service consisted of a standard hot meal with soft drinks and tea or coffee No alcohol was offered This was a short hrs flight and so the meal was very good There was no inflight entertainment

This is a very large and well maintained airport located in Virginia Given the size of this airport with its main terminal and then midfield terminals give yourself plenty of time to get to your gates especially the midfield terminals On arrival I had to take the mobile lounges to the main terminal The mobile lounges have frequent service from midfield terminal to main terminal No more than a min wait Restrooms in baggage claim are were very clean Departure was from Terminal C which necessitated using the labyrinth of escalators to get to the AeroTrains which run underground When I lived in Centreville VA Dulles was my airport of choice over Reagan National
It was perfect I love everything about thr airport It was quick and has good staff Good food and its modern Just love it but I dont like the national airlines like TAME

I visited Oman first time in and used this airport It was then very a small and unorganized airport Now the airport has become huge with many other facilities There is a museum with Omani architectures There are many handicrafts shops with very high prices of commodities There are KFC and McDonalds that offer food at an affordable price There are Muslim prayer room and toilets as well

Not a bad airport Flew out of Terminal A with American Airlines I thought Terminal B was nicer than Terminal A Plenty of places to eat and view the runway My only complaint was the longish wait at security Other than that San Jose is a very functional airport

While it is beyond the reach of New York City taxis ISP is five minutes away from Ronkonkoma railroad station in turn a hm train ride to Penn Station This may seem very inconvenient for Newyorkers used to La Guardia airoport but it isnt so bad if compared with JFK The airport is small and efficient There are little or no delays on the ground This field is used primarily by Southwest as its gateway to New York Southwest partner ATA is another visitor while some legacy carriers only offer regional service to their respective hubs or focus cities For those passengers who dont like turboprops be advised that Piedmont Airlines operates from this field with DHCs for Us Airways express while Colgate uses tiny Beechcrafts on flights for Usair express and Continental I find those tiny planes charming but many passengers complain Overall a very pleasant passenger oriented airport

Competent and efficient flights Delay in Geneva handled well captain came to boarding gate to explain Comfort seats had good leg room even on a A sandwich and drink served on each flight of just over an hour

I dont know what all the fuss was about Bad reviews about security dirty airport unfriendly staff no seating I experienced none of that In view of the negative reviews we arrived hours before take off and were through security in five minutes Very cheerful efficient and friendly staff Bought some items at duty free and the lady there was extremely pleasant and helpful Plenty of seating Good food and drink offers and both the airport and toilets were very clean Boarding process straightforward and stressless On return our plane landed about minutes behind schedule This unfortunately coincided with other flights landing at the same time so passport control was very busy but it only took about minutes to get through The staff there were smiling at I understand why passengers complain but its also useful to get positive reviews sometimes I hope my next experience of Leeds Bradford will be as good as this one

Small airport with basic but sufficient facilities Upon arrival airport staff welcomed passengers and provided a small bag of local snacks which was a nice touch Outbound processing was fine with courteous and friendly staff in security Checkin queue took a bit longer than normal for a regional ATR flight Room for improvement on this but ground staff very friendly and helpful

We visited Changi airport both on outbound and return journeys to USA and Europe The airport is outstanding and easy to see why ranked as st or nd best in airport rankings Very large but very well laid out and excellent presentation with multiple facilities and services throughout Convenient skytrain services and travel walkways to gates and between terminals Myriad of high end stores and food outlets etc Well posted advisory signage and notification boards We deliberately scheduled in x hr stops at Changi between flights on the outbound and return trips and took advantage of the airside hotel which can be booked in hr lots The Aerotel is on the air side of the airport so no need to pass through customs They also provide a meal with the booking not inexpensive but worth looking at Rooms are spacious and very quiet Service is professional and friendly

Having lived in the area all of my life Ive flown out of Syracuse Hancock for years It is a smallish regional airport with a few places to eat The bathroom facilities are abundant and clean while gate areas are somewhat outdated and a little shopworn The airport is divided into two main departurearrival wings previously each had its own TSA screening area Recent renovations resulted in consolidation to a single TSA screening area with capacity to manage both gate wings Because I was not aware of the renovations I took my usual path to my assigned gate only to find that I had to backtrack to the TSA area and then back out to the gate Perhaps further renovations andor improvements in signage could result in more a more direct and efficient pathway to TSA Once through the mostly efficient TSA process the walk to the gate was fairly quick and straightforward TSA lines can be long but not like LAX DCA etc during peak periods so be prepared Parking is adjacent to the terminal with very reasonable rates Ive left my car there for a few days at a time without concern While sometimes flights are less expensive out of nearby cities Rochester Buffalo Albany for example I choose to fly out of Syracuse because it is so accessible Lastly the Syracuse illuminated sign on the gate area has welcomed passengers for decades with its comforting deco appearance

Modern and clean airport The transit is really strange like you have to get into China and leave China again Came from Beijing to Singapore via Shenzhen Convenient airport lot of shops reasonable price airports many eateries Western Chinese Easy to find your way to the gate Ground staff do not smile

Rex Airlines is a standout in terms of professionalism and helpfulness Their call centres are here in Australia staffed by knowledgeable and problem solving women sorry men I have just dealt with amazing women Rex is our airline of choice when it flies where we need to go It is hands down better than the other airlines based in Australia and is a reminder that an airline can work well and treat customers with personal and professional service

I took the flight K from Mandalay to Heho to get to Inle Lake as it is the quickest way to get there This was my first time flying with Air KBZ and it was a pleasant flight Checkin and boarding was very efficient The flight left Mandalay about minutes before the scheduled time and arrived about minutes earlier The cabin was very clean and seats were comfortable Cabin crew were friendly I will not hesitate to fly again with Air KBZ

A little and modest airport in the capital of Saxony Apparently the politicians and the government members of the state of Saxony gave it the right to exist to be able to travel by plane directly to and from Dresden and avoiding using the bigger and better airport in Leipzig one hundert of miles away I wonder if this airport is profitable at all Any how it is very clean and clear and it is the best way to get to Dresden from outside east part of Germany Airport staff seems to be much more bored then engaged

I recently traveled through Johannesburg International Airport and was thoroughly impressed by the exceptional service and overall experience The airport staff were incredibly helpful and friendly making the whole journey smooth and stressfree The facilities were clean wellmaintained and easy to navigate enhancing the overall travel experience From efficient checkin processes to a wide range of dining and shopping options Johannesburg International Airport truly excels in providing a topnotch travel experience I highly recommend this airport for its great service and overall pleasant atmosphere

Departing from Terminal for a domestic flight The airport was well connected with the public bus and train The terminal in general was clean modern and efficient Check in was fast and completely automatic via machines with ground staff was ready to help Surprising no long queue at the security and everything was smooth There were numerous comfy seats available for passengers Shopping and dining were also really good and at reasonable price

Booking Mostly smooth except could not select seats and when selected the selection would not be saved Checkin Got reminder and was easy to conduct online checkin except no boarding pass as the document verification is not online Boarding Chaotic as boarding was not by zones but first come first serve So lot of traffic jams in the isles and many people sitting in seats they were not assigned to Broken seats with stained covers and strange smells Handrests chipped seatbacks cracked Enough legroom Inflight entertainment Many screens and controls not working broken Wireless entertainment worked smoothly but no clear directions on how to access it Inflight meals Very basic many drink choices eg gin and tonic not available Deplaning Long wait before people could get off not sure if it was the ground staff or the plane Baggage checkin and collection Smooth Got ontime notifications about baggage being loaded on different planes along the route Collection was also easy

Had a chance to fly Canadian North for the first time from Calgary to Inuvik in the Northwest Territories Check in friendly with no extra charge for my bags The aircraft was a Boeing which replaced the Fokker Flight Attendants were friendly attentive We were served a hot breakfast Return flight equally as pleasant with a hot dinner this time and free wine The service reminded me of the Wardair days I only wish that they flew across lower Canada as well

Used Entebbe airport yesterday to fly to DaresSalaam and was pleasantly surprised Terminal is very small but clean staff are friendly and welcoming and the facilities are fine to while away a couple of hours One of the best airports Ive used in the East Africa region and wish all border control staff could be as pleasant

After reading several negative reviews on this page regarding LPA Gran Canaria airport I wish to make a defence I find the airport similar to many of the Spanish airports operated by Aena in that it handles the volume of passengers proportionately and professionally Bear in mind the vast majority of passengers passing through the airport are there for leisure purposes this has always been a difficult balancing act to please the foot traffic Knowledge and preplanning are the key to success Informative information can be found online about the airport for example httpsgrancanariaairportcom is just one example Especially in this day and age with covid and the uncertainly about travel with changing restrictions it is paramount that planning ahead to provide a heads up of potential problems and issues is a must

After a week away we returned to Atlanta and couldnt find our vehicle Somehow the parking space location was deleted in my phone Nokuthuba Bray found us wandering around trying to find it It took about an hour but she went above and beyond to find it We are grateful for her great effort

If you dont need to go to Denver I recommend COS as the best option for going to Colorado Small but not too small clean efficient quick and centrally located to most points in Colorado Good quick car rentals I use it routinely to go to Pueblo and Denver Yes Denver as it can be more convenient and faster to get to a lot of places especially in south Denver Remember Denver airport is miles east and an expensive toll road from many points in Denver Also traffic is very congested in Denver but only moderately so in Colorado Springs Only problem I have is that most often but not always the cheaper fares are into and out of Denver
