I went to Jamaica for a week on vacation and I have no complaints regarding Caribbean airlines Not the best airline on the planet but theyre definitely by far not the worst they are reasonable and if youre willing to spend a bit more than business class definitely is substantially more comfortable The only drawback that I can think of but that isnt their fault is the fact that on the return trip I had to make four stops in four different countries

Its been decades since I last traveled through Nashville The transformation of this airport is amazing The international arrivals facility has Global Entry but no Mobile Passport Control Give yourself plenty of time at least hours to make connecting flights The lines care very long and the distances from the gates to Immigration and Customs are very long The terminal was very crowded however with wheelchair assist we were able to breeze through Immigration The only drawback is that one has to exit the secured area and go through TSA security all over again with very long lines Once youre through the security one is met with wide open very clean and brightly lit concourses with dining and shopping aplenty Restrooms were very clean The free airport WiFi was easy to connect to and very fast

We booked a day trip to Luxor from Sharm and flew Air Memphis Aircraft was an old MD which was tired looking inside and out but clean Friendly cabin crew juice and a snack were served Dont let appearances put you off

New and pleasant airport terminal Quite spacious Free WiFi Security was reasonably efficient and courteous Limited food and beverage service Quick baggage retrieval Extremely clean toilets Very close to city hotels and restaurants I would highly recommend Alexandria International AEX when traveling to Central or Northern Louisiana

Minsk to Zaporizhzhia with Motor sich airlinesThe itinerary showed Antonov as operating the flight but in reality the flight was operated by Antonov a year old Soviet Aircraft However Motor Sich airline did not pre advise of aircraft change h flight Big mistake in choosing seats in the first rows they are right by the engines and the noise is deafening Leg room is very tight unlike seats in rows have better keg room for some reason Window shades are cotton curtains a real weird bird a great privilege to fly such an old bird A nice cabin crew provided friendly service and had perfect English She served a ham and cheese Sandwich with some sweets hot teacoffee and water Cabin was very warm too but thats a general issue in Russia in the winter they just like to roast in the cabins A well worth aviation experience

I have traveled through Cairo airport multiple times before and my experience this time was a significant improvement A marked improvement in signage and organization within the terminal itself which made navigation through it a breeze The checkin process was quicker wifi stands and mobile charging stations were finally added the major downside however was the security procedures which were as slow and unorganized as usual and needs a ton of attention Despite the many areas for improvement i was impressed by the positive changes implemented since my last visit and hope they will continue

I cannot say enough how much I enjoyed this airline experience From the check in counter to the TSA at the local tiny airport to the pilots It is totally a different way of flying commercial and just so much more personal I wish more routes were like this because its such a nice experience My flight was also minutes early on arrival which allowed me to get to my next gate with ease Thank you Boutique Air and hope to fly you again some day Maybe there will be wifi next time

Ljubljana to Munich The homebase airport of Adria Airways is Ljubljana and it very small relaxing and convenient It is surrounded by the Alps and the departure was fantastic The airplane was modern and the crew was nice Ontime departure Drinks without alcohol were free and I paid for my white wine Considering that I had a cheap ticket I cannot complain Upgrades would have been available for which includes the lounge

Unhelpful Disorganized Was on a layover from Amsterdam to Toronto Canada I arrived through KLM airlines but my luggage didnt When I asked about my luggage the luggage staff said they transferred it to my next flight which they dont do and my itinerary said baggage not checked through When I left luggage collection and went to the check in area I asked a staff member if they could confirm it was sent through and they said with certainty that they would not have transferred my luggage and to go check again I went back to check again but security would not let me back into the luggage area I told them the story and without even looking at my flight itinerary said it was transferred to my next flight I had no contact with this security officer before nor did they know anything about my situation prior Now to be clear its almost certain that KLM lost my luggage and its not the luggage handlers problem But for them to just lie about it to get rid of me is unacceptable They could have said it appears it didnt arrive and thats fine I cant blame them for that But I just essentially went back and forth between people in the airport not knowing who was telling the truth or who knows what theyre talking about I dont expect Mexico City airport to be the best airport in the world but to be an international airport that essentially has no centralized information center and to have employees who just lie to get rid of you is really unacceptable Im sure they dont get paid the most and I get that

Friedrichshafen Hamburg It was one of my best experiences on a regional flightairline Aircraft was clean The crew CheckIn to cabin crew was very polite as well as highly professional Flight attendant made clearly understandable announcementssafety demos The only downside is that Intersky asks passengers to pay prohibitive expensive prices for onboard drinkssnacks But since they consider themselves as a low cost airline truly providing LCC price level it was no surprise and everybody is free not to buy anything

To get in from the street you must undergo luggage scan first as theres no entry hall To get out onto the tarmac and into your plane note well that theres no queue space the departure lounge seats are right by the exit gate doors Our flight was announced at gate N there are only gates but after minutes delay moved to gate then to gate for people with much luggage for a flight with first come first served seats The hostesses tried to get people to form queue lines in vain so embarkation was a free for all Shocking treatment for an international airport Aside from that the setting is very pleasant

Copenhagen to Vagar in the Faroe Islands with Atlantic Airways RC A aircraft Friendly checkin received baggage tag and headed to the gate Flight boarded in an organized fashion and flight attendants greeted each passenger as you entered the cabin Nice colors and comfortable seats Lots of legroom actually was very surprised Ontime take off and hours to the Faroe islands soda water and coffee serviced complimentary but purchased wine and food was reasonably priced Inflight entertainment was just the flightmap but had my DVDs to watch Landed a few minutes late in crazy wind and rain but the landing was good Parked farthest possible on the tarmac from the entrance to the terminal so we all got wet but that is how it is there Bags off in a reasonable amount of time Oveall a very good flight and for the price a good deal

What an airport Clean easy to navigate comfortable and customs and security are solid Landing in this airport coming back from the United States was just as good as when I left The one thing that would be nice is having preclearing for US customs which would have saved me time once I landed in the United States

I arrived at night so it was difficult to be as observant as during the day but baggage came off the conveyor belt within minutes and I obtained a modern car with a very pleasant driver for the transfer to my city hotel the transfer costing P which was reasonable Overall an airport that delivered for me on this trip

This airport is well organized and easy to navigate its become one of my favorite airports in the world On this trip JFKSFOTPE I flew into and also left from Terminal One recently renovated attractive and spacious It also contains quite a few spaces for relaxation plus many restaurants and shops On arrival my bag arrived before I did On departure I checked in at the Interational Terminal which is connected to Terminal One Going through security at International was fast and easy The only negative was that several of the restaurants in Terminal One were closed in the evening

Boarded by bus on an distant location AN on a very good condition crew was young people friendly and eager to help passengers to place carryons to the bins Legroom was tight I was lucky my next seat was left empty and the flight was barer able We departed on time min after departure they served coffee no free and hours within the flight they served lunch from Buy on board Menu Flight was full and almost all passengers transferring to North American destinations

I fly into Rimini Airport at least times a year to visit family It is a small airport and the restaurant and shops are expensive I love this airport You cant get lost and the best bit is you can go outside on a very large balcony and watch the planes land take off etc Also great if you smoke You are allowed to smoke only outside I would recommend this airport it is still small and friendly

I had booked this fare at a very discounted rate as I needed to travel back to BLR The check in experience was good I had arrived early and there was still time for check in to open so I was told to wait for mins before check in in my luggage Post that I had noticed that the inbound was delayed due to which the departure was also slightly delayed by mins The crew were welcoming and this flight was not completely full During boarding I had noticed that a lot of people had come with trolleys and they were told to check in their luggage which is good as a lot of folks come carrying big trolleys that just block the cabin overhead bins The flight tried to make time en route and landing in BLR was swift along with luggage retrieval One point to note here is that the seat pitch may be on the tighter side compared to other airlines but otherwise this was a good trip where the crew also distributed water bottles to everyone during boarding

The Fokker was certainly old but clean The flight announcements were made in Farsi and English to my surprise The flight was smooth on time and without any nervousness Food was surprisingly excellent Chicken rice and a bottle of Pepsi
Its not a big airport but clean and good However there is not much signage

TallinnAmsterdam is a short flight but crew were nice helpful and were able to understand at least languages they helped my Dutch Grandmother who speaks no English Amenities not normally provided but because flight was near empty they gave out snacks plus complementary tea and coffee They also allowed us to sit in vacant seats which was nice In general a nice trip and much more than was expected for basically a regional airline

I think Dublin airport does a very good job of dealing with large number of passengers efficiently and with courtesy I travel through there at least once a month and rarely come across any issues I think when they get more of the enhanced security scanners it will be even better

Loved flying into Milwaukee We flew in from DC with AirTran to attend our daughters naval bootcamp graduation and what an excellent airport It was a short minute drive to North Chicago We even loved the enterprise rental car pickupdropoff I highly recommend this airport
Great airport not many flights so no hassle From check in to take off minutes Car parking also free
Small airport with few but good services Reasonable time to check in and pass passport checks Excessively expensive duty free It offers a good free wifi service also available outside the air side

A small but pleasant airport On arrival customs officer friendly and smiling Luggage delivered quickly and duty free shops in the arrival lounge On departure staff pleasant including the security check Just be aware that the domestic terminal is very small and offer very few seating possibilities before check in

Its been years since I traveled through Terminal The refurbished Terminal is a world class modern airport terminal It is spacious brightly lit with plenty of seating and dining options aplenty There are oodles of power ports and USB ports at the gates however some of the power ports were not working Bathrooms are very clean The concourses are wide and directions easy to follow to baggage claim Security was a breeze with no wait time for the TSAPre checkpoints WiFi was easy to connect too and blazing fast The refurbished terminal is a significant upgrade to the old terminal

A small airport maybe or passengers a day I am guessing Fifteen flights a day AA to CLT and DFW DL to ATL And UA to DEN and IAH The plusses Fast From drop off to gate in maybe minutes max Friendly staff especially at TSA Small town helpfulness had a cell phone left on a plane returned to the check in desk before I got there to ask for lost and found Nice new departure hall and baggage claim Very airy with lots of light Low cost parking for friends picking me up The minuses The airfares They border on extortionate Many times cheaper to fly from MIA to Europe than to Shreveport And UA AA and DL always seem to have the exact same air fare The local chamber of commerce should work on that Concourses are dated Industrial carpeting remember that Looks like they have not been refreshed since the s Odd quirky amateur art and movie posters and house plants maybe a positive No discount carriers like Spirit Jet Blue Frontier or SWA No mainline jets just smallish regional planes

Terminal was fairly good Despite the bustling atmosphere the staff were efficient and helpful The terminal isnt very well organized but the clear signage made it easy to navigate The dutyfree area provided a good amount of choices the terminals facilities are old but clean and despite the usual rush of the terminal at the time I found a peaceful corner to relax before my flight Overall its not the best airport I have been to but it has a good potential for upgrades and enhancement and I can see them trying to achieve it

Bought a ticket around the world and finally I could try the JAL one of the Japanese airlines My trip was sublime I rate this as the best airline Cabin Crew were outstanding food was delicious wine are perfect As its Japanese it has the automatic toilets on board too Seat comfy Got rest got cocooned and now I know who to fly with

Excellent airport having recently done a roundtrip from Dundee to Birmingham It is really convenient for those working in and around Dundee with reliable flights from both Flybe and Cityjet Air France If you need to get away from Dundee Birmingham and London are ideal for onward connections and you dont have the hassle of having to drive to Edinburgh pay for parking and the long check in times Here you can checkin mins prior to your flight

The new Terminal at Birsa Munda Airport Ranchi is a welcome surprise for many Its a small but modern terminal with a few amenities that are actually not needed as the wait times are low due to low traffic You will find seats on both floors and few coffee shops to make your wait easier The airside is separated by tall glass panels and one can be entertained by watching the arriving departing planes Disembarkment and Boarding is done via the modern aerobridges that are truly of international standards Since it is a small airport the security checks and checkin process is very informal and the staff are courteous and helpful I always have pleasant experience in this small modern airport I wish there were more flights

Its been seven years since I last flew on Lufthansa I was fortunate enough to fly on Lufthansa for the first time in seven years and the moment I got on that plane I felt good Because it was a short flight I didnt have to worry about anything But the best part was that I got a Milk Chocolate bar from Lindt and whats nice is that they have a Lufthansa logo on it what a finishing touch

I departed on th April and was lucky to make my flight I was part of a tour group and as there were many groups trying to leave at the same time and not enough check in staff to process the travelers I made my flight with minutes to spare

Use the airport regularly and its great parking facilities are next to the terminal so no need to go on a five mile cross country slog with children in tow nor wait for a packed shuttle boss and try and cram all luggage and children on board As stated before the airport is small and basic understatement but then again I dont use airports to sit in or spend all my holiday money in shops before i even depart the UK something which I think happens at many of the larger airports A very short walk from the terminal the interim passenger facility as it is more technically known to the plane and then you are away on your flight Coming back is so easy as well the arrivals area is a seperate building from departures If two planes arrive at the same time then I am under the impression that one has to wait for a short period of time foir the arrivals area to clear However after disembarking getting through passport control and getting to the baggage claim belt we were waiting for about two minutes and then hey presto the bags started coming through Again a very short walk to the car park ever present taxis and an hourly bus service tofrom the railway station and city centre are also available and we were offhome within minutes of landingat a bigger airport just down the A I have been waiting for minutes just for the baggage carousel to start revolving All in all it is basic but it does exactly what it says on the tin its a building well two buildings for passengers getting to or arriving from a city by air and it does this with minimum of fuss and least amount of time In some ways it is a good alternative for any inbound passengers wishing to avoid the congested London Airports the bus to the railway station and frequent trains to the centre of London could have you in the capital very easily Heres hoping for the new terminal an increase in services and more airlines I know I shall be a regular user of Coventry Airport and so shall my friends family and colleagues for many years to come

This airport is vastly improved since the previous comment Ideally situated for the catchment area south of the Humber After nightmare journeys just getting to Manchester Aiport my visits to NZ are now via Humberside and Amsterdam Minimum fuss no crowding a relaxed start to a lengthy trip Additional package flights are now offered and the Amsterdam hub is a definite plus There used to be a direct link to LHR with Air UK but this was discontinued before the demise of the airline and never revived Although not essential could be useful on occasion Landing costs I believe
Changes made for the World Cup have improved this airport from small and efficient to small and very slick New access to departures security is welcome

Following the demise of BA Comair we were booked onto SAA for the final leg of a return from the UK on BA What a pleasure to find a proper business class seat with good legroom compared with the European standard economy class seat with the middle seat blocked Check in and boarding were efficient and on board service was good There were no hassles with the transfer at ORT and the A on the second leg had the best regional business cabin I have experienced Very spacious x configuration Again service was good and our overall impression was the the staff were very pleased to be back and keen to provide top service

I was very nervous as was flying on my own for the first time and with my young child All staff were very helpful from the minute we walked into the airport The lady who booked us in was so considerate When we got on to the plane we were met by Joanie she was so welcoming and involved Samuel straight away Joanie then went above and beyond during the flight to make sure we were ok and to help me keep Samuel occupied She was so kind and thoughtful and was very complementary about his behaviour To absolutely blow us away she let us meet Johnathan and Catherine I hope I have names right this made Samuels day He couldnt stop smiling Please pass on my heartfelt thanks to them all what a super team I will definitely be using Loganair again

My experiences have always been pleasant Security lines are extremely short and there is a lot of open space Checking in is never a hasslewe have been able to pass by the checkin desk in minutes or less on the worst of days Bathrooms are clean and theres always a cafe or news store open Delta seems to have the largest concentration of flights at the airport most of them being on their regional affiliates running under Delta Connection Overall the airport is very good clean and friendly

Bournemouth airport assistance staff gave my disabled fatherinlaw priority treatment right from precheckin to the aircraft entry ramp as did the security team It relieved us of much difficulty with the wheelchair security check and long walk from security to aircraft The staff members were super staying with us throughout Thankyou Bournemouth airport you are light years better than Heathrow for passenger convenience parking as well as disabled assistance and friendliness and we will recommend you to others and will actively select to fly from Bournemouth many times again

The airport is fine and clean food was good and getting through the security was fine However the so call dutyfree store is another matter everything was way over priced For example the Local Rum Appleton years old was over USD That is very expensive to pay that kind of money in Jamaica for local rum on a dutyfree when you can buy the same in Ontario Canada one of the higher liquor tax jurisdictions for under USD All of the products on the dutyfree were way overpriced You can get the same rums in the USA at the supermarkets for less from the dutyfree store of Montego bay airport I purchase a Cuban Havana Club year old in Havana on December for USD
Its not a big airport but clean and good However there is not much signage

During the checkin we paid a lot for having a few kilos over the weight limit This was dissatisfying The takeoff and landing were on time Boarding the plane was easy because it was done based on groups Extremely skilled pilot who took off and landed very safely We barely felt anything when the plane touched the ground Seats were very comfortable and the AC was strong Meals were alright given the trips short time I liked the entertainment system but was disappointed to see the WIFI was only limited to it You cant use WhatsApp for example Overrall my experience with Iberia Express was very positive and I recommend this airlineaw for a budget flight

There are a lot of negative reviews for this airlines but for a budget airline what do these reviewers expect Premium airline service They have obviously never flown on EasyJet or Ryanair to make a comparison Flew to Turkey from Manchester and was quite impressed by their checkin service and legroom on the plane Recommend to anyone

HarareLondonHarare Originally booked flight on Friday which was cancelled Flights were punctual and staff friendly Old planes and no entertainment But being the only direct flight to Europe from Harare and with prices less then half of any other airline still OK for anybody wanting a cheap flight to London as long as one has the flexibility to cope with changes of schedule

We recently flew business class New Delhi to Paro and Paro to Bangkok with Druk Air They are a fantastic little airline being only one of two airlines serving Bhutan We were on a trip via Delhi to Paro for nights and then onto Bangkok Both flights on time lounges were shared and and of a good standard Both flights considering Paro being one of the worlds most difficult airports to land in were flawless by the flight deck some amazing views en route and pointed out by the crew Food and beverage were of a high standard and plentiful for hour flights combined with excellent service from very professional and and delightful Bhutanese crew Would certainly use again Only point out being there is no Entertainment or wifi but the views en route you dont need it

Lovely airport With a three hour wait at this airport it was a lovely airport to spend some time before going through the gates Great food options and variety There was lots of seating with tables and we could have food from anywhere Great to keep the whole family happy I am not a big fan of designer stores so the fact that we spent time before security was ideal

Birmingham to Amritsar via Ashkabat No nonsense air line Great Indian vegetarian food There was no flight screens no seat screens We stopped at Ashgabat for one hour its nice modern airport with all facilities The good thing was that the time at Ashgabat and time in India is only minute difference

Very pleasant flight from Kolkata to Paro with Druk Air Friendly and efficient cabin crew Nice snack and drinks Even got boiled sweet for landing Superb scenery en route especially as we approached Paro of course Have no idea of cost as was booked as part of package but overall excellent

This is my home airport Completely renewed a few years ago its now a very good and modern airport Near the city center just minutes by car Its a small airport but its probably the better choice to come to Sardinia Depending on winds you can have a fantastic view over the famous sardinian beaches from your airplane window In the summer sometimes you may find crowds at security checks There are just a few overpriced shops but this is common in italian airports Car rentals taxis and bus are easy available

Paphos to Sochi via Moscow Excellent company and the only one that Im using for travels to Russia Very reasonably priced tickets They are the only company which offers perks before you reach silver status which requires at least flights miles eg free luggage if you have done flights On that particular flight the crew was nice as always food was great for an economy ticket and the seats were comfortable Highly recommended and hopefully they will continue growing

This airport is good but there is no wifi and check in desk is one There air two shops and one cafe The best thing is that there is an outdoor square and a fountain after passport control There are international gates The gates area is modern

I wanted to fly by Air NZ After finding out the Perth route was now going to be flying with WAMOS Air I researched I nearly canceled with all the negative star reviews Wamos Air is the best airline I have ever flown service was fantastic and the seats comfortable Everyone was given a blanket and pillow the food good for airline food You could get extra drinks and food if wanted and periodically they would come around with water On return to Perth it was the same The plane was not dated The lady next to me on returning was quite ill and the cabin crew couldnt do enough for her They even reseated me so I wouldnt be concerned and they could access that traveller in case of added complications

Expecting the worst but a great surprise It was a new building and super clean Great welcome by the airport staff and especially the Passport Control proud of their airport and their country and genuinely do their best to make it a painless process On departure the check in staff were efficient cheerful and helpful A very pleasant little cafe for snacks and once again through to more smiling passport control

Excellent service I flew on a hr m flight and the crew were excellent from boarding to disembarking The crew offered a complimentary snack onboard the seats are comfortable and the flight was smooth There were no delays or inconveniences during the flight The seats recline and although they are a bit old they are still leather and big so its very comfortable The crew helped me find my seat and they had a great attitude when I ordered a glass of water twice I will fly with them again recommended

When we arrived exiting the terminal is quick and our bags only took minutes Departing is also very efficient as its not a large airport and theres only one TSA checkpoint Security only took about minutes to pass through Although the airport is lacking any duty free There is a small cafe area to buy some food Only two gates Our flight even departed early At am Overall a nice little airport

Tashkent Airport has become very efficient on the international side Immigration and customs both on the way in and on departure were quite user friendly Not a lot of shops and restaurants but that was not inconvenient Readers should be aware that the domestic terminal is on the other side of the runway and it could take up to minutes to connect from one side to the other side using a taxi

Today I experience an outstanding level of service and friendliness at Dortmund Airport I forgot my mobile phone in the car of a friend who than brought it to the terminal however I was already checked in at the security so the officer went into the terminal and got my phone for me I have never experienced such a high level of service Also the lady at the gate was very nice and made a lot of jokes while boarding Overall the airport is clean and the signs are reasonable Furthermore the airport is quite small so you wont get lost In Addition to that there are security check ins so the queing times are short The only negative thing today was the wifi you have to pay for it

Arlanda to Marsa Alam return All things considered it was better than the Tui equivalent where our and year olds were only offered coffee or tea no water as a beverage for paid meals Staff were friendly food looked great we packed our own and no price gouging on the drinks service

This was my first flight with Jazz and all in all I was quite pleased The flight to Montreal was short and agreeable The crew spoked both French and English which makes a plus for the flight To my surprise the economy seats were equipped with personal IFE with the whole Air Canada inflight program Food consisted of a cookie and a drink which is more than enough for a one hour flight The only downside of the flight was the delay created by bad luck The aircraft was already late already and during taxi when we were about to align on the runway the tower decided to change of runway making us hour late On our arrival at Trudeau the crew make sure that the passengers going on another flight about to depart left the aircraft first
Flew on th April on day visit to Amsterdam on business Lovely small airport staff friendly good bacon rolls in the cafe A very pleasant relaxing experience

Santiago de Chile to Isla de Pascua Had the opportunity to fly with LAN from Santiago de Chile to Easter Islands a trip I had been expecting tor a long time Although the LAN web site indicated that you should report to checkin a whole hours before scheduled departure time I decided to play it cool and only arrive at the Santiago airport at for a am flight just to see that checkin was still well in progress without any rush Upon boarding the Boeing I just loved the cabin interior very light and roomy with nice LED lights around When finding my seat I soon realised however how small it was Im sure is the narrowest airplane seat Ive ever seen and the legroom was very short for someone of cm I was happy that I was only going to spend hours and not on this plane However I soon found the IFE which offered a great selection of top recent films certainly far too many for this six hours flight As I hadnt downloaded the LAN application on my tablet beforehand there would have been even a greater choice of entertainment available for this flight Soon after takeoff an excellent breakfast with fresh fruit and an omelette was served During the rest of the flight drinks and coffee were served several times The best part of this flight was however the Chilean LAN cabin crew The steward serving my section was chatting around making jokes and asking several times if I needed something more This is the kind of service I would have expected in First Class but here I was enjoying it in Economy Well done LAN

Stavanger airport Sola is a small airport like the one in Bergen and Trondheim Not many international flights but quite many domestic The terminal there is only one is years old but they have started to upgrade everything All in all a comfortable airport

Surprisingly nice flight for a Chinese airline The business class named first class is of the usual type in China ie rows of seats with old seats and small reclining angle The crew was very attentive wine Chinese was decent and so was the food nothing special but ok Reading material is of course restricted to the China Daily and there is no individual entertainment but on a hours flight especially on a night flight this is not essential Flights both ways were on time I would recommend this flight as it is the only airline to fly directly between Bangkok and several places in the Shandong province schedule is terrible but it is still better than transferring

Small international airport International flights limited to a few charters from China Arrival hall domestic has only one conveyor belt which did not work on the day I arrived so luggage were brought in very swiftly by handcart Taxi and shuttle bus available to city center km away Domestic departure hall is adequate and departure gates have sufficient seating a coffee shop and wifi

Quick flight with good service and friendly staff Checkin was efficient Aircraft was clean and welcoming Only negative was the arrival at a station where bussing brought us back to the terminal rather than an airbridge

Orlando to London Gatwick Flight was booked for Norwegian We learned shortly before flight that we would be actually flying with HiFly Did a quick internet search and did not find any alarming negatives We were surprised to see a plain white jet pull up to the terminal We were informed that the flight would be minimally delayed by the crew The boarding process was as smooth as rude impatient customers would allow the crew handled it well The flight attendants were young fresh energetic efficient and very nice a nice change for us The flight crewcaptain informed us right away about the flight route that we were navigating around a storm that he apologized for the initial delay but that he believed we could make up the time He did just that The seats and food were what we expected in economy class so no real complaints there as I choose not to pay for upgrades All in all very favorably impressed with this airline

Amazing service on this airline and consistently great as we flew a few times with them On time check in precision boarding and very friendly through out the whole trip even when it gets bumpy We will fly with Asiana Airlines again as this was the best service compared to Qantas Emirates Air France and SAS that we also used Thank you so much for looking after us on board
Short domestic flight Flight on time well coordinated boarding nice snack box friendly cabin crew good leg room arrival in Krabi at an airbridge recommended

Honiara on the island of Guadalcanal is the capital of the Solomon Islands in the South West Pacific and the only international airport in the country The traffic flow into Solomon Islands is minimal about six or seven flights a week mainly filled with Australian government officials Asian businessmen and the odd tourist The terminal itself was built by the Japanese Government about It is not airconditioned and can be very warm and humid inside given that Honiara is in the middle of the tropics Due to water and plumbing problems the toilets can be unpleasant It is a good idea to check in two hours before hand as checkin queues can be long as departure time approaches Flights are often delayed but airport staff are unlikely to be able to tell you much one way of checking to see if your departure will be on time is to check the Brisbane Airport website to see if the flight left Brisbane for Honiara on time Customs and security is usually quick on departure but customs and immigration can be somewhat slower on arrival Forget duty free shopping on departure shop in Honiara town instead On arrival sometimes the duty free booth is open and if so it does offer good prices on alcohol All in all a hot humid experience which will not leave you feeling terribly comfortable On the plus side staff are usually helpful and cheerful and cleanliness has improved considerably over the last couple of years

Linz is indeed a very small airport however it serves its purpose Facilities are limited and flying in at pm I found the few shops were almost all shut The hourly bus is excellent value for money at EUR compared to the I paid in London approx EUR and only takes minutes non stop to the city centre Beware there is only ONE medium sized duty free shop after passport control

Went through KLIA terminal one domestic section for morning departure and afternoon arrival Despite the age the airport maintains its cleanliness The toilets were kept clean and spotless by the cleaner all the times The custom check for domestic flight a bit crowded due to higher number of flights However the whole process at the custom check was very efficient Lots of cafes and shops available to fill up the time while waiting for flights The wifi works very well for me The baggage claim section still under maintenance I think Its been awhile and the airport management need to check on this Overall very satisfied with the airport facilities and management for domestic section airside I think this airport need a bigger new terminal soon as the present terminal already seems and feels crowded

ANRLCY vv recently with VLM Early morning flight on a Saturday back on a Monday evening Antwerp is a small airport and due to the low number of passengers it functions efficiently and fast My time from plane to car on the way back was about minutes which includes waiting for my luggagee

Waco Regional is not a bad airport overall They only have one flight which is to Dallas but I have heard rumors that United Express is resuming flights to Houston The reason I have given it stars is because their flights are always delayed or late My advice to travelers flying into Waco is to have patience The baggage claim takes a while The car rental facility is not bad for a small town Overall I think the airport shows good quality
Airline staff helped me with last minute web check in cancellation also helped locating the luggage and provided the best support and service for such hospitality and customer delight

Having travelled to and from Vnukovo twice both times flying on German Wings from Berlin it is an infinitely better introduction to Moscow than Sheremetyevo Immigration on the way in was as foreigner friendly as anywhere else in Russia huge lines officious officers scrutinising every last page of your passport and visa but everything else is great The new international terminal is very modern lots of glass On departure Germanwings flights depart from a gate area in the depths of the basement or so it seems but facilities including duty free and food are good if expensive by Russian standards There is a branch of SberBank in arrivals but the rates are awful so try not to change too much here just enough to get into the city centre As for travel to Moscow the best bet is the shared taxi transit van to Yugo Zapadnaya metro and then take the metro These services leave from just outside the domestic terminal right next to the international one

Another really good experience First leg Madeira to Ponta Delgada flight on a Q turboprop Flight left early and arrived early Polite check in staff in Madeira checked both our carry on and checked luggage all the way to Toronto OK snack and non alcoholic beverage service on a hour flight Second leg Ponta Delgada to Toronto on an Airbus On time departure and arrival Good unique Portuguese meal pasta with tuna bacon and chorizo two passes of the beverage cart Both flights had courteous and professional cabin crew for planes that were full lots of announcements from the flight deck about possible turbulence A better entertainment system would have been welcome for the second hour flight

I was a disabled passenger on the Tui flight departure date which eventually took off All Madeirian staff at the airport were polite very helpful in particular the disabled Assistance staff The poor weather affecting the departure will not deter my family from coming back to Funchal All the very best for the new year

Checkin was very slow with just three counters open for the full flight Boarding was unorganized and chaotic with just two gate agents being overwhelmed controlling the crowd There were no boarding groups and at the end they gave up and it was free for all As a result the flight took off minutes late Seats on the A were comfortable with a responsible seat pitch Service was good with ok food

Siem Reap to Da Nang I purchased a flight without baggage I purchased baggage separately for AU with great difficulty via the Cambodia Angkor Air website I received the receipt on Messenger The receipt could not be located at Siem Reap airport I was forced to then pay US to get my luggage on board I have emailed the airline with the receipt and transcript but there has been no response On board I had never seen a refreshment trolley pushed along the aisle with such speed allowing nobody the opportunity to obtain a drink

It was five and half hours flight They served only one breakfast After that they didnt offer anything unless we asked for a snack or drinks They should have offered another light meal two hours after breakfast Otherwise everything is perfect

Santa Cruz Bolivia to Sao Paulo Brazil a saving of about US over GOL At the airport checkin was easy I recommend that you arrive early to avoid the impending line The counter staff was as friendly and they did not charge me for my extra luggage weight I was impressed by the that AeroSur is using on this international flight do note that most AeroSur flights use aging s The flight attendants served a box meal and drinks on this two hours flight and we arrived on time

Used to be very busy in the Soviet times since then reduced the traffic by at least At the same time the new terminal was built with more adequate waiting spaces It is rather modern and clean Food service is kind of slow Public transportation to the city is not on top and I used parknfly only once
Very good airport Satisfied with all aspects of airport Best airport in Kerala Lots of new shops are opening on the airport I am sure this airport will make to top airports in India

Brussels to Milan Malpensa With only euros including drink and snack this flight was a real bargain CityJet flies this route on behalf of Brussels Airlines with a rare plane in the west the Russian built Sukhoi Superjet This turned out to be a rather silent seating plane with a good legroom The nice crew the punctual departure and a truly beautiful view of the Swiss alps made this flight a very nice one

I am sat in a light and airy air conditioned building drinking Cappicino Freddo The queue for checking in was small but very organised and the whole building is welcoming Arrival was just as good although a slight wait for baggage due to three aircraft coming in close together This airport has come on a lot since last year and I recommend it The indicator boards all seem to be working ok and the WiFi is good What more can you want Dont blame the airport for things they dont control

A good experience overall with Eastar Jet flying from Jeju to Gimpo The flight was cheap and easy to book on the airlines website I was sent an email a couple of days before flying Pity it was only in Korean I assumed it to be a routine one that airlines commonly send and assume I was correct as there were no repercussions Baggage is a stingy kg why and mine was I was charged for one extra kilo which seems like taking rules to extremes Everything else was satisfactory Checkin was quick the flight was more or less on time and reasonably comfortable and baggage reclaim quick

VilniusTallinn OV Sept We were very surprised when the checkin lady at Vilnius airport charged us the equivalent of around Euro pp for the checkin The use of the existing checkin machines at Vilnius airport would cause this fee as well she explained to us The only way to get a free checkin would have been the use of a smartphone We did not unfortunately have this possibility Up to now I have never encountered costs for the use of a checkin machine at any airport Apart from this Flight was on time Aircraft clean Quiet and comfortable flight Seats average Only few travellers on this flight Drinks and food for sale Free checkin baggage Very fast baggage delivery in Tallinn airport

Manston is a wonderful airport to fly out of I walked next to my bags as I left the aircraft and collected them withing two minutes The airports size means within another minute I was at the main entrance Departure is wonderful check in was quick despite there only being six desks Within the blink of an eye you are in the departure area Dont expect vast shopping areas or money eating distractions here though

Its been years since I traveled through Terminal The refurbished Terminal is a world class modern airport terminal It is spacious brightly lit with plenty of seating and dining options aplenty There are oodles of power ports and USB ports at the gates however some of the power ports were not working Bathrooms are very clean The concourses are wide and directions easy to follow to baggage claim Security was a breeze with no wait time for the TSAPre checkpoints WiFi was easy to connect too and blazing fast The refurbished terminal is a significant upgrade to the old terminal

RSW is a great airport The employees are nice very helpful The shuttle parking employees are the best especially Theresa My husband accidentally left his backpack with meds computer cash on the shuttle in long term parking today I drove Back hours later got it Everything is there They were so kind helpful Theresa had his backpack in the office What a relief So glad there are such good people in the world

This place is clean and efficient Lots of room and well staffed airport Both the internationaldomestic terminal and the USA pre clearance terminals are modern and the lines are usually moving very quickly US Customs is exceptionally efficient and considering the volume of persons traveling the process is smooth and the staff is excellent and friendly US citizens get to experience an even smoother passage with the automated terminals Just make sure you follow all the rules because some of them might seem unnecessary but if you have had a big win at the casino declare it or loose it after a night in a terrible local lock up and a visit to a magistrate back in town the next day if it is not a Friday
The cabin crew was amazing I forgot my earphones near the boarding gate and they found and delivered back to me The flight was LX on March nd Thanks again for a delightful trip

Gatwick is above all an experience An experience for the eyes nostrils and hygiene that might not exactly be considered favorable Bear in mind I come from the US We have some excellent major airports but also some rubbish ones Gatwick would easily be considered to be among the worst of what Im used to in the US and its the worst major airport Ive seen yet in Europe other than possibly Otopeni in Bucharest The only nice part of Gatwick I saw was the train station upon exiting the national rail Otherwise the checkin areas are depressing and run down like a throwback to whenever Thatcher was prime minister yet without any good cleaning since that time The checkin as well as gate personnel with Norse Atlantic Airlines were honestly surly professional but surly The security process is a hot mess and lines are incredibly long at least I had paid the pounds or so for expedited security While I made it through security quickly I still had to swiftly pay attention to what was going on Walking through the south terminal there were very few places to sit and eat At least the employees at the Pret were nice The floors were dirty and sticky The toilets and accompanying sinks looked like they were also from the Thatcher era The terminal had a pervasive damp dank flatulentlike odor to it not sulfur but still odd and gross Final point I usually like British people for their politeness but Gatwick is a place to see some of the worst in British people In closing if you have to come to London fly to Heathrow as at least some parts of it feel like a proper airport or to London City which is very small and easy Very clearly the privatization of many British airports has not served the British traveler well at all

This is the first review on airlinequalitycom for College Stations Easterwood Airport Frankly I had seen a host of negative reviews on Google and was skeptical about flying out of CLL I am elated to report that my concerns couldnt have been any more wrong First the parking is ridiculously easy immediately in front of the terminal Parking for the first two hours is free and daily parking is something like Second its very easy to get to from Texas AM the airport is on university property or anywhere else in College Station and Bryan but it feels like youre legitimately out in the country Third every single personnel I met from airline checkin agents who double up as gate agents since the airport is so small to TSAsecurity to the cashier in the one little snack shop postsecurity were quite friendly and professional TSA PreCheck also works like a charm there Fourth I was impressed that I was able to check my bag in with ease from CLL to southern Asia Fifth the terminal has obviously been recently renovated so its very modern and clean and yet it feels oddly spacious for such a small terminal probably the smallest actual one Ive ever been in As a side note the airport is so small that to walk from the lower level where groundlevel parking is to upper level for checkin security and departures one must either walk up stairs or take an elevator Thats right theres no moving sidewalk or escalator there This is such a nice alternative from larger busier airports such as Houston Bush which typically has good customer service but is smelly and beyond outdated and Houston Hobby and Austin both of which are very modern and clean but have generally poor customer service

Second last Vueling flight out of Gatwick on Sunday evening Lots of problems that evening with weather in BCN and especially to the south of that airport so plane in was delayed Early indications were for a minute delay but the crew were anxious to make up for lost time and expedited boarding Unfortunately the Captain then informed us that BCN was limiting arrivals and that we would need to wait for minutes before pushing back so losing the advantage that the efficiency of crew had apparently won for us Flight left as outlined per previous comments Flight was exceedingly smooth which counts for an awful lot with this passenger Perhaps because we flew straight across Paris rather than down the Atlantic coast but the tannoy was so poor that I couldnt make out the comments not heard Unfortunate But unimportant vs arriving safely and that after a very smooth flight Very minor hiccups on arrival exactly mins after fairly generous scheduled time Which left the Captain more than a little frustrated as he and his crew had been superefficient Overall its not the QE or the Hilton for sure but in my experience Vueling is always the best price on this route which we use or times per year and based on that degree of exposure to this company I contend that their service is by not as poor as a number of recent posts here suggest

This review is difficult to write since I was never able to actually fly with Air Tahiti Nui The company recently had a workers strike that caused them to cancel multiple flights The issue here isnt the strike it is how ATN handled it Their response to the situation was terrible with not only a lack of communication to affected passengers but purposeful misinformation when you spoke to their representatives My wife and I talked about taking this trip years ago when we got married We saved our money spent the last months planning and then flew to LAX the day before our flight to PPT via ATN Less than hours before takeoff they cancelled the flight They provided nothing more than general statements saying they were in the process of rebooking Then nothing but silence My wife called their representatives later in the day and were told that we would have a flight out THAT DAY and would be contacting us Then more silence nothing Again called in and were offered a flight days from now cutting our trip on half Absolutely unacceptable We ended up not getting rebooked not receiving any direct communication from ATN and had to cancel our trip If they had been more prepared for this contingency as most competent enterprises are they would have had plans in place in why to do when this happens Instead we lost our chance to go to Bora Bora This experience was not unique with many other passengers having to cancel their trips due to Air Tahiti Nuis utter lack of planning and communication My recommendation is to stay clear of Air Tahiti Nui They may not be a problem for your trip but their incompetence is readily apparent If things go sideways I dont trust them to know what theyre doing

This is a small regional airport with maybe a dozen flights a day so maybe it does ok but a booming population and tourism means that it can get crowded On arrival walk through the main hall full of departing passengers and then crowd around the tiny baggage carousel you really have to shove people out of the way when you see your bag On departure checkin and security were fast despite no selfcheckin kiosks but you then have to walk back outside to access departures then theres a few cafes shops and a bar in the departure hall Prices seem even higher than normal for airports Theres an attempt at an observation deck but it has poor views and seems meant for smokers No airbridges and you can get long walks to the plane in the unpredictable Queensland weather Still the airports much more convenient for this area than Brisbane Airport theres plenty of parking longterm for a day or even less you can look it up on the website but the booking function doesnt seem to work and theres a great approach over the water probably for noise abatement then a hard turn at ft to line up with the runway seconds before landing

As has been noted Skavsta Airport is really Nykoping airport under another name but as long as you factor in the minute bus ride into central Stockholm it is a viable alternative for getting to the Swedish capital As these peripheral airports go it isnt that bad On arrival the bags arrive fairly quickly and it was a short walk to the bus These run frequently and apparently wait for the incoming flights which is important of you are scheduled to arrive late Three buses an hour leave Stockholms central bus station for the journey back to Skavsta Returning to the airport checkin is a bit of a slapdash affair There are a number of checkin machines which print boarding passes and baggage tags for both Ryanair and Wizzair flights However if you have luggage you have to join the bag drop queue which is just about as long as the conventional chaeckin queue Most of the machines were unservicable when we arrived anyway There is catering both landside and airside Remember that this is Sweden prices are very steep There is a small duty free shop and well thats about it really There are five gates two of which require passing through passport control and are used by flights to the UK There is nothing the other side apart from a few chairs so you are probably better waiting to go to your gate for as long as you are comfortable in doing so Overall it might not win any awards but it does the job

Premium economy on Eva Air stands out for providing no perks that are now common across the premium economy sector Underwhelming and poor value for money No priority check in or boarding no welcome drink and a baggage allowance lower than offered in other carriers economy service Make sure your bag is not overweight they will charge you even if over by kg The seat has a peculiar design meaning that if your are ft approximately like myself the edge of the seat slowly digs into the back of your knees Fortunately I only had to sit on it for three hours

Avoid this airport if you have a wheelchair I travelled through Oslo airport with my year old disabled mother yesterday We flew in collected our suitcases and stood in line to recheck our bags on a British airline We had three hours and plenty of time to check in First the woman at the checkin was told by someone in Cargo that they wanted a photo of the battery Then they asked for some obscure information about the battery that we did not have and told us we could not fly unless we somehow produced a paper with the information My mother has been disabled for years and has flown several hundred times on flights in Europe and the USA with the same model of wheelchair she still uses Its a well known brand We have only ever been asked for the weight and dimensions of her wheelchair and the type of battery dry cell and how it turns off by key After standing there for an hour and a half another checkin person finally found some information online and we were told to go as quickly as possible to the gate I asked for help getting there as it was minutes before the boarding time I pleaded with the checkin person to get our suitcases on board they had been taken off the plane half way through this incident No help was given as we had to negotiate security the length of the airport and passport control by ourselves There was no time to use a disabled toilet which we knew from our trip through Oslo a week earlier had a broken seat and was dangerous which resulted in my mother not being able to use a toilet for hours she cant walk to use the ones on the plane This was a nightmare experience which only got worse when we landed at the next airport

The airport itself is nice and clean but the staff were awful I consider myself pretty easy going and let a lot of things brush over but the way my daughter and I were treated was completely uncalled for It was myself and my year old learning disabled daughter traveling home from a vacation visiting family in North Carolina TSA yelled at and berated my daughter for struggling to follow exact instructions scaring her and made following instructions that much harder It turned our already stressful day into a nightmare I understand millions of people move through the airport and there are protocols that need to be followed for everyones safety but I can say with absolute certainty we will never fly into or out of Raleigh again Experiencing one moodyrude person is easy to pass off as they are having a bad day but literally everyone Staff really need to get in touch with how to treat travelers like human beings not prisoners Chicago OHare TSAstaff are top notch and were so kind for our trip flying out making our experience this morning that much more shocking

Both Ethiopian Airlines and Asky Airlines have failed to deliver the services that I paid for Asky Airlines canceled our flights as we stood at the airport without a single announcement being made We did not receive an explanation as to why the flight was cancelled and were provided different explanations from every single person that we spoke with from the airline I emailed Asky regarding the cause of the cancellation and have yet to receive a response from anyone Since I had booked my flight directly through Ethiopian Airlines I called their customer support and somehow the Ethiopian Airlines rep was also unable to get any feedback from Asky Airlines How is it possible for Ethiopian Airlines to be a strategic partner to Asky Airlines and not know when theres disruptions with their connecting flights or be able to communicate adequately between the two airlines Even worst when Asky Airlines tried to reschedule us for the next flight they went through the entire process of rebooking and generating boarding passes only to come back and tell my wife and I that the plane was full for our rescheduled flights So after several hours of waiting in Accra Airport we were forced to stay an extra day for the next available flight back to the US It gets even worst because the final destination for our new flight is in a different location in the US since the airline doesnt seem to be able to find any other flight options So now not only do I have the cost of losing a day of travel but I also have the cost of having to book another flight from the new destination in order to get home This is absurd When my wife and I booked with Ethiopian and Asky Airlines we thought we would give them a chance to prove themselves despite all of the negative reviews that we had read online We have learned our lesson and will never fly with either of these airlines again

Nairobi to Eldoret This is by far the worst airline I have ever used in my life of years of international travel for three reasons The terminal managers deliberately withheld information from all passengers as to the fact that the flights were delayed and how long the delays would be making it impossible for the passengers to call ahead and make new arrangements for their appointments and ground transportation just because they were embarrassed to admit the delay in the first place The delays were very very long and endemic hours hours although the itineraries were very short min min flights to near incountry destinations and the flexi plus fare which is higher than other tickets was supposed to afford the ability to change reservations according to advertising without an extra charge however when I changed one flight by a few hours I was charged extra for a new reservation fee and new E ticket fee and was directed to the fine print The terminal managers continually lied to all of the passengers about the fact of delays while all the time continuing to post on the monitors that the flights were on time even when the time had passed They also fabricated delay estimates in min intervals when pressured to tell us how long the delay would be with very long explanations of where the plane was why it hasnt arrived and the fact that no one anywhere in the organization had any estimates as to the delayed departure times or whether we would ever depart This act of deliberate rudeness enraged many passengers who vowed never to ride this airline again There are two other airlines in Kenya to choose from one of which has an excellent reputation and has airplanes painted like giraffes I chose this airline because it seemed to be convenient to book online A big mistake You can book online with the other airlines too and they are responsive by telephone for reservations and changes

I live in Orlando so use this airport frequently I dont know what is happening but it continues to get worse and worse I flew internationally for holiday and returned last evening April th I left out of Terminal A and returned to Terminal C I parked in North Lot Apparently you can take a shuttle from C to the South Lot but not the North Lot WHY So I had to take a shuttle to Terminal A to then take another shuttle to my vehicle in North Lot The shuttle took forever to arrive to C I saw other shuttles Mears off site parking etc circle two or three times while I waited for the shuttle to take me to A When it did arrive me and other other passengers all informed him we were going to A however he dropped us at Terminal B and told us that was his only stop So I then had to drag my luggage across the airport to get to Terminal A to catch the next shuttle That shuttle arrived slightly faster however the driver didnt even get out of his seat to help any of the passengers board He just sat there staring at us A nice passenger helped me load my luggage onboard I had asked a couple people in the airport how to get where i was going and one girl actually told me it wasnt her job to answer that question When I did get to my vehicle and went to pay and leave the attendant couldnt have been any more annoyed that I was trying to pay her She barely could extend her arm to take my payment and seemed severely pissed off she had to actually perform a function I traveled to three countries and therefore three airports and am sadly embarrassed how our city is represented with regard to our airport After customs and retrieving my bags it took me hours to get to my vehicle last night which is horrible Why is there no shuttle to North Lot from C Why doesnt the shuttle that is supposed to take you to A not actually take you to A Why are the workers so rude and unhelpful Really poor on MCOs part

Booked an Air Madagascar return ticket from Nairobi to Antananarivo operated by Kenya Airways both ways cheaper than booking directly via Kenya Airways Onward flight date comes and theres no check in counter for Air Madagascar at Nairobi Airport so I go to the Kenya Airways counter and attempt to check in They have a hard time locating my name in the system but I assume they override it manually and check me in regardless since my ticket clearly indicates that I should be on the flight Fast forward days and Im at the airport in Antananarivo for my flight back to Nairobi Same story no check in counter for Air Madagascar in Madagascar and I go over to the Kenya Airways counter again and they cant locate my name in the system again I go to the Air Madagascar ticketing office and they confirm that Im on the flight I go back to the check in counter and this back and forth happens more times going through security over and over again everyone looking at me crazier each time and each time the people at the check in counter cant locate my name Finally the fella at the Air Madagascar ticketing office issues me a new ticket for later in the day free of charge Nice gesture and in order for this not to happen again I try to check in myself online guess what Air Madagascar doesnt have an online check in feature on their website Im writing this as I wait for my second flight wondering whether Ill have to go through this ordeal again later I recommend just booking with Kenya Airways directly

Really bad service I was requested to pay for a hand luggage euro which is above any reasonable price That was the first and definitely the last time I bought a ticket from that company

Gimpo international is not good Crowded check in long line for ticket control Longer line for security check Passport control ok This airport is a second tier quality Especially compared to Haneda

Finding this airport can be confusing because it recently changed its name from Teesside to DurhamTees Valley Signs on the main feeder roads ie the A A and AM have not all been updated so look out for either There is a free bus to and from Darlington rail station but it takes a while and is only hourly outside peak times At the time of writing May a new terminal building is under construction The temporary entrance is on the west side of the existing terminal and again is not well signposted This airports major strength is that because there are only one or two flights coming and going at any time there are never any massive queues Youll get through security and for incoming international passengers customs and immigration a lot quicker than at NCL or LBA The longterm car park is significantly cheaper too There are selfservice check in machines for BMI flights to Heathrow and desks for all other flights If you want something to eat before your flight I suggest getting it at the pub or caf BEFORE going through security as the only airside food outlet does pretty grim reheated sandwiches and not much else Ditto for newspapersbooksmagazines there is a WH Smith in the checkin area but not the departure lounge but it does have a bar and a duty free shop If theres nothing in it pricewise I would always fly from MME in preference to LBA or NCL because its a very quick airport to get in and out of but the facilities are more limited

Solid airline will fly again Professional spoke English polite efficient good value flight I was scared to fly this airline as I read so many negative views This is my experience I flew from Sydney to I am thoroughly frustrated and disappointed by the lack of action and customer service from Brussels Airlines My flight from Vilnius to Geneva was cancelled on May and I promptly submitted a compensation claim On May the airline confirmed my compensation entitlement of per passenger Since then I have been waiting for payment which was promised to be processed within to weeks Its now September and I still have not received any compensation I have sent over emails and submitted new claims on their website but have received no response Ive also made phone calls to the customer service center sent a direct email to the head of customer service and still nothing This lack of communication and disregard for customer rights is appalling Under European law specifically EC Regulation passengers are entitled to compensation when a flight is cancelled Brussels Airlines is clearly violating this regulation by failing to honor their commitments It is unacceptable that an airline would promise a hour response time but not fulfill this or even acknowledge the claim after more than months This is a serious breach of consumer rights and I urge Brussels Airlines to finally pay attention to my claim and settle the compensation as required by law
