A truly horrible airport with a makeshift immigration area that has simply sliced the departures area in half Unfriendly security staff and once airside there are very limited facilities not to mention seating areas in abundance The cafe and bar and shops are mostly all manned by eastern European migrants and the actual gate areas are a relic from the s around seats for plus passengers They extended and remastered this airport shortly after they culled tourism There once was a lovely open air rooftop viewing area which then became a glassed in lounge now even that has gone Couldnt wait to leave the depressing airport for the last time

Taipei TSA Tainan TNN in economy class on A I made the reservation for me and my children by phone the day before At the airport ground staff was efficient and polite but they all forgot their smile After giving the reservation code we received without any problems our boarding tickets and I paid with my credit card Our flight was delayed for minutes due to late arrival of the aircraft Although the flight was fully booked the boarding went smoothly Before entering the plane one had a choice between several Taiwanese newspapers Most of them were in Chinese but there were also a few copies of English written Taiwan news and Taipei times The one class cabin was clean and bright and the seats were very comfortable I was amazed by the amount of legroom It was much more than I have experienced on several international flights There was IFE useless for such a short flight minutes Commercials were shown all the way during the flight The FA made the announcements in Mandarin Taiwanese dialects and in English Both the FAs and the captain had good English skills There were female FA young and polite but like the ground staff they didnt bring their smile to work The inflight service was a disappointment Although it was a very short flight I was at least expecting a snack especially since it was a late afternoon departure All we got however was the choice between coffee and tea in a paper cup When I took a picture of the cabin a FA knocked that this was not allowed After announcing the approach into Tainan the crew didnt bother to check the seat belts or the position of the seats and table trays In Tainan we were bussed to the terminal where after a few minutes our luggage arrived Before leaving the terminal a ground staff of TransAsia checked whether the luggage identification tag matched so that no one could leave with the wrong suitcase

Not a long flight our row was ignored every time for some reason when passed by for food drink and garbage I specifically booked a window seat because Im neurodivergent and have trouble feeling safe if Im not stuck up against the plane wall or simply put for comfortability so I always make sure to grab a window seat on any flight Ive taken Initially I was seated wrong due to my own mishap and I simply moved to the row in front of me I had a window seat booked on this flight as previously mentioned and was assuming the elderly woman in my spot would get up to allow me in because its simply not her spot she did not so I said something along the lines of excuse me sorry to bother but this is my seat to which she just stared at me a flight attendant was beside me and told me can you please just sit down in the middle shes already taken that seat Im not one for confrontation so I just said I guess so and took my spot in the middle mind you the elderly womans patting the middle seat gesturing for me to sit down while Im getting situated which I found inappropriate she stared at my screen quite frequently through the flight which made me uncomfortable and then started pushing up against me to get me to move everyone else was stationed still waiting for conformation to move when waiting to exit the plane I am in no means wanting to disrespect any of the elderly community but Im tired of older people treating everyone younger than them rudely just because theyre older I will not respect you until you respect me I paid for a window seat and I expect a window seat let alone the lack of guidance from the flight attendant Alas its a cheap flight and theres not much more to be expected

Brussels Airlines damaged my luggage and have not made amends months later After several calls to their call centers Im being told Im going to get a call back within hours but I have yet to get any call back They keep saying the same thing this time you will definitely get a call back Its like talking to a scamphishing company not a well known airline This experience has truly shocked me Lucky I dont need to choose Brussels airlines ever again

I arrived here on a Jetstar flight from Brisbane with my year old mother who needed a wheelchair This latter was provided by Jetstar but then we were on our own to travel from the plane to the baggage area not an easy task as signage was almost nonexistent and some doors along the way were locked necessitating a rather anxious wait until an official with a key card arrived The only lift in the main area of the terminal was broken down although there was no sign about this just a loose flapping internal wall that was evident when the doors opened This discouraged all users including us In the end we ditched the wheelchair and proceeded slowly down the escalator There was a total lack of information signage or assistance of any kind in this outdated dirty terminal I intend to avoid this airport in future

Since March th trying to get refund for our April ticket to Madeira and back via Flightfinder who so far has provided all the necessary info that we have asked them about but Binter Canarias keeps refusing their responsibility and keeps sending our requests back to Flightfinder We liked this airline but this is just unfair policy towards its customers

Departure was horrible Flight was late and there was no notification on the board Delayed flight info was available only online and stated minutes delay however it was over an hour The day of the travel snow blizzard happened It was soo cold for april with large amount of snow and cold winds All passengers were checked in and sent outside the airport to wait to board the plane while the plane was filling gas Luckily the first people who were sent outside as per usual policy were families with small children so they were the longest time outside in the blizzard freezing and being wet from the snow This lasted at least minutes which could have easily been avoided as terminal where we were boarding bas basically half empty at that point with only one flight after ours The airport was filthy Bathroom was one of the filthiest and smelliest places I have seen After the passport control there was NO eating facility or bar only two machines with juices There was only several seating spots for ALL passengers on the checkin and most of the people were sitting on the filthiest floor ever It was a disgrace for an airport definitely one of the worst experiences regarding airports

I used Air Macau for a roundtrip from Tokyo to Narita I was able to get the tickets for a quite low price so I was not expecting much from this airline At the end I was able to get a fair flight from them but there were still some issues that made my journey inconvenient The thing that bugged me was that some items in the cabin seemed to either have issues or was nonfunctional One of them was the tray tables It was mandatory for me to use it as both of my flights included meal But whenever I try to place my food tray on it it keeps sliding towards me It was quite annoying at the time Also in one of my flights my seat recliner was broken Despite the poor maintenance the cabin staff was very friendly and helpful on both of my flights Overall Air Macau is a minor airline and passengers shouldnt expect much from them If you are a person that doesnt mind the poor condition of the plane and want a straight flight to Macau then I would recommend this airline to you If not then I would rather suggest taking other flights heading to Hong Kong and using the ferry from Hong Kong to Macau

Have flown Lynx at least times in the last years and Im done Never again Apart from the endless delays spent one time hours waiting for my flight to leave without any compensation whatsoever the fact that you now get charged for a backpack is ridiculous It is no longer a low cost airline if you start adding every thing up plus the ridiculous flying times Going back to the traditional airlines Certainly a lot less hassle

Absolutely awful airline whose primary aim is to scam as much money out of you as possible they sold me a ticket that included checked luggage but when I turned up at the airline to checkin they charged me to check in a bag both on the way out and back in The information they provide with the ticket and booking is so limited and everything is in french despite booking from the UK The customer service is a complete joke I will never fly with them again

Was horrified to find I had to pay to get water with Thomas Cook Airlines Scandinavia flying from Stockholm to Cancun I mean I understand you can pay for beverages such as alcohol and soft drinks but come on on a hour flight to only supply coffee and tea on two occasions its just inhuman and greedy to make people pay for water As for paying for inflight entertainment once again just money hungry Food was ok what little I had Im not an over weight person and eat normally but portion control is in full effect Staff were ok but I got knocked twice with the drinks cart as the were coming through the aisle Staff are more like sales people only interested in sell sell sell

We flew from Dallas to New York where we had a lay over and changed planes before going to Portland Maine We thought However our flight to Portland was delayed several times and then cancelled late at night when shops closed There were elderly people and handicapped people and some medical issues No assistance was offered The passengers stuck together and tried to help each other as much as possible Had to ask for snacks and water but no wheelchairs no blankets no directions just a lot of rudeness We spent the night on the floor freezing in the airport then next morning when trying to leave nothing but rudeness everywhere Security screaming at deaf boy because they wouldnt calm down long enough to realize or listen to us trying to tell them he was deaf Eating places the same way Dont mind taking your money but dont care if you get what you pay for and rude to boot Check in very inefficiently run

We use this airport at least times a year as we have a residence there They have been increasing the number of flights in and out but the new terminal was built too small to handle the additional traffic Seating often fills up and people are forced to sit on the floor and wait for a flight to depart to free up some seats Check in is slowed by immigration and security agents checking each passengers papers before you get to the airline counter Security lines can back up since there is only two lines If you didnt prepay your departure tax you can wait a long time on a line to do that at the airport as there is only a small office counter to handle this Food is very limited and very expensive Arrivals are the best part as the immigration and customs people are efficient and courteous All in all the new terminal is better than the old one but it already too small and inefficient

La Paz to Uyuni Due to weather issues the airline understandably cancelled our flight to Uyuni upon learning that rebooking was not an option due to tour constraints we were assured we would be reimbursed and provided the link to give our information That was June and in November we still have not received the reimbursement much less any information about it Despite filling out the paperwork multiple times and sending followup inquiries they are incredibly unresponsive and have not provided any indication that we will ever see this reimbursement If you book this airline be aware their customer service is extremely poor

San Jose is a small but plucky tidy and efficient airport marred by a couple of flaws and bottlenecks It is modern and adequate for the passenger flow except Upon departing the early morning flights to cause the security line to grow enormously though it is processed in the most efficient way While more and more airlines have switched to include the departure tax the line can still be huge and at some points of the day its poorly staffed Upon arrivals there is a critical rush hour at noon where several flights from the US Mexico and Central America arrive at the same time causing immigration lines up to hours Other than that immigration is usually quick and baggage claim is very efficient around minutes Customs clearance is also very quick The other topic is the criminal price of the food inside the terminal Costa Rica is an expensive country but it goes to cringe worthy levels where you pay for one Cinnabon roll you pay in CLT for a burger with fries and refreshment You seriously need to come with some food in your stomach especially if you fly in the early morning flights Another uncomfortable point is that there is no arrivals hall per se and once you cross customs youll be literally thrown to the street

Clean with efficient staff Plenty of bathrooms available before and after gates We were out of there in min coming in Small shoppingduty free area on the way out Gates were just as efficient One runway Expensive limited food choices I suggest getting souvenirs before the airport experience

It is extremely unfortunate that the residents of the Cayman Islands paid such a significant amount of money for this airport remodel We departed Grand Cayman on Saturday March and it was absolutely horrible No place to sit waited in line for minutes for a bottle of water There are currently no restaurants or bars to have a drink at before departure The departure hall was packed wall to wall The air conditioning was obviously not size properly for the building and the amount of passengers We had a similar experience on our arrival We stood in line for over an hour to get through customs and immigration I have to say bring back the old airport it was actually better

San Pedro to Belize City Enjoy the experience of a s era third world airline Reservations and confirmations mean nothing Your flight will always be leaving in minutes and passengers cheer when they are finally called to board Particularly difficult on families with children Officials sit inscrutably at the front desk and must be approached numerous times to ensure you have not lost you place in line Really great way to start and end a vacation
Worst Airline ever They combined two flights to save costs Instead of flying Pristina Ljubliana Zrich we now fly Pristina Ljubliana Mnchen Zrich Now we arrive h later at our destination

It took hours mins to clear immigration For over passengers there were only immigration officers This is a joke They want us to come and spend money and give us such a horrible experience from the time we land In this horrible immigration area there was no place to eat or have a coffee or smoke We stood in the line for minutes Then when we came out our bags were not yet there on the belt and we had to wait another mins for the bags Furthermore the free wifi never worked

I had a terrible experience at Gdask airport today at the executive lounge I arrived too early for my flight and decided to avail of its service There is a machine in the departures hall where you can buy a ticket which I used It was a very straightforward transaction The price of Zl came up I inserted my credit card and got a ticket On arriving to the executive lounge I was told that I could only use it no earlier than hours prior to my departure The staff member wouldnt call a supervisor wouldnt let me use the service now instead of later wouldnt refund the cost and actually told me to leave She was extremely unhelpful ignorant and confrontational She actually enjoyed the situation and her power over it She kept telling me about the rules but nowhere on the machine in the process of buying the ticket did I see any notice about a hours timeframe The ticket itself didnt specify it either I respect the rules but they should be clear visible and transparent So two major problems confusing and well hidden rules and terrible staff in the executive lounge
Airport security check is overcrowded prices are very high They cut free internet every minutes City shuttle bus too expensive and not frequent

Shanghai to Bangkok I called their customer service a week before embarking on my journey with Juneyao to verify how much it will cost for an excess luggage Since I never wanted any form of frustration at the airport I called them again asking the same questions after two days which they said same Now on the said date instead of the kg excess which was supposed to be rmb was now rmb I had to drag issues with them until they pulled out the recordings from the previous calls made They later agreed that I pay the rmb and assured me that I was gonna receive my luggage at my destination After a successful flight from Shanghai to Bangkok Airport i was by Egyptair to pay for my excess luggage which has been paid already or else they were going to offload my luggage I was really worried and had no other option since I was a student returning home and had no money on me Now my luggage have been removed and kept in Thailand until I make the payment before it will be brought down to me I see this as a cheat from the airline I got home with no clothes to wear and ever since Ive been wearing the same clothe I wore on my journey home

Flight expensive and left late Gap between seats very small Seats in front of emergency exit row could not tilt back but no notice of this given when booking seat Cabin service was one bottle of water Arrived in Tianjin not at a gate but on the tarmac Had to wait for buses in very cold weather to get to terminal

Tehran Merhabad is the old main airport of Tehran Easy access from city center Before security check there are plenty shops and restaurants after security check the choice is lower Long queue and chaotic scenes at check in also at first security check before entering the airport Second security check was taken a bit easy they not even use hand held dedectors No wifi available smoking rooms after security check available Waiting area after security looks like a bus station
I was traveling from Jeddah to New York and had a transit at Kuwait airport Security guys at the security check are horribly rude I was stunned by the rude behavior

Disappointed with Air Nostrum Air Nostrum said that due to a change of aircraft the CRJ instead of the ATR was not fit to land at San Sebastian airport for technical reasons How come a bigger aircraft like the A of Vueling can land in such airport They diverted us to Pamplona The flight was delayed more than hours Finally in Pamplona they took us in a bus to San Sebastian but instead of using the shortest route by motorway the bus driver told us he was taking the longer route I reached my destination almost hours later than I was supposed to
The worst airport in America Even the basics are impossible Flights delayed only to be cancelled rebooked on a flight with no chance of getting your bags Incompetency from this airport and its staff

Horrible No air conditioning Ridiculous agricultural inspection happens twice Twice Why The seating is uncomfortable Everything is outside Its hot And the buildings block any natural breeze that could provide relief Ive traveled to several third world countries and all of them have better airports Not sure I would recommend coming here unless you get an evening flight out And eat before you get here

Never fly with this irresponsible airline I am a travel agent and unfortunately I had to book many tickets with this new unprofessional Airline of their flights get canceled or delayed and no one is responsible either in the call centre or any office they dont have offices in most of countries

Travel to West Texas from South Texas to visit grandkids times a year Seems like I always have hours to wait either way I am going So I am always looking for a relaxing place to sit I have noticed on this trip that some of my favorite places to eat are no longer here What a pity The sit down food available at the present time is extremely poor over priced there is always a wait to be seated even seating for one If you choose the fast food options there are long lines then no place to sit to eat Why must the city of Houston rip travelers off by charging outrageous prices for food that is barely a step above fast food Also more of variety of food offered would be nice

There is a frequent direct bus from the city centre to the airport which only costs euros and only takes mins The building is large and modern and air conditioned inside We had no luggage to check in so went straight through security which was speedy We had hrs to wait and I was dismayed to find the international departures area is very small with a single tiny coffee bar and one small shop selling duty free perfumes and local products Seating also very limited although thankfully the airport wasnt busy I dont think there are any air bridges so all departures mean walking down outside stairs onto the apron Nice if its sunny

They have to be more customercentric rather than themself I flew from Lagos to Accra by AWA and lamented from where I entered for checking Ground staff kept asking to pay money and most of them did so It begins with weighing the baggage to the porters to the ground staff over there then to the counter while collecting my boarding pass to the person who will transfer my luggage to the transfer belt and many others Also when I paid staff and not the nd one They started saying I was not a good man stingy and many other things which made me feel like that is it a professional airline or the other way around They are not ashamed of their act that also in front of their seniors and surprisingly they also keep mum I felt like falling victim to their demands and ended up paying more than staff That two hrs I spent to do checking was terrible and turned horrible I was traveling with extra luggage and paid a handsome amount for the extra luggage which is an additional income for the airlines and this kind of treatment I received Its a SAD and disappointing I have boycotted AWA and will encourage my friends and family and all known persons to me to boycott this airline who dont care for their regular customers In one word Its pathetic

Brussels to Pau via Lyon Upon arriving at my layover I was immediately notified that I was rebooked on another flight taking me to Toulouse and a driver there would meet me and drive me to Pau that evening There was bad weather in Pau and the flights were cancelled I was a bit hesitant but I was assured that getting me to Pau that night was their top priority possibly because of my status with Delta and sky team So I flew to Toulouse and had to wait a few minutes for most of the people to get off the plane before I could retrieve my baggage which was all the way in the back I walked downstairs and didnt see anyone I walked out to the taxi area to see if someone was holding a sign and there was nobody I walked back inside to see if I missed somebody but I didnt even see the other people that also were placed on this flight and driven to Pau I was stranded approaching pm on a Sunday with no means of any customer support what so ever After doing a quick internet search I also realized HOP purposely does not even have a customer service number to call All they have is a poor form to fill out and you get a response over a week later or in my case I am on my th correspondence with these people and they still fail to see the problem I missed my am appointment the following morning and had to eat the additional hotel bill for the night in Toulouse and in Tarbes because notifying them at midnight that I was not going to be there was not good enough I contacted Air France but after minutes on the phone even they were unable to access any information within HOPs system

I have done my fair share of travelling this is hands down the worst airport out of the ones Ive been to Rude and incompetent staff Had such an awful experience I will avoid flying through China in the future At least through Shanghai China is also one of the countries I havent travelled to yet and now have absolutely zero desire to There are so many nice countries with lovely people in the world There is no need to travel somewhere with people so rude Awful first impression Avoid Pudong airport at all cost The people there have no idea what they are doing are unhelpful and will treat you like trash On a side note its also a huge mostly empty airport Very few shops and eateries

This airport gets my vote for one of the worst airports in the world Services are dismal There is nowhere to sit There are maybe functional check in desks in the entire airport One pair of public bathrooms filthy Not a single luggage cart to be found The construction mentioned in another review seems to have been left unfinished and all the construction barriers are still in place This means you cant pull vehicles up to the arrivalsdepartures area you have to walk a considerable distance from the clogged makeshift parking lot to the terminal Fine if you have one roller suitcase not so fine if you have a large number of bags to check We had to make trips back and forth from the parking lot to check in to carry our equipment Oh and the icing on the cake Customs agents that had to charge a fee aka bribe to get our equipment out of the country even though we had all the proper paperwork

Simple clean and functional airport Check in and security ws doe with ease The food vendors are on the expensive side and do not accept credit cards Seeing as most passengers rid themselves of local currency prior to leaving this presents as a problem

The airport is located just west of downtown Papeete and is on the sea front On arrival at the terminal you note that the front of the building totally open This means that the waitingcheckin area is hot and humid as there is no air conditioning It also means that the waitingcheckin area is not as clean as some would like The ticket counters are located a few inches behind doors that roll up and down The airlines only have their checkin counters open the rolling doors in the up position about hours before the flights depart Food service and shopping are both limited in the departure area before the security check point After passing thru the security check point there is additional and better shopping but even less food service options All food both before and after the security check point is expensive Seating in the international departure lounge after the security check point is also limited There are no bridges from the terminal to the planes Passengers need to walk on the tarmac from the terminal building to the plane and then climb a set of rolling steps to enter the plane The terminal while workable needs to be updated to meet modern international standards

This is a very small airport serving the island of Pulau Redang in Malaysia It resembles an airstrip more than an airport and serves only one airline Berjaya Air There is also only building with separate arrival and departure halls and small commercial shops selling souvenirs There is no airconditioning The baggage crew will collect the baggages from the plane and trolley them to the arrival hall where you would have to claim them There are no baggage belts Coaches would be waiting right outside the doorsteps once you clear immigration to transport you to your prebooked resorts Journey is about minutes from the airport to Berjaya Redang Resort where most people travelling via Berjaya Air would end up

Spent hours in airport with minimal information as flight cancelled then rebooked then cancelled again Gate area is like a third world airport with no accurate information and no seating with many sitting in the floor Would never visit Azores again until they improve their Airline

Flying with this company was an awful experience seats are so close that practically you breath on the neck of passenger in front of you staff quite cheeky and unable to offer reassurance to distress passengers who had to endure a long flight just to be told that they cannot land in cluj due to heavy fog we had to land in Bucharest and wait people were obviously very tired and staff didnt help not even with water when passengers asked Their answers were cheeky and dont know the meaning of politeness or costumer service manners

This is a basic airport very small and expensive with only a few stores both landside and airside However security is quick there is seating and charging points available in the cafe The connections to public transport are poor you will need a taxi to take you to Nykoping railway station or take the coach however this is expensive and can take up to two hours There are indoor smoking booths near the gates

As a gold elite plus holder I can use the Madrid lounges The trip was uneventful until I got to Madrid airport having to wait one hour in a passport queue Then attempting to enter the puerta del sol lounge where the receptionist seemed to have taken on the role of an autocratic authoritarian prison guard The police checking passports are far more pleasant and civil they are decent people Where AENA recruits it staff from I have no idea but they must treat them really badly if they are this nasty

At the arrival I had an issue with m luggage The employees in the luggage office were helpful The airport is small but well equipped At the departure only the security control was slow a bit Somehow they rescanned my electronic devices from the hand luggage The departure terminal was small cozy the staff in one of the caf were friendly The plane took off in time

Alicante to Stansted Terrible delay Delayed hours and no information as to why Check their flight history all are delayed Soon to go out of business I think Booked because of the cost and the leg room was good Sat on the tarmac for mins without AC

Absolutely appalling The flight was hrs late with absolutely no information just signs to keep watching the flight information board A plane eventually arrived at instead of it was unmarked so obviously a replacement plane which was dirty very uncomfortable no apology for the delay given I was in Business class the food was dreadful all covered in cling film did not look fresh and plastic cutlery Poor service grim flight very pleased to disembark Will never flight with them again I found out that Easyjet fly to Tunis if only Id known

Through a lack of concentration and waiting to board at the wrong gate I missed my flight to London Stansted I returned escorted to the checking in counter to get another ticket for the following day The agent who was available and did place order for the ticket said rather acerbically that it was important to concentrate when going through departure This is self evident and I resent the comment made as everybody lacks concentration at times and mistakes are made On departing the airport for an overnight hotel stay near the airport I was told the printed boarding pass would be issued the following day which he then repeated for confirmation On arrival at the airport I saw the same agent who asked if I had my boarding pass Now who is lacking in concentration Another agent I spoke to and who did hand me the boarding pass was courteous and very understanding of my situation and if the other agent was of a similar nature and character I would have given Airport staff stars On departing Narbonne I had a choice of airports Carcassonne or Beziers On reflection I wish I had chosen Beziers

Do not use this airline if you have any other options I travel instate extensively for business Over the last month flights into Kotzebue got cancelled Last week my flight from Homer got delayed and I missed my connection in Anchorage back to Fairbanks Alaska Airlines although a partner said it was my problem that I missed my connection Have a heated discussion was finally given a seat with a hours wait in Anchorage Yesterday May I flew to Dillingham Again the flight out of Anchorage was delayed and for some reason my one small suitcase was not onboard I was told it would arrive on the pm flight and did not This morning I was told it would be on the flight and it was not The desk agent in Dillingham tried to call the Anchorage desk and no one will answer the phone A family member called the corporate office an hour ago she was told the desk was too busy and we have not heard back

Was easy to get to however after I checked in my luggage I never got them at the final destination as they never made it there Every time I fly from this airport I have an issue for both Domestic or International flights
Airport was dirty Dustbins were uncanny and overloaded Washrooms were extremely unkempt and filthy Thats not how we expect an International Airport to be

Glasgow to Lourdes this journey proved all the negative reviews I had read about this airline to be spot on Plane arrived at Glasgow four hours late after which we eventually boarded Our troubles were just about to begin After counting the passengers on the plane at least half a dozen times the cabin crew asked passengers sitting in the front seats to move to the back Caused great inconvenience and lost time We arrived at our destination approx seven hours late and five hours late going home

Tried to book weeks parking in August Nothing available This is an airport that is trying to increase passenger numbers but they have not even got enough parking for the low number of passengers they have got at the moment Rubbish service they need to put someone in charge who knows what they are doing I checked the same dates at Bristol options available Wonder where I will fly from next time

Very sad experience on Dec rd in Berlin Airport They had to leave people behind in Berlin because in the airplane there were a few seats that were not functioning properly apparently Regardless of our emotions or business duties we had going on in Dubai Of course money is going to be refunded but I still cant understand how badly a flight can be organised that you oversell tickets because of badly maintained seating in economy class Very poor management with high damage to us as passengers

No way to get a refund My flight was cancelled three times in and back then the company refused to refund instead they issued a coupon that had a refund option after three years And now when the time has come they tell me that because Im a foreigner I can only get my refund in their office in Russia Kazakhstan or China I do not recommend anyone to fly with this company ever

Needs to hold itself accountable for their actions Arrived at our destination only to realize about of passengers luggage was not on the flight Only one passenger had her luggage how was this even possible Had to wait for about hours more without any form of compensation What was even more annoying was the fact that they didnt seem to care much about it as many clients were frustrated with the situation They need serious competition from another domestic airline in Ghana

I was flying alone to Chongqing The booking process was easy but I left my camera on the plane I felt anxious When I came to the transfer counter and told them the situation the staff were so kind They made some calls and directed me to the lost and found centre when I found my camera

I truly believe that the woman at Passport Control saved my life on Thursday July After being the last to disembark from a British Airways flight from London I mustered up what little strength I had as I approached Passport Control The woman at the entrance to Passport Control took one look at me and said You are having a medical emergency Come with me to the wheelchair line She whisked me to the front of that line and waited for the EMT staff to wait on me I was taken to the Banner Medical Center via ambulance where we discovered I had an acute case of Pulmonary Embolism I was going to try to push through my final flight to Tucson and get tomy home city Had she not recognized the acute state of emergency I was in and taken me to get care I may well have died I will never forget her

Varna airport is interesting Aircraft are parked on stands about m from the airport An old truck with airstairs pulls up beside the plane and you get off and wait mins in a really modern bus The immigration hall serves its purpose but once you get into the baggage hall thats where it gets interesting st century technology beside old world equipment It looks like they have just decided to put things in there without any real thought or planning There are baggage belts which seem to have been cut into the floor The baggage hall is about m X m and looks like it has been built to handle flights and there are only a couple of toilets in the baggage arrivals hall I think that mins was far too long to be waiting for my bags considering that my flight was the only one at the airport As you leave the baggage hall into the arrivals area its just like anywhere else scrum of people keen to get you into their taxi A word of warning about taxis though Its about a min drive into Varna about km The taxi drivers are always keen to rip you off and have a trick of pressing the meter button or times depending on how much they want to rip you off by A taxi fare into Varna should only cost about leva

Rude treatment of elderly passengers This is not our first time visiting Tbilisi It was always great This year I decided to meet my elderly parents in this city We were flying from America they were from Belarus We had a great time and were inspired by the beauty of Georgia its hospitable people unique culture and great food But all of this was crossed out at the airport Both of my parents are over years old and it shows At the security screening they were never offered help or possibility to skip the line Moreover they were rudely searched and groped and my father was taken to a separate office where he was forced to take off the hernia belt which he never takes off and cannot put back on on his own We got to the airport more than two hours before the flight time However because my parents cannot walk quickly all of this screening took a lot of time They were at the security line past the boarding time Even after their names were announced on the PA system several times they were not allowed to go through passport control without standing in line As the result they were forced to run as fast as they could to get on the plane My parents are very kind people they never complain about anyone and try to stay positive But I see that for a couple of days now they have not been able to recover from this stress I am shocked by this attitude of the airport security and border control staff I am very sorry that airport services demonstrate such treatment towards guests of their country

Old worlddescribes this airport in Southern Russia As with most flights in Russia passengers arriving on my flight were bussed to the terminal even though it was less than metres across the tarmac Let out and straight into the main hall to meet and greet where we had to wait until the luggage had been put on the conveyor then into a side room to collect our things As with all Russian airports and I seriously think this is a good policy you have to show your matching luggage tags before you are let out of the room Taxis are available of course or you can catch a bus to the eastern suburbs or just walk across to the main road its only metres if you want a bus in the other direction Didnt use it for departure so cant comment on things like checkin
